reviews.review_text: OMG THIS IS AN AMAZING PRODUCT HANDS DOWN! It leaves your skin feeling smooth, it leaves your face with a nice shine and smells amazing! I apply before my moisturizer and great feeling and refreshed skin! Complimentary from Sunday Riley!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Pleasantly surprised with my results! This was a great match for makeup! Nearly unscented, and a little goes a long way. Can be a bit heavy for a full skincare routine or before layers of SPF. I do have sensitive skin especially in the eye area and I had no irritation or reactions. Would purchase and recommend.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: An ideal finish for makeup preparation. Light matte with a bit of a CC function for a fair complexion. I was aware this is not a sweat proof or water proof formula but I was shocked to see the suggested reapplication timeframe was 40 minutes. I’m afraid it isn’t well suited to my needs but I remain a fan of the brand.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_title: Nice, but not suited to my needs.
reviews.review_text: Suggested reapplication timeframe is 40 minutes. Ideal for a quick outdoor workout but not practical for a long day of SPF protection. One ounce lasted 7-8 applications so this went quick. The formula was light and thin. Did not irritate or cause acne, however I prefer 80 minute guaranteed efficacy.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I was chosen to review this free for my opinion. I’m not terribly impressed for the price, this was a sample that lasted about a week. I can’t say I notice any results or would recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: Very smooth, totally worth the money.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_title: Bye dark spots, hello healthy skin
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample. I use one pad every week for two weeks in a row so far. I absolutely loved it! I apply in the evening after cleansing. It exfoliates my skin and helps refine the ski texture. I had dark spots on my cheeks due to sun exposure. After two weeks of using, I feel they are getting lighter and my skin is more youthful and smoother. I can’t wait to get some more for my bestie because I know she will definitely love it as much as I do.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this as a gift. And it’s my sec bottle. I use twice a day. The antioxidant-rich, ultra-hydrating buckwheat honey renews the skin’s appearance for a dewy, healthy-looking glow.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this product once I started using it correctly. The first time, I applied it to my skin without warming it up in my hands; it was difficult to rub in without applying it unevenly. After looking it up, I realized that I should have been warming it up and then pressing int my face. Since changing the application process I have been very happy with this product. My perpetually red cheeks looked flawless even without using any other products. Note: Those with acne scars and dry skin may have trouble with this product, as it looked patchy in dry areas and did not cover my acne scars as well as I had hoped. However, ensuring that my skin was hydrated and putting a little concealer on top of my scars made these issues go away. Overall, this product met my expectations and I would probably repurchase in the future.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this sunscreen. It has a milky texture that goes on super smoothly. I did notice that my skin looked a little oily/greasy post-application but made my skin look glowy within twenty minutes. It did not pill at all and I would definitely wear this under makeup or by itself while at the beach or working out. The packaging is cute and tiny while containing a lot of product. I am comforted by the fact that it is ocean-friendly and Hawaii compliant.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen stick is SO handy! I re-applied this over my makeup after using the Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen; I am so happy that I found a sunscreen that provides me with ample protection from the sun without compromising my base makeup! I noticed no streaks nor a weird smell and am totally going to keep this in my handbag for daily touchups.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Fair warning to those with sensitive skin…
reviews.review_text: I wanted to like this sooo bad bc the reviews and it smelled really nice- buuuuut after using it for around a month my skin is so dry, irritated, and breaking out really badly for the first time in a couple years!! Before buying it I thought this was in the same realm as a gentle cleanser and it absolutely isn’t.. So fair warning if you have sensitive skin DON’T USE THIS. I don’t think it’s all bad, but it’s not for everyone and definitely not for me.

reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this stuff for nearly 4 years now and it’s a staple in my skincare routine. It has helped get rid of my problem areas and maintain clear skin! Anytime I run out I go into a frenzy and run to the nearest Sephora. People need to get over the smell because it isn’t that bad and your skin will thank you!

reviews.review_text: This stuff was alright. I also went through it so quickly I feel like I didn’t really get my moneys worth!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: You don’t understand how much I love this stuff. It’s so hydrating and feels so luxurious on my skin. A little goes a long way. I’ve tried other moisturizers from Glow Recipe and First Aid Beauty and this one is my favorite by far. Might be a little overly moisturizing for oily skin especially during summer, but it works really well for my skin. The smell is also lovely and not bothersome.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: When I became a wedding photographer, my forehead started breaking out and it seemed like nothing would get rid of those nasty recurring acne! I never had problems with my skin before, but working 10 hours outside during the most hot months of the year + sweat mixed with sunscreen brought out the worst acne. It didn’t help that I constantly had my smear glued to my face and would wipe the sweat off my forehead with hands because there would simply was no time to take out a proper face wipe :( so I ended up with huge, recurring forehead acne that would leave dark scars and always appear on the same spots. I struggled with it for 2 years and I finally figured out a skin care regime that worked and  the Ordinary’s niacinamide is the key product! It cleared my skin and so far it has been keeping my forehead acne under control. I literally don’t go to bed without applying it and I’ve been religious about it. It’s been another 2 years since it cleared out my skin and I keep using it because I’m afraid if I stop, the acne would come back!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my favourite cream for summer. My skin gets oilier in a hot weather and this cream doesn’t clog my pores or feels heavy on my skin. I’ve been trying to find a perfect hydrating face cream for summer for a long time and when I found this 3 years ago I never looked back. The texture is very pleasant and applies easily. Skin is left illuminated and feels well hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This is my favourite cream for summer. My skin gets oilier in a hot weather and this cream doesn’t clog my pores or feels heavy on my skin. I’ve been trying to find a perfect hydrating face cream for summer for a long time and when I found this 3 years ago I never looked back. The texture is very pleasant and applies easily. Skin is left illuminated and feels well hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for 3-4 years now during winters, and so far it’s been working for me. I have combination skin with dry cheeks and a slightly oily t-zone. It works well for both. Not too heavy, not too light. The skin looks illuminated and the radiance shows through even through foundation (I’m using Chanel). I receive many compliments and people asking me what moisturizer I use. I’m 29 and I like the fact that it has some anti-aging components that are not very agressive.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: Totally amazing mask .. I’m so in love with it after using it for the first time my face become more texturized and leave my face super soft, clear and it gives glow too .. Definitely recommend to all the ladies to try it worth every penny..

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Love this product. Love the result after using it. It makes the skin super soft and smooth, fade acne scars. I have the dry skin, once a week at night I use DE Virgin Marula Oil and DE Lala Retro Whipped Cream after this mask. Next morning I’ll wake up with smooth, glowing face.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Bought it to clear acne and blemishes. It really does the job. Loving the result.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: What a lovely lightweight, cooling moisturizer. I was gifted this product from Fresh in exchange for my honest review. I have combo oily skin and this wasn’t too heavy as a moisturizer. I do think that it is pricey and you can most likely find a cheaper alternative, but for the product itself, it worked well in the hot, humid weather! I find that it gives me enough moisture without feeling too greasy.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I think it’s a nice hydrating eye cream. I don’t think it is worth the high price tag, and have not noticed a huge difference in my eye area. But, if you have the money to spare, it’s a fine buy. The packaging is really cute though, so there’s that. Plus, there are great ingredients- such as retinol and niacinamide.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: What a great moisturizing primer. I had heard a lot of good things about this product but was a little skeptical. It has been a really great hydrating primer that makes my makeup look a lot smoother and stays on well through the day.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Wow, how have I not tried this product from dermalogica before? It is a rice powder that is extremely gentle on my skin and makes my face feel so soft after each use. It has been gentle enough for daily use and has been effective. I am impressed!

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Wow, how have I not tried this product from dermalogica before? It is a rice powder that is extremely gentle on my skin and makes my face feel so soft after each use. It has been gentle enough for daily use and has been effective. I am impressed!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Pros- light watermelon scent, very little white cast. Cons- pilling. This sunscreen did not play well with certain moisturizers. Basically ruined my entire makeup application. Also feels slightly greasy/thick.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I use this everywhere on my face except on my t-zone and I LOVE IT! It’s finally getting rid of old acne scars that I have been trying to get rid of for years. It has a nice citrus scent that quickly fades and it doesn’t leave my face feeling sticky. I’ll continue to repurchase this and recommend it to everybody!

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: I only use this on my t-zone because that’s where I get oily and this makes my forehead waaaaay more oily HOWEVER it has gotten rid of some texture about my eyebrows that I have not been able to get rid of with anything else. It has also made my face less red so it is worth getting more oily throughout the day. I will continue to repurchase and use it.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this sunscreen! I have very oily skin and this helps keep my makeup looking good through the whole day. There is very little scent and no white cast. For the price you can’t beat it.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: This product really exfoliates and leaves skin so soft!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is nice if you have larger pores. Made my skin very soft!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Serum feels amazing on my skin. Only got a sample, but plan on purchasing soon.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: So I originally tried this product when I was on accurate and dealing with all of my pimples coming to a head and the worst skin redness I’ve never experienced in my life. I could not stand putting makeup on my face because of how dry I constantly was and a Sephora employee recommended this to me. THANK GOODNESS is all I can say. This stuff did wonders for me. It’s by no means a miracle product but it made me feel less like a tomato, kept me feeling less dry and also has spf, you really can’t go wrong with that. A little definitely goes a long way, and it looks a little gray until about 10-15 mins have passed. But after that you’re golden!! Highly, highly recommend!!!

My skin feels very supple and full after using this and it doesn’t leave behind a residue of any kind. Definitely recommend if you’re on the dry side and for winter months if you lean more towards a normal complexion!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m not usually a serum person, I lean more toward cold pressed oils for any targeted skin concerns. BUT, this one is an exception. I probably wouldn’t have tried it but I got it as a sample from Influenster and I’m so happy I did! I struggle with redness regularly and this has made subtle improvements over the last few weeks I’ve used it. I’d definitely would recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I really love this product, I love the weekly peel they offer as well and I usually go back and forth between the two when I purchase.  I really do notice a huge difference in the texture and glow of my skin when I am consistent with these!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for quite awhile and am not very impressed.  I was expecting this to be amazing after reading reviews on this line in addition to the price point.  I feel like my skin feels dry even when I mix with a cream and looks duller using this vs. every other product I have used.  Giving it 3 stars bc while it doesn’t seem very effective it didn’t cause any breakouts or anything like that.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: In love with this moisturizer!  I have been using it for a few weeks now and my skin has not felt or looked better in quite some time.  It is not heavy feeling at all, absorbs nicely and keeps my skin feeling fresh!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the perfect addition to my growing D.E. Skincare routine!  I can already notice a difference in my skin after 2 weeks, and no breakouts or dryness at all!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been looking into fragrance-free products and coincidentally got this bad boi. Consistency is thick and creamy to a point where it might be suffocating for some people. I can almost compare the consistency to Olay regenerist micro sculpting whip, drunk elephant polypeptide, or cetaphil: initially heavy until product sinks in. Super moisturizing and makes my face feel supple. Packaging is cute!!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: Received for free. Smells amazing!! Llike a floral baby power. I used this without moisturizing my face and works well with foundation. Texture is kind of silky and watery. Love this product and may purchase in the future!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This doesn’t feel like sunscreen. More like a moisturizer or primer. The consistency is more liquid than milky. It also smells amazing. This product makes me want to use sunscreen more often. Shiseido anything is my favorite

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for a month now and it works well. I haven’t received any blemishes from this product. I will say that I don’t have a lot of puffiness to begin with. I did use it on my forehead though! I have fine lines there i’m trying to get rid if that it’s helping to soften up.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_title: super soft and great for sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: This is my go to moisturizer every night! I originally got this as a sample but it was so good that I ended up using this as my main moisturizer! It’s soft and smooth and doesn’t affect my sensitive skin negatively. I will say I give half a point off for the scent. I’m not really a fan. it doesn’t smell bad or anything, I just prefer floral scents. My friend who tried it said she liked it though, so it could just vary person to person. It doesn’t stop me from using it all the time though, which is why I didn’t take off a full star.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: it was very soft and hydrating! I definitely felt like it was helping and a great moisturizer for my 10 step skincare. it smelled fine and didn’t irritate my skin which is great :)

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: it was very soft and hydrating! I definitely felt like it was helping and a great moisturizer for my 10 step skincare. it smelled fine and didn’t irritate my skin which is great :)

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I received this product for a honest review for influenster. I was hesitant because there’s so many mix reviews on this product but I love it . You can use it as a part of night time routine or before applying makeup . It helps moisturize and give a glow which is perfect for summer time skin . I love to wash my face and apply when I just want to wear no makeup and do errands when it’s too hot for makeup .

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I receive this product for honest review. It’s pricey but if you like high end then I highly recommend. It’s a very hydrating serum perfect for dry skin . It does hydrate and work but it depends on if you want to spend the price .

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received this product for a honest review . The formula is thick and creamy and when applied it lasts and it’s great for sensitive dry skin . It’s pricey but worth every penny .

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I I received this Smart Clinical Repair “wrinkle correcting Cream #freeproduct from #Topbox in exchange for my honest review. This product has a thick texture and has no perfume scent which I like. It absorbed  quickly into my skin and left it feeling hydrated. My skin felt soft and motivated greasey. Unfortunately since it was just 1-2 uses due to a small sample, I’m not able to tell if overtime it would help with my wrinkles and fine lines. The price to way to expensive for me and I don’t know if I could recommend it because I’m not able to continue to use it.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this Smart Clinical repair “wrinkle correcting eye cream“ #freeproduct from #topbox in exchange for my honest review. This eye cream product had a nice thick texture but felt light on my skin. It left my skin feeling  silky and smooth. The scent was very light also. But due to it being a sachet, I’m not able sure the long term effects.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this Smart Clinical repair “wrinkle Correcting Serum“ #freeproduct from #topbox in exchange for my honest review . The serum was easy to apply and made my skin feel smooth and hydrated. My skin didn’t feel sticky or oily, it absorbed real quick. After application  my face was looking brighter and overall refreshed. I think if I was able to use it longer, I could see a excellent  improvement with my fine lines. I would recommend it if you can afford it.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This is my first review but I was compelled to write it simply because of the quality of this product.  My skin feels amazing.  I had slight discomfort when I first applied it near a blemish but it went away after the first 10 seconds or so.  After washing it off my skin was smooth and felt refreshed.  Twenty-four hours later it still feels amazing.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I wear this lip sleep mask at night and during the day when my lips are dry.  Especially in the winter overnight it moisturizes my lips.  Awesome product especially for the price!

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: This is the BEST Sephora cleansing wipe.  It’s gentle enough to use daily and the exfoliating side is enough to get your face clean without causing discomfort.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Not the consistency I’m that I was expecting. Not like witch hazel. Little thicker. Goes on smooth and feels so darn good on my skin. Haven’t noticed change in pore size but will keep applying. So thankful to have been given this for free to test.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Not the consistency I’m that I was expecting. Not like witch hazel. Little thicker. Goes on smooth and feels so darn good on my skin. Haven’t noticed change in pore size but will keep applying. So thankful to have been given this for free to test.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary to review because of that I only had one pad to test. After one application I could feel it working but not enough uses to be able to really comment. I know the goop brand and therefore imagine it is a really great overnight peel.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Makes my lips feel soft and smooth. The scent isn’t overwhelming. I will be purchasing the other colors it’s that good.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Feels nice on the skin. Refreshes the skin doesn’t leave my face feeling sticky afterwards. Watermelon smells perfectly not to strong. Love to put it on at night before I sleep cools off my face.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: The holy grail of skincare products....I have very oily skin, with a tendency to be very splotchy and red, and generally a lot of blackheads on my chin and nose. After about 2-3 weeks of using this once a day (morning or night, sometimes both), my oiliness is insanely reduced, my blackheads are virtually gone, and my overall tone is much more even. I had about a week of purging (just smaller pimples and whiteheads) but after that it was smooth sailing. Absolutely worth a try for everyone!! This has changed my skin and I can’t live without it now!! And you can’t beat the price.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I developed eczema (red super itchy, flakey patches)  in the last year (28 years old and stress induced). I went to my dermatologist, went to light therapy, did the whole Cera-ve thing. It wasn’t until I randomly bought the eczema body cream that my sores(from scratching) cleared up. So I bought the face balm and wash- which I love. Now I’m ordering pretty much the whole line. I had red ‘lizard skin’ in my elbows and flakey skin to my scalp. To the point that it bled. It was bad and I used steroid cream (triamcinolone acetonide) to help temporarily. As I started using these products as part of my nightly routine, as well as stretches and 10 mins of peaceful stretching (full disclosure) my eczema is gone. GONE (exhale). After over 2 years. Give it a try.

reviews.review_title: This is a need not just a want!
reviews.review_text: Wonderful cream! I’ve been looking for something that’s hydrating for my dry skin but also absorbs. This cream is perfect. My skin just takes it in but also continues to hydrate through the day. I’ve struggles to find a cream that has the right water to fat/oil ratio. They’re either all water and don’t hydrate all day or just oil that sits on my face. This cream is the perfect combination and makes by skin glow! Bonus- I have eczema but I haven’t had any dry spots while using this cream!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: First of all, I thought the smell would be more sweet (cause, well you know lemonade ) but it is tolerable. I love how soft my face is after using this scrub.  This scrub contains AHAs which are Alpha Hydroxy Acid which can help reduce the appearance of surface lines and wrinkles as well as reducing the look of pores, this is only among some of the benefits. I personally can say my pores look smaller (amazing) and my complexion has brighten since using this 3 times a week. Would recommend!

reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this every night for about a week and my skin has looked so great! This is honestly the holy grail for great morning skin! Will continue to purchase when I run out! There is a light tingle after application but nothing too bad and sometimes I don’t even notice it. Your skin will thank you!

reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for two weeks now and absolutely no complaints. I love this product. It’s very versatile. You can wear it alone, with primer, foundations, skin tints. You name it you can do it. I personally like the look it has with primer and skin tint. Gets red of my super red spots on my face and then the skin tint for my under eyes and dark marks and I’m set. This is a color corrector and it’s for redness specifically. I do not recommend this for dark spots. Green is used only to color correct redness. So if you struggle with redness on your face this is for you! I was worried about getting this product due to the gray tint and oxidization complaints but honestly I haven’t had a problem. I have a neutral undertone which I think helps with the grayness and oxidation. Hope that helps!

reviews.review_text: I do really love this product. I currently have the scent vanilla and have tried it in the berry as well and really liked both scents. I got a sample of it and fell in love. I love the little spatula it comes with as well. When you put it on it feels thick but not sticky and tacky. It feels super moisturizing when you put it on. My only complain is for how long I’ve been using this, I figured it would help long term with lip hydration issues and it hasn’t too much. I still have to apply lip moisturizers constantly throughout the day.

reviews.review_text: LOVE this mask. Like LOVE. And I usually don’t get hype about products. Whenever I’m breaking out I use this and it helps so much. I love doing a little dermaplaning and then using this. My skin feels incredible the next day. And I love the price. I honestly like this brand a lot.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_title: Reduced size and redness of cystic acne
reviews.review_text: I have the type of acne (cystic) that is super deep, huge, never comes to a head, painful, and lasts for a week/week and a half. Im extremely lucky in that my face is pretty clear except for these suckers once in a while. But when I get them, no matter how much makeup I use, you can still see this giant mass on my face. I was skeptical about anything helping. Now I’m not going to say this is a magical cure for acne but after a night I did notice a significant decrease in the size and redness and after wearing them for 2 or 3 days it was mostly gone, cutting the time I have them down my half if not more. I would recommend highly just don’t assume its going to fix it overnight.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have searched far and wide for the perfect fast wash for my skin and this is it! Having oily combination skin with acne and dreaded redness this cleanser has done wonders. It has a wonderful texture and feel when applied to the skin and when met with water. It doesn’t foam heavily which I like as its more gel-ish? The scent is heavenly and isn’t overwhelming like others I have tried. The cleanser doesn’t dry my skin out nor oversaturate it, I’ve tried using it without applying moisturizer afterwards with no major issues although I do recommend moisturizing afterwards. Grab a sample and try it out, if its a success purchase the larger tube its more costly upfront but is a better price per mL. Highly recommend!

I won’t say I’ve seen any other results. I’m not fond of this product and will not purchase again nor will I fall again into a pushy sales associate.

reviews.review_title: I really enjoy using this face mask!
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy using this face mask! It goes on smooth, I use a foundation brush to apply it, and wears well. It doesn’t drip everywhere nor smells funny. It has a oddly soothing tingly feeling at first but then fades away while the mask hardens. My skin feels smooth and free of oils after I wash it off. Oh washing it off - make sure you are over the sink because you will get grey all over your counter top, small expected feature being charcoal/ dark in colour. Ensure you apply a moisturizer directly afterwards or you will defeat the purpose. Over I would recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Ladies. This. Is. It. Period. I have used a few different Hyaluronic Acid serums, and for the price ‘The Ordinary’ really stands out to me. I have tried and loved ‘ClarityRX - Daily Dose of Water’ and ‘Peter Thomas Roth - Water Drench’ just for reference. They are both amazing products, but I recommend this to anyone who may not have the $$$ to spend or is not sure if hyaluronic is for them. I highly recommend to my colleagues who would never look twice at this product because it says “Acid” on the bottle, a lot not being knowledgeable of what type of moisture this product gives. My aesthetician highly recommends that we all moisturize, especially as we get into the summer months and even more so into our late 20’s and early 30’s. The b5 is an added benefit to this as you only get one face and always want to feed your skin vitamins. If you are not using some form of hyaluronic by the age of 30 and need to plump your skin up, buy this now! I have seen my face clear up from deep little clogged pores simply because I needed that extra plumpness that this product gives. I recommend using this with a hydrating spray/mist and/or a hyaluronic acid cream as your AM/PM skin care regime. Also, ‘The Ordinary’ has an amazing caffeine serum for under the eye, works wonders and the price is tight!

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I was buying the mini due that included the small bottle of Cleanser and the Water Cream. Tatcha is the bomb, as is Kate Somerville. This bottle is huge and a little goes a long way. If you wear a full face like I do, I recommend Clinique Toner afterwards and with a cotton ball to remove any excess makeup/dirt/debris. And once a week the Dr Jart+ microdermabrasion (lightly scrub). Follow up with a nice moisturizer. 4 stars because I think the exfoliKATE does a way better job of removing makeup

reviews.review_title: Best self tanning product if used properly!
reviews.review_text: Pricing is not A selling point whatsoever however, this is by far the best self tanner on the market at the moment. The key is to use a very particular lotion and mix it in let it dry and then go for a second coat. I have no problem answering any questions, I started with medium, then went dark. If you are unsure, go and buy the starter kit in medium. In just a few hours I can go from pale to bronze. It’s better than a bohemian bronze. Secret: Australian gold Lotion. I will add photo. -1 star bc of price for little bottle. I tried to add lotion to my old bottle. I’ve had my new bottle for over a month and use it every night. And once you get your face glow you can use other self Tanners.

reviews.review_text: Not what I was hoping for. There were so many positive reviews of this product that I thought it could help me with my adult acne. I think it’s causing more breakouts and I have really dry, itchy patches on my temples that I’ve never had an issue with before. Luckily it’s cheap enough that I don’t feel bad tossing it.

Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: Over the past couple of weeks I’ve been using this serum daily and saw a difference in the overall texture of my skin. I’ve suffered from acne scarring and closed comedones on my forehead. I could tell that my forehead was a lot smoother within a week of using this product. My skin felt clean and smooth overall. The scent is fantastic, nice citrus scent that isn’t to overpowering! I would recommend this to anyone who has texture on their skin. Thanks to inflenster for sending me this product to try out.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use to use Clinique moisturizers all the time when I was younger. It’s been a few years since I’ve used them and they’re just as good as I remember. I especially love the moisture surge for when I’ve had a long day in the sun and my skin is a little burnt or irritated. It’s soothing and hydrating. Nothing more that I would want. Overall, I recommend this to anyone with any kind of skin type.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: Great vitamin c overall. No skin sensitivities or irritation to this serum. I know some of the vitamin c serums I’ve used in the past I had to discontinue use because of how strong they were on my skin. Kept my skin clear and looked brighter after continual use. Would recommend for to someone looking for a good vitamin c!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I hardly ever write reviews for any of the products I buy, but this one deserves it. I have ALWAYS had dry, chapped lips and have tried thousands of different products to help from balms to masks and everything in between. THIS is it, the holy grail, the thing that will make you toss everything else you’ve ever tried. After just two days of using it, my lips are soft and plump and NOT peeling. I’m honestly thinking about carrying it around in my purse to use as my everyday chapstick because I don’t know if I could go a whole day without using it now that I’ve tried it. If you’re on the fence, DO IT! This is one of the best products I’ve ever bought from Sephora and is worth it’s weight in gold. Like other reviews have said, even if this was $40 or $50 I would gladly pay it because of the quality of this product. In short, try it. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I’ve always had super dry,chapped lips and nothing helped until I found the lip sleeping mask, so much so that I wanted to carry it around with me day, but I didn’t think it would be socially acceptable to whip out my lip mask and applicator instead of a chapstick. Enter the glowy balm: I’ll be honest, I was a little disappointed by the glossy texture at first, but only because I was expecting something a little bit closer to the lip sleeping mask. However, the hydration is JUST as good as the sleeping mask and I know I’ll never use another chapstick again. The berry flavor also has a smell very close to the lip sleeping mask. This is ABSOLUTELY worth the $15!!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: As someone who has suffered with cystic acne for years and tried nearly every pimple solution on the market, I have never been so amazed with a product. I picked these up in desperation when a huge cystic pimple made an appearance the day before I was having pictures taken. I’d seen them at Sephora but I didn’t have much hope. When I woke up the next morning, my deep, angry, bright red pimple had completely faded and smoothed out. I’m also a big fan of seeing the results in the dot when I take it off. I’m a fan for life.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this and was super excited to use it- I don’t have sensitive skin and I’m a big fan of other acid products (SR Good Genes, Farmacy Honeymoon, etc). I had not used any actives on my face for a week prior to using this scrub and was excited to get some of the exfoliation benefits. As soon as I put it on, my skin started to sting and burn... after getting out of the shower I was bright red and my skin stung with any product for two to three days after. Needless to say, I threw my sample away and won’t be purchasing. I see that this product works for others, but just be cautious and maybe you’ll have better results than I did.

Would not recommend if you have oily skin, but is great for those with dry skin especially in a dry climate!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: this product was a great transition moisturizer into fall! Not too heavy, and perfect for daily wear. Not sure I would wear it in the summer as it’s a bit too heavy for that. I received the magic cream as a free gift in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this Korres cleanser!  It’s creamy and gentle on my sensitive skin.  I like that this product contains 86.4 percent natural ingredients and doesn’t have parabens.  Consumers really need to check the ingredients on their beauty products.  I highly recommend this cleanser for anyone looking for a healthier, effective, gentle cleanser for your face.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I really like Belif products and this eye cream is no exception.  It’s light, absorbs quickly, and feels great on my eye area.  It doesn’t irritate my eyes as other products do at times.  I see some improvement in puffiness and dryness.  This product is expensive but works well....and a little goes a long way.  It’s worth a try!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this mask!  It goes on easily and it is gentle on your skin.  After I use this mask, my skin is so soft and always looks great!  I would definitely recommend this mask to anyone...especially if you have dry, sensitive skin.  Love it!

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. Very nice sunscreen light weight feeling on my skin so you can barely tell your wearing anything. Non greasy feeling which I love with a very light scent. Another plus it doesn’t make my skin feel at all sticky

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I really like this pore minimizer serum, it’s so light weight I couldn’t even tell I had applied it to my face. A small amount really goes a long way too. Doesn’t leave my skin feeling oily, greasy or dried out. The best part is my face is looking so much better and more beautiful. It actually helps to minimize pores & black heads. Can’t get over how much better my skin looks since using the wonderful serum. #freeproduct #trytopbox

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing. I absolutely love this clay mask and by far one of the best I’ve ever used. It’s pretty thick but not really heavy if that makes sense. You definitely don’t need a lot either, a little really goes a long way with this stuff. A dime size amount easily covers one cheek down to my chin. It’s easy to apply, leave on for about 10 minutes then I rinse with warm water. Afterwards my face is left feeling smooth and clean. Gifted by innisfree.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I’ve seen a ton of influencers use this on their IG stories and when offered a free sample jumped at the opportunity. I have incredibly sensitive skin and rosacea on my cheeks. This product did not irritate my skin like some other peel products have in the past. After using this my skin was SO SOFT. Wonderful, glowy, beautiful. I was nervous how irritating it would be, and it honestly is great!!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: As a bit of a sunscreen junky, I’ve tried so many different types. This one exceeded my expectations. As a mineral sunscreen this melted right into my skin. It wasn’t as matte as I had hoped and had a very slight tint to it. It wore well under a full face of makeup also. It’s something I’m happy to put on my face each morning.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer. Not irritating, mild scent, and perfect texture. I’ve been a fan of this moisturizer for many years! Love that there is an anti-aging type.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Put this on at night, made my lips drier by the next morning. They were worse than before I went to bed. Some ingredient doesn’t agree with me.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: Average eye cream. Never really absorbed into my skin- just say on top. Probably better for younger skin.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff. I use this as my daily makeup. Evens out my skin tone. Absorbs fast into my combo/oily skin. Set it with powder/bronzer because it’s a bit white on my light/medium skin. Lasts all day - looks better than makeup.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff. I use this as my daily makeup. Evens out my skin tone. Absorbs fast into my combo/oily skin. Set it with powder/bronzer because it’s a bit white on my light/medium skin. Lasts all day - looks better than makeup.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: Hated this cream. Reeks of lavender - my skin started turning red immediately. It’s nice and thick- but never absorbed into my skin. Just sat on top and made my skin feel greasy.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Love this sleep mask- nice, thick cream that easily absorbs I go my skin. Wake up to softer, hydrated, and clearer skin. Will definitely repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: Love this sleep mask- nice, thick cream that easily absorbs I go my skin. Wake up to softer, hydrated, and clearer skin. Will definitely repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: HG night time moisturizer for me. It is thick and creamy but not greasy. It absorbs quickly and my skin feels plump afterwards. I put it on top of my serums and oils and everything is absorbed. Wake up refreshed with fine lines minimized. Have repurchased multiple times. Can’t be without it.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this free from influenster. Unimpressed with this product at this price point. The applicator is meh. There was a bit of a learning curve with dispensing the serum- at first too much came out. Had to lightly press on the container and then apply to eye. No noticeable difference in fine line or dark circles. Moisturizes.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: The product took about a week to show its results but they were amazing. My eyes are brighter and the skin around them more hydrated and dont have that reddish color anymore. Will definitely reccomend to a friend. I wish the bottle was bigger.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I got this in Influencer’s glow summer voxbox and while it worked the way it should have, it irritated my eyes. I loved, however, how it melted away makeup, impurities and completely cleaned my skin. The skin looks refreshed and glowing after the first use. Will keep using.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: What’s good about this product? Pretty much everything!! I loved how the texture is smooth and silky and it just glides over the skin. I loved that it isnt white colored but rather has a light and pleasant tint. It didn’t clog my pores or irritated my sensitive skin. Will definitely recommend and rebuy.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I use this twice a day after washing my face before I put on the Violet-C serum and have been quite pleased. I’ve been using it for about 2 weeks and have noticed my skin seems softer and brighter. I received them conplimentary to try and review and was skeptical because it says it is “plumping”. I’ve only tried plumping lip gloss and was not a fan of the tingling sensation so I was afraid this would be tingly too but it wasn’t-that’s not how it works. It is super hydrating and helps the Violet-C absorb, so if you’re trying the serum definitely get the Essence as well to maximize your results.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I use this twice a day after washing my face before I put on the Violet-C serum and have been quite pleased. I’ve been using it for about 2 weeks and have noticed my skin seems softer and brighter. I received them conplimentary to try and review and was skeptical because it says it is “plumping”. I’ve only tried plumping lip gloss and was not a fan of the tingling sensation so I was afraid this would be tingly too but it wasn’t-that’s not how it works. reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I’m loving my results already after using the serum for almost 2 weeks. I can definitely tell mh skin just looks healthier-like it has a little glow. Its not sticky and it auper easy to apply. I use mine after the Essence in the morning after I wake up and before I go to bed. My skin also feels smoother even though I haven’t been using any exfoliants on it. I was skeptical when I received this for free to try because I’m super picky about my skin care products, but I am quite pleased with my first Tatcha skin care product!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I wish this came in a bigger bottle, because I went thru it fast! It is easily absorbed by the akin and doesn’t leave you feeling greasy. I didn’t notice a huge difference in my skin visually, but the change was still there and I did notice a difference in the texture of my skin.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: I got this product for the first time from influencer and had never tried an olehenriksen product before. I was super nervous because my skins sensitive but this product was amazing!!  The smell was super good and the texture even no it’s a little sticky goes in smoothly into a nice layer, unlike other face mask it was super easy to wash off leaving my face feeling incredibly smooth glowing and refreshed. I am excited to keep going and seeing more improvements with my skin now

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Amazing, it smells super refreshing and you only need the minimum and it goes a long way. My skin suffers from dry patches that are supper itchy and flakey, after using this product for a week it has made a huge difference. I am now three weeks in and have no more dry patches at all and my skin feels amazing. The only thing I would recommend it watching how much you put on.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this product so much, let me start by saying the results are absolutely amazing, my pores are way less noticeable and my face loves all the hydration. The texture of the product is nice and light as well as the smell. I have been using the cold plunge for over a week right now and these are the issues I have had...- the slight burning everytime I put it on ( I’m hoping my skin is just adjusting and it leaves after a few second)- my face did break out the first couple of days but has cleared up since Over all I definitely will keep using this moisturizer and look forward to seeing more results!!

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by innisfree for my opinion on super clusters pore clearing clay mask.All reviews by me are honest and unbaised.First of all, I really like the slick packaging, it is a matte black glass jar. The clay mask applied smoothly and offered a slight scent which is pleasant. I have sensitive skin so sometimes clay masks can be too much for me. They either have strong smells or they burn my skin when I have it on. I left the clay mask on for 10 minutes as instructed, I did feel a cooling sensation while I had it on but it did not cause any rash or discomfort. I massaged it a little bit before washing it off. It left my face feeling clean but not tightening to the point it hurts.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_title: Rich cream absorbs quick and hydrates skin
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Skinfix to review Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Cream in change of my honest opinion.  This product was designed for sensitive skin which is perfect for me. Aftering applying on my hand to try it out before I put it on my face, I could tell it was a thicker cream than I normally would use. I have combination skin and I try to stay away from thick creams since they tend to be too rich and sticky for me. After applying on my face, it was quickly absorbed and my face was hydrated and left with natural glow. It was not sticky at all and the product doesn’t have strong fragrance to it which I love.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_title: Rich cream absorbs quick and hydrates skin

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Paula’s Choice with SKIN PERFECTING 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant. I have heard so many great things about Paula’s Choice and was excited to try this product. I noticed my skin was more calm after using this product. I have acne prone skin and any type of change, weather, skincare routine, food etc. would cause me breaking out. This product was able to keep acnes away from my face.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Such a nice sunscreen. It doesn’t have an overpowering smell. It applies without a white cast and stays on for hours. It has a slight skin tint instead of being white. I love that it has hyaluronic acid in it. It has a little ball inside the bottle that mixes up the contents when you shake it. It’s watery instead of thick, and is great under makeup. It feels so high quality and expensive. Everything Shiseido makes is top tier! Absolutely recommend this product if you’re looking for a luxury sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Such a nice sunscreen. It doesn’t have an overpowering smell. It applies without a white cast and stays on for hours. It feels so high quality and expensive. Everything Shiseido makes is top tier! Absolutely recommend this product if you’re looking for a luxury sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum! Oh my goodness. Let’s start with just the actual presentation of the product. Visually stunning. The color of the bottle is absolutely beautiful and the shape of the bottle is beautiful as well. The elixir is absolutely beautiful. It’s a white milky color. I can see the product on my skin, for sure. It seems extremely hydrating and seems to lock in any moisture the face already has. It has a very pleasant smell. I look forward to the long term effects of this product!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: This came in my Sephora Play box this month and it has become my new favorite lip balm.  I’m obsessed. Some brands I’ve used before leave a film/residue but this one is perfect, leaving my lips feeling smooth and moisturized without feeling greasy.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite product for removing my waterproof mascara.  It’s gentle on the eyes and isn’t greasy at all.  The woman in the Sephora store scooped me out a sample to try and I went back the next day to purchase.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite product for removing my waterproof mascara.  It’s gentle on the eyes and isn’t greasy at all.  The woman in the Sephora store scooped me out a sample to try and I went back the next day to purchase.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this in my Play! box and ended up really liking it and buying the full size.  It brightens, smells good, and leaves my skin feeling fresh.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have tried a few gel moisturizers, and they have all felt heavy or sticky but not this one! The gel melted into my skin and left it soft and not sticky at all. I like the soft subtle scent, and that you only need a dime sized amount to cover your entire face/neck area. I received this product free for testing purposes from influenster.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I received this product free for testing purposes. I have extremely dry skin that always feels tight and dehydrated, and there isn’t very much I haven’t tried to fix it. This toner is one of my new favorites. I haven’t noticed any long term moisture effects. but my skin becomes instantly softer and more hydrated after immediately applying the toner after washing my face. The scent is so light and subtle and smells good. I soaked a cotton pad with the toner and pat it into my skin and follow up with the hydra zen moisturizer and my skin looks so dewy afterwards

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I didn’t really care for this eye cream. I didn’t notice any difference after using it for 2 weeks. It was on the greasy side for me and burned my eyes a bit, but I also have kind of sensitive eyes. For the price I wouldn’t purchase again.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the scent of this cream, it is a light lemony kind of medicinal scent. It is very moisturizing, but I didn’t feel like it made me glowy or really did any brightening.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: So light on my skin it was almost transparent (as you can see in my picture). This cream was so buttery soft without that thick cakey feeling. I also really loved the smell, it smelled like fresh air and the outdoors, like crisp air. I love this cream. It made my skin feel super hydrated and after a hot dry summer it was much needed. I have sensitive skin and would recommend it to anyone with the same skin type!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Super hydrating lip mask!! It has no scent or taste which I prefer before bed anyway. I love how soft it makes my lips feel and the hydration is so intense they appear to almost plump up after it’s been applied. I would definitely recommend this for those wintery chapped lips and also for those who can be sensitive to scented items.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I can honestly say this is the best serum I’ve ever used. I love the texture which is a fast absorbing lotion and it smells wonderful! You can actually smell the vitamin C, it’s got this beautiful citrus smell just like orange. But the best part is how quickly it works, as you can see in my video. It makes my face super vibrant. One day this week I actually wasn’t sure if I was wearing make up because this blends my skin so beautifully and any of my previous redness I had has disappeared. It’s just instant glow! I will be investing in this product for sure! I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love this! I got this in my voxbox and it is the best thing I’ve used. It smells good and not too strong. And the packaging is sooo cute!! It makes my pores look refined and makes my skin feel tight, in a good way! Love this, I would definitely recommend this to others

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love this! I got this in my voxbox and it is the best thing I’ve used. It smells good and not too strong. And the packaging is sooo cute!! It makes my pores look refined and makes my skin feel tight, in a good way! Love this, I would definitely recommend this to others

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: The best thing I’ve ever used. It is simply amazing and makes my skin feel sooo good!! I would buy again and again.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: The best thing I’ve ever used. It is simply amazing and makes my skin feel sooo good!! I would buy again and again.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I really like how this feels on my skin and how light it is. It smells great too and has the cutest packaging. Definitely recommend this because it gives my face a fresh look. Get this for sure!!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I got introduced to very expensive serums & while I loved the results, I didn’t love the price. And that’s where The Ordinary line comes in & the Hyaluronic Acid serum ... it works just as well as the expensive brands & the value can’t be beat. This has become part of my daily skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: I used this for a few years & loved it. I think its great for someone in their 20s - 30s depending on your needs & the climate you live in.I’m 40 now, live in Canada & find this just doesn’t provide me with the same hydration in the winter as I need. But I still recommend it for others to try!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_title: Excellent for reducing fine lines & acne scares
reviews.review_text: What does this do you may be asking? This treatment brightens, hydrates, and smooths the skin’s surface. It reduces fine lines, wrinkles, and hyperpigmentation (such as dark spots, age spots, and acne scars).I use it at night because of the combination of product I use & because my skin is sensitive & I don’t want to increase any skin damage.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complementary for testing purposes. I really like this product! The texture is smooth and it has a light smell. I typically have an issue with creams and lotions making my face too oily bit this didn’t do that. I look forward to redoing my review as the weeks go on and tell you all the progress of my skin!

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received these products for free from Influenster and Target in exchange for my honest review. I really enjoyed the facial lotion. I normally have pretty oily skin and skip the moisture. But I gave this a chance and it didn’t disappoint.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I’ve never used a serum too much before due to my oily skin but I found if I do my normal night care routine and then add a pump of this before bed it really makes a difference in my skin.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love these things! I have tried so many acne spot treatments that say that will get rid of a coming zit/pimple within a couple hours or over night - much like this product stated, so I was skeptical at first. But now that I have tried it, I will never use anything else. When I notice a spot of acne coming up or bothering me, I just put on of these bad boys on it and within hours the bump and redness are basically gone. And also, when you peel the dot off, you can see where it was “fighting“ the acne as there will be a kinda white-ish puffy spot on the dot.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: With almost immediate results just after application, and on a day-to-day basis, this formula is perfect! And a little does go a long way.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin and this product feels so amazing on my skin. It’s so light, and not greasy feeling like i assumed it would. It is also great as a primer for makeup - skin products glide right over my silky smooth feeling skin, and nasty ugly blemishes.  :) thumbs up! Only down side is if you squeeze all the product to the top - kinda like a tube of toothpaste - it seems to just run right out, and I mean run, when you twist off the cap which kinda gets a little irritating because sometimes way more product than what I need comes out and then I have to force my boyfriend to try to salvage the excess. I guess that is my fault lol. All in all - highly recommend to anyone and hope it is a permanent product for them!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_title: Some sort of witchcraft magic potion!!!!
reviews.review_text: BUY IT! This product is amazing, I’ve never been let down by dr Jart yet but I tried it out on a whim since the reviews were SO good. I wasn’t 100% sure what was going on with my skin, I don’t have acne nor Rosacea but every so often I would get these red bumps (not raised) all over my cheeks/temples & super random texture on my forehead. My boyfriend said I was crazy and my skin was fine but after just one night of using this my skin was transformed and even he noticed how soft & even the colouring of it had gotten, I also had a deluxe sample in my drawer of the cream from the same line and I’ve been wearing them both and I’ve seen such a difference, the cream however is a bit heavier but if it helps I’ll definitely use it on top of the serum in the night time! 100% would recommend.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Absolutely love it, perfect cream/gel balance!
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love it, my favorite water/gel moisturizer so far.. I have tried the gel type moisturizer from Tatcha but the water cream blows it out of the water! I have combo/sensitized skin and this soothes and hydrates me perfectly without being sticky or oily later in the day. Has been also making my makeup look alot nicer.. I also have been using this together with the deep cleanse and they are a dynamic duo for sure! If you’re hesitant try the $30 set of the both products.. it’s what I did

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_title: The hype is real. BUY IT.
reviews.review_text: I originally bought the duo of this and the water cream because skincare can give me a hard time (combo/sensitive skin) but after about day 3 of using the two products 2x a day I was absolutely blown away by the way my skin was looking. I have been using dermalogica previously and it was great or so I thought but this has knocked dermalogica out of the hot seat lol. It has a nice not overly foamy consistency with an awesome gentle exfoliator. My pores (on my chin especially) have been significantly reduced in size as I go into week 3 of using both the cleanser and moisturizer together.. I know a lot of people have been knocking a star because of the bottle, I actually don’t mind it (pro tip if you shake it upside down once while the cap is still closed it will dispense a perfect amount with one squeeze of the bottle) Absolutely love!!!

reviews.review_title: Not a miracle worker, but great!
reviews.review_text: I was really hoping for better results based on the reviews! My skin DEF tingled right away but that went down after about ten min. I woke up with tighter feeling skin and a slight glow - definitely noticeable results - nothing miraculous. I would HANDS DOWN buy this product if it were cheaper. Maybe after a few more treatments, I would notice better results. I just cannot bring myself to spend over $10 a treatment for results I know I can achieve close to with a much lower price tag. Would def be worth it to purchase if it was on sale or had a coupon!

reviews.review_title: Not a miracle worker, but great!
reviews.review_text: I was really hoping for better results based on the reviews! My skin DEF tingled right away but that went down after about ten min. I woke up with tighter feeling skin and a slight glow - definitely noticeable results - nothing miraculous. I would HANDS DOWN buy this product if it were cheaper. Maybe after a few more treatments, I would notice better results. I just cannot bring myself to spend over $10 a treatment for results I know I can achieve close to with a much lower price tag. Would def be worth it to purchase if it was on sale or had a coupon!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Maybe I’m biased because this is my new fave brand (their overnight mask is amazing) but I really do notice a difference in my pore size after using this. I love the smell of this and how it makes my skin look/feel. Mix that with the fact that it’s clean and this is a winner!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This has a very lightweight texture that absorbs quickly with a fresh, citrus scent. That’s about it for the pro’s. I did not find this serum to show any instant results and the only results I had after a week were breakouts. I wanted to try it longer to see if I noticed any difference but my skin is too sensitive for it apparently. I received this product for free to review.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Omg. I wish more than anything that Influenster sent a full size product so I could speak to long term benefits. As for immediate benefits, this is one of the best face creams I’ve ever used and I have used a lot. It absorbs into your skin so perfectly and does not leave a greasy layer. My skin felt so soft and plump to the touch. I’m not sure about any reduction in wrinkles or lifting as the sample was not enough to see any difference like that but based on the immediate results, I wouldn’t be surprised if it worked magic over the next two months. I’m so upset it’s sold out because this truly is the best face cream out there.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I have wanted to try this product for quite some time so I was very excited to receive it from Influenster! Right off the bat, this is HEAVILY fragranced. Very floral and I have sensitive skin so I did not have high hopes. Despite this fact, my skin was glowing immediately and it did feel extremely nourishing upon the skin. Did i enjoy it? Yes but I do not think this product is worth the money. There are plenty of other products out there at a much lower price point that can achieve the same results. I did want to note that my skin started to break out so I had to stop using this product but I’m 90% sure it was from the eye serum as it was only around the eye area.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: I love this cleansing balm! A must try!
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample, and I am so glad that I had the opportunity to try this beautiful brand! First, I am so obsessed with the absolutely amazing smell of this cleansing balm, it is like a citrus dream. Second I have tried every single makeup removing balm out there, and this one did a great job of removing my waterproof makeup, without living a sticky oil film on my skin. I tend to break out easily as I have pretty sensitive skin, but no issues at all. I would highly recommend this gem to anyone that wants an effective cleansing balm. A+!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This cream is absolutely stunning. It smells amazing and is very hydrating but isn’t thick or sticky. I am really pleasantly surprised as to how nice and smooth my skin feels after using this. I can’t wait to try more from the Belif brand. My super sensitive skin loves this cream!

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I am so impresses with this product, it leaves my skin feeling so smooth and for the price it can’t be beat!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_title: I’d give this more than 5 stars if I could!!
reviews.review_text: Okay, first off, I received this full size product complimentary from Influenster and Peace Out skincare for an honest review. But that in no way influenced my decision for greatness that is this product! I’m very skeptical when it comes to skin care, even more so with acne products. So to be honest, after the first round of testing this product, I noticed a difference, but thought my feelings on it would be a little biased. So I tried it out again, this time on a holy mother of God zit! I left it on overnight, over the problem area, and when I woke up I felt the circle to see if I could still feel a lump underneath. Sure enough I could, so I was thinking maybe the first time was indeed a fluke. I took the dot off, and the lump was not a zit, but the dot itself that had whatever it pulled from the zit overnight. My zit was GONE! OVERNIGHT! No squeezing, no pain, just clear skin under the magic that are these acne dots!I will absolutely be purchasing these again, and recommending this product to all my fellow acne sufferers! The only thing I should note is, and I only discovered this after trying the first time, was that your skin cannot have anything else on it before applying these dots. No toner, no moisturizer, no cream of any kind or it won’t adhere properly. But that’s literally my only tip as these are seriously a no brained, set it and forget it type of treatment! Thank you soooo much Peace Out God’s!!Note: I attached a picture of the dot after use so that you can see visual proof of its greatness. Sorry, I know that’s TMI, because who wants to see anyone’s zit crap?! Sometimes you just have to see to believe!

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This night cream has been a saving grace for my combination skin! My skin has been soft, evenly textured, and glowing every day that I use it. I even ditched some of the usual products I use at night in place of this, and my skin has thanked me for it. I’ve always known Tatcha was an amazing skincare brand, and I’ve had the opportunity to try a few products, but this cream has encouraged me to continue my loyalty with this brand. The packaging, as well, is cute, sturdy, and the scoop it comes with saves my product from being contaminated!! This is definitely a product I would recommend, especially for anyone with uneven texture, dry, and even oily skin. I promise, your skin will thank you too!!

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: For starters, I’d actually never tried anything from Charlotte Tilbury before now. I’ve always been interested, but I had a hard time coughing up that kind of money on a brand I wasn’t familiar with. So, when I received the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Elixir, I was super stoked to get acquainted with the brand. The serum itself feels really nice on the skin. It’s not thick or tacky, and absorbs rather quickly. It also has a soft, delicate fragrance to it. Typically, I try to stay away from fragrances skincare as it’s just not necessary and has the potential to cause irritation, but the fragrance in this was non irritating and was also not overwhelmingly strong. If you’re familiar with the BareMinerals SkinLongevity Long Life Herb Serum, it is eerily similar. Like almost exact between the feel and scent. When using this serum, I just applied a few drops to my face before applying my moisturizer, and it seemed to play well with all of my other products in my skincare lineup. I used the entire bottle over the course of a month, and that was with conservatively sized amounts at each application, so it may not be a realistic product to add to your lineup if you’re budget conscious. Overall, I’m satisfied with the results this serum gave me. My skin did feel softer and less texturized. It also gave me a very healthy glow and did not irritate my skin whatsoever.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I love that this toner isn’t all water based. It’s a mixture of a gel and water which I like because I feel like I get more out of it. I love the smell and the feeling of this toner. Cleans off any makeup of dirt I have After I wash my face. It’s super refreshing. Love this toner

reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way! Even though it’s gel based I like the consistency. It feels like a rich moisturizer. Especially because my skin is so dry, it really takes this product in well and my skin feels so much more hydrating after. I normally use this at night to let it soak into my skin. I normally use something else in the morning but this is still great for morning.

reviews.review_text: Wow I’m utterly surprised by how fast this worked for me. The first use cleared up my skin. Although I only use a night because my skin is normally dry. But it still works and my skin looks so clear after. I’m so happy about this product!

reviews.review_text: I have been using it twice a day for a few days and can already tell a big difference. It’s creamy and goes on so smooth. I love this product.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I was so excited to give this a try after I received it complementary when I got it in my voxbox. It is soothing when rubbed and is not oily. it was extremely refreshing for my dry winter skin.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: This is my first time using a vitamin c serum. I have been using it for a few weeks and have defiantly noticed my skin is brighter. I love the bottle, it’s so bright and fun. I will defiantly be continuing to use this product.

reviews.review_text: I received the Daily Greens moisturizer complimentary from Farmacy, I have been using it for 2 days so far. Its a great moisturizer, smells amazing, only complaint is it takes a little longer to soak in than my normal moisturizer. But once it soaks in, it keeps my skin soft all day, makes my primer and foundation alot smoother and last longer. I have sensitive skin and it doesn’t make it red for a bit like most other moisturizers do. I really like it.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received the Glow Recipe Avocado Ceramide Recovery Serum for free to test. The packaging is so cute. It smells a little funny, but it feels good on my skin. It soaks in nicely. I haven’t noticed big results, but I have only been using it a few days. I will be keeping this in my routine.

reviews.review_text: I got the hydrating cream, even though i have only been using it for two days I really like it. It smells good and leaves my skin feeling good. I tried using it twice a day, but it was too much, but once a day is perfect for my skin

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: #farmacygiftedme | this oil-free, silicone-free daily moisturizer is a new fave of mine. reviews.review_text: This is my new obsession! I just love the glow this dew drops gives my skin! I love using this with makeup & without makeup. Also, it’s very hydrating & it smells delicious! I love that it absorbs well & quickly into the skin, it doesn’t leave any stickiness at all. This product helps me lessen my makeup routine since this works as a highlight & primer. I’m always amazed with Glow recipe cute packaging, it’s always so pleasantly pleasing to have in my vanity! Gifted by Glow Recipe to review, all opinions & experiences are my own.
