It’s a must-use for me after I do any type of mask. It feels so nice on the skin, lightweight and not sticky. This oil absorbs into my skin well and my face feels so hydrated and bright the next day. A little goes a long way!

reviews.review_text: This product has been on my wishlist for a while, and I’m so excited to try and love it! it gives an instant boost of hydration add softness and glow to my skin without any irritation. I received the product complimentary for testing purposes, but all opinions are my own.

reviews.review_text: I have been using this serum for a while now and yet I am surprised how gentle it is to my sensitive skin. I haven’t been using it consistently because I’m going through allergies right now and I literally stopped using any skin care product for a while, but as I’m returning to the serum and the essence, i can tell right away that both of them give instant radiance just after the first use! On the next morning the skin looks radiant and more even in tone.The serum is not sticky and absorbs super fast into the skin. I apply essence first and then the serum. I probably need to use it every night to see all the benefits and how the skin will react, but so far I’m loving these products! I received the products complimentary for testing purposes

reviews.review_title: Lightweight serum that you can use over makeup
reviews.review_text: This is a very unique serum. It is non sticky, lightweight and very hydrating. It works well over  makeup ( i tried over tinted sunscreen and full coverage foundation) and doesn’t pill any skincare layers. Absorbs really well, add a nice glossiness to the skin but once absorbed, the shine fades a little bit. Overall I like the product ( it smells so yummy) and would incorporate it into my daily routine.This product was gifted by Glow Recipe in exchange for the review.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Sooo delicious! This is creamy with a natural-smelling coconut scent, and hydrates my lips for hours. I put it on right before bed and wake up with it still on my lips! I love the texture - it’s only slightly sticky, which is fine because it helps with longevity. I prefer a balm that doesn’t slip right off my lips. Also love it over longwear lipstick, as it doesn’t cause it to fade/wear off like some oilier balms do.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My husband bought this for me for Christmas and at first I wasn’t psyched about it - moisturizer is probably the skincare product I typically get the least excited by. I used it a couple of times and gave it a rest for quite awhile. Well, lately I’ve been dealing with some health issues that have caused my skin to be extra sensitive and prone to dryness/irritation, and rather than investing in a new moisturizer I decided to go back and give this another try. Turns out, I love it! I noticed that many other high end creams I have will feel great at first, but by the end of the day my skin feels a little rough/parched in certain areas. This one genuinely keeps my face soft and smooth all day long. Also if you’re a sucker for great packaging, Tatcha definitely delivers in that regard. All in all, what seemed like a basic moisturizer initially turned out to be a great gift that I totally (secretly) under-appreciated and might just be my new (ish) holy grail. Thank god for that, given the price tag lol.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Oh man I LOVE the lime mint scent so much. I have the blood orange and coconut flavors, and while they’re both also delectable, the lime one just has a crispness to it that’s really addictive. The texture is smooth, not sticky or tacky, and it does a pretty decent job of keeping my lips soft and hydrated. It’s definitely not as intensely moisturizing as a lip mask - but then again, it doesn’t claim to be. These are so perfect for everyday, throw-in-your-bag-and-go usage. It’ll take me awhile to run out of these, but if/when I hit pan, the lime mint will be the one I go back for.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried hyaluronic acid serums in the past and didn’t ever notice a enough of a difference in my skin  to warrant repurchasing. Enter: Glow Recipe. This serum is amazing! It has such a satisfyingly wet, slippery, smooth texture that feels so good on application and has made a real difference in the overall hydration of my skin. I have combination skin that’s prone to hormonal breakouts and can get dry/flaky - which normally requires pretty regular physical exfoliation to slough off the dead stuff. Since I started using this I’ve noticed I don’t need to do this nearly as often or as much. My skin is supple and soft without feeling like the serum causes any build-up or congestion. I first tried a sample of this with a Sephora order and after two days of using that, I invested in the full size. It’s that good! Not much of a scent, either, for those who are sensitive to fragrance. Definitely recommend, even for finicky skin like mine.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this wrinkle smoothing cream that I received complimentary in exchange for sharing my experience. First, let me say I love that it works best with normal to oily skin, as my face can be a bit on the oily side. My face feels moisturized without feeling overly greasy. It’s a great base for my makeup as well. I did feel a slight tingle after application, not unpleasant or uncomfortable. I’ve only been using about a week but I can definitely feel the difference.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I should’ve known better than to expect too much from this. At 40 I definitely have the beginnings of crow’s feet. I really wanted to try this for at least two weeks as suggested, twice weekly. However, the package I received only had enough for a week and a half. The microneedles were definitely sharp and noticeable at first. I left on overnight as directed. The next day my crow’s feet were almost invisible to the naked eye, until I smiled. On the second attempt I applied my primer almost immediately after removal and washing but the effect was still short lived. I plan on purchasing and seeing how well the effects last when used as often as directed.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This milky serum didn’t have an altogether unpleasant scent but it’s not great either. It’s goes on smoothly and evenly with no stickiness and yucky residue behind. I was still able to wear my moisturizer over it without it being greasy. My face definitely felt moisturized but as far as actual retinol type results, I haven’t really seen many and I’ve been using about 3 weeks. I will continue to use though until it’s done to see if any noticeable results appear.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: There’s a lot of science that goes into this moisturizer that pulls from nature’s Hibiscus Morning Bloom and the miracle Moringa. However, I leave the science to Estee Lauder and I simply reap the benefits of applying this “supreme“ moisturizer each morning and night. This isn’t my first time trying this powerful addition to my skincare routine, and it won’t be my last. My skin is visibly brighter and more lifted. It hydrates without making my oily skin problematic and I love the soft, fresh scent. A little goes a long way, well worth it for this luxurious cream.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: Having used the original tiger grass repair cram for years i was so happy to see that more products in this line were coming out!! I got it for free through Influenster but LOVE THIS CREAM. It does exactly what it’s supposed to do, get rid of the redness on my face. I use it after spraying my face with the mist! Super great on my skin especially since i have sensitive skin

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: love this stuff!! when my super picky dermatologist dad even sees what’s in this product and goes this is the good stuff, i know it’s worth the purchase and i was right. it gets rid of all redness on my face without feeling like it’s weighing down my skin. i’ve gotten this product free for testing purposes BUT this was after i had already purchased and used this product for over a year

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: love this stuff!! when my super picky dermatologist dad even sees what’s in this product and goes this is the good stuff, i know it’s worth the purchase and i was right. it gets rid of all redness on my face without feeling like it’s weighing down my skin. i’ve gotten this product free for testing purposes BUT this was after i had already purchased and used this product for over a year

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: love a good serum and this one is no difference. i got this product free for testing purposes but i love the tiger grass line!! it’s the only thing that gets rid of redness. i’ll use this after cleansing and using the spray (or toner) and then the serum before using the cream or treatment. i’ll use the serum every other day!

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_title: nice toner and does what it claims
reviews.review_text: I am new to toners but this works. it helps with oil and shine and I have noticed my blackheads are slowly disappearing. I also use the day cream and it works nice together. 1 star off for the smell. the whole line smells like toilet bowl cleaner to me. I don’t know if this will keep me from repurchasing though.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I rarely give 5 stars but I absolutely love this eye cream. I had 2 samples and liked them enough to decide to buy the 0.5oz size. I’ve been using it for 2 weeks and it’s as awesome I remember the sample being. I use it mostly to moisturize and it does that beautifully. my eyes look way smoother and I definitely look rested. I like to use it when I am “masking“, especially with a peel or clay mask, to keep my eyes from drying out while I wait. I just pat on a thick layer and then rinse with the mask.I use it every morning after my eye serum and every night in a thick layer. it makes my BECCA eye colour corrector go on so smoothly and doesn’t crease because my wrinkles and creases have smoothed!!! (I was at the point of throwing the BECCA out because it always creased and looked so bad after an hour). I have tried a few eye creams, most recently the hyped up Fresh Black Tea eye serum and eye cream. wasted money, especially because the Kiehl’s product is only $40 for half and ounce. I am 36 and I look pretty good for my age but no one is mistaking me for a 20yo, I also never believed in the whole “HG“ product thing, but this eye cream might just make me jump on that bandwagon. I will continue to order this, I can’t see myself without it now!!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: I don't understand the raves, this is not good
reviews.review_text: I was so excited to try this. ordered the set that came with minis of eye cream and rose oil and have been using this for about 5 days. I must be picky because this is not it. I’ve tried many different face creams, estee Lauder, dr dennis gross, shishedo, DE (both lala and protini), origins and olehenriksen, some high end and some mid range and this stuff manages to be both greasy and not hydrating at the same time. the texture is nice and light but it goes on and almost immediately disappears leaving a greasy film  behind. I usually end up re moisturizing a while later. it also stinks. no no no. I am returning it tomorrow and already repurchased DE protini for daytime and will stick with Lala for night.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_title: leave on for 30 mins if you find it isn't working
reviews.review_text: The first time I tried this I was unimpressed. I had a deluxe sample and almost threw it out. As someone who regularly uses all kinds of acids and exfoliants, this didn’t seem to do anything. However I read through the reviews and saw one that said to leave on for 30 mins, not 15. That makesthe difference for me, and it is helping clear the congested pores and texture. I bought the full size and it is now part of a totally revamped acne routine that has really helped (Tarte Vitamin C and Knockout as well as some Eminence products and salicylic acid). I use this 2 or 3x a week.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is excellent for oily/combination skin. I am oily on my t-zone and dry along my jawline and this cream isn’t so light that it can’t handle both. I wouldn’t call it super lightweight but it’s also not heavy either, it’s somewhere in the middle. It absorbs quickly so no worrying about it setting before foundation. I’ve been using it for 2 years now and every time I try another moisturizer I come back to this one. A must buy for combination skin.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_title: Super moisturizing and light eye cream
reviews.review_text: This past year was the first time I started using eye cream. I’m in my early 30’s and really want to avoid dark circles and wrinkles and was starting to go in that direction. Fortunately, this stuff is unreal and works amazingly fast. It melts into your skin and absorbs about 1 minute after application, leaving a flawless foundation for concealer and a non-sticky canvas for bedtime. I have recommended it to several friends who have all raved about it. Yes, it’s a little expensive but a little goes a very long way and you can easily make the jar last 6 months if you use it once a day before bed. I see a big difference with my entire eye area as it use it on my brow bone and lids also. I don’t have a ton of experience with eye cream but this is easily the best I’ve tried so far.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical when I got a sample of this eye cream but ended up using every last drop of it, I was even using less to make it last longer. It dissolves instantly into your skin and is lightweight but very moisturizing. If you have oily or combo skin this is a MUST, it doesn’t just sit on top of your skin like heavier creams. Really an outstanding eye cream, I will be purchasing when it’s available.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this #freeproduct to review, and I have to say I was a bit surprised. I usually don’t use this brand, but I have to say it was not bad. The serum was easy to use, and I am happy that it was not too sticky. I am not really sure if I am seeing any big results, but hopefully with continued use I will see more results. I also love how easy it is to pump, and how compact the design is.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I am surprised at the quality of this cream. It feels so good on the skin, and I feel like it really does work. It’s also not too thick or thin.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: First of all the packaging is amazing, it feels so chic. This is a thick moisturizer and is perfect right now, especially with the weather we have. I also enjoy that it does not have a heavy scent either.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: It’s really good and hydrated, I’ve been using for 3 days and my skin is soooo soft!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I got it from Influenster to test it and I’m in love with it! I tried today and fell in love with the smell, it’s sweet and not strong/uncomfortable at all. It reminds me of spring and summer nights  The consistency is amazing too! Not sticky but not too dry, perfect at the right amount. I just love it so far!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I was surprised with the quality of this product! It helps to cover my pores and gave me a beautiful look with my makeup on, I loved it! The texture it’s perfect, kinda like a velvet thing. Not oily or dry, just perfect for all skin types! I got it from Influenster and have been testing for 1 week

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: This is only my first time using this mask, but as someone with very sensitive combo skin... my face is already a big fan. Most exfoliating masks leave my face feeling dry and raw, but this didn’t. I still felt like I had moisture in my skin. The mask went on smoothly in an adorable pink color, and turned white as you massaged it into your face. I left my mask on a few minutes more than recommended (but that’s ok haha). After washing this mask off, I noticed a difference already in the pores on my nose; which is a trouble area for me. I would like to revisit after using this mask for two weeks, and leave an updated review. However, at this time... my skin rates this mask a 10/10! This product was sent to me for reviewing purposes, however my opinions and thoughts are my own.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: Finally a vitamin c moisturizer that doesn’t burn! I have extremely sensitive skin and this moisturizer went on like a dream! Sank into my skin beautifully and smells yummy too!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is so good! I’m young, but want to start taking preventative measure to ensure good skin later in life. This product has worked amazing and has especially helped with my acne scars! It is strong so follow the directions and start at 2x a week!

reviews.review_text: I love this stuff!!! Literally feels like my skin drank a big glass of water every time I use it. It’s hydrating without being heavy at all, and layers amazingly with other products.

But this formula is so gentle and calmed my skin down, redness is gone and the irritation has really calmed down. It does have a smell very light, goes away quickly.  I love how its packed with all these natural ingredients

After using this cleanser, there’s the least amount of makeup on my toner pad compared to after my use of any other cleanser. This stuff really works.

Very pleased with this brand overall—the Deep Cleanse, Rice Enzyme Powder, Camellia Cleansing Oil, Water Cream, and now this...stunning job by Tatcha.

reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this product. I’ve been using FAB Ultra Repair Moisturizer for the past 3 years, so I was excited to try another one of their products. I got the sample size in the recent hydration sampler promotion. The one positive about this was that the smell was pleasant. I put it on all over my face and décolletage, and my skin got a tingly unpleasant sensation and I looked very splotchy. The moisturizer was also sort of sticky, and I felt like I had to wash my hands after using it. Like I said, I really wish this product had worked out but it was an overall letdown.

The SPF is an added bonus!

If you’re someone who doesn’t like the stained lip look - you may not like this but for the rest - very good product. I put this on alone because I didn’t read it was a lip gloss at first (I was too excited when I got my pr box

reviews.review_text: All around great, luxurious cream. Very moisturizing and settles into skin very well. This is also a great base before applying makeup. Balm like texture. I received a full size of this product complimentary from Influenster

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is a must have in my routine! It glides really nicely upon application and absorbs super quickly! I am someone who has really struggled with cystic acne and whiteheads, but since I’ve implemented this into my routine, my skin has cleared almost 100%!! Get the serum!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This stuff helps my skin feels so protected and healthy! Whenever my skin is extra dry, I put a little on over my moisturizer and reapply throughout the day. I noticed improvements super quick too!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This stuff helps my skin feels so protected and healthy! Whenever my skin is extra dry, I put a little on over my moisturizer and reapply throughout the day. I noticed improvements super quick too!

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: This is a good mask! Very gentle, and feels nice on the skin. Kind of sticky. The one problem that I have with it, is that the fragrance is VERY potent. If they removed it, this would be a near perfect product. Provides gentle exfoliation and doesn’t leave skin feeling stripped.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. I really enjoyed this light weight, fast absorbing facial sunscreen. I felt that it wore well with both my makeup and alone, without clogging my pores. It does have a light scent, which I didn’t mind and in my opinion, it smells much better than your typical sunscreen. I love that it can easily be slipped into my purse as it’s not big or bulky.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_title: Reduces the size of my large pores
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Innisfree the super volcanic clusters pore clearing clay mask, and after using twice a week as part of my skincare routine, highly recommend. Not only is it affordable, application is a breeze and results have been great. I only need a small amount to do the job. It goes on smoothly and rinses off just the same, leaving my pores looking smaller and clearer. I’m definitely a fan.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I had been hearing all about the Jet Lag mask by Summer Fridays since it came out, and now I know why everyone was raving about it. For reference, I have combination oily skin with large pores on my T zone. I also have a new baby, so sleep, and my once very on point skincare routine isn’t what it used to be. Needless to say, my skin definitely needs some help not only in the reduction of pores, but also in the brightening and plumping area. That’s where this mask comes in. After washing my face, I apply a small amount (seriously, you only need a little bit) all over my face. I typically leave my masks on an extra 5-10 minutes than recommend. After rinsing, my face seriously glows. Thanks to the niacinamide and hyaluronic acid, my face is brighter, softer, and my pores appear to be much smaller. I don’t know why I waited so long to try this!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: Wonderful product! The smell is fresh and bright, the texture is effective for exfoliating and my skin was smooth afterwards. I think a resistance needs to be built up for the slight burn. Slowly but surely.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Obsessed with this moisturizer. My skin feels do refreshed after using it and the texture is so thick. When I buy this I am going to put it in a refrigerator, it would be amazing.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: Very interesting to have a double serum. At first there was slight burning but I’m guessing it’s because my skin was dehydrated. After a few days my skin was much better.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I have a rough prescribed facial regimen from my GP and dermatologist that includes being on spironolactone, trentinoin, benzoyl peroxide, and metronidazole to combat my adult acne and rosacea. For months, I’ve been struggling with extremely dry and aching skin that feels like it’s on fire most days. My go-to moisturizer for a while was the FAB Ultra Repair Cream because you can just slather it on, but the eucalyptus oil in the original REALLY burns my skin at times. I also used to religiously use Neutrogena’s Hydro Boost for extra dry skin (’cuz no frangrance) and that was okay, but it’s silicone based. Enter Farmacy, my current love affair. This has helped my skin more than anything else in just a single use. It doesn’t make me greasier (ultra oily combo skin here), doesn’t burn, and the ingredients are all natural. A little goes a very long way, so I can justify the price easily. Plus, I love the smell of moringa. 15/10 will continue to purchase forever.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical of trying a new cleansing balm as they tend to be hit/miss for me. I have super dehydrated, sensitive combination rosacea skin that burns with just water sometimes. This has not irritated my skin or broke me out in the least and I prefer it my usual cleansers when my face is being ultra finicky. It does a fantastic job removing eye makeup and SPF, which is where I needed the most help, but of course removed stubborn foundation as well.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical of trying a new cleansing balm as they tend to be hit/miss for me. reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Buttery, honey goodness for sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: I haven’t had a Farmacy product do me wrong yet, but I was skeptical of this moisturizer working with my itchy, burning rosacea skin that’s been even more sensitive during winter and on new medication. I was also scared of the fragrance ingredient, but I’ll be honest - I’m not sure what it would be other than a very natural honey scent that’s barely there. This feels like rubbing non-greasy butter onto the skin and the moisture leftover actually stays behind - still without being greasy. I have combination skin that’s normally extremely oily when not on spironolactone (beta/androgen blocker) but still get a little shine through the day. This doesn’t make the shine any worse and it’s one my skin can’t just absorb immediately. I’m still amazed it doesn’t burn - my cheeks scream at even the most gentle moisturizers (Vanicream, CeraVe, the calm+restore line from Aveeno, and sometimes even just water), but this goes on like nothing and soothes them. I was using the Daily Greens moisturizer during the summer and loved it, but needed something a bit heavier for winter. I’m so glad I took the chance on this one finally! Also, the packaging is gorgeous like the rest of their honey line and the magnetic top with spatula is very convenient.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I cannot for the life of me get this stuff to work and have now given it a 6 month off/on trial. I only wear mineral sunscreen and the very occasional non-waterproof mascara but this stuff can’t be bothered with removing either and instead just visibly smears it to various parts of my face. I’ve tried a tiny amount, a quarter sized amount, on wet skin, on dry skin - nothing. It always leaves an oily film on my face and if I have excess dry skin, it balls up my sunscreen in clingy patches on my face that can only be removed with physical exfoliation. I can’t use chemical exfoliation unless I want a reaction and haven’t found any cleanser that my poor rosacea skin can handle other than Cerave’s moisturizing face wash, so I was really hoping this balm would do the heavy lifting, but no such luck. Definitely going back to my usual Clinique balm.

reviews.review_title: Meant for people who suffer ruddy reddish skin
reviews.review_text: This product seems to be made specifically for those who suffer reddish irritated,  ruddy color issues. This affects those mostly who dont tan well or have constant ruddyness due to sensitivities...Ive been very annoyed at the stupid comments I get about my ruddy skin so ive been wearing foundation for years. Foundation seems to dry me out, no I wont use primer, aint nobody got time for that. This product magically got rid of my ruddiness, and no I didnt look pasty like I thought I would. One step after your moisturizer and you’re out the door... Excellent product that does NOT dry out my skin like every foundation seems to do (even the super expensive ones dry me out). Get this ...

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: First off, this is the only mask that really helped my eczema and visible flaking skin over the winter. This mask has to be used by itself, if you are trying it for the first time, do not use this mask with other “first time products“ or you will not be able to distinguish what products are causing irritation. On top of having eczema, I also get dermatitis as well as severe acne and this product did NOT irritate me. This product is also good if you are a sun worshiper. So try this mask after your normal routine. This product also helped remove deep lines caused by skin trauma from very cold weather... The best and worth the crazy price...

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I was given this item complimentary for review. I have been using this serum for about three weeks and really haven’t seen any noticeable changes. It is nice, but I don’t feel that it is worth the money. It is very heavily scented as well, and while I don’t mind the fragrance it could turn someone off that has an aversion to heavy scents.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_title: Nice, but not sure it’s worth the price tag
reviews.review_text: I received this product free to test. I actually really like this product. I feel like it has helped even my skin tone, and it has definitely helped with hydration during these cold winter months. It does have a very strong fragrance though. While I like the scent - it can be off putting those people that may have sensitivities. I am unsure if I would repurchase given the price of this product though. It’s good, but I’ve tried other things that are just as good that are less expensive. Overall it’s a really nice hydrating serum.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_title: Great product, less than ideal packaging
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I really like this product. It is extremely moisturizing without being heavy. It soaks in to the skin quickly and evenly and really does help to blur pores. The sample that I received was ample size and the tube was a great delivery system. The cons are the following: the full size product comes in a jar which allows air and elements to get to the product. It also does not have an SPF so you will need an additional product for sun protection. Finally it does have fragrance. To me it was not off putting or overpowering, but it is there. I am debating if I will repurchase at this point - I really love the product but dislike the packaging

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Love the product but not the price
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer but there’s several things that are kind of a dealbreaker for me. The moisturizer is thick without being greasy, hydrating without making my skin oily or breakout. It does have a fragrance but it is minimal and not overpowering. I wish that this moisturizer was not is a pot - that it was in a tube or some other container that did not allow air and germs to touch the product. Next this moisturizer is expensive - while I do like it I have found other products at that are as good or better and a fraction of the cost. It’s definitely a nice splurge product.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I was completely skeptical of this product at first. When it is dispensed it is a very very light color. I expected to look like a ghost, but it blends well. I don’t know if that would be the case if I weren’t so fair. It is thin in consistency but blends out well. It layers nicely with other products and makeup. It doesn’t have a noticeable fragrance. I like this but unsure if I would repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I was excited to try this product since I’m fair skinned. It came at the perfect time. It is lightweight and non greasy. It has no discernible fragrance. It doesn’t leave a white cast to the skin after application and it layers well with other products and makeup. I will definitely be repurchasing when I run out of this sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This worked well over the C-Firma and B-Hydra! I have never been big on wearing Broad Spectrum Sunscreen due to greasiness. This product settles nicely on the skin. Not greasy, or heavy. My skin has never felt better. I am definitely turned on to this brand! Give it a try, you will not be disappointed!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love that you splash it on your face and pat it in! I def noticed a difference!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love that you splash it on your face and pat it in! I def noticed a difference!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It glides on nicely. I love the smell! I see results in my face! Smooths lines and wrinkles!

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It glides on nicely. I love the smell! I see results in my face! Smooths lines and wrinkles!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: Before I start I want to say that I received the product free for testing purposes from Influenster and Tatcha. I was so excited to recieve this product from Influenster and be able to give my feed back. I’ve always heard great things about Tatcha but I hadn’t tried it yet. That being said, I will be purchasing when I run out. This serum helps keep my face hydrated during the dry winter months and wearing a mask at work 12 hours a day. Its scent less and makes my face feel soft. I really loved it!

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this eye serum for a few weeks now.  I have noticed it helps with the lines and bags under my eyes. I don’t know if its any better then other eye serums I have tried though. The tip is metal and gives a nice cooling feeling when applying. I do not like that it’s hard to control the amount of product that comes out. Overall its a good quality solid product. Will I purchase it once I run out, probably not.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this stuff! A little goes a long way.  Its a cooling gel that feels great on my eyes.  I will buy a larger one as soon as this one runs out.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Love!  My patched lips came back to life. I live in a dry climate so I also use this during the day.  I gifted one to my sister after she tried mine. She loved it too!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Love.  Great exfoliant but stings! Leaves skin baby soft.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product is very good and keeps my dry probe lips from getting crusty.  It’s saved them during the start of wedding season and my lipsticks go on smoothly and aren’t a mess by being applied to dry or flakey lips! Lips are soft and healthy looking!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: LOVE!This keeps my lips moisturized.  So good I had to get for my mom and sisters.  A little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I was really excited to try this out because I love clean products and a good serum. However I was a little hesitant because my skin breaks out if a new product so much as looks at it!  BUT I was so pleasantly surprised! My skin isn’t breaking out at all from this and I am so thrilled because clean skincare usually is products that affect my sensitive skin. It smells really good and I also really like the texture of this - it feels more moisturizing and hydrating than most serums. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and hydrated. It’s certainly not a life changing product but I don’t think anything is the quick elixir of youth. 100% recommend and I’m a pretty harsh critic.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This product is very interesting! I was really surprised when I first went to use it because it was way more oily than I expected. I gave it a shake though and it came out a little thicker. It’s still very watery in its consistency, which I don’t mind for applying on the body. I’m nervous to try it on my face since it’s so oily and I break out easily. But overall this seems like a great product for using all over the body for sun protection. It does have a light smell that I don’t love. It smells like strong perfume so I’m grateful the smell isn’t more intense.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I’m always a fan of sunscreen sticks, especially because I have small children. This is great for applying to a face and it is completely invisible! I love that because usually sunscreen sticks have an opaque tint to them. Will always keep this in my summer grab bag.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: Enjoying my fresh face! This mask takes about 2 seconds to spread on with my fingers. It feels  warm going on. The pink to white is a quick change. Instantly starts tingling and dries quickly. I usually leave it on longer than 15 min Bc I forget it’s there. No adverse side effects. This mask definitely makes my face fresh and glowing. Also has cleared is up. I use it every 3 days. If my skin feels yucky I’ll give it a good scrub and then use this mask and it works a treat! I received this product complementary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This lotion is great. It spreads easily and you don’t need to use a lot. So I expect this size will last me a while. Only downside is YOU MUST shake the product a while to make sure it’s all mixed or when you pour it’s just a wet mess. It definitely us staying power after use I have to wash the area at least twice. This is similar to heavy duty sport sunscreens which is a great quality. It will burn if you get this in your eyes.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed using this product for the 7 day sample I got. It made my skin look dewy and healthy. I don’t think 7 days is enough to accurately see how my skin would react or transform. I enjoyed both the oil and turmeric sides. They blended well and went on smoothly. Smell was nice as well.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is the holy grail. I had been dealing with a massive overall adult acne breakout for a year...I’d never experienced acne on my forehead or cheeks and kept thinking I needed to dry it out. Turns out my skin was ALREADY DRY and that’s what was creating the problem. After falling in love with a few of the Sunday Riley products for acne but ultimately experiencing more dryness I decided to try a sample of Good Genes after reading reviews for helping acne. Within a few days I could see a significant change in my skin...I’m a month in now and I have two small zits on my chin but most of the congestion has all but disappeared. Full transparency, this isn’t the only product I’m using and I’ve been to the aesthetician three times in 6 weeks (who cheered for me when she saw me last and went and bought a bottle of Good Genes for herself to celebrate)...but it has absolutely been essential in turning things around. I will never be without this product!

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_title: A little goes a long way
reviews.review_text: I had a horrible acne breakout that lasted a full year. I can’t say that this changed my skin much during that time, except for maybe bringing things to the surface a bit quicker (went through a sample and then a full bottle)...but I think I might have been using too many drops which was contributing to my already very dry skin (that’s where the acne was stemming from in the first place). My suggestion: a little goes a long way, less is more...and use tons of moisturizer! I’d be interested to try it again now that my skin is under control with Good Genes, C.E.O, The Ordinary squaline and argan oils...I still have a two small zits and I’m betting it would work well for maintenance.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The moisture barrier on my face is easily affected by overkill products...I had a facial a few months ago and my esthetician left the wrong mask on too long on my chin and my forehead and I’ve been in a sensitive, stripped breakout cycle ever since.  I went looking for something to repair my moisture barrier and because I’ve always loved Biossance Squalane, I decided to try a sample of the S + Omega Repair Cream. The results were literally overnight...the redness calmed and it looked as if I was glowing from within. I went back to my old moisturizer after I ran out of the sample and just meh. So last night I went and purchased the full size and I just can’t clap loud enough, I’m so excited to see what this moisturizer does to my skin a month from now...I don’t think I’ll even need to wear foundation ever again.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Great for summer use. It’s a gel type so it does provide that cooling effect when applied. It is moisturizing but it does not provide “intense“ hydration as states. Will repurchase because of it’s reasonable price tag but at my age I need to invest little more on products with more unique ingredients. This is great for younger skins under 28 or so.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: As for any product, this serum needs to be used long term to see the full effect. I’ve gone through 3 bottles of this serum which proves it does what it claims very nicely. It diminishes dark spots and dull complexion as well as correcting uneven skin tone. You will see a slow difference after few weeks of use and before you realize your skin will be glowing. When you stop using this serum, your skin will go back to being dull and dark so it is important to continue the serum as long as you can.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is proven as the best by all the other reviewers and myself as well. It does not cause any breakouts or any other problems to my skin. It does moisturize my face all day long and feels very light weight. My husband also likes using this moisturizer for the same reason; he doesn’t like putting any skincare on his face. I would recommend this if all you want is hydration for your face and nothing else.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I purchased this toner in an Olehenriksen mini set and I am hooked. The scent is BOMB and it does a great job tightening my pores. I can visibility see a difference when I use this. I will be purchasing the full size when my mini runs low.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This stuff is great, I will definitely be repurchasing. It cleanses gently but is powerful enough to break down waterproof mascara, and it leaves my skin soft and hydrated. I’m so impressed especially for the price. A solid product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been self conscious of my large pores for many years now and have tried about everything to help shrink them or make them less visible, nothing has ever worked for me. I decided to try this serum to see if it would help since I have heard nothing but good things. I have been putting it on once a day during the night after I wash my face. I decided I would try it for a week and share my thoughts on the product. Within 1-2 days I could notice a small difference in my pores, they seem like they had gotten smaller - but they were still there. But by my 5th-6th day it was crazy how different my pores looked. They weren’t gone - no. But they were so much smaller and way less visible. I didn’t have to cake on primer and foundation trying to fill them. By day 7 the difference was so amazing. My face looks so much smoother and healthier. It’s so easy to apply, it didn’t irritate my skin or dry me out which is a huge plus. It has made such a large difference on my pores, I couldn’t be any more happy with the results.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for over a week now and the difference it has made on my skin is outstanding. I love trying different serums and facial products, but this one is totally different than anything I have tried before. I apply it twice a day after I wash my face and moisturize my face. You only need a little bit to get your whole face covered. I love that you can wear it under make-up and it gives you a great dewy glowing looking. But even if I don’t wear it under make-up my skin feels so amazing. My skin is so much more smoother, softer, and just looks so much healthier. Within a week I have noticed how much healthier my face looks. It gives me such a healthy glow to my skin, I am obsessed. I was given this product complimentary from Glow Recipe.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: As a mom of three young boys, the dark circles under my eyes and the bags have been getting worse and worse. What is sleep?  I have been on the lookout for a under eye product to help my dark circles, puffiness, and the bags - but have never been able to find something good - until now. I have been using this product for awhile now and the results have blown me away. I have been using it twice a day after I wash and tone my face. The difference it has made is amazing. It’s so easy to apply and you only need a little tiny bit for each eye so you  get tons of use out of the container. Within a week my dark circles have been completely eliminated, there is no more puffiness/bags, and my eye are is so much more smoother/healthier looking. My concealer works so much better under my eyes and doesn’t look caked anymore when I apply it. Highly recommend this product, it has worked amazing for me. I received this product complimentary from Algenist.

reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I was so excited to receive this! The packaging is genius and it comes with a metal spoon to scoop up product that magnetically stays on the lid! Packaging receives a 10/10 for me! The texture is thick but not too thick where my oily skin stayed oily. I used a small amount (size of a nickel) and I was able to cover my whole face and neck. This applied really well and did not leave a film or feel too thick. The only con I have is the smell. This is a personal preference but I don’t like products that have the earthy honey scent. Though it did not linger too long on my skin. I would have preferred it to be unscented. Overall I give this product a 8/10 in my book!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_title: Gentle exfoliation for dry, sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: The essence has really been a game changer for me. I have dry skin that is reactive to a LOT of ingredients, including hyaluronic acid. I also have (fairly minor) fungal acne, and have never found an exfoliant that will work with my skin without reactions. So, I’m usually left with the choice of having dry skin w/o acne, or moisturized skin with fungal acne.The Essence changed that for me! Its exfoliation properties are very gentle and take days or weeks to really be noticeable. But I’ve now gotten to the point where I can use properly emollient lotions and creams for my skin, while keeping fungal acne at bay.I do notice some plumpness when I use this, but wouldn’t recommend that as its main selling point - it really is about that long-term gain in texture and exfoliation from regular use. The price tag made me nervous, but three months in I’m halfway through the bottle, so it’s actually a pretty solid investment.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: It seems like every day there are new Vitamin C serums coming out from multiple skincare lines, but this one is really a winner for me. First of all, I came into this looking for an Ascorbic Acid serum because it’s the most well researched form of Vitamin C to be used topically. There are a lot of “newer” forms of Vitamin C in skincare that are promising, but you can’t go wrong with a tried and true form (side note, Ive seen a lot of gimmicky skincare lines market “Vitamin C” products that just have fruit extracts in them with only a tiny bit of active ingredients, so always make sure to research your serums). This product also comes with an air-tight and light-proof pump to keep the Vitamin C stable. The texture is great, like a rich cream that rubs into the skin very well and has not caused me any irritation. While it’s marketed as an under-eye serum, you can really use it anywhere as a spot treatment. I’m currently on my third bottle of this and am likely to keep repurchasing despite the price being a bit high. One side note: I do not recommend the companion serum to this (the “Powerful-Strength Vitamin C Serum”), as it has a very chalky texture, contains unnecessary and irritating fragrant components, and not all of the sizes come in an air-tight container which means the Vitamin C may become ineffective. I love the eye serum version, but I’d recommend passing on the “regular” version

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Tips For How To Use This
reviews.review_text: I have been using this cleanser consistently for over a year.  I have combination skin- oily t-zone and dry skin.  I have keratosis pilaris on my face and issues with blackheads on my nose, because my body produces a lot of sebum.  This cleanser has been a game changer.  Here is how I use it:1.  I take out a generous scoop and massage it into my face slowly and gently, to prevent tugging.  It starts to melt with body heat and becomes easier to work into the skin.  I massage my face in small, upward circles and especially focus on trouble areas (my nose and cheek).  This stuff gets out gunk like you wouldn’t believe and the face massage is great for blood circulation & relaxation - bonus!2.  When I am done, I turn on the water and let it get hot.  I take a baby washcloth and put it into the hot water, ring it out, and drape it on my whole face to steam my face and loosen up the cleanser, then I gently wipe the cleanser away.  I repeat this again, a second time.  I use a baby washcloth because they are very gentle on the face and because they are thin and dry out quickly.3.  At this point, you can leave your face as is.  On most days, I choose to follow it up with a gentle non-oil cleanser, for a second cleanse.This cleanser, and my current routine, have been very instrumental in my face become clear, producing less oil, and staying hydrated.  If you’re curious, here is what else I use:1. Slaai, 2. Indie Lee Brightening Cleanser , 3. The Ordinary Marine Hyaluronics applied to a damp face, 4. The Ordinary 100% Plant Derived Squalane, 5. A moisturizer.  I have been using samples of Dr. Barbara Sturm’s Face Lotion, and it is absolutely perfect for me, but that’s really expensive.  Tatcha The Dewy Skin Cream has worked second best for me.I sincerely hope this can help someone, because it has taken me years of trying to find a combo of products that work for my skin.  This cleanser is great, once you get comfortable working with it!

reviews.review_text: This stuff Is amazing. I used it in the morning and at night before bed, and my skin has never felt more amazing.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: In love with this eye cream! reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Fresh is one of my favorite brand and this one is absolutely the must have cream you need to try. It’s lightweight but nourish that keeps your skin hydrated all day, and very smooth afterwards. So perfect for winter season!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I looooooooove Fresh’s lip balm! I’m always into natural clean beauty on my daily lifestyle and Fresh always has a perfect colors! And of course keeps my lip hydrated that I can feel it’s been protected. I can’t live without them! This time it was Gifted by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: Alright, so I had decided to test this product for at least a month and then get here. But let me tell you, I am super impressed on day 5 itself. reviews.review_text: I’ve been waiting for almost a month to test out this product before I could review it. I am amazed to see its benefits on my skin. Its just the right product for you if you’re looking toneven out your skin tone and suffer from hyper pigmentation.

My only con is the packaging makes it’s hard to get your finger in there if you have any type of nails, mine really aren’t that long and I had to get creative on how to get the product out but this is just a personal preference and wouldn’t stop me from using the product all together. I definitely recommend this if you are dealing with dry chapped lips!

reviews.review_text: At first I thought I liked this serum but then I started to breakout and I am 99% sure it was this serum because I do not have sensitive skin and once I stopped using it, my face cleared up. reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: Love this moisturizer.  I use it as part of my AM routine before makeup.  I apply it to my face and neck mainly.  It dried fast and leaves my face super soft and radiant.  It can feel sticky for some while it is drying maybe for 10 minutes or so.  I do not mind it’s citrus scent either as it also goes away after 10 mins.  Already getting to my second jar.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: Definitely works for lines and wrinkles.  It does help with puffiness but not so much for dark circles.  It is also hydrating and gentle.  Been using for 3 months and already on my next jar.  Dropped a star for price and packaging.  It is a tad bit expensive and it would have been perfect to have something on top of the jar lid to stick the spoon as I keep loosing it and if it stays more than 3 months it may not be very sanitary.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Useless and causes serious under eye pilling!!
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this but it causes so much pilling under the eye.  It is worse if I put concealer and I literally put a pin size concealer under my eye.. it does not absorb and I would have continued to use if I saw results.. under eye still the same and I only get pilling. Sadly returned!

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review.  I have a skincare routine for my face in the morning and at night.  I believe my skin is very good except for an area around my mouth that has some dryness almost like a dermatitis or eczema.  I had treated it with steroids lately and it gotten much better but still visible and have little texture.  I used the Advanced Youth Watery Oil for about 10 days. During this time I used it as the main serum in the morning and at night.  I did not use any other serum with It as the instructions suggested it should be used as one.  I usually put my serum and/or water oil and wait for few minutes then put my moisturizer. This technique works best to make sure the serum is absorbed to get the best benefit.   I would definitely recommend that technique especially with this serum because it is also a bit sticky when wet.  The texture of this serum is definitely not watery as the name suggests.  I put 4 drops since I do not feel the suggested 2-3 drops cover my face. I have to work it very quickly over my clean face as it dries to a sticky finish very quickly.  As soon as it absorbs the stickiness goes away partially after few minutes and completely after an hour or so. At night I usually put it and unwind then put my night cream.  I do not mind the scent but I feel it is a bit overwhelming especially for products that are marketed clean.  I don’t think this serum causes my face to be greasy as some may fear the oil would.  I cannot comment on how it would behave under makeup.  Now as for the results, I think this serum makes my skin feel plumped. I did notice the dryness around my mouth reduced but not the redness. Overall the skins feels smooth, glows and looks really healthy.  Having said that the price point is quite high for using this on a daily basis.  I would probably only use it occasionally to give my skin a boost.  I may or may not buy again based on how my skin feels.  I reduced a star

reviews.review_text: I received a sample size product from influenster in exchange of my honest review. reviews.review_text: This stuff is great, very hydrating and refreshing on the skin. Makes it look and feel great.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: While I do agree about the size and price-point of this lib balm (too small, high price - hence the 4-stars) but, with that said, it’s honestly one of the best lip balms I’ve ever used. I have a bit of a lip balm obsession (full disclosure - also have a DE obsession, haha) so this lip balm was something I toyed with buying because of the price and size. But, because I do love this company I took the plunge - and I love it! I only really use it in the morning and before bed and definitely find that I don’t need much more and my lips are hydrated throughout the day. So, this is definitely a bit of a “luxury lip balm” and have seen great results from cheaper lip balms such as the ones at whole foods or from saje. But, I love that this has skin-friendly ingredients, and so this will probably keep being my go-to. Would love an spf option!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: I’ve only had this product for a short amount of time, and it’s great! I’ve been waiting for a product like this from DE (especially for use while camping and traveling). My initial thoughts - I first used as a mid-day refresh, and it felt very nice. Very light, cooling, and refreshing. I’ve also been using in place of my morning rinse, and it’s works well. Might still alternate between a water rinse and using this product, as I didn’t fully feel like I was getting the “fresh face” feeling I’m used to in the morning. However, still feels nice and absorbs well into the skin. Also, a little goes a long way if using on your hands directly as opposed to a cotton swab (I accidentally poured way to much on my hands and couldn’t even get it all to absorb on my face, haha, so be cautious!) I did give 5-stars because I love the ingredients in this product and value that there’s no added fragrance or anything. However, with that said - the smell is a bit off putting. I can’t place my finger on it but not the best (could be worse). I’ve used almost all the DE products (hair and body included) and never had an issue with the smell. It’s not too bad and it doesn’t linger but it’s not the most appealing. Overall, a fantastic addition to my DE collection and skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: I’ve only had this product for a short amount of time, and it’s great! I’ve been waiting for a product like this from DE (especially for use while camping and traveling). My initial thoughts - I first used as a mid-day refresh, and it felt very nice. Very light, cooling, and refreshing. I’ve also been using in place of my morning rinse, and it’s works well. Might still alternate between a water rinse and using this product, as I didn’t fully feel like I was getting the “fresh face” feeling I’m used to in the morning. However, still feels nice and absorbs well into the skin. Also, a little goes a long way if using on your hands directly as opposed to a cotton swab (I accidentally poured way to much on my hands and couldn’t even get it all to absorb on my face, haha, so be cautious!) I did give 5-stars because I love the ingredients in this product and value that there’s no added fragrance or anything. However, with that said - the smell is a bit off putting. I can’t place my finger on it but not the best (could be worse). I’ve used almost all the DE products (hair and body included) and never had an issue with the smell. It’s not too bad and it doesn’t linger but it’s not the most appealing. Overall, a fantastic addition to my DE collection and skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: First off, I have a nightmare combination of acne prone, super dry skin with an oily t-zone. I have been using this for about a month now and I’ve got to say, it’s worth the hefty price tag. This feels like it plumps and smooths my skin and controls oil production throughout the day in my t-zone while keeping my dry cheeks and forehead moisturized! I honestly feel like this has diminished the appearance of acne scarring and has helped control the frequency of my breakouts. I’ve been doing the Tatcha double cleanse for about a year now and in conjunction with this product, my skin is looking clearer and brighter than ever!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This product has been my new holy grail. I’ve noticed my very acne prone skin has been a lot more even and smooth after I added this to my nightly routine. If I had worn makeup that day, I would use a dime size amount and just rub it between my hands and then rub it on my face right on top of my makeup. I use it as the first step to removing everything. Then I rinse and follow up with a quick swipe of the Bliss makeup melting wipe. Just to makeup sure I’ve got everything. Usually, hardly anything shows up on the wipe because the Farmacy Balm has done such a great job at removing my makeup. Then lastly I use the Fresh rose toner, which is so hydrating. On days I don’t wear makeup I’ll just use a pea size of the balm and rinse, then follow up with the rose toner. Such a great product. This has definitely been the fix for my acne, it’s the only new addition.

reviews.review_text: I got this in my allure box and was so excited it was the full size, and then after a week of using it, I was SO disappointed. My skin cleared back up when I stopped using it. It sat on my skin and didn’t feel like it completely absorbed & it made my skin look so greasy. The consistency is terrible... it was way too heavy for me. It felt more like a moisturizer than a serum and I felt like such a greaseball after using it. This product is just horrible.

reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is amazing. It absorbs pretty quickly and doesn’t leave my skin looking or feeling greasy. I love the way my skin looks after applying it. It leaves my skin with a nice, somewhat dewy glow, but it’s not a greasy looking dewy glow. It also feels somewhat cooling, which feels great on my face after I’ve been outside running. It doesn’t make my skin break out. It isn’t super heavy, and my skin feels like it can breathe after I put it on. I don’t even need to mention how pretty the jar is that it comes in. This is my new holy grail product and I’ll definitely be repurchasing! Absolutely love this stuff!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Okay, first of all, I just finished a sample I’d gotten in my allure box & loved it so much that I just bought the full size. It’s amazing. So here’s my review:I love the kind of whipped like texture of this stuff. It went on smooth, & it made my face feel super smooth & soft immediately after application. It originally went on looking kind of shiny but once it absorbed, my face wasn’t shiny or greasy at all. It feels super moisturizing but light and not heavy & my skin feels like it could still breathe. It smells very light and fresh, but it’s not overwhelming at all. It calmed my irritation & soothed my redness. It didn’t break my skin out & it actually helped clear up the couple of breakouts I already had. I have a frown line on my forehead that has started to look softer & is less noticeable now (whaaaat?!). My skin looks clearer & more even, & it feels softer & smoother now. This stuff is 10/10, seriously. A little pricey, but I wouldn’t have bought the full size for this price if I hadn’t been so impressed with the sample size I’d gotten. I only used it for a week and a half before I ran out (used it 2x/day; also a little went a long way with this in my case) and it already did everything I described above; I can’t imagine what wonders it’ll do after a month of use!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This lip sleeping mask is fantastic. I put it on about 30 min before I go to bed, drink water, then hit the hay, When I get up in the morning, I still have a layer of the mask on my lips. After wiping with tissue, my lips are soft and supple. If I forget to put on regular balm after I wipe it off, my lips are still soft and nourished for hours afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I am fairly impressed with this product. Being in my mid-40’s, this does a pretty good job with moisturizing my eye orbital area. It even smooths out some of the lines in my upper eyelid area ones the solution is absorbed. In regards to puffiness, it does a fairly good job unless your eye get unusually puffy from allergies or something. I would recommend this to others,

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_title: Dilute with moisturizer if you have sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: OK, I do like this quite a bit. I can’t use this straight because my skin is sensitive to it. However, I add a drop or two to my night time moisturizer, rub my hands together, apply, and it is perfect. Diluted like this, my skin doesn’t react at all. I would definitely recommend a patch test before using it undiluted. Other than that, I am quite satisfied with the results of this product.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: This face wash is the only face wash I’ll ever use again. I dealt with terrible acne when I was younger, and needed to use Proactiv, and Proactiv . These wore terribly on my skin, burning it and leaving me either far too dry, or far too oily. Origins has solved this, and balanced my skin and skin-tone. Even if I’m left a little dry, I can add a little moisturizer and I’m all good! No more little bumps, highly minimized blackheads, and a smooth feeling is left to my skin. I could go one for ages about this product, but all I can say is ditch your drugstore brands, ditch Proactiv, and buy this stuff! Cetaphil left me with an allergic reaction, but Origins has treated me nothing but kindly!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This product has always helped my under-eye circles when a good night’s sleep ensues. While the difference might not be astounding, it’s enough for my nighttime routine. I wake up and my eyes DO NOT feel swollen, like many other eye creams. This eye cream prevents my (genetic) under-eye bags from worsening. The first eye cream I’ve ever used turned out to be the perfect one! I only have a sample, but it’s lasted me forever. I’ll be purchasing a full-size once the sample is gone!

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I love the glow that this product gives my skin! I’ve been using it for a month now, and my face is tighter, balanced in complexion, and brilliant overall! This product truly went viral for a reason.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Rarely can you use a skincare product just once and see results, but that is 100% the case with this product. My pores look smaller and my skin has never been so smooth! I will definitely be using this the night before special occasions because the immediate results are so good. In addition to just my normal skin looking good, I feel like makeup goes on smoother and looks more dewy after using. It does tingle when applied, and burn if you have any blemishes, dry patches, or abrasions, but that goes away after 15 seconds or so.  FWIW I consider myself to have normal skin, someone prone to breakouts particularly hormonal breakouts. Prior to trying this product I had been using an AHA toner and a BHA wash for YEARS, and more recently I started to use an AHA/BHA serum 1-2 nights/week, so I knew my skin could tolerate AHAs and BHAs.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I sometimes get pimples that feel like they’re spreading out under the skin and I can’t get them to form a head and just pop! But they’re painful and I used to always mess with them until my skin was red, weeping, even bleeding (and still had a painful zit!) These work on those. I wear them overnight and can feel them working and then in the morning the zit has come to a nice head - I can pop and move on with my life. I don’t use them on minor whiteheads because I don’t think they’re cost-effective, but it’s super nice to have them on hand for those occasional impossible-to-pop, impossible-to-ignore zits.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I really didn’t want to like this mask because, let’s be honest, I don’t need another expensive skincare step in my routine, but GOSH this mask is good. Especially now that we are rolling into the winter months (I live in the Northeast), I am happy to have this super hydrating mask. It makes my skin look and feel so smooth and fresh. Currently using once a week but honestly I think I would feel ok with using this as a nightly moisturizer. I have normal to oily skin and usually have a few breakouts a month. I feel really good putting this on; it’s very moisturizing without making me feel slick the next day. My skin just feels bouncy and smooth!

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I haven’t used a ton of makeup wipes that don’t leave behind eye makeup, but this one actually did the trick. I woke up the next morning with zero mascara/eyeliner residue. There is not a strong scent and the ingredients are not aggravating to my skin.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I live in a very dry place, and this cream does the trick. It’s thick but does not leave my skin oily or greasy, and does not cause breakouts. There is no scent which also makes it non-irritating even on the first use.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I live in a very dry place, and this cream does the trick. It’s thick but does not leave my skin oily or greasy, and does not cause breakouts. There is no scent which also makes it non-irritating even on the first use.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I purchased the mini size thinking I’d like to try before I buy. But it turns out that a little goes a long way and this mini size will probably last me a while. It has a very thick consistency but melts in nicely. The green tint also gives a light glow under my eyes which I love after removing all of my makeup at night. I have somewhat sensitive skin and eyes, and this product does not irritate at all, likely because of the ingredients and absence of fragrances. It’s very hydrating and I’ll be keeping this in my nightly routine.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for a few weeks at night and I don’t see a difference or the benefit. I do feel a slight tingle after I apply it, which is nice. I would not re-purchase, I may not even finish these pads.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a good moisturizer but I will look at other options when this runs out. I find it provides a medium amount of moisture which is ideal because my serums are hydrating. If you want a good moisturizer with vitamin c, Peter Thomas Roth has a great one for a similar price. I do like this moisturizer but for the price I would expect better.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this! It is a wonderful makeup remover and my skin feels very soft after. I had research oil cleansers and there was a lot of talk about “combat oil with oil“ and I’m a believer! Highly recommenced

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This product is so good! I found a lip balm that saved me by La Roche Posay and that has been my holy grail for a year now. It is still good, but this overnight lip mask has changed the game. I wake up with smooth lips. Even after I shower in the morning and I do my usual skin routine, I dont even need to apply lip balm. I highly recommend it and I have gifted it to many people. Also, I like in Canada and our winters do get dry and cold, so it can also withstand Canadian climate.

reviews.review_text: The bomb-dot-com! Recently started using Retin-A and my skin has been dryer than ever before, so this product is a life-saver!

reviews.review_text: Deeply moisturizing without getting greasy. My skin feels dewy when I use this.

reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin and this eye cream is a dream. It is super moisturizing but not greasy or oily. I tried it under my eye makeup and had no issues at all.  I love Clinique products because they are fragrance-free. I received a sample sized #freeproduct through #trywithtopbox so I haven’t tried it long-term yet but I would definitely buy this next time.

reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin and this cream is a dream. It is super moisturizing but not greasy or oily. I love Clinique products because they are fragrance-free.
