reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin and this serum gives a nice boost to the moisturizer. I like it for a bit more moisture especially as the weather gets colder. I love Clinique products because they are fragrance-free. I received a sample sized #freeproduct through #trywithtopbox so I haven’t tried it long-term yet and can’t comment on its anti-aging properties. It’s a bit expensive but I trust and like Clinique products so I would definitely consider purchasing.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this as a complimentary gift for testing and I’ve really been enjoying it. It makes your skin feel fresh and moisturized without being greasy or sticky. It’s super light and the scent is light and fresh also. I don’t have dry skin so I was worried it would make me oily or break out but it doesn’t.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is really a great moisturizer. It feels so lightweight and cool and refreshing! I have dry spots on my eyelids and when I use this they are significantly better the next day. Also it just give your skin a healthy dewy look. You only have to use a small amount, but I Definitely will be purchasing this after I run out!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff! I thought it was so fun to mix it myself and it gives reassurance that it is freshly mixed and the ingredients inside are still going to do their best. It feels like it really brightens up and tightens my skin! Unfortunately, the one downside I think this has is the smell is not appealing, but it doesn’t matter too much because it quickly goes away.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I just started using this since I received it last week. I’m hoping that it will work with my problem areas.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Daily peel .i received a sample of this from pinchme. I can’t wait to try it.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this from PINCHme. Bare minerals skin longevity long life herb serum. I always wanted to try their products for years. This seems like it would work. It feels nice. Need more than a few trys.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I try to use products for sensitive skin so I was excited to give this a try. Unfortunately I was not impressed with the texture, smell, or outcome. The face cleanser is definitely a goopy gel and hard to lather on the face. The smell is so strong, almost a mix between cucumbers and cucumbers being made into homemade pickles. After using it for a week I noticed it started to break my skin out. I will stick with my Aveno gel cleanser. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I received this face wash complimentary for review purposes. I have enjoyed using this as an alternative to my daily, non-exfoliating facial cleaner. This face wash smells lovely and I adore it’s natural ingredients list. It’s a good, strong scrub that really scrubs away impurities and makes the face feel so smooth and fresh. It does not lather much, however, so that takes time to get used to. I also am not impressed with the quantity received for the price. Overall, I like it.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I was unsure what to think about a facial oil, mostly because I have oily skin; but this stuff has been so hydrating without causing excess oil! It has made my skin soft and really helped to brighten my skin. I love that the ingredients are plant-based. I’m a big fan of Squalane and think it does wonders for the skin! I received this product complimentary to test from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster. I was really impressed with this serum! It instantly made my skin feel tighter and softer. It didn’t break my face out and really helped with some of the discoloration. My only criticism is the smell. Not fond of it. I do believe I would need to try this more than just a week to truly know how well I like it (I only received a week supply).

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this moisturizer as my night cream for about two months and I really like it. It feels great and hydrating, and it absorbs well into the skin. The price IS steep but I’m okay with paying a bit more for a good night cream. Also love the airtight container although I have no idea when I would run out.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’m so glad I decided to try this. I have never been able to find a good cleanser -- either it was too drying, left a residue or caused me to breakout. FAB’s cleanser is awesome! It’s foamy/creamy, very gentle on the skin yet my face feels super clean afterwards. Will re-purchase.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I’m so glad I decided to try this! This is a perfect sunscreen for everyday wear. Super light and non-greasy. Best part is that it goes on completely clear on your skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I’m so glad I decided to try this! This is a perfect sunscreen for everyday wear. Super light and non-greasy. Best part is that it goes on completely clear on your skin.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for about two months and I would say that it is just okay. It brightens the eyes but temporarily and it leaves a sticky residue. I’ll finish the one that I have but I won’t be buying again.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: this product works miracles, in two weeks helped clear all my hormonal acne.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Great stuff, this is my go to mosturizer! my acne has improved so much.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Great stuff, this is my go to mosturizer! my acne has improved so much.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: magic in a bottle. I used to use drunk elephant’s night serum, but this stuff is cheaper and works wonders on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I’ve used wipes for years - i know not great but i just like how quick they are when you get home from a long day of work. I was able to get this as a 100pt perk, enough uses to test and like that i purchased the TS during the last sale. I always hesitated on cleansing balms/oils because i don’t like the feel of heavy oil sitting on my skin and massaging on dry skin is an adjustment. This truly feels more like a balm compared to the DE ver i tried prior. The texture is much nicer but I still prefer to use a bifacil remover for eye makeup (less mess with eyeliner/mascara) and then go in with this to remove any residuals along with my base before cleansing. I wear medium coverage /matte foundations (full face) so i like to use a makeup eraser that has been soaked in warm almost hot water to further aid removing all of the makeup (i find this does a better job vs just my hands to rinse off). Once i cleanse my face after with fresh soy & foreo I can really feel the difference in removal vs wipes. Since i am WFH currently i’d imagine the TS is going to last until the next sale, but I will definitely purchase the FS next. If you wear less / lighter makeup you may not find a need to cleanse after removing.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: First let me preface this by saying at the time of this review i have only tried one other cleansing balm. I wanted to try more of the protini moisturizer, and this came in a duo DLX set to try so i thought why not. Initially i can feel this oil on application much more so than another green clean balm. This also seems to leave a bit of a residue until you cleanse after removing makeup, and i also feel like i need to use more of it. The smell is ’green’, assuming i am picking up on the marula oil - not my favorite but not terrible either. While this does a decent job of removing a full face of makeup it has not blown me away. I wear medium/matte foundation (full face) and find that i sometimes need to go in twice before cleansing to get everything off (if you wear less makeup /lighter this may be fine for you). This is also with the use of a makeup eraser to aid in removal. OK but not amazing, not running out to purchase the FS.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: Love love, this was a home run for me. I initially got a set of 3 last fall and fell in love. The new packaging is way better and i love the rubbery tip that has a slight curve to apply. The old aluminum type packaging is the reason i held off so long on trying it. This is closer to a gloss-balm in feeling, but with more shine than a typical balm. Sadly my favorite shade from the trio was brown sugar and limited edition so i hope they bring it back permanently. I use the clear one at home and throw the tinted ones in my bag.  The scent is amazing and not at all artificial smelling. They feel hydrating but still light and cushiony on the lips. This works day or night but I’d probably go with something heavier at night for the very cold winter months.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: First of all, this packaging is the cutest! This doesn’t have the typical sunscreen smell and it goes on super nice! I think it blends well with makeup. It isn’t greasy or thick and my skin is glowing! I didn’t notice that it pilled like some people said.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I love these for getting all of the gross stuff out of my pores, especially on my nose and chin. They don’t hurt when you remove them and it’s satisfying to see everything they pulled out! I would recommend

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: These drops were gifted by Isle of Paradise and are amazing and give a very natural glow! They’re gentle on my skin and didn’t dry it out. I love mixing it with my moisturizer and watching the color develop over time. I would recommend!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed this sunscreen. It has a pleasant smell and feels luxurious on the skin. The scent was overpowering at first, but after 30 seconds or so, you don’t even notice it. It blends well, has a nice consistency, and you don’t notice it under makeup.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed this sunscreen. It has a pleasant smell and feels luxurious on the skin. This sunscreen was also really convenient, glides effortlessly on the skin, and was easy to take on the go.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this amazing serum, Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum, for weeks now and I can really notice a difference. The refreshing metal spatula feels great on my under eye area and this serum really brightens my eyes to make me look less tired. I will definitely order this again!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I use this along with a clinique bar soap I use for my face in the shower, it’s a great product and really leaves the skin feeling clean and is soothing. I’m on my 3rd bottle

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: I really like this product for a daytime face cream. Its very light weight but moisturizing and leaves skin with a nice complexion. You do have to use a fair amount of this product but the 40ml lasts a decent amount of time. I tried the saturday skin and switched back to this because it calmed the redness in my skin a bit more

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: Nice luxurious product but not worth the price. Its a very nice product but personally did not do anything special for my skin. Its very hydrating and makes the skin feel soft but the job can be done with other products

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: I used to use the clinique toner for about 6-7 years before switching over to this. I wanted to start using something that didn’t have as much alcohol in it. It was hard finding a toner that balanced my skin, made it feel super clean without making it feel dry. After testing out the khiels and origins toners I tried this and was super happy-- it gave me the results of my clinique toner but contains much better ingredients. I’m now on my third bottle of this toner and cannot recommend it enough. It makes my skin feel super clean without drying it out. It has helped with controlling acne, and overall pore size. It really is a balancing toner. 10/10 would recommend. Also lasts a really long time

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Amazing scent and easy on dry skin!
reviews.review_text: love the smell...so good with such a subtle touch of creamy dreamy yogurt scent, it’s so lovely.  This product is very gently leaving my dry flakey skin hydrated, fresh and clean. I keep this by the skin and use each morning as I shower at night and it doesn’t feel harsh to my sensitive skin after a night up skin treatments I’ve recently been using. I am literally headed to sephora to purchase a larger size because its been so pleasant.  I recieved this product free for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: I love the convenience of this little power packing purple serum stick! I keep it in my bag because my skin has literally become so dry the past month that I haven’t been able to wear foundation that was created for dry skin...real struggle!  I love the formula,  it leaves my skins texture looking dewy and refreshed especially under my eye area.  I use it both underneath and on top of my it cosmetics bye bye under eye

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: flawless skin bare or under foundation!
reviews.review_text: I had the pleasure of testing out this product out free for my honest review and am pleased all around.  The product absorbed quickly,  leaving no tacky residue behind.  I personally love wearing this product underneath my foundation or bare. It looks amazing both ways and fills any fine lines and imperfections while treating.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Really hydrating and packaging is super nice!!! Smell is a bit off but product is really good.  I would recommend!  Consistency is perfect

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer!!!! Smells great, consistency is great and leaves my face feeling super hydrated.  It’s a bit on the pricey side but packing is definitely high end!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This was gifted to me by Glow Recipe.  These drops are amazing.  They left my skin feeling smooth and dewy.  I used this product under my makeup and my makeup looked amazing and glowy.  I would absolutely recommend these drops to anyone!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: This is a nice product. After the first use my skin felt smooth and soft. The product is very easy to use and instructions were very clear. Some acne has calmed down and softened some spots. Only downside is the product is a bit on the pricey side.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I don’t usually use night creams but I was pleasantly surprised by this one. It has a nice texture and I like how soft my face feels in the morning. I also noticed a nice brightening effect too. I’ve only used it a few times but I look forward to the results I get after prolonged use. It does “pill” a little on my face like an overnight face mask though, rather than absorb all the way like a typical night cream. It’s pretty scented too, if you are sensitive to smell be aware.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Haven’t used anything from Fresh other than their cleanser and lip balms but was pleasantly surprised by this moisturizer. Didn’t make my oily skin greasy, and had a nice softening effect. A little goes a long way. It is pretty scented so if you are sensitive to smells, be aware.

reviews.review_text: I really liked the idea of a stick Retinol for the eyes. I was surprised how small the product is. reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: Pros- I like that they are all one size that are large enough to cover my hormonal acne. They are very sticky. I have had no issues with them falling off and can wear all night. reviews.review_text: I received this item for free from the brand. I was very intrigued as I haven’t tried this brand before. It helps to calm the redness on my face and feels refreshing. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.review_text: This is a thick creme and I have oily skin so I was concerned it would be too moisturizing. It sinks into the skin quickly and leaves it feeling moisturized but not overly so. You have to rub between your fingers until it becomes translucent prior to application. reviews.review_text: I am in shock at how much of a difference this made in the appearance of my facial skin in only 3 days! It’s not a huge difference yet but very noticeable to me. I can’t wait to see how much lighter the dark spots get when I continue to use this! I am very happy so far!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Fantastic product! I have always had problems with sunblock due to dry skin and eczema flares. It is scented but very muted compared to other sunblocks. I dislike oily formulas and this one is definitely not oily. New favorite sunblock!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Sunscreen couldn’t get easier! Absolutely amazed by the packaging and the product itself. I can toss this into a bag to reapply. Typically I get eczema flares with this type of stick sunblock but haven’t experienced it yet with this one! Received this as a complimentary gift but can’t wait to go grab more once I finish this one!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Great for someone with redness and sensitive skin! I have eczema and very pink undertones and sometimes just need light coverage instead of wearing foundation or concealer. Love that this has spf and is lightweight for day to day. It applies really nicely with a slight learning curve. It looks best pat in rather than rubbing and it’s important to moisturize before because it will show patches if you have dry skin. Patting reduces any powdery looks.

Since I started doing this, my makeup wears a lot better and longer through the day. I also get tons of compliments about my glowing skin! Note: I did receive the product in exchange for an unbiased review.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen has a pleasant scent- almost floral, but not overpowering. This sunscreen is on the more liquid side than others I’ve used and it needs to be shaken well to make sure it’s not separated. This sunscreen said it could be used as a primer and was mattifying. Ironically it made my skin look greasy with my normal makeup about 3 hours after applying. I also found my makeup broke down quicker with this underneath. However this sunscreen looks amazing when worn without makeup! It gave my skin a nice healthy glow. I will keep this sunscreen to use on no makeup days.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I really like this sunscreen! I’ve been using it both with and without makeup on top. It doesn’t break my makeup down, which is nice. This sunscreen has a light fragrance to it and is not greasy at all. This has the normal sunscreen texture and feels like a light lotion going onto the face. I spent some time outside today while just wearing this sunscreen (no makeup on top) and didn’t burn at all!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer for sensitive skin!. I was worried at first because of the name milk moisturizer but it’s vegan and clean. It has no scent which I love and it goes on soft and smooth.

reviews.review_title: Definitely purchasing when I run out!
reviews.review_text: Been using this for a week and can already feel a difference in my skin texture! The winter has made m6 skin super dry but I put this on at night and my moisture barrier is healthy and my skin is plump. It’s a serum and it runs high, but if you’re going to invest do it on quality ingredients! Especially something you keep on your face for long periods. Invest in the tatcha Dewey serum!!

reviews.review_text: I’m not seeing any huge results but overall it moistures my under eye area. But unfortunately doesn’t work under the makeup, it stars peeling iff while I’m applying my concealer

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_title: To keep only one product! THIS is my choice
reviews.review_text: I used it as the last step of my skincare. I massage it on my face and a few hours later my skin look so beautiful, it help will dullness and uneven skin tone. I have acne prone skin and it doesn’t clog my pores. Im so in love with it.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I love how it makes my skin feel moisturized. It’s the best for under makeup (concealer), I searched my whole life for an eye cream to let me apply my concealer smoothly and evenly.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_title: Pricey but my skin loves it
reviews.review_text: Goop gifted me a jar of this delicious dual-action exfoliant and I’m excited to share my thoughts. Firstly, this is not my first jar and I’ve purchased it when the line originally launched. It’s potent so may not be ideal for those with super sensitive skin types but my combination skin (prone to congestion) does very well with it. The whipped formula includes microcyrstals for physical exfoliation and glycolic acid which delivers chemical resurfacing. The addition of Vitamin C only amplifies the overall brightening properties of this treatment. Word of advice: don’t leave it on longer than the recommended three minutes as it may leave you red for a while after rinsing. My only gripe is the rather hefty price tag.

reviews.review_text: This has been my winter go-to since its launch. The formula is rich and creamy but not overwhelming and while the scent is present, it does not bother me. I actually look forward to slathering this on when the winter temperatures drop. If your skin is combo/oily, it’s probably best you use it during Fall/Winter months as it can make your skin shiny otherwise. I enjoy the lighter version but this icon deserve the cult classic status.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I have yet to find a Fresh mask I did not like but finding a serum that can become a staple is definitely more tricky. When the brand sent over a complimentary bottle, I was ecstatic to give it a try. I am partial to the Tea Extract infused collection because I believe its antioxidant powers are both impressive and effective. This latest launch is pretty fantastic when it comes to hydrating the skin instantly -- it also contains Niacinamide which I gravitate towards every time to help with the appearance of enlarged pores. The addition of ceramides is much appreciated as I’m over 40 and always look for something to help with the glow and bounce. So far, it’s only been two weeks but it’s been a seamless addition to my routine (AM mostly) and I am looking forward to finishing my bottle.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This is my all time favorite moisturizer. It feels super light yet very moisturizing. Also fragrance free. I’ve gone through so many of these and will continue to repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

You have to really work it in then I like to leave it on for a minute or so. This cleanser is definitely worth a try. I’ve already purchased my second bottle.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: This stuff makes my face feel super hydrated and soft! I like to use it especially before makeup to creat a smooth canvas.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: This stuff makes my face feel super hydrated and soft! I like to use it especially before makeup to creat a smooth canvas.

reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample from Influenster but have used the product in the past as well. Absolutely LOVE this product. I personally find water-based creams to be so much more hydrating for my face but at the same time it is very light and airy so you don’t feel like there is cream sitting on your face which I like. I would definitely recommend trying it out for yourself!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: This toner unlike others is actually quite hydrating and doesn’t give you that stiff and rigid feeling that many other timers give. While it may not be chemically as strong, I actually prefer it, because it does the job without damaging my skin. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I normally prefer chemical exfoliants, but wow! I love this scrub! I immediately feel my skin is soft and smooth after use.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I recently got to try the Glow Recipe Dew Drops which I recieved #complimentaryfromglowrecipe for my honest review. This feels really nice on the skin, is moisturizing and adds a subtle glow. I like using this on the tops of my cheekbones for a natural dewy look without the use of an actual highlighter. If you like that no makeup, makeup look or a “glass skin“ look, I think that you would really enjoy this product! I gave the product 4 stars because I’m not sure about some of the ingredients and how safe they are. For example, I wish I knew what they used for fragrance.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Upon initial application, I really like how this feels on the skin! It’s like a creamy gel that sinks into the skin quickly. It’s lightweight and doesn’t feel sticky. It leaves the skin feeling moisturized and looking glowy! The scent isn’t super strong which I appreciate. You can definitely smell a fruity scent. I don’t totally love the scent but it’s not bad. Overall, I really like how it feels on the skin! It does have a pretty long list of ingredients so if you like more minimal ingredients in your products, this list of ingredients might be more than what you want. I do think that is has some nice ingredients though. It has lots of oils and fruit/leaf extracts. It also has hyaluronic acid and niacinamide!

The scent also isn’t very strong which I personally appreciate.

reviews.review_title: surprised how much I liked this
reviews.review_text: I purchased the mini size to try after trying a sample packet (the sample product is always great but when I purchase a full size it’s completely.different!) . I’m surprised how much my skin liked it, it’s a very thick moisturizer and I have combo/more oily skin and my skin just drank it up! maybe I’m dehydrated and didnt even know it?!  it is a bit thick for wearing under make up in warmer weather but as a nighttime moisturizer I really like it so far. I feel like it regulates my oily areas and gives hydration to my dry cheeks. I like that it doesnt have any active ingredients acid etc. sometimes our skin needs a basic moisturizer and itll do the rest itself.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_title: this can be a great product...if applied correctly
reviews.review_text: ok so I read all the reviews before I bought this. this is my first time using any kind of self tanner anywhere on my body. my coworker came in one with such a nice glow, I asked her and she told me about this product. I ordered and was EXTREMELY careful the first time i applied. I work from home I figure even if it’s a splotchy mess no one will see me anyways. so anywho I tried it on my legs first. I mixed it with the bum bum cream, for reference I’m middle Eastern, VERY pale in the winter but in the summer I get a nice bronze color not too dark. I wanted to mimic that since I’m home 5 days a week 9-5.  a lot of people were complaining about splotchyness and staining on the hands. so I did the first leg and worked it in all over until I couldn’t even feel the lotion anymore. (maybe 2-3 min) washed my hands and repeated on the other leg and went to sleep. I was SO impressed by the results, I did my arms and chest as well the next day. maybe I was overly cautious but what I’m try to say is application and attention to detail is important to get a good result. you cant just slap it on anywhere, then complain about splotchiness and blame the product. maybe there are better ones out there, but I really like the color that this gave me. and it just faded out after about a week or so. no patchiness or streakiness from water. I recommend.

reviews.review_title: The world doesn't need more dimethicone.
reviews.review_text: Feels AMAZING. Thanks dimethicone! Smells lovely. Thanks fragrance! That being said, yes...it moisturizes. Would I prefer not paying $50 for this? Yeap! I can do without. My skin can’t stand dimethicone and it’s in everything. No benefit to the skin whatsoever, just makes the product silky and glide on easily. Looking beyond the clinical packaging - I’ll PASS.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: You must try this...it really does what it claims!
reviews.review_text: Omg, I’ve NEVER used any skincare that caused such a change in my skin, as quickly or as effectively. I always took beauty/skin product claims with a grain of salt because I never saw any changes they promised without using religiously for 4-6 months and even then it was only a fraction of what was claimed. Well, I will never be without Good Genes. I bought it in a set with Luna oil and both are amazing. Good Genes gets right down to tackling slow skin cell turnover rate and by the first few days I could see a fresher look to my skin, like that dead layer that wants to cling so badly was being shed. From the get-go it was healing a few pimples I had  (I’m 43 and take Retin-A for stubborn persistent acne and although it Retin-A has gotten me so far, it isn’t the be-all, end-all, and my skin became so dry, it looked reptilian). I noticed that freckles and old pimple hyperpigmentation I had and I was treating with another product for 6 months were getting even lighter after just a couple weeks with Good Genes. This is not just another lactic acid, this is a treatment product that is your brightener, exfoliator, your skintone-evener, skin-plumper and hydrator (lactic acid is a humectant and draws in moisture). I will never be without this miracle worker. :)

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: This eye cream will make you believe in magic
reviews.review_text: Before using this eye cream from Drunk Elephant, I completely agreed with dermatologists who say that hereditary dark circles cannot be eliminated. Well, I’m here to say that that’s hogwash, at least for me anyways. I have a genetic disorder that makes my skin very thin, so you can imagine how thin the skin under my eyes are. Because of this thinness and my skin’s translucency, my under eyes were very purple from the veins beneath it. I’ve even had fillers in my tear troughs to try to help their appearance in the past. I received a 5ml sample of C-Tango and less than halfway through it, my under eyes became bright and hydrated. So much so that I hardly ever use concealer anymore. I know this sounds too-good-to-be-true, but this is my honest experience. Also amazing is the fct that I am still using that same sample! I don’t use it every night now, just a couple times a week to maintain. Of course I can’t say with certainty that C-Tango will give you the results I’ve had, but I can say it’s worth trying. Get a sample from a Sephora store and give it a for a couple of weeks. Just a tiny amount is needed. I will never be without this eye cream now and as soon as my little sample is done, I’m buying the full-size. I can’t imagine going back to my dark, unhealthy-looking under eyes ever again.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_title: You’re seeing cellulose, not balls of dead skin
reviews.review_text: Nice ingredients that will definitely help to exfoliate your skin over time but don’t think the balled up stuff you see when using this is dead skin. The second ingredient in this scrub is cellulose and all of these “instant exfoliators” have cellulose in it to make you think it’s working wonders and removing all this dead skin so quickly. Trust me, I make my own skin-care products from time to time and have cellulose to use as a thickener but i hate that it always balls up exactly like this. Don’t be fooled.

When I woke up it was GONE, but for a tiny bit of redness which was gone within the next 24 hours. This stuff is awesome!!!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Nothing compares. This balm is magical on my often irritated, dried out lips. Better yet it looks like a beautiful gloss.

reviews.review_text: This product is completely different than any face lotion I’ve ever tried. It does not leave your skin feeling oily or shiny. It also smells amazing and made my skin feel fresh.

I love the packaging with most charlotte Tisbury items but this just screams 20’s glam. It’s so pretty I’m gonna have to leave it on my vanity even when it’s used up.

reviews.review_title: Great actives, bad addition of perfume/coloring.
reviews.review_text: This has multiple forms of vitamin c, including both the pure form and various stable vitamin c derivatives. That is great and their active ingredients are the best feature of this product. The gel crème texture is great for easy application in the morning. Aside from glycerin, there are a few good hydrating additions, but most are too small in quantity to make it a great moisturizer. What’s up with all those plant extracts? They are quite unnecessary, but the use of artificial fragrance and coloring is what really knocks the stars off this rating. Ole, make a cleaner version of this product (more humectants/emollients and less perfume

reviews.review_title: Cosmetically elegant; best vitamin c serum texture
reviews.review_text: This serum as the best texture of any vitamin c aerum that I’ve tried, and I’ve tried a lot. I am surprised it’s not more popular since more vitamin serums are sightly oily. This is a lightweigt cream-fluid. It absorbed super fast. It’s a vitamin c derivative so it stays stable and the percentage is good too. People are really sleeping on this. Great formula. You should use vitamin c in the morning, but I used it at night after cleansing and before all other serums and moisturizers. Layering was easy and skin was nice and plump the next day. This is something to stock up on at Sephora’s next sale.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_title: Amazing color, not so amazing smell!
reviews.review_text: I have pretty fair skin but I tan easily in the sun. I picked dark because I figured I’d have to use less drops. I read somewhere that the certain shades help with color correcting so you’re “supposed to” pick your actual shade but I enjoy the dark! I’ve used them twice on my whole body & face. Use unscented lotion on your body & no spf on the face when you mix! (I use the yellow Vaseline lotion & the ordinary’s moisturizer on my face) I ended up using around 4-6 drops per body part & 2 on my face & it was a nice natural glow the next day. Only reason I give it 4 stars is because the fake tan smell was STRONG after it developed. Even after I showered I could still smell it more so than other tanners. Now I use dove bar soap after I self tan & it gets rid of the smell completely! So if you have the same issue as me, try it :)

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water
reviews.review_title: Your Natural Shade MATTERS When Choosing A Bottle!
reviews.review_text: All the bad reviews I see are saying they turned orange or that the color didn’t look good. I’m pretty fair (but easily tanned in the summer) & bought the dark. I had a TINGE of orange so I just exfoliated a bit & then it was natural enough. I plan on finishing the bottle then buying medium. I have the shade medium in their drops & the color-correcting is great! So the dark shade was personal error on my part. Just like most high-quality self-tanners, the smell is great when you apply but it still smells like every other self-tanner when it develops. (If you want to get rid of this instantly, use dove BAR SOAP on every inch of your body you tan when you first wash it off...yes even behind your ears) The application is very simple IMO. I also use my hands every time & I think it helps because none of the product is getting absorbed in the mitt which can result in unevenness with clear formulas. Just be mindful of where you’ve applied already, don’t overapply because you will turn orange or have different colored body parts, and wash your hands VERY well after. I also think it fades very naturally but I’m also quarantined & haven’t worked out with it on or done absolutely anything that would make me sweat it off. One of the best self-tanners I’ve used. *Note* Don’t expect to get as dark as something like St Tropez tanning mousse, it’s not that intense. Think natural bronze. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Took The Focus Off My Acne/Redness
reviews.review_text: I usually have normal-oily skin but with mask wearing my skin has been breaking out on my chin & around my mouth (where the mask is), oily but dehydrated, and the texture has been insane, every type of makeup just made it look worse. I’ve been using a prescription retinoid so I wear sunscreen daily & when I ran out I was looking for a new one that didn’t feel as greasy. Then I saw this product on a TikTok & immediately purchased it. I’ve used it for the last 4 days & it feels amazing. My skin feels more hydrated, a healthy glow that doesn’t turn to oil, and the redness is SIGNIFICANTLY reduced. This is a green to beige color correcting treatment with SPF, it doesn’t cover my acne but it makes my red spots from scarring a LOT less visible. It didn’t make my skin look perfect & flawless but it evened out my skin tone & took the attention off my redness & acne which has made me feel a lot better about my skin! If you’re looking for something light with spf this has been great & hasn’t had any bad reactions on my sensitive skin. There are essential oils/fragrance so check the ingredients but it hasn’t bothered me so far!

reviews.review_text: Coming from a fair skinned, freckled ginger who goes up into flames in the sun, my best friend told me I need to try sunless tanner. So I ventured out after reading endless reviews and investigating each product I could find. It was a toss up between St. Tropez and Isle of Paradise. Since I am a review junkie, I decided to try the latter. I also messaged the company directly on IG with questions. They responded the next day which meant a lot to Lil ole me. By golly does this stuff work!! I mixed it with my vitamin C serum and applied. I used 4 drops... and woke up the next day bronze. Not gold, bronze. So I will use 2 drops next time, but I love the glow this product gave me. I have read several reviews where people say the peach one does not give much colour...I say otherwise. Make sure you really get ALL of your face. I missed a small spot by my ear and yes you could see. Regardless of that, this stuff is amazing and I feel cheated I’ve missed out on this and remained pastey white for years out of fear. Definitely will be purchasing this again!!

The rice wash is beautiful and I use this moisturizer JUST at night because it is heavier. I’ve purchased cheap a** products off Amazon that have worked great, and I’ve also splurged on brand name products that do nothing for me. I got lucky with this one, but again I get the mini sizes to try first. Cleansing oils/moisturizing oils make me break out, whereas other people love them. reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I use this after my water based moisturizer and before I use foundation. One drop is enough. And it doesn’t make me more oily, but keeps my skin extra hydrated during the winter!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried even super expensive vitamin c serums and I still prefer this one. (Mostly because it’s so cheap and I get the same results!) Some people seem to complain about the texture and it “staying on your face” but I will use it in the morning and just rub a little extra till it dissolves. Then continue my routine. I love it! For sure helps hyper pigmentation and has brightened my complexion.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_title: can’t find a better serum for the price
reviews.review_text: This serum has made my skin feel more smooth and soft, plus it’s cheap! Why not?!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Amazing. I use twice a week for 10 minutes. My skin is soft and it helps clear up my spotty acne. I tell all my friends about it.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Helps keep my skin glowing and fresh. Overnight results. Gentle enough to use during the day with spf. Gets rid of my sebaceous filaments.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Excellent for my dry rosacea prone skin. Never need another moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Excellent for my dry rosacea prone skin. Never need another moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: MY HOLY GRAIL CREAM AND WORTH EVERY PENNY!!
reviews.review_text: I was delighted to see this product in a smaller size and price point. I wanted to try it out before committing to buying a $55 moisturizer. I was not disappointed! It is a powerhouse of anti aging ingredients yet it isn’t heavy at all! Not only is it one of the very few moisturizers I’ve found that has 5 different types of Ceramides but they’re some of the initial ingredients so they make up a large portion of the product! It also contains Elderberry, Hyaluronic acid, Sodium PCA, Hydrolized silk AND Saccromyces/ ferment in Iron, Copper, Magnesium, Zinc and Silicon! Saccromyces and or Galactomyces are the key ingredient in the Asian skin care treatment essences that are so effective and popular! The fact that is has all of these ingredients yet is so light and makes my skin so soft it’s truly astonishing! I’ve found my new Holy Grail moisturizer and DONT foresee myself switching anytime soon! I use this in the morning and Drunk Elephant’s Protini Polypeptide Cream in the evening and I’ve seen such a positive and drastic change! My skin hasn’t looked this plump, refreshed and soft since my late 20’s!!

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is amazing! With all of the ingredients is has and at it’s price point! I mix this with Cerave’s PM moisturizer. With those two combined you have every item your stratum corneum needs to be healthy! Which are ceramides, cholesterol, fatty acids, amino acids, sodium PCA, glycerin and urea. With my stratum corneum healthy now my skin doesn’t get dehydrated and I don’t have to worry about TEWL (Trans epidermal water loss). I’ve found by really studying what your skin needs and finding those ingredients you don’t always have to buy expensive skin care products. Truly skin hasn’t been this hydrated in years!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was elated when I found this item in the mini size. I’m usually pretty nervous and skeptical with a moisturizer that is over $50. I’d have to really like the ingredient list and watch reviews for people that aren’t getting paid to say that they like the product. I am glad that I purchased this moisturizer because over the moon for it. The texture is lovely plus it absorbs into my skin so well even after I’ve layered my serums and tretinoin cream before it. It applies beautifully and thankfully has no fragrance. It has a wonderful plumping affect and it makes my skin incredibly soft the next day. The omegas certainly do what they’re supposed to. I will definitely buy this in the full size once my mini size runs out. Whoever gave this a two star rating just because they didn’t like the trial size they received is ridiculous the reviews are supposed to be about testing the actual product. To bring down the rating on a wonderful product just because you didn’t like the size is absurd.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: About an hour ago this showed up on my doorstep, and I decided I should try it immediately to give my face a chance to calm down before an event tonight since peels tend to leave me red right after. BUT NOT THIS. I am blown away by this product! The GLOW UP! I washed my face, let it dry for a few minutes until my skin felt tight, and then spread this on with my fingers and set my first timer for 5 minutes in case the stinging was bad. Once the 5 minutes were up I repeated it for another 5 because it wasn’t bothering me, and then after 10 minutes total I washed it off. This is the EASIEST mask to use, because it really does wash off easily. My skin just looked bright and happy in the mirror, and then once I added my normal serum and moisturizer my skin was glowing. I really hope using this on a weekly basis will help keep up with the constant exfoliation I need from using retinoid at night. I am sold and I will be adding an extra bottle to my next Sephora cart to keep on hand. Also, this is better than Sukari Babyfacial... that’s saying something.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: A great product totally ruined by liquid plastic
reviews.review_text: I don’t understand why the polyethylene not being in microbead form makes it any less harmful, and I don’t understand why a product labels itself ’green’ when it literally has liquid plastic in it. I got a small jar of this as a sample and I was loving it... I usually use DHC cleansing oil at home, but I travel all the time and the oil is a pain to travel with because the mini bottle leaks. I took this on a trip with me instead and was so happy to have something that wouldn’t leak, AND THEN I LEARNED ABOUT THE PLASTIC. WHY. The Drunk Elephant Slaai balm is a much cleaner choice, and that will be the one I repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Wow, what an eye cream. I’ve been using this for about a week and it is excellent. I have sensitive skin and this hasn’t bothered my eye area at all. It’s extremely emollient and the perfect thing to use before bed! I like to swipe the extra on my lips and it feels great there too. My fine lines are definitely diminished while using this product.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I am seriously blown away by this sunscreen. It smells amazing, it absorbs quickly, and goes on clear. When I forgot to reapply after playing pickleball for 2 hours I still didn’t get any sunburn at all! I will definitely be repurchasing this sunscreen in the future, Shiseido knocked it out of the park with this one.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_title: Not a replacement for invigorating gel but not bad
reviews.review_text: I wish I could give this 3.5 stars. Prefacing by saying I loved the night Invigorating Gel that this seems to be replacing in Ole’s lineup, and I used it from age 19 to 28. Past 2 years I felt like I needed a more aggressive acid, and so I’ve been experimenting elsewhere but usually coming back to Ole’s products. In an ideal world, they could’ve kept the old formula but increased the acid content. Will I buy it again? Probably.Pros: This product definitely has a higher acid concentration, which I’m happy about. My skin likes it, and it definitely helps keep my skin clear and even and tightens my pores.Cons: Texture... It’s sticky. When I lay down at night my face definitely sticks to my pillow, which makes me concerned that it doesn’t sink in as well as the old gel did. It’s thick and seems to take a full pump to coat my face, and I’m going through this tiny bottle quickly. It’s like spreading lemon curd on my face at night, which could be pleasant if it would just sink in and not stick my face to my pillow.

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: Love this product!  So silky and light when you put it on and doesn’t leave my skin feeling oily and doesn’t cause me to break out. I was concerned about using it because a lot of night time products make me break out and his product did not.  I wake up with skin feeling supple and hydrated and a nice glow.  Even though it’s not really a mask in the way you might expect, basically just a nighttime moisturizer.  You don’t even need to use a ton either, a little goes a long way.  I Would recommend this product for sure. So great and worth the price.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have oily sensitive skin and this cleanser is super gentle and works great.  I’ve been using for several days and don’t feel like it’s made my face dry and doesn’t leave a residue, just very clean and refreshed. The scent is so subtle nearly nonexistent which I really like.  For the price however there are other similar products I’ve found so luckily I don’t have to use more than a small amount to get a good clean which makes it last for a while but still pricey so probably not worth it for some when other similar products are cheaper. I received this cleansing wash complimentary to test.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: The sugar literally melts as you scrub your face, if you have super sensitive skin I wouldn’t scrub too hard, you also really don’t need too. It left myFace feeling fresh and cleansed. The scent of strawberry is very clear so you may love it you may think it’s too much- I personally really like the scent.  Overall such a great scrub that worked really well coupled with the soy cleanser to leave my face feeling really exfoliated and baby smooth. I plan to continue using about once a week.  I received this exfoliating wash complimentary to test.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Really liked the gel turns watery texture of this product. Smells awesome, but couldn’t really see a difference in my skin. I’ve been very dry lately for some reason so I just felt like my skin absorbed this like a thirsty cactus. If you have normal skin this will probably work well for you. For the price I wouldn’t say it’s worth it, but might be someone else’s holy grail.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a few weeks now and I’m a fan! Such a great clean, lightweight formula. Works wonderfully for day and night, but I especially love it as it’s perfect skincare before my daily makeup. Goes in smooth and soaks nicely into your skin. Super hydrating, and leaves your skin really glowy! My texture and fine lines have improved greatly over the last could of weeks. Also smells amazing. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Gentle jelly-like cleanser that leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed, and not at all dry.  I love this with my clarisonic.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: My favorite night time moisturizer.  Wonderfully hydrating without feeling greasy!

reviews.review_text: I loved this as an overnight moisturizer. It went on light, and made me wake up with soft, fresh skin!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin is normally very dry, especially in the summer. This leaves my skin hydrated and glowing!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is my holy grail ride or die cleanser. I love it so much and always buy the largest bottle bc I use it all the time. What I like about it is that it’s simple and clean, feels soft and gentle, doesn’t irritate skin and removes makeup. Even my husband is obsessed with this bc it makes his skin feel really fresh and never irritates him. Seriously the perfect cleanser for every day. Always use it for my first cleanse at night and most mornings.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_title: Great product if you have extra $$$
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for a couple weeks now. I have to say that I really like it. I feel that it has made my skin tone more even and my skin is smoother overall.  I currently am not allowed to take my acne medication so I have breakouts on my chin - this product in no way helps my acne but I do think that once they go away it helps get rid of the red marks faster. Mine usually hang around for ages and I’ve noticed them going away much quicker. I love the way this product feels but it is definitely pricey which makes it hard to justify the splurge.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I got this eye cream to try courtesy of Influenster. I really like this eye cream and have actually used it in the past. I love the way it feels going on and it keeps me feeling moisturized all day. It sits well under makeup and I think it helps my eyes look younger and refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: An industry holy grail for a reason! A wonderfully cushy and creamy texture that is very nourishing. Thanks to built in primer it Leaves your skin very matte and d fresh. Can be worn without makeup over it honestly. So good! Smells like orange.  This jar will last a long time

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: A gorgeous sunscreen! It has a lightweight texture and it absorbs well leaving a healthy finish that’s not greasy or overly matte. Makeup goes well over this product. It has a light fruity scent that masks typical sunscreen smell. It does leave a little bit of whitish residue that might be problematic for darker complexions. All in all, a good product

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: What a lovely product! This fresh milky serum packs a punch. Skin becomes replenished, moisturized, calmed and looks and feels visibly tighter after use of this product. I love that it absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave a greasy residue. One potential drawback is a string tea scent. I personally find it revitalizing but I can se me how someone might be sensitized to it. It’s a great product for my skin, and it combines effects of multiple targeted products, which saves money.

reviews.review_text: I was super excited to try this product! I love all things bare minerals. The smell is light and refreshing. It doesn’t dry sticky and give the skin just a little sheen.  Overall, it was just ok. We will see what it does for my skin.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am absolutely in LOVE with this product. It took mh winter skin from dry and irritated to dewy and beautiful. The more I used it, the better my skin got. I was Sooo sad when it was gone! I haven’t purchased more just yet because of the price point, but it is definitely on mh splurge list!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: The serum was also super light and clean smelling! Again, a week wasn’t really enough time to evaluate its effectiveness. I liked the 2-phase formula - 2 products in one!The only downfall I found was that it’s very pricey! Definitely out of my normal price range and I didn’t get to used it long enough to decide if I loved it.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: The consistency is nice and it is moisturizing! I’ve tried several overnight masked and this one is pretty on par with the rest. After using it several nights in a row, I didn’t notice a huge difference in my lips over all.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_title: will buy this when i run out!
reviews.review_text: I wasnt sure when i first tried this if it was gonna work for me. it makes my skin a lil dry but so clear! I’ve started putting some aquaphor on top of it at night and i wake up with really glowy skin. works well but can be a bit drying. also may sting or burn the first couple times. i rode the discomfort out and now im in love. i think this might be a holy grail product for me. i never knew i needed this. but now i know.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff so much. My skin is dry and thirsty. But this makes it supple and glowy. It’s not oily, greasy or tacky. It has no scent. My skin looks so good.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: It smells really good. I can’t see any difference in my skin. I’ve used the regular aqua bomb before too. I may need more hydration for my skin than this provides. But the scent is delicious.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: I loved this serum! I have large pores some redness and dry skin. This product helped with all that as I put in on right before my foundation. It’s usually hard to find a product that actually helps my make up look fantastic. Has a slight fragrance to it but didn’t bother my sensitive skin at all.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is the first Tatcha product I’ve ever ever and I love it! Let me first say how hydrating it and how beautiful it looks on my skin. In the morning I’ll cleans then use his serum and moisturizer and it looks so glows. I also love the smell it smells clean and natural. I have combo skin more dry usually in the winter and sensitive skin this product works amazing for me.

reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin living in the desert. I am always looking for new products that will hydrate my skin. I thought this product was very good compared to other hydrating products I’ve tried. After cleaning in the morning I’d put this on and then my normal moisturizer. I felt like my make up sad very well on my skin through out the day.

reviews.review_text: I really love this I don’t have a lot of products that take off my eye makeup but this does. And I don’t feel oily after! I couldn’t really see after but i think that was a me thing! I love it

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: If I could give this product more then 5 stars I would. You use a SLIVER amount and it lasts 24 hours! I lick my lips and eat and drink all that fun stuff and my lips are still good to go and 100% kissable! 11000000000/10

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I am new to the giving-a-crap-what-my-skin-is-doing club, so I started with this to combat the flaky skin between my eyes and around my nose, especially as I experiment with a weekly retinol. I love that it has no odor whatsoever and I have a pleasant dewey sheen throughout the day. My only qualm is that using it twice daily as recommended, I seem to be blowing through it a little more quickly than I would like for the price point and bought the YTTP dream mask to slow my roll on it and have something else to try out at night. This is my go-to for mornings and after showers when my face feels super tight and uncomfortable. I have noticed no heaviness in this cream or greasiness as it is getting warmer out!

reviews.review_text: I am new to the giving-a-crap-what-my-skin-is-doing club, so I started with this to combat the flaky skin between my eyes and around my nose, especially as I experiment with a weekly retinol. reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: My only concern with this stuff is how quickly I am going to go through it with how much I enjoy using it. I’ve gone down the one pump per use, every 3-4 days to extend its life. I just started using this and already got a compliment on my skin through a video call, it was that obvious how much brighter and smoother my face was! I thought my face would be dry in the morning but it wasn’t. The slight burn on application isn’t like a refreshing minty burn but like a light chemical burn you would expect from an AHA that goes away before I fall asleep.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way in terms of moisture so I feel like the jar will last me a while. I use it on top of my retinol once a week and haven’t flaked out like I used to. The smell is nice and doesn’t linger. The texture compared to the adaptogen cream from YTTP is almost whipped. Didn’t notice particular glowiness but stayed hydrated for sure.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way in terms of moisture so I feel like the jar will last me a while. I use it on top of my retinol once a week and haven’t flaked out like I used to. The smell is nice and doesn’t linger. The texture compared to the adaptogen cream from YTTP is almost whipped. Didn’t notice particular glowiness but stayed hydrated for sure.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Locks in the moisture, lips feel nice and soft. I am not as good at applying it on consistent basis so the lasting of soft lips does not last during winter. Will def try other flavors once I get into a swing of using this one!

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: Not a fan of the smell but i definitely can tell the difference the next morning. My skin breaks out easily but it has not caused any issues. Will def order again!

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I use it to help with break outs and also used it on my nose piercing (not intentionally). I haven’t noticed a lot of changes to skin but my piercing def healed faster. I like how it feels after I clean my face and apply moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I really love this.  I mean REALLY love this.  I’ve been eyeing it from the moment it came out but was reluctant to get it bc of the mixed reviews (mostly good reviews but still a lot of bad ones saying it’s sticky etc) Anyhow, I ended up grabbing this about a month ago and honestly did not expect it to be so good. It’s so perfect for oily/combination skin.... just don’t use a lot bc you don’t need it.  Legit just a touch will spread fast and everywhere so very very little is needed for the full face.  Makeup sits on top of this perfectly as it acts like a primer as well.  Also, it feels like it has silicones but it doesn’t (it goes on like a dream) I’ve been spending so much money lately on skincare and was trying to ration out what I need and if I need to return something I don’t quite love and didn’t even think twice with this product. I absolutely love it and didn’t think I would.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m very blown away by this moisturizer especially since I never thought my skin would agree with it.  I don’t have dry skin but rather oily/combination to a degree (not an oil slick but more on the oilier side) which is why I’m surprised my skin responds the way it does with this cream. It’s gorgeous! So so gorgeous!  It truly lives up to its name “the dewy” skin cream as it definitely makes your skin dewy. It’s one of those creams you have to try for yourself as everyone responds differently but if this does suit you, you will LOVE it, I promise :)

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Love this product. Makes my skin look so smooth, plump and glowing. I am quite surprised how this turns orange on some people - I don’t get it because it’s a cream that blends right into the skin and adjusts to your skin tone - it doesn’t add colour.  Are you using the same product or is this something you purchased off amazon? It baffles me because it’s not supposed to pull orange. I recommend this. I got a sample and purchased the full size right away - it’s gorgeous!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff! I combine it with two of my other moisturizers but this stuff helps take away the redness and discoloration I normally have, which is amazing because I don’t like to wear concealer. I also have sensitive skin but find this is extremely gentle on it. I’m in love. I want more of this line.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff! I combine it with two of my other moisturizers but this stuff helps take away the redness and discoloration I normally have, which is amazing because I don’t like to wear concealer. I also have sensitive skin but find this is extremely gentle on it. I’m in love. I want more of this line.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I haven’t been using this stuff but a week now but I’ve already noticed it helps immensely with the puffiness in my eyes. I realize it won’t get rid of my hereditary dark circles, but I feel like it does help them look less sickly. This is a win for me, especially for the price. I’m so excited about this product.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has been just what I’ve needed. It has a great texture and doesn’t make me break out. I use it in combination with another moisturizer and it keeps me feeling soft and hydrated all day.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: AMAZING!!!! James Welsh recommended this on his channel and he was right. My skin glows up. I’ve received compliments from friends and family that I look more refreshed and of course glowing. I will 100% recommend.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve put this in literally every review so far. James Welsh recommended this product and it worked wonders in my skin. It’s now smooth and even in color texture.

reviews.product_name: Mini Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: Another amazing recommendation from James Welsh’s channel! This partnered with the niacinamide and hydronic acid from inky list really brought out the best in my skin. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Really nice. It’s light and liquidy but leaves my skin soft for hours after application. It also is a good base for makeup with is important because some moisturizers will separate foundation and concealer. You get a decent amount in the bottle and a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Really enjoy this product! It’s really refreshing feeling on the face. A little thick, but it smells lovely and melts into your face nicely.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Really enjoy this product! It’s really refreshing feeling on the face. A little thick, but it smells lovely and melts into your face nicely.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: Really like this product! I’ve been using It now a few times a week for the last few weeks. It has a faint citrusy smell that’s nice. It’s gentle on my skin ans i haven’t reacted To It at all. I would recomend!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love eye creams! I have a bad sleeping patterns and constantly have dark eyes and it bothers me so much! I’ve used so many diff eye creams but this one has to be my fav so far, I love how it is so gentle around my eyes and how it makes them feel the day of and the next day! I will forever recommend this product

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this product, I was so excited to review this as part of the topbox circle mission and wow, I am more then pleased! This cream is so smooth on my face, I am turning 30 and I have a young face but it won’t last forever, I amGetting started on taking care of my face for the future me and this cream has become a staple in my routine!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: If you love a good serum and able to splurge I recommend this entirely! It’s so soft and not drying at all, it makes the skin so smooth while it does it’s magic it’s definitely worth the price and such a lovely product

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: This eye mask was gifted by glow recipe and I’ve been using this every night since I received it. Its so good. Melts in my skin like butter. I’ve reached 30 and my eyes need some assistance. And this is really doing the trick. My eye area is so hydrated that you can barely see any fine lines. I love it.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is some magic in a bottle. My skin looks plump and dewy after using it just one time.  My fine lines and wrinkles definitely look softer and less noticeable. I’m excited to see if there is a bigger difference after multiple uses. This was gifted to me and I’m so grateful.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Living this product. It goes on soft and smooth. The applicator is nice and cool to the skin. It’s also a very creamy nice formula. I’ve been using this serum every night and I wake up with the skin around my eyes looking smooth and plump, in a good healthy way.  I love Sunday Riley and this eye serum is just as amazing as I thought it would be.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Love this!! This product is my first experience with Supergoop, and I couldn’t be more obsessed. It spreads and sinks into the skin so nicely, leaving a great glowy look. This is the perfect summer product for me, as I tend to stray away from makeup in the heat. The slight color makes me look so glowy!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product! I have been using it once a day for about a week now and have already noticed a difference in appearance. I use it in the morning to help reduce puffiness and help wake my skin up. My face feels firm and moisturized immediately after use, and it pairs nicely with the rest of my skincare. It is very easy to apply and feels great on the skin.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: Great product! I love the packaging and found it made the product very easy to use. I have noticed a significant increase in overall brightness and my skin looks so glowy and even. The product feels light and luxurious on my skin. *Gifted by Drunk Elephant*

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: Good but not great. While this product feels nice/luxurious on the skin, I did not notice much of a difference in brightness or improvement in dullness. The product is easy to spread and feels fantastic as a part of my morning routine, but at this price point, I would expect more drastic results. *gifted by Sunday Riley*

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Cleanses without being too harsh on skin! I will be buying again!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Loveeee! This is the best lip mask ever! Smells really yummy as well! This last a long time and has a really nice tint to this colour!

reviews.product_name: Mini Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: I really like this mask but didn’t realize how small the product is…

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: In my 70’s and using 3 little wonders for over a year, so I was skeptical to try anything new, but love this brand as it finally stopped my sensitive skin from breaking out.  Being a product junkie I gave it a whirl along with the cream.  It feels amazing when you apply it, using sparingly.  I follow with the companion cream.  Since my skin is sensitive, I use it every other day. Bnot reaction and my skin feels so smoothe.  Will order again and continue to use every other day.  OleHenriksen is an amazing brand.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: Only been using for a week.  Very nice consistency.  Been using Perricone pore minimized for years, but because Ole Henriksen three little wonders were such a game changer, I thought I would try this.  Seems to minimize pores and is refreshing.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Got a sample, and tried it.  I couldn’t believe how soft it made my skin feel, it’s amazing.  I immediately ordered the full size which just came today.  It feels so good on your skin.  It’s pricey, but the jar is big and you only use a little do it will last a long time.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: i love this cleanser, it is simple, non irritating and has really helped balance my skin. i enjoy that it doesn’t have an overwhelming scent and doesn’t dry out my face after washing as well.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is the one! It’s non abrasive and is really gentle on the skin and doesn’t dry out your face or make your skin feel stripped. I have repurchased this item multiple times I have gone through At least 4 of the 2 oz travel bottles and I love the formula, smell and the sustainable packaging. I have had way less break outs. I double cleanse so I use jojoba cream to remove my make up and follow up with this cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is the one! It’s non abrasive and is really gentle on the skin and doesn’t dry out your face or make your skin feel stripped.
