reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: My favorite night cream. This moisturizer is so nourishing and  comfortable to wear while sleeping. Does not have any oily residue and really keeps my skin plump and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: My favorite night cream. This moisturizer is so nourishing and  comfortable to wear while sleeping. Does not have any oily residue and really keeps my skin plump and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: Welll it’s a beautiful colour and smells deliciously like orange juice, the formula seems to just sit on my skin and not fully absorb, causing my skin to become increasingly oilier throughout the day. It too bad because I really wanted to love this serum and for the price, it just wasn’t it :(

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: My new favourite serum!! My skin is significantly less oily and has no congestion! At first I was using too much product and it would cause some peeling around my nose and chin. A little goes a long way, can’t get enough of this!!

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: SO GOOD! Does not streak or give you that yucky orange fake tan look! I use one to two drops and build over a couple days. Resulting in a beautiful glow!!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is the perfect cleanser. I don’t even feel like I have to try new ones. Refreshing and replenishing. My skin has never been healthier or more clear! I recommend x 100

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is the perfect cleanser. I don’t even feel like I have to try new ones. Refreshing and replenishing. My skin has never been healthier or more clear! I recommend x 100

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I bought these today, my 6 hours aren’t up yet, and I’m already writing a review. I bought these as a “just in case” for an upcoming vacation, but pulled some of the Dots out when my cystic acne came to a head. I’ve had my first thee patches on for about three hours and have already peeled them off because they were almost “full.” I’m already amazed at how much the blemishes have shrunk and at how much the Dots have pulled out of surrounding pores (the main reason my Dots filled up so soon). I’m planning to to go back to Sephora tomorrow morning to purchase more Dots and the pore strips!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I almost fainted when I saw the price tag; this is the first “expensive” over the counter product I purchased to help deal with adult acne and enlarged pores. It is absolutely worth the price.This product not only reduced the size of my pores, but it has helped tremendously with my acne.(It did burn my 3rd time using the product, but not for very long and only sporadically since.)

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best non-prescription products I’ve ever tried. I have terrible adult acne, including cystic acne. I’ve never been able to find something I can use on my skin when it’s breaking out AND when it’s dry from too many harsh chemicals. Until this.  I cannot recommenced this product enough.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: I received this own free from Influenster. I don’t see myself ever purchasing this on my own.  The stick glides easily,  but feels greasy.  I haven’t noticed any difference in my skin in the areas I applied it.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I just started using this product,  but I like it already.  Minty with a slight tingle.  Feels very moisturizing without being greasy. Didn’t feel sticky.  I’m excited to see how my skin looks in a few weeks.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This product is really neat.  I love the low mess aspect.  I also like how is easier to control how much I use. This worked great to remove a full face of heavy liquid foundation.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This stuff is heavenly.  Super light and silky.  Feels like water at first,  absorbs super fast.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This stuff is heavenly.  Super light and silky.  Feels like water at first,  absorbs super fast.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for about a week now, every morning along with the C-firma, umbra sheer and shada serum. The packaging is really cute and fun to use. My skin feels really soft, moisturized and looks plump and bright. The only reason I haven’t given it 5 stars is because of the scent-I don’t like it while applying but once it is on it doesn’t bother me. Still recommend! For reference, my skin is dry now in the winter when I am trying it (and oily in summertime)

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: So my biggest concern is using SPF is that it would clog my pores. I have been using this every morning for about a week now and so far I haven’t had an issue! Definitely going to continue using this. Until now, I used a moisturizer with SPF in it. I’ve been using this in combination with B-hydra, C-firma and the Shada serum. The combination of these 4 has left my skin feeling soft plump and bright and is keeping the winter dryness at bay. The only reason I haven’t given it 5 stars is the scent-I really don’t like it as I am applying the products but once it’s on my face I am fine for the rest of the day, it doesn’t continue to bother me.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using a retinol for a while already so I can’t say I’ve seen massive changes to my skin, a lot of my problem areas were being tended to for a while already. For this particular product, the texture is nice and feels good on the face. Doesn’t smell great though and I’m sensitive to that so took off one star. Using retinol in general my skin is much smoother, the coloring is more even and I’m really in it for the long term anti aging effects

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: I have been using a retinol for a while already so I can’t say I’ve seen massive changes to my skin, a lot of my problem areas were being tended to for a while already. reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_title: Under eye hydration like no other!
reviews.review_text: So I got this item complimentary from Influenster about a week ago for reviewing purposes and wanted to give it a good amount of usage so I could properly review it. I actually love this eye cream. If you’re looking for great hydration that lasts this is it. It does exactly what it states. I was mostly surprised by the fact that it really does prime your under eyes nicely before applying makeup! My only wish is that it helped with dark circles, but I can’t dock the product because it doesn’t claim to help with that, just a hope for the future then! This is actually the third product from Belif that I have tried (the other two came in sample boxes) and I have been impressed with all of it. I look forward to trying out more from them!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I got this complimentary from Influenster for review purposes and this is probably one of my favorite products I’ve gotten. I love the smell (rose has always been my favorite). It soaks in to the skin easily and quickly without leaving behind a greasy/oily film. Your skin just feels plump and soft!!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a while now so that I could get a proper opinion on it before I reviewed it. Firstly it smells delicious, which I like. I also like that it dries to a soft smooth matte finish. I’m not sure I’ve used it long enough or frequently enough to notice changes in the amount of blemishes but the ingredients are consistent with acne treatments so I’m sure it will. Only downside is that it isn’t the most dry skin friendly. I did notice some dry patches even after applying this. Otherwise great moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I liked this product because you can use it as a moisturizer and primer instead of using 2 separate products. On days when i didn’t have break outs i just wore this and my skin looked radiant and fresh. However, in the winter I found that it wasn’t thick enough for the dry parts of my face.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: This product was not hydrating at all. I have combination skin, but it’s more on the dry side and this moisturizer did nothing for me. Thank god I received a sample before purchasing.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I received this cleanser and the polypeptide cream as part of the Sephora birthday gift. I’ve been using it for over 2 months and have noticed considerable improvements in my skin. Now, my skin is more eventoned, less breakouts are happening, and it’s softer and brighter. Wish they had these in minisize!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this cream. Not greasy and makes my skin look and feel great.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Okay I loved this product! It was super lightweight and didn’t leave an awful white cast! My skin was glowing and I didn’t have any burns from my big day at the beach! I really appreciate the clean formula, that it is reef friendly and vegan!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This was amazing to try as complimentary from Fresh! It was super hydrating but also gave me some great colour pay off! I definitely want to try the other colours available. This is perfect for all year round, winter for the hydration and summer against the humidity.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: The Fresh Tea Elixir Serum was a breath of fresh air! I didn’t have huge expectations, just another serum BUT it’s not! This left my face feeling and looking fresh! The scent was clean and subtle! Definitely a must try!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: you get so much in here and you need so little for your lips to feel incredible. smells great and leaves a beautiful glossy shine.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: got this on a whim while needing a new moisturizer. at first didn’t think much of it, considered it to be just as good as the rest of my moisturizers and creams, but after using it up i really find myself missing it. i’ve definitely noticed a difference in the radiance and plumpness in my skin since i’ve not had it. will be picking up another one soon!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: this is my new favourite skincare product. it’s incredibly hydrating without feeling greasy and a little goes a long way. i used it as a primer today and my makeup lasted all day and looked amazing. will be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: this is my new favourite skincare product. it’s incredibly hydrating without feeling greasy and a little goes a long way. i used it as a primer today and my makeup lasted all day and looked amazing. will be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Haven’t got to use it much yet, but is a very nice sunscreen & seems to work well! I have pretty fair skin & am usually picky with products like this - however the scent is nice, it’s not tacky, or thick like other sunscreens - would def recommend!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Smells decent - most sunscreen has a very strong scent & I would say this one is very mild, and more fresh! Not thick, oily, or tacky - glides on nice & works!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This product has helped me control my breakouts! I have normal/dehydrated skin, but have always suffered from hormonal breakouts around my chin/mouth at least once a week! I am so happy to say that I am about a month free from any major blemish! The exfoliating ingredients in this serum have helped control and also repair my skin from unwanted breakouts! Definitely recommend trying!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Not the best, but not the worst! A little goes a long way! My main concern with this product is that it’s advertised/recommended for all skin types. I usually have a normal/dehydrated complexion! When first applying it feels great and replenishing - however after about an hour it feels like it just sits on my skin rather than absorbs, and leaves me feeling & looking greasy! Would only recommend for someone with a more dry complexion - and otherwise would only recommend tying a sample before purchasing!!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received a free product from Goop for testing and review purposes in a way that’s clear and conspicuous, that being said wow! This face exfoliator is wonderful, it isn’t harsh on my face and doesn’t feel like I’m rubbing salt or sand all over it, it is very gentle. My face feels super soft and clean after use and even a day later.  My only complaint would have to be is it doesn’t tell you how much to use, like a quarter size amount or anything.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by  Sunday Riley the Good Genes for in return for my honest option, with that being said I have say this stuff is pretty amazing. Within minutes I noticed my skin looked brighter and healthier. It does have a scent that I couldn’t quite put my finger on but it does go away quickly after drying.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received the Avocado Ceramide recovery serum complimentary from Glow Recipe for my honest review. It really makes my skin smoother and it absorbs really quickly. It smells amazing and reduced skin redness almost immediately after applying.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is one of the most divine, luxurious eye cream I have ever used! The texture is to die for (soft, buttery, rich- but somehow goes on silky smooth with no sticky/heavy residue!). I’ve been using it both day and night. I’m always hesitant on applying eye creams in the morning as I found my concealer around the eyes cake up if I do. With this eye cream I felt the exact opposite- my makeup looks even, smooth and completely flawless! Perfect eye cream for both day and night. I received the eye cream complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This is one heavy duty exfoliator! It’s definitely not for sensitive skin. It made my skin smooth, but a little red and irritated even after letting it rest/skipping all my regular daily exfoliants for a few days. If you have thick skin (literally), and also do well with harsher exfoliators, this may work better for you. I also only received 1 pad complimentary for testing purposes, so chances are your skin might get used to it after several uses.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This is one heavy duty exfoliator! It’s definitely not for sensitive skin. It made my skin smooth, but a little red and irritated even after letting it rest/skipping all my regular daily exfoliants for a few days. If you have thick skin (literally), and also do well with harsher exfoliators, this may work better for you. I also only received 1 pad complimentary for testing purposes, so chances are your skin might get used to it after several uses.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I love this scrub! I’m usually not a fan of physical exfoliants because beads can damage the skin by making small cuts here and there. This one is an exception! The beads are small and almost “soft” feeling, rinses off super well and my face doesn’t sting when I apply skincare afterwards. I love the refreshing lemon-y smell and my skin is silky smooth afterwards! I use this the night before a big day or when I know I’m going to be putting on makeup. Highly recommend! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing! The consistency is slightly thick but sinks in well and has a lovely lemon-y scent. It does give me a sligntly tingly sensation right after application, but it’s not severe and goes away fairly quickly. I wake up with baby smooth skin in the morning! I’ve been using it for a couple weeks and it’s helped with my overall texture as well. Highly recommend!! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Have been using this for years. Good hydration at a great price. Taking one star off for the consistency, which is a bit sticky. Otherwise, I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I have used this product prior to it launching at Sephora and its a staple in my skincare routine. I do put a hydrating eye moisturizer underneath and pay a few drops of this on top. It works great. Firms up my eyes without making them look creepy. Does what I need it to do at a cost that can’t be beat!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I originally received a trial size of this using rewards points and it lasted me through the summer. Honestly, I was doubtful I would like this as most  bronzing products make my fair skin look orange so I was pleasantly surprised how nice it looked mixed with my sunscreen. The key is to use this VERY sparingly. I have tried mixing this with gel moisturizer, serum, facial oil, foundation, and sunscreen. Personally, I prefer mixing it with my sunscreen. It allows me to skip foundation most days. However, it really looked nice with every product I mixed it with. And I love that it does double duty as additional skincare. I like it so much I just purchased the full size!

reviews.review_text: I have really come to like The Inkey List products, and Caffeine Eye Cream is certainly no different! It didn’t irritate my eyes at all, and it worked equally as well as a moisturizer at night as it did a de-puffing moisturizer under my makeup during the day. reviews.review_text: I’m really impressed with this facial moisturizer. However, if you do allow for it to sit on your face for a few minutes after you worked it into your skin, the moisturizer and skin then dry and it no longer feels greasy but it does then still continue to feel moisturizing, and soft. This cream does make my skin very soft and not dry. Over all the greasy until dry feeling is something I could get use to and other than that I really do enjoy this product.

reviews.review_text: I’m so happy I got gifted by Sunday Riley this bottle in exchange of my honest review. Normally my skin is very dry and I have a few rougher spots on my face. However, since I’ve started using Sunday Riley Good Genes my skin is much softer and the rough patches are gone. The scent is so nice and light. It reminds me of something but for the life of me I cannot figure out what it is. It’s such a nice scent though not overpowering or too faint either. Once applied you can’t smell it at all. I will say the first time I put it on my face didn’t react as  I would have hoped however by the second time I applied it my face was just fine. I like to use it both ways as a mask as well as to rub into my skin and leave it on. Once on it’s not greasy or oily which I love because I’m very sensitive to products that leave behind a greasy film.

My only complaint is that it does not have an SPF, which I really look for in any product for daytime. Overall, this is a great product. Received free for testing but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a #freeproduct sample of this Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum from TopBox Circle in exchange for my honest review. The sample size provided was enough to give me three morning applications after my regular cleansing and toning routine. I only needed a small amount of the serum to cover my entire face and neck. It went on seamlessly and absorbed very well. There was no leftover stickiness which I despise in some other branded serums I have tried. My skin was smooth to the touch and appeared well hydrated before applying any cream. I didn’t notice any scent with the serum which I really liked- I do not like anything I put on my face to have a strong scent or chemical smell. I followed the serum with Clinque’s wrinkle correcting cream (both eye and face) which I was also provided #freeproduct samples of. Even with three applications, I can tell this is a good serum! I can’t say it will erase lines or wrinkles, I did find that it helped my face appear more smooth and hydrated, which is my main goal when using serum. I’m impressed with this product!#topboxcircle #clinique #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a #freeproduct sample of this Clinique Smart Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream from TopBox Circle in exchange for my honest review. The sample was enough for me to apply for three mornings and although I can’t say that it erased my undereye fine lines after only three applications, I can say I wished I had more to see what the long-term results would be like. I love that the eye cream goes on smoothly and feels very hydrating, indicating that it absorbs very well. Applying undereye concealer was a breeze following using this which is a must for any eye cream I use! I used this eye cream in combination with the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum and Cream for the rest of my face which I was also provided a #freeproduct sample of. The product is fragrance-free which I absolutely love. #freeproduct #topboxcircle #clinique

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a #freeproduct sample of this Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream from TopBox Circle in exchange for my honest review. The sample lasted me about a week with application on my face and neck twice daily; once in the morning and once in the evening. For the first few days, I used it in combination with the Clinique Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting eye cream and serum, which I applied prior to this cream. I used this cream solely for the remaining few days in the week. This cream absorbed seamlessly into my skin and did not leave any stickiness behind. Very little of this cream is needed to cover your whole face and neck. I like that the cream is fairly light because I do find when creams are too heavy, I tend to break out or my makeup doesn’t stay put throughout the day. Having said that, I do prefer to use a bit more hydrating cream in the evening as my face can get quite dry, especially as the days get colder. This cream really works for me for day use though! I do feel like the daily use made my face begin to look and feel more youthful. I could see how this cream could benefit my face and fine lines over a month or so of continuous use. I did prefer to use it during the day in combination with the Clinique eye cream and serum. The combination of them all just seemed to work best. There was really only one con I found in this cream- it absolutely has a scent and although it was very light, it smelled a little like a chemical. Perhaps my sense of smell is too keen but it definitely is there. #freeproduct #topboxcircle #clinique

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I love the way this feels. It has a thick texture but it starts to melt into a lightweight, silky, cream as you massage it into your skin. It’s very hydrating but not oily. I have combination skin and have to be careful about heavy creams but this didn’t make me shiny and greasy at all. It has a light floral scent and lasts all day!

reviews.review_text: I wanted to like this but it just didn’t work for my skin. It feels tingly and cooling as it goes on, I think it could be wonderful in the summer! It was a little heavy for my skin and it didn’t seem to soak in as fast as other moisturizers I have.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I am a 34 year old female, and I’ve been ignorant of eye creams. However, my age is no longer letting me ignore the issue. Within a week, my eyes were a lot less puffy, more clear and less tired looking.  It’s an easy product to use, feels good on the skin, and doesn’t leave a heavy residue. I would recommend for anyone not wanting something heavy and burdensome. Really makes my eyes look more youthful!

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for about a month now. My skin is very dry, and especially right now during winter. I am a 34 year old too, so I’m really trying to keep my skin looking youthful and fresh. This product has been great! It smells super nice, and it feels great. Not oily or gloopy. Goes on nicely and I can sleep easily without worrying about it rubbing off everywhere. I usually try to put it on before my makeup in the mornings as well. It has made my skin look so much fresher and supple. My makeup no longer becomes flaky! I’m really impressed with this moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Helps eyes look fresh and bright
reviews.review_text: I’m in my mid thirties, so I’m starting to get more wrinkles and dark circles that coffee just can’t help. I used this product day and night for over two months and noticed my under eyes looking less dark and more firm. I noticed results within two weeks! My eyes didn’t mind the cream, whereas some other creams I’ve tried made them sting. When I used concealer, I noticed my under eye wrinkles less and I just looked fresher. I liked the feel of the cream. I recommend!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum

reviews.review_text: I got this directly from their site a couple months ago and I am happy to say it really works. I have had acne since I was 10 (I am now 21) and although this hasn’t cleared it up (as really nothing ever has), it has made a huge difference. This helps control sebum production, which is one of the main causes of acne/blackheads. It reduces current blemishes and prevents new ones from popping up. When my acne is particularly bad, a thin layer of this product applied at night has me waking up with my acne under control. I have tried a lot of different products and despite the low price tag I think this has been the best for my acne out of everything. There is really nothing to lose!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I am constantly on the look out for eye products that help with dark circles, and am very often disappointed. There are very few that make a visible difference, and few that deal with the root of the problem rather than cover it up. Finally found one that works! I originally got this as a free sample and them bought the full size.I’ve always had to use concealer or something along those lines, but dark circles seem to be more of a problem for me as I age and if I have any other contributing factors (less sleep, less hydration, feeling under the weather, etc.). My only complaint (and its a tiny one) is that the improvements eventually plateaued. It was super exciting in the beginning when I could see visible differences on the regular. Can’t expect miracles and I will take the win. I still need to wear under-eye concealer, but make-up free looks a lot better than it used to.:)

I have been getting hormonal acne every month since grade five, even proactive did nothing to help it. it would appear that after a decade this has stopped my hormonal acne, which is really awesome. reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: Disclaimer: I got this as a sample three times  and I liked it so much, I bought the full size. I have acne prone skin and my work life does really take a toll on my skin when working under adverse conditions or strict deadlines. So this serum is a true blessing and my holy grail!  I use a salicylic acid based cleanser by first aid beauty, tone my skin with oil control toner by ole henriksen n then this serum from caudalie. Finally I top with my favorite moisturizer. Using this skincare regiment, I have noticed my face feels tighter, pores closed and instantly hydrated. When I feel my skin is behaving (no more acne break outs) I switch to a more vitamin c regiment. So I don’t really stick to a salicylic acid regiment all the time. I give my skin opportunity to feel supple n nourished more on my non-acne days

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: For me, this is probably the best sunscreen for face I have ever come across. I have an oily skin and I hated the feeling of thick white sunscreen either mineral or not cover my face. The formula for this is lighter compared to most sunscreens I have seen in Sephora  but grainy too. So blending it with your other skincare I.e serum and moisturizer is a must. I generally use it with my vitamin c serum from Drunk elephant or passioni retinol moisturizer or the protini moisturizer. It depends on seasons. I just have to be careful about how much I apply to not grease up my skin and it really works! So not only does the umbra sheer sunscreen protect my face against sun damage but it also hydrates my skin all day. I love it so much I bought the littles package because that’s the only kit that has a travel size of this so I can keep topping it from time to time when I am at work or driving. I live in LA and it’s bright and sunny so this sunscreen is a must have for me. I highly recommend this if you are looking for a good sunscreen. If you are new to drunk elephant, try the littles kit - you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This is a great sunscreen. I like the quality and how smooth it is when you apply it, but I feel like it’s a bit too oily.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I love the packaging and ease of using this. It goes on smooth and doesn’t feel gross like others I’ve tried. I plan to always have this in my bag as we get out more this spring!

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I’m so glad I got to try this product! I love how it was lightweight and hydrating. I personally liked the smell as well. The only downside is the price, but you get what you pay for. I would recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I’m so glad I got to try this product! I love how it was lightweight and hydrating. I personally liked the smell as well. The only downside is the price, but you get what you pay for. I would recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: If you love Glow Recipe’s Watermelon Glow Sleeping mask you’ll love their new moisturizer. I love its light texture that just soaks right into my skin. It keeps my skin soft throughout the day and goes on great under make up. Even my hubby loves it!

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I don’t usually use overnight creams or masks beacause they are so heavy and leave me feeling greasy in the morning. But this mask changed my mind! I love how light it is and how my skin just drinks it up. It has a cooling feeling when applied and I love the way it makes my skin glow when I wake up. I told my husband I’m in trouble.... I think I am in love with this mask!I recieved this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer for the dry winter season! I was really worried this cream would make me break out as most heavy moisturizers tend to do eventually. But I was pleasantly surprised when I felt how soft my skin felt

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Skin appears firmer and less swollen
reviews.review_text: I enjoy the inkey list line of products because they work well together as well as with other brands. However, I was initially skeptical of the caffeine product. In general caffeine doesn’t work well on me. Since I’ve been using this product, I’ve noticed the skin around my eyes is firmer and appears less swollen from allergies and lack of sleep. I also look more alert. People have remarked I look well rested or cheerful and awake. It’s a bold statement to make since I’m usually not what one would consider well rested. It’s interesting to me because I noticed my skin appeared firmer. However, I didn’t notice anything drastic like looking well rested and awake until other people mentioned it to me.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: What I love about Dr Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel is it’s simple to use. It’s effective. I see results immediately. I have combination skin. I have uneven skin tone with rough patches here and there. Not dry skin, rough textured skin - particularly high on my cheekbones. I also have scars and smile lines. Step 1 has a floral tea scent and breaks down all those rough patches and imperfections. Step 2 is practically scentless; but, if I had to describe a scent, it smells like purified water. It smoothes my skin and evens my skin tone. It’s a quick way to improve my appearance. It’s a nice product for people like me who’ve always liked to do things myself as opposed to making an appointment with an esthetician or dermatologist.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Charlotte’s Magic Serum Crystal Elixir has a bright, fresh fragrance that’s a cross between wild roses and wild apple blossoms. It has a rich, almost milky texture. It’s easily absorbed into my skin. After application, it feels very light. I can’t even feel it on my skin. It leaves my skin hydrated, smooth, with a luminous appearance. *Cruelty Free *Free of sulphates*Free of Parabens *Free of Phthalates *Gluten Free *Vegan

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for a good week and a half and I’m not super impressed. It does give my skin a beautiful glow but I haven’t seen any improvements in my fine lines and wrinkles or my pores. I did see a difference when I applied my makeup however. My skin is very textured and it really did helped me achieve a smooth look. I was very worried about the fragrance after reading reviews and researching the product but it really wasn’t as bad as everyone made it seem. Very light scent in my opinion! If you’re looking for instant gratification this won’t be the product for you. This is a product you will have to use daily for a good while before getting the results you’re looking for. I do think the packaging is cute! Do I think it’s worth $80? No. There are plenty of products out there that are just as good if not better that won’t break the bank. Thank you so much @influenster for sending me this complimentary product to review!!! Can’t wait for my next #Voxbox #charlottetilbury #MagicSerumCrystalElixir #complimentary @ctilburymakeup

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I am actually very pleased with this exfoliator! The scent is nice and not overpowering. It leaves my skin feeling really soft and gives me a beautiful glow. I could definitely tell a difference after only one use! I do like that they use clean ingredients. The only reason for 4 stars is because it is a little pricey. I do actually think I will purchase this product again. I really do like the way it made my skin look and feel!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I am actually very pleased with this exfoliator! The scent is nice and not overpowering. It leaves my skin feeling really soft and gives me a beautiful glow. reviews.review_text: Let me start out by saying thank you @influenster for sending me this #complimentary product to try out & review! This is the first time I have ever tried a Estée Lauder product and I am pleasantly surprised at how well the serum is working. A little goes a long way! It has helped reduce the appearance of my fine lines and wrinkles and helped smooth my textured skin. Most serums leave me looking oily but this one has not. My skin looks way more vibrant and less red. It’s a great product and definitely worth the money!! #GenerationANR #contest #esteelauder

reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this awhile ago and started using it recently. It does a good job moisturizing and firms the skin as well. I ordered a full size so I can keep using this cream. The smell is a bit strong, but not unpleasant.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: I’m think this is doing what it’s supposed to but I’m not 100% certain. I had a few small lines around my eyes but now they are smooth. I’ve been using it for about 2 months I think,it doesn’t dry my skin and seems to be doing the job. The application method is pretty cool too.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: These dots really work, I even got my husband wearing them. They reduce the redness and inflammation and sometimes the whole zit comes off overnight and when you remove the dot it takes it with it (without harming you skin). These are always stocked in my bathroom and I never travel without them.

reviews.review_text: This cream is perfect, so hydrating but it is very light and turns into “water“ somehow. It’s difficult to explain the consistency but it work so well. I wear it to sleep after using Tatcha’s The Deep Cleanse Exfoliating Cleanser and it’s a perfect duo. My skin feels amazing in the morning and looks fresh and bright. I’ve worn it under makeup and it also works great but my personal choice is at night. The light scent is kind of soothing.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product! Origins has always been a brand I thought highly of, and this product makes me want to try out other products from the brand. The moisturizer is light grey in color but does not stain or anything like some charcoal products. It is easy to apply an sinks into the skin leaving it feeling soft and moisturized. It has a light lavender scent which may be my favorite thing about this product, it is very relaxing to apply. I have noticed a decrease in acne since using this product. I hope they create body products in this line! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_title: A little goes a longgg way
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this eye cream. It is probably one of the best that I have ever tried! I got a small sample size complementary from Influenster however I am so impressed with how little product do you need for each application. You just need the tiniest amount on your finger and it covers your under eyes as well as extra to put on your eyelid. This is really nice because it is an expensive product however I do think if you were to buy it it would last you a really long time. I also really enjoy how this product makes my under eyes feel. It does have that water-based feel which is really nice and it has not clogged my pores which is very important to me however it’s also so incredibly hydrating. I would recommend putting on this product at night because it is so thick that I don’t know if it would play nicely under makeup. I really would consider buying this again when I run out.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been very impressed with this product. I’m 23 years old, however I do have some fine lines under and in the corner of my eyes due to squinting. I use the teeniest tiniest amount under my eyes each night and I really have seen a remarkable difference. I received a sample size complementary from Influenster and I do think it will last me a while.Because of the price point I don’t know if I would re-purchase it but I do think that it could be very useful for those who have fine lines and wrinkles.

reviews.review_text: I thoroughly enjoy this face wash. A little goes a long way and my face always feels very clean after use. My only complaints would be the smell and it makes my skin feel strange when washing off, but goes away quickly. I usually only use in the shower because it is a little challenging to wash off but overall I really enjoy it. I will continue using this product.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster and Estée Lauder in exchange for my honest review. I loved that this product doesn’t have a heavy fragrance and has a clean smell. I did notice minimal decrease in my under eye crease which I was happy about. My main reasoning for 4 stars opposed to 5 is that I’m not sure the product is worth the price for the minimal benefits.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is amazing! It is thick but doesn’t feel heavy on the face and doesn’t make my skin feel super oily. I’ve been using it for a few weeks and can tell that my skin loves it so far. I definitely would recommend this product to anyone!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: This micellar water is gentle yet effective! In the morning I put this product on a cotton pad and distribute it on my face and leave it as is and at night I double cleanse and use this as one of the cleansers!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini

reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is incredible! I’ve been trying to be more conscious of protecting my skin from the sun but so many sunscreens are thick, heavy and tacky on the skin. I’m so happy I found this product because it’s light, moisturizing and great under makeup! the smell is nice too and this bottle lasts a long time so it’s worth the money

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This is a great product! I received a small sample and was kind of disappointed but a little goes a long way - this is obviously great as an overnight lip mask but I’ve found myself using it during the day especially now that it’s the dead of winter. This worked within 2 uses and my lips were DRY!

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: This is a good product,  I’ve tried it before and it was good. However I’m not overly thrilled by it.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: As a rule I love Sunday Riley products in general. This one however I am really grateful came as sample size in the PLAY box. I don’t like feeling like the product is still wet on my skin half an hour after I put it on. I realize it probably wasn’t a long enough time period to see a significant change, but I did expect a slight change and there was no lightening of dark spots.  I do give it credit for fresher looking skin. After reading some comments I realized that maybe I could accuse this product of increase of pimples, or I could also look at the calendar and put the blame where it belongs,  on mother nature.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: WOW! I received this in my March Play Box,  just in time too, as I am almost out of sunscreen (where I live, it is a must year round) No breakouts, no greasy film, dried quickly. Directions state to reapply every 2 hours, I haven’t done so yet, as I really only need the sunscreen for protection while driving to school, but as summer gets closer I will probably be reapplying,  if I remember hopefully I will update on the results of if I had to reapply a lot of my makeup.

reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this!!! Thank you Sephora this is one of the best products ever in the Play Box.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_title: A drink of water for your face
reviews.review_text: I received this cream from Influencer to sample and let me just say I’m very impressed! When it says 26 hours of hydration it’s 100% accurate!! The cream itself feels like a very heavy nourishing cream when you dip your fingers into it, but then it glides on the skin and is absorbed and leaving your skin silky, hydrated, and refreshed! As someone with combo skin I’m always on the search for any hydration creams that hydrate without leaving a greasy film on my face. I’m honestly impressed by how lightweight this cream is on my skin and doesn’t leave any trace of oil residue like with other hydration creams I have tried in the past. With maskne being a thing now I have been using more ance based products on my face leading to areas being more dry than others, this cream balanced and fixed up my face in a matter of 2 days! and the price of the cream is also a plus because a little goes a longgggg way.  I would say if you’re looking for a good hydration cream/ winter cream look no futher, and if you are looking for more anti aging I would just recommend partnering this cream with a good anti aging serum. It honestly does wonders and I for sure am excited to check out more products from this brand!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_title: Take the plunge and buy this! You won't regret it!
reviews.review_text: This product was complimentary from Influencer for me to try. First off I love the bright packaging, minimal design with a classy aesthetic. The product itself at first glance looked quite thick, but upon application it applys like a sorbet gel type texture, that melts into the skin. I absolutely loved how light the moistureizer was and how it mattifed my face well keeping it hydrated at the same time. The cream has a lovely light peppermint scent to it and smells very fresh. When applying you also get this amazing cooling sensation which I believed really helped with imflamation. I’m personally a huge fan of the cooling effect and found it super relaxing and therapeutic. I didn’t notice a huge difference in my pore size... but I do believe having bha/lha’s in this moisturizer will ensure that sunscreen/ heavier makeup products won’t clog up your pores, making them appear smaller. I did notice a little bit of a light burning sensation the second time applying the cream, I believe this to be my skin getting use to the salicylic acid. I cut back to using the cream every other day to build up a tolerance to the salicylic acid first, and once my skin adjusted I started using it daily. I personally think this would be an amazing moisturizer for anyone with combo-oily skin, large pores, likes cooling effects, doesn’t mind light scents, and is looking for a something in between a thick cream and a gel cream. I think this is a very user friendly cream you just need to make sure you’re not putting it close to your eyes, and working up a tolarence to the salicylic acid so it doesn’t dry you out due to over doing it. The ingredients are amazing when I was overlooking them, I think this is a soild high quality cream! 10/10

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_title: The golden elixir to hydration and glow!
reviews.review_text: First off I would like to say how the bottle embodied the brand perfectly, the hexagon shape bottle that resembles the bees honeycomb! So beautiful!! I’m not going to lie I was nervous to try this seeing how I’m prone to acne and have large pores, I couldn’t be more delighted that I got to try this out! Upon applying the oil is super light weight and feels like water, there is no greasy or slip to it like a regular oil. There is little tiny golden dots in the bottle which is Commiphora Oil and these melt on contact with skin and create a beautiful sensorial texture. The oil not only feels opulent but it really does the job! After I finished washing my face I applied this oil right away, it absorbed immediately leaving my skin supple with a lovely soft focus glow, my skin felt firmed and definitely nourished. After a month of soild using this in my skin regime, I can say my skin looks more hydrated and healthy, has a beautiful glow and definitely more firm, my skin texture is more smoothed out which has made smile lines look less pronounced and softer. I didn’t think it really pumped up my skin but I could see it doing that on more mature skin. I think this oil is absolutely amazing and great for anyone who needs some extra hydration and extra radiance. I have applied the watery youth oil directly on my skin and mixed into my moisturizer, foundation, or tinted sunscreen... I can say my favorite is to apply the oil raw to washed skin but I 100% love love love applying it into my foundation!! It just makes the foundation application go on smoother and makes you have that super healthy skin look! The only con I will say is this oil is heavily scented! It is natural scent but to some people I know this might be a deal breaker. Aside that I think everyone should incorporate this into their regime, you will be pleasantly surprized if you don’t have sensitive skin to fragrance.

reviews.review_title: Good but not great for pores
reviews.review_text: I reallt wanted to love this but I found it super heavy and clogged my pores. When applied it’s a new heavy gel texture so for someone who doesn’t have dilated pores it honestly would be super lovely! The gel cream did make my skin feel baby smooth and really moisturized, it was just a little to much for my pores.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this product so much. I have all of the flavors- totally worth it to get them all. I don’t use this just at night. I keep a mini one in my purse, at my desk, and next to my bed. This product makes my lips so soft and hydrated and the tub his HUGE.  The flavors are great without being overwhelming. It goes on smooth and soft without feeling greasy or sticky. If you’re looking for something to replenish your lips, this is it!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer works okay, however it doesn’t make any miracles happen. It smells wonderful and hydrates okay, but I wish it did more to brighten and moisturize a bit more. I use a water drop cream and a rose water toner in addition to this to get the desired effect. The product doesn’t clog my pores, which is why I was able to use up nearly the whole bottle. Again, not a bad product, but not a miracle worker.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_title: NOT a scrub. It’s a peeling gel.
reviews.review_text: The description of this product is wrong. It’s a peeling gel. PTR & Saturday Skin, & Boscia all have versions. It works well and left no irritation, like the other brands. It’s gentler than a scrub, so I feel that advertising it as such may turn others away.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This has helped to make my skin smooth and hydrated. I sometimes skip moisturizer because this works so well! I put a couple of drops in my palms and rub it over my face and neck and let it dry before I put on serums or moisturizer. I love the luxury of the glass bottle and it lasts a while since I’m about 1/3 through the bottle of my purchase a couple of months ago. I feel this would be great through all seasons since it’s a little moisture that can be layered upon if necessary.

reviews.review_title: Best lip product I’ve ever used
reviews.review_text: Love this product so much. Received as a sample and bought the full size. The pink smells amazing but got the vanilla as I’m obsessed with anything vanilla and it didn’t disappoint: I’ve had try, flakey lips in harsh Alberta winter and this literally is the first product to ever solve it. It feels soft and wonderful and I use it night and day. It leaves a really nice semi gloss/ semi matte sheen to your lips which I like and is smooth and velvety, not sticky and does not deposit any colour. Also it lasts FOREVER.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this product! I’ve used green clean in the past and really like a cleansing balm, and this did not disappoint. It’s smooth and creamy and does not clog my pores, and is lovely and melts away the makeup. I would absolutely use this again. I have oily and dry combination skin and it’s really a perfect product for me. I received this product as a complimentary sample from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Very nice light moisturizing cream. I received a complimentary sample from Influenster and although it feels very sheer, it’s hydrating and non greasy. I feel it may not be thick enough for dry Alberta winters but in the summer this is a very fresh moisturizer that leaves a nice soft finish. Doesn’t clog pores!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff! Super soft on the face too! It’s also really nice that it comes in a smaller size!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff! Super soft on the face too! It’s also really nice that it comes in a smaller size!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I use this either in the morning after shower or in evening after shower! And I love this stuff! It makes my face shine really nice! And when I use this I don’t use my moisturizer and save on that!I love the smell too.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Decent face wash. I wish it came in watermelon. Maybe one day! I use this every morning and evening, and the times I don’t use this then I have a mask on in teleplays of it.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_title: I'm pretty sure this is love...
reviews.review_text: I have suuuuuper sensitive skin, so I’ve been searching for a new moisturizer, (for what seems like forever,) that wouldn’t cause me breakouts or hives/allergies. I read all the reviews and decided to take a chance on this one, and let me tell you.... it’s AMAZING!!! I seriously felt my skin take a sigh of relief the first time I put this on!! It’s so lightweight and sinks in fast, and it leaves your skin feeling so soft and hydrated. I think I found my moisturizer for life!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample with another order, and absolutely  loved it! I went right out and bought a full size. It has the perfect amount of exfoliant, and leaves my face feeling fresh, smooth and hydrated. It also smells AMAZING, like Lemon Merangue Pie!! Just try it...you won’t regret it.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I can’t rave enough about this cleanser... it seriously saved my face!! I used to have horribly dry, dull skin, (especially in the -30°C weather where I live,) to the point that it would become painful and itchy. I was even breaking out more because of how damaged my skin’s moisture barrier was. After a few weeks of using this, my skin began to transform and heal. I’ve been using it for over a year now and I’ll probably never go without it. My skin feels moisturized, soft, and glowing! I literally have better skin now than I did in my 20’s. I definitely recommend giving it a try, and give it a chance to work for you.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: My saving grace for random stress breakouts. Shrinks zits literally overnight

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Not sure how effective this cream is long term but short term it feels super luxurious and creamy and wonderful.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: My skins feels more hydrated and doesn’t dry out as quickly since adding this to my skincare regimen

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I really love the Lancôme Tonique Confort! It has all the great qualities of a toner PLUS a soothing lotion inside. So, it’s perfect for people with dry/combination skin who would normally be a bit hesitant to try a toner. The lotion on the inside did catch me a bit off guard when I habitually placed a cotton round on top and tipped the bottle over, because not very much came out of the bottle. The lotion makes the toner a bit thicker, so it doesn’t come out like it normally would. So, I now turn the bottle sideways and kinda pour a bit of it onto the cotton round instead, and that technique works like a charm. The toner is also infused with rose, so it smells super nice and it still leaves my skin feeling nice and tingly and ready for it’s perfect pairing: the Lancôme Hydrazen lotion.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I absolutely LOVE the Hydrazen Lotion by Lancôme! It is infused with rose, so it smells amazing! Plus it feels really nice too. Compared to other lotions that your pores just kinda eat up and then continue to leave your skin feeling thirsty, the Hydrazen lotion actually keeps your skin feeling moisturized for at least a few hours. Because of that fact, I make sure that I use this lotion under my makeup, so that my makeup doesn’t dry out. After a hot shower, often times my pores will release the excess moisture from the shower, so I will sometimes need to dab the lotion a bit with a tissue to make sure it doesn’t leave me a bit too moisturized (no one wants to feel sweaty after a shower). But even with that, my skin doesn’t dry up. I highly recommend it for dry/combination skin, and I definitely recommend using it after the Lancôme Tonique Confort!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I am a huge fan of serums, and this one is especially amazing. It makes my skin feel super glowy! I also love that it doesn’t leave a thick residue like some other serums I’ve tried. As always, I feel so fresh after using Bare Minerals! Got to test this product for free.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample and I love it! I’ve been using it for a few weeks now and it’s my new go to eye cream.  It’s super moisturizing and helps with my dark circles.  I totally recommend it for any girl who loves to ensure their skin is moisturized and loves a good eye cream!

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I’m not the type of girl who regularly uses toner (that’s why the four stars) but I have to say that it is light and hydrating.  It’s done wonders for my combination skin.  It does not irritate, it doesn’t have an overpowering scent. Overall I would recommend this! I received this product for free.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have been using this moisturizer for about a week and I’m obsessed! It is light, hydrating and has a mild flowery scent.  It feels luxurious and keeps my skin looking healthy.  Overall, great moisturizer! I received this product for free.

reviews.review_text: Worth the price. Because they are washed off I usually try to spend the least on cleansers when it comes to my skincare routine - with the exception of this oil. It removes makeup entirely w/o stripping or irritating my sensitive skin. The best cleansing oil I have tried by far (both high end and budget). Does NOT leave your eyes ’cloudy’ like other oils when removing eye make up. I usually double cleanse, but the truth is if I am in a rush, or on a lazy night, a quick cleanse with this oil gets the job done by itself.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Great With Tretinoin! Please CHANGE The Packaging!
reviews.review_text: This thick, emollient cream has allowed me to streamline my evening routine. I use this product as a moisturizer over my prescription retinol. It has virtually eliminated any dryness/irritation that retinol causes my sensitive skin, allowing me to increase the frequency of my retinol use to 5+ times per week. This has definitely maximized the results I have experienced. This cream works wonders on it’s own, and is now the only evening moisturizer I use. It is very thick, and a little goes a long way. IT is ALMOST perfect - My ONLY criticism is the packaging: 1. I have to sterilize a tiny spatula everyday b/c I do not want to contaminate the product with my fingers (plus it is open to the air). 2. I wish the packaging was opaque. - The clear glass jar increases the chance the ingredients (especially vit C) degrading from light; so I must store it in the paper box it came in. YTTP PLEASE FIX YOUR PACKAGING!!!!

reviews.review_text: Hands down the best value in the Drunk Elephant line. This is a lightweight, effective peptide formula with convenient and functional packaging. The peptides are a wonderful daytime compliment if you are using retinol in the P.M.  If your skin is sensitive like mine, make sure your face is completely dry prior to application for best results.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a great product at a great price. I have and would repurchase. I love that it is a clean product with no parabens, too. It feels light upon application and not greasy or heavy. Even though it says acid, there is no stinging, etc. Try it!

reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer. it was very hydrating and did make a difference in my skin. I found it very thick on my skin but this was good since it is what I was looking for in terms of hydration. In the warmer months, I felt a layer of this on my skin in the heat - this I didn’t like but new it was working. Now that I use the Protini, i can see a huge difference in how these two work. I will purchase again for more hydration in the colder months. I gave it a four because the packaging is not great - I understand that this packaging means less contaimination etc but I want to see how much is left. I also broke the top of the lid with a screwdriver when I had finished the product and got the remianing product out of the inside. This is because it is expensive and  I want every drop!

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_text: this oil is amazing! It makes my skin so soft and flawless feeling. As soon as I applied it, I could feel the difference. It makes my skin feel so healthy. reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: I’m really loving this cold plunge pore remedy moisturizer!! It has a really nice consistency that melts into my skin and makes it feel smooth and soft. It has a cold, almost minty feeling on my skin which I believe is from the Willowherb extract. It makes my skin feel refreshed and it gives it this nice cooling effect. My pores are quite large and are usually clogged. I have noticed my pores look minimized! When I wake up in the morning after using it the night before, my skin feels amazing and so, so soft. I am really loving this moisturizer and I’m very pleased it has been a BHAs/LHAs. These help loosen that skin cells that clog pores and it’s rich in antioxidants which helps nourish my skin. I can really see the difference in my skin and I’m loving it!

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I have really dry skin and after using this product for only 3 days so far, my skin is so soft and looks moisturized!I apply it after I thoroughly wash my face with an exfoliant, benzyl peroxide cleanser and then a salicylic acid face wash. reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this product. It didn’t leave the skin feeling sticky or heavy, and it had a nice scent without being overwhelming. I also liked the level of hydration it gave me for summer, though I’m not sure that it would be enough for my winter skin

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I think that this is a good product. It can go on a little thick if you’re not careful, but it works well as an overnight lip mask and has a pleasant feeling and extremely light smell

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: If price is not a determining factor when purchasing a moisturizer, then I suggest giving this one a try! The product absorbs quickly and leaves no greasy feeling behind. I have combination skin and it keeps my face feeling moisturized all day without getting oily in my usual areas

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is the most amazing eye product I have ever used! I’m 46, turning 47 in May. It is diminishing the fine lines that have started to appear and the dark circles I’ve always had (always invested in good skincare...and stayed out of the sun...until this year.) I’ve also used it around my mouth and those lines are also virtually gone (I’m careful not to put it to close to my lips though.)  I’ve tried other eye creams with Retinol and they are extremely drying and never seem to work for me but this product DOES work!  I put it on two times a day and saw immediate, quick results with this product.  Bought it on 11/7/19 and still a lot left, think it will last a decent amount of time, maybe 3 months?  If it lasts 3 months, that’s only right over $18  a month and this product is very much worth it!!!I saw this eye cream in the store but hesitated because of my skin sensitivities.  The Sephora sales rep raved about it and said something about it being a top product or something but...based on his recommendation, I bought it and absolutely LOVE it!!!  Can’t wait to see him again so I can let him know how amazing this product is and that I’m SO glad that he took me back to it, recommended it, took time to answer my questions, and ensured I left with samples of other products to also test out (because of my skin sensitivities.)  I typically decline help initially, because I like to shop solo, but they always offer me assistance and acknowledge me when I enter the store.   I ONLY shop at Sephora!  Their customer service is superior to any of the competition I’ve tried as well as their product knowledge and...I’m also grateful they hire a workforce that doesn’t discriminate regarding race/sex/age, etc.  They also ALWAYS acknowledge me when I enter the store.  I have had poor experiences where the competition has not and they have left me standing for extended periods of time.  I’ve never had that experience at Sephora. :)

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this product.  My skin adores this product.  My skin does really well with Vitamin C products and I always get a boost in my skin color and it looks brighter.  Wouldn’t go without this...

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product is AMAZING!  When I first started using it, I wasn’t sure but I do use it in combination with my Dr. Dennis Gross products as well as my Ole Henrickson.  I have several Biossance products that I love and this one has turned out to be a top favorite for me.  I have skin sensitivity issues so I have to change it up and I have to mess around with it just like a cook would in the kitchen for a recipe and I’ve used eye creams around my mouth to help with lines and I’m going to try this on under my eyes now because it is EXTREMELY rick and does REALLY well with my skin in conjunction with the other product lines I’ve mentioned above.  I’m 47 and I’ve done some cigarette smoking and I’m trying to stop and if I had not taken care of my skin so much over the years I would look really bad right now but these products ARE helping me improve my skin while I taper off smoking/quit.  Read some articles about aging/smoking/turning 50+ and what happens and that will definitely help one quit smoking HOWEVER...my skin looks amazing because of these products.  It’s definitely taken a hit due to medical/personal issues but these products have been EXTREMELY IMPACTING on recovering my skin, again, I just turned 47.  Biossance + Dr. Dennis Gross + Ole Henrickson = TOP FAVS + well priced especially considering the return of these products.  Investing in a bit at a time helps as well as using enough/not to much and ensuring you fully use “all“ of the product.  I’ve cut tubes open to get the rest of the product out.  I do NOT waste my skincare products and I ensure that I use ALL of it.

reviews.review_text: I have applied this eye cream for one week. I have noticed a difference in dark circles, bags and fine lines! P.S. pinch skin at the beginningI received this product complimentary for testing .

reviews.review_text: These moisturizers can leave your skin feeling fresh and less weighed down when compared with a rich moisturizer. This makes them a great option for people who don’t like the feeling of a thicker cream on the skin I used it as my daily moisturizer, it’s not oily at all and keep my skin hydrated all day long. Highly recommended. Try it, You won’t be disappointed!!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: My emergency dots. Help me prevent some acne and i love it!!!

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I never write reviews but this product has changed my skin for the better. Little back story, I have oily and dry skin, especially on my nose where the skin is super flaky. I have tried multiple products to try and combat the flaky skin and nothing has actually helped it. I would put concealer over my nose and instantly it would have cracks and look horrible. So I decided to try something with retinol and came across this product. I have used it for a little over a month and omg it has helped my skin tremendously. I use way less blotting papers throughout the day and my nose no longer has flaky bits. I would give this product more than 5 stars if I could. I highly recommend it, definitely worth the higher cost as I have save 100s trying to find different products that ultimately do nothing for my skin.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is just what my skin needed. I use this in the morning and Luna at night. I struggled with dry patches and flakiness on my nose. It was horrible as I could not cover the flaking with concealer as it would worsen, and I have red pigment across my face so I need to cover it up. I have purchased this moisturizer x3 and still love the results. I have noticed a decrease in pores and blackhead along with the resolving of the dry/flaking. It does say it helps with pigmentation but I have not really noticed a change with respect to that. I don’t find this product to be tacky which is nice but it does feel like it moisturizes well. One thing to note is when you first start using this product it caused mild tingling and redness (for a couple minutes) initially, but after a couple of uses that resolves. I am quite happy with this purchase and it is well worth the cost. I will continue to repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is moisturizing but does leave the skin tacky after use. If you want something that absorbs right away and doesn’t feel dewy this cream isn’t for you. I dont personally notice a decrease in redness after using (I think the jar version that the USA sells is more effective at masking redness). But this cream is very effective at keeping my skin moisturized during the dry winters in Alberta. It takes a bit maybe 5-10 minutes to fully absorb into my skin where I can apply makeup afterwards without it causing separation of my concealer etc. The container looks small but I’ve been using it daily for about 2 months and its only about half gone, as you only need a dime size amount from your face and neck.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I received a free 3 day sample of Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare Alpha Beta Extra Strength Peel from PinchMe.com and it has completely changed my skincare game. I immediately bought a month supply after my first time using the peel. My skin is the softest it’s ever been. And my dark spots are fading after one week of use. I will be purchasing this for the rest of my life.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I tried this product in the Night Bright trial set. I could not justify spending $90 on a face serum, but I had heard such incredible things about this product that I had to at least try it. Let me tell you- my skin improved drastically after using this for 3 months. I had a lot of acne scarring and clogged pores, and after using for about a month, I noticed a drastic improvement with my skin. My acne scars were fading, and I was breaking out less frequently. The trial size lasted me for three months, and when I ran out, I bought the full size. It will last me forever- you only need one pump for your entire face! I am so glad I gave this a chance. Yes, it is ridiculously expensive, but it is so worth it if you have problematic skin.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin, and I have such a hard time finding moisturizers that won’t break me out. I got a trial size of this in the Night Bright set, which I honestly just got for the Framboos serum. I had no interest in this product at all, but since I had it, I decided to try it anyways. And I am so glad I did! My skin loves this oil; it did not break me out at all, and truly has made my skin more hydrated and healthy, along with the Framboos serum. I recently bought the full size of this during the VIB sale. It is really expensive, but a little goes a long way so it will last for a long time. I am really excited to try more items from this brand- I am so impressed!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: This is such a good product! It feels just like a silicone primer, and has absolutely no white cast or scent. It wears beautifully under make up, and does not irritate or dry out my sensitive skin at all. It’s the best facial sunscreen ever!

I love highlighter, and combining my two favorite things literally has gotten me so many compliments. Definitely worth the investment.

reviews.review_text: For the most part, I like the toner because it doesn’t tighten my skin or leave any residue like other toners. Easy to apply and smells like a Sour Patch Kid. I’ve been using it frequently for about a month and haven’t seen any changes in my skin. I think paired with more of GLOW RECIPES products would make a difference. Other than that, I’m not impressed but still giving it a shot till I’m out.

I now use this product on a need-basis and have not seen the dry patches. It instantly refreshes my natural dark circles and slightly reduces puffiness. The product itself is extremely cool and smooth to the touch. I think it’s worth it for the price.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I love the smell and texture of this mask. Honestly, I can’t tell if it’s placebo or the product but I don’t notice anything stark different about my pores. The mask does get tight on the skin, which I prefer my masks to do. Once washed off my skin looks practically the same. Now I use this once a week for my self care days. Every other time I’ve used it I’ve had a spot appear on my skin that does itch. Since I’m not using it frequently, that’s something *I* can look past. I have dry to normal skin with pretty deep blackheads. I’ve noticed blackheads have visibly reduced but not from this product.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have incredibly sensitive dry skin and was looking for an affordable dupe to Tatcha’s dewy skin moisturizer. After reviewing the Watermelon Toner from GLOW, I was really on the fence but listened to my friend. A little goes a long way with this product, and I even apply it to my neck and chest (if low cut shirt.) I see an instant difference in my skin and have been thoroughly pleased. My skin has had 0 bad reactions and it sits weightless. I am not a skin care fanatic, and really trust in personal testimonies. This was the first product I bought blindly and can see why it has such great reviews. For extra plumpness, I put it on my lips before adding my Carmex lip balm. I love it and my skin’s texture has drastically changed.
