reviews.review_text: I love the natural ingredients. My eyes feel hydrated and refreshed, I use this morning and night. You only need a small amount, and it melts into skin. Note that this doesn’t have any corrective properties in terms of anti aging or discoloration. If you are looking for purely moisturizing, this is the best!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Love it, especially for no-makeup days
reviews.review_text: This color correcting treatment is the real deal. I struggle regularly with pigmentation due to acne and sensitive skin - this stuff cancels out redness and evens my skin tone without being too greasy or heavy. However, I personally don’t like layering under foundation - I save this treatment for days when I want to go foundation free. I put a little bronzer and concealer, and I’m good to go.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Love it, especially for no-makeup days
reviews.review_text: This color correcting treatment is the real deal. I struggle regularly with pigmentation due to acne and sensitive skin - this stuff cancels out redness and evens my skin tone without being too greasy or heavy. However, I personally don’t like layering under foundation - I save this treatment for days when I want to go foundation free. I put a little bronzer and concealer, and I’m good to go.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_title: Skeptical at first but now in love
reviews.review_text: When I first purchased this over the summer, I was smearing it on after day serum instead of a moisturizer.... no no no no no. Now that I have better incorporated this product into my morning routine, I truly love it. Mix 1 pump of this product with your moisturizer - use a slightly smaller amount of your moisturizer than you would normally use in order to accommodate the moisturizing properties of this serum. I am especially grateful for this product on days where I need to wear less foundation than usual and still want to look glowy and bright. I did take one star off because I am relatively fair-skinned, and can’t imagine how this product would be applicable for darker skin types. If they released another formula to provide the same benefits for darker skin tones, it’d be a win!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant to spend $72 on a moisturizer after tax... it is pricey, but it’s EXACTLY what my sensitive skin needed. Everything irritates my face, so when I got a sample of this and felt how nice it was- I knew I was suckered into purchasing the whole thing! If you’re a texture person- it’s like a mix between a face lotion and gel. It’s not a heavy-duty moisturizer, so if you’re REALLY dry, I wouldn’t recommend it... but overall, it’s perfect for my morning and night facial routine.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Don't see what the hype is about.
reviews.review_text: Made my skin feel really suffocated and tacky-- like, it would never fully absorb into my skin; so then when I went to lay down after applying at night, my pillow case literally stuck to my face! I’ve never had a moisturizer do that before. I gave it 2 stars because the smell wasn’t too overpowering, and I DID try it with makeup since it was sticky enough to act as a primer- but my face was oily quicker by the end of the day than with my normal face primers. I just don’t see what the big deal and big price tag is with Tatcha products!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: If you’re into rich and creamy moisturizers, this will be your absolute new favorite! I use this when my skin is feeling especially dry, or if just need something a little heavier under my makeup when I have dry patches on my face that my primers just don’t hide. I have EXTREMELY sensitive facial skin, and the slightest hint of perfumed lotions, etc... irritate me, and this is has nothing in its ingredients that is aggravating. The smell is of virtually nothing, if you don’t care for overly “lotiony“ smelling moisturizers either! If you’re hesitant on getting this and can tolerate a thicker moisturizer- this is your golden goose... Just get it and you’ll thank me later!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: Okay, I’ll start this review by saying I’m a huge fan of facial oils, so I’m picky when it comes to the one I’ll use in my skincare routine. I was using the $120 Saint Jane beauty oil before this, and was just not impressed enough to keep with it, so I decided to give YTTP a chance. I’m really glad I did. There’s no offensive smell to it, not overly greasy, absorbs into the skin quickly enough but still provides a nice barrier. A little goes a long way, so I think anyone with anything negative to say about this are using entirely too much. Will be purchasing this again, and trying out other YTTP products now! 10/10, highly recommend 👌

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: After finishing this whole product and actually rebuying it, I have concluded that it is a great nighttime moisturizer if you have drier skin. I lean more towards dry, especially in the winter when I was predominantly using this, but when it started to get hotter, it started to feel like it was sitting on my skin and not sinking in as well (picture body moisturizer after showering that takes forever to absorb so you have to wait to put on leggings kinda vibe but on your face). Although it was nice in the dry, cold weather of upstate NY winters, it is a bit too much for me during hot days and nights. Definitely would never use as a day cream. Probably will not rebuy due to the price, but I’m glad I gave it a try. I have very sensitive, acne prone skin and it did not break me out or irritate my skin in anyway so that was a huge plus :)

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I almost never rebuy masks of any sort, but I fell in love with this blue tansy mask. I know some people have mentioned a weird smell, but I personally was really enamored by it - it does smell kind of herb-y but to me that just signified that there isn’t any artificial scents or fragrances in it, only natural stuff. Even if the smell did bother you a bit, I personally think it would be worth it. I used this about two times a week, and my skin always felt rejuvenated, less red, and soft. I will agree about the short shelf life that others have mentioned - I noticed some specks of something (assuming mold? not sure) around the lid and the glass walls of the container when I started running low, but at that point I had had the mask for at least four months. Because this is a natural based product, I think that aspect makes sense. For me, I was able to finish it before I thought I needed to toss it, but if you are not planning on using it every week I would maybe be wary!Overall, I love this product and Herbivore in general. I have very sensitive skin that is prone to redness and acne so it is always really refreshing when I find a product that not only doesn’t worsen those two things but actually helps mitigate them.

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_title: The hype on this one is real
reviews.review_text: Okay - this stuff definitely costs an arm and a leg, but if you can afford it, it is WORTH. IT. I have been using this for about two months now, at night, using a small amount on a cotton round. Although you definitely need to make sure to wear sunscreen (as you always should), I noticed that my skin was brighter and smoother almost immediately after using it. My skin is really sensitive so I sometimes struggle with BHA and AHA products as they can be waaay to harsh, but this is the perfect, light step in your nighttime routine. If you have acne prone and sensitive skin, I think this guy is a winner :)

reviews.review_text: Lightweight yet very moisturizing! I have combo skin and it is perfect in the morning under makeup!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: WOW. I cannot recommend this product enough. I use it every night, and even sometimes during the day when my lips are especially chapped. It is totally worth the price, one tube lasts for months. I’ve been on this one container for six months now, and still have some left. Absolutely love and totally worth the price. So reasonable compared to other lip masks out there.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: This is my #1 skincare product. I’m completely obsessed with it. The jelly feels cool and refreshing on your skin; sometimes I leave it in the fridge so it is extra refreshing when I put it on, especially on really hot summer days. I use it every night, and you receive so much product for such a reasonable price. The smell is amazing and you wake up with smooth and soft skin. I love it!

reviews.review_text: I’m pretty content with how this purchase turned out. I wasn’t sure what to expect since it is so cheap, but my breakouts have been completely under control and it fits in with my skincare routine perfectly.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this product. I have sensitive skin, yet it hasn’t been too strong for me. My fine lines have diminished significantly. My overall skin tone looks great. This product is magical and I have told soooo many people to use it. Everyone has reported back with rave reviews so it hasn’t let me down so far! A bit pricey but completely worth it.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I started with Good Genes, and then added Luna to the mix and I couldn’t be happier. My skin looks so youthful and balanced. Nice light fragrance, gentle enough for my sensitive skin. It’s seriously amazing.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample. At first I thought it was working as it seemed to neutralize the red. However after using it for about 4 days the areas that I applied it to (I’m redder on my chin and around my mouth/nose) were terribly red and burned all day long. As I didn’t use any other new products, and the only area affected was the only area that I applied the Tiger Grass Cream to, its pretty easy to know where the irritation came from. I had to stop using and apply cortisone to help reduce the redness/burning. It certainly did the opposite of what I hoped it would.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: What sort of magic is in this bottle? I’m not a huge foundation wearer. It’s just not me. I decided to give this a go after reading so many positive reviews and literally from the first time I tried it on I was hooked. It makes my skin look perfect. I truly don’t understand how it’s happening. lol. My skin looks glowy, smooth, and even in tone. I’m obsessed with anti aging, and while I have no clue if there are long term benefits, on the short term I look youthful when wearing this.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: These were a huge disappointment. Not only do they take forever, it felt like they brought a ton if stuff up to the surface of my skin, but didn’t remove any of it. I had to follow up w/a good old fashioned Biore pore strip to try and remove it all b/c I looked awful. I like the Peace Out Acne and have purchased them several times, but I won’t buy these again.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I am new to Retinol and was looking for a product that would not irritate my skin, especially how delicate the eye area is. I’ve used Sunday Riley for two weeks now as part of my nighttime routine, and I like how the texture feels and how easy it is to apply and be absorbed.

I think I found it.Since I use retinol at night, wearing sunscreen during the day is super important on my fair skin. I love Glow recipe products and this new sunscreen is everything! I love the fact that it is SPF50 and combines niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. I feel protected all day!

reviews.review_text: The Genius Liquid collagen, gifted by Algenist is one of my new favorite skincare products. My skin feels smoother and brighter after 10 days of using it. You don’t need a lot of product, just a pea size for the face and I like to use one for my neck. I only use it in the morning before my moisturizer and after my Niacinamide serum.  I love the bottle as well, everything seems to have a dropper these days and I am not a fan of it; so definitely likes that this is a pump bottle and transparent to see how much product is left.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for a year now and my skin has never looked better. I’ve struggled with hormonal and stress related acne, but this did the trick. I found that for the first month of use it did not clear up my acne. If anything it looked worse. But after a month of allowing my skin to get used to this product it has never looked better. In the beginning this really dried out my combination skin, but I realized all those dry flakes were just dead skin cells and texture that this oil was removing. Now this oil is extremely nourishing for my combo skin. I wake up with smooth skin, minimized pores, lightened dark spots, and smoothed wrinkles. If you can stick out the month where your skin looks like a wreck, then this product will do amazing things.

reviews.review_text: This Greek Yoghurt foaming cleanser is amazing. I would have never tried or discovered this if it wasn’t for Influenster. I recently received this in my Boss Babe Voxbox from Influenster. I have sensitive skin so I’m always hesitant trying new skincare products but I have to say I’m really impressed with this one. I love the smell and feel of this product. It has a nice light scent and feels very soft and luxurious. I have learned that a little goes a long way because it starts off as a cream but once you apply it to your face it turns into a foam and there is a lot more product. When I firat tried it a few pimples did break out a few days later but it was nothing crazy and I didn’t have any redness or irritation. I think sometimes that happens when you try new products. I have been using this daily and really love it. I received this for free for my testing purposes and review. I do plan on purchasing in the future and continuing to use it. I discovered on the brands website they use natural ingredients and do not test on animals and that’s really important to me!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I was very nervous trying this product at first because my skin is extremely sensitive and a lot of products cause irritation. The moisturizer felt a little thick to me, like vaseline texture but softer. It left my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I haven’t seen any improvements yet but I also haven’t had any negative reactions. I’m very happy this brand does not test on animals and uses beneficial and more natural ingredients. I received this product for complimentary in exchange for my testing purposes and honest review.

reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has a subtle scent. It smells very clean, fresh, and a mix of water and soft florals. The scent does not linger, after awhile I could not smell it any more. I liked using this moisturizer but I probably would not purchase this because this company is not cruelty free. I also did not see any differences in my skin and prefer a moisturizer with no fragrance. I haven’t had any breakouts from it or harsh reactions but I have only used this a few times. I think what makes this moisturizer different is how it does have that cooling and refreshing feeling on the skin. I really like the concept of this product, which aims to provide “a drink of water“ for your skin.

I thought maybe it was just going to be a purge so I continue to use it but at this point I’m thinking I’m just having a reaction unfortunately so Im probably not going to use it anymore after today... Every morning I wake up and there’s more pimples and at 33 yrs old I shouldn’t be having this issue lol smh texture was great tho and besides the pimples I haven’t had any issues w dry spots or irritated skin so that’s why I give it 4 stars. reviews.review_title: Great facial scrub that smells amazing
reviews.review_text: This product smells AMAZING!!!! Smells like candy. It smells so fresh and fruity and leaves your face feeling and smelling fresh. I like how the exfoliating sugar dissolves after you run into your face for a while. I do wish it lasted a little longer to be able to scrub my face a little more. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and really clean. It’s not over drying. It cleans very well without being too harsh on my face. I have dry skin and my skin doesn’t get that dry tight feel after using this. Would definitely recommend

reviews.review_title: Initially makes my skin feel smooth hydrated.
reviews.review_text: I received this product a couple days ago so I’ve only been using it for two days so far. My initial thoughts are that it does leave my skin feeling moisturized. When I use the serum day and night it does help my skin feel like it locks in moisture for longer throughout the day. I put it on first thing after cleaning my face. It goes on smoothly and soaks in quickly to my skin. It really absorbs deep into my skin and doesn’t leave any greasy feel to my skin at all. I do still have to use a moisturizer because this serum alone is not enough moisture for my skin. Initially I do notice that my skin feels a little bit more smooth and soft to the touch. It also has a nice clean sent to the serum that I do enjoy. I am excited to see what the results will be after using this for 30 days.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: No product has ever come close to doing for my skin what Good Genes (GG) has. For me, the first week was rough. My skin got flakey, my pores looked bigger and gunkier, and I was getting lots of pimples. This happened first on my nose, then my forehead, cheeks...my chin lasted the longest. Then my skin started to clear and what was left behind was a glow I haven’t seen in decades. My neck looks younger. Overall, my wrinkles have significantly lessened everwhere but by my eyes. My nose is where I’ve seen the biggest change so far. It’s starting to look like glass skin. My family and friends have noted the difference. I’m only one month in and I’m excited to see my skin continue to improve.Daily Routine: I use GG every other night. I use Drunk Elephant (DE) Marula Oil to moisturize when I don’t have GG on, and cleanse every morning with a salcylic acid scrub after a good rinse (lactic and salcylic can react) followed by DE Jelly #9 to balance my skin PH. My nighttime wash is DE Jelly #9 after a micellar water.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I used points to get a sample, and will be buying a full size. Moisturizers usually cause my skin to breakout. This one doesn’t. I’ve been applying a light layer every other night and most mornings.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Unlike other products claiming anti-aging benefits, these changes don’t disappear after a shower. This product isn’t restricting blood flow to remove redness; causing swelling to remove lines; dyeing skin to mask discoloration; using silicone to fake improved texture. Instead, I wake every morning with clearer skin that looks healthy instead of aggravated (my skin is sensitive with mild rosacea). Suddenly I can tell when a moisturizer is causing blemishes, because I’m not getting any otherwise. My pores are clearer & appear to be shrinking. Lines are getting thinner & disappearing. Discoloration (freckles & that mask from BC) is SLOWLY being faded.I used this every third night for about two weeks to start. I usually use a baby shampoo/bodywash to clean my face, & don’t apply a facial moisturizer over this product.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing for a scrub. First off, it has an amazing scent. It’s not to strong nor is it overly chemical smelling. First thing I noticed after that was how light the scrub is. Meaning it’s not as abrasive as others. Sometimes when using scrubs, I feel as if mI’m scrubbing my whole face away. This was light and airy, easy on my skin but still took off my dead skin. After just 1 use, I noticed a huge difference. My skin was very soft and bright. Definitely would use this as my normal scrub. HUDA nailed it with this one! Keep it up. I am forever in love with this... and I have extra sensitive skin.

I had to use a second product to remove the eyeshadow, mascara and eyeliner and then proceeded with my cleanser. I am dissapointed..!! Anyway, this product can be used in different ways, so I’ll try it as a facial mask for hydration purposes so I don’t feel that I wasted my money on this one.  I’ll stick to my Clinique and Hada Labo cleanser oils as a first step in my skin care routine to remove the make up.

reviews.review_text: I’m glad I redeemed some of my points to try this..! This one is excellent and “affordable“ compared to Shiseido and Sulwasoo brands. It really soothes skin and calm redness..! Due to the infernal heat of Summer in San Antonio, TX, my skin is constantly red when I go outside and I’ve noticed it gets red as well, when I apply my niacinamide 10% serum. Maybe my skin has become sensitive to niacinamide or whatever... Anyway, the same day I received the serum-moisturizer from Tatcha I did my pm skin care routine as usual but incorporated the Tatcha Indigo instead of my SkinFix Moist. OMG..! Redness dissapeared within minutes, skin felt soft, it took a while to absorb but I did not know it was so rich and I applied too much :-), so a little goes a long way. The next morning, my skin looked flawless; healthy glow and super soft. It is in the pricey side but I am truly considering purchasing the regular size because it is the first product I use for redness purposes that has succesful results in no time.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: Thank you, Butterly @thisisbutterly and Chick Advisor @chickadvisor, for selecting me for Wave 2 of @clarinscanada Clarins Double Serum campaign. I received a complimentary 7-day treatment sample of Clarins Paris Double Serum (Hydric + Lipidic System) Complete Age Control Concentrate to test and review.This unique anti-aging two-phase serum contains 21 different beneficial plant extracts, including turmeric, to help fight skin aging plus other botanicals to help firm, smooth, and boost the radiance of your skin. I gave this product a try for a week. Not sure if I see a difference in my fine lines yet, but my combination skin does feel smooth and is relatively hydrated. I used it once a day, mostly at night, after cleansing my face. You mix both phases of the serum together, before applying to your face. It felt refreshing on my face, perhaps a bit tingly which worried me. Clarins Double Serum “universal texture” claims to be suitable for “all ages, all ethnicities and all skin types”, including my sensitive skin. I didn’t break out after using this product, but the fragrance, although pleasant smelling, was a bit strong for my skin. I may purchase this product again if I got it on sale. I would recommend Clarins Double Serum to those looking for a luxe anti-aging serum.  #DoubleSerum #ClarinsSkinCare #gotitfree #cadeau #ChickAdvisor #ProductReviewClub #thisisbutterly #clarinscanada #clarinsdoubleserum #Sephora

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Thank you so much Topbox Circle for letting me test this new Clinique Skincare product for FREE in exchange for my honest review. I received three Clinique samples, including a 1 ml sample of Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream to try. I used this new wrinkle correcting eye cream both under my eyes and on my eye lids for several days. I gently applied a pea sized amount of this fragrance-free cream all around my eye area in the mornings.It absorbed well, and the hydrating effect of this eye cream was also long lasting. It didn’t rub off or “crumb” like some other eye creams do if you touch the area. Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream promises to “strengthen your dermal support structure” to give you visibly younger-looking, smoother skin. It is suitable for All Skin Types. I found this eye cream to be quite soothing and comforting. It did not irritate my sensitive skin or eyes. After using this product my eye area felt hydrated, refreshed, and I looked more awake. My under-eye area looked a bit less puffy, and a bit brighter.One tip I have is I like to keep my eye creams in the fridge so that the product is cool when I apply it to my eye area. I find this helps to de-puff the under-eye area, plus it wakes me up! I would buy this product. I recommend Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream to anyone looking for a smoothing line fighting cream that helps strengthen the skin around the eyes. #trywithtopbox #freeproduct #CliniqueSmartClinicalRepair #topboxcircle #topbox #Clinique #Sephora

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: Thank you so much Topbox Circle for letting me test this new Clinique Skincare product for FREE in exchange for my honest review! I received three Clinique samples, including a 5 ml sample tube of Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream to try. I used this moisturizer on my face for a few days and applied it both in the day and at night. It absorbed well into my skin. The texture of this cream is nice. Not sticky, and not too thick. It glides on smoothly. I found that this was the only Clinique Smart Clinical Repair sample out of the three samples I was given that had a light mild fragrance to it. The Serum and the Eye Cream were fragrance free.Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream promises to “de-age“ your skin with its new CL 1870 Peptide Complex formula. It is suitable for All Skin Types. This cream did not irritate my sensitive skin. After using this moisturizer my skin felt nourished, hydrated, soft and smooth. Too soon to tell if my fine lines will be visibly reduced after using this product, but my skin did look immediately more supple. I’m willing to give this wrinkle correcting cream a longer try. I recommend Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream to anyone looking for a good moisturizer that promises to help fight wrinkles. #trywithtopbox #freeproduct #CliniqueSmartClinicalRepair #topboxcircle #topbox #Clinique #Sephora

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: For the last year, I’ve followed a double cleansing process where I remove all makeup with an oil based cleanser followed by a gel cleanser or a rice-based physical exfoliator. I’ve liked this process because I prefer a dry application and using a cloth to wipe away the cleanser for added exfoliation. The Beste No. 9 jelly cleanser is described as an “innovative” cleanser that “removes all traces of makeup, excess oil, pollution and any other grime from the day.” It can be used on wet or dry skin. Based on this description, I hoped to consolidate my double cleansing process to one product. I choose to apply the cleanser dry and work up a dry lather everywhere except the eye area before adding a little water and scrubbing my entire face, including eye area, before wiping the product away with a damp cloth. Be sure to avoid direct contact with your eyes when using this product. I’ve tried this product both with and without makeup. In general, the cleanser did a decent job at removing most makeup and dirt without drying my combo skin. I did observe a little leftover foundation color on my towel after drying my face post-wash. Because of this, I don’t think this cleanser is powerful enough to completely abandon my double cleanse process. I’d like to pair this with the Slaai makeup-melting butter cleanser in the future. Overall, I’m pleased this product is free of fragrance. It’s a simple, effective, and above average cleanser that should work for a variety of skin types. The “smoothie” I currently use has started to resurface my skin as expected, so I believe all of DE’s products work well together to accomplish skin care goals. I would re-purchase this cleanser again as a second step in my double cleanse process.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This is an average lip balm at an above average price. Consistent use didn’t really deliver any amazing results. Nothing about this product distinguished it from others. I prefer the Fresh Advanced Therapy balm or the Fresh sugar balm.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I have temperamental skin and finding a moisturizer that meets the needs of my combo skin has been a struggle. Most recently, I’ve used Tatcha silk cream as my daily moisturizer, which was just a little too much (but better than the not enough water cream). I was pleasantly surprised at the results provided by this moisturizer. First, the packaging is A+. Rather than dipping my fingers into the moisturizer, a pump lid dispenses the exact amount needed. The formula feels thick and rich. Alone, this would likely be too much for me. For my particular skincare smoothie, I combine the moisturizer with one pump of the TLC Framboos serum before applying. This thins out the moisturizer to the perfect consistency for my skin. I’ve experienced noticeable results after consistent twice daily use. My skin’s texture is smoother. Dark spots are lighter. My oilier t-zone area is tamed. I’ve noticed my foundation applying more smoothly with less settling in pores as my pores shrink and texture disappears. My foundation longevity in the t-zone area is dramatically improved. Overall, this is a great solution for my skin type and I would definitely continue to invest in this product.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Though I’m just over 40 years old, I’m fortunate to have few wrinkles, but my skin is textured. Combining the Lala Retro moisturizer with this serum twice a day has helped me to improve this texture. Major problem areas, like my forehead and chin, are noticeably smoother. I also enjoy the unique dispenser design. I’ll definitely continue using this product.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have a love-hate relationship with eye creams. Most leave my eye area oily, which eventually leads to raccoon eyes as my mascara disintegrates. Not so with this eye cream. The cream effectively sinks into my skin, leaving my eye area moisturized without the grease. I’ve noticed subtle improvements to the condition of the skin around my eyes as well. I will continue to use this product.

reviews.review_text: This is an OK retinol serum. I think it’s best for those who are new to retinol and those with sensitive skin. The serum helped smooth texture on my skin and did well with managing oil in my oilier areas. It did nothing for any hyperpigmentation. It does not create fragrance, which is a plus. The natural scent reminds me of the Drunk Elephant retinol serum, which I’ve used with great results. Overall, There are more effective OTC retinol treatments on the market, both at and below this product’s price point.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Ok this is by far my favorite moisturizer of ALL TIME! I’m usually not into cult following brand, I’m really staying away but with Drunk Elephant I might just join the tribe. The texture is creamy rich yet light, nourishing and heavy but sinks into the skin to only leave it supple, moisturized, glowing and looking healthy (especially adding their D Bronzi serum in the mix). I tried so many moisturizers that feel heavy and shiny and do not sink in before like 30 minutes if I’m lucky. Which is fine at night, but with Protini in the morning you get the experience of an extra rich cream with the results of an oil free moisturizer. This is just amazing. I’m finally writing my review after I finished my jar (4 months once a day) and I bought a new one today in store because no other moisturizer even comes close. reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This is THE most versatile hydrating mask EVER created!Primer, yes. Moisturizer, yes. Sleeping mask, yes. But here’s how everybody should use it. Apply a very thick layer on clean face, run yourself a warm bath, leave the mask on and take your bath, let the steam open your pores and massage the mask into your skin any time you feel steam condensing on your face, it’ll press more moisture and hydration into your skin. Relax in your bath for about 30 minutes. DO NOT RINSE. Once you’re out of the bath, leave it on until you had it at least 1 hour. Damp a washcloth with warm water, wipe slightly and pat the the remaining into your face. I like to follow with a retinol cream and eye cream. I swear the next day, you will not believe the results. Skin is smooth, plumped, youthful, soft and evened-out. Do yourself a favor, listen to me, you won’t regret it. Only downside is the price for the amount I use for that trick. Wish they had an auto delivery with 15% off at least.

reviews.review_text: I have never left a review for anything. This is worth changing that. I moved to NYC 5 years ago. My skin was ok but over the years it has gotten a lot worse due to the harsh pollution, and stress resulting in adult acne. I got a sample of this with VIB points by chance. I use it over a generic hyaluronic acid serum morning and night and nothing else. It has completely replaced my moisturizers! And i have some problem combination skin. After the first 24 hours I noticed a visible difference. I have since almost finished the sample and this has changed my life!

reviews.review_text: Since moving to New York City 5 years ago, I haven’t gone a day without makeup to cover up my acne due to stress and pollution. I’ve been using this morning and night but I think it would be a nice day cream because of the brightening effect. A little goes a long way and on my skin at least this definitely works. I use the other Sunday Riley products and LOVE all of them, so how I went a year without knowing this existed is beyond me.

reviews.review_text: This moisturizing cream was gifted by La Mer. I love the product a lot! It is very moisturizing and absorbs very fast. I only need to apply a little to cover my whole face. I have sensitive skin but I am totally fine using it. Besides helps keep skin balanced and calm. Despite the price, I like everything about it.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: The eye cream was gifted by Biossance. I love it very much! Since I started seeing those wrinkles around my eyes, I have been hunting for eye cream to control the wrinkles. It is amazing that I can see the difference agreeing using this eye cream from Biossance. I like it’s rich and moisturized texture and absorbs well. I will continue using it and the wrinkles become less obvious in long run.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: One of the best products I’ve received from Influenster.  I was so excited to try.  I use at night and before my makeup as a primer.  It’s so soft and creamy but not heavy on my skin.  Smells heavenly.  Definitely made my skin softer after application.  I did notice a slight blur effect when applied. I’d definitely recommend but not sure if I’ll repurchase because it’s a little on the expensive side for the benefits I saw.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I have received SHISEIDO sunscreens before to try and they are just so amazing.  I love how they smell. the consistency is so sheer and light. This one has a light peachy tint to it which made my skin glow after putting it on. Almost like a primer. They never break out my skin.  10/10 recommend.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I have received SHISEIDO sunscreens before to try and they are just so amazing.  I love how they smell. the consistency is so sheer and light. They never break out my skin.  10/10 recommend.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: It’s difficult to review vitamin c cream because honestly you don’t really see big drastic changes. It’s more for prevention. But I did like this one compared to others I’ve tried. I liked that it was a thin cream not a gel or oil. Didn’t have a bad smell like others.  Overall pleased with it and would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: The product has helped reduce the severity of my cystic acne, and also appears to speed up the healing process. I have tried other niacinamide serums, and this is by the far the most effective for me.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product has an unpleasant scent, but it is highly effective for fading my acne scars and hyperpigmentation. I have tried many products for the two aforementioned issues, and this product has been the most effective thus far. I have sensitive skin, and this product did not irritate my skin.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: My fingers were peeling from dryness,  and my dermatologist gave me samples of a lotion found at big box stores, That didn’t do a thing. Then I bought a mini of this ultra repair cream, and it stopped the peeling. I came back and bought the 8oz size, because I never want to be without it. This gets rid of my dry patches and moisturizes my dry skin so there is no more peeling. And there is no greasy feeling from this cream.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive skin, and these pads don’t give my face a stinging sensation. I use these pads twice a day, and they have helped brighten my complexion. Also, I’ve gotten less acne since using these pads.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I would recommend this sunscreen.   It has a vrey pleasant fragrance and feels velvelt soft on the skin.  It’s easy to apply and absorbs quickly.  It lasts long on your skin.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This creme is all it’s said to be. It hydrates your skin. My skin has been brighter. It has been super soothing for winter dry skin.  I am enjoying the results of this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This creme is all it’s said to be. It hydrates your skin. My skin has been brighter. It has been super soothing for winter dry skin.  I am enjoying the results of this product.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I was impressed with everything! I loved the smell and how soft if feels on my skin. It also feels so light on the skin. I felt an saw improvements almost immediately. Everything about this product is just so soft. I am obsessed with it.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this eye cream! The Advanced Night Repair range does not disappoint. The soft feel and texture is amazing. It also has a very soothing effect after application. I will buy this.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really like this cleanser, except for one thing: it smells horrible!! I know it’s made for sensitive skin, so they don’t have any fragrance to upset any ultra sensitive folks, but UGH! It is a great cleanser though; it washes off makeup easily without stripping away your skin’s natural moisture. If the smell could be improved, I’d never look at another cleanser again.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample with a Sephora purchase. It’s really not that great as a cleanser. It’s very creamy when you squeeze it out of the tube, but if you don’t get the right water and cleanser ratio, it’ll feel like paste on your face. My face feels tight and dry after I use it as well, but I don’t feel like it totally cleanses my skin. I try to double cleanse with an oil based cleanser beforehand, or I use a good toner afterwards. Finally, it smells really strongly of lavender, which isn’t bad, but not my favorite smell either. I feel there are much better cleansers out there for better values, so this will definitely not be something I purchase.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So I will admit that I am a Glow Recipe fangirl, and will try every new product that comes out because I usually love them. However, the plum serum was a miss for me because it was like putting water on my skin that evaporated in 5 minutes. THIS product, on the other hand, is absolutely amazing. It’s very light and almost like a jelly, but sinks in easily and leaves my skin soft, smooth, and bouncy in the best way. Also, it doesn’t take much and it spreads like a dream, so I feel you get your money’s worth. I’m a nurse and have crazy combination skin and maskne, and this helps my skin recover so much when I use it after my 12 hour shift. This is definitely one of my new staples in my skincare arsenal.

reviews.review_text: This is my very favorite first cleanse, and I’ve tried quite a few. It doesn’t irritate my eyes when I use it on my eye makeup, and my face feels so smooth once I rinse it off. I’ve never had an issue with it clogging my pores either. Make no mistake, this is only a first cleanse, so you’ll need to follow it up with another facial wash once you rinse this off. Also be mindful that if you are sensitive to scents, this product may affect you. I personally find the tropical scent amazing, and it doesn’t cause any issues with me. Overall an excellent product!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely adore this product; it has been my go-to since right before the pandemic, and has saved my face from maskne in the best possible way. It is wonderfully moisturizing and hydrating without being thick and greasy, and I have never had an issue with it clogging my pores. It is scented and smells absolutely divine, so keep that in mind if you are sensitive to fragrances. Absolutely hands down a holy grail product for me.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this product, I’ve seen a huge difference with consistent use.

reviews.review_text: I received this sunscreen complimentary in exchange for my honest opinion, and I absolutely love it! It is lightweight, dewy, and oil-free while still protecting and hydrating my skin. I like to wear it under my makeup everyday. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.review_text: I received this sunscreen complimentary in exchange for my honest opinion, and I am so glad that I did! It is lightweight and oil-free, and it lasts a long time. I like that it feels like it is hydrating while protecting my skin. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.review_text: This serum was complimentary of Influenster for my honest review. This is such a gorgeous serum! My skin drinks it up and it balances my oils and redness. Super light weight leaving my skin so soft  and hydrated!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this complimentary of Influenster! I was beyond excited! This serum is beautiful and applies like a dream. reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Such a light glowy serum. Niacinamide has always been my favorite ingredient! This leaves my skin plump, hydrated, while achieving that glowy/dewy look. With the beautiful, subtle shimmer shift of pink, Uber makeup it holds so well and looks so Natural!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Great for anti-aging and skin clarity!
reviews.review_text: I received the Good Genes complimentary from Sunday Riley. This is my second product from them. My first is the Tidal Cream which I adore. Good Genes is another winner. My skin feels so much smoother and dare I say more youthful looking after using this treatment. My fine lines are less prominent. Definitely notice an improvement in clarity and evening out of my skin tone. Acne scars/marks are slowly fading. Most of my pores are around my nose but I haven’t really noticed a change in that area. I highly recommend trying Good Genes if you are able to! All in all great for anti-aging and skin clarity!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_title: New permanent addition to my routine!
reviews.review_text: I was gifted the Plump Plump Hyaluronic Serum complimentary from Glow Recipe. This is my product by Glow Recipe and I can tell it won’t be my last. The winters are cold and my home is very dry as a result of cranking up the heat hence I’m a fan of hydrating products. I love applying the Hyaluronic Serum after washing and toning my face. I make sure to apply the serum while my face is still damp for maximum effect. My skin feels plump and hydrated. It a nice light serum that layers well with other products. Love how I can blend it with Vitamin C products which I have to have in my daytime routine. I can see myself using this all year round!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: The new Floral Recovery Calming Mask a luxurious mask infused with various floral extracts to soothe and hydrate dry skin. This is a saviour for angry skin; whether my skin is super dry or suffering from maskne! Depending on how my skin feels I either use it as a wash off mask or leave it on overnight and wake up to calmed and most importantly hydrated skin! I know I’ll be using this all winter!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Love the Unseen Sunscreen because it doesn’t leave a white cast!

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Love the Unseen Sunscreen because it doesn’t leave a white cast!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I have incorporated this product into my daily skin care routine and have been using it nightly for a week. I would normally wake up with some morning under-eye puffiness, but with this product I don’t have any of that. My under-eye looks brighter and feels hydrated. Be sure to wear SPF after using this product. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes, but would definitely purchase again.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This night cream is decently hydrating, but I did experience  an increase in oil on my skin when I woke up. The product was light and spread easily. Good moisturizer for the price point, but could be more hydrating since it is a night cream. I’m not likely to purchase in the future.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Overall a good product, but I would not recommend for oily/breakout prone/combination skin. The fragrance seemed to irritate my skin and leave small breakouts. Once I stopped using the product, they cleared up. If you’re more sensitive I suggest trying a sample first. The hydration wasn’t anything special, you definitely get what you pay for here.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Moisturizes and plumps skin. I didn’t see any drastic benefits from this product, but it was hydrating. If you’re looking for drastic changes in your skin, I’d invest in a different serum.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love everything about this cream. The push down dispenser makes for mess-free and measured application, which is key because this cream is EXPENSIVE! It has a light fresh scent and feels refreshing on application. Easily absorbed into the skin. I use this as a daycream.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: I love the texture and feel of this mask. It has a pleasant scent. My skin looks glowy and dewy afterwards and feels silky smooth. I received this product free through Influenster.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I chose this as a free sample last time I ordered from Sephora because I had heard and read rave reviews. I have very sensitive and acne prone skin so I have trouble finding effective exfoliants which are gentle enough for my skin. This did not disappoint. I liked it so much I ordered it immediately! I like how you can control the “grittiness” depending on how much water you use. I’ve also mixed it with my Avene cleanser. Expensive, but a little goes a long way.Updated On: February 12, 2020I have now used this twice a day with my regular Avene cleanser for almost 3 weeks. My skin is super clear and soft. I really think this is worth the price tag.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely moisturizer. It’s perfect for my sensitive skin. It layers well under makeup. I like that it’s clean. Only thing I would say is I do not like the packaging. I find it kind difficult to get off if my hands are even the tiniest wet or greasy. I received this product for free via Influenster Canada.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I had the strangest experience buying this product, but it was worth the wait. My first jar arrived empty. I thought I was just having a ridiculously hard time getting the pump to dispense, but I took it to my local Sephora and the associate opened it up to find it completely empty. So that was awkward. The manager had a new one shipped to me, and now I look forward to using it every day.I mix it with Umbra, B-Hydra and C-Firma in the morning, and with TLC Framboos and B-Hydra at night. (Shaba for day, C-Tango for night.) It also mixes nicely with D-Bronzini and a couple drops of marula if you’re refreshing your face for the evening.I love the smooth texture, both of the product and of my skin after I apply. It applies like a dream after you rinse off Sukari (add a pump of B-Hydra and two drops of marula for a sleep treat).I use this product as kind of a bridge between all of the DE sets I have. Lala feels a bit heavy for me, so I sub Protini where others might prefer Lala, or where Lala was included in a set and not Protini.Highly recommended and will be a staple in my routine. Looking forward to figuring out when to use this with Passioni.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_title: No pilling, no white cast, no scent
reviews.review_text: This was my gateway product to the world of DE. I wear this every day. I apply a cocktail of Protini, C Firma, B Hydra and Marula when I get out of the shower, pat on a bit of Shaba around eyes, then after a few minutes top with Umbra + D Bronzi. It sounds like a lot, but it’s just two steps because you don’t need to obsessively layer to avoid any pilling. Others have mentioned a scent, or that this formula is mattifying/drying, but I have not found either of those things to be true. I love it!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: What I love about this is how easy it is. One pump mixed in my Umbra is perfect for everyday wear. No streaks, no orange, no transfer. The full-size pump dispenses more than the mini (or it seems to) so I had to adjust accordingly. The mini lasts forever, so this should last me the rest of the year, I’m guessing, even with daily use.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Does exactly what it says it will
reviews.review_text: I read the reviews here and wonder if some are DE haters just hating. This cleansing balm does what it says it will do: melt makeup. And it does a really good job of it. I have combo skin, but have been using the DE routine for a couple of months now, so my skin is actually more like normal at this point. I have used cleansing oil before (Josie Maran) but never a balm. The biggest issue I’ve had with this is figuring out how much to apply. I used way too much the first time I tried it, and too little the next time. I’ve got my “Goldilocks“ amount now and I’m very happy with it. I don’t wear a lot of makeup so I mostly wanted to use this to really melt away sunblock and pollution from the day. I love that it does not leave my skin feeling tight in any way after I rise it away. I can opt to skip additional moisturizer and just apply my retinol or glycolic after using it. With the DE Beste jelly, I always need to moisturize right after I cleanse. I really think I will appreciate this even more next winter and maybe use it less frequently as the weather gets more humid, but either way it’s a great tool to have in the toolbox depending on what my skin needs.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_title: ALL IN ONE sunscreen / foundation/ concealer
reviews.review_text: Saw this on Tik Tok and I had to give it a try to see if it lived up to the hype. IT’S LITERALLY A MIRACLE WORKER! A tiny bit goes a long way and it masked all my redness. Didn’t need a 10 step makeup routine with concealer, foundation, primer, and sunscreen - this replaced all of that into one. I will continue to use this as it’s saved me so much time to get ready in the morning for my WFH zoom calls, I just wash my face, moisturize, then gently pat the color correcting treatment over my face and boom ready! Praying it doesn’t clog my pores but so far haven’t seen any additional oilyness or clogging so seems promising!

I’m convinced I’ll stick with this cleanser for the rest of my life. FABulous!

reviews.review_text: At first I was a little skeptical, but I really enjoyed this product. I used it during the winter months, it kept my skin hydrated and looking soft. the size of the bottle is worth the price. Most def reccomend it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: At first I was a little skeptical, but I really enjoyed this product. I used it during the winter months, it kept my skin hydrated and looking soft. the size of the bottle is worth the price. Most def reccomend it!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really liked this face wash! Kept my skin feeling very clean without feeling dry! Doesn’t smell like anything!! great for my sensitive skin

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I love these pads!!!! They smell like maple syrup in my opinion haha but it doesn’t bother me. they have really helped with the texture of my skin and calm down my breakouts!

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this product. It has really lightened my dark spots and acne scars. I use this at night because it is a heavier oil, in my opinion.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this product. It was really cleared my acne without drying my skin

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I really loved these! I tried them for a few days and had no issues. my skin did start clearing up and it didnt dry out my face like some other peels. I am buying more because I really like them!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: My pores have been a little out of control lately so when I received this product, I was super excited to try it. My pores have definitely minimized, which is amazing! I love the way the serum smells and feels on my face. My only issue would be that it dries my face out a bit. My skin has a tendency to dry quickly and I was hoping this had more moisturizing features as well. I loved it overall though!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My face is very dry so I was eager to try this out and see if it truly would work for my skin. So far, I have no complaints! I wake up and ky skin feels moisturized and hydrated. The lotion does not smell weird and goes on pretty nicely. Will keep using!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have extremely dry skin and this product has helped from the very start that I got it! It makes my skin feel super soft and it doesnt feel too heavy. It also feels nice when I put makeup on over it. A lot of lotions make my makeup look horrible so this was really a nice surprise.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: Great scrub. I like that the scrubbies last unlike some scrubs where they dissolve in the first few seconds. I feel like it gets my skin super clean. And it smells really good, like a light lemon scent. My skin looks much brighter and refreshed after using.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product in a complimentary voxbox to test and review.I love the way this feels. I put it on before bed and I wake up and my lips feel so soft and hydrated. The texture is so smooth, I love it.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I received this product in a complimentary vox box to test the product and review. It made my skin feel smooth and hydrated. I used at night and during the day under my makeup.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product in a complimentary vox box to test the product and review. I like the product, has a nice scent and absorbs nicely. I used it at night and under makeup. It is very very watery, I’m surprised it’s called a serum.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Most moisturizers I’ve used have felt really sticky and weird and have really done nothing to my face. The Magic Cream felt smooth and smelled great. My face felt smoother and healthier after just one use. I will use again. Thank you Influenster and Charlotte Tilbury for sending me a complimentary sample!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product in a Vox Box from Influenster. I gravitated toward it because of the bright and pretty little bottle it was in and because of the Coconut Water of course. I love Coconut Water and love the scent of coconut. I usually use moisturizers and they make my acne even worse, so I usually stop using them. This moisturizer is not like other moisturizers I’ve used. It isn’t sticky like a lotion. It goes on smooth and clean. And my face drinks it right up! It gives a noticeable difference in look and feel. My face seems like its glowing. It feels great when I put it on and leaves this great feeling. I will use this little sample bottle until the last drop and might even purchase a bigger bottle! I have never found a moisturizer that didn’t feel weird or make my acne even worse until I found this one! Thanks Sephora and Influenster!

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I like the packaging. I like the smell. It did make my skin look more radiant (in my opinion). I just didn’t really like the way it felt in my face. It felt sort of sticky and a little greasy. I don’t think it’s really helped my acne, so I don’t think I want to use it anymore.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I still can’t believe that I received this complimentary from Influenster! The package is SO CUTE! And it is so informative! I love it! It feels great when I put the product on my face and I feel like it makes my skin look great as well!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I still can’t believe that I received this complimentary from Influenster! The package is SO CUTE! And it is so informative! I love it! It feels great when I put the product on my face and I feel like it makes my skin look great as well!!!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Noticed a difference overnight! I’ve been using for a few weeks now and it gets better and better. Very lightweight but my skin has never felt smoother or more moisturized.  It is a bit pricey but a small pump goes a long way. Love the packaging. Smells refreshing and clean.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I never knew how dull and clogged up my skin looked until I started to use this product! Overnight I noticed a difference in clarity around my nose and cheeks. Now after about 3 weeks of using this my acne is clearing up beautifully. My face is so smooth, clear, and radiant. I don’t even want to wear foundation because of how beautiful the glow is from using this. I have been searching for the perfect skin exfoliant treatment, and now I’m never going back! Absolute perfection! (The smell is a bit strong for those of you who are sensitive to smells, but I promise its worth it. And it fades in about 10 minutes)

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Smells lovely, nice texture. Unfortunately did nothing to improve my skin in terms of moisture, texture, or appearance. No negative changes, but none positive either.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Smells lovely, nice texture. Unfortunately did nothing to improve my skin in terms of moisture, texture, or appearance. No negative changes, but none positive either.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing. I’ve been using it once per week along with this brand’s Marula Oil and honestly my skin has never looked more clear and fresh. My acne scars are improving and the overall tone of my skin is becoming even and smooth. I personally did not have an issue with the “tingling” or “burning” sensation that others reported. However I don’t have particularly sensitive skin, and I am only using once per week!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Never once in my life have I been complimented on my skin. I’ve always had acne, rough patches, oily buildup around my nose, etc. Started using this product and was getting color matched for a new foundation when the artist says “your skin is just so glowy & beautiful”!!!My jaw dropped! That same week a coworker asked what I use for my skin. I swear it’s all because of my new skincare routine including this! My face is baby smooth & the clarity of my skin tone is unbelievable. Picture is with absolutely no makeup. Thank you Farmacy!!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: The only product I have rebought over and over and over again. It’s a primer, it’s a sleeping mask, it’s a everyday moisturizer- it’s amazing. I hope they never ever ever discontinue.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: The only product I have rebought over and over and over again. It’s a primer, it’s a sleeping mask, it’s a everyday moisturizer- it’s amazing. I hope they never ever ever discontinue.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I use this morning and night after cleansing. I feel hydrated, my skin is plump and clear- if I get too much sun, I know this will be my saving grace to avoid peeling! Love it. Will keep buying into the fall!

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Great way to start anti-aging regiment on eyes!
reviews.review_text: I can see this working after two weeks of twice-daily use. Less dark pigmentation and less puffiness for sure! I bet it will work even better in conjunction with an eye cream- any suggestions on what eye cream I should try? I’m 27, normal skin (drier in winter, oilier in winter), and work long hours in the office.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I have no idea how these cute little stickers work, but whenever I cap a whitehead - in any stage of development - with one of these for the night, in the morning it’s gone. LOVE these!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This is so easy to use and it isn’t too greasy on the skin and isn’t irritating either. It protects my skin very nicely and feels quite effective as well. I definitely recommend giving this a try.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I really love how convenient this is and how easy it is to use. The product is unscented and it does not irritate the skin at all.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_title: not worth the super high price
reviews.review_text: Alright so to start this off, let me say that this is my first time using a Tatcha skincare product, and I’m pretty much impressed. Considering this product costs well around 70-80$ dollars, the quality was ought to be good. I’ve incorporated this product into my nighttime skincare routine, and it’s been working very nicely. The ingredients list looks very good and the moisture that this cream provides is also very nice. It can be the slightest bit greasy depending on your skin type, but otherwise it’s lays freshly on the skin. I personally have combination skin, meaning I have an oily t zone with the rest of my face dry. This did do a good job of moisturizing, but have I seen any long term effects or changes yet? Not really as much. However, I absolutely LOVED how soothing it was and how gentle it was. It was a pleasure to try this product out though, but I would personally recommend another cream in place of this that works way better and is substantially lower in terms of price. I’ve written a detailed review about that product (Keys Soulcare Skin Transformation Cream) as well, and I recommend you check it out!

reviews.review_text: This is the best moisturizer I have found for my body. It absorbs quickly & leaves my skin feeling so soft. The price tag is a bit on the pricey side though for how quickly you will run through it.

reviews.review_text: Love this moisturizer, it absorbs quickly & does not leave my skin looking shiny. It works well under my spf as well.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample & only used it twice because I felt like it was clogging my pores.

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I tried using this product twice & each time it made my face red/irritated. It also feels sticky after it dries. I’m glad I received a sample of this & did not purchase the full size.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I tried using this product twice & each time it made my face red/irritated. It also feels sticky after it dries. I’m glad I received a sample of this & did not purchase the full size.

reviews.review_text: This product is amazing. I wish I had decided to try it sooner. It’s very moisturizing, & absorbs beautifully. The consistency feels somewhat thick, but my skin absorbs it instantly. No scent, no sticky residue like I’ve experienced with other products. I will continue repurchasing. If you have dry skin, you won’t regret buying this!

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this serum, & it did result in a noticeable difference in my complexion over the last 7 months. However, the difference was not significant enough to repurchase. My skin looks a bit brighter & more even, but it did nothing for my dark spots.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: Messy & stung when I applied my normal products afterward.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: Messy & stung when I applied my normal products afterward.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive, combination, & acne prone skin. This stuff though is a miracle. It does not dry me out as I was expecting, but rather deeply exfoliates (it feels a little uncomfortable the first few times / minutes) and I can SEE the difference. This is the only skincare product, especially a mask, where I can tell right away I’ve done it. Love love LOVE this mask and will never buy another. Do yourself a favor and try it out, especially for such a killer price.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: Combination, sensitive, and acne-prone skin. I love this product. It is perfect for nights I don’t do their AHA/BHA mask for less intense but still obvious exfoliation. Huge difference in my post-acne dark marks in just a week. I will never buy another toner - so cheap and use once daily so lasts forever!!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This is truly a life saving little bottle. I have been struggling with acne for years and this addition has made life so much easier. I am on tret. as well, so need to be careful in terms of dryness, but so long as I lather on a moisturizer I’m fine. I recently went from using this once to twice a day and even in winter it is not over-drying. It is working both at keeping my acne at bay (minimizing pores and preventing breakouts) but also seems to be helping my hyperpigmented scars heal up as well. Love love love.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This worked great for me! After lathering on thick creams for my combination skin in winter I was worried it wouldn’t do enough for me, but a little goes a long way with this. Very impressed with the finish as well - moisturizes but leaves me looking matte more like a primer. Give it a second to soak into skin otherwise definitely worth it especially to get a HA product at this price!

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_title: My results were on par with LaMer Soft Cream
reviews.review_text: I can’t believe what I am about to write... The results are on par with LaMer soft cream. I have the most sensitive, Rosacea skin and LaMer became the only lotion that would calm my skin, until I tried this. I put it over Amorepacific Vintage Single Extract Essence and my skin is super happy. Crazy soft, my pores are smaller and the redness is reduced. I’m super happy with this!

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: This works great. I use it at night on my nose and when I wake up, my pores are tighter and blackheads reduced. — Gives zero irritation, skin is smooth and soft for make-up application the next day. This one really works. I’m in my 40s with combo/sensitive skin.The accompanying toner in this line is amazing too.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_title: Great Exfoliation - Clears for Make-up Application
reviews.review_text: This is scary messy to apply, but it worth it. 10 min and your skin is baby soft. Works as good or better than DE Baby Facial which costs $80.00 - This is a new staple for me.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I have struggled with rough patches from rosacea on my cheeks for so long that get worse every year. Got a sample of F-Balm and by morning I had smooth skin. My make-up went on so nicely, it was amazing and I have tried EVERYTHING. So, I purchased a jar of F-Balm, hopeful it would not be a fluke. My skin still loves it and my rough patches are GONE.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am in love with this product. I live in Arizona, so I need all the moisture I can get. This toner / moisturizer combo is so amazing. Instead of drying the skin like most toners, it adds moisture and it feels sooo good. Be bottle is nice and Minimal, looks great with my other skincare products (if that’s something you care about)  I did receive this product for free in exchange for an honest review, with that being said, I would defiantly be buying this myself. The product is amazing, and the price is great as well

reviews.review_text: Product was Gifted by GOOP beauty.I was very excited to receive this product. Especially because I love Gwyneth Paltrow. The pads are nice love the little finger pocket. It’s a double sided which is also a bonus. However when I apply them to my face they are extremely tingly it’s actually a little bit more of a burn than a tingle. It doesn’t last very long but it can be a lot at first. I haven’t noticed any brightness to my skin but it does feel softer. Was really hoping for more, especially for the price

The scent is unique, and it comes in a nice glass container. Totally recommend.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this cleanser! Removes makeup well and I love the light exfoliation. I do agree with other reviews about the packaging. Needs and upgrade, you either get too much or not enough

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this cleanser! Removes makeup well and I love the light exfoliation. I do agree with other reviews about the packaging. Needs and upgrade, you either get too much or not enough

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I think this is mostly for people with mature, or dry to normal skin. I have oily skin with red spots around my nose, blemish scars, minor fine lines around my mouth and forehead and usually clogged pores on and around my nose area. I feel like this mask might have enhanced my flaws. It stung a tiny bit and wasn’t exactly tingly. Its brown, and doesn’t smell nice or have a cool consistency to it. Don’t get it too close to your lips or mouth because it tastes toxic! After washing it off I noticed a softer smooth skin consistency but that’s about it. The pump is choppy and difficult to use. I don’t like having to use 4-5 pumps just to cover my face. I didn’t notice any significant difference in my pores or fine lines. Maybe I need to use it a couple more times. I’ll keep using this product since everyone is swearing by it. I just don’t know if this is suitable for oily or sensitive skin. I can’t decide if it’s worth it. I feel like a good exfoliator or serum can do better than this. I hate returning things all the time, but unfortunately this might be going back. Seems like Drunken Elephant products might not be for me. Two stars for the softness and smooth effect so far.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using Crème de la Mer for years and had stopped when I couldn’t afford to splurge. Now, i highly regret using other moisturizers and serums because this is really a miracle all-in one cream. I’m obsessed with the texture, and you won’t find anything else like it. It’s the richest cream I’ve ever felt! A tiny dab goes a long way. It smells luxurious like a fresh dewy marine scent but it’s very subtle. It applies like butter and leaves your skin plump and silky hydrated. I use it all over my face, my neck, and under-eye contour area. My makeup applies perfectly smooth and holds up longer than with regular moisturizer, serums, or primers. It doesn’t irritate my adult acne or clog my pores. it actually has a smoothing effect on my pores and I’ve noticed my blemishes and redness decrease when I use Crème de La Mer. It’s the type of cream that you’ll become addicted to and look foreword to in you’re skincare routine. I really can’t live without it, even though I’ve gone “clean” and cruelty free—I can’t give this up! It’s magic. The 0.5 jar would last me 3 months or so and I’ve finally invested in the 1oz because it’s totally worth it.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: It smells just like the mask (herbal almost vegetable like), and I’m not into the scent—but it’s a good cleanser. I like that it’s simple, natural, and non-drying. It foams up nicely with my Philips Visa Pure electric cleansing brush. It removes my makeup and doesn’t leave any trace or buildup. The 8oz bottle comes looking like it’s less than the amount though, the top is half way empty and has air inside. You have to pump the dispenser a couple times before it will pull through—but it does. I’m just suspicious if it’s really 8oz or not. This is definitely an everyday cleanser, unless you’re sensitive to smells. It doesn’t irritate my acne and it leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean with no tightness. I love doing away with harsh chemicals and soaps.
