reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: This is great! I wanted something highly effective for my skin as I’m reaching my 30’s and this is it. I‘ve tried a lot of other Tatcha creams and they didn’t really suit my skin concerns. I have oily-combo and hormonal acne skin that is starting to show fine lines and loss of firmness (yikes). I’ve already noticed instant brightening and a plumping effect from this serum. This is a more affordable version of those high end medical and designer serums and I love that Tatcha is cruelty free and “clean”. Two pumps cover my entire face and neck and it doesn’t leave any sticky residue or build up pieces like other serums do. It has a light citrus scent but it doesn’t linger or irritate my acne either. I’m loving the results already and I’ve only been using it for about two weeks so far. I can already see some minimization of my acne scars and fine lines. I highly recommend this product and all of the Violet-C line.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is great! It goes on smooth and silky and leaves your skin dewy, not oily or full sheen. My skin has a bounce and moisturized feel. It doesn’t irritate my acne or cause breakouts and clogged pores. I’ve tried The Watery creme and it wasn’t enough...I also tried The Indigo face cream and it just wasn’t cutting it for what I needed in my routine. I’m glad I gave in and bought this because it accompanies the Violet C serum perfectly for my routine. A little goes a long way and it’s safe to use around my eye area too. There’s not much of a scent that I notice and I’m really sensitive to scents and added perfumes. I had no issues with this underneath my full cake makeup (I use the Huda FF Foundation with NO primer). This seems to be the best of all the Tatcha creams imo, and The Silk one doesn’t even seem as nice as this one does!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Totally overpriced and does the same as products that cost three times less. I kept it near my bedside and used it at night hoping it would be a game changer—or at-least work like a mask. It isn’t really more than a lip balm, however it doesn’t moisturize as well as it seems it will. After an hour my lips were back to dry and scratchy and felt tighter. The only great thing about this is the scents and packaging. It’s comparable to scented Vasealines.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It smells okay until it touches your skin…then it reeks like burning oil for some reason but it fades. I don’t notice much moisture and it takes a while to sink in. Even when it seemed to be absorbed, it left a film-like feel on my face that made me look like I just applied a heavy silicone primer. It pills up like crazy when I try to smooth it out again and leaves tiny rubbery pieces on my skin that I have to pick off. I don’t like anything about this cream besides the fact that it doesn’t break me out and made my skin look okay…but a drugstore cream can do that! Good thing I got the trial set. There’s absolutely nothing youthful or powerful in this jar for me and my 30something skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It smells okay until it touches your skin…then it reeks like burning oil for some reason but it fades. I don’t notice much moisture and it takes a while to sink in. Even when it seemed to be absorbed, it left a film-like feel on my face that made me look like I just applied a heavy silicone primer. It pills up like crazy when I try to smooth it out again and leaves tiny rubbery pieces on my skin that I have to pick off. I don’t like anything about this cream besides the fact that it doesn’t break me out and made my skin look okay…but a drugstore cream can do that! Good thing I got the trial set. There’s absolutely nothing youthful or powerful in this jar for me and my 30something skin.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I liked the amount of moisture this gave and it was easy to use. I didn’t have to paste layers on for the effect. The scent is floral but not good—imo it smells off. It reminds me of a Dior product gone bad. It feels very calming at first like a heavy duty moisture cream. After it settles it says you can blot the rest dry or blend in? It feels too greasy like I put Vaseline body lotion on my face. I suppose that means it’s moisturized, but I don’t think you should rub the rest in and wear it like it says. This completely CLOGGED my pores to the point I had to do a full T-zone extraction immediately! And I never need to do that whatsoever. I couldn’t believe what I was seeing. Every single pore in my T-zone had a thick white head on it! It was totally the mask because it resembled the same white color. I tried cleansing and using a scrub but they were still very noticeable. Makeup could not hide them. This didn’t work for me, but at first it seemed like a nice floral mask because I like all the Fresh masks. Sure there was some redness reduction…because the WHITE chalky ingredients suffocated my pores to funky whiteheads. Maybe this could work for someone in their 20s with dry skin.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: It smells great, looks good, feels good…works okay. Doesn’t remove mascara much. I like the European Bio brand one best—to compare—for the price I couldn’t seem to buy a full size of this. Milky for sure but no worthy price for me.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: It smells great, looks good, feels good…works okay. Doesn’t remove mascara much. I like the European Bio brand one best—to compare—for the price I couldn’t seem to buy a full size of this. Milky for sure but no worthy price for me.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is by far my most favorite moisturizer I’ve used. It sinks in so nicely to the skin, doesn’t leave me greasy, but still is so hydrating. It feels so nice going on and the packaging is great. Not having to dip your fingers in to a tub is so wonderful, I wonder why any other brands still even do that. I can use this product morning or night. At night for some extra hydration, I’ll add 2-3 drops of marula oil mixed in. I let my brother (who takes care of his skin the best way a college football player can) try it once, and now he sneaks in to my room to steal it *eyeroll*. I’ve repurchased this maybe 3 times by now and I don’t see myself switching to a different moisturizer any time soon!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This has been an absolute game changer for me. I first tried it when I purchased a littles kit. This was the product I knew I needed to have a full size of right away. It has completely changed my skin. I use it every night in combination with other DE products. It never broke me out or had any “getting used to“ period. My pores are noticeably smaller (they’ll never disappear let’s be honest). I no longer have a nose full of blackheads. My breakouts, which rarely occur now, heal so fast. My skin is glowy and feels so, so smooth and soft. I like this product so much that when I hear strangers talking about skincare I can’t resist to but in ad tell them about this product. My only recommendation would be to make sure you use a good moisturizer after this. I use DE Protini when it’s more humid or hot or DE LaLa Retro when my skin is dryer or the weather is colder, and add a few dropsof marula oil mixed in. If you’re considering trying it, just do it - you can always return if for some reason you don’t like it! I buy it once in the fall and once in the spring (when the sales occur!) and never run out.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I’ll start off by saying I am not typically a lip balm/ chapstick user. However, I got this in one of the sets and fell in love. It goes on so nicely. I apply this every night before bed, and assuming the weather isn’t insanely drying out my lips, it keeps them nice and soft. I sometimes wear it through the day, and appreciate that it gives my lips a nice shine, has no strange taste or smell, and wears really nicely as it sinks in. I never feel like I need to wipe it off before I eat or drink, like I sometimes do with other lip balms. I’ve repurchased this product and will continue to unless I come across something better, but for now, this is it!

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I had previously been using the Clinique Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm (went through a few containers), but figured I’d try this one since I’m a big fan of DE and needed to restock anyway. This one wins for me. The Clinique balm broke down my makeup effectively and washed off just fine with water, but always left my eyes and contacts blurry for a while. This one has all of the good parts, and more! First, DE is clean at Sephora, Clinique’s is not. This balm has a great texture that melts very easily when warmed up between my fingers. Melts my makeup effectively and takes all of my waterproof mascara off with no problem. I rinse with water, and follow with DE’s Juju bar face wash. My skin is so soft, radiant, and clean after. This balm doesn’t blur my eyes at all, or leave a filmy residue as some makeup removers might, it’s awesome. The packaging coming with a scoop is a bonus as well and magnetizes to the lid. The bamboo booster included I’ve only used twice, mixed in with the balm as directed, and it was a great physical exfoliant to easily add in to my normal routine, really great if you feel like you need a good scrub or have a thick layer of makeup on. Really, really recommend. Hope they make it in a smaller container for traveling!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Perfect for spot treatment as it dries my breakout within 2 days but not really beneficial for entire face.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Honestly, I like ordinary but I don’t really like this product. I feel like it’s sticky and made my face to have acne. However, for the price point, it may be a good hydrating serum.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This toner is really effective and affordable! It’s a helpful product in my routine to use every other day to help with my whiteheads and blackheads. It doesn’t feel so drying and uncomfortable.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: It’s super lightweight and smoothing for under eyes. Actually my friend was using another sensitive friendly eye serum product and he got red patch under his eyes! And when I gave him this to use, red patch disappeared in 1-2 times use! So, I really believe it’s a good product.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I tried this moisturizer in a mini size in a set; The texture is gel and lightweight, however, it got super oily on my T-zone especially my forehead even though I have combination skin not to oily the few times that I used it which I really didn’t like. I also didn’t like the smell personally; it smells kind of like a mixture of mint and rose water. I didn’t feel so moisturized nor plumped/glowy.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I loved this overnight lip mask!! I’m bite my lips every day since forever! Unfortunately I can’t stop it, however, I put a lip mask at nights on them so to restore them and make them feel better! I use this lip mask and it works perfectly fine!! I love it! It restores and heals my lips overnight, it’s rich and smooth in texture, and a little goes long way! I apply it with my lip brush and gives me luxurious feeling haha

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free gift from Influenster and I am so glad i did. I love all Clarins products and was excited to try this out! Its definitely gentle on the skin while leaving it refreshed and hydrated. It has tumeric in it, which is an excellent anti aging property. Over time, it claims to decrease signs of aging. I’ve been looking for a new anti aging serum to try at night, so I’ll definitely be buying again!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Another amazing Belif product. This is so hydrating and I’m so excited to use it for the cold winter months. A little definitely goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this moisturizer as a complimentary gift from Influenster and I am so glad I did. I love Estée Lauder products and this one is no exception.  It’s super lightweight and hydrating. It leaves my skin looking refreshed and radiant. A little goes a very long way.  Definitely worth the splurge.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this moisturizer as a complimentary gift from Influenster and I am so glad I did. I love Estée Lauder products and this one is no exception.  It’s super lightweight and hydrating. It leaves my skin looking refreshed and radiant. A little goes a very long way.  Definitely worth the splurge.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this as a gift from Influenster. I love this brand so I was excited to try this moisturizer. It’s super hydrating and light weight. A little goes a long way and it sits well under makeup. Definitely recommended.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I struggled for years to find the right cleanser for my skin but this my absolute holy grail!! I have combination skin and this improved my skin within the first week of using it.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this product. It smells SOOOO GOOD! And it is super duper hydrating. Absolutely would recommend for all skin types.

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: Smells like heaven, perfect packaging and a great price. One stick can last a month if not longer. By far my favorite lip balm out there and I am an avid lip balm user. If you like the smell of the bum bum cream then I can guarantee you will also love the smell of this balm.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: So far I am loving this toner! I have combo skin and I have noticed a big change in my dry areas! I was a flaky mess on my chin and cheeks and my skin has definitely improved since I started using this.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Baby facial is the perfect name for this! After using my skin feels the same way it does when I leave the spa. I’m really impressed.

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water
reviews.review_text: I was so surprised it didn’t smell at all! This is the 1st time I put on tanner and my husband didn’t notice. The color is also even and really pretty. I sprayed then used a mitt to rub in. Perfect for summer.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Soooo great! I absolutely love this. I even stopped wearing foundation. I have been mixing this with my moisturizer and it looks so gorgeous and natural! I will def be buying again once I run out.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this! Very hydrating and pretty. Also it smells wonderful! Just what I needed for spring. I bring it with me everywhere.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I’m not prone to breakouts but I head some enlarged pores on my nose that I wanted to look less noticeable. I tried this overnight. Not only did this do nothing but I got 3 zits on my nose the next day. All places where the strip was sitting. I usually get 1 blemish a week around my chin so this was definitely this patch. I wouldn’t risk using this and I would never recommend. One of the blemishes is really bad. This is a dud.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: My go to lipbalm. I tried all FRESH sugar lip balms. Lovely, hydrating, smells wonderful. Only thing is - never bring it to the beach or leave it in the car! It melts and/or breaks while you are applying it!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: My lips are always dry and they just get worse over the winter time. I actually use this as an everyday lip-balm - before I go to sleep, I apply lipstick, and during the day. So hydrating and it builds a layer of hydration on my lips!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My favorite morning cleanser. It makes my face so smooth and hydrating. Love the smell and texture. Perfect for morning use. I don’t use this for the night though - it just doesn’t erase all my waterproof makeup - which is one disappointing thing.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: Works for some. Doesn't work for some.
reviews.review_text: It worked like a wonder for the first couple months. And then, it stopped working - my skin didn’t get worse or better. So sad, I don’t know what has happened. It just plateau on my skin. I stopped using it for last two weeks. I still don’t see any changes. I have dry combination skin with acne breakout during my hormonal week.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Perfect for winter. Hello Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this creme. So hydrating and thick enough to survive this horrible winter and yet, not pasty like other ones. I love the smell. It just wakes me up every morning with its texture. I just love this Vitamin C line products!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the smell. I love the texture. .... But it didn’t do anything on my skin. I have dry combination with frequent acne. No change - better or worse. I loved the cream, so this was a disappointing news.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: The Korres Santorini grape poreless skin cream is amazing. It’s a gel type texture. It’s hydrating & Lightweight at the same time. It’s a little thicker than most gel type creams. It has a light scent which is pleasant & not overpowering. It applies so smooth on my skin & works well under makeup. It checks all the boxes for my needs.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This Shiseido oil free sunscreen is lightweight with a slight tint so that it doesn’t leave a white cast. Has a pleasant scent but not strong & doesn’t linger. This sunscreen feels great under make-up. Very easy to reapply.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: The Shiseido Fresh Moisture with hyaluronic acid is my favorite sunscreen so far. It’s a little on the thicker side, has a pleasant scent. Gives so much moisture you won’t believe it’s a sunscreen. You can feel the hyaluronic acid when smoothing onto your skin.  I can apply this as a moisturizer with sunscreen as a bonus protection.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received the Clinique Smart Cream from Influenster for free for my honest opinion. I’m really enjoying this line. I have now tried the cream, eye cream, & serum from this same line. All are phenomenal. Work well with my middle age skin. Keeping mey skin hydrated all day. My skin is glowing. Has a slight scent but packs a serious punch. Continuing to use the sample wasn’t enough for a 2 month review to see if I’m seeing true results. I’m definitely noticing my make-up applying better daily.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: High quality eye cream that actually works! This lightweight eye cream brightens under my eyes and has helped with my dark circles.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this skin treatment. I thought that it made my skin appear more even and brighter. After about 3 days of use, I noticed a difference in my skin.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: I liked this eye stick. I thought that it was ultra hydrating on my under eye area and was super easy to apply. I stored mine in the refrigerator so it was cooling on my skin when applied.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this essence. I thought it was hydrating and lightweight on the skin. It didn’t irritate my skin and make my skin more oily as I have combination skin. The bottle is super pretty too and feels lyxurious.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this essence. I thought it was hydrating and lightweight on the skin. It didn’t irritate my skin and make my skin more oily as I have combination skin. The bottle is super pretty too and feels lyxurious.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Nothing even gets close in comparison
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this for years.  I’ve tried others, but they just don’t come close to giving the same smooth, even appearance and foundation lasts and stays fresh so much longer.  I find that silicone primers don’t hold make-up nearly as well and some actually seem t repel other product.  This also goes a very long way.  I usually don’t care for fragrance, but it a has a light fresh citrusy scent which is nice and fades away after application. One caveat is that on really hot, humid days, I stick to one layer of either product or foundation.  Otherwise I just sweat it all off and waste a great product and the money spent as well.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_title: Great results!  Pricey but in this case worth it.
reviews.review_text: This is a skin saver. There’s no other resurfacing mask I’ve tried with the exception of a professional facial that clarifes my skin like this does.  Definitely closer to “baby-skin“. I have very resilient medium fair combination skin.  If you’re skin is sensitive, my guess is that you would have to be very judicious with application and less frequent use. One caveat is that the pump can get clogged with dry product.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Love, love, but oh-no, the fruity scent
reviews.review_text: I chose this as a reward, and really like the consistency & the results of this cleanser.  It feels creamy but has a little frothiness to it which I like.  My skin feels hydrated and looks calm (no red irritation) after use.  However, the scent for me is really strong - like a fruity kids cereal.  That’s why I gave 4 stars or I would have rated it a five.  I’m torn as to whether or not I will purchase it after my sample is done.  I would have loved the scent as a teenager.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Love, love, but oh-no, the fruity scent
reviews.review_text: I chose this as a reward, and really like the consistency & the results of this cleanser.  It feels creamy but has a little frothiness to it which I like.  My skin feels hydrated and looks calm (no red irritation) after use.  However, the scent for me is really strong - like a fruity kids cereal.  That’s why I gave 4 stars or I would have rated it a five.  I’m torn as to whether or not I will purchase it after my sample is done.  I would have loved the scent as a teenager.

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: Very effective! I chose this as a reward, and highly recommend it.  After sweeping with a gauze pad, my skin felt smooth but not tight.  While I am not a fan of anything with a scent, this is kind of citrusy and refreshing.  I have medium light, very resilient skin.  It has a bit of a tingle, and I would suggest being gentle with your application.  I see one review where someone used this twice a day.  Even with pretty tough skin, I wouldn’t start that way.  I would suggest using it in the evening and then apply treatment or hydrating sleeping mask after.  If you have sensitive skin, I’d start with every other day and alternate with something hydrating.  I will probably buy this once I am through with the generous sample.  Definitley give it a try if you are looking for an exfoliating toner.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: Very effective! I chose this as a reward, and highly recommend it.  After sweeping with a gauze pad, my skin felt smooth but not tight.  While I am not a fan of anything with a scent, this is kind of citrusy and refreshing.  I have medium light, very resilient skin.  It has a bit of a tingle, and I would suggest being gentle with your application.  I see one review where someone used this twice a day.  Even with pretty tough skin, I wouldn’t start that way.  I would suggest using it in the evening and then apply treatment or hydrating sleeping mask after.  If you have sensitive skin, I’d start with every other day and alternate with something hydrating.  I will probably buy this once I am through with the generous sample.  Definitley give it a try if you are looking for an exfoliating toner.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Took years off the appearance of my eyes!!
reviews.review_text: New Holy Grail eye cream! When I say I have tried every eye cream on the market I really do mean it. From drugstore all the way up to la Mer, even prescription creams. Nothing has ever wowed me like this one. It goes on cool and you can immediately feel the intense hydration. It’s not thick or sticky like some eye creams, just silky and hydrating. I wear this at night because even an hour later, my under eye area is still moist! I wake up and my eyes are refreshed and hydrated. Now for the amazing part- I have used this cream for 3 weeks straight at night, not only do my eyes feel hydrated and amazing - but they look that way too. Seriously, In three weeks I have noticed a significant reduction in fine lines and wrinkles! It seems to have taken years off my eyes. I just turned 51 and I swear my eyes look younger than when I was in my 40’s. I just bought a back-up in the Sephora sale because I never want to be without this eye cream.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: This was what my skincare regimen was missing! I have used this Dior Skin Perfector for almost a month and I can definitely say the texture of my skin has improved, which is amazing in a primer product. I have mature (I’m 51) dry skin and this product seems like it was made for me. I use a light moisturizer and apply this in place of a primer. It goes on beautifully and sinks right into my skin. Next I apply a Lancôme stick foundation and it glides over my skin beautifully thanks to this Dior Skin Perfector. With the Dior Skin Perfector underneath my Foundation I get a slightly glowy finish, which at my age I love. I lost my glow many years ago so something that helps bring it back is a WIN in my book! I do see that my skin stays hydrated throughout the day (dewy - not oily) and make-up lasts the whole day with this Skin Perfector. There is a light scent (roses?) but I don’t mind it at all and it fades pretty quickly. All in all, I will be adding this to my morning regimen for many years to come!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: These are my little miracle dots! I’m 51-years-young (LOL) but I still get pimples on top of my wrinkles. The joys of aging, amiright? So I get these hormonal bad boys - the big painful bumps under the skin -  on my chin or cheeks. I slap one of these stickers on my bump before bed and I kid you not - my bump is either gone or almost gone in the morning. I have tried other brands of these dots - COSRX, murad and more and none have come close to being as effective as these. Now my 14 year old son is starting to get pimples and he is grabbing these too. They work just as good on his young skin as they do on my more mature skin. And if you like the gross factor - when you peel them off your bump - you can actually see the gunk they drew out of your skin. My son LOVES this part!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: The only eye cream for my 53-year-old eyes!
reviews.review_text: I’m 53 and I’m fighting this whole aging thing as much as I can with just skincare and an occasional facial. No shade to those of you that do more, just not for me. So it’s no wonder that the first thing I look for is a good eye cream. The eyes are the first thing that tell your age, in my opinion. I’ve tried every eye cream from la mer to drugstore searching for a winner. But I may have finally found my winner in Clinique. I’ve been testing this Clinique eye cream for about 4 weeks now and I’ve seen a difference in my dark circles AND my fine lines! YES! Holy smokes usually an eye cream gives you one or the other but this one has improved both! I use this at night and it leaves a nice cooling sensation. It sinks in to my skin beautifully and I’ve had no irritation. I wake in the morning looking a little more refreshed and plump under the eye area. Consider me a convert!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Pretty standard hyaluronic gel moisturizer, it does what it claims no more no less. I can see this being too light weight for winter use, I have normal skin.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I am a cleansing balm attic. I’ve tried cleansing balm’s from drunk elephant, Clinique, Sunday Riley, farmacy and this is one is on par with my fav one from farmacy! The Reason I love it so much is because it is easy to rinse off without leaving in oily residue. Ever since I started using cleansing balm’s and oils to remove my make up I found that I needed to follow with a double cleanse because of the oily residue left by it afterwards. I don’t find that I need that with this texture and it is just as effective at removing make up.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: Smells like limencello! Enjoyed this fine granulated texture. I already have ahas regularly incorporated into my routine but it’s nice to have an extra boost in the shower. I received this product from influenster for testing.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: Recieved this from influenster for testing purposes. I’ll start by saying that price is usually not a determining factor for my skin care. That being said I’ve stayed away from guerlain because of the scent in their products, I’m pleasantly surprised by the mild scent of this as well as the texture. It looks like it’s going to be oily but it doesn’t feel that way at all. Not quite sure how to describe it but you really have to try to understand it. So far so good!

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: Recieved this from influenster for testing purposes. I’ll start by saying that price is usually not a determining factor for my skin care. That being said I’ve stayed away from guerlain because of the scent in their products, I’m pleasantly surprised by the mild scent of this as well as the texture. It looks like it’s going to be oily but it doesn’t feel that way at all. Not quite sure how to describe it but you really have to try to understand it. So far so good!

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I have received a few other Ole Henriksen products to try before and really wasn’t impressed.  However, this one is a different story.  I love the packaging, smell and how the product feels on my skin.  I like to think the lavender color helps to even out some skintone issues.  The serum isn’t sticky or oily.  Sinks is pretty nicely.  I use this every morning before my moisturizer and I like how it is a natural retinol.  Definitely recommend and even though I received this product complimentary from Influenster, the review is my honest opinion and I actually just bought another bottle with my own money during the Beauty Insider Appreciation Event!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have used another Essence before from another brand and I wasn’t impressed with that one at all.  So when I got this one to use with another Tatcha product - I wasn’t expecting much... but man!  This one actually seems to do what it says it’s supposed to do!  After the first few times, my face was actually soft.  I like how this has a spout for you to pour the essence into the palm of your hand.  I highly recommend using this in conjunction with Tatcha’s other products.  Will be keeping this in my skincare routine!I received this product complimentary for an honest review.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have used another Essence before from another brand and I wasn’t impressed with that one at all.  So when I got this one to use with another Tatcha product - I wasn’t expecting much... but man!  This one actually seems to do what it says it’s supposed to do!  After the first few times, my face was actually soft.  I like how this has a spout for you to pour the essence into the palm of your hand.  I highly recommend using this in conjunction with Tatcha’s other products.  Will be keeping this in my skincare routine!I received this product complimentary for an honest review.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I was so excited to try this out as I have recently been a bit obsessed with Tatcha products.  Let me start with the pro’s:  I like the pump, the packaging is pretty, and after using this for 2 weeks - I can honestly say that I have seen a difference in my complexion.  I have been using this in conjunction with the Essence from Tatcha and I like the two together.  Now let’s get to the cons:  I only have one and that is - the serum is too water-y.  I wish it was a bit thicker so that I wasn’t afraid each time I pumped it out that it would slide out of my hands like water.  Totally a personal preference but that is the only downside to this.  Other than that, it was great - didn’t irritate my skin or anything.  Recommend!I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I don’t know why there are so many negative reviews. I actually loved this toner. I didn’t know what to expect since I had never heard of the brand before and didn’t know how they could make a hydrating toner. But ... they did!  First of all, the packaging is pretty cool. I like how the cap is designed. I’m all about aesthetics when it comes to packaging and I think Belif did a good job. For the toner itself, I don’t know how they did it, but they actually made a hydrating toner. It feels almost gel like and it does hydrate my skin. I did get this product complimentary for my review  - but I’m not getting anything extra for writing a 5 star review. Seriously, if you have dry skin - check this toner out.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have oily but dehydrated skin and I must say this is a great moisturizer during the winter months. It leaves my skin dewy; as implied, not oily. My skin appears healthy, and plump!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Does a wonderful job cleansing my sensitive, acne-prone skin. It doesn’t strip my skin of its natural oils but one star off for the glass packaging (not travel friendly). I’ve since transferred the liquid to a squeeze bottle, therefore, crisis averted.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Does a wonderful job cleansing my sensitive, acne-prone skin. It doesn’t strip my skin of its natural oils but one star off for the glass packaging (not travel friendly). I’ve since transferred the liquid to a squeeze bottle, therefore, crisis averted.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I mix this product in with my La Mer Skintint. It gives me a healthy natural glow.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Leaves my under eye moisturized and has helped with fine lines and wrinkles. Couldn’t be without it!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Initial Impression: The bottle feels really nice to hold and I appreciate that it isn’t in a plastic bottle. I pumped once for my whole face and the consistency is quite runny. I pat it into my skin and it absorbs well. It does not leave a sticky feeling to the skin. I will continue to use to see difference this product does to my skin. I enjoy niacinamide in my skincare routine so I have high hopes! This does contain a slight scent — very mild but we’ll see how I feel about it after my four weeks.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This cream is quite thick but blends out nicely. For me, it may be too much for my T-zone but I did see suggested to apply on the dry areas vs all over, if you are combo-oily. I find myself not really gravitating towards this cream because it is super moisturizing, but I can say how lovely this feels for dry skin - normal skin types. I apply this as a primer on my dry areas and the foundation application doesn’t enhance the dry patches. I quite enjoy the scent of this cream — I will describe it as a floral ..more rose type of scent that seems to perk you up without it being too grandma smelling.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: The Tatcha Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream is such a delight. I would say that this cream is very light on the skin. It has a built in serum like cream that just absorbs into the skin. It does take awhile to sink in completely. It does leave your skin looking dewy. It can feel a little too greasy in the morning, but I wake up to nice, healthy skin. This has a slight scent that isn’t artificial smelling. I do find it quite pleasant. I do suffer from redness and when I apply this after a hot shower, it does bring my redness down. I share this with my mom and she has been using this every night as well. I see more effects on her than on me. Her skin looks more plump and has more of a glow. She has dry to normal skin, so this works really well for her.Overall, I enjoy the cream and I appreciate how it comes with a Tatcha Scooper for hygienic purposes! I received this from Influenster but these are my honest thoughts

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_title: A bit pricey but I like it
reviews.review_text: I LOVE love the original aqua bomb and I have always wanted to try this vitamin C cream. I felt like this formula is just as good as the original. It’s light and refreshing with a subtle citrusy scent. This cream is packed with vitamin E & C with well known Lady’s Mantle herb that’s in their original formula. I would describe this cream as a gel-cream that doesn’t feel tacky. I love these types of formulas during the summer months. I haven’t seen a dramatic difference in my dark spots, but I have seen improvement of skin texture. My skin looks quite radiant in my opinion after using this. This was only a small sample that I have tried but it worked well on my combo acne prone skin!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff, keep lips moisturized and smooth with a kick of color. Pretty color!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love this product! Have purchased this lip therapy multiple times, keeps my lips moisturized and looking smooth for hours, I only reapply because I like the smell and feeling it makes my lips feel. Does help with smoothing over lip lines. Def recommend!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Finally a toner that actually minimizes my pores! Smells nice, and it is thicker than a regular toner, but I use a flat cotton pad and it works just fine to absorb on my skin. Skin looks & feels great from using this, and the Ordinary hyaluronic acid & buffet serums. No more dry spots on my chin or cheeks!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Finally a toner that actually minimizes my pores! Smells nice, and it is thicker than a regular toner, but I use a flat cotton pad and it works just fine to absorb on my skin. Skin looks & feels great from using this, and the Ordinary hyaluronic acid & buffet serums. No more dry spots on my chin or cheeks!

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This stuff works great! My skin’s dry spots have cleared up. If you put on too much, it takes a little bit to soak in. Use AM & PM, putting makeup on after is fine as it doesn’t pill under my makeup (powder or liquid foundation). Dry spots have cleared up FINALLY! Had them on my chin, cheeks and a small area on my forehead. Also use the Ordinary Buffet serum with this. If you don’t reapply, the dry spots will return but that’s the point of a daily routine is to wash off then reapply. Glad I found this line as I have spent way too much money on trying to find something to help with my dryness!

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: This stuff works great! My skin’s dry spots have cleared up. It is thick and a little goes a long way, but after I put my moisturizer  and makeup on its fine. Use AM & PM, doesn’t pill under my makeup (powder or liquid foundation). Dry spots have cleared up FINALLY! Had them on my chin, cheeks and a small area on my forehead. Also use the Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA moisturizer with this. If you don’t reapply, the dry spots will return but that’s the point of a daily routine is to wash off then reapply. LOVE IT!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Smells great, a little goes a long way, no issues and i have sensitive skin. Wearing under makeup and by itself.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: Super happy this serum is part of the clean at Sephora! It’s super light weight, and has a very very light fruity scent, feels great, paired it with my Codex moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: So light weight and smooths out so nicely. The smell is delicious, like fresh sweet peaches!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive eyes and did not experience any allergies or excess oil. The cream is light and isn’t noticable.

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: I was a little nervous about this being a gel moisturizer because they usually leave my skin feeling sticky or oily. This was not the case with this one. It left my face feeling fresh, moisturized and super clean. The smell is an added bonus, smells very good!! I wouldn’t definitely buy This or recommend to anyone!

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I really like this mask! It’s like a drink of water for your face and you can almost immediately feel the hydration. The smell is amazing as well.. very fresh and clean! My only gripe would be that when I received the product the gel side looked only half full - I received this product for free for my honest opinion, but If I had paid the $50 I would have been pretty upset that it wasn’t filled to the top. However, I will say that very little of this goes a long way so you don’t need much to keep your face hydrated over night and into the morning. I would highly recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Just OK. I’ve definitely tried other under eye serums that were much better - however, at this price point it is a great option and does the job! I use this either the Inky Hyaluronic Acid and vitamin C. I would suggest this entire combo. Ireceived this product for complimentary for testing purposes

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this!! I have been using it as a part of my Brightening routine, applying before Vitamin C Cream and the Caffeine Eye Cream. Using this as a part of the set has definitely made a huge difference.. I can already tell my sun spots are starting to fade! So glad I was able to give this a try before purchasing! I received this product free for testing purposes but I would highly recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I received a few samples of this product to try and I loved the way it feels on my skin, especially when you add the firming cream on top! It definitely left me wanting more to start adding to my skin routine. Wish I could tell a difference but with only a few samples I’m not able to really tell.. that’s why only 4 stars! Would definitely recommend trying the full size product for best results!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_title: A must for my beauty routine
reviews.review_text: this is by far my most favorite exfoliating product. It does an excellent job at removing all the dead stuff without over scrubbing (if that makes any sense). I use it twice a week and my face always feels smooth but not over dried. I love the plastic bottle, and its ease of use. It really makes for very little to no mess.I would definitely recommend this to family and friends

reviews.review_text: I love the way this felt around my eyes. It really helped with depuffing!!

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: My new favorite moisturizer! Feels great on my skin, leaving it moisturize but not cakey  feeling. Very weightless doesn’t feel heavy at all. My sensitive skin tolerated it amazingly.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Received a sample of this product. Noticed diminished crow’s feet within 2 weeks dark circles slightly better. But I’m a single mom and I don’t sleep a lot, so lol. Nice creamy formula didn’t bother my sensitive eyes at all. Definitely worth a try..

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really didn’t know what to expect because it felt so light but it was very moisturizing. The packaging is beautiful and the spatula is integrated perfectly on the container. I have noticed a difference with my skin and the more I use it the more it glows. I recommended this product to anyone with dry skin that doesn’t like heavy products!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I really didn’t know what to expect because it felt so light but it was very moisturizing. The packaging is beautiful and the spatula is integrated perfectly on the container. I have noticed a difference with my skin and the more I use it the more it glows. I recommended this product to anyone with dry skin that doesn’t like heavy products!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Pretty basic serum, nothing special or amazing. After you apply it, your skin does feel soft.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I didn’t know what to expect and I wanted to try it for myself. I have combo skin with hormonal acne during periods. This is a very thick creme which is great for the winter.I noticed my skin is so much softer and it controlled my acne which is awesome. The only CON is that you have to warm up the lotion on your finger tips.

reviews.review_text: THIS is Amazing!!! I notice a difference right away and if I don’t use it, my skin feels dry. I use it every morning and night after I clean my face.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: THIS is Amazing!!! I notice a difference right away and if I don’t use it, my skin feels dry. I use it every morning and night after I clean my face.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: I am currently 6 months postpartum and my skin had some hormonal changes. I had uneven skintone, acne and dry skin. I need something hydrating! Within 2 weeks of using this product my pimples disappeared and my redness was gone. After 1 week I was planning to return this but it started to work and now my skin is glowing again.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I received this as free sample. I love these peel pads. They are intense. You only need to do them once a week but what I like about them is that they’re inspired by professional chemical peels (and frankly, yield the same results!). This peel instantly exfoliates and brightens. and you wake up with noticeably smoother skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I received this as free sample. I love these peel pads. They are intense. reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Was gifted by Algenist . This is my first Algenist product but it won’t be my last one! I love the texture of this cream. No tugging and it feels so silky but not heavy. The skin around my eyes already looks smoother and my dark circles have brighter. I use a lot of great products, but this is my new favorite! This is the best eye cream I’ve used!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Was gifted by Fresh. The cream is luxurious. Makes my skin feel hydrated morning and night. It is the best skin cream I have ever used. Not to oily and last all day. It had a beautiful scent and you don’t need much. My skin feel as soft and moisturized as I always wanted.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Was gifted by Dermalogica. I love this product. The best exfoliator I have used that is gentle enough for everyday use. It makes my face feel really soft and your appearance brighter like all the dirt and dead skin are removed from my skin after using. It’s so gentle on my skin but highly effective at cleaning and reducing skin problems.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Was gifted by Dermalogica. I love this product. The best exfoliator I have used that is gentle enough for everyday use. It makes my face feel really soft and your appearance brighter like all the dirt and dead skin are removed from my skin after using. It’s so gentle on my skin but highly effective at cleaning and reducing skin problems.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Because of the price, I want to give this less stars but can’t because it’s worth it!  It’s very moisturizing, yet absorbs so quickly and never feels heavy.  My skin looks and feels so much softer.  A huge plus, a little goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Because of the price, I want to give this less stars but can’t because it’s worth it!  It’s very moisturizing, yet absorbs so quickly and never feels heavy.  My skin looks and feels so much softer.  A huge plus, a little goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: OBSESSED! I am a lip balm junkie. I have a drawer just for all of my lip products, it’s actually ridiculous.  But this has become my absolute favorite, absolute must have. I feel naked if I travel and forget it. It leaves my lips so soft, not sticky and makes my lips glow differently than others that I’ve used. Almost like a seductive natural glow? Seriously, I’m obsessed with this as well as the balms!

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I LOVE Algenist products, and this is a nice compliment to my nightly routine.  It leaves my skin feeling soft the next morning, almost cushiony? I especially love it for my neck which gets a little neglected. It is very expensive which is why I gave it 4 stars. I like Youth to the People Superberry dream mask which is half the price and works equally as well.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I struggled between 3 and 4 stars.  I’ve gone through 3 bottles of this and I can’t really see a difference. But to be fair, I use a lot of really great masks, so sometimes it’s difficult to tell which is doing what. So my review is based on what I noticed once I stopped using it.My skin isn’t as plump as it was, I don’t notice much visibly, more so when I’m applying products I can tell the way my skin moves. Not as much of a bounce back?I am a HUGE fan of Algenist, particularly the genius line so I trust the science in this product, but for the price I just don’t see the benefit how I had hoped.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: This mask is first of all super easy to apply and has a nice, not overpowering floral smell. It has a cooling effect on your face while it is on. My skin felt very hydrated after I washed the mask off. I would definitely recommend this product. This product was sent to me for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This is such a good serum. I love the consistency of the  product. I have been using day and night underneath makeup. It is great for sensitive skin and has not caused any breakouts. I can tell it has helped with any skin texture I had.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: I lot this micellar water! It is a thick milky consistence that does not leave a residue on your skin after. Removes all makeup and makes your skin feel very clean.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: I lot this micellar water! It is a thick milky consistence that does not leave a residue on your skin after. Removes all makeup and makes your skin feel very clean.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: Great product! First of all the packaging itself is very luxurious. It has a great smell that to some people could be overpowering but it does not linger. It leaves your skin feeling super hydrated and works well at night or under makeup. I have sensitive skin and this product has not broken me out. I am loving the results from using. I was sent this product for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: Great product! First of all the packaging itself is very luxurious. It has a great smell that to some people could be overpowering but it does not linger. It leaves your skin feeling super hydrated and works well at night or under makeup. I have sensitive skin and this product has not broken me out. I am loving the results from using. I was sent this product for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It’s very creamy and smooth; however, my skin soaked it up quickly and seemed to dry out more.  My face itched and just didn’t feel good.  I did mix it with another DE product (which they recommended), but I just didn’t like that drying feeling.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Great sun coverage.  However, it left my face very white after I had applied it and that was after I had rubbed it onto my face for a while.  Once dried, it left a white shine to my face.  Had to be careful around the hair line and rub in it very good there or lots of white was left.  Foundation went on smoothly on top; however, my foundation was lighter than normal because of the shine.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is the best cleanser I have ever used!  I use to use makeup remover wipes and then wash my face, and I would still have makeup residue left.  This takes it all off and doesn’t leave makeup behind!  I don’t use makeup remover wipes anymore (so in a way this will safe some money).  Use as directed; I use about a nickel size amount.  I do like to use the DE Pekee Bar afterwards but that’s just me...I feel like it adds a little moisture.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I use this eye cream at night!  I gave it only 4 stars because it does irritate my eyes if it gets in them.  I use this only under the eyes and in the outer corners.  I’ve tried using it on the lid, but that’s where I have found that it gets in my eyes and causes irritation (and in the inner corner for sure causes irritation).  Eyes feel very refreshed and hydrated in the mornings.  A little goes a long way, so I only use 1/3 of a pump for both eyes.  The cost maybe a little much for some people, but if you are only using 1/3 of a pump only at night the product should last longer.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Great night serum!  I’ve been using this serum a little over a month now, and I can start tell a difference on my forehead lines...they are appearing less noticeable to me.  My skin is starting to look a little more even in tone.  I do mix this with the DE marula oil.  My skin does tingle a little after using it, but the tingling does go away.  But I wouldn’t use it right before going to bed because the tingling is noticeable enough to keep you awake...it will stop tingling after a few minutes though!  Two pumps is plenty.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I mix this with the DE TLC night serum.  I can start to tell the lines on my forehead are diminishing, and the tone is starting to even out.  Absorbs quickly!  It’s an oil; however, it doesn’t leave an oily feeling behind.  Leaves the skin feeling softer.  I use three drops to my two pumps of TLC.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I love this serum, and I’ve been living off the samples since November (~3 months) and I would love to buy this, but I want to find a serum that is cheaper but has good results. It has evened out my skin, decreased the appearance of old scars from picking at acne (curse High school me), and my skin is glowing! It soaks in quickly, and a couple of drops is enough for your face and neck!

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_title: Okay; will find another that's a better fit for me
reviews.review_text: I got this as the sephora birthday gift last year (w/ the serum) and it’s okayyy: I will be trying out more moisturizers until I find my fit! This sinks in fast, it doesn’t smell bad, it’s not really sticky or oily, and I do wake up with slightly softer skin, but I just don’t feel like it’s as moisturizing as what I would expect from a moisturizer and when I apply it I don’t feel like my skin is all that nourished. I think this is better suited for sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I  received a small tube of this complimentary for testing purposes, and frankly this isn’t as expensive as I was expecting yay. I have sensitive skin that tends to break out when I try new products, and I didn’t get that with this. It’s a gorgeous, creamy lather, that feels silky on the face, doesnt irritate or dry out the skin, and makes the skin look matte. I didn’t notice anything drastic like changes to my skin, which is fine, it cleans my face that’s all I need lol. I would recommend! I especially love that it’s #cleanbeauty

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I would definitely recommend this! I have combo skin, and I was using the tinted sunscreen from this brand but it was really annoying and the tint would go on my mask. After I finished that I purchased this and it’s sooooo much better: the texture is more smooth because it doesn’t have that makeup feel (both are creamy though) to it, it also is clear and silky, almost like an oil without looking shiny (kind of like primer). I also am someone who cares about clean beauty so this is great. This has not given me any breakouts.I haven’t written a review on sephora in a long time but I really wanted people to look into this, buy this over the tinted version for sure. I haven’t used the matte version so I can’t attest to that.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer

reviews.review_text: I find it a good serum, it is light but moisturizing with a slight fresh scent that I think is good for those who are sensitive. It’s only been 5 days and I also use a gua sha tool after this serum twice a day. I like it so far!

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Judging by reviews I had mixed feelings about ordering this cleansing balm, it is exactly that. A BALM (think thick lip balm) further reading reviews I realized I’d give it a shot at my first attempt to start double cleansing and WOW. I just love this stuff! It’s packed full of good stuff, it definitely does help remove my full face makeup, waterproof, long wear and so on. I follow this with a foaming water based cleanser and my face immediately feels hydrated, fresh and Clean! The consistency of this balm is thick, identical to lanolin. I personally do not find it difficult to squeeze a bit of product out of the tube. My first time using it I soaked the tube in a sink filled with warm water and leave this in my bathroom cabinet. Unless you have extremely dry, flakey skin, I suggest using this as a double cleanser or else yes you will find your face has an oily film left behind.

reviews.review_text: I was skeptical about how much these Peace Out Wrinkles patches would really improve the wrinkles I have starting on the top of my forehead, but I was very pleasantly surprised! I’ve never used a skincare product that has given me such noticable results that quickly. These patches seriously help to nourish and plump the skin, leaving wrinkles way less noticable and my confidence increased! They are comfortable to wear and do not cause any type of skin irritation for me. I am so impressed with this product. I am definitely going to continue to use these and I highly recommend trying them out.

reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product. I have combo acne prone skin and I a lot of trouble with texture. It leaves the skin feeling refreshed and super hydrated and my face felt so soft and smooth afterwards. I appreciate that it didn’t leave a sticky, tacky feeling like many other serums do. This product is so nice. I would love to continue trying this wonderful serum out to see what the long term effects would be on the skin. It did not irritate my acne prone combo skin at all, which is a huge plus. I plan on purchasing more of this in the future and I would definitely recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m so impressed with the IT Cosmetics Confidence in a Cream! This stuff is really good and it makes my skin feel so soft, smooth, and hydrated. It is a very thick, rich cream but it absorbs nicely into the skin... it doesn’t leave my face feeling greasy or leave behind an annoying, heavy residue. Also, my skin can be very acne prone, so a huge plus is that this moisturizer did not clog my pores or cause any breakouts or irritation. I love that the IT Cosmetics Confidence in a Cream Moisturizer provides my dry, dehydrated skin the hydration it needs and leaves behind healthy looking, refreshed and smooth skin without any of the negative effects so many other heavy moisturizers have had on me. I have tried so many other brands and they often either cause breakouts, don’t provide enough moisture, or leave behind a disgusting feeling heavy residue on the skin. This stuff is awesome! I must also mention that a tiny bit of this cream goes a long way, so the full size tub will actually last you quite a while. I really have enjoyed using this moisturizer and have absolutely no complaints about it. I would definitely repurchase it and i highly recommend trying it out for yourself.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Youthful dewy glow with no breakouts
reviews.review_text: Algenist GENIUS sleeping collagenI waited a full 2 weeks to post my review as I wanted to make sure I was giving a complete review, not just an initial one. I also wanted to wait as I have acne prone skin in my 40s and I wanted to see if it would cause my skin to flare. I spot tested my neck for 5 days before using it on my full face. I cleaned my face, used the liquid collagen, then applied the Algenist GENIUS sleeping collagen before bed. Much to my relief, It did not cause a breakout flare (YAY!!) the cream goes on very smooth and light. (I did not wake up stuck to my pillowcase!) The cream smells the way it feels, light and clean. It does not have a medicinal smell, which my husband appreciates. It left my skin very soft in the mornings. After using the cream for a week, I noticed that my skin was much softer. I continued using the cream for another full week. After w full weeks using the cream, I noticed that my skin had a soft dewy glow and was incredibly soft. I hesitate to use the word radiant, but I will absolutely state that the Algenist GENIUS sleeping collagen cream gave my 43 year old skin a youthful, soft, dewy glow. I am a 43 year old, former sun worshiping southern woman with acne prone skin. I am an honest reviewer who insists on using a product long enough to form an actual, not just initial, opinion before I will review it.
