reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Pretty darn good. I’ve purchased basically the whole line of DE products and this is the one where I’m not *really* sure if it is that effective. I like that it is so light, so perhaps this will be more useful in spring than winter. For now I mix it with the Vitamin C serum and have had some good results.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This product really works. It does tingle at first when you put it on, but for me using it 1-2x a week is worth it. Immediately afterward and the next morning I feel like my skin is much smoother, and whatever is going on with it is soothed. Really a great addition to my skincare regimen.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Yeah, I am addicted to this oil. I have tried so many oils in the past and this one is just the best. I know that whenever I put it on, it is just going to improve whatever situation is going on with my face. It soaks in so well and is so rich without feeling greasy. The Marula is great because it has anti-bacterial properties for acne, and it is just so darn hydrating. This is my last step before primer and the rest of my makeup, and I really notice a difference when I don’t use this. It works so well mixed or layered on top of the other serums in the DE line and just makes a perfect canvas for other products. I love the entire DE range, but if I had to choose one this is truly the one that I couldn’t live without.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have been enjoying this as an additional part of my nightly routine.  I’ve noticed brighter and smoother skin and it smells really nice.  I’d recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster to share my honest review.  I’ve been using it for a couple weeks now and I like it because it keeps my eye area hydrated and reduces puffiness.  I’d like to continue using to see what else it can do.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this product and I’ve been loving it.  It feels great on my skin and it hydrates so well.  My large pores feel tighter and makes me look fresher.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: I like that this is super moisturizing but at the same time it makes my face look greasy.  I do like they way it feels and it smells good.  I just need to powder more when I use it.  If you have dry skin you’ll love it.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer rejuvenates my skin and gives it a lively glow. I have oily skin ---this product does not exacerbate this issue.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I have struggled with acne, dry spots, uneven tone --this serum combats my acne prone skin/uneven texture without drying out my skin. I apply several times per week at night.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I top off my skin care regimen with this product-it feels so cool and fresh on my skin and leaves a dewey glow. I have oily skin and this product does not make my skin more oily

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_title: Lay the groundwork for healthy, glowing skin!
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this product. I use it every other night (had to easy my skin into this and actually started with 1 x weekly, with gradual increase in use). It goes on so smoothly and I have noticed improvement with regards to my uneven skin tone/texture, pimples/clogged pores. My skin is more vibrant and has a glow-I have had several people recently ask me what foundation or makeup I have on to which i reply, “ No makeup, it’s just drunk elephant!“

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: Extra strength alpha beta peel is awesome
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a sample and after 3 treatments- my skin felt radiant and clear. Recommended

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: My skin is softer, hydrated, and healthier.
reviews.review_text: “Crime de La Mer”is a thick luxurious face cream with a light fragrance. I warm a pea sized amount for a few seconds on my finger tips- a little goes a long way. I lightly press it into my face and neck- impressed with how soft my skin is! I’m seeing a difference in that my skin as it is  healthier and hydrated. It is a bit pricey but worth it because you do not need too much! Spoil yourself.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: My skin is softer, hydrated, and healthier.
reviews.review_text: “Crime de La Mer”is a thick luxurious face cream with a light fragrance. I warm a pea sized amount for a few seconds on my finger tips- a little goes a long way. I lightly press it into my face and neck- impressed with how soft my skin is! I’m seeing a difference in that my skin as it is  healthier and hydrated. It is a bit pricey but worth it because you do not need too much! Spoil yourself.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This thick anti aging facial cream has a faint scent and has luxurious feel on my face and neck.  It seems nourishing and my skin feels moisturized and lifted. Love the extreme moisture and glow face has after using this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This thick anti aging facial cream has a faint scent and has luxurious feel on my face and neck.  It seems nourishing and my skin feels moisturized and lifted. Love the extreme moisture and glow face has after using this product.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Lovely serum for hydrated and glowing skin
reviews.review_text: I was so excited to try this “magic” serum by Charlotte Tilbury and was pleased with the overall benefits from this product. The glass bottle and dropper are nice and my skin really drank up the serum. There is a scent to this product that I rather enjoy- I noted that the scent lingers but it is not overpowering. I use this product in the morning and evening after I wash my face and before I use my moisturizer. I did notice that my skin feels nice and hydrated after using this product.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I had to purchase this product after the rave reviews, this guy is huge hit for many, but personally I didn’t see any results from using this consistently. I felt the sting, but after use my skin looked the same, and this is quite an intense product. I have some bad redness on my cheeks, bumpy forehead and some dullness and dryness, so maybe this wasn’t the best match for my skin type, and for the money it wasn’t worth the investment.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this guy, my skin is incredibly stubborn and chooses to ignore most products I try. I struggle with small bumps, dry patches and redness. This stuff actually works, I was beginning to give up hope after nothing would make any difference. I noticed that it reduced redness and helps with my bumps. The one thing to note is that it melts into skin instantly so evenly spreading the correct amount around the face is difficult, so sometimes I feel I apply too much. Make sure you wear SPF when using the product because I believe it can make skin sensitive to the sun.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried at least a hundred cleansers and nothing seemed to make any difference for my stubborn skin. I struggle with redness on my cheeks and dull uneven skin tone and this stuff is the only cleanser that I can see and feel a difference. It leaves my skin soft and smooth. I quite enjoy the scent, and it doesn’t create a huge lather which I actually appreciate. My skin can be sensitive and it did not react at all to the fragrance, which is very light and pleasant.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: No secret that this guy is such a massive hit. It works like absolute magic, even makes your lips look fuller and completely smoothes them and makes them totally soft

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I had high hopes for this product but unfortunately it caused some bad bumps on my face, my skin is relatively sensitive,nothing crazy but it had a bad reaction to this. on top of that, it wasn’t even that hydrating, its very light and silky but didn’t do much and my skin is normal to oily.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Price tag is wild but totally worth it. Despite it being an oil its not oily, it sinks into the skin and does not create greasy skin. It makes your skin glow in the morning and totally works. the best facial oil I’ve ever tried

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I’ve bought this product a few times and wouldn’t hesitate to go back (currently trying new products). It’s creamy and hydrating and works well under eye makeup. I can’t say it’s outstanding on mitigating fine lines or dark circles though, if that’s your concern.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Moisturizing, gives a nice tint, and smells good!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Used this for 9 weeks thinking the new pimples and whiteheads on my cheeks were purging. Changed the frequency from every other day and kept lessening it to once a week to once every other week. Still caused pimples! :-( It’s been 2 months since I stopped using it and I’m still trying to remedy my skin :((

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Bought this on a whim as I was looking for a good hydrating night moisturiser. Still unsure what this really does, but it does calm my skin, doesn’t break me out, and is hydrating enough. I always wake up with soft skin when I use this. I like the little spatula that came with it, too, for hygienic purposes!

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Bought this on a whim as I was looking for a good hydrating night moisturiser. Still unsure what this really does, but it does calm my skin, doesn’t break me out, and is hydrating enough. I always wake up with soft skin when I use this. I like the little spatula that came with it, too, for hygienic purposes!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: I own this in the pink shade and loving it so far—esp when I want hydration/moisture on lips with a bit of tint when I’m lazy to put on lipstick.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Really nice eye cream! Most eye creams slightly irritate my eye area but this one is the best I’ve found. It occasionally tingles, but is much better than anything else I’ve tried! It has a barely there-delicate floral scent and a little bit goes a long way!!!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free and I’m so glad i did! I see why this is called magic! Did it get rid of all my skin concerns (acne ans wrinkles), no. But it did really help my irritated skin. My skin is somewhat sensitive and sometimes moisturizers can really sting-the did not. I loved the consistency of the formula, it’s very rich but also light and doesnt give a heavy feeling.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_title: Beat out my ride or die
reviews.review_text: Yes yes yes! I’m an aquaphor devotee and everything else usually pales in comparison. But I think it’s been beat! I’ve been reaching for this every night and it keeps my lips so hydrated and lush that I often skip lip balm in the morning cause I do t really need it. Also I haven’t had any clogged pores right above my lip

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: BUY THIS! I don’t know where to start with all the things I love about this cleanser, there are so many! This is the creamiest, foamiest most luscious cleanser. It’s got the best feel, perfect scent, and really leaves you feeling clean without being stripping.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: Okay, so let me tell you about this freakin’ serum! I got it as my birthday present and I was kind of disappointed. It didn’t seem like a “fun“ birthday product. But I decided to try it and... wow. I noticed results INSTANTLY. This moisturized my skin, and really made it more radiant... glowy... without being oily. And I’m a combo-to-oily skin girl! But this is proof that you want to be adding moisture to keep your skin healthy, instead of taking it away. The little size lasted for about a month. I’m dying to buy the full size but the price is keeping me at bay. I DO think it’s worth the price, but this isn’t one of those one-time purchases. The moment I commit, I’m going to want to keep this in my routine forever... gulp.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: This is the first Caudalie product I’ve tried so far that I don’t love. I have combination skin and it makes my face feel dry and itchy all day long. I’ve tried it on its own and with a few different serums to see if that helps but no luck. At least it smells nice, but I was very disappointed.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I didn’t want to like this product, but it’s SO GOOD!!! Rich, delicious moisturizer that looks lovely and smooth under make-up.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I haven’t loved a cleanser this much in years! Smells amazing, exfoliates gently, and helps clear skin. I removed one star because the packaging makes it a little hard to get product out.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I haven’t loved a cleanser this much in years! Smells amazing, exfoliates gently, and helps clear skin. I removed one star because the packaging makes it a little hard to get product out.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Nope. Sad this didn’t work, because all other Drunk Elephant products I’ve tried have been amazing. But this one was too heavy, oily, and left a gross film on my skin. It broke me out, too. The Farmacy one is much better. Giving it two stars because it smells nice and it feels good as you are using it, even if I don’t like the results.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really didn’t want to love this moisturizer because the full size is so pricey but my God, it’s SO GOOD! I love the *experience* of using this moisturizer, as it really does feel luxurious and smells great. It almost… relaxes me? While I put it on my face. Looks fantastic under make-up, too! Smooths my skin and acts a bit like a primer.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Really helped clear my skin. Good ingredients and the price is reasonable. Love it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Really helped clear my skin. Good ingredients and the price is reasonable. Love it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this lip mask. I use it night and day. Very soft, not oily or sticky, smells nice. I bought this lip mask and the tatcha one and I definitely like this better.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I really like it, but it’s a little too sticky. More of a lip gloss look than a balm. I love that it has clean products, since lip products can end up in your mouth.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Not worth 50 Dollars. I bought this after the amazing reviews on youtube but its just alright. I didn’t feel any great improvement. Won’t repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Not worth 50 Dollars. I bought this after the amazing reviews on youtube but its just alright. I didn’t feel any great improvement. Won’t repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Instant Brightness! I use this in the morning and it acts as a primer for me. Glowing skin right away.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I really like this toner so far! It has a nice sweet smell, and as soon as you apply it you feel a little tingle. Not a bad tingle, it just feels like it’s working. I have been using it for a few days now and I can already tell a difference in the brightness of my skin. Great addition to my nightly routine! I got this product complimentary for a test run.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: So far I really like this mask. It’s really gentle on the skin, it doesn’t burn or anything, and I feel like my skin was a lot smoother after. I’d recommend giving it a try! I received this product free for testing.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this cream so far! I have been using it for about 2 weeks, and I have had great results. The only reason I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars is that it took a while to soak in and left me feeling a little oily, but when I woke up the next morning my face was super soft and bright.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love love love! It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling super soft. Also love the smell. Highly recommend for anyone on the market for a new moisturizer. Especially in the winter when my skin is super dry. Try it!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: This mask is the real deal if you have acne prone skin like mine. I use it multiple times a week with no irritation and notice improvement in my skin immediately. It also works as a great spot treatment! Leanne it on spots overnight! Just beware it dries before your head hits the pillow. I received this mask to try for free for testing and I’m so happy I did, it’s amazing!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: BEST skincare product out right now, hands down.
reviews.review_text: Wow wow wow. If you spend money on ONE skincare product, this is it. I am so happy I tried this and even more happy with the price for the results you get. Using this it tingles at first, but go to sleep and prepare to wake up amazed. My skin was literally GLOWING and soft as a babies bum. It also takes care of zits overnight. I have hormonal acne on my chin and when I use this the pimples are nearly gone in the morning. Honeymoon glow also helps with redness, it completely evens end out your skin tone. Of all the exfoliating serums I’ve tried, this is the golden ticket. It moisturizes while exfoliating. I have sensitive acne prone skin with combination oily and dryness, honeymoon glow tackles all of that for me. HIGHLY recommend this for just about any skin type. Just start out slow 3 times a week. Also put it on right after cleansing and beat not to mix with any other product until it’s settled into your face for a bit. Then if you need, put on some night time oil or moisturizer. I don’t mix it with anything because for me the moisture it provides my skin overnight with the hyaluronic acid is perfect!

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_title: Like a Morning Facial in a Bottle!
reviews.review_text: Absolutely LOVE this serum. It does exactly what it says: evens out skin tone, plumps, makes your skin look fresh and “awake” minimizes fine line, and so much more. My acne scars and redness are so much more reduces since using this, and I have a lot. I also have sensitive skin, and this doesn’t irritate it a bit. I feel like just a week of using this has made my skin look younger. It can feel sticky, but I don’t mind it. Makes my skin feel soft and stronger as well. And makes me go from looking tired to bright eyed and bushy tailed. I use it in the morning after cleansing and using an AHA exfoliating toner, then I let it sit for at least 10 min on my face before applying my moisturizer. HIGHLY recommend this, i know the price is hard to swallow, but it really is a perfect day serum. A little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Wont leave any makeup or dirt behind, LOVE THIS
reviews.review_text: This is an awesome cleanser. No left over makeup after washing with this which is what I’ve dealt with from other cleansers, is have to wash my face twice to get everything off. Also this does what it says and is very moisturizing so your skin doesn’t feel stripped or anything. Love love love this cleanser. Only downside is it’s pricy for the size but whatever it gets my makeup off in one wash, that’s worth it to me. Also has a great scent and it non irritating to sensitive acne prone skin like mine.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I could notice a difference in one use but especially after two uses. Leaves skin so soft and help keep my large pores clear and my skin smooth. Does sting slightly and momentarily if you have any blemishes/open areas but is not irritating at all. Worth the price!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: The best cleansing balm I have ever used. Warms up in hands quickly and foams up nicely with the addition of water. Rinses clean and product lasts a while. Will be a repeat purchase for me.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: The best cleansing balm I have ever used. Warms up in hands quickly and foams up nicely with the addition of water. Rinses clean and product lasts a while. Will be a repeat purchase for me.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: Great addition to my night routine. Beautiful application that just glides onto your skin. Plumps skin and makes me look refreshed in the morning. Worth it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: Great addition to my night routine. Beautiful application that just glides onto your skin. Plumps skin and makes me look refreshed in the morning. Worth it!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
reviews.review_text: Great addition to my night routine. Beautiful application that just glides onto your skin. Plumps skin and makes me look refreshed in the morning. Worth it!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Best eye cream out there. Yes, it doesn’t dry down all the way and is a bit creamier than others but that is the beauty of this. Truly moisturizes and helps prevent wrinkles. Unfortunately, I purchased another eye cream to try and instantly regretted it. Will switch back to this as soon as I finish the other cream!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Ordered this bc of the amazing reviews. I will say that it really does make your skin feel baby soft and smooth. I am still, however, waiting for my skin complexion to improve but I have been spotty with the 2x a week usage, so I am hopeful if I really stick with it that I’ll see results. It surprisingly didn’t burn me as badly as some of the other reviews say. That said, if you do have an open blemish/redness on your face, this is where is burns, but only for a few seconds. I am able to leave on for the full recommended time.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: super hydrating. get on the waitlist.
reviews.review_text: Love this. It is really hydrating. Makes my skin look fresh and supple. Great for those dry winter months, and the other 3 seasons. I use it in the AM and PM, everyday.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: Buy it now. or get on the waitlist.
reviews.review_text: Really amazing toner. My forehead looks like the skin of a 12 year old. It’s unclogged those hard to unclog pores on my nose and chin. I use this at night and the salicylic acid in the AM. These two babies have really helped clear up my skin. Totally worth it.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: This is my second purchase of this stuff and I love it. I will say, though, that my first bottle was quite watery, and like some of the other reviews, I didn’t like it at first but given the price point, I made sure to use the whole thing. I did notice a change in my skin tone and texture with consistent use and now I’m obsessed with it. Skin is clear, smooth, even and supple. Just got my second bottle and the consistency is different, more like a gel, which I like a lot better, just hope the results will still be the same!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Absolutely in love with this product. I’ve been on the hunt for quite some time for a new cleanser that would leave my face clean and not strip all the natural oils in my skin. This product definitely achieves that and more. Definitely found my new staple in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Absolutely in love with this product. I’ve been on the hunt for quite some time for a new cleanser that would leave my face clean and not strip all the natural oils in my skin. This product definitely achieves that and more. Definitely found my new staple in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I had my doubts but really wanted to give it a shot after seeing all the positive reviews. I suffer from oily, acne prone skin and recently had a bad breakout before my period on my cheeks as per usual. I tried this mask out and just the next morning saw a difference in my skin. I’ve since now used it twice with the Ordinary Glycolic Toner and my face is dewy and clear and my pores are smaller. Literally obsessed with this stuff and it’s def going to become a permanent part of my routine!

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This stuff is really great. I’ve noticed a huge change in my skin since starting use. I will say though that it stung pretty badly on my acne areas. I was breaking out right before I started my period but this stuff along with the mask has cleared it right up. Only reason I’m taking off a star is because the color of the toner is not as pictured? It’s more pink / orange

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff! It’s so great and for the price you cannot beat it. I used the Peter Thomas Roth serum for a while and this stuff is better and way cheaper.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I received this product free for review, I just love the moisture in this cream its thick yet not sticky or uncomfortable, brightens my under eye area.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Looooooove how this makes my face feel! I had tried the toner and the lip balm from this specific rose line so I new I had to try this one and it has been great my skin absorbs it so nicely. I would definitely purchase this over and over!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Lightweight! Doesn’t leave a white cast and very moisturizing! I use it in the mornings and before my makeup routine and it has been wonderful. The packaging is so cute and it doesn’t have a sunscreen type smell. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Like every other fresh product I’ve ever tried they do not disappoint, not only is the packaging stunning but the way it makes my skin feel and look is delicious fresh and plump, moisturizing without it being greasy! 10/10

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This has a very similar texture as the moisturizer - not too thick, not too thin. Using the Youth Preserve Moisturizer each morning and this face cream at night has definitely helped hydrate my skin so I don’t need to use as much moisturizer in the morning. Also, I do have mild acne, but haven’t had any breakouts since using their products, so that’s always a plus! This is definitely a great nightly moisturizer/face cream! Oh, and it smells AMAZING!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is literally the PERFECT texture! Not too thick, not too thin. I normally have to use a heavier duty moisturizer around my mouth/chin because that area gets drier than the rest of my face, but after using these products for a few days I didn’t have to anymore! Also, I do have mild acne, but haven’t had any breakouts since using their products, so that’s always a plus! This is definitely a great daily moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I was pleasantly surprised by this sunscreen! I have dry-combo dehydrated sensitive skin, and although this does lessen my redness, it makes my skin dull and is hard to spread. I also feel that it’s not moisturizing enough, and that there’s more cons than benefits. Would not be using this again.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best face moisturizer I have ever used. I have dry-combo dehydrated sensitive skin and have tried several brands such ad Dr. Jart, Fresh, Drunk Elephant, Laneige, and more, and none of them are good enough. This moisturizer makes my dull skin glow and it soothes my skin, making it smooth, hydrated, and less red. It decreases my sensitivity, making my face brighter and more radiant. And another plus with this moisturizer is, you only need a small amount for your whole face, which is kind of rare with face moisturizers. This is totally worth of its price. I have found my holy grail moisturizer!

reviews.review_text: I have been using this for about 2 months now and am obsessed. My face looks and feels smoother, I haven’t had any breakouts (where I typically get 1-2 big ones a month), and my pores really look smaller. I will say, the first time I used this I almost returned it. After I washed it off my face was really red and hot and looked sunburned but it went away the following day. I left it on for 30 mins the first time - so don’t do that! Now I only keep it on for 20 mins but if it’s your first time I would only leave it on for 10-15 mins and then work your way up to 20. Worth every penny and lasts a long time!

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I started using this after beginning to use tretinoin. I was looking for something that would add an extra kick of moisture to my skin and help with the flaking and irritation...This does exactly what I hoped it would. It’s very reasonably priced, you get a lot of product (mine is going strong after 3 months of use), and it’s good packaging. I use 6 drops at night, mixed in with my moisturizer. This has cleared up my skin, gotten rid of dry patches. If you don’t mind going to sleep looking like you stuck your face in butter, then you will be fine! Haha. Sometimes I add a drop into my moisturizer during the day if I’m having a particularly dry day. I love this oil. I will re-purchase once I use it up.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Just what my dry skin needed
reviews.review_text: I really love this moisturizer. I was looking for a moisturizer that would combat how dry and irritated my face has been since starting tretinoin. Nothing was really working and my face felt irritated, kept breaking out, was flaking, etc.Enter stage left! Farmacy Honey Halo. It’s the right amount of richness, without being heavy. My skin has cleared up since I started using this (!!!), probably because it’s less irritated and actually getting the moisture it needs.I do like the packaging and I like that it comes with a magnetic spatula to get the product out, as I don’t like dipping my fingers in open moisturizer like this. The wooden top is beautiful, but as another commenter said, I wish that we would be able to purchase a refill! I have to say that the smell took me a while to get used to... The first few times I used this, I really did not like it. It smelled like weird, earthy nectar, but off... Now I don’t even notice it when I put it on. Overall, I love this moisturizer, it has cleared up my skin, and it’s good for day and night (I use it both). I will be re-purchasing this and I would recommend it if you’re looking for something extra nourishing.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this product. The only reason I give it two stars is because the packaging is lovely, the product looks very nice on the lips (so can be used during the day or at night) and it’s got a good texture. Unfortunately, this does nothing for my lips. In fact, it dries my lips out more. I am trying to use it up because I want to buy something else, but I’ve been using this since June and it’s just not doing it for me. The way I use it now is to put lip balm on underneath and then seal it in with this. I use this throughout the day to put SOMETHING on my lips if I’m in desperate need, otherwise, I will reach for a product that actually moisturizes. I wish I liked this!!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I have tried so many lip balms from expensive to drugstore to natural... This is the best. It’s so hydrating and nourishing. It truly makes my lips feel AND look pillowy soft. I use the coconut one and it’s got a pleasant, mild odour. The packaging is cute and it slips easily into my pocket. Truly, even my boyfriend who is loyal to his Blistex, likes this lip balm. This is great for wearing under lipstick or another product, as it’s lightweight and feels comfortable without being too sticky or slippery. I LOVE IT!

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I really don’t like this. I am usually quite generous with reviews and not harsh on products but I have an almost full container of this that I can’t use. It actively dries out my lips to the point where they will crack and be scaly the next day after this ’hydrating’ thick balm comes off... How?! I just use my go-to Rosebud Salve, I don’t know why I experiment with lip balms.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was excited to try this moisturizer in combination with the serum. Over the course of a few weeks I have noticed significant improvements to my skin’s overall texture and appearance. A little of this product provides good coverage. The only disadvantage in my opinion in the price, but with the results I obtained I would consider a repurchase in the future.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I am always excited to try new products for my skin. I especially like finding products that help my skin maintain its youthful glow. I tend to have skin that leans on the drier side. This product applies nicely with my other nighttime routine and leaves undereye skin looking hydrated and firmer in the morning with consistent use. I also noticed that this product was a good fit for my sensitive skin and did not irritate with regular use.. I would highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing eye cream! It’s super hydrating with the smallest amount it goes a long way.  The only reason I give it 4/5 stars is because I haven’t seen any long time results where I have with other eye creams I’ve only used it for a few weeks but I’m already in love.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the sunscreen, it’s super lightweight and easy to apply has no greasy feeling and absorbs into the skin and leaves no white cast!  I did receive this product but either way I highly recommend it it works great

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This is a great sunscreen if you are dry or extremely dry. I tend to have dry skin and this sunscreen is super hydrating almost to the point where it feels oily if you’re not used to that feeling of super hydrating oily moisturizers you will not like this. Although it is a great neck and hand sunscreen so if you looking for a good body sunscreen this is great it has a creamy skin like color so it blends into the skin

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this as a #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox for my honest review! Truly a very firming and moisturizing cream from the small sample I’ve tried for a few nights. I especially liked that it had a firming texture that went on your face and covered it in a protective barrier that did not feel out of place. It felt like a second layer of my skin so I really enjoyed the texture! Would have seen more results with a full tub, but overall I liked the product I sampled!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this as a #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox for my honest review! Truly a very firming and moisturizing eye cream from the small sample I’ve tried. I especially liked that it was fat absorbing and non greasy. Would have seen more results with a full tub, but overall I liked the product fragrance, texture, and effect I sampled!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this as a #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox for my honest review! It was a very firming and moisturizing wrinkle serum from the small sample I’ve tried. I especially liked that it was fast absorbing and non greasy. Would have seen more results with a full tube, but overall I liked the product fragrance, texture, and effect I sampled!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I received this 7-day trial sample from @thisisbutterly @chickadvisor @clarinscanada for my honest review. First of all, I LOVE the scent of this product as it is mildly fragrant and super pleasant. Secondly, it was extremely difficult to get the product out onto the palm of my hand to mix it up prior to applying it to my face. This process will obviously be omitted upon purchasing a full-sized product. Overall, I think it did an adequate job moisturizing my face overnight. Did I see dramatic results within the 7 days of consecutive use? No. I did not. However, I do need to disclose the fact that my skin was drier and more prone to dullness due to the constant fatigue from raising a newborn. Perhaps with a full night’s rest, the serum might have had better results. Unfortunately, I did not see a miracle for my trial. Would I purchase it for myself? Not likely from the cost VS the results. Please do your due diligence in ensuring your skincare products do what they promise and are suitable to your skin type prior to purchase!#ClarinsSkinCare #DoubleSerum #GotItFree

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: This product is so good. I have to stop myself from using it too much . The texture of the liquid is almost like a gel and it feels so good going on he face and leave it feeling so refreshedI received this product for free for reviewing reasons but since then I’ve added it to my daily routine!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product really came at a great time. My skin is getting so dry from summer and this is saving me. I use it before my sunscreen to trap in as much moisture !I did receive this product for free for testing purposes but I’m glad i did!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Great product! My new favorite sunscreen. It’s not white and thick it is a silky sheer texture. Blends into the skin really nicely and not oily. I think it works really well under my makeup and keeps my skin hydrated. Can be used on body too so you only need to carry one product to the beach. Will definitely be repurchasing when it’s empty

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: This lip balm has a lovely lemon meringue smell but is not that moisturizing. I would recommend the Fresh lip balm that comes in a tube over this one as I find that formula to be more hydrating.This is fine as an everyday lip balm, but if you have very dry lips, this will not be strong enough.The packaging is a bit inconvenient as it’s in a pot but it lasts a long time.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream is very light. If you have dry to normal skin, this won’t be hydrating enough. I had to use a second moisturizer on top of this.The cream has a very nice texture though. Once you apply it, it feels like water and sinks into the skin immediately. It has a mild scent that disappears once you apply it to your face.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is very light. If you have dry to normal skin, this won’t be hydrating enough. I had to use a second moisturizer on top of this.The cream has a very nice texture though. Once you apply it, it feels like water and sinks into the skin immediately. It has a mild scent that disappears once you apply it to your face.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: If you have dry-normal skin, this may be too heavy to use as a day cream. Works well as a night cream though.The cream has a light purple tint and a mild scent that disappear when you apply it to your face. The texture is quite thick, so I recommend taking a pea size amount and rubbing it between your palms to warm up the product before applying to your face. It does make your face look dewy upon application but I haven’t noticed any improvement in my skin with continued use.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is good for calming down the skin if you have any breakouts or sensitivity. I tend to use it after exfoliating or using retinol. I don’t notice any immediate reduction in redness when I first apply the serum, but when I wake up the next morning, my skin looks less red.This serum has a light green tint and a mild herbal smell that disappear once you apply it on your face. If you’re deciding between the serum or the cream, I would recommend the cream as it has the same benefits but is more hydrating.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a great light moisturizer for the summer or normal-oily skin. For dry skin, I recommend the lala retro cream over this one.This cream has a very lightweight consistency that sinks into the skin quickly and layers over other products well. It has a mild scent that disappears upon application.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is a great all around moisturizer for dry skin. It sinks into the skin quite quickly and can be used day or night.I find one small pump to be enough to cover the entire face. I recommend warming up the product in your palms then patting into the face. The cream has a mild scent that disappears after application.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Best lip treatment available, and I have tried a lot of them!!! The texture is so smooth and moisturizing but not sticky or thick. A little goes a very long way, so the tub will last you a long time. I wear it during the day as well as at night and it makes your lips look so plump and juicy. Super moisturizing and smells amazing. Will repurchase again and again.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: Feels refreshing, but irritates my eyes!
reviews.review_text: I love the cooling effect of this mask. It feels very refreshing on the skin and does make your skin feel hydrated and a little plumped up. However, I have found that this mask really irritates the skin around my eyes. I find this unfortunate because I have seen Marianna Hewitt (co-founder of the brand) suggest that you use it as an under eye mask and wipe off excess before makeup application. I have made the mistake of getting this mask even somewhat close to my eyes on more than one occasion and have woken up with or been left with red eczema-like bumps all around my eyes. So while I really do enjoy the mask on the rest of my face, I have to be very careful to stay far from my eyes.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_title: Noticeable results in only a couple weeks!!
reviews.review_text: I don’t usually use toners but I am so impressed with this product! I only use it every second or third night to avoid irritation. Have been using for about a month now and have noticeable reduction in dark spots!! I have a lot of hyperpigmentation from pregnancy hormones, too much time spent in the sun, etc, etc. I have tried many different brightening products- many that were much more pricey than this— and I have definitely seen quicker results with this toner than other serums and brightening products. Also, I feel like it is a great value. The bottle is big and you only need to wet a cotton round, so I have barely put a dent in my bottle after using for almost a month. Will definitely repurchase!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I wouldn’t normally buy something like this at such a price point....luckily I recieved mine complimentary for testing purposes and it is definitely a MUST HAVE!!!!!! Most people review about their before and afters concluding their first week, which I could do too and it would be great but I literally saw a difference after the first night of use. The packaging is super clever as well, with it being very liquidy/watery the bottle doesn’t dispense too much and only does just enough. Love this product and will definitely purchase in the future.

reviews.review_text: This stuff is absolutely amazing. It decreased my redness even after just one use. And after a week it’s nearly completely gone. I recieved mine complimentary for testing purposes but I have easily became a future customer of this product. I recommend it ten times over!!

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product!! Feels great on your skin and the results were unexpectedly great!!! I would recommend this product to anyone! Very smooth and pleasing!! I could tell small differences in my skin after every night I used it!

reviews.review_text: This is the lightest overnight mask I’ve ever worn. It has zero sticky residue, it feels moisturizing from the second it touches your skin, and it is absolutely one of the most refreshing things I have ever put on my face. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: There are so many things to love about this product. First off, from the moment that you open it, it smells fantastic! Super citrus, super summertime glow happening in this little bottle of magic. I have super dry skin and am always looking for something to hydrate me without causing me to get clogged pores and thus break out and this seems to be the perfect product. 10/10 would recommend. I received this product complementary for sampling purposes, but everything stated here in this review are my sole opinions. Buy this! Use it! Love it!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I really liked this product. i have mega dry skin which is only enhanced by colder temps in minnesota. i love that this mask is in jelly format, so it’s super easy to apply and doesn’t make a huge mess during application or once it’s on your face. the only thing i didn’t love about this product is the menthol-y smell when applying, but i didn’t notice it much after it was on my face. overall, would recommend for anyone who maybe doesn’t take as good care of their skin as they should and wants a low maintenance product to help them feel super moisturized. p.s. i received this product complementary through #influenster

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: This mask is incredible. I see a huge difference in my skin immediately after using this. It’s the perfect refresh after you’ve been slacking on skin care for a couple days. I don’t think I can live without this now.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’m sure this does wonders for the skin and is super great, but I’m just wondering... am I the only one who thinks it smells like cat litter?? Just my first impression.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I don’t know how this product works for anyone. It’s super thick and hard to spread. Looks super patchy and makes your skin look grey. I’d much rather throw on a bb cream.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I don’t know how this product works for anyone. It’s super thick and hard to spread. Looks super patchy and makes your skin look grey. I’d much rather throw on a bb cream.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This may be the best cleanser I’ve ever used. I’ve been faithful to the Fresh soy cleanser for years, occasionally trying something else if I got it in a gift set. But this changed the game. It’s so gentle and pleasant to use, but it makes my skin feel so even and smooth. I just love it. Will definitely be buying the full size.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’m 42, and have started to notice crow’s feet, crepey eyelids, and fine lines under my eyes. I applied this to all of those areas. This cream feels super luxurious, and I love the whipped texture. Even after one use, it felt like it was doing something. I’m excited to add this to my anti-aging products and see what the results are!

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_title: Love the concept of tanning drops
reviews.review_text: I love that I can add these Isle of Paradise Tanning Drops to my favorite moisturizer! I love that I can add just a drop if I only want a little color, or a few drops if I want more color. *Gifted by Isle of Paradise

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I really like this Supergoop! Glowscreen SPF 40 in Sunrise. I love that it is SPF 40 and lightweight at the same time. I love that it contains hydrating ingredients like hyaluronic acid and niacinamide. This shade looks great on my skin. I love that it gives my skin a luminous glow!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the texture when I apply this to my damp face (how you’re supposed to apply any hyaluronic acid). I’ve been using it right after my toner for a year, it has a really nice plumping and hydrating effect.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I battled cystic acne for a year then landed on this product. Along with some other ones (caudalie products) I have successfully controlled my breakouts and transformed my skin to a texture I couldn’t Imagine. I’m also on acne therapy birth control but I know a good product when I use it. Love the fragrance, very refreshing. This is a transformative product, let this be your sign to get it.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry acne prone skin and this has been a great sensitive moisturizer perfect of Canadian winters. I still used it throughout the summer. reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best serums I ever used! It does exactly what it promises. I have combination skin & I’ve been a big fan of retinol for years, but felt I needed something extra. I use the DE serum 3x a week & retinol the other 4 & WOW...my skin has never looked better. I saw an improvement right away, but really noticed a difference after about a month. If you’re looking for something to even skin tone & texture, then this is the product for you. It’s a bit pricey but a little goes along way. I use about 1 & 1/2 pumps for my entire face & neck. If you’re new to glycolic serum, start off with 1-2 times per week then work your way up to your own comfort level. I like to alternate nights with retinol (never both on the same night) & this has really made a difference!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I use this with my DE Umbra & love how it takes that white cast out of sunscreen. One drop mixed in is all I need for my face & neck & it gives off a beautiful subtle glow. I’ve seen some reviews saying this looks “orangey” but I haven’t noticed anything like that since using it. The directions say to use it only as a mixer because it’s very concentrated. So if you’re putting it on your face without mixing it with a serum, moisturizer, sunscreen, etc... then that may be the case. However I love it & would definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was looking for a moisturizer for my dry skin especially now that the weather is getting cooler. I bought the mini size that came with the vitamin c rose oil just to try it out before committing to the full size jar. I applied the moisturizer after my serums & then the vitamin c rose oil as the last step in my nighttime routine. I was really impressed by how soft & hydrated my skin felt in the morning. I’ve tried so many different moisturizers in the past but I don’t think I ever remember getting results this good. Also I’m not sensitive to smells & didn’t notice an odor as much as other reviews I read. However I took off 1 star because the jar wasn’t as full as I thought it should be & there was a big air bubble in the middle. Other than that if you’re looking for a moisturizer for dry skin I would definitely recommend giving this one a try. I’m willing to purchase the full size jar because this cream is truly amazing  & hopefully it will be full of product without the air bubbles

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_title: Best Vitamin C serum I’ve been ever used!!!
reviews.review_text: I wanted to wait a little while before I wrote my review, but within 2 weeks, I’ve noticed results. This is hands down my favorite vitamin c serum. It has helped my acne subside. An had given my skin such a beautiful glow. I’m really happy with this product. An it is worth the every penny. I don’t know however that this would be a good starter vitamin c. It’s powerful. I can feel a slight tingle and I’ve been using vitamin c for about a year. However if your not new to vitamin c, this is a game changer!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is such a nice moisturizer. I tend to like a thicker cream. An this one I actually enjoyed. It’s lightweight, but helped make my skin so moisturized! I was thoroughly impressed! I will say I am 33, dry skin, and suffer adult acne. An this didn’t break me out! I will be buying a full size of it, bc I enjoyed it that much!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I waited to try it all before I wrote my review. I will say if you have dry eyelids you’ll love this. It’s not too greasy where it causes milia. It’s just right. I did notice a decrease in the look of fine lines on my lids, but I think it’s just from the hydration. Over all I like it. I will probably not repurchase, but I am glad to have tried it.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Bravo! Bravo! OH where have you been my whole Life??  I have used countless Bronzers and Self Tanners to no avail until now.. reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask

Used 3 pumps to cover my face. It felt tacky on my skin for about 20 minutes. Tbh after it settled in I wasnt blown away but the next morning I woke up with hydrated, plump, dewy skin. It stayed that way all day. Even after I showered there was a layer of hydration that my face has never known. This will be a permanent  staple in my night time routine. A game changer ladies & gentlemen! Drunk Elephant has done it again!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: So far I’m impressed! I have dry and pretty sensitive skin, but it can be fairly dull and sometimes a little congested. This layers well with my other skincare and overall, I really enjoy it!

For me, it’s a nice hydrating serum with a mild brightening effect (although I would have to use it longer than a week to see full results). I think at this price point, you could find something less expensive to deliver similar results, although this one is nice if you want to splurge.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product does wonders! It made my skin so clear after a full month of trying it out. My face was left feeling refreshed and clean. I did receive this product from Influenster for complimentary purposes, all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: It’s a really practical product, it really helps to have a smooth skin when you have a sensitive skin. It’s perfect!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I think it’s a good moisturizing primer, but I didn’t feel like my skin was looking necessary smoother and flawless. Also, don’t put to much because it will roll on your skin. I think this primer is perfect for dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: It’s a good product, really fresh, smooth and you can feel the hydration on you skin when you apply it. I think it’s nice for summer for normal to oily skin but for a dryer skin or during the winter it is not enough.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a couple days and my skin loves it! This guy sat on my counter for months as a trial size without being touched. I’m glad I decided to give it a shot before trashing it. There’s really no smell and my overly sensitive skin loves it! My skin is instantly smoother and feels very calm.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: My skin is left glowing. I also like how effective it is at getting rid of acne spots. Only a few uses in and it’s already managed to fade them away rather quickly. Highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I cannot believe this moisturizer...I have sensitive skin that’s also pretty dry at times. This has provided my skin with ample amounts of moisture without irritation or looking greasy. It also spreads super easily. I switched from my water glacier moisturizer to this, and I’m glad I did.

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: It has a brighten effect which I Love! I have only been using it a week so far and will be continuing to use it!

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. This sunscreen is great! I love that it is SPF 36. I have always burned easily but now I am on medication that makes me photosensitive so I burn even easier. I had been using SPF 30 for years. I would apply 2 or 3 times during a day at the lake. With this sunscreen, I applied 2 times during a day at the lake and did not burn!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum is great for my skin with healthy, clean, natural ingredients!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Great for Sensitive and Dry Skin
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive dry skin and this cleaner is fantastic, I use it as the second step in my double cleanse after micellar water and takes away the rest of the impurities left on my skin. I also love how the cleaner smells I always feel so clean and fresh after using it!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_title: Great Quality for the Price Point
reviews.review_text: I’m a big fan of this product and especially the price point. I’ve noticed my skin looking brighter and my complexion more even.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream

reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this product after hearing so many good things about it but I just don’t think it is right for my skin. First Air Beauty is a go to for me for my sensitive skin but this product stings when I use it. Also, even though I normally have dry skin since I get oily in the summer and my normal moisturizer clogs my pores and I break out. So in the summer I switch to a gel moisturizer but this product doesn’t leave my skin with enough moisture and I feel super dry after using it.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: Obsessed with all of their serums! Not only did I notice a difference in my pores, my skin looked more refreshed and hydrated!

reviews.review_text: Super gentle on my sensitive skin! Very thick texture and smells literally like oatmeal. I plan on continuing to use it as a moisturizing mask instead of daily cleanser as it leaves a film on my face.

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Super gentle on my sensitive skin! Very thick texture and smells literally like oatmeal. I plan on continuing to use it as a moisturizing mask instead of daily cleanser as it leaves a film on my face.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: After a few uses my skin is already glowing! I have sensitive skin so there is a slight tingle. Already noticing a difference!

reviews.review_text: I just love this and I tend to have dry skin... the smell the consistency ugh LOVE IT!

reviews.review_text: I bought the small one and it came in last week, since then I’ve used it 2 times and OMG when I wake up my skin looks so healthy and plumped. I have dry skin and no in the winter its gets really bad, but this has been an extra step in hydration

reviews.review_text: I swear by The Ordinary brand. I love to use this product at night and if has helped a lot with my dry skin. I recommend using it after any other product, because it will pill when something is applied on top of it if it isn’t completely dry.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I swear by The Ordinary brand. I love this peeling solution. I have very dry, sensitive skin and my skin tolerates this well. It has helped a lot with the uneven discoloration I have from acne scars. Definitely do not use it on any broken skin, because it burns like the dickens and don’t leave it on for longer than the recommended ten minutes!

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: I swear by The Ordinary brand. This is my favorite moisturizer ever. I have very dry, sensitive skin. I use this in the morning after the Amino Acids   B5 formula and it has helped so much with my dry skin. This is my go-to before applying makeup in the morning.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My MUST-HAVE product!I have a dry, sensitive skin, and is very easy to be allergic to something (or anything). Whenever I feel itchy or irrational, I will use LaMer. It calms my skin and my emotion. Love it and use it forever!

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My MUST-HAVE product!I have a dry, sensitive skin, and is very easy to be allergic to something (or anything). Whenever I feel itchy or irrational, I will use LaMer. It calms my skin and my emotion. Love it and use it forever!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite skincare brand. I love all the products. This Rose cream is very good for my dry and sensitive skin. It’s light but vey hydrated , no irritation . Another thing I love is the fresh smell, it makes me feel in a roses garden

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I used it first time in 2019 winter ,so I am very glad to get this gift from Summer Fridays. It has Light texture, very easy to apply, and give me a good moisturizing. I have dry skin and need oil every night. This mask will leave a  dewy skin after washing, and keep it for one day.

reviews.review_text: I used it first time in 2019 winter ,so I am very glad to get this gift from Summer Fridays. It has Light texture, very easy to apply, and give me a good moisturizing. I have dry skin and need oil every night. This mask will leave a  dewy skin after washing, and keep it for one day.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: My favorite product for exfoliating. Gentle enough for my sensitive skin but strong enough for the dead skin and pore. I used it every week for the deep cleaning for more than one year and still love it .

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: My favorite product for exfoliating. Gentle enough for my sensitive skin but strong enough for the dead skin and pore. I used it every week for the deep cleaning for more than one year and still love it .

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Soothes, smoothes, hydrates, and nourishes dry chapped lips while smelling delish and giving a nice light sheen. It’s a bit sticky/tacky and my hair will get stuck to my lips, but it’s a balm, what do we expect? I use the night time sleeping mask at night and this during the day and my lips are smooth and hydrated, no more flakes or split lips.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve almost finished my first jar and am about to restock; this moisturizer has saved my dry, acne prone skin! I’ve used it both morning and night, but prefer it as my nighttime moisturizer. It’s thick and creamy but absorbs well and I wake up with soft, smooth, blemish-free skin- just amazing!

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Absolutely my favorite lip mask. I had been using the Laneige sleeping mask but was still getting chapped, flaky lips during the day, even with the dewy lip balm. I started using the Kissu lip mask at night and my lips are now soft, smooth, flake free and ready for whatever lip look I want to do during the day. I’ve also noticed a reduction in the fine lines in my lips and just overall plumper, younger looking lips.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use so many different essences, serums and masks that I try to keep my moisturizer super simple and inexpensive. Then I received a hefty sample of Protini and it quickly became apparent that I needed to add it to my regime. Within days, my skin looked firmer and plumper than it has in a decade and my fine lines were definitely less noticeable. I have never experienced such remarkable results so quickly. I love its light gel/cream texture. It is perfect for day under makeup. I also apply it in the evening and add a heavy duty moisturizer or oil on my driest areas. I anticipate that Protini will provide enough moisture on its own when the weather is warmer.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I had been using Drunk Elephant’s C Firma and Framboos for years and loved them both. Because they worked so well, Sukari Babyfacial seemed superfluous. Seriously... how much better could I expect my middle aged skin to be? But then I sampled it and purchased a full bottle less than 12 hours later. My skin is now insanely soft and the few, barely noticeable age spots that lingered on my jaw line have disappeared. This product is so amazing... 4 of my friends purchased it after seeing and feeling my face! They didn’t even bother sampling first and they are just as excited about it as I am.I use it twice a week and experience minimal tingling. I imagine it might sting a little more for those not already using acids.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: I love this product. It effectively removes my makeup and leaves my skin feeling super soft. Other reviewers have mentioned needing to use lots of product to get the job done. This has not been true for me. My application is a little unorthodox. Since it is thicker than other micellar waters, it is possible to squeeze a dollop into my palm. Then I rub my palms together and work it into my face and neck. I let it sit for 30 seconds are so and then I remove it with a cotton pad. I usually double cleanse at night, but when I am exhausted, I reach for this. I especially love E-Raise in the morning to remove whatever treatment I applied the previous evening. Very refreshing.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: I love this product. It effectively removes my makeup and leaves my skin feeling super soft. Other reviewers have mentioned needing to use lots of product to get the job done.
