reviews.review_text: SOOO GOOD! I love this flavor. It has a little bit of a lighter pink tint than the berry lip mask and smells amazing. If you like sweet scents, I highly recommend this one.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I’m a sucker for lip products lip so when I saw this I knew I had to give it a shot. Upon receiving the product I was shocked to see that the jar was so small. After testing it out, I noticed it’s very thick and stays on your lips for a while. It will eventually sink in and it will help your lips, but for the size and price, I don’t think it’s much better than the Laneige lip mask. A plus is this has no flavor, which I know some people might prefer! Overall, if you’re looking to splurge a bit or want something without a flavor, maybe give this a shot. It’s a good product, but not life changing.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Amazing product. I apply it once a week after washing my face in the evening and apply it alone! I wake up the next morning with less texture, redness, reduced pimples and smaller looking pores. I’ve noticed when I use it alone it works best.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: Okay I wanted to LOVE this product. The reviews are amazing. I have dry skin and apply 3 drops of this oil after cleansing my skin and while I’m using my gua sha. I’ve been using for about 2 weeks now and noticed it has been clogging my pores and I’ve been getting more blackheads than usual. I also noticed that it kind of just sits on my face. It doesn’t sink into my skin. I also noticed it will not dry for a really long time and leaves you wanting to wash your face asap. Personally, this is not my favorite and I feel like there are better options out there. I wish I was able to return.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: Pills So Much, Best Used Only at Night
reviews.review_text: This stuff pills like crazy! Even after letting it dry for a long time, it still pills. I only use it at night because of this, and let it dry for about 10 minutes before adding my oil. It seems to work, my skin is nice but the pilling makes me think it does not get absorbed

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I have dry sensitive skin, and I am in my late 30’s. I received this in a sample and was afraid to try it, but figured I might as well. I did a patch test to make sure it did not burn too much. It does definitely tingle, but that goes away quickly. My face does not turn red, just tingly and a little bit of burning, especially in sensitive areas like my upper lip. This stuff WORKS! You wake up refreshed! I now own the full size and use it 2x per week. Make sure to use sunscreen regularly, and I follow up this treatment with squalane oil and wake up like I really was just on my honeymoon!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I don’t know if it is doing anything for my skin per se, but it definitely gives a nice glow. I am light/medium tone and my husband comments when I wear this that I am “glowing“. Obvi, he does not know it is this. I mix it with my foundation or tinted moisturizer and I love it! Again, not sure it is doing anything long term, but nice way to get face to match chest and it has nice ingredients. One drop is all you need, comes out dark.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_title: Must have if you use retinoid!
reviews.review_text: I love this gentle scrub and use it daily. My face gets flaky from retinoid use (tretinoin), and this saves my face! I use it every morning except the morning following my treatment and my skin has never looked so good!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Affordable, simple, and works Affordable, simple, and feels great on the skin. You can’t go wrong with it.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: If you’re considering buying an $80 face peel I’d opt for this. It’s inexpensive and genuinely works well. I will admit I used it too frequently at first and it freaked out my skin — Once I took a break and started using once a week or two I started to notice it was benefiting the texture of my skin while heaving it a healthy glow.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I am 26 years old. I have dry skin and experience hormonal acne. I like to think of this as a stress-free moisturizer, meaning that I don’t have to worry that it’s not doing it’s job. It’s creamy, moisturizing, and sets in quickly. I saw a review of someone saying it smelled bad but I can’t smell this product hardly at all. It doesn’t break me out and feels gentle. A little of it goes a long way so it’s more lasting that other moisturizers. I saw someone say to not apply makeup after using this due to piling, but I wait for my moisturizer to dry and then use an oil based primer before my foundation.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for about 4 months now in the morning and it really gives me a glowy look. I have acne scars and I feel like it has helped but it took a while to even see a little bit of improvement. I also can’t even tell if this product is what’s helping my scars because they’ve been really small for a while now. I also did get a very small purge when I first started using it so I recommended starting with once every other day instead of everyday.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed. Has never broken me out and doesn’t make me look dry when I wear it. Don’t even think about it just buy it!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed. Has never broken me out and doesn’t make me look dry when I wear it. Don’t even think about it just buy it!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: This has helped my texture and scarring so much. I used to have texture everywhere before starting this. I’ve been using it for scout 3 months.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product since before additive! I absolutely love it. I got this from Influenster to try and I highly recommend this vitamin c!! Definitely brightens and hydrates my skin! I would 10/10 recommend!!!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This is a decent lip mask. I still prefer the laneige lip mask over this one. But I would definitely buy it for sure. I really like the texture of this mask. But nothing compares to my laneige one! 8/10 recommend!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer would be really good for normal to combination skin, plus acne prone. It felt really nice on my skin and I would recommend it to others to try.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Love love love! I use it every night, it’ll last forever. Since I started using it, I haven’t had any problems with chapped lips.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: It’s definitely moisturizing but I didn’t see a huge difference. Not a holy grail product like I thought it would be.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: It’s definitely moisturizing but I didn’t see a huge difference. Not a holy grail product like I thought it would be.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I love Belif and a majority of their products and I also love a hydrating toner. I super excited to be one of the first to try this new hydrating toner. I was very sad to see that the third ingredient was Alcohol Denatured. The one thing I don’t like in my toner is - alcohol. As hydrating as it may seem, my already dehydrated skin did not thrive with this added alcohol. My skin was irritated a few days after use. The actual application was very pleasant. It was very refreshing and did not feel tacky. It wasn’t for a few days that I saw the negative side effects. If your skin is not sensitive to alcohol or essential oils this may be a great choice for you. Price is right too.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Perfect cold weather moisturizer! She is extra thick and yet it feels surprisingly light weight. Ingredients are amazing AND it’s fragrance free! I am in love! ❤️

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This really works! I had this product put on me while I was having a service done and honestly it worked instantly. The balm just melted into my dry chapped lips and became so soft. I use it every night. Worth every dollar.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is lovely for my skin this winter. I normally use Clinique’s Take The Day Off but this is just as good and smells lovely. It’s a nice change - definitely feels a little less greasy too.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This is lovely for my skin this winter. I normally use Clinique’s Take The Day Off but this is just as good and smells lovely. It’s a nice change - definitely feels a little less greasy too.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This actually a decent moisturizer. I was having some contact dermatitis- either related to skin care or makeup and I used only this and it left my skin soft and supple and it sinks in right away and it can hold its own.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: It does what it says.  I stand by ordinary products because they do a good job for a cheaper price.  I put it under eyes and over eye lids. It is gel like thick consistency and a single drop works for both eyes.  When it is drying, I feel the solution around my eyes, almost like its firming up the skin around eye area.  The feeling lasts like 2-3 mins. Use a moisturizer or eye cream after using this as this is not hydrating at all and leaves u feeling dry.  But this is exactly what this solutions supposed to do so no complaints so far.  I also use this on my face occasionally if face is looking too dull.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: it is an okay product.  For the price it’s not worth it as I’ve tried better dewy hydration products for a better price too.  this is not much different from dewy night skin cream, only that this product is moisturizer type and dewy night skin cream is more gel based.  both products are for night time use because it does get a bit sticky and I dont think make up with apply well on it.  I used it night time but felt that something was on my skin, like a dewy layer was on my skin, so I was conscious of sleeping.  I personally like it when the cream goes into my skin and makes it plump looking.  I had to return this product and most likely will not recommend this product.  I have dry skin and I bought DE product instead which was so much better.  Also, giving it a low rating because it is not “clean“, check ingredients before buying.  giving it 3 stars because my skin in morning felt hydrated, but honestly, not worth it.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m on my 2nd bottle of this product, already half finished and definitely going to order more in future.  I have been using hyaluronic acid for over a year now and it’s a favourite part of my skincare regimen.  For starters, this product best works when layered with a facial oil or moisturizing face cream on top of this serum.  Using it alone may cause tight dry skin. I have extremely dry and sensitive skin and this product has been super nice to me.  I wear it every single day as a first step of skincare before any Vit C serum.  I usually wait 5-10 mins before layering with oil or cream as some products MAY pill IF used right after applying this serum.  I would definitely recommend purchasing this if you have dry skin.  it holds in moisture throughout the day (esp winter months because canada is brutal like that). After incorporating this in my skincare routine, and following up with oil/cream, I have never experienced dry patches on my face.  my face looks dewy and moisturized at the end of the day.  highly recommended!!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_title: It's okay.  Not a must-have product.
reviews.review_text: I used this multiple ways - removed makeup, removed just eye makeup, removed a mistake while doing makeup, used this after face washing, and used this first thing in morning after waking up.  For anything makeup removing related, I have to use A LOT to get the clean face, no rinse needed feeling.  I would rather double cleanse my face.  It’s good as removing a makeup mistake.  Doesn’t strip off skin.  Used as a toner after face wash - I saw some dirt and grime on cotton pad that washing didnt take out  and finally used first thing in morning to remove nights serum and oil on face - didnt make my skin feel dry and felt clean so no rinse needed after. No breakouts, no dryness.   Glad I tried it but probably wouldn’t buy again.  3/5 for formula and multiple usage, 1/5 for bottle packaging.

I have started developing white flakes on my chin and after using this cream on my face every night, my dry skin feels so nourished and revived. This is a thick cream that has a neutral scent, kind of reminds me of the Aveeno lotion scent which I normally use on my body.

reviews.review_text: This Jet Lag Mask is exactly what you need for your skin because it is so moisturizing for my dry skin. I usually use this as the last step in my skincare routine and put it on before I go to bed. This was gifted by Summer Fridays and I am in love!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This Jet Lag Mask is exactly what you need for your skin because it is so moisturizing for my dry skin. I usually use this as the last step in my skincare routine and put it on before I go to bed. This was gifted by Summer Fridays and I am in love!

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: The Sunday Riley serum gifted by Sunday Riley realy does help in my skin tone and overall brightness. I have a dark spot on my cheek that is looking more and more faded every time I use it, so I am very excited to use it for a longer period of time.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this lip mask! It smells amazing, and it makes my lips feel so soft and refreshed in the morning. I live in a really dry climate, so lip products are a must. Happy to say this really helps! I definitely recommend it. I received this product complementary for testing from Influenster and I will be using it nightly from now on!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Very moisturizing! Feels great on the skin, and the moisture is long lasting. Definitely reccomend!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this cleansing balm. You only need a small amount, so the jar will last you a long time, and it’s very effective at taking off makeup.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I was kindly gifted this product from Fresh in exchange for my honest review. I am a frequent masker and was excited to try this one. It is the perfect overnight treatment for my dry skin being in the cold Chicago weather. It did not sting or irritate my skin. I love the texture in that it’s thicker, but spreads on the skin so nicely. You can build upon it to boost even more hydrating and nourishing effects. I woke up the next morning with skin balanced, calm and redness diminished! A staple for me multiple times a week to top off my evening skincare routine. The jar is quite large so you will get a lot of applications since a little goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I adore this SPF! I love a hybrid formula. It goes on so nice without pilling with my other skincare products. The finish is the perfect dewy glow without being over the top. It feels nourishing & hydrating to keep my dry skin happy throughout the day. This is one that I will definitely reach for on a regular basis!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a nice and light hydration and barrier boosting serum. I was worried that it would clog my congestion prone skin, but luckily I did not have that issue using this serum twice a day! It helps reduce redness and calm my skin when it’s irritated. A good one to pair with my retinol at night.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t expecting much from this eye balm. I don’t have wrinkles yet but my eye area does get very dry. My first time using it I was surprised by the cooling affect after applying. It felt good and my under eyes didn’t feel dry. It also sinks into your skin and doesn’t sit on top. I have dark circles too and after a few weeks of using this eye bomb I noticed my dark circles weren’t so dark. I would highly recommend this to anyone over 30

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: Sensitive skin approves! I was so excited to test this! I’m a skin junkie and anything vitamin C. I’m 35 with sensitive acne prone skin that’s also dry. I’ve used this morning and night for a few weeks and I’ve noticed smoother skin, no more dry patches and my dark spots have faded. This cream is very light and a little goes a long way. It absorbs fast too. I’ve had no issues with burning or redness with this cream and I love the ingredients! Will be adding this to my daily skin routine forever

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: My first time trying a lip mask and It feels like Vaseline. I would purchase this. I would just use basic lip balm if I need to extra hydration

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve only been using this for a few weeks but have noticed the lines around my eyes are softer. Will continue using and highly recommended

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My skin being very dry I really needed something moisturising and guess what I got this cleanser complimentary from influenster for review purpose. I loved it! I felt fresh and my skin was soft after 1 use.I really recommend this to someone who has a dry skin problem.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received this product compliments of Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I like it. It’s nice and light weight. It didn’t leave my face with a greasy feeling. I feel like it protected my skin. My only dislike is the sme

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Overall, I very much liked this sunscreen - it’s easy to apply, wears great in the heat of Cancun, doesn’t mess with the makeup being applied over it. i liked the texture of it - creamy and doesn’t run. I didn’t notice my skin being any more hydrated, but it didn’t feel dry while wearing it either. It still does have a slight smell of sunscreen but the overall smell is pleasant. I got this complimentary  from influenster.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Perfect to wash off makeup easily! A little goes a long way, so this would probably last a year if you use it right. Totally worth the money! My friend let me use this when I stayed over 2 years ago, and I’m still in love with this product

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: This is awesome. It does what it claims to do! Once the mask gets dry on my skin, I can literally see the white heads that have been drawn to the surface. BUY THIS!

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I LITERALLY JUST PUT THIS ON LAST NIGHT AND I WOKE UP THIS MORNING TO MY BOYFRIEND SAYING “Wow your skin looks amazing, your acne is almost gone!“!!!!!!!!!!!! THIS WORKS. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: Gadamn. This felt like putting perfume on my face. Didn’t do anything. Received as a sample, not purchasing.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I use this at night and I was attracted to the avocado ingredient. However, this created dry red spots around my eyes, it looked like someone punched me in the face. I don’t have sensitive eyes at all, but my skin reacted horribly to whatever is in this. I am not new to eye creams either and I know my skin should not be reacting this way. Returning and never repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: Super thick consistency, thicker than most toners I’ve used. Very hydrating! Smells like roses and honey. Usually I apply toner with a cotton ball or pad, but I actually found applying with my hands worked best! I use this after serum and before moisturizer. My skin feels baby soft! I received this product complimentary from Influenster but all views and opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: Super hydrating, smells amazing! I use this moisturizer after serum and toner. I need to let my skin sit for about 10-15 min before applying makeup. It soaks into skin but is not too oily. I received this product complimentary via Influenster but all views expressed are my own.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: Love the smell and the refreshing cool feeling it gives your skin. Very lightweight oi! Been spending a lot of time outdoors in the sun and putting it on after felt great and smelled great. Appears it helped moisture my skin as well.

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water
reviews.review_text: This stuff is great, it’s easy to apply and you get a natural looking non-streaky tan.. it feels like you’re basically spraying water on your skin, but in the morning you wake up looking nice and bronzed. The smell  is a bit perfumey for my taste, but I’m ok with it since it’s just going to be used for my body. The only con I have, is I feel like if I continue to use this for my whole body it will run out really fast ... for my first time use I used 1/6 of the bottle for a full body tan...so what I would have six uses of this ? I guess it can be easy to go overboard because the spray is clear. Nonetheless, it’s great stuff if you can afford it and/ or use it more sparingly

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: ok, first ill start by saying do not use this on broken or irritated skin. it will burn lol. sensitive or oily skin probably won’t take to this very well either (it is greasy). the way I use this product is by dropping very very little, and mixing it with a drop of the ordinarys resveratrol and pycnogenol (might have spelled this wrong lol) then I mix it in with a moisturizer  and PAT  that concoction into my face and neck.  no burning for me as its diluted with other antioxidant serums.  I think the key is to mix a drop of this with a moisterizer and then apply, as opposed to applying a pure dollop of it. anyway then I put on a non oily sunscreen, and I’m good to go. keeps my skin from feeling too dry over the course of the day. basically less is more with this.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: This stuff is incredible one drop goes a long way you can mix it w moisturizer and it will give you a nice glow and as others have said even out skin tone without adding much pigment. The ONLY reason I minus 1 star is for the new packaging... why oh why DE did you switch to this boxy container ??? Before it was in a tube and at least when it was reaching the end I could cut it and use the remaining leftover product that won’t squeeze out ..which ends up being quite a bit. Don’t like the new box packaging. Nevertheless this is a great product I’ve re-purchased a couple times

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is such a thick and wonderful cream. I was experiencing dry patches due to winter and none of my thick moisturizers were cutting it. I started using this line and a few days later there were no more dry patches on my face! My skin is incredibly sensitive as well and this did not break me out. LOVE.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love how hydrating this is! It works great under makeup or alone and significantly reduced the dry patches I had in combination with the night cream. Love these two for my dry, sensitive skin and I would definitely repurchase!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a fairly good product! I can’t say it beats my favorite moisturizers, but I do enjoy it. My skin is very sensitive and it didn’t bother my skin at all. I received this product free for testing purposes from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Gentle enough to use *most* days but not every day
reviews.review_text: This is a beautiful eye cream! I really enjoy how light yet moisturizing this feels going on. I didn’t find any irritation with the product containing retinol and being used on the eye area. I used this daily for a week and a half and unfortunately had a slight bit of sensitivity with continued use. I would have been more surprised if I was able to use it every night from the get go. I’ll be using it every other night now and am enjoying so far! My undereyes feel moisturized and they look plump.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This product is absolutely amazing. I use it every night! It soothes my eye lids, and really does the job! I have noticed significant improvements since I started using it! I would recommend to anyone and everyone.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from influenster and could not be happier! It has become a staple in my skin care routine! It is smooth, light, and extremely moisturizing! I get dry lids when the weather starts to warm and this has cleared it up! Highly recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I am in love!! I received this product complimentary from influenster and am absolutely amazed! I have dry skin and feel like even when I’m wearing make up I have clearly visible pores!! BUTTTT with this product, my skin is smooth and my pores are close to invisible! Will be buying when this is finished!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by fresh. I have pretty big lips that get chapped easily so I love lip masks and treatments but I usually don’t love putting color on my lips but I’m obsessed with how subtle and natural and pretty this color looked, and how buttery the product feels! Some lip balms I’ve tried feel nice when you apply but feel dry within minutes, this one has a very velvety feel and leaves my lips feeling hydrated longer!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_title: Great for smooth texture & vibrant skin!
reviews.review_text: I have loved fresh products for a while, their cleanser and toner are my go to every single night and this is no different! My skin is dry, sensitive and pretty dull and this product has helped my skin look so much more plump and hydrated and vibrant! Another hit from fresh!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Murad, I am loving it so far, I have been skin cycling, using a retinol every 4th night and my skin has not been this clear and smooth in years. I highly recommend this product! I use after cleansing and moisturize afterwards!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this!! I don’t even wear face makeup when I use this because it does such a great job at evening out skin tone. I have redness around my nose and this makes it vanish. I received this for free to test out, but will certainly purchase it again in the future.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this!! I don’t even wear face makeup when I use this because it does such a great job at evening out skin tone. I have redness around my nose and this makes it vanish. I received this for free to test out, but will certainly purchase it again in the future.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: I have extremely sensitive skin & absolutely love this moisturizer. I love the consistency because it is thicker than most face creams, but it soaks in quickly! I also really like how the packaging is a tube so you aren’t sticking your fingers into a jar. My dry, red skin loves this!! I received this product for free, but will be purchasing it because I love it so much.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is great! I love using it along with the other Dr Jart Cicapair products. It’s very moisturizing and soothing. I received this product for free to test out & am very pleased with it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This is overall a great product. It was super smooth on my lips, and left a great shine. The only reason I gave it a 4 was because I was not particular to the flavor. It did however stand up to the wear and tear of everyday use. I received this product as a free trial, but I would but it again.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I am asolutely in love with this face wash. I received this as a trial product from Influenster and I am so glad that I did. It makes my face not only feel clean, but so smooth and smells great. I would definitely recommend this to everyone looking for a new face scrub, and will for sure be buying it when I run out.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This was a pretty great cleanser! I definitely felt like my face was cleaner after using it, I just wish that it had a bit of a better smell! But I do appreciate the fact that it is all natural.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This eye serum is really a 5-star product just like in it’s name. Formulated with retinol, niacinamide, and ceramides to repair and moisturize your eyes. I found it very soothing to use (especially at night), and the applicator tool made it easy to massage the product around my eyes. I would wake up with less puffiness in the morning even if I didn’t get enough sleep. Although it’s not necessary in a skincare routine, this product is nice to include.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This mask is very nourishing to use, especially in the winter time where the weather is cold and dry. I prefer to use this as an overnight mask (replacing my moisturizer), and my skin feels soft and hydrated the next day.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed using this product because it is a mixture of both a moisturizer as well as a makeup primer. It has a citrus-like scent which is nice, and texture wise it smoothes out my skin’s texture. It holds foundation for quite some time which means it functions just like makeup primer.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Best balm I’ve ever used!! Those out all my others after using this for two weeks, hydrating without being greasy with no obnoxious scent or flavor.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Great hydration, lovely smell, this lotion keeps up with my dry skin and I swear it has reduced the appearance of my pores and a few old scars too.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Great hydration, lovely smell, this lotion keeps up with my dry skin and I swear it has reduced the appearance of my pores and a few old scars too.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser and I think it fits perfectly into Tatcha’s line. I have the Camellia Cleansing Oil for days when I don’t need to exfoliate, the Polished Classic Rice Enzyme Powder for my weekly exfoliant, and now I have the deep cleanse for inbetween. It smells great and is gentle, but remember not to press hard into your skin or you can hurt your skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser and I think it fits perfectly into Tatcha’s line. I have the Camellia Cleansing Oil for days when I don’t need to exfoliate, the Polished Classic Rice Enzyme Powder for my weekly exfoliant, and now I have the deep cleanse for inbetween. It smells great and is gentle, but remember not to press hard into your skin or you can hurt your skin.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love the Lala Retro (purple) moisturizer from Drunk Elephant so when this was released I hopped on it. I have dry/sensitive skin and this didn’t work as well for me - it left almost like a sticky residue on my skin and I wasn’t a fan. Went back to the Lala Retro Whip !

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is pretty expensive, but I’ve heard great things so I decided to try it and I do like it.I have sensitive, dry skin so my skin was a bit disturbed when I first started using this (it’s fine now). Be sure not to use before going into direct sunlight! I only use this at nighttime because of my skin’s sensitivity. I don’t have much skin problems (acne, pimples, etc) besides sensitivity & dryness so I didn’t see a huge difference after adding this into my nighttime skincare routine but I did notice some more firmness, which is awesome!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have dry/sensitive skin. I added this to my skincare routine - after toner & essence, before eye cream & moisturizer. It hasn’t caused any issues for my sensitivity, and it adds a little boost to my moisturizer. I don’t use this everyday because of its price point, I use it twice a week or when my skin is drier than usual. My personal opinion (I’m not an expert) -- if your skin isn’t dry, I don’t think you really need to add this step, especially since it’s expensive. But if you have dry skin like me, it definitely adds a boost when used before moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I have dry/sensitive skin and this one works great. It’s pretty light but moisturizes well. I like the dispensing method so that the product is untouched except the amount you’re going to use. The only thing that I don’t like is that it’s pretty expensive. Also, the container kind of makes you think there’s more product than there really is.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have extremely sensitive skin plus I’m very oily and this just did not work for me. It didn’t irritate my skin but it caused mini breakouts and I didn’t see an improvement in terms of oil control.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: Perfect amount of moisture for my oily/ combo skin! Doesn’t leave a greasy film and really sinks into the skin nicely.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser does it all! Ive never used a cleanser that completely washes off makeup and spf WITHOUT leaving my skin tight and dry! It lathers up so nicely too. I have acne prone skin and this didn’t break me out ! :)

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Such an amazing product! I have extremely dry skin and this is repairing my moisture barrier!

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is comfortable to wear for both morning and night. My skin is on the dry side, but more normal in the summer months. The hydration definitely lasts all day and through the night after cleansing. Curious to see how it will perform as the seasons shift. Very good purchase if you’re looking for a gentle, light weight, yet extremely hydrating face cream.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is comfortable to wear for both morning and night. My skin is on the dry side, but more normal in the summer months. The hydration definitely lasts all day and through the night after cleansing. Curious to see how it will perform as the seasons shift. Very good purchase if you’re looking for a gentle, light weight, yet extremely hydrating face cream.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer gives my skin such balanced hydration and I come back to it time and time again. It has a non-greasy formula that never feels heavy and doesn’t clog/congest my pores. I love it the most for change of season/ drastic weather when my skin doesn’t know how to respond. The texture is lightweight and easily absorbs which makes it suitable for morning and nighttime use. My skin is happy and at peace when I use this moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wholeheartedly trust this cleanser. I’ve never struggled with acne until recent years, and my skin is generally on the sensitive side of the spectrum. I’ve never experienced burning, tingling, irritation, or redness while using this. With consistent use of the cleanser, my skin has noticeably become less congested, and my pimples/ breakouts are kept at bay. My face always feels properly cleansed without feeling stripped or tight. I always follow up with hydrating products and have achieved the most beautiful results. I am beyond satisfied with the way this cleanser functions.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This is my product by Sunday Riley & i’m so impressed! Love how unique the applicator is and the cooling effect feels great on my skin. It has some really great ingredients and I’m looking forward to using this in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I’m in love with this new Floral Recovery Calming Mask yet! It’s so soothing on my skin and really helps to even out my skin tone. I’ve also noticed a difference in the texture of my skin. Overall super impressed with this product.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a couple of weeks under my makeup & I have mixed reviews. While it feels enriching, it’s a little drying on my skin. I haven’t noticed any crazy changes to my makeup but the vitamin benefits are nice.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I really really love this daily exfoliant! It’s so soft on the skin but I can really see a difference. I’ve been using it every day for the last week and noticed my skin feels and looks brighter and smoother. I was gifted by Dermalogica Sampling

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I really really love this daily exfoliant! It’s so soft on the skin but I can really see a difference. I’ve been using it every day for the last week and noticed my skin feels and looks brighter and smoother. I was gifted by Dermalogica Sampling

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is pretty darn amazing! It actually feels like it is working when you put it on. The purple serum absorbs very quickly and helps reduce dark spots. The scent is divine!!! I will say that it did not really mix well with some of my skincare but not sure exactly why so I have to play around with my regimen a bit more. Ultimately, I think this is a great serum to try for those wanting to decrease signs of aging and dark spots.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This gel cleanser is amazing! It has a unique texture but foams up enough to remove all make up and debris. The reason for 4 stars is the price, I feel like you could find a dupe for a lower price point but this is really great.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: Great micellar water!!! I love gentle micellar waters that can be used with contacts and this one is fantastic for that. I don’t usually wear waterproof makeup so I can’t speak on that but I do wear full makeup and this removes it all. I still follow with face cleanser of course. Mild scent. Gave it 4 stars bc I do have some other micellar waters that are amazing and half the price.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: Great micellar water!!! I love gentle micellar waters that can be used with contacts and this one is fantastic for that. I don’t usually wear waterproof makeup so I can’t speak on that but I do wear full makeup and this removes it all. I still follow with face cleanser of course. Mild scent. Gave it 4 stars bc I do have some other micellar waters that are amazing and half the price.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Like tiny angel hands caressing my lips. 10/10. Chefs kiss.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing *if you use it correctly*. You must not use too much and PAT IT IN. I have rosacea and it truly does reduce my redness in lieu of foundation.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing *if you use it correctly*. You must not use too much and PAT IT IN. I have rosacea and it truly does reduce my redness in lieu of foundation.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: Just purchased a refill in the new packages after I COMPLETELY used up the last one. How often is one able to say “I finished an entire lip balm without losing it” that is how good this stuff is. New packaging is definitely an upgrade and muuuuuuuch easier to use.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: When I was originally given this product I was told, as the packaging states, that it is for “oily and acne-prone skin,“ neither of which I have. In the warmer months I lean more normal, with an oilier nose, and in the cooler months I am dry. Year round, however, my skin is very sensitive.I get the occasional breakout, nothing too terrible, but I am usually left with pronounced post inflammation hyper-pigmentation. This not only controls my breakouts, but it’s lessened the appearance of the scars I had left over, and it greatly decreased the bumpy texture my skin has. I’ve gone through a total of three bottles, and now consider this a holy grail product. As I am drier, this doesn’t dry me out, but I only use it at night-every night. As I have sensitive skin, I first started using this three nights a week, and then worked up to using it every night. I do follow it up with a moisturizer, as this doesn’t give me enough hydration alone.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I have been using this toner for a few weeks now, so I figured it would be a good time to share my thoughts. I use this toner by pouring some out into my hands and gently patting it into my skin. It does take a while to absorb fully, so I like to let it sink in for about 30 seconds before I put my serum on, otherwise it just leaves my skin feeling wet and sticky. I have noticed that my skin feels softer and more plump. I wouldn’t say I ever have had issues with my pores, so I can’t really speak to that. I purchased this because I love the Glow Recipe line, and I liked that this featured both hydrating and exfoliating ingredients. I will definitely be repurchasing this when I run out.

The first time I used it I had my contacts in, and it didn’t make them gross or “foggy.“ I have fairly sensitive eyes, and this didn’t leave my eyes itchy or irritated. I was worried that this might break me out or leave my skin either feeling oily or dry it out, but none of those things have happened! reviews.review_title: A rosy routine for mature skin
reviews.review_text: I don’t see a lot of reviews here for mature skin so thought I would leave one. I previously used revitalift and while I was not unhappy with it I felt I should use something clean and better in my mature age. So when I found the fresh rose line I had to give it a try. I have battled with rosea since I turned 50 and went thru extreme stress and physical issues. I pretty much fixed the issue with antibiotics and the Avene miceller water as well as an Avene cream but in the last couple years began trying other lines very carefully. When I saw the rose line I thought I might have hit on my holy grail and I was right! The rose mask is so moisturizing and comforting that I don’t want to remove it! I apply it with the mask paddle available from Sephora which makes the entire process easier. When it comes time to take it off, I put a couple drops of the soy face wash in my hands and massage it into my skin. I use a face tool to help remove the mask and then wipe it all away with a washcloth. I finish with toner (the one with rose petals) and the rose serum. Finally I use rhe rose cream to lock in the moisture for the day. I only use the mask at most every other night as it is so rich. On alternate nights I like to use the other mask and then exfoliate with a scrub. This is my entire routine and my skin loves it!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_title: I finally have the perfect cleanser in Soy
reviews.review_text: My skin is quite dry especially in winter with spells of rosea, and in the past I have never been able to use anything other than miceller water or the occasional glycolic acid scrub from Loreal so it came as a wonderful surprise when I tried a sample of this face wash and it did not irritate my skin! I had purchased a gift set of about five fresh items including the face wash and a toner so I dove in expecting tight skin from the wash. But I got soft skin! What a shock! This could not be true not on my skin that has always been like a prune. I carried on with the toner and moisturizer and felt divine. I tried again that night thinking it had been a fluke and same thing. Soft skin! This little tube lasted for a full month and I finally replaced it with a full size. I expect it will last at least six months so do not let the price of the Fresh poroducts sway you. You only need a tiny amount. As an added recommendation, when using the toner with the roses I would suggest pouring it directly into your hand and then patting it onto your face and that way you will waste far less product than if you pour it into cotton. I intend to purchase that next but hoping it comes on sale as I intend to get the large bottle and I will need more cream by then as well argh it never ends.

reviews.review_text: Lovely moisturizer that has the scent of roses in it. If you don’t care for roses you may want to use another line as the smell is very prevalent in the line. However the roses are very helpful in getting moisture to the skin and I’m finding that my skin feels better over all after using this for four weeks. It’s certainly more comfortable. I also use the rest of the line including toner, masks and face wash. I do feel this is the most gentle line overall I have ever used, certainly not the cheapest but one of the best. reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been following Shani for a while on instagram. When she finally hit Sephora I bought the 1 oz bottle. It has 2.2.% retinol which is less then some others on the market but it is paired with 2% lactic acid serum which is really what helps with seeing immediate results.I have acne prone skin, and acne scarring not many wrinkles but preventative measures are always nice. I started out using twice a week before bed with nothing layered underneath and now I use it every other day with another serum like Estée Lauder advanced night repair.  Shani says you can use a moisturizer on top if you need added moisture but I figured I would try without to see the results. After first use I definitely noticed a difference in the pigmentation of some of my acne scars. My pores also looked less huge. I haven’t taken before and after pictures, but every time I use the product I am happy with the results. I have read that the formula has changed since it was originally formulated but I don’t know the difference as I have only tried the version after it hit Sephora. I took off 1 star because for the price of the product I feel like there are other retinol’s on the market (like Sunday Riley that offer 6.5%) that offer more bang for your buck. Friendly reminder to always use an SPF during the day if you are using a retinol :-)

reviews.review_text: I bought the smaller version that comes with the virgin marula oil, because I wasn’t sure the product was worth the hype. BUT happy to say it is totally worth it! I used it once a week and they recommend to never pair with their glycolic night serum on the same day because this product offers a higher % dose of the AHA. When I am really looking for an effective facial and more fresh youthful looking skin this does wonders for me. Leaves my pores looking smaller and a nice flushed and soft look. With the marula oil paired with it just after using the mask I wake up looking like a dream! My makeup also applies really smooth the when I use this. It is not for people with extra sensitive skin in my opinion, it does have a slight tingle or burning sensation when applying and the texture of the product is slightly grainy and can feel rough for those with raw or sensitive skin. Taking off 1 star because although the pump seems convenient the product is just too thick to be kept in a pump. I would recommend a jar instead.

reviews.review_text: Love this stuff !!! I try to find new products all the time that are cheaper...but I always come back !!! Can’t find a better product and I’ve tried them all !!!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive skin and I am pretty picky about moisturizers but I love this one. the moisture is locked in and lasts. I usually apply after I was my face at night and also in morning.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive skin and I am pretty picky about moisturizers but I love this one. the moisture is locked in and lasts. I usually apply after I was my face at night and also in morning.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: This product is fantastic. I received as a free sample and I am blown away. This makes the eye area feel very rejuvenated the next day if you use before you go to sleep. I have sensitive skin and I love it

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary and I was surprised to find that this actually felt good and made my skin feel hydrated. I have super dry sensitive skin and also sometimes get dermatitis on my face. But when my skin was doing well this also was good on my face. Definitely bettter than expected.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My new favorite. This has kept my skin hydrated but not greasy all summer. I’m on my second bottle and will continue to use. My skin is noticeably firmer since I’ve started using this and I had no sensitivity to it.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This is one of my favorites! I received this through Influenster and I fell in love. I apply every afternoon over my makeup. It glides on so nicely and doesn’t leave any sort of film over my makeup.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This is such a nice, smooth sunscreen. I received this through Influenster and I fell in love. It is so smooth on skin and finishes nicely. I’m just not sure it’s worth the full cost.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I love these, not only do they smell amazing but they work great. They don’t leave too much of wet or oily residue on your face and really takes the makeup off.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I had heard good reviews for this so I thought I would try out the mini size. I have had this stuff for a while and it looks brand new. You get so much product. As for the actual product, it is amazing. It has such a nice soothing feeling. It hydrates my under eyes wonderfully. It is light enough to use under makeup too! Amazing!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I think this lip sleeping mask works wonder! I love the the texture of the product. However, if you do not like the smell of fake strawberries don’t get the original scent.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: So so good! I’ve been using this for about 4 weeks now and my skin is glowing. I barely break out now, even hormonally, and it hasn’t caused any of the dryness I experienced with the lactic acid formula. A really good way to introduce serums into your routine and sensitive skin friendly! Obviously it won’t react the same for everyone, but it has definitely improved things for me.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: I started using this to help with some fine lines and texture issues, and it just wasn’t for me. Unfortunately about a month in, my skin got super sensitive and began breaking out no matter what I did. The package says to use it daily, but really it should only be once or twice a week to avoid damage, and always with sunscreen!! Once I dialed it back it was better, but I eventually quit it for the niacinamide and zinc formula, which has been gentler and more effective for me.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Perfect for daytime! I have dry skin, and this moisturizer is rich enough to keep my skin dewy without leaving a residue. Is a dream to layer under makeup, even with sunscreen and primer on top. Rich enough for winter but light enough for summer! I’ve gone through ton of moisturizers (La roche posay, neogen, tonymoly, cerave, neutrogena) and this is the only one I’ve stuck with for more than a few months. It’s not cheap, but it doesn’t break me out or cause irritation, doesn’t clash ingredients with all my other products, and has a really nice cucumber scent. The night cream is fantastic as well!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I loved using the rose oil after the rose mask! The mask left my skin feeling light and dewy. Then adding the rose oil helped my skin feel moisturized! I have been looking for a face oil and really enjoyed this product! I recurved this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer for dry skin . The moisturizer was much thicker than I thought it would be, but it did a great job of soothing my dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: My skin seems to be soaking up this serum every day! My skin feels softer and better each day. I received this free from Influenster

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have very sensitive and dry skin. This is so hydrating and leaves my skin silky smooth. It does the job of a toner and a moisturizer at the same time. Definitely a great product and a must have in your skincare. So happy with my purchase! Give it a try, your skin will love it.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for 3 months now , and I can clearly see the results. I use it twice a day, in the day under my sunscreen and at night under my pm moisturizer. My skin is so much better. My acne scars have reduced and I can see them in the fading process!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser. It foams so well and leaves my skin so fresh. Must try if you have sensitive skin. It is so light and gentle.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This face mask is super hydrating! I absolutely love it. It does leave your pillowcase slightly greasy and has a yellow tinge to it, but I still think it’s 100% worth it. My skin is glowing by morning. It’s a must have if you live somewhere with a dry winter like me!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: This face mask is super hydrating! I absolutely love it. It does leave your pillowcase slightly greasy and has a yellow tinge to it, but I still think it’s 100% worth it. My skin is glowing by morning. It’s a must have if you live somewhere with a dry winter like me!

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is very hydrating and has made a noticeable difference in my dark under eye area. I continue to use my eye cream with retinol in my evening routine, but this is perfect for the mornings! Makes you look bright and refreshed! I haven’t noticed any difference in fine lines, but it definitely does what it says and I have zero complaints!

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: The only thing I don’t like about this serum is the price because now I’m officially addicted. My skin typically is dry and dull - this serum didn’t dry it out (I used it with my same vit c oil and moisturizer that I always use) and after a couple weeks, my skin looks amazing. So glowing! I don’t have enough good things to say about this, it will become a regular staple in my skincare routine going forward!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from dermalogica. This was my first time using a pre-cleanse so I was very hesitant. It turned out to be really easy to use. It takes off your make up very fast, it’s very light weight so it spreads very smooth and it has a very nice scent! This is so much better than using make up wipes! My skin felt very hydrated afterwards. Although it says it is used mostly for oily skin I feel like it still feels nice on my dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from dermalogica. This was my first time using a pre-cleanse so I was very hesitant. It turned out to be really easy to use. It takes off your make up very fast, it’s very light weight so it spreads very smooth and it has a very nice scent! This is so much better than using make up wipes! My skin felt very hydrated afterwards. Although it says it is used mostly for oily skin I feel like it still feels nice on my dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product was honestly soooo good. I was really glad it didn’t break up the make up on my face. I even had my sister try it and she loved it even more than I did. My face felt really smooth and my makeup applied really nicely.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: I’ve been so excited to try this and it didn’t disappoint!! Firstly, the tip applicator was very unique it’s more pointed to fit your lips better which is great. I have very dry lips and the hydration is spot on. It’s not thin or thick it’s somewhere in the middle. The scent isn’t overbearing at all. When I compare it to another brand like Rhode’s I would choose SF’s every time. The bottle is the perfect size and doesn’t soak in quickly so you’re not having to reapply constantly. I will definitely get the colored ones now.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: Been using it as part of my nighttime routine and i love it! It has been helping my dark circles

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: Love this i received a sample of this and i keep it in my purse it’s been keeping my face refreshed during this cold winter

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love it I’ve been using it as part of my skin care routine for about 2 weeks and i feel it leaves my skin feeling soft and tight

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I liked the hydration this product provided as well as the smell! Great for dry skin. It is a gel, so make sure the product is dry before applying makeup, as it can be a little sticky.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: This toner is a must have for the summer months! It hydrates your skin and works really well with my sensitive skin. It’s a very nice base in the day time, and leaves you with a dewy face before moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this product and loved it. It has a gel consistency which is very refreshing. It gives your skin a nice dewy look and I find it to be perfect to prep your skin before makeup.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: Watermelon scent always sucks me in lol. I love these for traveling.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: As always, I love everything I have ever used from this brand. This is hydrating and makes my skin feel soft. I  don’t have sensitive skin so most of the products from ole Hendrikson  works great for me.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_title: Non sticky, fights aging in face
reviews.review_text: I received this item through influenster. I wasn’t really sure at first what to expect. I’ve never really tried anything on my face that supposed to help fight aging in your face. I started using this when I got the box about 3 weeks ago, and I’ve found that my skin feels a little but more tight and moisturized. I recommend using it at night after you wash your face, I did try using it with my morning skin face routine but found that it kind of affects the application of my make up. The serum is very light weight, and I don’t think it feels sticky at all. It doesn’t have a scent, so it doesn’t bother me either. Overall, I felt it was a good product and I would definitely recommend it to others.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: I received this mask for free, complimentary to test out from influenster. This mask is honestly very very lovely. It has a nice, calming scent. And the charcoal and honey really help to moisturize my face, just after one use. I have very dry skin, not oily whatsoever, and this moisturizing effect is super important for me. I do have acne prone skin, but I think it’s more from my skin being dry. The instructions do say to use it once a week, however I will more than likely use it at least twice a week so that I can counter the dryness I experience in my skin. Because honey is a natural antibacterial I would expect it to also help with acne in the long run, after several uses of course. This is a great product that they’ve put out, and the nice scent made it a nice after work treat to come down to! I did open up my pores first with a warm towel so that the mask could really dig into the impurities.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have acne prone skin, so finding a cleanser can be very difficult for me. This cleanser so far has been amazing. It didn’t clear my acne, but I have seen an improvement. My skin has also just looked all around a lot better. I’ve been using the product for almost a month now, provided to me complimentary to test out. It’s very gentle and soft. A tiny amount lathers up very nicely, so even though it is on the pricey side of cleansers a little goes a long way and I foresee it lasting me some time. This is easily the best cleanser I have ever used and I’d recommend it to anyone.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have acne prone skin, so finding a cleanser can be very difficult for me. This cleanser so far has been amazing. It didn’t clear my acne, but I have seen an improvement. My skin has also just looked all around a lot better. I’ve been using the product for almost a month now, provided to me complimentary to test out. It’s very gentle and soft. This is easily the best cleanser I have ever used and I’d recommend it to anyone.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_title: A Serum for Naturally Dehydrated Skin.
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product as apart of my (nearly) everyday skincare routine. It works wonders for those who have problems with legitimately dry, and as a result, dull skin like I do. Using more then 3-4 drops is over-kill, after using this serum I use either the Squalane + Omega Repair Cream or the Squalane + Probiotic Gel Moisturizer. It keeps my dry, tired, and over-it skin moisturizer all-day or until the next morning (when I use it as nighttime regimen). However, because I have pre-existing skin condition called eczema, which is why I stated earlier that it’s nearly apart of my everyday routine, when flare-up start it’ll exacerbate the problem. In general, this is great product for what it’s intended for, naturally dehydrated, dull, and as result of the dryness; wrinkled skin. To use it for anything other then that defeats this products purpose. Listen to your skin, be kind to your skin, love your skin.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing moisturizer!I don’t normally use exclamation points but this product is worth it. I mainly use this product as a nighttime moisturizer, after I apply either the Biossance Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Oil or the Biossance Phyto-Retinol Serum. After I use it, I notice that my skin looks and sometimes feels renewed (“refreshed“ is impossible, without a latte macchiato in hand). It’s almost as like you wore highlighter to bed and it didn’t come off on the pillow, your skin looks dewy and feels hydrated after a hard night sleep.First, all you’ll need is 1-2 dime size dollops of the product, warmed up in your hands, and it smoothly glides across and nourishes every part of your face and neck. Using too much, it’ll start to feel heavy.Understandably, for some individuals this product will be too rich for their skin, this product is made for those with naturally dehydrated skin (like mine). It doesn’t always matter how much or how often you stay hydrated, sometimes your skin needs a little boost from your skincare routine. The omega fatty acids and hyaluronic acids in this product will do the exactly that, give your skin the boost it desperately needs. I cannot complain when I have an eczema flare-up either, it doesn’t irritate the outbreak spots at all. Seriously, my desert-skinned sisters, try it. Listen to your skin, be kind to your skin, love your skin.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I rave about this product to others who have difficulty with redness. Personally, this product over time has corrected the redness I’ve had since High School; however, this didn’t magically do it all, alone. I changed my skin care routine first, to washing my face once a week, using a skin texture correcting solution, and moisturizing twice a day (dry skin). I had to use this product on a moisturized face first, or else it would look chalky on my skin. Additionally, I only used it during the day when I was going to outside and immediately took it off with micellar water when I was done with the day. All-in-all, give it time, stay moisturized (if you need it), eventually you’ll be using this in replacement of foundation.

reviews.review_text: I haven’t used a toner in a very long time.  This doesn’t irritate my skin or make my dry skin even drier, which I like.  What I don’t care for, however, is the smell.  It is a very strong orange essence smell for me.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Kiehl’s ultra facial moisturizing cream with squalaneAbout me: Almost 40, dry skin, some fine lines and wrinkles, light, always burns skin.First impressions: It’s got an almost gel-like feeling at first.  I thought for sure, it would leave some greasiness behind or feel really thick on my skin, but I was pleasantly surprised.I found this cream to be really thick and moisturizing, but it’s not heavy by any means.  It soaks in quickly and doesn’t leave any greasiness behind. It feels rich on my skin, but it feels lightweight.  Afterwards, my skin felt smoother and well hydrated all day long.  I also found it was a great addition to my normal skincare regimen, letting all the serums soak in properly.  After using it for a few days, I can say that the moisture “locks in” all day long, making my skin feel moisturized, soft, and supple.  I would definitely be adding this to my normal skincare regimen.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am a 40 year old with dry skin (live in a dry climate too, which makes it worse) and fine lines and wrinkles. I found this cream to be super thick and rich feeling on my skin, but it didn’t feel heavy or oily.  It wore really well under makeup as well. It hydrated my skin quite well overall.  In using it just one week, I found my skin was plumper and more moisturized, and  I had fewer dry spots on my face.  The only two downfalls I found were 1) the jar format, which is an issue for other moisturizers as well, but I use a silicone brush to apply, and 2) the scent is pretty strong, but again, I find this an issue with other moisturizers that I like as well.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Compared to tatcha’s silk and indigo creams, this product is so thin. I didn’t find it to be adequately hydrating. If you are looking for truly luxurious moisture, reach for their silk cream. That is probably one of the best moisturizers I’ve ever used.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Compared to tatcha’s silk and indigo creams, this product is so thin. I didn’t find it to be adequately hydrating. If you are looking for truly luxurious moisture, reach for their silk cream. That is probably one of the best moisturizers I’ve ever used.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way for this product. It’s heavy, so I find myself using it as a night cream and question how practical it’ll be for regular summer use. My skin tone evenness, texture and hydration has improved noticeably since adding this to my regimen. I find the results comparable to tatcha’s indigo cream for correcting redness too.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: It pains me to say this; I had visible results with this product but can’t use it. I have fairly sensitive eyes and when I rubbed my eyes throughout the day after using this serum, my eyes would burn as if I had just cut onions. I’ve never had this problem with other eye serums and am such a fan girl for DE products. I would recommend getting a sample to try to see if you have the same problem. Again, I loved the results but just couldn’t tolerate my eyes burning when I rubbed them.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_title: does nothing you want it to do
reviews.review_text: I used the entire pack of these as directed and I just felt like they are overpriced blotting papers that stay on your face for 4-6 hours. Saw little oil spots but never any blackhead “gunk”. I actually thought they made the pores on my nose a lot more noticeable. Disappointing considering I love the little acne dots peace out does.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_title: my favorite and I’ve tried a lot
reviews.review_text: Ole Henriksen products were some of the first skincare products I bought at Sephora almost a decade ago. I’m a serial product hopper but recently have cycled back to the brand. And oh my gosh, after revisiting their toner this will be a staple of my skincare regimen. It has a refreshing cooling sensation and adequately preps my skin for my remaining skincare. I can’t credit all of my skin improvements to this product but it definitely works synergistically with my other products to give me the best skin I’ve had in years. Also if you like this you will love the sauna scrub in the green bottle from ole too!!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Tried this after reading a review comparing it to DE’s babyfacial. This product really knocks it out of the park for me and the price point is amazing. I use it every week or week and a half depending on how my skin is. I’m just amazed with the results I’ve had!! Super soft skin afterwards and in conjunction with my current regimen is fading hyperpigmentation caused from acne.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I love the ease of use and how it feels on my lips, but I think if I only used this it would dry out my lips. I use a lip mask at night and algenists collagen lip serum, as well as the Jack black lip balms. I like these because the scent/texture is indulgent. The coconut to me is very pina colada/good suntan lotion scent. I think if I used this exclusively I would benefit from using a lip scrub regularly. I don’t use this outdoors either because it has no SPF. The jack black balms (7 dollars) are a good complement to these if you’re going to have sun exposure.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: My skin is irritation and acne prone, and tends to run dry rather than oily. This winter my skin has really needed a little extra moisture, so I decided to give this serum a try. It’s not really doing much, but it’s not irritating or breaking out my skin either. At this price point I wish I would’ve picked up another bottle of edible beauty’s goddess serum instead of this.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_title: Amazing Sunscreen for Mom on the go!
reviews.review_text: Since moving to Florida last fall, sunscreen has become my number 1 face product. I love the high SPF (50) as well as how lightweight it feels on my face. It’s also super hydrating and lightweight for everyday use. It’s perfect to layer under my make up for every day use and strong enough for our beach weekends. Lastly, it makes me so happy to see that this product is reef safe so I don’t worry about it when getting into the ocean with my little guy.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This lip color  that was complimentary from Fresh is absolutely perfect for being on the go. It’s a great sheer color and I love having it in my purse. My lips feel nice and moisturized throughout the day without being too sticky or glossy.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_title: Perfect addition to my daily routine
reviews.review_text: I love this serum. It felts so silky going onto my skin. I could see a huge difference in how hydrated my skin felt and looked after a week of using it. I will absolutely be adding this to my daily routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: My skin feels so smooth after using this daily microfoliant gifted by dermalogica in the mornings. My make up goes on so much smoother and I’ve been using less since my skin looks so good! Highly recommend to anyone looking to love their skin again!

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: My skin feels so smooth after using this daily microfoliant gifted by dermalogica in the mornings. My make up goes on so much smoother and I’ve been using less since my skin looks so good! Highly recommend to anyone looking to love their skin again!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_title: Fabulous Add to my Night Routine
reviews.review_text: This retinol is great. It feels silky going on. I’ve been using this for a little over a week and I can already see a huge difference in my forehead. I look forward to seeing the results in a few months

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_title: Fabulous Add to my Night Routine
