reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is life changing!!! It goes on smooth, creamy, without feeling heavy and greasy. I got sunburnt at the beach and this moisturizer def helped calm my burn down and help me not to peel! It has a light scent. I loved it!

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I absolutely fell in love with this product!!! Within just a couple weeks of using it I noticed a huge difference in my fine lines and wrinkles.  The product does a great job of moisturizing without leaving a greasy film (and helped tremendously when I got sunburnt at the beach). The smell is nice yet subtle. Even friends recognized a difference on my wrinkles and asked if i had gotten my Botox recently lol!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_title: Eh, it’s nothing to write home about
reviews.review_text: I received this, and totally wanted to love it, I love the smell, the way it goes on, and the fact that a little goes a long way. But I Will be completely honest, for the cost I don’t think It works as well as others I have used. It could just be me, but I wouldn’t spend this amount on something I didn’t absolutely love and couldn’t tell a difference in my skin.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: GO BUY THIS NOW!!!! This is such an awesome product! Ultra light weight without being too runny! I have dry skin and I’m always looking for a little extra kick to add to my moisturizer. This is  exactly  what I needed. Brightened everything  up, leaves me looking dewy but not oily looking! Scent is light but pleasant and the pump bottle gives just the right amount for a full face. Using am & pm and will buy when this bottle runs out!! Seriously one of the most amazing products I have come across in a very long time!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I love Clarins! Their products are phenomenal! This serum is amazing! I noticed a difference in my face within just a couple of uses! Their products might be a little more expensive but you get what you pay for, it is so worth every single penny!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Such a great face cream! After using for a month I could tell a huge difference in my face and fine lines and wrinkles! I highly recommend this! The smell was a little weird at first but you get used to it!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I added The Inkey List Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum to my beauty regimen. This hydrates my face immediately, and keeps my skin so soft. I really liked it. I would recommend this product to anyone wanting softer skin.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. This Daily-Greens Oil-Free, Gel Moisturizer works great. It hydrated my skin. It smells great. You can apply in the morning and at night. It’s very lightweight, and does not leave my skin shiny or oily. I would recommend this product.#greensforall#@FarmacyBeauty

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I think this DR Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel worked really well. It made my skin feel balanced and soft. It helped alot with oily spots on my face. I really liked it. I would recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this Sunday Riley Good Genes! This all-in-one lactic acid treatment worked great for me. It did not dry my skin. It made my pores less visible. My skin felt so soft, and I haven’t had any breakouts, since I started using it. I see a visible difference in my wrinkles also. I am definitely adding this to my daily beauty regimen. I recommend this Sunday Riley Good Genes Treatment. I got this complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This bareMinerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum works great. It made my skin so soft.  It wasn’t too oily like some serums. I am 45 years old, and I always worry about wrinkles and aging. This is the perfect serum for me. I recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: LOVE! This product completely balances out my skin and has made a huge difference with how my skin looks. Game changer and staple for my routine now

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: LOVE! This product completely balances out my skin and has made a huge difference with how my skin looks. Game changer and staple for my routine now

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: If you have sensitive and sensitized  skin this product will help calm you.  I’ve gone through two tubes of this in less than four months. That’s how much I like it. I only use it at night and the my skin is inflamed or overly sensitized (which can be often during the summer being outside for long periods often). When I wake up I can see a visible difference and calmness in my skin the next morning I use this.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product! I received this as a sample and it made sucked a difference in the smoothness of my under eye that I had to purchase it!

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_title: pretty good for dry skin I think
reviews.review_text: I received this cream as a sample along with one of their eye creams (auto correct) which I fell in love with. This cream is great for night but only if you’re extremely dry in my opinion. I have dryer combo skin and this will be something I will love to use in the middle of winter when my skin is really chapped.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I am a licensed Beauty professional and product junkie for 15+ years. This eye cream has completely blown me away with my expectations for what it could do. This is amazing for all skin types and a great makeup eye primer! Skin around my eye is visibly smoother, plump, and more bright.  The thing I’m most impressed about is how it’s smoothed my fine line crows feet!

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to love this product, and while I liked that it didn’t have a strong scent, and it went on smooth....it left my lips feeling more dry than they had before I used it.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This night serum is an amazing product! It is incredibly lightweight and silky. Your skin will feel amazing after using this product! I combined it with the LaLa Retro Whipped Cream at night and my skin felt so amazing in the morning. I have issues with dry skin and this was hydrating but not heavy!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this cleanser but it wasn’t my favorite. The jelly worked ok, but my face felt dry after using it and I had a few minor breakouts after a couple of uses. I am assuming this was the cause. I didn’t feel like it cleaned my face more than other cleansers I have tried either that have worked better for me.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I loved the feel of this rescue cream. I followed the instructions they sent me and mixed it with the night serum. It is incredibly hydrating and my skin felt so soft even after the first day that I used it. I liked the unique container that it comes in, and one pump of the product was plenty for me. It is a very thick lotion, so if you have sensitive skin or acne prone skin this may not be the choice for you.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is incredibly hydrating and a little goes a LONG way.  I used a full pump the first time and it was way too much. A half pump is more than enough! I just have some fine lines under my eyes that I am trying to deal with and I am hoping that by using this nightly, I  should see a difference! I appreciate that these products don’t have a strong odor and leave my skin feeling silky smooth!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I love how lightweight this rose oil is. It isn’t greasy at all and absorbs into your skin immediately. I used it alone and added it to my daily moisturizer. I am very sensitive to smells and this doesn’t have a strong scent at all. The packaging is beautiful and I can’t wait to see my long term results!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a very hydrating, creamy moisturizer. I only had a sample size to test but I liked that it was so rich feeling and had little to no scent.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a very hydrating, creamy moisturizer. I only had a sample size to test but I liked that it was so rich feeling and had little to no scent.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a very small sample size of this product to try. I used it nightly on my neck and decolletage. It is very moisturizing and while I didn’t have major changes in just a few days, I like that it was unscented and made my skin feel soft.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing! I’ve been using the Clinique one for years and wanted to try something new and I’m so happy I did! This stuff takes all of your makeup off! Like all of it!! It also comes with a little scoop which I love. I didn’t expect anything but perfection from this brand they kill it everytime!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing! I’ve been using the Clinique one for years and wanted to try something new and I’m so happy I did! This stuff takes all of your makeup off! Like all of it!! It also comes with a little scoop which I love. I didn’t expect anything but perfection from this brand they kill it everytime!

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I mean there isn’t enough good things I can say about this mask. If you have redness you can literally see this mask taking it away as it’s on. It makes your skin flawless and it’s amazing for acne prone skin. I’ll seriously cry if this is ever discontinued.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This stuff is ok. It does smell really nice but it doesn’t sink in like other moisturizers and it honestly feels really sticky.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I think the formula changed. I used to use this and had great results so I ordered it again month and not only did I see no difference to skin but it also caused breakouts on my chin and neck. I don’t get why companies ruin a great product buy changing it. This stuff used to be amazing. I’m waiting for my local Sephora to open back up so I can return this.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing! I put it on my dry face and rub all of my makeup around then I add water and do the same then rinse off. Takes everything off and I love the clean smell it has. Another winner from DE!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This stuff is incredible and the price is unreal for how well it works. I’m not gonna lie I wasn’t expecting much because of the cost but this is the ONLY product that has helped my stubborn skin. My pores were huge, face redness and stubborn pimples but literally because of this and a couple of other things my face is in the best shape it’s ever been. I mainly credit this for doing it though. I would give this 100 stars if I could.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Smells great and takes everything off! With other balms I would have to use it twice to get all of the Makeup off but not with this one. The only thing I don’t like is that is doesn’t wash off easily but I realized a little goes a long way. If you use too much it leaves a weird residue.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: This broke me out so bad and my skin can take anything! I’m still trying to fix my face!

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I bought this product because of several recommendations, especially from Ingrid on YouTube. I waited until I finished the entire jar before writing this review. It took me about 4 months.. just finished yesterday, and I’m super disappointed with this product. It looks great and has a beautiful, light peachy hue, but other than that, it did not hydrate my lips at all. In fact, I felt like this made my lips even drier the longer I used it.. Overall, NOT WORTH THE HYPE. I just switched to primera’s lip mask last week and that one is cheaper and actually hydrated my lips so much more!

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: This stuff actually works. I bought this in July 2020 after my friend recommended it to me. She has perfect skin and it made her luminous. But when I first used it, it made me look super sweaty af. I kinda put it away for a second but one day realized my skin looked dry after putting on makeup. I layered this on top then put on some setting spray and VOILA, my skin looked glowy just like the way my friend’s did. I would reocmmend this product if you are on the drier side

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I’ve been on the hunt for a lip mask for SOOO LONG and decided to buy both the Laneige and the Tatcha one. I definitely like the Laneige one more. Despite the lower price, that one just hydrated my lips more. This tatcha one isn’t really great for overnight - just felt like a sticky lip gloss. Now, I just wear this during the day.. I’m honestly not sure if I would repurchase this

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this toner. I love this and the Paula’s Choice BHA liquid exfoliant but prefer this one because of the thick consistency!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this toner. I love this and the Paula’s Choice BHA liquid exfoliant but prefer this one because of the thick consistency!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I quit makeup wipes and have been using this religiously. It really cleans off all your makeup before going into a cleanser, and I love the minty fresh feeling it gives off.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I quit makeup wipes and have been using this religiously. It really cleans off all your makeup before going into a cleanser, and I love the minty fresh feeling it gives off.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This is super glowy. I love the glass skin effect it gives to your face. It’s super versatile as well. You can use it as a serum before your moisturizer, you can mix it in with your foundation for a more hydrating finish, OR you can use this as a makeup primer (my favorite way to use it)

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: The packaging is so pretty. It looks like an emerald gem. The serum is a creamy and very lightweight. A pump is enough for whole face. I like how easily it can be used to smooth skin. Highly recommend to use at night time!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Dermalogica sampling. This has literally made my skin glow! When I feel congested or if a breakout is coming soon, this stuff will wipe away all of that and reveal smooth, glowy skin underneath. This has been such a lifesaver as I’ve been eating unhealthy on vacation. Highly recommend! I can’t wait to buy the full size

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Dermalogica sampling. This has literally made my skin glow! This has been such a lifesaver as I’ve been eating unhealthy on vacation. Highly recommend! I can’t wait to buy the full size

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Love, love, love. Feels like magic going on. Heads up -- if you are using Vitamin C, use apart from this product; e.g. C in  the morning and this at night, as it can cancel out the Vitamin C (per this product’s directions). I have sensitive skin, with classic t-zone areas that get oily and clog; this helps, but mainly seems to be a hearty dose of something good that my entire face likes. Even if it did nothing I might put it on just for the feeling it gives going on. OK obviously not, but it feels soooo great as it sinks into my skin. Cannot begin to beat the price on this stuff.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Fantastic- restored my skin!! A must!
reviews.review_text: This cleanser has been a game changer for me and I am so grateful!!  My face was a mess- red and dry from cold but getting oily during day.  In the store, a Sephora staffer recommended this, and literally my skin calmed on the first usage.  I was getting oily bc my face was being stripped, and that stopped too.  This may be the first cleanser I’ve ever used that restores balance, and I’m 52, and used some quality products.  No problems or allergic reactions from my sensitive skin.   The smell and texture are wonderful; washing with Korres is a lovely experience.  When I double cleanse, I use this after Tatcha cleansing oil or CeraVe cleansing water.  I think it would take a winning lottery ticket to get me to try another cleanser, and even then I’m not sure I would.  This product restores such balance to your skin!

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I was SO skeptical about oil cleansers; but fortunately I was recommended a sample of this by the store; liked that well enough to order a larger sample with a promo ... and found myself buying the product.  Feels wonderful, cleans so very well, leaves skin soft, not overly dry by any means, and soothed.  Love it.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love. Melts into your skin; feels like nothing. I have historically worn Elta MD tinted moisturizer which is also a terrific product but am changing up my routine and Elta was too heavy.  I am 50 years old, have clogged pores n my nose and chin, normal forehead area, and very dry skin elsewhere (cheeks).  I felt that this sunscreen handled all areas of my face equally well. I selected a sample with one order and it only took one application to lead to me ordering.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love. Melts into your skin; feels like nothing. reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I have had very good success with this product. I actually use it at night, even though Ole makes a nigh sleeping creme version. Before this I used retinol or SkinBetter retinol products, and this is just as effective but without all the harsh and drying effects. So, really, maybe it works better -- because I can use it frequently.  Seems to have a nice moisturizing impact as well, and easily layers with other products. My skin does not do well with heavy creams and this is a good consistency for me.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: Can I give it 6  stars????  I was fortunate enough to be selected to receive the VoxBox with Dr. Hart’s products and this is my absolute favorite cream ever!!! I am even wearing it as primer. It works perfectly as primer. It has almost no scent, feels silky and delightfully light. It moisturizes even the driest skin and it is so gentle!! Even my husband (hyper sensitive skin and rosacea) loves it. A definite must have if you have super dry skin patches (like me), super sensitive skin (like my husband) worth every penny. I do have to disclose I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using the serum for about 10 days. I received it on a VoxBox for review purposes, and I feel like the luckiest gal ever!!! The box’s arrival coincided with my period and this serum and the most have made a world of difference! My chin is not breaking out like I’m 12 years old. The few little bumps I have are much smaller than usual, less red, and the skin around it less dry. The scent is very delicate and almost imperceptible. My skin feels fresher, more even toned. I will definitely buy again when I run out, this is a must have for me, and a few drops go a long way. I also love the packaging, it feels like a quality product the second you get it. From the box to the bottle and it’s content.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way. I received a sample as part of a complimentary package from Dr. Jart for review purposes and I love it!! It doesn’t affect my makeup application, and it does precisely what it states. It helps even out your skin tone, and minimizes redness. I will absolutely be buying more soon!

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way. I received a sample as part of a complimentary package from Dr. Jart for review purposes and I love it!! reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I am IN LOVE with this cream!! It hydrated my face even better than my Dior cream for a fraction of the price. I have extremely dry skin on my chin and nose, and it has really made a remarkable difference. I already bought a full size tub. It even moisturizes my hands as I apply it. It is velvety and dewy. I just adore it.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: It hydrated without over saturation. It does not interfere with my usual makeup routine, and it leaves my skin. Silky soft. Highly recommended!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: A beautifully hydrating sunblock that is perfect for daily wear. In my experience, it did not interfere with my usual makeup routine and makes my pores look smaller when I wear it by itself. It is Unscented and a little goes a long way. Great value.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I recieved GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfloliator complimentary from Goop and I am so glad I did! I am in love with this exfoliator!! I can tell a major difference since I have started using it. I have fewer breakouts and my face looks and feels so soft. It has a nice whipped texture that isn’t rough on your face like most exfoliators. Definitely a favorite in my skin-care routine. I would highly recommend this product!

reviews.review_text: I recieved this product complimentary from Fresh. I absolutely love the Fresh Rose Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer. reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I love the Summer Friday Jet Lag Mask. I use this as a night time moisturizer/overnight mask. My face feels super hydrated and refreshed in the mornings after using this. I will definitely be buying this again!! I highly recommend trying this.

reviews.review_text: I loved this product! It was so cooling on my skin and refreshing. Since it’s fragrance free there’s no strong artificial scent but for me I do smell a hint of avocado and cucumber which I really like. It’s VERY light weight and absorbs into the skin really really easily

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love the scent of this, it’s a light rose scent that isn’t too overwhelming. I don’t know if it’s a natural scent or artificial but like I said before it’s not overwhelming. The container is nice and heavy which feels very nice. This hydrates my skin so well, and has a nice thin consistency which I like.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this bottle complimentary from Influenster and this thing is amazing and is now a part of my daily skincare routine. reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_title: absolute game changer for your skin
reviews.review_text: I am so  beyond pleasantly surprised by this product, and the whole DE brand. Up until now I thought I had sensitive skin and mild rosacea. I have always been advised against products like these, because they are strong and supposedly irritating to sensitive skin. Well turns out this product not only reduces redness, pores, balances my skin, and makes it super soft, but it actually treats it too. My skin has been less red and more even and balanced since I started using this product. No more dry patches !! I have only used it 3 times, weekly for 20 mins. Amazing results. TRY IT !! Don’t waste your money on professional chemical peels, this is a weekly routine your face will love, gentle yet so effective.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Not my fav from he DE line
reviews.review_text: I think Protini is my least favorite from the DE line and I have tried all the products except the eye creams. It’s got a stickier texture and it’s not a refreshing gel like b-hydra or a fluffy thick moisturizer like lala. It’s a light moisturizer but i don’t feel like my face is moisturized if i just apply it. It’s supposed to supplement your other creams - like a shot of protein - and I don’t like that, i prefer to use less products if possible, especially since you can find serums and creams that have peptides already. In terms of ani-aging properties, it is hard to tell if it works or not, i use it almost daily and can’t say i see other changes than before. The DE line is pretty awesome in general but I don’t think this cream fits in my routine.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this thing, it has so much exfoliation yet it is so gentle on the skin. I have sensitive skin and this product only makes my skin better, no irritation, no dryness, just very soft skin, less redness.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_title: not sure it’s effective for me
reviews.review_text: I have dry patches on my cheeks and have to use peels to keep the texture under control. I love DE mask and got this one bc lots of people said it works the same, but I can’t see the same results or resemblance. It’s hard to apply it bc it’s very watery so I can’t layer it thick like I like my masks. Regardless of the consistency I don’t get that deep clean feel that I do after the baby facial and don’t feel like it’s getting rid of my dry patches. I don’t get the tingle at all that I usually get with acid masks ..don’t think I’ll repurchase unless I am on a tight budget.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for over a year now and I don’t know what I’d do without it. I use it as the base for my skincare routine morning and night. I pump one pump of the product on to the surface, then mix in my other DE products like C-Firma, A-Passioni Retinol at night, along with the Virgin Marula oil. It keeps the oil at bay while giving me the perfect amount of moisture. I would recommend trying this on its own first. When I first bought this, I thought it was causing me to break out but it was actually a toner I’d also bought around the same time. After that, it has never broken me out and I switched to only using DE products on my skin. They are worth the investment and I couldn’t be happier. Save your money at the dermatologist and invest in DE instead.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: “All you Need“ serum is definitely a must-have! This product is a great addition to my skincare routine, and brings my skin a great feeling - more elasticity and visibly plumper. I love the pump bottle, very practical and easy to use. I love to use on my 3rd and 4th day of my skin cycling. This product was gifted by Alegnist, but I will buy it for sure and will recommend to my friends and family.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Love this mask. Smells good and does the job!  My lips feel way better in the morning. I still need chapstick throughout the day but this definitely helps with keeping them soft and moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Love it!!  It’s the perfect gloss, not sticky at all. It leaves my lips a soft pink, not too light.  Once the gloss had kind of absorbed, my lips feel super moisturized and silky.  I’m getting more colors!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have normal/slightly combo skin.  I only took one star away because it’s too moisturizing for my face.  So it sits on my skin a tad and makes me oily.  But the product is great.  So if you need some moisture in your life this is the moisturizer for you.  I now use their gel moisturizer everyday and I’m never switching!

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: This has literally changed the texture and color of my face.  My skin tone is so much more even and not as red. I always have one or two deep hormonal acne spots on my face and now they’re gone within weeks of starting to use this.  I only use it twice a week, so my face won’t peel.  It’s string, a little goes a long way!  The best!!!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It’s a no for me. It’s fine, but too thick.  It also smells like sunscreen.  I guess if you have extremely dry skin this would work well, but I felt like my face wasn’t absorbing it.  It just kinda sat there.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: If I could give this ten stars I would. I am so confused by the other reviews. I have sensitive, acne prone skin.  My acne is hormonal with sometimes the ones that are so deep, they don’t go away and kill.  This wiped my face clear within one week of using. My skin hasn’t been this clear in years. It even helped with my black heads on my chin and nose.  My face isn’t perfect, but I’ve only gotten smaller spots of acne that go away within a few days if I don’t touch them.  I love the consistency, a little goes a long way.  It’s almost like a thick serum but once you add water to your face it has a really nice lather. My face feels so soft and smooth after I wash it. This has not irritated my skin once or done anything weird in the month I’ve used it.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: get to the best layer of your face
reviews.review_text: I got try try Dr. Dennis Gross daily peel to leave my honest opinion, I really loved it my face felt refreshed and like all the dead skin was wiped clean from my face, Also I love that it’s in those convenient wipes. I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I’m really excited to get more of Peace out wrinkles,I could feel it working, the 3 times I used it I took the advice of the product leaving it on over night while I slept, I noticed a very big difference. My fine lines under my eyes were less obvious. I can’t wait to purchase more of Peace out wrinkles and try other products that they have.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this Inkey list serum, the product glides over your skin and it’s like you can feel your face sucking in all the nutrients, My suggestion wait 3 minutes before you add lotion on top, your make up will look so perfect.  I also really liked the subtle smell of the product, I highly recommend giving  The Inkey List a try

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the Bareminerals brand they make amazing products I got to try this product for free for my honest review. I love it!! left my skin glowing I have already recommended this skinlongevity to a few friends the product smaells amazing as well

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_title: Try it! you will be amazed!
reviews.review_text: This Shani Darden skin care retinol reform is amazing, my skin drinks it up, I have to say when I try a new product I can’t tell if  it’s working for me till after a month of using it. The Shani Darden showed me results in a matter of 3 days! I love it, plan on The Shani Darden skin care retinol being my next purchase pick

reviews.review_text: Creme geniale. Une sensatiin de fraicheur à l application. Pas d odeur forte et penetre instantanement. Fan de tatcha.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Creme geniale. Une sensatiin de fraicheur à l application. Pas d odeur forte et penetre instantanement. Fan de tatcha.

reviews.review_text: Odeur super agreable, léger et agreable à appliquer avec la main. Texture un peu “gluante“ qui n est absolument pas derangeabte.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Odeur super agreable, léger et agreable à appliquer avec la main. Texture un peu “gluante“ qui n est absolument pas derangeabte.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: Je l applique tous les soirs, et ma peau à moins de taches. J applique un ecran solaire le matin afin de preserver les bienfaits.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: C est plus un baume qu une creme, mais qui reste leger sur la peau. Donne une sensation de fraicheur à l application et à un effet un peu “flouteur“. Parfait.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Ma peau est beaucoup us nette et moins rouge. Je l utilise le matin, le soir le serum c violet de Tatcha. Ma peau est transformee.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is my all time favorite lip balm. It is so hydrating and unlike drugstore lip balms it doesn’t make your lips peel or more dry later. Applying it gives you immediate moister to the lips and a nice tint of color. I literally use this every single day, I used up an entire tube which is a first for me and I bought a second tube because I love it so much. The price seems quite high for just a lip balm but I think it’s totally worth it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: if your lips are dry just wear this over night and in the morning they are nice and hydrated, I love how there’s no overpowering smell like some products do, highly recommend especially during the dry winter time. I also like that it comes with a little spatula to keep the product clean and is easy to scoop out.

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: I love the smell, it reminds me of being on vacation. This is my first product from this brand so I can’t say if it smells like the Bum Bum cream but this lip butter smells really good. It’s also nice and hydrating without being sticky or too glossy.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best sunscreens that I have tried. I like to glide it on my face and then rub it in with my fingers a little bit to make the application more even. It seems greasy at first but once it sets it doesn’t feel greasy anymore. I also don’t break out from this sunscreen as I do with other sunscreens. Since it’s a clear stick, it doesn’t leave any white cast. This product also has a nice light and fresh smell.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This is one of my favorite sunscreens that I have tried. It doesn’t leave a white cast on my face and feels moisturizing while not feeling greasy. I’ve been wearing this every day for a few weeks and it doesn’t cause my skin to break out, for anyone else that is prone to breaking out from sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product is one of my mom’s favorite cleansers so I made sure to snatch the limited edition size for her! The ingredients are great for a gentle cleanse however I would recommend a double cleanse to ensure all your makeup, if any, is completely removed. She doesn’t really apply alot of makeup on a daily basis so this is perfect for her.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This year I finally hopped on the bandwagon of Korean beauty, particularly in the skincare department. There are just so many Korean brands that appear to know what they’re doing ingredient-wise and I’ve found that for my skin Dr. Jart  is one of them. Love the centella asiatica in this! I use a little dab of this on my cheeks (hyperpigmentation areas) and as the product name suggests, it helps color correct. On my light-medium skin tone the resulting “beige“ color blends out into my skin without any problem though I can see how this product may not be suitable for richer complexions.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: What should I say about this moisturizer? I’ve purchased this item thrice already. I appreciate the slight orangey scent as well as how hydrating and gentle it is on my sensitive skin. In general, every product I’ve tried from the OleHenriksen Truth line has preformed well on me (truth serum, banana bright eye cream and this moisturizer). The rest is up to you to decide!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Like Melting Water Drops on the Skin
reviews.review_text: They call this “Superfood AIR-WHIP Moisture Cream“ and I couldn’t agree more. This moisturizer feels like water droplets on the skin as you rub it in. I like the clean ingredients and even on my slightly sensitive skin, this product did not break me out (I’ve been using it for a little over a week). Only complaint is although I haven’t been using this product for that long, the amount of product seems to be going fairly quickly. Maybe I’m using too much to compensate for the very light, somewhat gel-like consistency of the product? It feels so thin and light-weight on the skin, but my skin is definitely being thoroughly hydrated... I would recommend   repurchase but only on sale!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: When I saw this in the store and saw the ingredients list, I really liked that it was a relatively gentle exfoliation compared to some others that aggressively scrub the skin. I used it for a solid week and I started noticing 2 whiteheads forming in different areas of my face. I stopped using it for a few weeks... Eventually I rediscovered it on my skincare shelf and decided to give it another try. Once again, after using it for like three days only at night, I had some tiny whiteheads forming again! I hadn’t incorporated any new products at/around that time so it makes sense that it’s this product.However, don’t let my own experience stop you from trying it out. My main advice is to ask for a sample before you purchase!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_title: Hydrating? Yes! Pore-tightening? I don't think so.
reviews.review_text: I wanted to try this product because of the good reviews and also because I love watermelons during the summer haha... For reference, I have combination skin that gets oiler during the summer months and this product has not broken me out yet. I have used this product every night for nearly 3 weeks now and the main difference I’ve noticed in my skin is that since I started applying this toner, my skin feels a bit softer, more hydrated and plumper to the touch. The consistency is somewhat stickier and less liquidy than other toners I’ve tried in the past; I’m assuming the cactus extract may have something to do with that? I honestly don’t mind it at all since it doesn’t leave a sticky residue on the skin. However, I have not seen any visible brightening or pore-tightening effects so far. That being said, I’m still planning on finishing this bottle for sure although I’m not sure if I’ll repurchase...

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_title: My Go-To Sunscreen (for the most part)
reviews.review_text: I think the Unseen Sunscreen is a great primer-like sunscreen in the sense that it really helps blur my pores a bit and smooth out my skin before applying any base makeup product and I find that on my skin it also helps the longevity of my makeup although I haven’t actually tested this theory out. I keep returning to this sunscreen anytime I want to apply makeup afterwards because of what it does for my skin’s appearance apart from providing SPF. The best part? NO WHITE CAST!

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_title: an unusual miss for a great brand
reviews.review_text: While I appreciate that Sephora has finally upgraded the PLAY! box selections (this month was fantastic), and I generally love SUNDAY RILEY, this serum didn’t do much for me. In fact, Rapid Flash magnified my most troublesome skin problem: the dry patch with large pores between my eyes on the bridge of my nose. But, it smells very nice, like fresh citrus fruit (unlike Good Genes, which is revolting, but works) and I enjoyed trying something new.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: Following the instructions is critical to the efficacy of this mask. Gently remove it using a warm, damp cloth. I couldn’t believe how fantastic my skin looked after the first use, and it just gets better. This is a STAPLE.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: To borrow a line from Tom Hanks in the movie BIG...I don’t get it. Is this a refreshing frippery, a preparatory base, a uniquely formulated setter? I’ve tried it every which way and I still don’t get it. It has no impact. It smells nice, the packaging is pretty, but I don’t understand its purpose. Tatcha is a great brand. LDSM is out of sync with their other products—all of which are carefully thought-out and highly effective, with a clearly defined purpose. This mist lacks intention but, if Tatcha returns to the proverbial drawing board, they’ll innovate a superior new product.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_title: loves it, needs it, respectfully demands more
reviews.review_text: Velvety smooth like Kopari’s coconut gloss but, instead of sitting atop your lips like an oil spill, Fresh’s balm is formulated to be evenly absorbed. If I don’t keep my lips hydrated during the winter months they get very dry, very fast—like clockwork. In the last few years I’ve probably tried three dozen different products. Sugar Lip Caramel is the only one that hits the ideal balm trifecta: 1. It truly, quickly hydrates. Great as a preemptive strike against dryness, AND those “Dear god, why do my lips feel like two slices of stale baguette??” rescue moments.2. It’s a flattering shade on everyone. Let’s face it: we wouldn’t be here if we weren’t a little vain, so why BS each other? I’ll ditch the most hydrating balm on earth if it makes me look weird. 3. Staying power. Unless I eat, this divine nectar shields me from croc-lips for several hours. That’s a pretty long time for any balm. One complaint: If we’re going to pay this much for a balm, we deserve more product. C’mon, Fresh...it’s the Higgs-Boson of balm canisters.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: One reviewer said this isn’t enough for dry skin, and she’s right. But my dry skin demands two moisturizers anyway: a water-based AND an organic, natural cream. That’s the dry life, babe! Until Tatcha WC, I’d never seen a moisturizer produce instantaneous results. Not even close.I’m 39 with healthy, very dry skin. I look for creams that mega-hydrate, but I always hope to find a diamond in the rough. Something to re-energize my skin, reactivate the color and firmness of my youth. A pipe dream, until this.Two days ago I spent $400 on new skincare products. Planned to overhaul my whole routine. I didn’t buy this, I snagged it as a reward. That night I tried my new Algenist anti-aging cream. It was very hydrating but left my skin dull, colorless. The Algenist cream’s consistency and scent are unappealing, at best. Kinda like rubbing your face with old pudding skin. Last night I reached for my Tatcha sample on a whim. My skin responded to this cream, dramatically, UPON CONTACT. My 25 year-old flesh materialized in the mirror. The long, gray winter has left my sun-craving skin pallid and dull. As I applied the Tatcha WC, I grew slightly tan and my cheeks’ natural, peachy hue resurfaced. My skin was crying out for something in this. It smells and feels wonderful. It’s a minor miracle. I’m lucky to have strong, clear skin, but time doesn’t discriminate. Age slowly diminishes the X factor of youthful beauty. Tatcha Water Cream restored mine. Thanks to my little 100-point reward, I stumbled upon an amazing combo. No BS, I haven’t felt so lovely in a decade. Yeah, I need a second cream to fully combat dryness, I just don’t care. [Products I used with Tatcha WC: Fresh Umbrian Clay Mask, Son & Park Beauty Water, Boscia Balancing Tonic, Shiseido essence, Eminence Organic’s Bamboo Firming Fluid, Tatcha Water Cream, Eminence Coconut Age-Corrective Moisturizer (to retain max hydration)]

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: Maybe it was a bad batch, but my bottle emitted a strange funk. Nevertheless, I tried it for a couple days. The results were underwhelming, especially considering the BANANAS price tag.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: Maybe it was a bad batch, but my bottle emitted a strange funk. Nevertheless, I tried it for a couple days. The results were underwhelming, especially considering the BANANAS price tag.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is an exceptional cleanser for dry skin. There’s a small amount of abrasive material that gently exfoliates without stripping the skin’s protective barrier. The scent is subtle and wonderful. I’ve experimented with ten different facial cleansers in the last few months. Although I now prefer to buy most of my skincare products from a Hungarian company (organic, with zero additives) not sold by Sephora, Tatcha’s Deep Cleanse is my favorite cleanser. It leaves my 40 year-old skin clear, hydrated and glowing.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: During the summer I get breakouts on my nose and between my eyes as a result of wearing sunglasses while sweating. If I didn’t wear glasses in the heat I’d have no ongoing problem with blemishes; I’m fortunate to have clear, resilient skin. I do fight dryness all the time, so I was a bit hesitant to try anything drying. However, this serum is like a magic pill for my t-zone troubles. At night, after a long day wearing sunglasses and sweating, I wash, exfoliate, tone, and apply the Caudalie serum to the affected area only. I don’t use this on my cheeks or other dry areas of my face, just the oily t-zone. Then I moisturize with an organic, plant-derived night cream from a different brand (not sold here). Every single time this happens, the newly formed zits have vanished by morning. Literally, where there were several red, irritated blemishes forming hours earlier, once I wake up that skin is totally clear. You need very little, so the bottle should last a long time. I have no idea how well this works for folks with serious acne problems, but it’s a staple for me.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: It smells okay, but that’s basically it. These days I rarely buy skincare from Sephora; most of these brands are sub-par industrial junk with slick packaging designed to appeal to teenagers and younger women. During the 20% off sale I thought I’d give this remarkably well-reviewed mask a shot. I’m 41 and this had NO visible impact on my skin. We all have different skin and product efficacy varies by individual, but I didn’t see and increase in brightness, radiance, tightness or clarity, and there was certainly no reduction in fine lines. Based on the reviews I read and how little it did for me, I believe this mask’s popularity is the result of a very savvy marketing/PR strategy, and nothing more.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: A little more than a dewy glow...
reviews.review_text: I received a trial size of this moisturizer and was excited to give it a try. My skin felt really nice after using it although I have some very dry patches on my face due to the winter weather, and this moisturizer wasn’t quite strong enough to help those. In general my initial reaction was favorable until I looked in the mirror. Woooah! My skin looked metallic. Nowhere on the sample did it mention the intense “glow.” I prefer matte skin so I was a little turned off, but for those who like the beam, this product is for you.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way, and my skin feels great. I have some patches of dryness thanks to the winter cold, and although this moisturizer isn’t super heavy, it managed to soothe them. My only complaint it the fragrance. It smells oddly chemically and strange. The scent fades fairly quickly so it’s not a total deal breaker, just odd.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: This balm is very hydrating and feels really great on. I think it works really well for overnight moisture. The caramel scent isn’t too heavy (which is good because I didn’t want anything overly fragrant). My only complaint is the type of pot it’s in. I understand that it’s probably too thick for a tube, but with my nails it’s really hard to get out without too much fuss (and my nails are not very long).

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: If you prefer a slightly heavier creamy moisturizer, this one is great! I usually don’t go for creams (like ever, I hate thick moisturizers) but found this one really pleasant. It applied really smoothly and my skin felt great afterwards. It’s definitely too dense to add to my daily routine, but I think I’ll continue to use it after peels or other treatments that dry me out.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this toner from Sephora and really liked it! I didn’t use it long enough to see if it effected my dark spots, but I might buy it because I enjoyed the sample so much. It smelled great and I liked the tingling sensation on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I use the balm every night before bed and my lips are still soft and moisturized in the morning. I liked the lemon enough I just ordered another fragrance to try. My only complaint is that the lemon isn’t very zesty (it’s more like a creamy lemon) but other than that it’s totally great.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried this balm in three flavors and so far Lime Mint is the best! The balm itself is super hydrating- I put it on before bed and my lips are still soft in the morning. This balm has definitely become one of my must haves

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: My skin was definitely softer and smoother after using this although I think some people would definitely dislike the balling up. It works well but is a strange experience. I took off one star because I could tell my skin would have been dry and tight if I hadn’t followed this scrub with my normal skin care regime. I liked it but not enough to buy the full size

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this gel moisturizer. My skin immediately feels better and stays hydrated all day or night. It’s a really nice consistency (not too thick!) but is moisturizing enough to tackle the cold winter months. I bought an extra as backup!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I am so impressed with this!!! I’m so happy that first of all it’s so compact and can fit right in my purse which I love for on the go and traveling! I love how it’s not greasy at all but also leaves my skin feeling and looking so beautiful and glowy! I’ve never found a sunscreen that does this, it’s just amazing!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: i love this lippie so much! such a nice everyday color while also moisturizing my lips! i love how much product is in there and I love the packaging as well! I have gotten so many compliments while wearing this as well! gifted by fresh!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: My skin feels soooo extra hydrated and so smooth after using this serum! It’s amazing! I love the texture of the serum itself it’s so nice to the touch and immediately my skin feels so much smoother and brighter after using it! I’m obsessed!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I love that this product is super easy to use and so far I’ve really noticed a difference in my skin texture after using it! reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Smells sooooo good. Kind of reminds me of Skittles but, better? I put it on just before bed and I wake up and my skin is soft and feels super hydrated! And the ingredients in this mask are so amazing. Definitely going to purchase another tub of this once I run out.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: love love love this stuff! i use it as a mask and as a regular lip balm. when i put this stuff on at night, i wake up and my lips are soft. when i use this during the day, i notice that i don’t have to constantly apply it to keep my lips from being dry. it’s light and is not sticky at all.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_title: works- but not what you would expect
reviews.review_text: unsure as to why huda was claiming that the product was dead skin because it’s definitely not. i got this as a sample and was given a generous amount. as soon as i applied the product to my face and massaged it into my skin, it started to develop into a grainy texture. the grain of the product did help to exfoliate the skin very gently. considering how gentle the exfoliation felt, upon washing my face, my skin felt smooth afterwards. i do recommend this as a gentle exfoliant that gets the job done well. but don’t purchase if you are expecting the claims huda made in her demonstration video.

reviews.review_text: This moisturizer really helped with some breakouts I had on my forehead for a super long time. After using this for a week, the breakouts started disappearing! I was extremely impressed by this, and I would recommend it to people struggling with breakouts! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: Mine came with the cap loose and I think that affected the consistency of my mask. It was super thick and hard to spread around. I don’t know if this affected the mask’s potency.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. Farmacy never disappoints! This moisturizer is wonderfully thick and nourishing. It’s not greasy at all, and sinks in quickly. I think this would be best suited for dry skin, but I have combo skin and it still is amazing.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This was gifted by Glow Recipe. It is a really unique product, I love how much you can multitask with it as both skincare and makeup! I also really love the gorgeous bottle! With that said, I expected a little more from this. It seemed just like a regular serum to me, and I experienced stickiness when it dried down. It does smell really good and is otherwise pleasant to use, so I think i’ll keep it in my routine!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: i love this moisturizer! it’s so thick and nourishing but never greasy. it sinks in so fast and leaves my skin feeling super soft and hydrated. also love the push top type of jar, so convenient and clean!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: goes ontop of make up and NO WHITE CAST if you use to work out - 100% recommend (did not break out)

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: Honestly why did I not try this moisturizer before! This is so hydrating, soothing and instantly my skin feels good. reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I feel sleepy after applying this product idk why. I feel tired and my eyes feel tired. I got a sample of this from sephora and omg I DO NOT LIKE IT. I feel too sleepy to do anything after applying this.

reviews.review_text: SKIN TYPE: DRY ACNE PRONE AGE: EARLY 20sThis is such a beautiful toner omg I just love how pretty it looks and beautiful it smells. The toner itself is hydrating and soothing. I recommended both it’s just as a college student I can’t keep up with this toner.

reviews.review_text: SKIN TYPE: DRY ACNE PRONE AGE: EARLY 20sI do not think this face wash was meant for me honestly. I love fresh and most of all their products but not this one. I feel like this one does not really exfoliate my face. When I rinse my face and use this I just don’t feel this in my face. The sugar honestly disappears once it touches my face. And when I used to on my dry skin it just doesn’t really spread throughout my face. Idk I just don’t think the texture of this Face Wash. I have it 2 star because after I use this on my face my face somewhat feels a lil soft. This is pricey and in my opinion not a great Face wash!

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: Honesty one of the worst cream I have ever tried. First of all the color is different like what?!!!!
