Second of all the smell omg the smell, I have this on right and I feel like I am wearing a cherry costume or something cause that’s how I feel! I can’t wait to go and return this tomorrow. Please do me yourself a favor and not do not buy this cream!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This eye serum is really lovely. Goes on smoothly evenly and gives eyes a nice boost of hydration. The consistency is great and doesn’t feel heavy and the packaging is just too cute! I’ll need to use more to see if it’s effective but first impressions are that I really enjoy it!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I was pleasantly surprised with this lip treatment. The texture is very smooth, almost glossy, but feels incredibly comfortable on the lips and is relatively hydrating on contact. I do have to use quite a bit for an overnight mask but still found it to be rather effective.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I received this from Fresh in exchange for my honest review. I am seriously impressed by this one. It’s got a thick texture that practically melts into the skin, absorbing quickly as well. It does have a mild floral scent but nothing too overwhelming. It leaves my skin plump and hydrated in the morning, while also helping soothe and dissipate any irritation. This was the overnight mask I didn’t know I needed in my life!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Glow recipe has done it again with another great product. What I love about this one is the refillable pod and the hybrid gel meets cream texture. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed, not tacky at all. It also plays really well with my other products and has helped combat my dry winter skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Glow recipe has done it again with another great product. What I love about this one is the refillable pod and the hybrid gel meets cream texture. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed, not tacky at all. It also plays really well with my other products and has helped combat my dry winter skin.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’ve always been impressed with fresh lip treatments and have quite s few different variations. Papaya is a bright coral color in the tube but goes on with a sheer wash that hydrates and nourishes my lips. It also has a subtle fruity scent that I find to be nice and not overpowering in any way. *gifted by Fresh in exchange for my opinion*

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a beautiful serum with a lightweight l, milky texture that absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving it hydrated and plump after use. It has a subtle scent of earl grey tea that is lovely, not overpowering. I mostly enjoy how refreshed and hydrated my skin looks after using it. Although it’s on the pricier side, my skin really has been looking so glowy and plump.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love the tint on this balm, it’s a soft pretty pink that looks very natural. It glides on smoothly, leaving your lips with an almost cushiony feel to them. I do find, however, that after a while of wear, the moisture seems to fade and the pigment that remains gets a little dry. Full disclosure, I have been using this on very dry lips as a result of an allergy to another lip product. On my regular lips I doubt it would be an issue but if you suffer from severley dry lips, I say stick to the clear one.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ll admit I consider myself lucky. At 50 years old I don’t have many wrinkles and the fine ones I do have respond well to basic skincare products. What I do suffer from is loss of elasticity, especially in my mouth and chin area. Enter this product. After a week of use I already see the sagging downturned look at the corners of my mouth reversing...noticeably! My husband even commented on it. I’ve tried many products and this one has definitely given me the fastest and most noticeable results for drooping skin. Unfortunately, it goes very quickly and at this price point is no bargain. I’m definitely stocking up during the yearly sales.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: Love these facial wipes. They get rid of all traces of makeup, even my eyes and lips. The exfoliating side is rough but I like that so I can feel it working. If I had a complaint, which I really don’t, it would be that the little rough dots on the exfoliating side kind of come off on your face but I just wipe it down with the smooth side and they’re gone. I  usually wash my face with a regular cleanser afterward anyway so it’s not really a problem..

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Goes on nice and creamy like a traditional lip mask but instead of just coming off on my pillowcase during the night, it feels like it absorbs into my lips and I wake up to perfectly soft lips.This helped me recover from severely dry and flaking lips due to a product allergy in no time!

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: Definitely noticed a lightening in my most sun-damaged areas. The bluish-purple iridescent color also gives a bit of instant glow. It’s a shame I use it only at night because the sheen is actually pretty.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I get super chapped lips, particularly in the winter (probably need to drink more water ugh) so am constantly looking for ways to heal them. Unfortunately, a lot of lip balms just make the problem worse. I did not find that the case with the belif lip mask though! I either put this on at night before bed or in the morning—when it’s gone hours later, my lips are left much more hydrated and happy than before. Also, it is sticky but not lip gloss-sticky. Will continue to use! (Photo was taken right after applying recently—been using this a few times a week for a month now).

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Was really excited to try out this new moisturizer and it didn’t disappoint! Texture goes on great and smoothly but feels thick enough to last like you would want a night cream to last, leaving my skin feeling hydrated. I didn’t notice a difference in fine lines but my sample size only lasted about a week so it’s too soon to say—def want to try for longer next time!

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Was really excited to try out this new moisturizer and it didn’t disappoint! Texture goes on great and smoothly but feels thick enough to last like you would want a night cream to last, leaving my skin feeling hydrated. I didn’t notice a difference in fine lines but my sample size only lasted about a week so it’s too soon to say—def want to try for longer next time!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Firstly, love that this sunscreen is spf 42–I’ve found a lot of face sunscreens are less than that. Goes on clear, and keeps my skin hydrated rather than drying it out like some sunscreens do. As a plus, I had no irritation or breakouts when using this. Overall, a great option I’ll be using this summer!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This spf goes on super easily (when you first put it on it looks tinted, but it goes on clear) and meshed super well under makeup—no pilling! It delivered on its slightly mattifying promise AND didn’t make me oily by the end of the day. My only downside is the size (I got the 30ml bottle)—def opt for the 50ml unless you’re just testing it out. Other than that, a new fave!

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this morning and night and while the serum itself is great, applying this with the head completely wakes my eyes up in the morning. After even serious puffiness, when I apply this, with a little bit of cold afterwards, my eyes completely depuff. Beyond that, the serum overall helps hydrate my under eyes , helping with my dark circles. One last note: this has a faint smell—I loved it but should note if you’re sensitive to fragrance.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this serum but overall, I felt like it was just okay compared to other vitamin c serums I’ve used in terms of brightening effects. Could be worth trying though in case it’s just my skin!Pros: - Amazing texture—goes on really well and sinks in quickly - Price point isn’t bad - No smell - Doesn’t make products applied after pill Cons:- I been using this a few times a week and I honestly haven’t noticed much difference in my complexion. - Packaging for the sample size I had was difficult to use as it poured out (but full sized packaging looks better!)

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I am new to DE and already a huge fan. I have sensitive skin and this stuff is great. A little goes a long way - one pump covers my whole face!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Wow. I didn’t want to love this stuff because of the price tag, but the day after using Babyfacial   the sample marula oil, my skin looked and felt so good I went back to sephora and bought the full size marula oil and the tlc serum. I literally spent $200 on DE products in two days and it is worth every penny. I had just had a breakout from eating too much sugar over Christmas break... the babyfacial made my redness go away, bumps went down. It definitely tingled (almost burned) going on but it was so worth it. The next morning my skin felt like velvet.. I’ve only been using DE for a few days and I havent worn makeup since.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I was so worried trying this (I break out easily) but so far so good. Makes my skin look and feel like velvet and no breakouts whatsoever! I love this stuff. Pairs really well with the TLC serum and a little goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing. I literally use it INSTEAD of makeup. Right after you put it on, your face looks soft, plump and ultra glowy. Seriously.. I know a lot of people use it at night but I use it in the morning because it makes my skin looks so healthy and gorgeous that I feel confident enough to skip makeup entirely.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: This stuff is INCREDIBLE. I can finally put sunscreen on my face every day and not feel greasy or break out. Didn’t think it was possible, but my face literally feels better after putting this stuff on.. soft, smooth, absolutely zero grease or shine and it held up for a whole day at Disneyland and an entire day at the beach (no sunburn). After trying endless face sunscreens, this is it. I will buy this till the end of time.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: This stuff is INCREDIBLE. I can finally put sunscreen on my face every day and not feel greasy or break out. Didn’t think it was possible, but my face literally feels better after putting this stuff on.. soft, smooth, absolutely zero grease or shine and it held up for a whole day at Disneyland and an entire day at the beach (no sunburn). After trying endless face sunscreens, this is it. I will buy this till the end of time.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I loved this product! This product is super easy to use. It’s recommended to use after your moisturizer or to apply this product instead of your moisturizer before going to bed. You leave this mask on over night and then wash it off in the morning. Super simple! I used it in conjunction with my regular night routine. This routine includes a moisturizer already, so I was using this mask in addition. Let me tell y’all! The next morning, after washing my face—- I’ve never had such soft skin! Seriously... I couldn’t stop touching my face! I definitely fell in love with this product and loved the my face felt after using it. I have extremely sensitive skin, and no issues were caused by using this product.  I would highly recommend this product to anyone who wants hydrated and super soft skin.  I received this product complimentary for the purposes of testing and providing my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I really like this sunscreen and I would have given it 5 stars but the formula was a bit too watery for my tastes. With that though, I did enjoy how well it absorbed into my skin and that you only needed a tiny amount to cover your whole face. It provided great coverage from the sun and I don’t feel that it left your skin too oily. Some sunscreens are very thick, and this one was much lighter. I tested this by wearing it under my makeup and and I don’t believe it seeped through or caused me to be more oily.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I LOVED this sunscreen stick and definitely feel like I am going to be using this in the future. I guess my one “complaint” would be that because it’s clear I feel like i don’t know if I’ve rubbed it all in- but that is minuscule compared to the great qualities. I love how easily this glides on. I don’t think it’s too oily when absorbed. I love that it’s a convenient stick to just carry around with your. I think it’s easy to apply, more than a lotion.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Sadly, my review is kind of tainted because I’ve been having some problems around my eyes (NOT BECAUSE OF THIS CREAM!!! My skin issues have been happening since late November way before I tried using this) So I could only use this on days my eyes weren’t bothering me. Even with the sporadic use... I did notice a small difference in the fine lines around my crows feet area. This eye cream is super creamy and absorbs into your skin very well. The skin around my eyes was left feeling extremely hydrated. Obviously I have sensitive skin in this area, and this cream caused no sensitivity reactions. I have a feeling if I was able to use this more consistently, I would have noticed more of a difference.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for my honest opinion. This is my first time trying anything from Biossance though I have seen the brand at Sephora many times. I can tell you that with the testing of this moisturizer, I am interested in seining what else this brand makes because this was a very high quality product that noticeably softened my skin to the touch and left it feeling highly moisturized. The texture is very smooth and the consistency is quite think, so a little can go a long way. The only reason I did not give this product 5 stars was because of the scent. It is rather strong and could be deemed unpleasant. I didn’t totally mind it and thought it faded fairly quickly, but it is noticeable.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: Thanks to Influenster, I’ve actually tried Belief products before and I love them! When using the Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream, this cream actually repaired my skin when it was suffering from some dryness from my current skin routine. I used this a few times and the dry patch went away. I really do love Belief products, they do wonders for your skin. As a bonus, I’ve been using Aqua Bomb Hydrating Body Moisturizer on my elbows and have really soften them.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I’m excessively picky about my lip balms. This one is nice, but i don’t think I’ll purchase it again. For $2 more, i can get my favorite one. It’s probably wonderful for someone who’s not as picky as i am, as it’s not a bad balm by any means. It has no scent or flavor, which is a big bonus for someone who doesn’t like these things. It’s worth a try, as it’s for sure better than, say, chapstick.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This does what it promises. My skin is softer and smoother after a single use, and continues to stay that way with repeated use. There’s no smell, it was gentle enough for me to use nightly immediately, with no stinging or irritation.   If you have the money, it’s a good solid product.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is a solid facial moisturizer. It isn’t anything super fancy in my opinion, and i get just as good results from a drugstore moisturizer with ceramides for 1/3 the price. But if you have the funds, it’s a nice, unscented moisturizer. I have exceptionally dry skin, and i feel i can use this alone.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Is it anything amazing?  Not for $64. It’s a decent eye cream. I don’t notice a significant difference with repeated use though. I’ve found drugstore products with more effectiveness for 1/3 the price. It’s not bad. It’s just overpriced in my opinion

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: it cleans, but not my fave
reviews.review_text: It’s a cleanser. It’s not my favorite but I’m exceptionally picky. It’s decent, light, and cleans. It’s not magical. If you want to spend the money, it’s not going to be wasted.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I got this product a while ago in a subscription box, and I put it on the back burner because I was using the Drunk Elephant TLC Framboose serum. This one does the exact same thing for $40 LESS. I like that one pump works for my entire face and neck, it has no discernible smell, and it’s gentle enough that it doesn’t burn, sting or irritate my rosacea. I use it every night, and will definitely repurchase once it’s gone.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: OMG!  This is an AMAZING serum!  It’s fabulous on my dry, flaky skin. I *almost* don’t need moisturizer after using it. I am so grateful that I got to try it from Influenster. I will be purchasing this when I’ve finished this bottle.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I got these these to try from PinchMe and I’m happy I did, these strips were really good! my nose doesnt get bad with the clogged pores, but these worked great for even the little I do get!! I definitely recommend them.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this now for a little over 2 weeks and i have to say I’m pretty impressed so far. I’ve used a few Dr. Gross products and have loved them, so I went in hoping to love this product and I was not disappointed. I have larger pores on my nose and cheek area surrounding my nose and I could definitely see a difference within a a few days. My only issue is the price tag, but in the end you get what you paid for and when it works its worth it!!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: My face felt so soft and exfoliated after trying Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel. I tried them for free as samples and just the few times I used it I could definitely feel a difference in my skin.They are also very convenient for travel and and last longer because of the individual packaging.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I really like Sunday Riley products and was really hoping I’d love this one but I don’t really feel it did anything drastic for me, at least not for the cost. I will say i saw another review recommend using it under concealer and i do like it as it helps brighten. I’ve just been wearing it at night for some extra hydration.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin and usually go for lighter moisturizers especially during the day, but I have notice my skin getting drier in the winter months lately. This moisturizer is pretty hydrating but it’s a bit thick for me so I’ve been using it primarily as a night time cream. Would be great for extremely dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed the consistency of this eye creme and like that a little goes a long way. There’s no particular smell do deal with so once it absorbs no residual smell. So far I haven’t noticed much of a difference, but as it is with samples you’re not always going to see a huge difference. But I don’t mind it and my eyes did feel more hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is hydrating and feels great on my skin once applied. I just wish I received larger sizes samples to try to get the proper 10 day results. Overall I would still recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: This serum does boost and firms your skin but I was not sold on the smoothness. it is on the pricey side but most skin care regimens are. I wish I could have used it for longer to get the complete sense of it’s effectiveness that being said I will purchase it on the future so I can try it out for myself longer than just 7 days.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This is such a cool concept...just mix with water. This exfoliant gives you such a nice glow after every use. I love how soft my skin feels after every use. The fact that is vegan is a plus and has no strong smell either.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This is such a cool concept...just mix with water. This exfoliant gives you such a nice glow after every use. I love how soft my skin feels after every use. The fact that is vegan is a plus and has no strong smell either.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum came beautifully packaged and is true to what it claims it will do. It brightens my face every time it’s applied. I love the texture and how it’s not too greasy or filmy. I am looking forward to using it to see it’s anti-aging properties.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen. I especially like the hyaluronic acid aspect and that it’s oil free. It glides on easily and does not leave a residue which always allows makeup to be applied. the packaging is cute and makes it easy to pack with your travel essentials or carry in your purse.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This is a moisture filled sunscreen that can work as a primer too. I love that it’s hydrating and doesn’t dry out my skin. This is my first time using this brand but now I will be a repeat user. I would recommend this product to others.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: This line of products but especially the Ultra Repair Cream deserves more attention!! This stuff definitely rescues me during dry Winter months or when the eczema is flaring up. Soothing! My skin feels so much better even after one more application. Light scent. Creamy but not heavy greasy sensation.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this product!!! I’ve been addicted to this ever since DE introduced this magic cream. Very light light scent. Creamy light texture- almost like a gel. This makes my skin glow and feels hydrated immediately after application. Love using this in the warmer months because it’s not heavy, doesn’t clog my pores, makeup sits nice on it. I’ve repurchased this many times, definitely a product I can rely on!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for many years now, on and off. I do notice a nice difference when I use this consistently (aka months)- my fine lines fade and my skin is just more soft/bouncy/hydrated. I actually do love this scent. One pump is enough to apply to my entire face and neck. I like to do the one pump in my hand, warm it up by rubbing my palms together, and then slowly pressing it onto my face. Sometimes a little pressure to move any congestion. Devine!! I really enjoy that it keeps the folks guessing on what my actual age is ;) Skin care is definitely a must and a worthwhile investment.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Light scented, quick absorption, non-greasy! Love wearing it own it’s own or mixing it with the Marula Oil. This size lasts for a long time because you don’t need a lot. One pump is more than enough to apply to face, ears, neck, and décolletage. This product is great for sensitive skin, really helps with hydrating the skin as it clearly states!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Love this oil! Makes my skin glow, in a wonderful way- hydrated, bye bye fine lines! The scent is light, love mixing this with the other products in the DE line. Absorbs easily. I have combination skin and I think it’s helped decrease the oil in my T-zone. I do like to apply this to my face AND body especially during dry winter months- helps heal and maintain a healthy skin integrity :)

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product is hands down amazing.  My skin looks and feels so much better when using this and I have noticed gradual improvement of moisture and fine lines after 2 months.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Great HA product! The price is unbeatable.  I use this with a Vitamin C serum in the morning and my skin is moisturized and plumper during the day.  I love this!!!

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this for day time with a Vitamin C serum.  Really moisturizes and leaves skin feeling more plump.  I do feel like after a couple of months my skin feels smoother.  I noticed no improvement with fine lines but I still love this.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: It’s no surprise this product has almost 5 stars from thousands of reviews.  It is a miracle worker and I have turned so many onto using them.  I use these pads twice weekly, before bed and they leave my skin looking porcelain by morning.  Pores are extremely minimized, texture disappears and when I’m getting a pimple under the skin, two of these treatments get rid of it all together.  It sounds dramatic, but I can’t and won’t live without these pads lol.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I did not notice any difference after using this toner for 6 months.  It feels nice on the skin, kind of a watery gel texture and did not leave any tackiness.  I didn’t notice any change in my pores or texture.  I think for the price, I’d look else where.  In my opinion, Beauty Water by Son & Park beats this product; lasts longer and does what the bottle says.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I did not notice any difference after using this toner for 6 months.  It feels nice on the skin, kind of a watery gel texture and did not leave any tackiness.  I didn’t notice any change in my pores or texture.  I think for the price, I’d look else where.  In my opinion, Beauty Water by Son & Park beats this product; lasts longer and does what the bottle says.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This primer is everything.  It is moisturizing, not sticky and has a subtle pearlescent sheen that gives off a “glow from within vibe.”  Makeup sits flawlessly on top.  I mix this equal parts with Laura Mercier tinted moisturizer.  I am a lifetime customer of this stuff!!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I love what this product has done for my pores!  Now in my mid 30s, I have become a big fan of serums and their lightweight but efficient satisfaction and what they have done for my skin.  This brand and product does not disappoint!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Wow I love love love this product.  I used it twice daily and saw results in a week.  Having a new baby has left me looking tired and I feel like my wrinkles have increased ten fold.  This cream has a nice light shimmer and had me feeling so refreshed!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Great everyday serum.  My face looked brighter and clearer after the use of a couple of times.  Would be interested in seeing long term results of the BAREMINERAL SKINLONGEVITY LONG LIFE HERB SERUM.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This product has a nice light scent.  It protects my fair skin from the suns rays and is not oily or greasy.  I would recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample in exchange for my review.  I loved how this appeared thick but wasn’t too heavy on my dry, aging skin.  I did notice my fine lines softening but wish I had more to see lasting results.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I like this product. It doesn’t have a perfume smell and that is great. The pump on the bottle is awesome too, I wasn’t expecting that. It’s a very light cream and it seems hydrating. I have been using it everyday

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I like this product. It doesn’t have a perfume smell and that is great. The pump on the bottle is awesome too, I wasn’t expecting that. It’s a very light cream and it seems hydrating. I have been using it everyday

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m OBSESSED with this eye cream. I’ve been using it every night since I received it. My under eye lines have definitely improved and I can feel a sort of tightness after using this. I definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is very hydrating without making your face greasy. I love this stuff. The smell is night and simple as well. I don’t like overly perfume smelling skin care and this is great! I received this product for a review :)

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is very hydrating without making your face greasy. I love this stuff. The smell is night and simple as well. I don’t like overly perfume smelling skin care and this is great! I received this product for a review :)

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I love this mask! I was concerned it was going to smell extremely floral but it doesn’t at all. It’s a very light scent and I’m very impressed! I left the mask on all night and woke up feeling refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Yaaaass Bobbi Brown! This primer is great. My makeup stayed on all day and I didn’t have any cakey-ness like I have with other primers. This made my natural look-look amazing. I recommend. Love love it!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I like this lip treatment. It did make my lips feel nice after and it didn’t dry for about an hour. The scent is nice and the tint is perfect. It’s not too red! My partner likes it too. I recommend if you get dry lips! Gifted by Fresh

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is super lightweight and is perfect for oily/combination prone skin. It doesn’t break me out and is perfect under make up or by itself! It also smells amazing, but isn’t overpowering. This product was gifted by Glow Recipe.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This is super nourishing and helps with dryness! I am oily/combination and I find this helps heal blemishes quicker and fades scarring and hyperpigmentation. I typically use this around my cheek and jawline area where I mostly get hormonal acne. This was gifted by Skinfix.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This is super nourishing and helps with dryness! I am oily/combination and I find this helps heal blemishes quicker and fades scarring and hyperpigmentation. I typically use this around my cheek and jawline area where I mostly get hormonal acne. This was gifted by Skinfix.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I have been looking for a new niacinamide product and this is it! It is lightweight and blends in effortlessly. It makes my skin bright and am excited to see the long term effects of this! Also adore the packaging! This was gifted by Glow Recipe.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product works great for my oily/combo skin! It literally melts into my skin and works great alone or under makeup. It has a very pleasant, subtle scent and is super refreshing! A great addition to my AM routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product works great for my oily/combo skin! It literally melts into my skin and works great alone or under makeup. It has a very pleasant, subtle scent and is super refreshing! A great addition to my AM routine.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is beautiful and has a very nice scent! I love the packaging as well. Excited to continue using but great first impressions so far - would definitely recommend trying it out! For reference, I have oily combo skin.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This was gifted by Fresh. this cream is amazing, I love how incredibly this cream left my face feeling fresh, smooth, and moisturized. I have been using it for a couple of days now and noticed the my face has been a big improving. I have rosacea and this product helped a lot, it calmed my skin. Overall, this is an amazing cream I love it.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I’m in love this product, I have incorporated it into my  skincare routine and its just amazing. I have rosacea and I’m always worried about how my skin will react to a new product, but this one was excellent! My skin is very hydrating and smooth.I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica. This is great for unveiling that smooth, shiny skin that you’ve always wanted. I love this, it smells good, has drastically helped my acne and imperfections and has given me a great overall look to my skin.   Never knew my skin could be so shiny!m up enough. reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This retinol  work really well, I’ve only been using it a few weeks. I can tell a small difference. No issues with irritation or dryness, which are usually big problems with  my rosacea.I recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This retinol  work really well, I’ve only been using it a few weeks. I can tell a small difference. No issues with irritation or dryness, which are usually big problems with  my rosacea.I recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Im in love with this wonderful product -  the scent is amazing ! All Fresh product is the best . Looking forward to trying more of their products. This serum is a luxurious treat for yourself, so go ahead and get it! I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Hands down the best facial oil and definitely my favorite skin product. This stuff is magic.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Let me start by saying have SUPER sensitive skin. I can’t use most facial serums because they make my face super red and dry. This stuff is honestly the best thing for exfoliating sensitive skin and for acne. I no longer use scrubs, just this miracle worker twice a week. I suggest using it once every three days for people with really sensitive skin and mixing it with the Drunk Elephant marula oil for extra moisture. It will change your life.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff! Super creamy and I can use it twice a day on my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is one of the most underrated drunk elephant products. I’ll admit, I tried the sample size and wasn’t blown away at first, but I decided to give the full size a try almost a year later. Best decision ever. This moisturizer has been my go-to this summer because it’s not heavy or greasy but leaves my skin feeling so moisturized. I mix I especially love mixing it with the drunk elephant vitamin C serum since I have sensitive skin (it makes the vitamin C a little less harsh on my skin). Love this stuff!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Let me start by saying I have very sensitive, combination skin and I’m very picky about the moisturizer I use. That said, this moisturizer is amazing. It’s thick enough to use as a night cream, but thin enough to wear under makeup. My skin always feels so soft and moisturized after I use it. I’ve tried the Drunk Elephant Lala Retro moisturizer and I hated how it made my face feel. It was so oily, thick, and unbreathable. The Protini moisturizer is so much better. Definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I’ve really enjoyed testing this product compliments of Influenster! It’s a great toner and leaves the skin feeling clean and refreshed. I definitely noticed a difference in dark spots and hyperpigmentation on my skin. I’m going to continue to use this for months to come. It’s awesome!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I really love this moisturizer! It’s light and airy, but also packs the punch of moisture that your delicate facial skin needs. It’s also non Greasy and doesn’t have a heavy perfumed scent. A must for anyone with combination skin.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t sure What to expect when I received this item through Influenster, as I’ve tried many serums before and could never really tell a difference in my skin. Even when touted as top of the line or premium ingredients, I was usually disappointed. You won’t be wasting you time or money on this one though! After a few days of using this serum, I could definitely tell a difference in my skin in texture, dark spots, and fine lines and wrinkles! You will not be disappointed in this product. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: This is hands down my new favorite go- to makeup remover! I love the moisturizing feel of this product with no scrubbing to remove waterproof mascara. I just saturated a cotton pad and held over my fully liquid lined & mascara-d eye, and voila! No trace of makeup left. My skin was left refreshed and clean. I’ll always keep a bottle of this in my skin care stash!!!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: This is hands down my new favorite go- to makeup remover! I love the moisturizing feel of this product with no scrubbing to remove waterproof mascara. I just saturated a cotton pad and held over my fully liquid lined & mascara-d eye, and voila! No trace of makeup left. My skin was left refreshed and clean. I’ll always keep a bottle of this in my skin care stash!!!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: There is definitely a reason Clarins Double Serum is a Worldwide Bestseller! That definitely made me want to try! This product is for All ages, all ethnicities, all skin types—even the most sensitive skin. (Like me!) and it’s Mineral oil free! I’ve been using this product for 9 days and compared to my other serum, well there isn’t a comparison! I’m definitely switching to this one. Just a small amount leaves your skin feeling tight and firm, but also dewy and glowy right out of the shower. The iconic dual-chamber houses the perfect ratio of water soluble (hydric) and oil soluble (lipidic) ingredients, similar to the skin’s hydrolipidic film. Amazing! I have been super self conscious of my naked face since having surgery to the side of my upper nose in 2019. If anything can help give me bare skin confidence, I definitely want to invest in it.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I honestly love the biossance squalane + omega repair cream. This face cream is not greasy or heavy at all, but deeply hydrates and leaves facial skin feeling clean, healthy and radiant. Definitely incorporating this product into my daily routine.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe. I want to start off by saying I LOVE how glow recipe’s products smell, this one is no exception! The texture is slightly thicker than a serum, more like a serum/primer. It did absorb into my skin quickly and it definitely gave me that “glow“ although my skin is quite oily so my face naturally produces enough glow already! For that reason, if you have oily skin, this might not be the best product for you and if you do use it, only use a very small amount! I think this product would work much better for people with drier skin!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love Fresh Beauty’s rose scented products but I also love that it isn’t overpowering. The cream itself feels very rich but absorbs into your skin really fast. I have combo skin so I was worried it might be too rich but it did not make my skin oily but gave it a nice “inner glow“ Overall I would recommend this product, especially now that it is on sale at Sephora! I was gifted this product in exchange for a review

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: First off, the packaging is so beautiful! And I was really impressed with how much product there is. reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley.  This is a very well known product and I tried it for the first time ever after being curious about it for years. What can I say that hasn’t been said about good genes already!? It’s amazing and yes the hype is real.  It’s such a great product that can be used by itself over night or mixed in with your favorite moisturizer. When I wake up the next say my skin is silkyyyy smooth. Try it you won’t regret it!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is the best moisturizer out there for combination or oily skin. Smells amazing, light weight texture that absorbs into the skin quickly and doesn’t weigh the skin down! I’ve been using this 3  years and it has seen me through the end of my 20s acne to now a more dry early 30s skin that is free of blemishes. The consistent use along with oil cleansing and other belif products (Hungarian water essence!) has helped me transform my skin! I refuse to change moisturizers!!

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This melts makeup off your face without leaving the face oily. I used this as an introduction to oil cleansing and it changed my skin!! I now use it before the belif cleansing oil to remove makeup - it works so well and leaves my skin feeling super soft afterward!

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This melts makeup off your face without leaving the face oily. I used this as an introduction to oil cleansing and it changed my skin!! I now use it before the belif cleansing oil to remove makeup - it works so well and leaves my skin feeling super soft afterward!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This did not work for my skin! I have combo skin that’s been running dry lately and this made my skin itchy and feel like little needle pricks all over it for the whole next day after using it. Plus my skin was abnormally red from the irritation. I normally do not have sensitive skin and react like this to products but this one is a no-go for me.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This did not work for my skin! I have combo skin that’s been running dry lately and this made my skin itchy and feel like little needle pricks all over it for the whole next day after using it. Plus my skin was abnormally red from the irritation. I normally do not have sensitive skin and react like this to products but this one is a no-go for me.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Love this hydration serum. It’s thick but goes on smoothly and you don’t need too much. It leaves skin feeling hydrated and absorbs instantly. I go between this one and the Hungarian water essence from Belif. I’ve been mixing this serum with the C-firma serum in the mornings and I like how well it helps disperse and mixes with that product. I’d definitely buy this again in the future.  I will say, I do not like the packaging for this. While it’s an innovative twist top, the plastic feels very cheap considering the cost of this. The travel size versions packaging is much better. I received the full size as a free sample.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I like that this is a mineral based sunscreen and it will last forever. A little goes a long way. It goes on well, absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave a white residue. The smell is not attractive though. I think it probably doesn’t have added fragrance which is good, but the smell isn’t attractive. I am not sure I would buy this again even though I do feel like it’s a good value. I received this product for free as a sample.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried a lot of eye creams and serums over time and this one I actually really like. I’ve been using it twice a day for about 2+ weeks. I’ve noticed the lines under my eyes soften a little and my dark circles slightly lighten. The cream doesn’t have an offensive smell and it applies smoothly and evenly. I plan to go through 2 full bottles before I decide if it will be a mainstay for my routine.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I love shiseido products and their sunblocks. This oneis nice, I especially love the little tint of color. I don’tlove hyaluronic acid - however this does make yourskin hydrated throughout the day. I didn’t find it to bemattifying the way it’s advertised but I do like it. Theconsistency is runny and you definitely want to shakeit up before pouring out. The fragrance is light butpleasant. Overall I don’t think it’s anything superspecial but it’s good.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I love shiseido products and their sunblocks. This oneis nice and like their others. I don’t love hyaluronic acid - however this does make your skin very hydrated throughout the day, more than the other sunblocks in this same line. The consistency is really nice and spreads evenly. The fragrance is light but pleasant. Overall I really like this sunblock but wouldn’t repurchase because of the hyaluronic acid. I would use one of their other similar ones.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: Love this product! Got it complimentary from Influenster! Applying it felt great and when I took it off it felt great as well. Love the color of it, it makes it all the more better! And it really works :)

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Love this product! Moved from the moisturizing bomb to this to give it a try and OMG! I put it on at night before I go to sleep and in the morning under my makeup. My makeup looks so smooth and my face looks so hydrated during the day!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I like this product! I like the smell and noticed that when I wake up in the morning my skin is soft. I haven’t used it long enough to notice any other differences though!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I recommend this product. Would like to keep using it to notice stronger effects but it has a nice smell and is great for my sensitive skin! Does not cause any irritation.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I like this so far! Goes on very well under moisturizer and doesn’t have a strong scent. Not sure if it makes a difference on my skin yet though. Will keep using.

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I like this so far! Goes on very well under moisturizer and doesn’t have a strong scent. Not sure if it makes a difference on my skin yet though. Will keep using.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
reviews.review_text: I like this so far! Goes on very well under moisturizer and doesn’t have a strong scent. Not sure if it makes a difference on my skin yet though. Will keep using.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser! I was using Proactiv for years, but wanted to switch those products for more natural ones. After plenty of research, I finally settled on this one. I love how it is lightly exfoliating, but not harsh. A little goes a long way for me. Its super gentle, which is what I was looking for. My skin feels soft after using it as well. Only downside is the price. Super expensive for a cleanser!

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser! I was using Proactiv for years, but wanted to switch those products for more natural ones. After plenty of research, I finally settled on this one. I love how it is lightly exfoliating, but not harsh. A little goes a long way for me. Its super gentle, which is what I was looking for. My skin feels soft after using it as well. Only downside is the price. Super expensive for a cleanser!

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Love all glow recipe products, and this one is no exception. Smells amazing, does the job. I follow up with the Tatcha soy cleanser and my skin feels clean and smooth, but not stripped.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I am never disappointed by Glow Recipe products, and this serum is no different! My skin ends up very dry during the winter, so this is a must have for me. It feels instantly hydrated and smooth.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I adore this mask! I have combo skin with a super damaged barrier, so there are often days where I need extra moisture. Using this literally feels like my face is a sponge, and I had no idea how dry my skin was until I used this product. It goes on smooth, and I usually use about two to three pumps for my face. I’ve also noticed that it calms down some of my stress breakouts and dark spots.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love cleansing balms, and I’ve been a faithful user of the Glow Recipe cleansing balm for about a year. However, I’ve been looking for one without polyethylene, an ingredient I don’t resonate with, and finally decided to try this one. Honestly, this gave me the best cleanse of my life, not even joking. It melts super easily and glides onto my face, and then all it takes is splashing it with water to assist with emulsifying and rinsing off. I think I’ve found my forever cleansing balm! I’m not a huge fan of the scent, however, a small price to pay for an incredible cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: Love the scent and is gentle on my sensitive skin! It is great during the day for a refreshing boost for my face and no residue left behind!

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: These are the best little face pads I have used so far! They are great for a quick degrease on my bad places (nose, chin, forehead) and make me feel more fresh then only using blotting papers. No breakouts and no sticky feeling after using them and the scent is barely present if I had to guess it would be a tea-like aroma.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample and I love it! Did not cause breakouts was very light on my skin and absorbed well with no residue . It smells amazing and the textre makes my face feel so fresh I use it in the morning with my skin care routine!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really like this moisturizer as the texture is amazing and light weight and does not leave your face sticky after use. Has neutral smell if any and works well with my skin care routine also did not cause any skin irritation feels very refreshing on your face.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really like this face wash as I feel it actually cleans my skin and leaves it very refreshed and not too dry. The gel formula lathers just the right amount and rinsed off easily with no residue . Great value for the amount of product you get.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: WOW! This product was a game changer for me and will remain apart of my skin care routine ! I have extremely oily skin during the day and over night it gets even worse I used this in the morning to start off and see how it works and it literally slowed down the amount of oil significantly! I’ve now been using this for about a week and what a difference it has made! It did not dry my skin out or cause irritations of any kind. I felt very fresh and no Stuckey residue was left behind after use. On days especially when my face feels extra oily I’ll use it at night but for the most part just using in the morning has made a huge change I love it! Smells great and good quantity for the price deff recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I like this cream! No strong smelling!! Rich but not super thick to make my face oily. I uses it every daytime with top layer of sunscreen, and didn’t have any breakout or redness. The city I lives has average 102° daily during summer time. Highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I tried this product several time and it hasn’t helped with my breakout for even one time

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I think this product is good enough for acne. It helps me with my breakout and scars 85% of the time. Just friendly remind every one who buy this product follow the directions strictly.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I have used this mask three times, and it really makes my face feel soft. The only thing I don’t like is the mrula face oil in the box. The face oil caused the breakout of my face

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: works really well but take times
reviews.review_text: I like this peel. It helps me with my acne, my dark spot, and my reddish chick. However, it takes me a long time to use this peel just once per day b/c it really hurt (tingling) at the beginning. I started with one pack of wipes every two days for about three weeks, and one pack every one days for about two weeks, and now one pack every day. I have to admit that this peel help my face the most when I use it every day. So I imagine it will work even better if I can tolerate tingling (but I can’t), and use it twice daily. Overall, I think the peel worth to buy.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Not for dry skin, but great for combination
reviews.review_text: I have an extremely oily T-zone, where has frequent breakout during hot weather. The water cream works great for my face. It keeps my face moisture but not too oily, and I never have a breakout. I use the water cream as a day cream. I prefer thicker moisturer as night cream, so I can understand why this cream might not work for people with dry skin. But if you have combination or oily skins, water cream works like magic

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_title: Not for dry skin, but great for combination

reviews.review_text: Before trying this product, if I let sunscreen stay on my face for few hrs, my face will have breakout the next day. With this correcting treatment, I don’t have any breakout issue, and my face doesn’t feel really dry. This cream also helps me to cover some redness on my face, so I don’t even need to wear makeup. I have never used this cream with makeup though. The only thing I don’t like is the smell of the cream. It’s acceptable but not my favorite.

reviews.review_text: Hmm I don’t know what is cram doing to my skins, bc I didn’t see any change...  But to be honest, this eye cream is just like one of many other expensive eye creams: moisture my eyes but don’t do anything else. I guess I just can’t ask more than moisture for eye cream

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Received little jar as sample. Tried it twice per week for three weeks and see no difference. This mask gives me a greasy feeling.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: Received little jar as sample. Tried it twice per week for three weeks and see no difference. This mask gives me a greasy feeling.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Was very harsh on my skin, usually don’t have that problem because I don’t really have sensitive skin. Maybe it was because you have to rub the sheet on your face it intensified the harshness, I’m not sure. But I broke out bad the next day after using it.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: Great for night time use, otherwise a little heavy for me to wear under makeup (I have oily skin). I have been using a sample I picked up with my points and even with the small bottle you get so many uses out of it. I’ve used it a few times and the next day my skin feels and looks smooth and clear! I suffer from acne scars as I had very bad skin when I was younger. I hope overtime to see a lot of reduction in the appearance of it, but as for making skin look great it does instantly.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Cleans makeup very well and leaves skin soft and not overdried! Little goes a long way too

reviews.product_name: Mini Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Hate hate haaaaate it. Waste of money. “Sugar” in it is way too coarse for the 2 seconds that it is present. Then completely melts away and becomes a weird sticky regular cleanser that still leaves your face dirty. Also doesn’t smell like strawberries smells more like candy, which I hate. Skin care should be unscented or at least smell mild

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I’ll be honest...... I bought this solely for the packaging. The product itself is mediocre. It’s very sticky for a balm but I will say I lightly tap it with my finger once and it’s enough for my lips. Very little goes a long way in terms of covering your lips but I feel as far as hydration goes it’s not the best. Feels more like Vaseline doesn’t seem to absorb kind of just sits there. Probably really good in the winter I’d imagine as it would be a nice barrier from the wind I suppose

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: Very nice absorption, almost immediately gets sucked jn to my skin when applied. Because it absorbs so well it goes well with any product I put on top. Smells great and fresh, and really seems to even out skin tone over time. It’s a good one in my opinion. Would recommend

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: Almost a 5 star, I’m docking one star off because every tube I had (I’ve had many because it is a great, very hydrating product - specifically advanced therapy ones) they all got melty and warped and eventually broke. It’s like they soften overtime, and I noticed it happening over a span of a couple weeks. Not left in a hot or humid place either. I don’t know what it is about these but they look gnarly after a while. If these were jn little jars they would make more sense for the texture. That being said they last very long and are very pretty and hydrating. I would still recommend.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_title: I don’t normally like toners but...
reviews.review_text: I get hormonal acne on my chin that seems to leave the worst dark spots, which I never had a problem with until now (22 years old). I’ve been using this for the last two weeks and the most troublesome dark spots have already lightened up! Face does feel a little tingle after application, and I did peel a tiny bit (also live in a cold, dry climate) but so far, I love it!! I also alternate this with Drunk Elephant’s TLC Framboos Night Serum a 2-3x a week

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_title: PERFECT GLOW ON NO MAKEUP DAYS!!
reviews.review_text: I seriously love this product so much! have been using for over two years now and tried with many different moisturizers and sunscreens. You can mix it with DE’s B Hydra as well. The only moisturizer I have tried with d bronzi that I don’t recommend is tatcha’s the water cream. If you use the water cream, you will understand what I mean when I say the the cream spreads out too easily on your face to mix well with d bronzi. The texture of the water cream and how it kind of melts across your skin is not compatible with d bronzi and will just cause patches of bronzy glow all over your face. Out of all the moisturizers/sunscreens I have tried with these drops (Purito, Krave, DE, Acure, Tatcha, Summer Fridays, and more) I think the best mixture I have found is with DE’s LaLa Retro. The two products blend together seamlessly and create such a natural look on my face. For those of you who don’t know, d bronzi requires mixing with some kind of other product (moisturizer, serum, sunscreen) because it is CONCENTRATED. Sometimes when you apply it, it looks a little scary at first but after working it into your skin a little you will get a beautiful flawless glow. I have fairer skin (but tan easily in summer), blue eyes, and blonde hair, and it works wonderfully for me, but I’m guessing it will probably not be as effective on tanner/darker skinned beauties just because it is not super dark. However if you do have a deeper skin tone and white moisturizers leave a cast on you, this may work well to hide the white cast!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this lip balm! beautiful subtle tint and I love the consistency, the scent is definitely strong but I liked the watermelon for summertime. If you want something a little bit cheaper that has less strong of a scent I would recommend the Awake Beauty (sister brand of tarte) Lip Mask in watermelon! would buy this again though

reviews.review_text: this product really does what is says it will! I have easily inflamed skin so my skin is red basically all the time, this product really does neutralize the redness, but it does almost too good of a job so I recommend using a little bit of contour and maybe some cc cream to add the dimension back to your face

reviews.review_text: one of my favorite stick lip balms, smells is nice and it is very moisturizing, feel like the tube is way bigger than how much product it actually contains though, reached the bottom of the tube in maybe 3 weeks of use

reviews.review_text: refreshing scent and feel. I have combination skin and this prevents pimples without over drying. Love that it’s anti aging too.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: refreshing scent and feel. I have combination skin and this prevents pimples without over drying. Love that it’s anti aging too.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: love this mask!! Word of advice- start with less and gradually add more. First time I caked on too much and broke out, so just know less is more. I’ve used as night mask and makeup primer! Plumps skin up and soothes too.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: I used 3-4 drops in moisturizer and the color was natural looking and took a few days to fade (I use a vitamin c serum which may cause it to fade faster). Smells great. Only complain is that its colourless so you don’t see any uneven areas until its already set. I just buff them out with micellar water though and its fine.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I use this to make my foundation darker after I fake tan my body and also in my face sunscreen to give a bronze finish. If you want to add tan to your face that can wash off at the end of the day this is perfect. Plus it can add anti aging ingredients to skin care you already use

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: A good chemical exfoliant, didn’t cause irritation for me. For the price it is worthwhile. I prefer to have a physical exfoliant too so I feel like dead skin is being removed (hence 4 instead of 5) but if you just want chemical one this works well

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: You’ll still need to double cleanse to get off makeup, but the product works well and doesn’t over dry.

reviews.review_text: At first it felt like a burning sensation, however after I had it on for a few minutes it felt really comfortable to my skin and it felt hydrated

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Made my lips feel super hydrated throughout the night, however, in the morning part of them felt crack.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Makes your skin feel super hydrated. This is not oily at all which I love. Makes my skin feel naked and free. Work throughout the day without having to reapply.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Makes your skin super hydrated. Does not feel heavy on your skin. Feels like nothing is on once it dries.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: My skin usually doesn’t tolerate glycolic acid products, so I have been introducing this one slowly. So far, so good. I’m using it every second day, and applying tretinoin and azelaic acid on the other days. I haven’t noticed any irritation or dryness, and I’ve actually received compliments on my skin. Hoping I will be able to continue to use it!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’m a fan! I have to be very careful with cleansers because I have rosacea and sensitive skin. I love that this cleanser doesn’t have added fragrance or anything else that irritates my skin. The only downside is that if I use it to remove my eye makeup, it does cause some mild stinging if I happen to get it in my eyes.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is one of the first Drunk Elephant products I have tried, and I’m truly impressed. It’s moisturizing enough that when applied at bedtime, my skin will still feel soft and plumped in the morning. When applied in the morning, it moisturizes without leaving my skin feeling greasy. I apply sunscreen over it and I haven’t had any issues with pilling and my makeup goes on nicely over both.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I’m super-picky about lip products - and this one is sooo nice. I like how it’s lightweight but moisturizing - and the amount of “slip” is perfect. I’ve never used a lip product that contains peptides so I’m excited to see if there will be a change in my lips with continued use.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: My undereye area is very sensitive, so there have been very few eye products that I’ve been able to use over the years. This is one of those few! I love the consistency and how it moisturizes without being greasy. So far, it has also played well with all of my other skincare & makeup. I haven’t used it long enough to see any changes in my skin, but I’m hoping I will over time.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: THE BEST MASK ICE EVER USED!
reviews.review_text: Probably the best hydrating mask I’ve ever used. It does such a good job at hydrating the skin and making it feel so smooth. IIt truly gives you a glow lit from with in after using it the FIRST TIME. I defiantly recommend and will be for sure repurchasing. Just wish you can get the product In bigger size.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of the Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask free from Influenster and Belif in exchange for my honest review . This lip mask was lovely to use, though I worry about possible air, light, and bacteria exposure of dipping into an open jar. It’s a thick balm that melts with your body heat into a hydrating but sealing thick jelly on your lips. It feels like a cross between petroleum jelly and a moisturizing lip gloss or oil, and felt very comfortable upon application. The top ingredients I recognize are Shea butter and waxes, along with many I can’t pronounce. The second half of the ingredients list worries me since it has so many fragrant essential oils, something that might irritate lips, though some may soothe them as well. The actual formula has no discernable scent though. The morning after using this, I notice my lips aren’t dry, but also aren’t very hydrated either. After a few uses, there seems to be no noticeable difference, but that may be because I don’t currently have dry winter chapped lips to try it on. Unfortunately however, a thin layer of petroleum jelly leaves me with more moisturized lips when used as an overnight mask. Overall though, for a very thick lip balm, it’s enjoyable while it’s on . #nofilter #gotitfree #complimentary #free #influenstervoxbox @Influenster #contest #skincare #review @belifusa #belifsmoothtalker #FallFavesVoxBox

reviews.review_text: Goop beauty gifted me with GoopGlow microderm instant glow exfoliatorI’m always looking for a new exfoliator and this is definitely among my favorites now. I’ve only been using it for about 2 weeks, but my skin has been smooth and I’m actually going makeup free to work more in the last week and a half. I have combo skin, so finding something that will balance without drying me out or freaking out my oily issues can be a hassle. So far using this, I haven’t been having issues. I am getting a decent amount of oil in the area between my eyebrows, but not all over like I used to. The scrubby bits are small, so this isn’t a rough exfoliator and gives you a nice, baby soft feeling after. A little goes a long way, which makes the pricetag a little easier to handle.

reviews.review_text: This was gifted to me by Goop, so I did receive this for review.I’ve been using this for 2 weeks now, and overall I do like the product. It has a tingling feeling when you first apply it and the scent is fairly strong, but most glycolic peel type products have this type of scent. I haven’t noticed a huge difference, since it’s only been 2 weeks, but my skin is much smoother. My pores are still the same, as are my fine lines. It’s super easy to use, open a pad, slip it on your fingers and rub small circles on your face until you cover the entire area. Dries fairly fast, so you don’t have to wait long - then go head off to sleep and rinse in the morning. After the first couple uses, that subsided and my skin was back to normal.I took a star off because the price is hard to swallow

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: It’s kinda pricey but I love it! I’m into my second tub. I still use facial wash after because I’m just used to doing it no matter what. Before, my routine is just facial wash and then toner. But then, the cotton ball picks up a lot of makeup residue even after washing my face. When I tried this makeup remover, it easily dissolves makeup and it’s not tacky. It’s nondrying too. It’s a bit tricky at the eyes though. It’s not irritating at all but some of it make the vision blurry if you don’t wipe carefully. Other than that I have no problems with it. After usage I checked if there’s still makeup and nope! All gone. But I still wash my face out of habit and because I’m more at ease when I wash my face. I feel completely refreshed and there’s no makeup residue. It doesn’t have any scent and the consistency just melts into skin like a cream even though it looks hard in the container.

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: It has a two step process of moisturizing. Right off the bat the scent of rose just fills the air. It’s not for people who don’t like scents in a skincare routine. Personally, I don’t mind. After I get used to the smell it starts to dissipate as well. Upon applying the cooling gel mask(yellow one), it feels refreshing and lightweight on the face but it gets warmer and thicker as you apply it. It feels a little bit sticky and tacky but didn’t bother me. I waited for my skin to absorb it and applied the second step which is the water cream. It did feel watery but became thicker again when applied. My face also felt softer from the first gel. The second cream claims to lock in the moisture. After an hour it started to feel itchy around the eyes. I had a little bit of rash. I didn’t remove the product but I added a little bit (just in affected areas) of anti pruritic cream to calm the itchiness. I think my face is adjusting to the cream and the rashes weren’t anything drastic. My face is sensitive and it’s understandable to have rashes at the first try and it does happen when I try new skincare products. I stuck with the with it because my face is dry and I do have faith that it will make my face hydrated. My faith didn’t fail me because the next day my face feels soft, plump and more hydrated. There were no breakouts or irritation the morning after. I will keep on using this and I do recommend it :) Because this is an overnight sleeping mask, and becomes thick and tacky when applied to face, I can’t use this under makeup. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

Since I’ve healed, I’ve continued to use this morning and night to “seal in” all of the other products I use. It makes my skin look plump and healthy and I haven’t had any dryness at all since using it (and I have dry acne-prone skin). I got this as part of a set with the HA serum, but get a better result from this moisturizer. I will continue to use it daily and think it’s 100% worth the cost. LOVE!

The texture takes some getting used to, because it’s thick, but it works so well on my fair skin that I’ll never stop using it.
