reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this 3 times in the week and a half that I’ve had it. Even on dry, broken skin, it doesn’t feel as bad as you’d expect it to. I haven’t seen any results as far as limiting breakouts (in fact they’ve been worse but I think that’s from something else), but it has faded my old acne scars fairly dramatically. So far it also hasn’t shrank my pores or even cleaned my blackheads out much, but I’m hoping those will get better with more use. TL;DR don’t expect it to change what your skin does much, but it will lighten up any scarring/pigmentation fairly quickly.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample and wanted to love it, but this made my skin feel like an oil slick. I don’t even have oily skin, but within a few hours it had felt like I coated my skin in oil. It felt great on any dry patches I had, but I wouldn’t recommend for anyone but people with extremely dry skin in a cold climate. Also, it’s very scented, and while it smells fresh and spa like, if you don’t like scent I wouldn’t suggest trying it.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This honestly has worked wonders for my skin. I use Aklief retinol which is super drying (it can make my skin peel overnight) and this has really worked to strengthen my skin barrier when used underneath. It has also improved the look of my red post-acne marks by a LOT when used morning and night. I find that it applies best when I pat it into damp skin immediately after washing my face. I always follow up with a moisturizer, and have never had any issues with this being weird under my makeup.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_title: O. B. S. E. S. S. E. D.
reviews.review_text: So I bought this on a whim since I love the avocado retinol sleeping mask so much. This is now the first step in my skincare routine: as soon as my face is cleansed or I’m out of the shower, I apply one pump to my entire face. In the month that i’ve been using it, my acne has decreased about 75%, my red spots are almost gone, my skin texture is totally smooth, and I’m glowing. It feels so soothing and lays perfectly underneath makeup. I highly recommend for anyone with sensitive skin, or redness, or inflammatory acne.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I have oily, dry, sensitive and combination skin and I use this at night after a use a cleanser and it has made my skin so soft and plump. It doesn’t dry my skin and my skin never feels tight afterwards. Doesn’t break me out either. It’s also not super harsh like other exfoliators so I know it’s not damaging my skin.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_title: I can’t wait to use this again!
reviews.review_text: When I put this on, it doesn’t sting my whole face, only where I have open acne that I’ve popped that day but only for a couple seconds. My skin is very tolerant though, I’ve had laser treatments, used pure salicylic acid before, and burned my skin chemically so many times, so this is the perfect exfoliation for me. I did this at night and in the morning my skin looked so smooth! I was very impressed! My skin did feel drier though so I had to extra moisture after this.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Cause a bad reaction around my under eyes
reviews.review_text: I used it once and it caused these tiny red bumps all over my under eyes and eyelids. It was super sticky too. My boyfriend usually never comments on my face but when I put this on he said that my under eyes looked really dark that day. I will finish using this for my body because I heard caffeine is good for skin in general but just maybe not for around my eyes.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_title: Too thick and sticky for me
reviews.review_text: I felt like this was way too thick for my eyes, I felt like it was almost dragging my skin trying to put this on and it didn’t really absorb well at all. It also was kind of sticky. Maybe this can be good for people who don’t have really delicate under eyes.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_title: Like crack but for my skin!
reviews.review_text: This paired with the vitamin C serum from Tatcha has transformed my skin in a matter of days! My skin looks so much clearer, more even texture and tone, more dewy, and more hydrated. This also helps the water cream aboard even better into my skin and I love how my skin looks and feel afterwards. And I really was skeptical too but this honestly does wonders for my skin! I will continue to repurchase forever and ever.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_title: Like crack but for my skin!

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Wonderful gentle makeup remover and cleanser!
reviews.review_text: I use this for removing makeup when I do wear makeup but I also use it just as the first cleanser in my 2 step cleaning. It takes off makeup really well and doesn’t burn my eyes at all unlike every other makeup remover/cleanser! Thank god! I also have acne prone combination skin and this has not broken me out at all which is great because I was so scared it would cause breakouts. It cleans my face really well while not making it feel super dry and tight afterwards. I follow up with the rice powder and it’s a great combo leaving my skin feeling clean and exfoliated.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: After only a couple uses my skin feels amazing! The texture of my skin is improving and my face looks so much brighter! When I started using it I had several breakouts but now, I have zero acne for the first time in my life! My confidence in my skin is sky high and I’ve never had that before so I’m extremely grateful for this product. This product is truly a holy grail for me and I can’t picture my skincare routine without it.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love the scent. Is a bit tacky but gets absorbed within 4-5 minutes. It leaves my skin with a nice glow but not shiny but I don’t feel moisturized. I like it but don’t love it.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: Loved this eye cream, it definitely depuffed my eyes (I suffer from insomnia). And it didn’t irritate my eyes like most eye cream do. It’s a decent size so this will last me a while and I would recommend this product to anyone looking for a lightweight cream to help with our baby raccoon eyes. I received this product from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. They did not pay me for my review.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: A very good lightweight moisturizer. It does what it claims and kept my skin moisturized. I have dryer skin during the cold months and this helped. I would prefer this during colder months though. I still recommend for anyone to try it, it didn’t break me out at all and I have sensitive acne prone skin. I received this product from BzzAgent in exchange of my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen feels amazing on the skin. Super light weight but effective. Rubs in easily and absorbs into skin well. Will continue to buy!

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product nightly for a few weeks now and it truly has transformed my skin in the morning. Fine lines diminished and face is overall smoother to the touch. I will definitely continue to buy! Only downfall is it is a bit heavy (buttery!) but with results like this it’s a minor issue.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: Feels great going on skin. I will say a little goes a long way... if you put too much on you will have residue in the morning. Overall will continue to buy!

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: Great alternative to good genes for a fraction of the cost! I have been using good genes for a year which I love but it’s been pricey. I switched a month ago to the ordinary (I also got the retinoid from the ordinary to replace Luna oil) and so far have had the same great results. Very happy to have the extra money for other beauty products!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have tried other products from biossance and just like the others I found this one to be amazing. Great for hydration without being too heavy. I love the fluffy soft texture and the nratural ingredients. I find it to be very hydrating and keeps skin supple all day - which is great for winter. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are mine.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a staple item for me and the moisturizer I always come back to. I’ve got combo skin that gets drier in winter so this creamy texture is soothing, high absorbing and provides excellent moisture to the skin

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have heard raving reviews about this product from many youtubers and have finally decided to give it a try.  Its very hydrating and wears nicely under makeup but I do have to wait a while for it to set before applying foundation.  I like it more to wear at night even though it is a primer and when I wake up in the morning, my face still feels hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_title: Love the mix of Niacinamide and SPF
reviews.review_text: I have oily skin so I was a little hesitant to try out this product because I thought I would end up looking like a grease ball but I really love Niacinamide so that is was suckered me in. This product definitely gives me a glow but when I apply foundation on top, it does tone it down quite a bit but still gives me a slight healthy glowly look. It doesn’t make me look to oily. It can leave a white cast if you apply too much but it blends in easy. It does not have the smell of sunscreen at all, just a faint watermelon scent. It is not too overbearing. Overall, I like this product. I love that it has the mixture of Niacinamide and Sunscreen, two products that I love.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: The product has a pretty strong scent which is concerning for me since harsh scents break me out, so far this has not happened and I will continue to use it to see if it will. I like how the product is thin and feels light on the skin. I like to use this at night even though it is fine to use during the day too. I have used this for a week so far and I can say that it has definitely made my skin look more supple and hydrated. I am excited to continue using this product

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I love moisturizers like this that plump up the skin but don’t feel too heavy on the face. I have been using it in the morning and even on super cold and dry days in the winter it keeps my skin moisturized.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a few days now and love how it feels on my skin. I’ve been using it at night since it’s a heavier moisturizer and I wake up with plump and gooey skin.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: Although I received this for free I do really love this product! I can tell when I wake up in the morning that my under eyes look more supple and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I use this without fail day and night after using a toner and it absorbs really fast. I use it under make up as well.It is a great product for the price

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This toner works wonders makes my face feel soft to touch . It helps to smooth skin and exfoliate at night to get the makeup residue out.It helps fight acne.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Seen visible change in my skin after using it for a week. My skin looks brighter and healthier.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Seen visible change in my skin after using it for a week. My skin looks brighter and healthier.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I love this product. It gives a cooling effect on my skin and makes my skin very smooth. It is also very hydrating and doesn’t make my face oily even though I have combination skin. Overall a good moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I tried this on for a week and it does smell good. However when I apply it to my face it becomes very dry texture than my other sunscreen. I am going to continue to use it because I haven’t seen anything bad.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this facial wash! I have combination oily skin and got this in my trendmood box. My face was clean and supple all day and my skin didn’t get very oily like it normally does.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this facial wash! I have combination oily skin and got this in my trendmood box. My face was clean and supple all day and my skin didn’t get very oily like it normally does.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I got this product in my trendmood box and absolutely love it! It makes my skin look dewy and fresh. I also spritz it before I sleep and wake up with  hydrated skin!

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_title: You can put this in your purse!
reviews.review_text: Got this in my trendmood box and it is so lightweight on the skin! I have combination oily skin and used this as a pre makeup moisturizer and it worked wonderfully! Very hydrating and easy to carry around!

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer

Love it!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: My one and only! Love the limited additon cherry!!

reviews.review_title: Love this, a new go to....

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m not too fond of the herbal smell but this serum has prevented dry patches from forming on my face. It’s light and not oily at all. I would recommend.

reviews.review_text: It seems to work fine. There’s a mild scent and I wouldn’t call it lightweight. It feels like a film over the skin, but it’s not unpleasant. I prefer EltaMD sunscreen. I’d still use this though. Full disclosure: I received a complementary bottle for review from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Went on smooth, not too sticky and felt light on my face. I like how it’s a stick so I don’t have to touch my face to apply it. Conveniently, small and easy to carry in my purse. Full disclosure: I received a complementary full size product to review from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: On the plus side, it smells nice and feels good upon application. However, I don’t see much a difference in the puffiness of my under eye area after continued used for about a month AM and PM. I wouldn’t recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this and I am currently using the mini one. But, the formula seems to be super sticky. Overall though, I will repurchase this and it is a great pair with the Lala Retro Cream Moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Love this!! Got this in the birthday set for the month of February and I’m obsessed! Feels so hydrating and makes me look like a glazed donut! Definitely has the dewy finish to it.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Love love love! This is great for making smoothies with other drunk elephant products like the bronzi drops and rosi drops. I will definitely repurchase this when I run out. Worth the $$!!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have used this cleanser for years and has never irritated or make my skin red or anything but how it feels - my natural skin on my face and it makes me feel awake plus it is soy based and natural organic ingredients. That is why i love it so much!!

reviews.review_text: This I didn’t like because it promoted acne for me but I liked it. I am going  to order the the rice polish gentle version/1

reviews.review_text: Bought it in the store and loved it. The online promo has a smaller sample to use so I got 2 of them. I love fresh products a lot and am really Sephora carries them. :)

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Awesome Sweet Candy Lip Mask - Smells Amazing!!
reviews.review_text: I just got this Sweet Candy Lip Sleeping Mask from my online order and love the smell of it. I tried it on and it’s awesome. I thought of getting the original lip mask but love this scent instead now and it’s very moisturizing as that is what I need for my dry lips. I love this brand a lot!! :) I highly recommend it for anyone who had pretty dry and chapped lips like myself. I will use it when I sleep now. Can’t wait!! :)

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Gummy Lip Smelling Mask - Smells Great!!!
reviews.review_text: I love Laneige’s Gummy Bear Lip Sleeping Mask as it has all the essential fruits for my cracked lips but it sleeps awesome. I also have the Berry Lip Sleeping Mask and this smells super nice and fruity berry and that is what I like alot!!:)

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Amazing Mango Scent - Very Moisturizin On Lips !!
reviews.review_text: I love Laneige as I have collected and used many lip sleeping masks. I am so glad I ordered this Mango lip sleeping mask as it smells like the mango fruit and it is so hydrating and moisturizing on my lips like a lip balm/chapstick I used it in the daytime and love it before sleep time too. I highly recommend getting this mango lip sleeping mask ASAP as it is a limited edition scent.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried a ton of skincare lines- out of my own pocket. I know everyone’s skin is so different but I struggle with oil, congested pores, very visible pores and occasional hormonal cystic acne...... slight texture issues and SOME discoloring. Anyway...... this product I cannot say enough about. It’s amazing. It completely elevated my skin and it is glowing. I use it in conjunction with the sorbet and that’s it! Seriously worth the try...I also get occasional chemical peels and I will say that has also made a huge difference I think getting one at least once a month plus these products have changed my skin.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I truly have felt this has extended the affects of the professional peels I get about 6x a year. My skin is clearer and is much more glowyy. I use this twice a week for around 10 min ~ my skin is used to chemical exfoliants so if I go over it’s not the end of the world ~ but FOLLOW instructions! I have oily skin that has slight congestion and occasional cystic acne that hardly ever comes to a head. I am an OCD buyer and I wouldn’t review unless I truly believe in a product.

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I just recently got into toners and by - got into - I mean kinda wrapped my head around what they are used for. I hope my skin never adapts to it!

I was suffering from severe dry skin thanks to this winter weather, and this product has worked absolute wonders. It keeps my face hydrated without giving me an oily face afterward. This is an absolute plus in my book.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary through influenster. I absolutely loved this! It left my face hydrated for a long period of time. Definitely recommend!

reviews.review_text: This is a decent moisturizer. It’s not my favorite but it’s still good. My skin is dry so I have to use more than the recommended amount which I don’t like having to do. But I like how it makes my skin feel.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is absolutely one is the BEST moisturizers I’ve ever used. I am extremely picky about what I put on my face, because I DO NOT like the greasy or oily feel of most moisturizers. This liquid moisturizer is so light, it melts right into your skin. I was afraid that it wouldn’t do the job as some of the thicker creams, but I LOVE it! I’m not wearing near as much foundation or make up even because my actual skin looks amazing!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a few weeks now and my skin feels amazing. The first thing I noticed when I first opened the bottle was the fresh scent, which was amazing. The product itself is a little thin, I would’ve liked it to be just a little thicker. But, it works great and my skin is so soft! I would recommend this to anyone!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This Microfoliant is amazing. I had heard of this brand and wanted to try it out many times. The first time I tried the exfoliant, my skin was so smooth and refreshed. After that initial bump, it was all smooth. I didn’t give up on it and around my fourth or fifth try, this actually started working miracles. I started using this product in January and waited until now to post a review. The blemishes have reduced dramatically, acne has gone away and my skin hasn’t looked so good. I use this only in the mornings and moisturize it really will after applying. Love it. This works!

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: I’m on the fence with this product. The packaging is beautiful, and really convenient for on the go use. But let’s be honest, I’m not going to carry this thing around with me in my purse. I have combination skin, so I don’t need an extra pick me up throughout the day. It would just make me look like an oil slick.. The only way I can use this is at night during my skincare routine. The skin around my eyes were super dry and peeling, and I applied this all around the eye area and when I woke up the next morning it looked way better. It does feel a bit heavy, so I never used this on my entire face. It does tug a bit around the eyes as that skin is sensitive anyways, so I kind of just warmed it up on the back of my hand.. While I have been enjoying this, I can’t say that I will purchase when I run out. But if you’re someone who has dry skin, you will probably love it! Oh, and it doesn’t have a fragrance, which my sensitive skin personally likes.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: I’ve found my new face wash!
reviews.review_text: I have finally found it! After trying many face wash products over the past several months in search of a new product for my changing skin needs, I received @Tatcha Rice Wash #complimentary from @influenster for test purposes and I’m so glad I did.Let me first say the packaging was attractive and classy without being over the top or what I’d consider excessive or wasteful. The wash itself was even better. The texture was neither too thin/watery nor too thick/goopy. It was heavy enough to allow good coverage and the granules inside provided just the right amount of exfoliation without being abrasive. So I’d say mild and yet very effective. It rinsed away easy leaving my face feeling smooth and so clean and bright. I’ve been using it a.m. & p.m. yet it does not leave my face feeling dry at all. The scent is pleasant and soothing and I will most definitely be purchasing the @Tatcha Rice Wash as a permanent part of my daily facial cleansing routine. But don’t just take my word for it. I highly recommend you giving it a try for yourself. #MyRiceWash #complimentary @Tatcha @Influenster

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_title: can have a glow even in winter!
reviews.review_text: Oh man I love this. My skin doesn’t do well in the winter (I look like I’m sick when my skin is pale lol). This is my first time using self-tanning drops, and I haven’t had any issues in the past week with color transfer. I have sensitive combination skin that has handled it fine.For reference, my skin ranges between shades 22S and 36Sin the Tarte Tinted Moisturizer (I believe those are the codes for light-medium and medium skin tones but I can’t remember nor do I have the products with me at the moment. I normally mix the two to find my perfect shade). Prior to using the drops, it ran closer to the 22S side. I believe I applied 5-7 drops for my face the first time I used it, which really brought color back to my skin. For my body, I’ve stuck to 5-7 drops per limb. Reapplication frequency has varied. I’ve done my body more because there was less color, but I’d say you probably need to reapply ever few days to maintain the color.

reviews.review_text: I wanted to like this because I do like the brand, but it hasn’t wowed me. :/ I got it because I wanted to address my pores, but I haven’t seen any change in the past two weeks (maybe it needs longer to do something? I feel like I can usually tell if a skincare product is really great within 2 weeks though). Plus side is it does feel a bit hydrating on my combination skin. Downside is it’s brightening my skin, and I do NOT want that. Also, no pore shrinkage yet. After I finish this toner, I think I will go back to my usual toner and my usual night serum that has AHA + BHA instead of relying on this toner.

reviews.review_title: Works great! Approach with caution - very potent!
reviews.review_text: This does exactly what it’s supposed to and totally changed the texture of my skin for the better. My face was pulled tighter and was left virtually poreless. I will say that I have pretty sensitive skin so I only left it on for about 12 minutes the first time and I’m glad I did because my face turned tomato red for an hour or so after I took it off. It really did the trick and cleaned all the gunk out of the deeper layers of my skin! I am having some breakouts afterward but I’m also trying a couple other new products - not sure of the cause. Only try one new product at a time, kids!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been trying out a lot of skincare products lately (probably too many) in an attempt to revamp my routine and this one is the only one I know is here to stay. This makes a definable, obvious difference from the first use. It flattens out any breakouts, makes my skin tone more consistent, and has made the texture of my skin so much better over the last two weeks. I would strongly recommend this to anyone and everyone. I also use Drunk Elephant’s Sukari Babyfacial mask once every week or so and the combination of the two has dramatically changed my skin. Worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream will work wonders for your skin but be warned that it pills up pretty badly. I was lucky enough to discover this before trying under makeup but be warned: that would not go well. Try this at night first to see if it pills up. I’m continuing to use this because the glowy, luminous effects are worth having little moisturizer balls on my face at night.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE! Just added my second one to my cart. Works so well in melting your makeup especially waterproof mascara. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE! Just added my second one to my cart. Works so well in melting your makeup especially waterproof mascara. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been religiously using this for about a month. Totally game changer. I tried as a sample which lasted about two weeks and then decided to bite the bullet and get the bigger size. I have very acne prone/ scar skin and i’ve noticed a difference in my scars getting lighters and my pores getting smaller. Overall, my face just feels so soft and smooth. I use this in combination with the Marula Oil. I know it’s pricey but this is by far the best investment i’ve made.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: If you have tried the original sleeping mask this formula is a little thinner.. The smell isn’t overpowering and it does leave your lips looking nice and glowy. Loved it enough that i purchased it in 3 different flavors.

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is extremely hydrating! You’ll love it if your in need of some glow. I think the two step system is awesome and so fun to use. I love incorporating any good skincare into my nightly routine and this mask helps your skin feel soft, healthy, and plump in the morning. I tend to get dry skin around my nose and mouth and when I apply this, my skin is SO moisturized in the morning. You don’t need too much product, a little layer goes a really long way. If you apply too much, it will remain on your skin all night- which will get sticky, so don’t go overboard! The texture is high quality and the glass packaging makes it even more luxurious. I like to use it two to three times a week. This stuff is good!! This product for for testing purposes and was sent to me complimentary to try, however, all opinions are honest and my own.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_title: Haven’t broken out since using this!!
reviews.review_text: I have combo skin and tend to breakout a couple of times a month. I’ve been looking for a good moisturizer that has dual effects and this has been great!! Very high end feel to it and although it seems thick, it blends easily and doesn’t leave a greasy look. The salicylic acid and charcoal really help to keep my pores clean because I haven’t broken out since using this in my night time routine (it’s been about 3 weeks)! Influenster was kind enough to send me this product complimentary, but I enjoyed it and would definitely recommend it to anyone with acne prone skin. The only thing I wasn’t a fan of was the scent, it’s a little stronger than I would like, but it fades away once you blend it on the skin. Definitely won’t stop me from purchasing it in the future.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I am in LOVE. This oil is wonderful. It smells clean and absorbs quickly into the skin. It’s not thick at all but my skin stays hydrated. I use it before bed and have seriously noticed my skin looking softer and more revived since using it. I’ve used it for about 3 weeks now and hands down would buy it again. I was given this complimentary to try out, but I’m sold!!

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I have been using this eye cream for 2 weeks now, i use this every night and i have to say it has made a huge difference. I have really bad dark circles and my skin is very sensitive, this cream did not sting nor burn and have reduced the dark circled. My undereye area looks hydrated and makes my concealer look amazing.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I have really sensitive skin which becomes very dry in winter. This cream has done wonders, it does NOT  clog my pores, does NOT cause irritation rather its very moisturizing and made my skin very soft and supple.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Wow i am impressed I have very dry and sensitive skin so a lot moisturizers don’t work for me, but this one did wonders. It didn’t break me out and kept my skin hydrated. Can’t recommend this enough.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Wow i am impressed I have very dry and sensitive skin so a lot moisturizers don’t work for me, but this one did wonders. It didn’t break me out and kept my skin hydrated. Can’t recommend this enough.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_title: works but can feel uncomfortable and oily on skin
reviews.review_text: Been using this product for just about a week. The first night I used it I used a bit too much (over a pea-sized amount). I noticed it was an oily product right away. I tend to avoid oily-texture products but I decided to give it a try. I applied it to most areas of my face. I was breaking out a bit at the time on my cheeks and forehead. Immediately I noticed a tingling sensation that increased over time. It did feel quite uncomfortable, so much that I almost washed it off. I gave it some more time and the feeling eventually went away. Within 2 hours I looked in the mirror and the redness from my breakout spots were much brighter. So far I’ve been using this product in the PM, now more as a spot treatment on areas I want to brighten, like acne scars or small break out areas with redness. I use a pea-sized amount and just lightly dab it on to my skin. It can take a while to absorb. I still notice a strong tingling feeling though less intense than my first time. I use a different vitamin c product for the rest of my face.Overall I’ve noticed a reduction in the size of my break out areas, and my acne scars are brighter. My personal opinion is that it works, though it is not for everyone. The tingling may be overwhelming, and the oily texture of this product may not be desirable for some people.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Love! Using this for about 3 weeks now daily in the AM and my face always feels nice and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: Have been using this for about 3 weeks daily in the AM after HA+B5 and niacinamide. I find it’s a good consistency and does not leave a greasy or oily feeling on the skin.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: So I used these patches on 3 different pimples. 2 small ones and one larger one. It seemed to only really affect the large pimple after 2 days if applying patch.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I recurved a sample and IWas very impressed. I have sensitive combo skin. This melted into my skin and my makeup when on beautifully. It’s pricey so I’ll be saving up to buy a full size.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I recurved a sample and IWas very impressed. I have sensitive combo skin. This melted into my skin and my makeup when on beautifully. It’s pricey so I’ll be saving up to buy a full size.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this since Dec 2020. For reference I’m in my 40’s have combo/ sensitive skin. While I like this product it didn’t wow me. I notice it does dissolve all the makeup like some oil cleansers I use. I’ll stick to DHC oil from Target.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I don’t usually use eye creams but I got a deluxe sample with my points. It really has made a difference with the fine lines under my eyes. My eyes look less tired and puffy too. I’m 44, combo sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have super sensitive skin and this cleanser is really gentle on it. I love the smell not sure why the bad reviews but to me it smells like cucumber or some herb. I love it as my second cleanser. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: This is amazing with my skin. Since I received this I have been trying it every night before I apply the rest of my skincare and in the morning my skin feels so smooth and healthy! I definitely recommend this new formula and have already told my friends about it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: This is amazing with my skin. Since I received this I have been trying it every night before I apply the rest of my skincare and in the morning my skin feels so smooth and healthy! I definitely recommend this new formula and have already told my friends about it.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
reviews.review_text: This is amazing with my skin. Since I received this I have been trying it every night before I apply the rest of my skincare and in the morning my skin feels so smooth and healthy! I definitely recommend this new formula and have already told my friends about it.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Ever since I saw the launch of this sunscreen I was so excited and looking forward to trying out this brand. When I got the opportunity to test out this sunscreen and give it a try I was incredibly surprised because it was an amazing experience and one that I’m happy to do every single day. It has become a part of my routine and I love how milky and smooth it is.  it applies clear and absorbs into the skin. I really like the packaging because it’s easy to use and to keep it clean. The only thing is that when I applied it to my face it was a little bit irritating to my eyes but I quickly learned to avoid my eyes and All is well. I definitely recommend this to anyone because of how good it is.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: All I can say is this sunscreen stick is an excellent choice to use for every day and I love the fact that it glides on clear and it absorbs quickly into the skin leaving a nice safe barrier. It feels so smooth and nice not heavy on the skin at all it’s like a silk veil. It’s very practical in its form and easy to use.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Honestly, I didn’t think it did anything the first time I used it. It looked and felt like it just sat on top and the next day I went about my day not being wowed at my lips. HOWEVER, there is a significant difference in my lip texture when I do not use the mask. My lips are dry & cracked when I try to use a regular balm at night. My lip looks plumper after using this because the lines are not noticeable. I have chronic dry lips and on top of that I work with a mask in a dry environment. This product has been a life saver. No more dry cracked lips when I take off my mask.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has a clean scent and is lightweight. It’s gel-like consistency gives a nice cooling/refreshing feel when applied. I have extremely dry skin and I don’t find that it penetrates my skin adequately to feel hydrated. I can see myself using this in the summer, but not something I would reach for often.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster for review. I’m so happy to receive this because love this essence. I have highly reactive skin that’s prone to redness (dry skin, heat, cold, etc). I’ve noticed my skin is brighter, more even and less red and I feel like it’s been helping absorb all of my other skincare products. I was using a facial oil but felt like it didn’t penetrate fully into the skin but my skin has felt hydrated since using this prior to the oil. It doesn’t make me feel sticky and doesn’t have any bad scents. My skin doesn’t react at all upon application. I would definitely purchase this in the future!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster for review. I’m so happy to receive this because love this essence. I have highly reactive skin that’s prone to redness (dry skin, heat, cold, etc). I’ve noticed my skin is brighter, more even and less red and I feel like it’s been helping absorb all of my other skincare products. I was using a facial oil but felt like it didn’t penetrate fully into the skin but my skin has felt hydrated since using this prior to the oil. It doesn’t make me feel sticky and doesn’t have any bad scents. My skin doesn’t react at all upon application. I would definitely purchase this in the future!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this twice a day for a few days and my skin looks good. I wasn’t sure if I was going to like this as the scent it a little off-putting but my redness and pores seem to be diminished. It absorbs into my skin well and dries down so it doesn’t feel tacky. My skin doesn’t feel as hydrated as it usually does, but it could be due to the cold weather. I haven’t had any breakouts or irritation on my highly reactive skin. I would recommend this for someone who doesn’t have dry skin like me.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_title: Magic potion for dry wrinkled dull skin
reviews.review_text: This product claims that it1. improves skin texture2. visibly reduces fine lines3. increases skin’s radiance4. improves skin toneI cannot agree enough with the third point. It gives my skin a beautiful sheen after every use, which prevails. I have slightly textured and locally hyperpigmented skin that is wrinkled under my eyes and has fine lines on my forehead. I see improvement in skin texture after 3weeks of use. Not very sure about the fine lines, but I definitely sense my under-eye brightening up and feeling hydrated all the time. Haven’t seen any stark difference in skin tone, may be because it’s summer time and you get tanned a lot.But I am in love with the key ingredients and the texture and feel of it on the skin. It smells as clean and fresh as sunlit Pacific floras.Only con about this serum is it on a bit oilier side for Summer, hence not recommended for those who have super oily skins. I believe this one is going to be my Winter go to.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_title: Hydrates, soothes and loves my tired skin
reviews.review_text: Received this from Influenster for review purpose. I have dark circles since childhood, most probably it’s generic. I have tried numerous solutions. Some worked excellent, most didn’t. This one however worked well to soothe the tired skin under my eyes, hydrated it properly, toned the wrinkles down a tad. But the dark circle is not reduced yet, provided I used it every night in last 1week. I hope it works on that, no matter how slowly. The applicator couldn’t be better. I am looking forward to buy a full sized one, once my existing ones are over.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster,Clarins, and Sephora in exchange for my honest review.The Clarins Double Serum is enriched with goodness of Turmeric, an Ayurvedic herb trusted for thousands of years in Southeast Asia for glowing skin. I love this serum for how perfect amount of moisture it delivers to your skin. The fragrance is amazing and something that I would love to hold on to in hot sweaty Summer days. If you are not a fan of perfumed product I would recommend you to use it after a a few minutes of mixing it, once the fragrance starts fading away. I do not like fragranced skincare products, and yet it took my breath away.

reviews.product_name: Mini Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I remember really liking a small packet of this face wash sample that I’d chosen with another order. I had loved the texture (not harsh; you could feel small sugar crystals mixed in with the liquid) and had fallen absolutely in love with the smell. I thought I’d get the 50 mL tube because I couldn’t see myself using a physical exfoliate everyday (maybe 1-2 a week). With this face wash you only need a pea size amount which rubs all over your face. But when I got this 50ml tube, I couldn’t smell anything and washing with this didn’t give a luxurious feel; I felt I could pick up another exfoliator from the drug store. So I’ve returned it.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_title: This is a return for me
reviews.review_text: Really don’t understand what the hype is about.. unnecessarily raved product. This is just like any other peeling mask that you keep on and then massage off. The texture is like putting a wet tissue paper on your face and massaging it around. There’s no grit to the product. Spoonful of chickpea flour with milk or yogurt is a better alternative than this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_title: This is a return for me
reviews.review_text: Really don’t understand what the hype is about.. unnecessarily raved product. This is just like any other peeling mask that you keep on and then massage off. reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I had bought the 150 mL tube (limited edition) for $24.50, so got it at a pretty good deal. Not super impressed with it though. I like the texture, just like a gel face wash that lathers up nicely. It’s got the franchise lotus youth preserve moisturizer scent that lingers on even after washing. However, I find this is very drying on my skin, and that is what matters to me most, so will be returning. I have better options from Sephora (Purity cleanser, Fulvic acid cleanser) that seem to work better on my skin, so I’ll stick to those.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Got a 15 ml sample with another order. It might last me about 15 face washes, so comparing product to price it’s darn expensive. That said, it’s a gel face wash that lathers up nicely. It has a “grass juice” smell to it, and having had grass juice before the smell makes me nauseous; don’t think I could be cleansing with this everyday. The after feel is nice; it’s got a matte, clean feel without overly drying. Decent face wash, I don’t think I’ll see benefits face wise from a face wash, so for the price point I don’t think I would be purchasing this cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Bought this during Winter sale for $15 (150mL tube). This might be my new favourite cleanser. It’s thickk, and a small pea size is enough to lather on your face. It smells like fruit loops to me. And, it has a nice after feel; my face doesn’t feel crinkly, it’s matte, non-drying and comfortable. I tried washing a lip stain with this, but wasn’t able to remove, so that’s why docked off a star. Otherwise, this is definitely a great cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This really is the best lip mask, especially in the Winter, when I find myself reaching for this all the time. I had bought the original until my sister stole it (she loves it too) and took it to Uni. I’m now trying to get as many uses out of a dime sample that I added to my order, lol and so far I’ve been able to get 15 uses out of it; and maybe 5 more. The hydration stays after application for a good couple or more hours. I have bite beauty lip masks too, but I’m finding myself gravitating towards laneige (bite is thickker in texture). The texture of this is like whipped Vaseline if that makes sense. There’s no taste to this, but a nice sweet Candy floss scent. I’ll see if I can purchase another scent next time I buy again.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I got a 2ml sample with an order, and got 3 uses out of it. I really hoped that I would like this, and maybe my expectation was that it would feel like DE Lala Retro or FAB intense hydration, but it wasn’t. This felt like a medicinal cream, kind of thick texture and has an old smell. I didn’t like the after feel.. will stick to my FAB intense cream.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I had added a sample with an order to try this out. It’s a thick texture and when I put it on my face, the texture is like when u put on a bubble face cleanser (but this cleanser doesn’t bubble up it lathers). It’s got an old rancid smell, and I was expecting it to perform like the rice polish enzyme powder but it’s nothing like it. Just a usual, thick face cleanser with a bad smell.. didn’t like. Maybe it has long term beneficial properties, but nope I can’t get past the smell and will stick to buying the rice polish enzyme powder instead.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: The texture of this cleansing balm is amazing. It literally melt in to your skin like butter. The scent is light and fresh , not too fragrant. When it comes to makeup removal it does get the job done but you have to throughly massage it in.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have combo/dry skin with eczema and this serum is amazing. It hydrated really well while still being super lightweight on the skin. The texture is beautifully silky and glides in with ease. I have also noticed my skin is a little clearer since I started using it. It gives my skin a very dewy smooth look after using it. The smell is super subtle but pleasant and I just love how luxurious the packaging and little spoon make the product feel.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have combo/dry skin with eczema and this serum is amazing. It hydrated really well while still being super lightweight on the skin. The texture is beautifully silky and glides in with ease. I have also noticed my skin is a little clearer since I started using it. It gives my skin a very dewy smooth look after using it. The smell is super subtle but pleasant and I just love how luxurious the packaging and little spoon make the product feel.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This overnight lip mask really works. I use it for my sons lips and it keep them moisturized. I also scrubbed my lips raw once and this healed them while keeping them soft. It’s unscented and the texture reminds me of lanolin or Aquaphor.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product was in a sample skincare set I bought from Sephora a few weeks ago. I LOVED IT!! My skin felt so clean and fresh after each use. It’s got such a fresh scent and feels light on my skin. I just ran out of the sample size and have purchased the full size bottle.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product was in a sample skincare set I bought from Sephora a few weeks ago. I LOVED IT!! My skin felt so clean and fresh after each use. It’s got such a fresh scent and feels light on my skin. I just ran out of the sample size and have purchased the full size bottle.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I love this product!!! I’ve been trying to find an under eye moisturizer to minimize the “You look tired” look. After a few trial and errors, I’ve stumbled upon the Belif Moisturizing Eye Bomb and have found my perfect remedy! It’s so light and effective enough for day and night use. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: I tried this product as part of a set by The Ordinary. This moisturizer is amazing! I apply it at night after my serum and oil and in the morning, my skin was still very hydrated. The more I use it, the longer I’ve noticed my skin is hydrated. I really like this product!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using DE for a couple of years, and the line has totally transformed my skin. When I first tried B-Hydra, I wasn’t that impressed, especially in comparison to TLC, C-Firma, Marula, etc. I felt like it was an unnecessary step in my routine. After repurchasing recently, I fell totally in love. It just amplifies each step of my routine - my face is noticeably more plump, smooth, bright, and hydrated. I didn’t give 5 stars because it’s not something I can’t live without, but it’s still a great product. I will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_title: Healed dryness, works well under makeup
reviews.review_text: I’ve been struggling with consistent dry patches from winter with no help from my eye creams. I decided to buy the small jar of Kiehl’s eye cream and wow.. it healed my dry patches so quickly!! It is rich and creamy but not oily. I started by using this only at night but I like to wear it during the day now too. Sure it takes just a little longer to fully sink in but once it does it works so well under my makeup and I no longer have to deal with that tight dry feeling and no more flaky skin either. I don’t think I’ll bu the bigger size bc the small size is still quite a lot of product and a little goes such a long way. I think that, given the jar packaging, the product would “expire” in the Big jar before I even finish it

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Guys.. what IS this magical product?! I love DE so, naturally, I snagged this mf as soon as it became available. Truthfully, however, I wasn’t entirely sure what to expect/whether it would live up to its hype. Well, it did. I have a medium skin tone, so I use anywhere between 0.5 to 1 full pump of this mixed in with my Umbra Tinte (after applying a C-Firma, B-Hydra, and Lala cocktail) and I have completely stopped wearing foundation. I used to wear tinted moisturizer (not DE) daily, and foundation sporadically, and now it’s D-Bronzi daily, tinted moisturizer sporadically. I feel so confident in my skin now! Also, when I don’t use Umbra Tinte, D-Bronzi gets rid of any white cast from my older sunscreens which is great because now they won’t go to waste. Like all of DE’s products, the packaging is excellent

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for almost 3 weeks & I’m already noticing a positive difference. My under eye area is usually a little dark, slightly sunk in/yet puffy. This eye cream has helped in evening out the tone of my under eyes & keeps the area moisturized. I apply this with my AM routine (I use it if I’m planning on wearing makeup, too) & my PM routine. My under eye is slightly brighter. The biggest difference is how hydrated my under eye area is now & I love that this eye cream doesn’t irritate my eyes (I have super sensitive, dry eyes).

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: In the past, I’ve struggled to find skincare products that work for my sensitive skin (I have mild acne & severe rosacea). I was excited & nervous about using this product, because I’ve gotten my skin under control. This product helped with active acne & it doesn’t make my rosacea flare up. So far, I’ve incorporated it into my morning & nighttime routines, I’ve already noticed a positive difference in my skin. It can dry your skin out if you use it with other actives (which has happened to me), but overall, it’s a wonderful product.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have a normal skin (outside of having sensitive/rosacea skin). I’ve been using this moisturizer at night, after all of my serums & I’m enjoying it. My skin is noticeably softer & brighter in the morning after wearing this overnight. I don’t wear it in the morning/daytime, it’s very heavy, too rich for my to wear under makeup. It’s a great nighttime moisturizer & it definitely keeps my skin from drying out with all the other products in my routine.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Great for my oily, yet dehydrated, skin. This is the only moisturizer I’ve found that doesn’t break me out, but keeps my winter face baby soft.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Moisture and Glow for All Ages
reviews.review_text: Superfood for the skin. I’ve been dealing with some allergy-induced acne and was almost afraid to add this to my routine; however, this is exactly the kind of moisture my skin was needing after attacking the breakout with my full arsenal of acids. Good for all ages, which is the main reason I chose it over the Glow Recipe line (which seems to only work for “young skin”, I’m in my mid-thirties).

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Loved this product! It didn’t burn or irritated  my skin at all.The scent wasn’t too strong or harsh either.I used this at night and in the a.m. I felt like my skin looked a bit brighter than usual. I can’t wait to see long term results!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I really love this product! It’s very clean smelling and doesn’t leave a gross “film“ as other products do. It seemed to seep into my skin very nicely. I noticed a big improvement in the texture of my skin after using this for just a week.I can’t wait to see what it will do in a month!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Since I received this as a sample, I will only share my limited experience.I loved it! It didn’t break me out and didn’t “sit“ on my skin.The smell was good and not overwhelming. I can’t really say whether this worked or not ,but I will be buying a full bottle so I can really tell if it makes a significant difference in my skin tone.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is a very hydrating balm that helped get rid of my chronic, dry cracked lips! I am not a big fan of the scent, but it definitely did the job of keeping my lips super hydrated! Definitely recommend. Complimentary from fresh

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This exfoliant did a nice job getting rid of any flakes and dead skin cells off my face. It felt a lot smoother after using and my face appeared brighter as well. It’s better than other exfoliants I’ve tried! Gifted by dermalogica

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This is wonderful for breakouts! I use it twice daily & there was a significant decrease in breakouts. It also helped with my hormonal breakouts which I did not expect. I love it. Great value too! This is now a staple for my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer. It’s nice and light and is a great final step to my skincare routine. I wish it had a little SPF in it but it’s not a big deal to mix it with some SPF during my daytime routine. I love the glow   and hydration it provides.

reviews.review_text: I previously used the Vitamin C Suspension in Silicone and it was awful. This one is so much better! It actually stays put, I have had no issues with peeling like I did with the silicone. It goes on so easy, just like moisturizer. My only issue is that it’s super gritty compared to the silicone based suspension. But the results are undeniable. Highly recommend

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a free sample and tried this moisturizer out. I liked the glow it gave me without the greasy feeling. Made my skin feel soft and face feel radiant. Must try!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream

My skin is definitely smoother and stays moisturized just the perfect amount (no dry skin spots, but doesn’t make skin oily at all either). It goes on easily and has a light, refreshing scent. reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: This scrub is amazing! The lemon sugar scent is wonderful and the scrub gently exfoliates without being too intense. It left my face feeling clean and fresh, visibly brighter, with less oil the next day. And I love that it is cruelty-free!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: My first 1 star review for Inkey
reviews.review_text: I love the Inkey List and I wanted to love this so much. It felt amazing under the eyes and was so moisturizing. I do not have the most sensitive skin,and I’m so sad this didn’t work out for me. Atleast it wasn’t much money,but sadly it’ll be going to the trash.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I definitely notice a brightening and firming effect. Sometimes I feel like it “stops” working after a while, so I give it a break, but then my skin doesn’t look as great. This just means that it is always working but I’ve just gotten used to the effects. I’ve tried many other peptide formulas (because this one is so expensive), but I always come back to this one - I have probably gone through 10 bottles since it came out.   This is a good enough moisturizer for oily skin types, but probably not enough for dry/normal types. The texture is extremely light and airy so your skin will absorb it quickly. If you have dry skin I would mix it with a couple of drops of your favourite oil (ex. Rosehip seed). I use this on my body too a few times a week by mixing a few pumps with my regular body lotion.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Perfect for dry/normal skin all year round and oily skin in the winter. It’s definitely not cheap but nothing else can replace this. I use this as the last step to my 10 step skincare routine as an occlusive to “seal” everything in. It’s oily but not as thick as it looks because it melts over your warm skin. I have acne prone skin and this doesn’t clog my pores or cause breakouts.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is the first butter/oil balm cleanser I tried and I immediately fell in love. I don’t think I’ll ever need to try another one as I have no complaints with this. I don’t even use makeup remover anymore. This stuff can take off my whole cake face including waterproof mascara and false lash glue. The best part is it’s not drying at all. I used to aggressively wipe my makeup off with cotton pads soaked in bi-phase makeup remover solution and then follow up with a foaming face wash (sometimes have to wash twice) and my skin would be so dry and tight after. I also did a course of accutane and this stuff was gentle enough for my super sensitive skin.

reviews.review_title: I loved it, but I can’t to the fragrance anymore
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer, I really do. I have combination-dry skin and it was my go to daytime for the longest time! It really helped with my moisture barrier whenever it got trashed, and I absolutely love it. I even got my mom who has EXTREMELY DRY SKIN (who also just doesn’t like skincare that much) to love this, and she actively went out a BOUGHT A JAR BY HERSELF WHEN SHE RAN OUT! She has NEVER done this, and she also has never bought any skincare product more than $10, and if I’m being honest, this is the 2nd skincare product she’s ever went out and bought. My only issue is that my skin has randomly decided that it can’t do as much fragrance as it used to in a leave on treatment, and now I can’t use it as much. I still actively love it and recommend it to people, but I just had to shy away from it. If they ever came out with a fragrance free version, I would buy 20 of them the day they dropped it.

It reminds me of the cheaper Body Shop products since they never fully get absorbed into skin.

I did notice my skin glowed and looked plumper on the nights I used the product, so I do feel it would be effective. I have used Dr. Dennis Gross’ products in the past and I’m a huge fan so I’d definitely recommend it to anyone on the fence about trying this or any other of his products.

reviews.review_text: I received this product as complimentary from innisfree in order to give my honest review. I absolutely love this face mask! It is quite drying though because it takes out EVERYTHING from your skin (all impurities) so I highly recommend going in with a heavy moisturizer afterwards! The volcanic clusters really do their job. I highly recommend this for a weekly face mask for those with combination to oily skin.

reviews.review_text: Love this product! I suffer with hyper pigmentation, dry AND oily skin, sensitivity which cause breakouts etc... my skin changes due to hormones and seasons. But the best part is how my skin looks and feels in the morning. I’ve been using it for over 1 year and it has proven to be a staple in my nightly skin care. Smells great too!

After my first use of this I did notice my skin was very soft and smooth, the dry areas were almost completely gone, my skin was left non-irritated and very glowy! 4 stars only because it has been only 5 uses, can’t wait to see results after a month of use!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed using this cleansing balm, it is a great texture and consistency for removing heavy makeup! It is very creamy and does not feel stripping what so ever on the skin. It gently yet efficiently removes everything from long wearing mascara to waterproof concealer. I am very happy with how it leaves your skin feeling very hydrated afterwards as well! The scent is very lemon which is something I could do definitely go without, which is why I’m only giving 4 stars! This product sizing for the price is amazing as well, you get so much and only need a little!

It has a bit of a smell to it but quickly dissipates when it absorbs. I’m excited to see with further use how this brightens my skin as I do have some pigmentation I’m looking to brighten up!

reviews.review_text: I have a combination skin which gets dry near the upper lips and nose. This product get absorbed to my skin like anything. If you have a dry skin, I would suggest a thicker moisturizer.

reviews.review_text: I received this product a second one of my 100 points gifts. And I gave to a friend who was having acne problems at the time, since I don’t tend to get acne often. She said that it was the best thing she ever tried. She had a few zit under her skin around her chin and applied this oil over night. Her result were immediate. The swelling had gone down and even dried the problem areas. So this review is based off her expert and what she stated.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a complimentary mini soze Byblos’s using my Sephora points. This product has been on my list to try since all the other moisturizer she I’ve used have been subpar. And I have to say I’m glad I finally got my hands on this. It isn’t one of the best moisturizers I have used. It makes my skin feel so soft, smooth, and refreshing. Not sticky or tacky. Also, I find that it goes all through the night after cleansing and toning. When I awake, my skin still feels smooth. I have combination skin and it does wonders for me. I can’t speak about everyone else, but I’m in love with this product. Just ordered two of the Sephora tatcha bestsellers kit and I cannot wait to try the rest of the products in order to order my full sizes.

reviews.review_text: I received this as one of my birthday gifts from Sephora. (Mini size, of course) I was hesitant to try it since I’m a tatcha water cream girl. But I have to say, after using this moisturizer, I have found my skin to be very moisturized and soft after cleansing, toning, adding a little bit of grape seed oil, and then the moisturizer. My face looks clean and healthy after applying the cream. On the days where I just use toner and the cream, I get the same results. I’m on the ropes of buying this in full size since I really enjoyed the experience. I did not have this kind of reaction to the Water Cream and I love Tatcha products. Also, I’m normal to oily skin around my T zone. I have not noticed any breakout issues other than the one’s I get on the norm.

reviews.review_text: I got this cleanser around a month ago and I have been using it every morning and night before doing my skincare. I like how this one comes with a pump because for the clinique one I always had to open the cap to use it.

It smells strongly of watermelon, but I personally don’t mind it!It’s a liquid serum, but when you apply onto your face it has a very tacky feeling. Some other serums might have a more watery consistency, but if you are fine with the tackiness this is perfectly fine!I read many reviews that people will put it in their primer for makeup, but I personally put it on as the last step of my morning skincare routine right before I put on a moisturizer and sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: the only thing that clears up my skin!
reviews.review_text: Literally clears up your skin overnight. I can’t stay how important this is to me in my skincare routine. Just make sure you wear sunscreen everyday! My skin is sensitive so when I first started using it, there was a very slight burning sensation but that went away quickly.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_title: Not for me, maybe for you
reviews.review_text: I wanted to like this sunscreen because I heard so much about it and I love to get the natural dewy glow. However, this one is just not for me. I put in on after my moisturizer and I usually don’t wear makeup on top of that. After a couple of hours, I felt like my face looked so oily and greasy. :(When I was putting in on, I waited to let it absorb and pat it on, but I feel like I started to get a little bit of piling. I feel like under foundation it does give an ok glow, but without makeup it’s too much for my skin. I have dry cheeks and oily T-zone, but I feel like this still make me look so greasy all over my face.I am going to try the summer friday sunscreen drops, hopefully that will work better for me.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: For a high-end skin care product, you totally get your moneys worth! I know a lot of other brands charge $70  for 0.5 oz of product and that’s not the case here. The product is a light green color and doesn’t really have a smell (a plus for me, I don’t care for scented skincare). A little goes a long way, I use a pea size amount and that covers my under-eye and eyelid area up to my brow bone. The cream is just the right thickness to moisturize the area but it doesn’t take a long time to sink in. I’ve used  it morning and night for almost a month now and I haven’t noticed any irritation or break outs. *I got this for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review*

reviews.review_text: I had never tried an essence before. After trying this product I think I will be making them a permanent part of my routine. reviews.review_text: I love love love love this product! I use it year round as my morning and night moisturizer. It’s the perfect amount of thickness for my combo and sometimes dry skin. It feels so silky when applying and sinking into my face. I also love the packaging because it prevents bacteria growth by having an open jar. The pump also ensures I don’t use more product than necessary stretching the time I’m able to get out of each jar (4ish months with 2x daily use).

reviews.review_text: I finally caved and purchase this product while on vacation in Las Vegas without my usual sunscreen. It’s so light weight and has a barely there feel which is just what you want in a facial sunscreen. It has a silky slip to it that has doubled as my makeup primer. This is the first sunscreen I’ve been compelled to reapply mid day with because it’s so light.

reviews.review_title: Gave me a rash after first use
reviews.review_text: This is the first DE product I haven’t loved. I woke up in an all over face rash the morning after my first use. I have pretty tolerant skin that’s well acclimated to strong acids so I was surprised to experience such a bad reaction. My fault for not doing a patch test first. I’m a big fan of DE b-hydra, Protini, and c-tango so bummed that baby facial didn’t work for me.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a week now and I’m BLOWN AWAY at how much this has Transformed my skin. I have dry, sensitive, and textured skin with very occasional hormonal pimples. Recently I had a couple of blackheads for the first time I guess because I hadn’t been exfoliating properly. But my skin is so sensitive I really hate strong chemical exfoliants or even most granular physical ones. I didn’t purchase this with the expectation it would fix my problem I was just trying to consolidate my cleansing oil and enzyme powder cleanser step and was just excited to try something new. Turns out this is what my skin needed all along my random blackheads are gone, but that’s not even the best part. My skin texture has disappeared! I’m even and glowy after ONE USE. it’s only gotten better after a full week. The fragrance is not bothersome like some have mentioned and I have the most sensitive skin ever so I imagine the vast majority of people could tolerate the fragrance. Plus you wash it off. This does leave a film even after rinsing it off so this product is only for a double cleansing routine.  I follow this up with the krave matcha hemp gel cleanser because the gel is strong enough to cleanse the film but gentle enough never to leave my skin stripped or inflamed. These two products are a match made in heaven!  I cannot rave about this enough. Love this stuff, it’s earned a permanent spot in my routine.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: No irritation even for my hypersensitive and dry skin. It’s not fragranced and the texture of this cream is great to apply! I’ve been terrible and not managed to apply this consistently enough to see major results (hence 4 stars) but with absolutely no irritation even if the results are subtle I think this is a great starter retinol product before I move up to more potent products.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: And I don’t use HG status lightly. I have extremely sensitive and dry skin so discovering oil cleansing has been a game-changer. However, finding a product with a texture I liked without a strong fragrance has been difficult. Cue the oat cleansing balm!; soothing, cheap, and effective. It is like a thick oil/balm texture than removes makeup and sunscreen flawlessly with little effort. Two things to note, however; first, this is not going to be a good enough cleanse on its own as it does leave a slight film. You will need a second cleanser (double cleansing method), so then it’s a non-issue. Second, due to the oat powder or something in this, there is a very very very slight grit if you rub very hard. I have sensitive skin and find that it’s not a problem at all including around my eyes. I just wouldn’t recommend scrubbing your skin with all of your might. Even with those slight issues, it’s still my favorite and I would recommend it to anyone. I’m on probably my 5th bottle now because I find that nothing else compares and it’s such an important soothing step in my routine. Please never stop making this.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Keeps lips nice and moist overnight. I love the smell. Living in a dry climate, it does not produce any miracles, but is lovely nonetheless.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
