reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love how hydrated and youthful this makes my skin look. Makes my skin look and feel fresh and moisturized. Definitely would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love how hydrated and youthful this makes my skin look. Makes my skin look and feel fresh and moisturized. Definitely would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Awesome quality! Feels amazing on my skin and makes my skin look and feel hydrated, youthful and smooth. Definitely would recommend!

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I purchased the Black Friday special size for this product and used it as a makeup remover instead of using makeup wipes and I love it! I went back to purchase the full size item since and this is definitely my go-to makeup remover.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I purchased the Black Friday special size for this product and used it as a makeup remover instead of using makeup wipes and I love it! I went back to purchase the full size item since and this is definitely my go-to makeup remover.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: Received this as a VIB gift with a $35 purchase, I have been using this for the last two weeks now and my pores have minimized and my skin is noticeably clearer and brighter. I am very pleased with this product so far and will consider purchasing the full sized product after my little sample jar runs out.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: By far one of my favorite moisturizers. I’ve tried this dewy skin cream and the water cream from Tatcha and they are honestly some of my favorites. This dewy skin cream does exactly what it’s called, it leaves my skin feeling moisturized and hydrated. I love wearing this under makeup and have come to also love a few other Tatcha products. I’ve tried many moisturizers and decided to repurchase this one because it doesn’t leave a thick sticky layer for me as some of other moisturizers do.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: Really helps with getting rid of redness and puffiness overnight, and a good alternative to picking.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: The tone, evenness, brightness, texture, acne, EVERYTHING got better because of this product. The price sucks. So much. But I will use it forever. I cannot believe how much my skin has changed.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: The tone, evenness, brightness, texture, acne, EVERYTHING got better because of this product. The price sucks. So much. But I will use it forever. I cannot believe how much my skin has changed.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin is better because of this product. It evened out my tone and texture and douses every bit of my skin in hydration. I hate myself for trying it, because I now will never go back. A costly, but worth-it find.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin is better because of this product. It evened out my tone and texture and douses every bit of my skin in hydration. I hate myself for trying it, because I now will never go back. A costly, but worth-it find.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE this. My lips feel so hydrated after using this. I used to wake up and have to put on a balm immediately, but I’ve noticed a huge difference with how my lips feel when I use it before bed. No more dry, cracked, or flaking lips, and no feeling like I need to grab my lip balm the minute I wake up. It also smells wonderful!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: Great Balm Cleanser for 1st Step in Double Clean
reviews.review_text: I first tried this when I got a sample with purchase. I loved it then, and now I’m halfway through the jar I purchased and I love it still. It smells wonderful, it really does melt away stubborn makeup, especially waterproof mascara, and my skin feels soft and nourished. No breakouts, and any residue is removed with my second cleanse. It doesn’t take much to do the job, so the jar will last forever.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_title: Great Balm Cleanser for 1st Step in Double Clean

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has been perfect for my dry combination skin.  I feel hydrated, soft, and my skin is nice and plump without feeling heavy or greasy. The gel-like consistency sinks into the skin instantly. I’m on my second full-size, and I will absolutely purchase again.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was able to try the Honey Halo complimentary from Farmacy Beauty and have been using it  for 3 weeks and it’s something my skin desperately needed with the change of season. The emollients in this products replenish and basically rehydrated any dry skin. As someone who suffers from excema and dry skin constantly this is a product that I’m going to keep on my shelf through the winter.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Having Dry Skin in the summer time is always an issue for me. Heavy creams and oils are always unbearable. Ive been using this mask morning and night as an all in one mask, moisturizer, eye cream and make up primer. This is my go to when traveling- I have a tube in my bathroom, purse and gym bag! The new formulation is absolutely less irritating if you maybe just exfoliated and Ive found it layers much better with other products without and pilling.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: Love that with the new launch of the updated packaging they released a tinted version! This just has a subtle nude tint to the same formula of the OG lip balm. Looks great on its own or paired with a nude lip liner!

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: I absolutely loved this product before and the only issue was the packaging. Love that the gals at Summer Fridays listened and changed it up to make this more functional. Same great formula just an easy to use applicator. Also the applicator is molded to fit around your lips which it a great touch!

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: Wish I could give this zero stars. This smells like fish, I couldn’t get over the overwhelming odor. Tried to wash it off to no avail.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: As previous reviewers mentioned, this product broke me out like crazy. Only used it three times so far and only now realized that this must be the cause of all the pimples popping up all over my face as nothing else has changed in my skincare routine. I normally love everything Tilbury and as a proud Brit, been supporting her ever since she launched her makeup brand however this is one product I sadly cannot recommend.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I don’t get the hype around DE. Who is their target audience? Young adults that cannot afford their products or more mature people that are put off by their juvenile packaging? This is an okay moisturizer, absolutely nothing outstanding, for the price I expected much, much more. I’m going back to Tatcha and Estee Lauder.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I have super dry skin that’s sensitive so I was a bit worried about trying this but I shouldn’t have. I had a bit of hormonal breakout going on around my chin and this beautiful cream cleared that up within two days with ease. That’s salicylic acid for you. Texture is smooth and luxurious, there’s a faint scent to it but nothing over-the-top or artificial. I really enjoy this product despite it being advertised for oily/combination skin. I’ll keep this on my routine as it’s hard to find a good salicylic moisturizer that doesn’t dry out skin. This one is perfect.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using Algenist’s Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm in my skincare routine for over a year but I recently received some samples so I was instructed to leave a review.It has a true balm consistency, sinks right into skin, no fragrance, no irritation and leaves my sensitive undereye area nicely prepped and moisturized. Comparable to other skincare products in the same price range. For reference, I’m in my early 40s with fine lines, no dark circles and very dry/dehydrated skin (I live in the desert).

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant and Daily Superfoliant for the longest time however I have received a few sample sachets complimentary from Dermalogica for my honest review. For reference, I have dry, dehydrated, ageing skin. I keep repurchasing this product because it’s so gentle and effective at exfoliating, I could use it every day. I don’t, but I could if I wanted to. I find that incorporating Daily Microfoliant into my skincare routine 3 times a week is the perfect balance for me. This product may seem a little intimidating at first - you have to ’freshly’ prepare it each time by pouring about a half tablespoon of powder in the palm of your hand and adding water til you get a nice paste consistency. Apply this paste all over face and neck area (or anywhere else you wish), rinse off and pat dry. Follow up with a moisturizer. Will leave your skin feeling not only squeaky clean but also super soft.I find this Daily Microfoliant to be great value for money as the full-sized product generally lasts me a full calendar year.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_title: amazing for oily, acne-prone... now dry skin!
reviews.review_text: I started using this lotion with my regular acne-prone, VERY oil skin. I’ve tried so many products in my life and this was the only lotion that wouldn’t make me break out more. Unfortunately, I couldn’t fix my acne so I ended up going on Accutane, so now I can also tell you that this moisturizes very dry skin very well too

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love it. I’m on Accutane rn and my skin is crazy dry. I do agree with others that when I wake up, it’s still on my face. Idk if that’s necessarily a bad thing? But it seems to really moisturize my skin, and I like feeling like I can layer a bunch of things and then top off with this and it’ll keep everything in overnight :)

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I usually don’t breakout after going on Accutane, but this unfortunately makes me get pimples on my lip line :( It smells nice and I like the consistency, and it does help my chapped lips. But it’s not worth it for me when it gives me huge zits. Definitely do a small sample size if you’re acne prone

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_title: if other lip products break you out, TRY THIS!!
reviews.review_text: finally, a lip balm that doesn’t break me out. THANK GOD. idk what it is, but literally every other lip thing i’ve tried from other brands makes me break out in pimples around my mouth - laneige lip mask and balm, burts bees, jack black, eos, any chapstick, even just aquaphor’s lip balm, i always get whiteheads around my mouth when i use them. i’d mostly resigned myself to having chapped lips forever, but i love belifs moisturizing bomb so i gave this lip mask a shot and it doesn’t break me out!! i’m so happy. i’ve been using it for more than two months now and no whiteheads!! my lips are better now but still a bit chapped, but i’m admittedly not good about putting this on every night. when i’m good about it, my lips are much better. SO HAPPY!!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I got a sample of this when I purchased the Drunk Elephant Get Even kit, which included the Umbra Tinte sunscreen, and this one is sooo much better. I have sensitive skin, and some sunscreens give my face a burning sensation throughout the day, especially if my face gets hot. This one does not do that at all. The texture is very similar to the Murad Invisiblur that I used years ago when they were cruelty free. Since Supergoop is CF, I think this might be my new go to sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great face wash for sensitive and dry skin. It is very gentle and doesn’t feel like it strips my skin of natural moisture, while still making me feel fresh and clean. The consistency is nice, almost like a very thin gel, and it has a very slight foam without being drying. I also like the glass/pump packaging. Definitely my new go to for cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great face wash for sensitive and dry skin. It is very gentle and doesn’t feel like it strips my skin of natural moisture, while still making me feel fresh and clean. The consistency is nice, almost like a very thin gel, and it has a very slight foam without being drying. I also like the glass/pump packaging. Definitely my new go to for cleanser.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is honestly life changing. I have ridiculously dry skin, and over the past year or so I’ve been getting serious about my skincare. I truly believe this is what kept my face from getting chapped and flakey over the winter. It removes dullness and makes your skin fresh and glowy. In fact after I began using this, I stopped wearing skin makeup all together, save for concealing the occasional blemish. After I used it up I decided to try a different chemical exfoliator, and though the new one is fine, I found myself missing this one. I know it’s pricey, but I can’t even tell you how worth it the price tag is. New holy grail, all hail Drunk Elephant.

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Just what I was looking for
reviews.review_text: Love this gel! I have a mix of dry and sensitive skin prone to breakouts and this works exactly how I hoped it would. Sinks in fast, is cooling and doesn’t aggravate my rosacea, doesn’t feel greasy and has a vibrant citrus scent. The texture is lovely. I wouldn’t say my skin looks any different with this compared to other moisturizers but it feels less aggravated and more hydrated. I layer the Herbivore Lapis oil and it seems to be working together fine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Great exfoliant for sensitive skin! I don’t use it daily but it doesn’t aggravate my rosacea when I use it 2-3 times a wee and seems to calm my redness. It leaves my skin feeling really soft but not stripped. The only reason I’m not leaving 5 stars is because it’s a little difficult to control how much comes out of the shaker.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_title: A staple in my sensitive skin routine.
reviews.review_text: I love the way this oil works, feels, and smells. I have sensitive skin that can sometimes get rosacea and I don’t find this irritates me at all. With most Dermalogica products I really find your results drastically increase when you use more products from their line. Paired with the calming cleanser this works really for me, removes makeup, doesn’t cause irritation, breaks down my sunscreen, and helps prevent my face from feeling stripped after cleansing.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Good Genes helps tremendously in colder climates
reviews.review_text: Living in a cold weather climate...by cold I mean it’s been-20F for 2 weeks now. My face is dry which makes it hard to even wear makeup as it just leaves my face flakey! I have deep under eye circles along with a few deep forehead wrinkles. I’ve been consistently using Sunday Riley Good Genes which I was gifted by Sunday Riley for an honest opinion. My skin feels rejuvenated! I normally have fairly sensitive skin and the directions say to use and rinse face if you have sensitive skin or just apply if you don’t. I don’t have to rinse it off! My skin tone is looking better with no red dry patches. I can apply makeup whenever I want without being flakey and my deep wrinkles are subsiding. I have larger pores on my nose and chin area that I never really knew how to fix or hide, good genes reduces the appearance of these pores and even has gotten rid of most of this issue. The product doesn’t leave my skin oily, it absorbs into your skin within minutes. The smell has a light citrus aroma which isnt overpowering and doesn’t linger. The consistency isn’t overly thick and applies smoothly. Great packaging as it has a dense foam insert to protect the glass bottle while in transit to you. I plan on continuing to use Sunday Riley Good Genes for the foreseeable future after trying it.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I’ve really seen an improvement with my dark under circles. This is the primary area I like using the product. I have the original shade and I don’t really see much of a “color“ once applied. The scent is light and hardly noticeable after application. I definitely would consider this my new favorite under eye cream. Light application makes me feel like my circles aren’t visible.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I don’t like lotions that make my skin feel oily/greasy after applying. Kiehls has a light and moist texture while applying and absorbs nicely. The scent is very mild which I appreciate.  I will definitely continue to purchase and recommend this ultra facial cream as I forsee it lasting a great while also.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I don’t like lotions that make my skin feel oily/greasy after applying. Kiehls has a light and moist texture while applying and absorbs nicely. The scent is very mild which I appreciate.  I will definitely continue to purchase and recommend this ultra facial cream as I forsee it lasting a great while also.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Fantastic product to replace my summer lotion cream I have been using for so long. I needed a heavier moisturizer and it’s a fruity melon smell which is so much more enjoyable! My skin has looked slightly Oiler over the last few days but I also use an AHA cream which might have something to do with it. No break outs either with my super Sensitive, dry, and red skin!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Personally, I enjoy this face cream over the night cream. I found the night cream much heavier with a fruity smell. This face cream is a lot lighter, and not as greasy. I recommend it for people who have dry and sensitive skin! It smells nice, very light, I can’t quite put my finger on what fruit it is.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: The product is actually incredible. I’m just extremely disappointed with the smell. It reminds me of cherry cough medication, you’d think it made with Greek yogurt would have some other smell, to me it’s extremely off putting. It’s similar to a mousse/ face cream, and blends in well. I have sensitive skin and haven’t had a reaction yet.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Good make up remover, the product melts in your face easily (coconut oil consistency), you need a small amount for all your face and is easy to remove with water.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Good make up remover, the product melts in your face easily (coconut oil consistency), you need a small amount for all your face and is easy to remove with water.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I definitely recommend this cream, it feels very smooth and moisturizing! My face is dry, during the winter is worse, but this product make a huge difference!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: This is the first product that I tried from FRESH, this toner is absolutely perfect for me, is a little bit oily but in a good way if you have dry skin. The skin feels hydrated and soft, and now I have the serum and cream, even better results!

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I’ve struggled for years to find a moisturizer that was oil-free and didn’t clog my pores/make me break out. I’m almost through my jar of this product and so far, no issues! That said, only 4 stars because the jar is kinda weirdly shaped and it’s difficult to get all the product out.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Used this product for a few years now, and it’s always been a good one! Great for acne prone skin.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I don’t think there’s anything super special about it, compared to other products. But it’s affordable and works.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: It goes on like a lotion. It has a pleasant, light scent, though I feel adding a scent is unnecessary. It absorbs into the skin quickly allowing  you to continue with the rest of your makeup without having to wait. It’s also comfortable to put on at night without being irritating or having to wait before laying down. The area I noticed the most transformation in is my jowl  area. I saw tightening and lifting approximately 2 weeks into usage. I had no issues with it but my skin isn’t particularly sensitive. I could see myself purchasing this product when I finish it.I did receive this product complimentary for review from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I recieved this product from Influenster complimentary to test and I’ve been using this for a few weeks and I’m such a fan. I have dry skin and I’ve found that my skin really responds well to it. My skin it more hydrated, glowy, and over healthier looking. This is absolutely something I’ll continue to use. Bonus is it’s so affordable as well.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Glow Recipe this product to test and I was really excited to have the opportunity. Anything that promises to give my skin a glow I am all for. The texture of these drops are so lightweight and smooth. I thought it would be a tiny bit tacky or sticky but it wasn’t at all. It absorbed well into my skin and you can definitely see my skin has a nice glow that looks natural and not like it’s an artificial glittery glow. Used alone, without makeup my skin just looked brighter and I appeared more awake. When I used it with makeup, admittedly very minimal makeup, it didn’t interfere with anything and actually made my makeup look more natural. I’m such a fan of the ingredients, particularly hyaluronic acid, as they agree with my skin and has shown a noticeable hydrated and brighter look to my skin. A big win for me.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I tried this once and it was a bit much for myCombo skin but it has done wonders for myBf’s dry skin! He always forgets to put lotion on in the morning but if he uses this the night before he doesn’t have as flaky of skin! It’s done wonders for him and he loves it!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This is going to be a staple for my pale skin I am obsessed. This is one of my favorite sunscreens and the high SPF is amazing and makes me feel at ease. No more sunburns during brunch or on a run it is sweat proof and makes my skin look and feel so healthy.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This is such a great sunscreen and so easy to apply. I will be wearing this every single day this summer since I am very pale. It didn’t get in the way of any makeup I applied and actually made my skin look very dewy and hydrated when I went all natural. Obsessed!

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: New holy grail!  Instant plumping and hydration!
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Algenist.  My biggest insecurity on my face is my under eye area because of its hollowness, dark circles and fine lines.  This eye balm immediately hydrates and plumps my skin.  It is thick and moisturizing yet instantly absorbs and leaves behind no residue or stickiness.  In a week of using it morning and night, my dark circles are slightly less noticeable.  It works great as a base for makeup because it prevents concealer from settling into the fine lines under my eyes.  I also love the scent which reminds me of coffee and awakens both my eyes and my senses whenever I apply it.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: A must have moisturizer for dry skin!
reviews.review_text: I received the Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream complimentary from Fresh.  This is the moisturizer my dry skin has been craving.  With a thick, rich consistency, it leaves my face feeling nourished into the next day.  Instead of waking up with dry patches, my skin continues to feel softer and smoother.  A little goes a long way; a few dots are enough to cover my face and neck.  Despite being a thicker moisturizer, it does not feel greasy or heavy.  It absorbs quickly, so it can be used morning or night, on its own or under make-up without having to wait an extended period of time between layers.  The rose scent is prominent and authentic, similar to other Fresh products such as the Rose Face Mask.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: Less Fragrance, Just as Powerful Results
reviews.review_text: I received the new Jet Lag Mask complimentary from Summer Fridays.  I was a big fan of the original formulation and the main difference is that the new mask is unscented as opposed to the original which had a minty scent.  It is more gentle for those who are sensitive to fragrances.  However, the new mask’s benefits are just as incredible as the ones I achieved from the original mask.  The mask is white and has a thick, creamy texture that fully absorbs into the skin and turns transparent within a few minutes.  It is versatile and can be used as a moisturizer, a quick mask where the excess is dabbed off after 10-15 minutes or an overnight mask.  I’ve heard of others even using it as a primer or hand cream.  I prefer to use it as an overnight mask because I wake up with refreshed and baby soft skin.  I have dry, sensitive skin and never experienced any tingling, redness or irritation.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Wow! I received this product as a free sample and I am so impressed! I love the texture and how it instantly plumps up my eye contour with hydration. I use it during the day under my makeup and it helps prevent my concealer from creasing and I also use it at night. I’m in love!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen! It is lightweight, no white cast, and has a lovely smell. I use this primarily on my face and I have had zero breakouts from it. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: The fact that this stick goes over makeup without disturbing the makeup on your face AT ALL is a miracle! I love this stick so much it fits perfectly into my active lifestyle. I live in Florida and regularly take it kayaking and to the beach with me, quick and easy application!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I have tried HUNDREDS of moisturizers, and no one could seem to recommend one for sensitive, extra dry t zone / dry skin generally but this is AMAZING.I pair this with my ole henriksen vitamin c serum and this moisturizer and i’m set for the day!It has very little smell which I love, but still smells good. It also is thicker and cool so it gives irritated skin a nice chunk of relief.100% recommend, I got it as a sample with drunk elephant and other stuff, but this one truly caters to all dry types, not mature dry skin or anything, JUST EVERYONE ❤️

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_title: a great layering item - not for alone use
reviews.review_text: theres a key to using this this item!I have EXTREMELY dry skin year round. So, I tried this as a mini and it works amazing ONLY if you combine it with the ultra hydrating cream (heavy duty one) so what I do is I first apply this coconut light weight one on, let it dry completely then go back in with the heavy duty moisturizer and apply the heavy duty one. The two of these layered works perfectly.However, alone I would say this isnt enough for dry skin, it is a great LAYERING product for severely dry skin year round.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: wonderful night cream for true hydration
reviews.review_text: I am in LOVE! I got this as a deluxe sample size on my last order along with the day face cream (I hate the smell of the day cream, smells like celery). But this night cream is everything :D I layer this on top of my Cosrx hyaluronic acid intensive cream for extra moisture. It feels so soft like silk and doesnt make my face feel heavy, just hydrated. my skin is sensitive too and I love the smell (like candy in my opinion) and the hydration and other benefits this offers. I recommend trying the small size first as it isnt cheap.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin but I get a lot of black heads around my nose so I used this like you would one of those peel-off nose patches. I have sensitive skin so peel off masks have been too aggressive and actually damaged blood vessels, but this mask worked wonders! You don’t get the satisfaction of peeling out the white gunk but it still cleans out pores and leaves your skin SO SMOOTH! My skin was a bit pink in the exact area I had applied but I moisturized and after 10 mins the redness went away. I highly recommend this for anyone trying to beat black heads without using harsh methods! My boyfriend was even jealous and I came home and he had it all over his face.

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: Love this moisturiser. While I definitely have dry skin, most moisturisers targeting dry skin feel sticky and uncomfortable for me. Sometimes I feel like my skin is more dull and rough when applying rich creams. I love the texture and consistency of this product which doesn’t leave any residue, yet makes skin feel ’juicy’, ’plump’ and hydrated throughout the day (not just for a few hours after applying!) I mostly got this as a day cream because my Laneige Sleeping Mask does the heavy lifting for hydration but my skin feels naked and uncomfy if I’m not wearing some sort of moisturiser during the day. I’ve layered this over The Ordinary Vitamin C, over their Hyaluronic acid and also over First Aid Beauty hydra gel - it never pills or feels like ’too much’- just holds it all in neatly. I also picked this one because I’ve used the Ginzing exfoliating cleanser in the AMs and even though it left my skin feeling tight, I LOVED the smell. It’s very bright and zesty and will definitely wake you up when you do NOT want to go to school/ work/ adult. I’ve not tried this under makeup but it does also work well under sunscreen (shiseido clear stick).

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: Soft clean skin & luxurious velvety texture
reviews.review_text: Obsessed with this! I use it daily as a regular cleanser and it works beautifully. When I do wear makeup, this works brilliantly too! It smells like a SPA and it feels so luxurious I would pay a lot more for it honestly. I really can’t explain how a velvety balm-oil product (a little goes a long way) leaves your skin feeling so soft and clean at the same time but this does exactly that! I have dry skin with rosacea and it’s super soothing and delicious to massage this around for a few minutes like an at home facial. Not drying, no pimples, no redness just clean soft skin :)

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_title: Soft clean skin & luxurious velvety texture
reviews.review_text: Obsessed with this! I use it daily as a regular cleanser and it works beautifully. When I do wear makeup, this works brilliantly too! It smells like a SPA and it feels so luxurious I would pay a lot more for it honestly. reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer for dry sky or someone who just need extra moisture in the winter. Very soft and makes my skin feel so smooth and takes all the dryness away.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love the packaging and the way it applies so easily in my lips. It’s a very pretty subtle tint on the lips and so beautiful for an everyday lip color. My lips feel smooth and hydrated and it last a lot longer than I thought it would in my lips  gifted by fresh

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: ingredients definitely help make this serum feel hydrating, especially for my dry areas. It layers well under makeup and it gives me such a lovely glow! Such an innovative serum this makes my skin look so good every time I use it. Super hydrating yet makes my complexion look for youthful and firm.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: Shipping was fast. Don’t be discouraged, it takes about a week of continuous use, to see a difference. The puffiness goes down a little bit

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: Has an old lady smell but it works how you want it to. Good for night use

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product was very helpful. I wasn’t using any other cream before this. It goes on easy, smooth, smells nice, and keep me feeling hydrated.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product free from Influenster. I was so excited since I wanted to try Drunk Elephant products and especially a night mask which I like to use. My skin is dry, not too dry, but definitely needs a moisturizer. According to instruction, customers need to use 4 pumps for the whole face which are a lot. I tried use only one mask by its own and haven’t found any difference. Second way is mixing it with my regular moisturizer (mine is Elemis now). It worked better; however, haven’t found too moisturizing skin, I used moisturizer in the morning before makeup. To sum up, for me this product didn’t work as much as they promised, but didn’t give breakdowns which is good.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I do love this sunscreen! It does not feel sticky on the skin, and it is easy to blend. Also, it works great. I have not tried it on the sun yet but I use it every day when I go outside

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_title: one of the easiest and comfortable products
reviews.review_text: I love that this stick is compact and easy to carry in the bag. I love using it before makeup to prevent my skin from sun! The structure of the stick is amazing too

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this cream and how it makes my skin soft and hydrated. A small amount is enough for the face. I wouldn’t say anything about fine lines but it is definitely a good moisturizing cream. Plus the package is very convenient.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing. I could tell a difference from the very first time I used this. My lips are so smooth when I wake up in the morning. I also use this throughout the day as a lip balm because I love it so much.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is one of my go-to moisturizers. Absolutely love the texture and feel of the cream. I feel like this actually absorbs into my skin instead of just lying on the surface. It really truly is a burst of hydration for your skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This is one of my go-to moisturizers. Absolutely love the texture and feel of the cream. I feel like this actually absorbs into my skin instead of just lying on the surface. It really truly is a burst of hydration for your skin.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Absolutely amazing moisturizer. I have extremely dry and sensitive skin due to the retinol I am using. I was overjoyed when i​ heard they were making a cream for dry skin, and I can already tell a difference after just one use. My skin feels soft and hydrated. The cream also gives you a nice dewy glow. This is ​more for those with dry to normal skin. I’m not sure those with oily skin would enjoy this product because it is on the rich and heavier side of moisturizers. I will definitely be repurchasing this. If you’re struggling with dry skin, give this a try.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: This is my go-to face mask. I love the way it makes my skin feel so soft when I wash it off!! It does a great job of cleansing my pores, and I think the formula of the active charcoal and clay combination is fantastic! This is my favorite mask to use to really give my skin a good detox. I don’t use this every single day, but about every 3-5 days in my skincare routine. I did receive this product free for testing.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I really liked this product! My skin was noticeably brighter after using and I loved the way it felt! I received this product complimentary for testing.

reviews.review_text: I really liked this product! My skin was noticeably brighter after using and I loved the way it felt! I received this product complimentary for testing.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I really liked this sunscreen! From someone who hates wearing it, this doesn’t feel heavy and thick or sticky or smell like chemicals which check all the boxes for me! I received this product free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: I only use this at night because, as others have mentioned, it’s visibly grainy. And it absolutely does make my skin look shiny - even when I wake up in the morning it still feels greasy on my face. However, I’m giving it 5 stars because my skin is super dry and the shiny finish works for me. I’ve worn it under makeup a few times and it gives a nice dewy finish.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I never use toner, because it always seems to make my skin tight and dry. This one is really great for dry skin, though. I’ve never used anything like it before. I received this product free for review purposes, but I’m pretty sure that I’ll be buying another one once this bottle is empty!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’m such a fan of this moisturizer. I’d never tried it before and while I liked the scent and the texture, I wasn’t really convinced that it would make an actual difference in my skin. It really does give me a nice glow, though. My skin is very dry and this moisturizer did the trick. I received it free for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I really liked this. It wasn’t what I thought it would be at 1st but that’s why it’s so great. I was on accutane from 8 months so my skin is so sensitive. This gently took all the junk out of my pore while I slept.  I loved it. I really think this is great for all skin types. I received this in my pinch me box and it was on off the best freebies I’ve gotten so far! For sure I’ll be buy this!

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I’ve seen such a difference in my under eye dark circles. I look more awake and refreshed. I get compliments all the time now.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin and this stuff has rescued my skin. It’s quickly become a holy grail!

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Never thought I'd like it but I do!!!!
reviews.review_text: It really does go on like water but quickly absorbs.  I like it.  I use it along with a bit of Vaseline petroleum jelly so that it really absorbs into my skin.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Awesome winter moisturizer as it’s a bit thicker for we Canadian girls who rely on a thicker blend to get us through our winters.  Nice mild aroma

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this particular brand for some time now.  Slowly but surely, my dark circles have faded.  They aren’t permanently gone however I can use less corrector and concealer.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I always find Shiseido products well formulated and hydrating. This product feels good going on and with regular use, reduces fine lines. I like to pair this with Shiseido night cream.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free. I liked it very much- conditioning but not too thick or greasy.  Happy with the ingredients as well.  However it does not appear to have any spf so keep that in mind!

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: Great product! The smell is fresh, it’s not sticky, and it leaves my skin feeling firm.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream. It’s an absolute five star for me. Loving the hydrating feeling it leaves. It’s a heavier cream and I just use a small dab goes a long way. I haven’t noticed my small lines disappearing but I do notice after six months of use no new lines are forming. My skin feels great. I have super sensitive skin and this cream has not made me breakout or itch.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love SUNSCREEN! I love Shiseido products and I am in love with this Sunscreen! Light weight and no residue! Not gritty and smoothly applies. This new technology with wet force and heat force is amazing.  I have had no issue using it on my sensitive face. No rash or irritation.  No burn and lasted for hours of protection from the sun! I am so happy and will be purchasing more on my next visit to Sephora!  Love to you all!

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: SK-II so happy I got to sample this Essence/toner for review.  I did receive sample sizes for free to give an honest review.  I loved the Essence and am happy to say it is great for the week supply given. I unfortunately did not think it was a product I would continue to use. I am super sensitive and suffer from dry skin. This product was not a successful one for me.  I also am reviewing the skin power eye cream and the face cream. I was supplied the eye cream sample for free trial. I didn’t notice a strong overwhelming scent.  It did glide on smoothly.  Soak in fast but again didn’t notice a difference with the amount of product supplied.   I am hopeful others live this product.  The Skin power cream has a light fragrance.  Very creamy. Soaked in well. Delightful and am happy to report it didn’t make my super sensitive dry skin act up. I received it for a review, free sample.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: SK-II so happy I got to sample this Essence/toner for review.  I did receive sample sizes for free to give an honest review.  I loved the Essence and am happy to say it is great for the week supply given. I unfortunately did not think it was a product I would continue to use. I am super sensitive and suffer from dry skin. I received it for a review, free sample.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is great for more mature skin. I’m a makeup artist and have trouble finding products that help the skin look more hydrated and smooth. It doesn’t completely hide wrinkles but I definitely see it has softened wrinkles and fine lines a bit. I will definitely keep this as a staple product.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: My skin is normal to dry and this product gives my skin life! I’ve been using it on clients as well and it makes a huge difference. I recommend applying this product with your hands and really pressing it into the skin.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: A little goes along way! I got the mini sized and I will definitely be purchasing the bigger size. It’s great for my normal to dry skin. Makes my skin feel super plumped. Makeup looks great over it.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Really enjoy this as my evening cleanser! Soothing and satisfyingly creamy/foamy. Skin feels clean after, and I’ve noticed my redness is looking a little happier. Cannot attest if this is drying like other reviews, because I user a toner, essence, serum, and night cream after.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Wish it came as a mini, great for under eyes
reviews.review_text: I use this as a night cream for my eyes, with one of my indie eye serums. Really like it. But I wish they sold it in mini, because I will never use the full size before it expires.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Love it! Makes my skin look amazing. Feels nice, not greasy, and great for all year round (for dry skin types). Just put a little extra on during winter.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Love it! Makes my skin look amazing. Feels nice, not greasy, and great for all year round (for dry skin types). Just put a little extra on during winter.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Very disappointed. I have dry, and sensitive skin. So I can’t just lather on a think layer. I really wanted to like this, but I break out every time I use it and it never seems to fully absorb. WAY WAY to rich for a day cream-- I would be so gross by the end of the day, that I couldn’t wait to get home and wash my face. I tried this for two weeks-- a little goes a long way-- and I’m ready to return it.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Yummy texture, luxurious feel on the face
reviews.review_text: Although pricey, I am a fan if this line. When Slaai it hit the market, I sampled and then took the plunge.I am a cleanser and exfoliating aficionado: I have used Julep’s cleansing oil for years. I am 53 and like a creamy make up remover. This one fits the bill for me.I love the feel. It feels very luxurious and like I am deep into self-care when I spread it on. Even my husband is impressed by the spatula. The exfoliating mix sold me. In fact when I realized that was a part of the deal, I whipped my credit card out.I think it is great for older, dryer skin. You have to be willing to make the investment, but if you do, welcome to the spa every night and morning.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I purchased this on several occasions. I wish these had existed during my teens. Now, I have very few zits. But then, lots of zits. I have relatively sensitive skin, so once I get a zit, the remnant stays a long time.When I do get one, it tends to be on the cystic side. I tried these as a result. I found everything I put them on wherever I put them, they reduced the inflammation. In some cases, everything was gone: no bump, no discoloration. I have had such good luck. I wear them overnight, but have been known to wear them around the house all Saturday or Sunday long. I forget they are on because they match my skin color so closely. That wouldn’t be the case for everyone, but it was for me.I like the cute packaging, the thoughtfulness of the product. I definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_title: Long time user, first time reviewer
reviews.review_text: I have used this product off and on for 15 years. I love this product! When acne was still an issue for me - I have finally aged out of it — it would clear up any problems I ever had. My skin was so clear, pores so small. I am grateful for Paula’s choice: simple products designed to solve a problem.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Farmacy Beauty. I have been using it for a month and I love the thick texture of it as my skin type is very dry. So far I am enjoying this cream and I use it as a night time moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely product. I received it as a gift from the brand. First of all, the texture is lovely. It is not sticky or oily, fast absorbing and is not piling. I found the watermelon smell wonderful too. After 3rd use with retinol, my skin became visibly brighter and clear. I received it as a gift but this is my honest review I would definetely purchase with my own money!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product as gifted by Sunday Riley *I have been loving this product a lot! It prodes very good amount of exfoliation and also its hydrating! It visibly diminished my scars and evened out my skin tone.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I use the honeysuckle version of this. For years I have had dehydration wrinkles, peeling, dryness, and nasty texture on my forehead, and this cream helped clear it right up. Highly recommended for dry, flaky skin.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: Will make your skin brighter with one use!
reviews.review_text: This is a great affordable toner that is effective. My only complaint would be that it stings, which one would expect of an acidic toner, but sometimes I don’t want my face to feel like it is burning in the mornings. It can also cause some redness and bumpiness. The acid can irritate skin if you overuse it.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Can’t really tell what this is doing for my face. I feel like the Emulsion Retinoid does enough. I think maybe the HA in it helps with moisturizing, but I prefer a thick creamy moisturizer over a serum like this.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: I am in love with this product. As soon as I started using it I noticed a difference in brightness, skin tone, and texture. It’s a gentle acid exfoliate that’s a perfect introduction to acid peels for newcomers.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: Best moisturizer ever, i have a really sensitive skin, and also have psoriasis, first brand I’ve tried that actually helped my skin, and saw a change in my skin within hours. I highly recommend this brand, worth trying.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love it, i suffer from really dry skin and most products burn my face but this one is just amazing, left my skin super soft and hydrated, recommended for anyone with redness, dryness and psoriasis, it help me to feel rejuvenated and soft.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Really like this product, super light weight on skin, refreshes and moisturizes your skin. I have really sensitive skin and it worked great for me.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Loved this! Saw an immediate change in my skin in under a week. I love this so much. I have dry skin and it was a saviour.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: It was okay. Didn’t wow me. The texture is nice and it absorbs into the skin well. It’s very light. Didn’t notice any changes in my skin.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: Loved this! made my makeup look so soft. It instantly takes away any look of “powderyness” and dryness. I love this. It kind of smells like curry hahah, but the smell goes away instantly. Would give the full 5 stars but I don’t think it increased the wear time of my makeup. But it did make it look beautiful

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: this is such a beautiful oil! it absorbs onto the skin immediately, leaving it soft and supple. it’s not greasy whatsoever. it’s light enough to be worn during the day under makeup, and hydrating enough to be used at night. i love this stuff. it’s helped my skin become so much oilier and smoother. definitely worth the price.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: The first vitamin C serum I’ve tried and I love it. It’s reasonably priced and gives me an extra layer of protection under my moisturizer. It’s also not sticky and it makes my skin look brighter.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is a miracle product for my post-Canadian-winter dry and cracked lips. It smells amazing, goes on smooth with no stickiness, and leaves my lips soft and smooth.

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: This lip butter keeps my lips soft and smooth, and it smells delicious!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This was a great product for me even with my dry, sensitive skin. It calmed my skin down and a lot of my acne went away in just a couple weeks. My skin is much better now. Would recommend to anyone with acne. Just make sure if you have dry skin to pair with a moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Loved it, with dry and sensitive skin it really worked well for me. Would recommend for anyone, not just people with dry skin. I’m definitely buying it again!

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: Wasn’t the best for me, I also have very dry, sensitive skin. So what it advertises is what it delivers. Would recommend for someone with oily skin.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this product for a little over two weeks and love how hydrated my skin feels. I use this in combination with the c-firma so I can’t report on how it would be by itself.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Protected my skin in the Florida sun!
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this product for over a week, most of which was spent in Walt Disney World. I used this product to protect my skin while spending time in sunny Florida and I’m proud to say that it worked perfectly. I have very fair skin and burn easily but I’m happy to report I didn’t get burnt at all! Only downside is that I feel the product left my skin somewhat oily feeling.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream feels so luxurious and truly thick and creamy! I love the subtle glow it provides. The smell is light but pleasant. I do feel that after using this for several weeks my under eye area is firmer. I’m very conscious of under eye bags/wrinkles and feel that this cream helps alleviate these issues. I received this eye cream complimentary for testing purposes through VoxBox - with that being said I don’t know that I would typically pay $70 for this cream (hence the 4/5 stars).

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I use this face cream every morning and I love it. I have really dry skin and this cream gets rid of the tightness in my skin and makes me feel moisturized all day. I also love the packaging on this product and am glad I do not have to dip my fingers into the product. I have purchased this twice and just bought the value size and love it!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I use this face cream every morning and I love it. I have really dry skin and this cream gets rid of the tightness in my skin and makes me feel moisturized all day. I also love the packaging on this product and am glad I do not have to dip my fingers into the product. I have purchased this twice and just bought the value size and love it!!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is a great hydrating mask to use at night before bed. It hydrates my skin and makes it look and feel plump and moisturized. It only takes a little bit of product and seems like it will last me a long time. I do have really dry skin so it doesn’t have any tackiness or oiliness left to it when I wake up.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: This is a great hydrating mask to use at night before bed. It hydrates my skin and makes it look and feel plump and moisturized. It only takes a little bit of product and seems like it will last me a long time. I do have really dry skin so it doesn’t have any tackiness or oiliness left to it when I wake up.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen has a really great texture that I love! It is lightweight and feels moisturizing on my dry skin. It does not pill or leave a white cast. Super easy to blend out and a great price for the amount you get.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Received free Clinique product sample from topbox. I used the entire sample over the course of 3 days morning & night. I layered the Smart clinical serum, eye cream and wrinkle correcting cream. All three products did not have any offensive fragrance, greasy or texture. They absorbed quickly and hydrated my skin well. There was no stinging or drying. Nice alternative to perscription retinol.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: Received free Clinique product sample from topbox. I used the entire sample over the course of 3 days morning & night. I layered the Smart clinical serum, eye cream and wrinkle correcting cream. All three products did not have any offensive fragrance, greasy or texture. They absorbed quickly and hydrated my skin well. There was no stinging or drying. Nice alternative to perscription retinol.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_title: Super hydrating and lightning fast absorption
reviews.review_text: Loved this product 5/5. Received free Clinique product sample from topbox. I used the entire sample over the course of 3 days morning & night. I layered the Smart clinical serum, eye cream and wrinkle correcting cream. All three products did not have any offensive fragrance, greasy or texture. They absorbed quickly and hydrated my skin well. There was no stinging or drying. Nice alternative to perscription retinol.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Really disappointed to report that this didn’t do anything for my skin. I used it religiously every morning for 6 weeks and noticed no differences. The packaging is stunning and looks lovely in my bathroom but that’s the only benefit.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Not greasy and easy to rub in. I have used every sunscreen their is and this is at the top for the best.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Not greasy, doesn’t feel like it’s clogging my pores and it’s so easy to throw in my bag. I can’t wait to try it in the summer.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So luxe! I am a redhead with sensitive skin so I’m very picky about moisturizer. That said this is wonderful for the winter. Thicker but not greasy and no overwhelming scent.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So luxe! I am a redhead with sensitive skin so I’m very picky about moisturizer. That said this is wonderful for the winter. Thicker but not greasy and no overwhelming scent.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I recieved this complimentary from influenster and I was a bit skeptical due to the texture of the moisturizer but it smells amazing and it feels fantastic on my skin. Once I’m out I would buy again.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this from Influenster to share my opinion. Very nice light feeling moisturizer that you don’t need to use a lot of to cover your whole face. Very buttery feel.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Kept skin very hydrated! Would repurchase again. Could see a visible difference after consistent use

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I really love this serum! My face definitely feels smoother and more radiant in the morning. This Advanced Night Repair has done wonders for my skin! The hyaluronic acid helped to plump and brighten all while reducing the fine lines and wrinkles. It truly keeps my face feeling hydrated. The smell of this serum is subtle which is nice. I would add this to my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I really love this serum! My face definitely feels smoother and more radiant in the morning. This Advanced Night Repair has done wonders for my skin!
