I would add this to my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
reviews.review_text: I really love this serum! My face definitely feels smoother and more radiant in the morning. This Advanced Night Repair has done wonders for my skin! The hyaluronic acid helped to plump and brighten all while reducing the fine lines and wrinkles. It truly keeps my face feeling hydrated. The smell of this serum is subtle which is nice. I would add this to my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: This product is a game changer. I have fine lines and dark circles under my eyes due to age, sun exposure, and staying up late. I thought I wouldn’t be able to rid or at least minimize this. But this product has significantly reduced the lines and darkness. The wand makes it easy to apply and spread out the product evenly. It’s like a spa experience..

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a lightweight gel moisturizer that I use before applying my makeup. It blurred my pores leaving with my flawless look. I definitely felt the all day hydration.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The texture of this product is really light, which I like.  It does a good job of removing makeup, but full disclosure I use an oil based cleanser to remove my eye makeup prior. So I’m not sure it would remove waterproof mascara.  I have very sensitive skin and this did not bother it at all! I found it left my skin feeling clean, and maybe a tiny bit dry/tight. But soon as I put on moisturizer it was fine. I’ve only used for about a week but I’m excited to see if there is any long term benefits as well.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product!! Using it a night, it makes me skin feel slightly tingly, but nothing bothersome. Then I wake up next morning and have smooth glowing skin! I’ve only used it for about 2 weeks and I can already see a difference in my skins texture. I will continue to use because I love the results so far!! It’s no wonder everybody loves this product, it definitely lives up to the hype!!

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: So far I’ve only used this product every few days because I have sensitive skin. And I’ve had zero issues with irritation thus far. My under eyes looks smooth and less puffy, which is a win for me! The pump dispenser gives the perfect amount, which is enough for both eyes. So I can see this product lasting a long time.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Honestly, I am blown away by this SPF! I love that it’s both mineral & “cleaner” chemical sunscreen for extra protection, with added skincare. It applies better than any other mineral sunscreen I have tried & I’ve tried several new high-end SPFs on the market recently. It has a lovely faint scent of watermelon & makes my dry skin feel so soft & hydrated. It’s super lightweight, refreshing & layers great with my foundations. I even like how the cap snaps into place. It’s just fantastic all around! I really can’t imagine loving any other clear SPF more! HIGHLY recommend! =D

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was super excited to try this product & it did not disappoint! I got the shade Peony, the texture is SO smooth & it feels incredible on the lips. The color is sheer, buildable & very flattering. The smell is delicious! Like a lemon tart. *drool* I love the metal packaging as well. This is clean beauty at its finest. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I am loving this serum! I have dry slightly textured skin with a discoloration/redness; & this elixir has done an amazing job smoothing & balancing out my complexion. I like that there’s not not of a scent & the green glass bottle is beautiful. I’m not crazy about droppers, but it works fine with the thin formula. If your trying to minimize your skincare routine, this is a fantastic multitasking product to layer under your moisturizer. Absolutely worth trying! :)

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_title: Good product, but not for me
reviews.review_text: I’m pretty torn on this product. First the pros: It is pretty effective with brightening & firming, which is obviously the most important thing. I love that it’s fresher from mixing yourself. The texture is pretty nice; somewhere between a gel & a lightweight oil. And the twist pump (that doesn’t need a cap) is a great pump design. BUT the cons: I HATE all the cheap plastic. It’s definitely on the stickier side. And.. It has that classic horrible hot dog/dog food scent that is common with unscented Vitamin C serums, which I absolutely cannot stand. If these cons don’t bother you, the pros are probably worth it. But for me, I prefer the experience of using my less sticky, naturally better scented Vit C, that comes in beautiful sustainable glass.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: This product means BUSINESS. I have always struggled with eczema on the face (upper lip, forehead and bridge of nose). I got this product because I had heard that it is suitable for people with eczema. My derm told me to stop using the moisturizer I was using for years because it was causing milia on my face. I got this one (even though it isn’t non-comedogenic), and it is working wonders on my face and eczema patches on my body. I am absolutely in love with it, and will continue to use it.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I have weird skin. I’m in my mid-20s and I have started to develop acne on my forehead. I will get painful cystic acne spots just where the light hits my face and it beams like a lighthouse guiding ships to shore. I felt totally hopeless. I was recommended this product by a friend. I had already used FAB because it’s so eczema friendly, so I was open to trying it. I tried it and, after using the product consistently, my painful forehead acne started to diminish. It is a STAPLE in my skincare routine. My skin has never looked better!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I just bought this and really enjoy it so far. It makes my face really soft and sloughs off a lot of that dry skin!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_title: The best moisturizer for dry skin!
reviews.review_text: I have the worlds driest skin, and this really is a lifesaver for me. I use it immediately after cleansing/oil/serums and it really hydrates my skin so quickly, and after about 2-3 minutes it has completely sunken into the skin so it doesn’t feel heavy at all. There is a slight scent at first, but that doesn’t bother me or my super sensitive skin at all. I use it at least once a day, sometimes twice a day in the winter, and I feel like my dry skin has been improving immensely.This is holy grail status for me.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I have super dry and sensitive skin. I use this a few times a week after cleansing my skin, and it really helps to keep my skin bright and glowing with no dry flakes. I’ve had no irritation (it does make my skin red for about 10 seconds when applied, it quickly fades) and this bottle is seriously HUGE for the price! I’m so excited to have this in my routine.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: The caffeine solution is great for puffiness around the eye and that’s what I find it actually works for. I haven’t noticed my dark undereyes improving at all with this, but they definitely do look more awake and less puffy. If you have saggy eye bags or even a saggy brow bone, it’s honestly like an instant lift! I really enjoy it. Keep it mind it isn’t hydrating, so I usually put my moisturizer on top of this.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: Overall this is a good moisturizer. I’ve been using it for about a month and have noticed my pores look smaller. The downside I have encountered has been the smell and texture. The smell is intensely strong. I am sensitive to smells and don’t really like fragrance in my products especially skin care. Then the texture, it is much thicker and hard to move around then other moisturizers I’ve tried. The texture is similar to a watery clay mask. I’ve found I have to pull at my skin. Because of those two I must only give this 3 stars.(I was sent this product by Influenster’s for reviewing purposes; all my options are my own and mine alone.)

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: Pretty good. Only tested this product for a short amount of time but overall I like it. It does seem a bit thicker then most gel moisturizer. I don’t think this does anything that my normal moisturizer doesn’t already do.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This product is fine. It wasn’t amazing but it wasn’t bad. I noticed a slight difference in my undereye area but not much. Good product for the price.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this eye cream. It’s the perfect consistency; goes on smooth and dries leaving your undereye moisturized. Definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I love this in a stick it’s much easier for me to put on my face. I put this on about 30 mins before I went outside. I normally get a burning feeling when I use sunscreen but this one I didn’t. This is definitely going to be my go to sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen. It’s not greasy like others. It goes on smooth and the smell is amazing. Being from Florida sunscreen is a must. This is definitely going to be my go to sunscreen from now on.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff so much. I’ve never before used a night mask for lips. I’m loving how my lips feel in the morning. Belif has some amazing products. I will definitely be getting more of this.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I. Love. This. Serum! This serum is on thicker side than I’m used to and I was not sure how hydrating it would be. Boy, was I wrong! I used this two different ways (it’s been 4 days since I started). One was to use this after I apply C-Firma and the other way was to mix C-Firma and B-Hydra together before I apply. I was not super crazy about “mixing” them but did it anyway because that’s what DE suggested. I found mixing them together works a little better. It allows me to apply both product evenly because there is more to spread! It does leave residue but I see that as a good thing because it makes me feel like my skin is hydrated and makes my makeup application easier. Oh, and smell is very subtle, almost undetectable if any which is a plus. It is pricy for how much it has but I feel like I don’t have to use as much because I mix it with C-Firma now. I need to see the result when I finish the bottle but I’m leaning towards to purchasing a bottle in the future.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Great but it requires patience and extra time
reviews.review_text: I have been using this sunscreen for the past 4 days and I am glad to wait and gave a chance before I wrote a negative review. This sunscreen is on a thicker side than I’m used to and it felt a bit oily at first which made it tricky to apply makeup. I tried different things with different method (using different primer, water base foundation, pressed powder, BB cream only, etc). This might not be the best solution but I ended up waiting for about 10 minutes after I apply this sunscreen before I move on to makeup and it worked pretty well. It does what it supposed to do which is to protect my skin from the sun but I took a star off because I don’t always have that 10 minutes to let the product soak in / settle into my skin in the morning to get ready for the day.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Loved it but be warned about the smell
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin and a regular user of Tretinoin cream (0.05%). The texture was interesting - the cream feels thick and rich but light at the same time. It spreads very easily and doesn’t leave a sticky residue. It kept my skin moist until next morning and I don’t have any complaints. The only thing that is not worthy to those who are sensitive to smell - the cream is unscented and you can smell the actual scent of the product. It is not strong but noticeable. I would try it first before make the purchase. Great moisturizing cream though.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I read a lot of great reviews on this lip mask and wanted to see what the hype was all about. So glad I did. I LOVE everything about this product. The smell is a very subtle berry smell and this was is huge for me...IT DOESN’T TASTE BAD if it gets in your mouth! The light glossy pink color looks beautiful on everyone and you get so much product which is so nice. I’d give it 10 stars if it was possible. Great product. Highly highly recommend

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Game changer for dry skin! I love using this on my décolletage and back of my hands as well as my face because of the gorgeous glow it gives your skin. Will never be without this!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: LOVE this! The smell is amazing and it’s so soft and buttery. It gives your skin a glow that makes it look like you eat kale and drink tons of water even if you don’t. I like to put this on the backs on my hands because it’s so moisturizing. If you have dry skin you will love this

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: LOVE this! The smell is amazing and it’s so soft and buttery. It gives your skin a glow that makes it look like you eat kale and drink tons of water even if you don’t. I like to put this on the backs on my hands because it’s so moisturizing. If you have dry skin you will love this

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical of trying this because of the brand, but this product work as well, if not slightly better than the other high end at home microdermabrasion products I’ve tried. I’m a big fan of the chemical exfoliation part of this as well, I feel like it made my skin look even more glowing. The physical exfoliation was fine on my skin, but I would definitely patch test if you are sensitive.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical of trying this because of the brand, but this product work as well, if not slightly better than the other high end at home microdermabrasion products I’ve tried. The physical exfoliation was fine on my skin, but I would definitely patch test if you are sensitive.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Works really well, made my skin soft and smooth. I loved the gentle exfoliation!

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Works really well, made my skin soft and smooth. I loved the gentle exfoliation!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have really noticed a difference using this serum in the Winter. Though my skin leans oily, during the winter it can get kind of dull and needs a pick me up. My skin looks noticeably more radiant and plump, even after a few uses. This is my first time trying Tacha and I’m definitely going to try more!

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love a good acid serum and my face has been building up a tolerance for a while, so this serum worked well for me without uncomfortable burning. The texture and smell was pleasent, plus I feel like it did a great job, when I woke up my skin felt soft and smooth.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: If used as part of a nighttime skincare routine, it works well enough as a moisturizer. In the morning my skin is so soft. It has a pleasant but mild smell that I appreciate, and it hydrates nicely, does not leave any residue or film, and most of all, it is not greasy. This is a good option before applying your SPF. The hydration and glow are what I like most. I recommended it to my mom and friends.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I really like how environmentally friend it is, makes you feel good about what you are using. At first appearance, it appears to be colored, but it is not. It’s quite light and doesn’t leave you feeling greasy. It’s oil-free, but it’s still hydrating, hyaluronic acid which is beneficial. Not a strong scent which is good.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: It hydrates and leaves a very light dewy finish. It’s a moisturizer and sunscreen rolled into one. It has a wonderful scent , goes on smoothly, and looks great under makeup. Definitely recommend, and I’ll buy it whenthis runs out.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I use this as a quick mask instead of my moisturizer on days that I’m feeling a extra red and dry. The formula is a little thick but I like it. I normally put on a generous amount, wait for 10-15min, then massage in the excess. I love this mask because it immediately makes my skin brighter, smoother, and less dry. Would recommend to everyone! :)

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I really like how lightweight this product is. It feels like I have nothing on and keeps me dewy and moisturized throughout the day. There’s also no white cast when you put it on. My only problem with this product is the smell. Does it smell great? Yes. But do we really need fragrance in our sunscreen? Not really. The fragrance just doesn’t add anything to the product; in fact, it takes away from some of the other great ingredients. I have seen other reviews that say the sunscreen burned their eyes but this did not happen for me. I applied a generous amount and it also did not peel for me. Overall, I do quite like this product and will continue to use it.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I like this product! It is slightly thicker in texture but does not feel heavy at all. I use this in my night routine and in the morning, my under eye area looks visibly brighter and feels smoother! Overall, would recommend!! This eye cream was gifted by Algenist.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I received my product and it smells really good, the smell of avocado. I recommend this to anybody else. It’s really good helps out your skin. And It came with a avocado sleeping mask.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I loved the hand cream. And it kept my hand really hydrated. It smells really good.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I recommend this product. It has helped me out for my tired eyes. Its great .

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: The scent of this lip balm immediately got my thumbs-up, so yummy! I’m a frequent lip balm/chapstick user, and this has become one of my go-to’s. It’s just light enough to not feel goopy, but really hydrating and long-lasting. I received this for promotional purposes, but will definitely purchase myself!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The scent is really fresh and almost citrus-like. I like how smooth it goes on and doesn’t create a ton of suds. I received this complimentary for testing purposes, but would definitely purchase in the future!

reviews.review_text: LOVE the fresh strawberry scent of this cleanser! It truly smells like strawberries and you can feel the sugar granules as you rub it on your face. They slowly dissolve and leave your skin SO smooth. This is the perfect exfoliant for me because my skin is sensitive and sometimes exfoliant scrubs can be too harsh for my skin. This is the perfect duo and though I was sent this complimentary for testing purposes, I will definitely buy in the future!

I didn’t find it to be greasy at all. I can’t really so how well it worked as it was a small sample and am thinking if using more over time, I will probably help with the wrinkles. It did make my skin feel soft. I will buy this to see if how it will really help with the wrinkles.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been sampling this product faithfully using it 2x a day and I have to say I have seen results in just one week. I will be purchasing a full size bottle. I’ve been doing this for about 2 months now, I don’t feel dry during the day and I live in the desert, I also haven’t had any acne problems while using this product. Really happy.

reviews.review_text: After using for a month, I’ve noticed lighter age/sunspots around my nose and cheeks. It feels tingly and a little uncomfortable immediately after you spread it in your face. reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Hands-down a winner for treating dark spots and hyperpigmentation.  This lactic acid treatment is not as harsh as others for those with sensitive skin and is akin to a soothing serum.  Yet strong enough to wear you visibly see results within a couple of days of usage. My skin was noticeably brighter, clearer and softer. Amazingly fast results.  I apply this after cleansing and using a toner (Oleg Henrickson’s dark spot toner is very good and I highly recommend).  Then apply moisturizer.  I use this as a night treatment due to the lactic acid.  This us not cheap but certainly not expensive compared to others.  Good luck.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: There is a lot of hype and huge cult celebrity following for this product.  After using this product for a few weeks, I am a little disappointed by my results.  Yes deeply moisturizing - almost too much.  After applying, I felt it was too heavy - almost greasy. I’m 50 and I do have dry skin but the texture was just a little too heavy for me.  In the morning, I didn’t notice a big difference. For the price and the description, there are other moisturizers that provided me with noticeable results and not the heavy feeling.  For those that got good results - great.  Just not me. Good luck.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I get the spirit of this product, but I’d rather wear light makeup or concealer. First, this product is thick and sits on my face, so it looks and feels like I’m wearing a heavy foundation. I bought this because it’s marketed as skin care that balances redness, which sounds great in theory but not in practice. I feel better wearing a basic tinted spf and being okay with any redness that shows through, it looks more natural. Secondly, this smells like the Covergirl foundation I used in high school. Third, it’s in a tub and it’s messy to get product out. Fourth, this is expensive! I recommend trying the smaller size before committing to the full size to make sure you like it. I guess to it’s credit, it covers my redness, in fact it completely washes me out like a medium/full coverage foundation would. TLDR; it feels and looks more like foundation than skincare, oh and it smells like old Covergirl foundation, too.

reviews.review_text: This is a basic and effective balm cleanser. It smells kinda weird and has a strange texture, so no it’s not a super sophisticated product. However, it is a reasonable price for something that is used to remove makeup/sunscreen, so it does it’s job. I can use it on my eyes to remove mascara without it making my eyes blurry, watery and uncomfortable (usually). I enjoy other balm cleansers more from an experience standpoint, but for me, this does the job of a first cleanse and I’ll save my money for the following steps of my routine. Also, I’ve had it separate sometimes but it hasn’t affected its efficacy.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for two months now and I really enjoy it. I will combine a few drops of my fancy serums into the gel and it makes for a super nice hydrated glow. I will try something else out when the colder months come as I need a thicker cream for my dry skin, but this is perfect in the warmer months.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I saw other comments saying it smells like feet- low and behold, it does. it doesn’t bother me much though. it is a thick cream, great for winter skin. I use the vitiman c + rose hip oil and then apply this and it’s pretty leaves my face well moisturized and a good base for makeup without piling. I got this as part of the “unstoppable glow“ kit as I really wanted to try Bioessence. I’m not disappointed, but I’m not a die hard fan (yet?) either.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have tried a lot of different exfoliating products but none of them were great like this one. After just one use I noticed a difference. It has glycolic acid that helps minimize the appearance of pores for smoother and more radiant skin. It does have a very pleasant citrus scent that isn’t overpowering at all. I would definitely recommend this!

Highly recommend for your best looking radiant skin!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

reviews.review_text: My skin is so soft! Bought this to go with Ordinary HA Serum and it does the trick. Light weight, sets like a primer so it goes under makeup well.

reviews.review_text: Love it. Not the best smell (I thought it’d smell a lil more like actual roses) but it works well. Just a small amount at night and my skin is glowy next day

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum

reviews.review_text: This is one of the best cleansers I have ever used! The scent is very mild and pleasant. reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer, I have sensitive acne prone skin so I’m very selective on what I use on my skin and this moisturizer doesn’t give me breakouts. I mix a pump or two of the hyaluronic serum and a pump and a half of the moisturizer and it creates a nice cocktail for my skin, I love it. I use it at night before bed and my skin feels so nice and smooth in the morning. It’s worth the price since my skin loves it and it’s clean ingredients

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Love his serum, it adds an extra boost of moisture to my moisturizer. I mix this serum with the polypeptide moisturizer and it feels so smooth and buttery on my skin when mixed but doesn’t dry tacky which is so bomb.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I saw how much this product had a lot of hype and good reviews so I purchased it thinking it would work for me but it didn’t. It only used a small amount and rubbed it in nicely but when I applied my makeup on top it made me look shiny and oily even my husband told me my makeup looked different in a bad way and that was the only new thing that was different from my everyday makeup so I had to return it. It didn’t make me breakout though which is a plus at least

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy using this product! Especially when I wear more makeup than usual and I want a deeper clean with light exfoliation. I use it after I double cleanse my skin to ensure my face is clean and ready for my skin care. I use it every other day but can be used everyday

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I was super excited to review this product, the packaging was super cute and easy to use. I loved how smooth this face mask went on and how soft my skin felt after rinsing it off. I felt very clean and fresh and my skin felt smoother afterwards. The next day I woke up and my skin was glowing!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this lip balm gifted by Fresh! It is the perfect lip product to carry with you wherever you go. The packaging is super cute and simple, fits it your bag perfectly, and doesn’t spill everywhere. It leaves your lips with a slight tint and moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted to me. I personally love using it every morning and night. when i wake up in the morning my skin feels super soft, hydrated and young. it goes the whole day looking bright and awake.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I got this product free from Influenster to test and give an honest review. I liked this product, the applicator is very nice, clear so you can see the product. The consistency is very smooth, and the scent/taste is great as well! It is advertised as having a slight tint, but I could not notice any color change on my lips after applying, so if you’re looking for a product with a lot of pigment, this may not be the one for you. Not too sticky, and kept my lips hydrated for a long time!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this lotion! I was scared at first because it said “greek yoghurt”, but it has a very smooth consistency and does not really have much of a scent at all. It’s very light and after I rub it in, there’s no residue at all left on my face. I use this at night after my shower, overall great product, especially for the price!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: This scrub leaves my skin noticeably smoother and more refreshed after using! It’s not too harsh, and has a nice (but not overpowering) citrus/lemon scent. I got this free to try and will certainly buy another!

It isn’t sticky or tacky.  I can already see some positive results after a little over two weeks of use.  I use in the morning and a night.  I will definitely be purchasing after my samples are empty.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: How did I live without this product?  I love the 42 SPF and the hyaluronic acid.  It melts into my skin and doesn’t leave it greasy or oily.  I will definitely buy in the future.  I received this product complimentary to test and give my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I love the way it glides on and doesn’t leave my skin feeling sticky.  A little goes a long way. I use in the morning and the evening.  I will definitely purchase when I run out.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing for everyday use and if you have oily skin! It sinks right in and doesn’t leave an oily residue. Truly a holy grail! I go with something a little bit heavier at night time.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I love with product along side the aqua bomb! I love this at night for a really deep moisturize. I wear it during the day when my skin needs extra hydration. I don’t wear it during the day if my skin is feeling oily.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Seriously worth the hype. I’m not a fan of pot things because I feel like it gets messy but this doesn’t even both me. The product is so efficient. It works to remove everything. You only need a little bit for you entire face! It’s definitely worth the try!

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Seriously worth the hype. I’m not a fan of pot things because I feel like it gets messy but this doesn’t even both me. The product is so efficient. It works to remove everything. You only need a little bit for you entire face! It’s definitely worth the try!

reviews.review_text: Really refreshing and smooth, I would remove the make up with the neutrogena wipes and then finish removing it with this it leaves skin soft and glowing.

reviews.review_text: Love it it gives your skin exactly that a Boost!! it leaves skin feeling fresh and really hidrated.

reviews.review_text: My go to foundation!! i love how buildable the coverage is and it looks natural!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Sadly one of the most overrated products of all time. Might as well grab some Crisco from the grocery store and slather that on your face. It made me and two of my friends all break out, and we all have very different skin types. The “glow” is just looking greasy. The mask was like oil and a thick lotion mixed together. Better off with one of the many overnight masks on the market right now! I’d recommend the Belif one.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: There’s a fine line between using too few drops with no payoff and too many drops and looking orange. If you hit the sweet spot though the payoff is gorgeous! I do think they make me breakout a little, but only if I use them multiple nights in a row.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Really wanted to love this due to the price point but this product just did absolutely nothing. I used the whole tube without noticing a difference, it’s been about a month since it went empty and still no change... meaning there wasn’t even a gradual difference that it made. Big disappointment!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: The only eye cream I have ever used that made a noticeable difference! My eyes were brighter, more awake, and younger looking. This little tub lasts forever thanks to not needing much to be effective. I use it morning and night!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This makes my skin glow like no other. I have tried so many other HA products but keep coming back to the B-Hydra because it’s lightweight, not sticky, and layers perfectly with both morning and night routine.

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water
reviews.review_text: The worst self tanner I’ve ever used. I love the self tanning drops so had high hopes for this! The water leaks out of the spray pump so it’s very messy and because there is no color it is impossible to see where you’ve put tanner so leads to a very uneven tan. The color is beautiful, just wish it was even and not so messy to apply!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Wow. This product is amazing. I love using it at night. I wash my face, put this on, then let it sit while I brush and floss. Do not leave it on for more than 10 minutes! My skin likes around 6 minutes, after that it starts to burn. To me, the fact that it is so quick to do its job just adds to the convenience. I put on moisturizer and oil then wake up to clear and glowing skin!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m not sure if it was just me not using it for more than a few days, but I felt it didn’t do anything extra on the dry skin of my face fresh from face wash. I would have to quickly put the moisturizer quickly to get some hydrating feel. However, I know my friend has used this and had great reviews. So maybe this is one that you gotta persistently apply to notice. I think if you’re on a budget, then try it.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin, started using this recently, feels great on the skin, and I’ve noted some glow to the skin overall after 1-2 weeks of using, will keep!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A promising product! Tried this while finding some moisturizer for my very dry skin. It does the job of hydrating pretty well I’d say - you feel the hydration until washing your face again. Only caveat is the fragrance - it does have a mild-mod honey fragrance - which I feel with summer coming I wasn’t comfortable with (I like more fruity/floral fragrance in summer). The cream also is slightly on the heavier side compared to the likes of laneige - however I was surprised with how light it ended up feeling on the skin while applying. I may be going back to this come winter if I can get some improvement in the dryness of my skin -because I feel I need something tad more hydrating for my skin.

Some reviews said this smells bad after a few months which hasn’t been my experience and I’m on my 7th jar. I keep a jar at my parents house as well, so I only use that every other month or so and it’s still doing great after a year+ I will say that I wouldn’t recommend this to people with really oily skin as it will be too much moisture. reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I love The Ordinary, you can’t go wrong. Note: I had to read up on how to use direct acids properly. Essentially direct acids (AHAs and BHAs) have a low pH and ideally shouldn’t be applied at the same time as retinoids and serums with a higher pH (peptides etc). Your serums will only work properly if you use those with pH that agree with each other. So what I do is apply a hydrator (e.g., Hyaluroic Acid), peptide (e.g., Buffet, or Matrixyl, or Argireline), other “molecules“ (e.g., niacinamide and caffeine), and lastly an antioxidant (e.g., Resveratrol or Pycnogenol) in the morning. And then I alternate between a direct acid (e.g., Glycolic Acid, or Lactic Acid, or Mandelic Acid) or a retinoid at night. Because it is drying, it is a good idea to put a basic cream moisturizer on after a direct acid or retinoid.

My tone is more even, I’m not breaking out at all, and my skin looks soft and healthy. I will definitely be buying the full size jar soon!My only tiny complaint is I’m not in love with the smell. It’s not bad at all, I’m just not the hugest fan.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: It burned a little bit when I applied it, but nothing unbearable. When I washed it off my skin was really baby soft, just like it claims, but felt extremely tight and dry. I had a sample of the Virgin Marula Luxury Facial Oil so I followed it with that, but felt like the oil just sat on top of my skin. The next few days my skin got really dry and flaky in some areas, but I had some zits and a few red spots that got noticeably better over the following days, so I think next time I’ll just follow it up with my favorite moisturizer and skip the oil (face oils never work for me), and hopefully I can beat the dryness. Overall I think it’s definitely worth giving this product a try, just be aware of how drying it can be.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I should start this off by saying that I’ve never found a facial oil that I’ve liked, and I only tried this one because I got a little sample of it. I have combination/oily skin, and no matter how fancy and expensive the facial oil is, it always just seems to sit on top of my skin and never get absorbed, making me feel dirty. This oil was no different. Even after a few hours of trying to massage it in, it still felt like it was just sitting there. I ended up washing my face and just applying my regular moisturizer. I think if facial oils are your thing, this might work for you, but I definitely will not be purchasing it.

reviews.review_text: I got a deluxe sample of this with an order, and after just a few days of using it my skin was noticeably better. I’ve been suffering from some redness and acne, and it cleared up almost immediately and made my skin look healthy, plump and glow. I have naturally pretty oily skin, so I find this cream to be too heavy to use during the day, but it’s perfect as a night cream. I do wake up feeling really oily, but I just wash my face and then my skin looks amazing.

reviews.review_text: Ok, the hype is real. This has been my spring/summer evening moisturizer/mask in Denver, and my skin looks more matte and bright when I wake up. I’m obsessed. It is part of a routine of a few products that have transformed my skin and allowed me to ditch foundation - which is crazy for a 32 year old with combination skin that has formerly suffered from bouts of adult acne.

A pump would have been much better and wouldn’t have ruined the look of my bottle.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: LOVE - the perfect night cream for eyes you’ll wake up feeling so hydrated. I get very puffy eyes and this helps reduce it tremendously.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I’m so happy to try this pore clay mask gifted for free by innisfreeusa . I have a huge problem with my enlarged pores and blackheads. First step was applying the mask on the face for 10 minutes m. After washing it, I put my face above the face steamer so I can extract black heads. I really like the texture of it and the way it feels on the skin. I was feeling something cooling, and calming. I love that it doesn’t smell strong or weird. After washing my face the skin felt less greasy and pores looked smaller I will continue to use it twice for better results.

reviews.review_text: This is my first time discovering this skinfix cream and I’m thankful to receive this product complimentary from Skinfix.. I love that it is a very rich moisturizer, as winter comes I tend to have a very dry skin. I love that it doesn’t have a smell, it is free from fragrance and has clean ingredients , this is a huge plus for me. I love it and I will definitely buy more in the future.

reviews.review_text: I’ve got a sample of Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Serumfrom bareMinerals and I didn’t notice anything. I like that it’s herbal and I guess it has a more natural path. Not sure if it’s worth the price with so many other more powerful moisturizers out there. I didn’t notice any change in my skin. It smells great, but doesn’t work for me.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Good genes was gifted to me, and I also bought it in the past. It is one of the products that I think I will buy again, because I saw that it works for my skin. After first time of applying it, my skin felt itchy and red, so next time I used first an oil and then this serum, so it feels more comfortable.  I have a very sensitive skin and I don’t want to make it even more sensitive. I’ve noticed that my super-enlarged pores look better and the dark spots are getting lighter. Every time I go outside I have to use SPF because the sun can damage the skin very much. I don’t have many wrinkles, but I saw an improvement in my fine lines. I am not a fan of the scent, but as long as it works, I really don’t mind.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: Finally a retinol that I can actually use for eyes only. I break out when I use retinol on my entire face. Yes, it is irritating the eye area a little, that’s why I introduced it slowly in my skin care routine. I use it once a week. Then I will use it more and more often. This balmIs very concentrated, so it is a little hard to apply. I apply it on the eyes area and then I use a special spatula to make sure it gets in. I use it before bedtime, so in the morning the fine lines seem to be less visible and eyes look less tired. What I really like is that it’s unscented. I  hope this little stick will last for a long time, because for eyes it should be enough of the product.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Smells great, hydrates nicely and absorbs relatively quickly.  I always put it on before bed, and usually a few hours later it has fully absorbed.  A bit expensive, but lasts forever!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_title: Great product, but a little pricey!
reviews.review_text: Perfect for my oily skin.  Nice texture, light and hydrating, and absorbs quickly.  I just wish it wasn’t so expensive!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This is a nice, moisturizing lip balm that adds a perfect little tint of colour and tastes great!  It’s a small tube, but it lasts pretty long.  Fairly decent value for the price.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: Doesn’t completely clear out pores and eliminate blackheads, but works pretty well! Always makes my skin feel refreshed and glowy.  Great value for the price.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this oil. This is such a nice night oil. Wish I liked the green one as much. Your skin just feels and looks nicer. I enjoy my skin when I wake up. I have repurchased this and will continue to.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Good moisturizer but made me break out a decent bit for me.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Definitely makes a difference in my skin. It is more smooth. Lines don’t seem as pronounced. I really like this serum and always miss it when I run out.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Saved my skin. My did was so dry and nothing could make it right even oil. This was my saving grace. New holy grail moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: My favorite eye cream. It is so good. It is my favorite .I will continue to re-purchase probably forever.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: Like the color, but I’m so splotchy. I added 8 drops to a gel cream moisturizer for each area of my body including my face. reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream

reviews.review_text: Recently purchased this for the first time after seeing it all over YouTube & Instagram. Let me tell you, this stuff is AMAZING. reviews.review_text: An absolute staple in my skincare routine. Whenever I run out and don’t use it for a while, I notice a difference right away. Such an incredible chemical exfoliator! Definitely a power duo.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I know this cream is SO EXPENSIVE but I think it’s totally worth it if you are willing to splurge on a skincare product. It’s sooooo hydrating and smells amazing (not overpowering or anything). I’ve purchased the 50ml twice and recently bought the value size because I love it THAT much. Are there other less expensive products that work just as well? Yes. However, this cream is truly an experience. reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Been using for about two weeks now, and I’mobsessed! I mix one pump of this with B-Hydra to thin it out for night; and 1/2 a pump with B-Hydra for the morning. My skin so soft, hydrated, visibly plumper and overall tone has improved. It’s a fairly light texture that provides a soothing amount of moisture that sinks in quickly. I usually hate heavier moisturizers because they felt suffocating on my skin which is why for the longest time I only used B-Hydra. I decided to try this after developing some general sensitivity while using their TLC serum and then not replenishing my skin enough and this is a perfect fit. I still adore TLC and this has only made its use more enjoyable. I have oily, acne prone skin with occasional dry patches and this has kept my skin quite balanced. If I get a little crazy with how much I pump out for the AM I can feel a touch oily towards the end of the day but otherwise no issues. This hasn’t irritated any of my current breakouts and is keeping them from flaking as they heal. I love the pump on it to keep everything sanitary and fresh. Its pricey but worth it for the results you see and how long this will last.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Used this about three times now, and it definitely delivers on smoothing texture and exfoliating away dull skin. My skin feels soft and extremely refreshed after this. I don’t feel like I see an immediate brightening effect, but possibly in the long run with how well this sloughs off dead skin.It does have a decent sting for the first 5-8 minutes, not so much painful but it feels itchy and annoying until it calms. The first time I totally did not use enough product, feeling no tingle whatsoever. I use about 5 pumps for my whole face; two for each side and one for my forehead. I also find it helpful to use a silicone mask spatula for easy application and less waste. I only use it when my skin feels seriously congested so not too concerned about running out quickly.And you absolutely need to replenish your skin well after this. The oil sample that comes with this is not a suggestion, it’s required. I apply two or three moisturizers to help soothe my skin and calm any redness from the high acid content. I have sensitive skin and while it definitely does mildly “react” to this, it dissipates quickly and my skin is markedly better than before I use the mask.I like this for its quick exfoliating benefits and I’m curious to see how it tackles my acne scars and if any brightness sticks around to decide if I’ll repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’m so far enjoying this balm, it feels soothing and removes make up nicely. The texture melts in my hand and distills down into an oil that breaks down my makeup well. It doesn’t sting or dry out my eyes and mascara comes off with a few gentle rubs.Only real negative is I don’t feel like this emulsified at all upon contact with warm water. It turns into this waxy pilling film that somehow thickens the more you try to break it down. It’s not a great feeling what so ever. So the best way to rinse it off is with a soft warm washcloth; it rinses beautifully with that method. It leaves my skin feeling soothed, cleansed without being stripped, and softened. I typically always cleanse with washcloth rather than my hands so it’s not a inconvenient jump for me to use it this way. I don’t like to wear my makeup any longer that I have to, so days when I get home early I felt like this gap of cleansing and then applying nightly skincare hours later occurred. So with this I can remove makeup early while keeping my skin moisturized and comforted, then use my pm gel cleanser and follow with my serums, moisturizers, etc. later on. It seems to fit my routine well and works nicely.I’d say purchase if you use a washcloth to begin with or don’t mind using it instead cause it does work well.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This is was a total impulse buy as I walked towards the register and I’ve been pleasantly surprised by it. It feels lightweight and leaves a pretty subtle glossiness to my lips. It’s not sticky at all, and I love that it doesn’t cake up in the corners and inside edge of my mouth during wear. It has kept my lips soft and hydrated through out the day. The scent is so pretty! The grapefruit is that fizzy sweet without the sour like it says. I also got it in pear which smells wonderful as well— fresh and fruity. I like that these have no taste as well, cause most of the time balms are a sickly chemical attempt of whatever “flavor” they’re meant to be.Only place it loses a star is the lasting power and tint. They might as well have marketed these as clear and let the very subtle tint be a bonus. There’s really nothing it gives you color wise and you will need to reapply in about two hours if you’re talking a lot. And it definitely will not survive eating or drinking.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: These are my favourite makeup/face wipes. I love coconut and the smell is so fresh and nice and does a great job removing everything from sunless tanner to eye makeup.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been through my ups and downs with this product. The truth is, I have super sensitive skin, and this product requires me to use it long term and just trust. Honestly, I’ll also say that when I DO go through phases of inconsistent face washing for some reason-an occasion or travel etc- when I’ve been using this regularly otherwise, I find my skin less sensitive and breakout prone than before I added it to my routine.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This is everything in a BASIC face moisturizer youve ever wanted. Natural is the bonus.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: I love this product. I got this as well as the retinol stick for your whole face, and keep them on my nightstand, as the final step in my nighttime skincare routine. With one week of use (following instructions, not used EVERY night) I noticed an improvement in my crows feet.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: So glad that this is available in a larger size. I have sensitive skin and it just soaks this up.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: It worked wonders the first time I used it! My lips were so soft the next morning, I couldn’t believe it. A little bit goes a LONG way.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: This jar is going to last a LONG time. I use it every couple of nights and it is a miracle worker! A little bit goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: Been using this for about a month now and am very happy with the results; Belif has some fantastic products, is always consistent and great for sensitive skin

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this free trial size moisturizer with my online purchase using promo code VEGAN.  I haven’t tried Milk products before but read about them online and in magazines so I was happy to have a chance to try one of their products for free.  I like this moisturizer because it’s thick and creamy, but it doesn’t leave my combination skin feeling oily.  It’s scent-free which is a bonus.  I feel like this is a good cream for day or night and I actually just rubbed some of it on my hands that were feeling a little dry so it’s safe to use on your whole body if you need something in a pinch.The trial size jar seemed small at first but knowing how little I need to use this sample will last me for a bit which is great because I plan on saving it for March break.I can see myself buying this moisturizer in the future.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I received the LANEIGE lip sleeping mask in a Sephora Favorite’s Haute Hydrator kit that I recently purchased.  I’m giving it 4 stars because it smells yummy (like berries), but has no flavor (so I don’t want to constantly lick my lips).  It feels great on lips and my lips are still moisturized when I wake up in the morning.  The reason why it lost a star is because I’m just not a fan of sticking my finger in a jar of sticky gloss and the lip sleeping mask is a little sticky.  I read some reviewers use it during the day but I prefer a lip cream that absorbs for daytime wear.  I can also buy chap sticks that work just as well for a cheaper price.  I’m super fussy about my lips and I do like this lip product so I can see myself buying it in the future and would like to try a different scent (like the vanilla or lime).

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I received the cleansing balm in a Clinique kit recently.  I like that it’s non-scented so when I remove liquid lipstick there’s no fragrance taste leftover on my lips.  It works pretty good.  I have used it just as a regular cleanser and also to remove a full face of makeup: primer, foundation, eyeliner/shadow, setting spray etc.  I have a different cleansing balm I like better because it seems to remove liquid lip and eye makeup better (and it’s cheaper).  The Clinique balm took a few tries with the liquid lip and didn’t fully melt away the eye makeup.  Maybe I needed to use more.  As I’ve gotten older the area around my eyes are sensitive to makeup wipes and removers (especially milk products) so I like that this cleansing balm didn’t irritate my eyes upon application.  And my skin did feel soft and clean afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I received the cleansing balm in a Clinique kit recently.  I like that it’s non-scented so when I remove liquid lipstick there’s no fragrance taste leftover on my lips.  It works pretty good.  I have used it just as a regular cleanser and also to remove a full face of makeup: primer, foundation, eyeliner/shadow, setting spray etc.  I have a different cleansing balm I like better because it seems to remove liquid lip and eye makeup better (and it’s cheaper).  The Clinique balm took a few tries with the liquid lip and didn’t fully melt away the eye makeup.  Maybe I needed to use more.  As I’ve gotten older the area around my eyes are sensitive to makeup wipes and removers (especially milk products) so I like that this cleansing balm didn’t irritate my eyes upon application.  And my skin did feel soft and clean afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Not the best but not the worst
reviews.review_text: I chose this as one of my free samples/promo codes when I made an online order in April.  It’s a decent makeup remover or cleanser and beats using facial wipes or using liquid/milk removers and wasting a bunch of cotton pads.  I find this product to be oily though so I always use a wet face cloth rather than my hands to properly remove the residue.  It eliminates makeup quite well but I noticed a film over my eyes when I removed my eye makeup and perhaps I used too much.  I didn’t like that feeling and had to keep washing my eye lids and I also used eye drops afterwards.  I have used other makeup melting cleansers that cost loss and don’t irritate my eyes.  As an exfoliation with the bamboo it was nice because I could control how much product I wanted to add so it was never too abrasive.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: I received a mini version of this mask in a Origins mask discovery kit.  It has the typical charcoal scent, but it’s not overwhelming like some charcoal products I’ve tried.  It’s surprisingly creamy but goes on thin.  If I try to apply more product the mask gets streaky.  The mask gets tight but I don’t find it hurtful.  This isn’t a favorite for me because I’m not a huge fan of charcoal products because they tend to dry out my skin and cause irritation.  What I do like best about this product is how easily it is to remove and I haven’t experienced any stinging on my skin when applying my night time products.  How well it works is yet to be determined.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: When I applied this mask it reminded me of calamine lotion.  The mask is a very light pink.  I prefer clay masks to charcoal because they provide me with the same benefits but without the irritation that some charcoal masks give me.  This mask is creamy and not very gritty so washing it off is easy and doesn’t irritate my skin.  How well it works is yet to be determined.  It is scented but I find the scent lighter than the other Origins masks I’ve tried.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: I find the only difference between this Origins charcoal mask the Origins charcoal mask for pores is the scent.  The scent for this mask doesn’t smell great in my opinion.  I have seen pictures where the mask looks shiny but I don’t have enough product to really lather it on to get the same results I think.  I have a mini version that I got in a Origins mask kit.  Like the Origins charcoal mask for pores this mask is creamy but layers on very thin.  When I try to apply more it gets streaky.  I’m not a huge fan of charcoal masks but I prefer the other Origins charcoal mask to the charcoal honey mask.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This isn’t my favorite lip balm or gloss. I received this in a Sephora favorites kit. It smells great but it’s not very moisturizing and I didn’t notice that much shine. Maybe I have to put a lot on? I still don’t think that would work because what I do put on quickly absorbs. On the plus side I noticed little flavor and it’s fine to keep in a purse when you need some extra lip care. The clear balm is great for wearing under a mask. I don’t think I would purchase this balm but if other colors/scents were included in a favorites kit I wouldn’t mind trying.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a trail size of this eye cream in a Sephora Favorite’s kit.  It isn’t my favorite eye cream but it certainly isn’t my least favorite.  I just happen to have a eye cream that I find more soothing because my eyes are rather sensitive.What I do like about this eye cream is it is hydrating, and nicely tinted to help diminish dark circles but not so dark that it looks like concealer.  It hasn’t caused any irritation, but there are two other eye creams I like a lot better that are a lot cheaper.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this product in a Sephora favorites kit in April. I had tried the daily green melting makeup remover balm and this gel has the same sweet jolly rancher scent. I like the scent but would prefer my face moisturizers to be scent free.I like the gel-cream texture because it’s less sticky than straight up gels which I would normally search for in a serum or concentrate to wear under a thicker cream. I can wear a heavier concentrate or essence under this farmacy moisturizer and it won’t cause issues for my combination skin concerns. Because this is a oil free gel it’s been working great during the weather. But it’s still a little sticky so I wouldn’t try applying makeup over it immediately. If I had to I would use a different product like a mist followed by a good primer.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Pros: very moisturizing and the texture is almost buttery. I love the magnetic lid and metal spatula for scooping out the product.Cons: for a clean product it’s disappointing that it’s scented. It took me some adjusting to the honey scent, no matter how light it is. I have also heard concerns there is an ingredient in it that could be harmful to dogs if they kick your face? I have made sure to not wear it around my parents and in-laws dogs.Over all good thick facial moisturizer. I won’t be wearing it much in the summer because my combo skin won’t be able to handle it but great for colder months or at night.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I’ve been looking for a moisturizer for my sensitive eyes that react to products easily, so I was really happy to receive this complimentary sample from Estée Lauder. This eye concentrate is a very soft cream and applies with a wand. Doesn’t sting or set off irritations, and hydrating which is what I need. Someone with dry skin will probably want a dedicated moisturizer on the eyes however, as my skin is oily/combination. I also liked that it’s dermatologist and ophthalmologist-tested, non-acnegenic, and free of parabens, phthalates, sulfites, sulfates, mineral oil and synthetic fragrance.I think this is a nice all rounders to have but will mainly better for those who have concerns with fine lines and visible signs of aging.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: The Peace Out acne patches are great. Short ingredient list of just salicylic acid, aloe vera, and retinyl acetate, minimizing the chance for any other skin reactions so they’re great to use. Only negatives are that these are extremely pricey at $19 for 20, when many Korean brands have them at $4-5 for 20-30, and that the packaging coming in a box is just very wasteful space wise. Nothing wrong with the product but the packaging is definitely there just for the sake of the markup.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Beautiful luxurious jar. Packaging box was a bit more flimsy and crushed in transit so be careful if you’re gifting. Product is medium thick cream, feels very nourishing. Scent is super lovely but very strong, as someone sensitive to fragrance this was a bit too much for me. A lovely cream otherwise.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: Cute packaging, great ingredients. I like that the base is separate, these types of approach keep things fresh although I know some people don’t like to go through the trouble. Smell is very off-putting however, and I would pass if you are sensitive.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: There’s a tinge of medicinal scent that lingers while you’re wearing it. I’m quite sensitive to heavy fragrances but I could tolerate it. If you’re hyper-sensitive scent wise, be careful since you have to keep this applied for a while. The strips don’t adhere super strongly. I used it for 4hrs and it didn’t work that well. Only 2-3 spots shows up on the strip for me but in general my sebaceous filaments all stayed where they were. I like that this is mild but the result is kind of disappointing. Wanted to like this but unfortunately doesn’t work that well for me.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: LOVE this! Thin, light weight, fast absorbing, and does not effect your makeup!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: Received this in my Play! subscription box and fell in love! I even purchased the full size bottle and have added it to my regular skin care routine. Helps clears pores without pulling on the skin. Skin might be a bit red during and after use but it fades fairly quickly.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Love this formula, it’s thin enough that it melts right into the skin and makeup applies wonderfully over top!

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Perfect for those dry skin days!
reviews.review_text: I only like this cleanser in the winter when my skin is super dry, if not I notice my skin is a bit oily the next day.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I am really impressed with this. It’s not greasy it’s more of dewy glowy look and very moisturizing. This didn’t cause me to break out or aggravate my skin. It works fantastically as a primer or to wear alone My makeup lasts all day. I wouldn’t really recommend for people with oily skin because it would probably make them to shiny.

There is no orange cast either which was definitely a small fear with any bronzing product . I had no break outs or anything from them either. I highly recommend if your looking for a bit of a glow.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: This stuff is top notch!!!! It’s so gently yet removes makeup so effectively. It even removes my lash glue!!!! It doesn’t burn or sting my eyes which is awesome. I can’t praise this enough!!!! And it didn’t cause me and breakouts or skin irritation/issues. I HIGHLY recommend

reviews.review_text: This has quickly become my favorite makeup remover. I also really appreciate that it comes with a spatula, it makes the experience feel much more hygienic. Would definitely recommend, especially to those with dry skin like myself.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a new staple in my routine. It diminishes redness, shortens the life of blemishes, and hydrates, all for under $10. What more could you ask for?

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: These are a great, fuss-free way to try chemical exfoliation. They’re gentle yet effective, and completely foolproof.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer. I use this at night and it keeps my face feeling hydrated all night and in the morning it’s ready to go. I couldn’t tell I huge difference with my acne after using this product

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I was excited to try this product because I have a lot of acne scares on my chin and cheeks. Since the three weeks I have started using this I have noticed a DRAMATIC difference in my skin. I will be purchasing this product again

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_title: Helps with the dry winter lips
reviews.review_text: In the winter my lips get so dry and chapped. I apply this every night before bedtime and it gets them hydrated all night. The mango isn’t too strong and it’s just the right consistency

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I was very excited to try this product because I have black bags under my eyes. I’ve been using this for about 3 weeks and I can already tell a difference. It tingles a little when I use it but not bothersome. I will be purchasing this product again

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product blends so well!  I love using it on my neck.  As a woman in my early thirties that’s where I need hydration!   It has no scent also, which I love.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I love this!   It  protects so well and has ZERO smell!   I get migraines so it’s so nice when a product doesn’t have a scent.  I love that I can use it everyday and it works so well under my makeup.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Best moisturizer I’ve ever used. Great texture and not too heavy. Well see how it does over the winter as my skin is a little more dry and maybe I’ll incorporate Lala.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: another DE product added to my routine!
reviews.review_text: Was hesitant to try at first because of the reviews saying it left dry patches and/or white heads. However, this wasn’t the case for me. Took my make up right off and left me feeling fresh! No break outs after using! I  apply to dry skin and rinse off. Magic.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: most gentle cleanser I’ve used and gets the job done. Has never caused a breakout. By far my fav cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This stuff is the bomb. I’ve only had it for two weeks and I already feel a difference in the hydration and smoothness of my lips. You can use it before bed, in the morning, or just as a lip balm. Its pretty thick but it melts down nicely on the lips and has a fruity smell. I think it’s worth the $20 because of the amount of product you get and the quality.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is one of my go to cleansers. It works on sensitive skin because it is very gentle. It will take your makeup off but not strip all the oil off of your face. If you have acne prone skin I’d recommend using something in addition to this cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: These work!! Great for if you get hormonal breakouts of just a few pimples here and there. Only giving four stars because I feel like it is too pricey for only 20 dots.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I loved this water cream so much I went through the whole thing. It feels so silky, smells delicious, and feels so light and smooth on the skin. Not heavy, not greasy, not overly smelly, just perfect. It didn’t make me break out at all and after using the whole thing I can feel a noticeable difference in the smoothness of my skin. I don’t use many other skin products other than cleanser, acne spot treatment when I get hormonal acne, and sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Glow Recipe. For context, i have slightly oily, acne prone skin. I really like this product. I’ve used it five times, once without makeup and four under my makeup. It gives me a nice glow and has niacidamide which really works with my skin. other products like this have broke me out but this one has worked great with no break outs.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Really enjoy this product. It had an amazing thin consistency. It soothes my skin barrier while making it appear less red. I have oily acne prone skin and I had no irritation. As an added perk, the bottle looks gorgeous on your skincare shelf too!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Right away, loved the ingredients. It does have a bit of a fragrance that has a potential for irritation. But my skin was fine! I enjoy the packaging with the pump. It made my skin feel a bit oily but still enjoy if!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m someone who is skeptical of under eye creams. But this product is legit. Somehow it had an incredible cooling feeling when you apply it. It has a great consistency. I love the combination of ingredients!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This was my second time being gifted by Dermalogica and I will continue to use it beyond. Fantastic removal of makeup, even the tough stuff. It is a liquid consistency and is oil based. It does not break me out at all!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed with the Aqua Bomb!!I recently got the True Cream in Aqua Bomb and also in Moisturizer Bomb and both were better than I expected! reviews.review_title: Don’t let the purge scare you!
reviews.review_text: Within the first couple of days of using this product I had not one but two cystic acne flair ups! I normally only get these a couple times a year and often they don’t come to a head the way they did this time. This made me want to stop using the product but I go over the humps and continued. After a month of continued use I have found my skin surface to be smoother. I normally have trouble applying makeup to my nose because it applies unevenly but this product really helped with that!
