reviews.review_text: This is a nice, thick moisturizer from Drunk Elephant. In my opinion, it is her used at night as it doesn’t have SPF and feels noticeable on the skin. I like that it isn’t scented was hoping for more from Drunk Elephant.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Efficacious and pleasant but spatula not practical
reviews.review_text: I actually really like this product for moisturizing my lips and for a pretty, natural-looking shine. The slight pink tint is just enough to bring life to my face without looking like I am wearing a color cosmetic product. It took me about 18 months to use up the entire jar applying in the morning before putting on makeup. By the time I was ready to apply lip color (my last step), my lips were hydrated but not “slimy” feeling. I removed one star because the tiny spatula that this comes with is a good idea, in theory, to keep germs from your fingers out of the jar. However, then you are left with a sticky spatula that does not magnetize to the jar and is left either on a counter or in a drawer. Definitely not sanitary and is easy to lose!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Best moisturizer I have ever tried
reviews.review_text: The first time I used this cream on my normal/oily skin, I finally understood what it meant to have moisturized skin. The difference in my skin in just one night was significant - my face felt plump and moisturized from the inside out. I wasn’t extra oily, just soft and normal. As expensive as this is, I have never found any moisturizer that even comes close to doing what this does for my skin. In that regard I think the cost is completely justified. I especially love using the sample size of this while traveling because that is when my skin seems to appreciate it the most.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I picked this up because I love the Lip Sleeping Mask but I wanted something a little more portable. The original lip sleeping mask has a tiny spatula which is cute but is inconvenient and unsanitary to store when not in use. This is not quite as thick as the original and is more akin to a gloss. It is hydrating and feels good on dry lips, but it disappears quicker than the original and doesn’t have quite as much cling on the lips. Because of that, I feel like I have to reapply more often. I do really like the grapefruit flavor, but I love grapefruit flavoring to begin with. Overall, it’s a good product that I would recommend if you are looking for a hydrating gloss. I removed one star because I expected the formula to be closer to the original, since it was marketed as a more portable version of the original.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: Good for bacne or KP, but not face
reviews.review_text: I find this way too harsh for my face, even though I have “rhino skin” that is used to regular chemical exfoliation.However, I do think this is a great, inexpensive option for bacne or keratosis pilaris (“KP” or “strawberry skin”) on the body. The trick is to put a spray pump on the bottle and regularly spray on those larger body areas right after a shower. Make sure you let it dry down, as it is pretty sticky upon first application.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_title: No benefits to justify the cost
reviews.review_text: I purchased this because I love DE as a brand and because Stephanie Marie on Youtube said it was moisturizing and helped to define her vermillion edge after regular use. I was less than impressed. It isn’t as moisturizing as my drugstore lip balms and I did not notice any improvement in my lip line. The taste is supposed to be almond, but it isn’t particularly pleasant on the lips. When the product starts to run out, it sinks below the plastic edge and makes application to the lips scratchy and uncomfortable. And as much as I struggled to use this up, I got to that point relatively quickly. Overall, I will not repurchase and would not recommend because I don’t see any situation where this would be a better alternative to a less expensive lip balm like Chapstick or Vaseline.

reviews.review_text: Oh my goodness.  I received a sample of this a few years ago as a birthday gift and wasn’t that impressed, so I tucked it away. reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask

After applying it nightly for a few nights, I noticed that when I woke up my post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation seemed to have slightly dissipated and my skin was very soft. I have combination skin that starts out dry after cleansing, and gets oily throughout the day. Typically applying moisturizer at night makes my face oily and greasy feeling when I wake up, but not with this sleeping mask. It’s the perfect balancing moisturizer. It’s one of the more expensive masks of its kind but you get what you pay for and it’s well worth it. A little bit of this product goes a long way so a jar will last quite a while. I’m so glad that Influenster sent me tons of products from Dr. Brandt completely free to test out. Thanks to them I am sold on this product and it is now a part of my nightly skincare routine!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a dupe for 166 dollar SkinCeuticals CE Ferulic. This product does contain an effective form of vitamin C - L-Ascorbic Acid stabilized with vitamin E and ferulic acid. L-Ascorbic Acid has been shown to boost collagen production; however, not in this product specifically. It would be great if there were studies on this product similar to SkinCeuticals. L-Ascorbic Acid is highly unstable and needs to be stabilized in the product formulation before we can be certain it actually penetrates the skin and does what it’s supposed to do. Other than that, I think it’s a good product. It’s free of fragrance as I believe all DR products are and is very hydrating. Ferulic acid has skin brightening effect so this product does make skin appear less dull and more youthful. Please note that this is a new formulation of this product where you need to mix the contents of 2 bottles together. Personally, I am not a fan of this. How do we ensure the contents are mixed perfectly for L-Ascorbic Acid to be distributed evenly throughout the bottle? You can certainly do that during the product formulation process in a lab but I doubt we are likely to achieve the same result at home.

reviews.review_text: This particular moisturizer is captivating for many reasons. The packaging alone is so feminine and elegant. Even better is how amazing the ingredients together make a great product. I have oily/ combo skin, but the moisturizer is very nourishing and smooth! I received this product complimentary for sampling  purposes but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Excellent for prepping and priming you’re skin or leaving on as an overnight mask. It does have a little tingle to it which feels kinda weird at first, but then really nice! This will be my new go-to moisturizing mask.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Excellent for prepping and priming you’re skin or leaving on as an overnight mask. It does have a little tingle to it which feels kinda weird at first, but then really nice! This will be my new go-to moisturizing mask.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: When I first poured it into my hand I was a little worried about how the consistency would work on my skin. Once I applied, it actually went on so smooth and served as a really nice primer to build my makeup on. It smelled really nice. I can’t wait to actually try this in the summer! It has a silky texture that doesn’t leave you ghostly white. It blends with any skin tone as it is transparent. Price point is steep, but it may be worth it. Will report back once I put it to work at the beach.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_title: Didn’t think this would work, BUT IT DID!
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a few days after some skepticism. The formula is deceptive. It looks like water, but really did plump my skin! I applied during my morning skincare routine and it helped to smooth out my natural lines morning blanket face.

reviews.review_text: This was wonderful! Could feel it working in the moment and after as well. Super happy with the results!

reviews.review_text: So far so good! It’s a nice texture and settles well into the skin. Immediately after the skin feels plump!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’ve used every lip mask/chap-stick possible and this by far is the BEST thing I’ve ever come across. I use this before I go to bed and throughout the day as a lip gloss/chap-stick. It’s super hydrating which makes your lips look plumper because it genuinely restores the skins elasticity and reverses any type of damage. The jar will last me minimum 3-4 months and that’s using it throughout the day. A little goes a long way. Worth every penny!!!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Simply amazing. I’m on my fourth bottle and will continue buying. You wake up with glowy/healthy looking skin. A little goes a long way. It brings life back to you skin.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for about a year. Each time I use this product I wake up with a radiant/glowy skin. It minimizes pores and evens out tone and texture. Worth every penny!

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for about a year. Each time I use this product I wake up with a radiant/glowy skin. It minimizes pores and evens out tone and texture. Worth every penny!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This is one of my favorite products from The Ordinary. I really notice a difference when I skip. I use daytime with The Buffet as base, then Niaminicide, then Azeleic Acid. I add on a moisturizer and sunscreen and I am ready for makeup. Does not make my oily skin shiny. Love!

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_title: Base of day and night skincare
reviews.review_text: So glad Sephora added The Ordinary. Excellent skincare, proven, simple formulations. I use this after toning, night and day. Great base for serums and moisturizer. Sinks right in.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for several months and it is a wonderful serum. It does feel a little grainy at first because it is a powder in a cream type emulsion, which is weird, and it can tingle, although I grew used to. I do use during night as it makes my oily skin shiny, but it does make a world of difference and you cannot beat the price. Simple, effective ingredient to add to skincare.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_title: Great for oily skin and breakouts
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this! I’m a big fan of lemon scrubs already but this one definitely smells like lemonade and not just lemons. It’s great for oily skin as I’ve found it helps balance my skin out especially on my extremely oily days plus it gets all the gunk off my skin. I don’t get breakouts often but when I do, I turn to my lemon scrubs as they always help. This one is no different and helps a ton. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I really like this sunscreen! I liked the other one from Shiseido as well but this one left me looking so glowy and moisturized. I wore it out alone without makeup yesterday and I felt so beautiful with just the sunscreen on. I love the smell as it’s still definitely like normal sunscreen scent but lighter. It’s so light and serum-like and doesn’t cause me to break out which is nice. I would definitely recommend this because it feels and looks like a moisturizer while keeping your skin safe from harmful UV rays. I received this #complimentary in my #VoxBox from @influenster in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t excited for this because I thought it would be thick but it’s like a serum lotion/moisturizer and it’s heaven on your face. I honestly don’t wear sunscreen on my face normally and I really should but I have always broken out from the thickness and clogging of my pores so I just stopped wearing it. I absolutely love this formula! It makes your skin look plump and well rested even if you’re actually not. It wears amazing under powder foundation! 10/10 recommend! I received this product from @influenster #complimentary in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water
reviews.review_text: I love the tan this leaves and how long lasting it is. I have tried so many self-tanners that work wonders, but wear off within a day or two. This one is definitely longer lasting. I have had a few streaks, but likely because I rushed application. So it is not streak-free, but with careful attention it probably would be. The only downside is the smell! Some say this doesn’t leave as much of a smell and I couldn’t disagree more. The smell lingers, even after the next-day shower. It took two showers to not notice the smell anymore. Overall, I would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I usually wait two weeks before I review a product but that’s because it usually takes a while to feel and see results. I’ve used this sample size only a few times and am confident enough to give it 5 stars!!! It makes my skin SO smooth! It feels amazing on - doesn’t clog my pores & doesn’t leave my skin dehydrated. Amazing! And I am a tough critic of skincare products! I try tons and usually don’t bother to leave a review! Yay!

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I usually wait two weeks before I review a product but that’s because it usually takes a while to feel and see results. reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: Meh. They’re okay. They smell delicious and remove most of the makeup, but they’re not great in comparison to some other face wipes. I like to have them for on-the-go, but I wouldn’t go out of my way to recommend them.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff. I honestly didn’t expect much… since I’ve never had much luck with a toner. But it’s moisturizing while also somehow making my skin look less textured throughout the day. I have clear, combination skin with big pores due to mild acne as a child. I love how it doesn’t feel sticky or drying. However, I don’t love the packaging. I only bought the mini so I don’t know if the larger size is the same. But it’s hard to get enough out at once. I will be buying the full size regardless, though. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff. I honestly didn’t expect much… since I’ve never had much luck with a toner. But it’s moisturizing while also somehow making my skin look less textured throughout the day. I have clear, combination skin with big pores due to mild acne as a child. I love how it doesn’t feel sticky or drying. However, I don’t love the packaging. I only bought the mini so I don’t know if the larger size is the same. But it’s hard to get enough out at once. I will be buying the full size regardless, though. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I received the Grapefruit Lip Glowy Balm from Influenster but have been a long time fan of Laneige products. If you love the infamous lip mask, you’ll love this too! Perfect to wear as a daytime treatment or for a little extra shine. Keeps lips moisturized and beautiful.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Gentle yet effective cleanser leaving skin soft and clean! Smells like a luxurious spa and is great to pamper yourself a bit! Love this cleanser!

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Gentle yet effective cleanser leaving skin soft and clean! Smells like a luxurious spa and is great to pamper yourself a bit! Love this cleanser!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed with this product! The Dewey Skin Serum came out at the perfect time to save our dry flakey skin this winter. It’s great to use in the morning or evening. My skin always feels hydrated and soothed after using this serum.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I love this essence. It is perfect for my combination sensitive skin. It absorbs well and it is not greasy at all, it’s actually a very light refreshing feeling. This fits perfectly into my daily routine and I just wish it wasn’t so expensive :(

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I love this essence. It is perfect for my combination sensitive skin. It absorbs well and it is not greasy at all, it’s actually a very light refreshing feeling. This fits perfectly into my daily routine and I just wish it wasn’t so expensive :(

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream made my face feel soo nice and soft! And not to mention  the smell reminds me of roses too, so refreshing.  I apply it on in the morning and before bed and it leaves my face and neck feeling hydrated all day and night long

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: As someone with sensitive skin, this mask is a life saver! It calms any redness and irritations and the texture is so so creamy and smooth, feels so great upon application and isn’t sticky whatsoever.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this cleanser for 4 weeks now and my skin is ✨glowing✨This cleanser is super gentle; and really smooth after you rinse it all off. I can’t recommend this enough to folks with oily skin who don’t wanna have a greasy feel after cleansing their face.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this cleanser for 4 weeks now and my skin is ✨glowing✨This cleanser is super gentle; and really smooth after you rinse it all off. I can’t recommend this enough to folks with oily skin who don’t wanna have a greasy feel after cleansing their face.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: If you have oily skin and you want to have a luxurious and refreshing feel, this moisturizer is for you. When I apply and gently rub it onto my skin, it immediately bursts into water. It does not leave my skin greasy or sticky at all.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: If you have oily skin and you want to have a luxurious and refreshing feel, this moisturizer is for you. When I apply and gently rub it onto my skin, it immediately bursts into water. It does not leave my skin greasy or sticky at all.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: After using the Tatcha Water Cream for several weeks, I wanna try something new and this comes across me in Sephora. I have to say this is oily skin’s gem! This moisturizer is super lightweight and sinks right into the skin. It doesn’t have the greasy and sticky feel at all! Plus, the smell is bomb!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I LOVE THIS! Not a fan of fragrance but it smells amazing and isn’t an intense but light coconut smell. It has a gel like consistency and smooths on beautifully. Skin looks bright, even, and smooth after.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite face mask, I prefer chemical exfoliation over physical exfoliation because it is way better for your skin in the long run. I used to use the ordinary’s peeling solution but then I tried this one and noticed a way better difference in my skin. It is pricey but it lasts a long time, so worth it!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+

reviews.review_text: I personally LOVE this product however its thick and stinks a little but once you really work it in your skin, it has a beautiful glow. What sold me was the price point and the zinc. It’s a love or hate product- no in between.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Feels nice after my toner, but I think it’s a bit too watery. Not sure if it does much to help my skin. I have oily skin, so I suppose it’s definitely better than essences that are too thick.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

reviews.review_text: A bit heavy for summer for me but I can tell I will love this in the winter! Soaks in pretty well but takes some time. I noticed a glow to my skin that I’ve never had before after about a week of use. I received this complimentary from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I am thoroughly impressed! After only one week of use, I see a noticeable improvement in my fine lines and wrinkles around my eyes. It looks like I got Botox and I swear I look 7 years younger in 7 days! I use it both morning and night and I can feel it smoothing and tightening my skin. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

It felt great, like a facial massage almost. I’ve only used it a few times and it does such a great job exfoliating. The packaging is super pretty and it smells great. I did receive this from Influenster in a voxbox.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I have really enjoyed using this multifunctional product. By mixing skincare with the sunscreen function, I feel like I’m getting more bang for my buck. This product applies with a whitecast and gentle sunscreen smell but absorbs quickly and dries down matte.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I didn’t think this would work. I’ve only been using this product for a couple of days but I can already tell a difference in my skin. My skin feels and looks much smoother, even, and brighter than before. I received this product for free or complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I didn’t think this would work. I’ve only been using this product for a couple of days but I can already tell a difference in my skin. My skin feels and looks much smoother, even, and brighter than before. I received this product for free or complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: So far so good. I have used this product for a couple of days and my skin has seem to be brighter and much more even than before. I received this product for free or complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: This has been great on my skin. I absolutely love the gentle formula. I have pretty sensitive skin and I have been using this for a week with no breakouts. My skin is super soft and I love the fresh strawberries in the formula. I would totally repurchase this product!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I honestly can not live without this product. I have been using it for over 6 months now and WOW! It truly prevents breakouts.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: It was really moisturizing and nice but it made me break out around my lips. If you don’t have acne prone skin then I would say go for it though.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Says it works for oily skin but it dried mine out. I also have sensitive skin so that is something to consider.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Says it works for oily skin but it dried mine out. I also have sensitive skin so that is something to consider.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I first received this as a birthday gift and have not stopped buying it since! I have tried so many cleansers I can’t even count how many and this is the only one that takes of all the dirt and grime while not stripping my skin!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Idk what to think of this product because at first it burned and after a couple of weeks it didn’t and worked fabulously. This might have been due to my sensitive skin but other than that love the product.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Been using this for a week now and I do see a difference already. I have very sensitive skin and break out easily but not with this. The texture of my skin is already improving. Love the product so and love the price even more!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: Life saver for oily skin!! Finally found a moisturizer that does what it claims. Been using it for a week and I works say my face is at least 80% less oily.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I don’t often write reviews but this lip balm is amazing. No lip balm lasts long but this one lasts longer than any other I have tried. It’s not sticky at all. It truly moisturizes my lips. I love the laneige night lip mask that’s why I tried this. Smells amazing. Feels amazing. I loved it so much I purchased the peach and grapefruit as well. I hope they are as good as berry.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I have Berry, Grapefruit and Peach. Berry and grapefruit have a wonderful scent. Peach as no scent at all. I will still keep it because of the quality of the lip balm but I am very disappointed.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: Great product if you have oily or combination skin!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I was oh-so-skeptical about this product. For one, I have never used a cleansing “balm,“ but also, it’s not exactly inexpensive for the amount of product. That said, I am VERY happy with this purchase. I will say that I do not recommend it as a solo cleanser. I use this to remove my makeup and then use my normal Kiehl’s to actually wash my face. I have extremely sensitive skin and tend to see breakouts with new products and have never had an issue with this. Again, it works really well in conjunction with my normal cleanser. I will never go back cleanser only - and also, will never again use any type of makeup removing wipes or micellar water.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I was oh-so-skeptical about this product. For one, I have never used a cleansing “balm,“ but also, it’s not exactly inexpensive for the amount of product. That said, I am VERY happy with this purchase. I will say that I do not recommend it as a solo cleanser. I use this to remove my makeup and then use my normal Kiehl’s to actually wash my face. I have extremely sensitive skin and tend to see breakouts with new products and have never had an issue with this. Again, it works really well in conjunction with my normal cleanser. I will never go back cleanser only - and also, will never again use any type of makeup removing wipes or micellar water.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I am telling everyone I know about this skincare line. For the price, it’s amazing. Do yourself a favor and try this one out - it’s not drying, doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin, and layers really well with other products.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I purchase these healing dots literally once a month and I have to say they are the absolute best, such a game changer for me!!! Whenever I get a bad pimple that has a whitehead I put one of these on and leave it overnight and in the morning when I go to take it off the pimple comes off with the sticker! It’s really the best, I prefer it to topicals because usually the main ingredient is alcohol and that really dries out my skin and makes it red and flakey and gross and that attracts more attention to the pimple, in my opinion. This is just easier and less harsh on the skin and I will continue to purchase this product every month! Love love love!!

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: These pads are awesome! They really help brighten up your skin and even out your complexion while still being really gentle on the skin! Normally I feel like a product like this would be really harsh on the skin, not this one though! It’s really a great product and I’d definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Influenster to review, and my honest opinion on the product is that it’s very good! I’m a total product junkie and I’ve tried a lot of different facial scrubs and this one is definitely in my top three… I would recommend! I was concerned about the lemon burning my face as I have very sensitive skin, but it was very gentle and that was a big plus for me.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love Kate Somerville products, they have yet to let me down or produce a product that I want to instantly return.I received a sample of this to try and I was pleasantly surprised, I have oily skin and this soaked right in without leaving any residue behind: usually I wake up in the morning with an even more greasy face. The scent is so fresh and clean yet feminine. I will definitely be purchasing the full size. I did knock a star off because I didn’t get the flow effect this advertises. I’m also leaving this review as part of a contest.

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: The product is just okay. I have combination skin that’s a little bit on the oily side and I don’t have too much redness or irritation. It does feel kind of greasy at first so I was a little concerned about waking up to a greasy oily face in the morning but I didn’t. I have started to notice a few pimples and I don’t normally break out so I kind of want to contribute it to this product since this has been the only change in my skincare routine. For the price I don’t really recommend. But maybe try a sample first. I received this complimentary in exchange for my honest review after testing it out.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I’m pleasantly impressed by this toner. It has a nice smell without being overly perfumey. It’s got a milky, thicker texture, which I sort of like, but I knocked off a star because it’s so thick it makes me use more product to soak a cotton ball to wipe my whole face. It is hydrating, I used it after I was peeling from a sunburn and it didn’t sting or anything. I didn’t want to wash my face with something harsh, and this was perfect. It refreshed my skin will providing it with a drink. If you plan on using this 2x a day every day, I’d say to go with the bigger bottle. I have oily skin and actually felt like I was less oily later in the day after using this. I would be happy to purchase this after I run out of the first bottle that I received for free for testing purposes. I otherwise wouldn’t have tried this product.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this product so far after only a few days I noticed my pores looked shrunken and my face looked smoother. I can’t speak on the long term effects of this product as I haven’t had it long but, it’s very liquidy like a liquid foundation. The color is so pretty, goes on like with a tint of purple which goes away once it absorbs into your skin.I love the smell and feel of it, not greasy or oily. I have oily skin and wake up extra oily in the morning, and this didn’t mess with my face or leave me extra oily.I knocked a star off for the time being since I don’t know the long term effects yet.I received this free in exchange for my honest experience.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this with a recent order and omg I love it! My skin felt so smooth, moisturized and... radiant! 3 things I look for because I’m in my 30s and aging is starting to show. I even used this under moisturizer in the morning and my oily skin didn’t turn into grease factory. I’ll definitely be making the investment for the full size.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: this is a great moisturizer. I have oily skin and with the seasons switching my skin was going haywire, then this lovely product came in my monthly play box. my son is settling down it moisturizes without making my face greasy and actually absorbs into my skin. I love it!

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: love it! makes my skin glow

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I am in love with this face oil. I was so excited to receive it, and it did not disappoint. I deal with rosacea and combination skin. This didn’t break me out and soothed my redness. I apply it at night as my last step, and I’ve even started to use it under my makeup for a little glow. I will definitely purchase this on my own as I love using it. The good news is that a little goes a long way, so I don’t think I’ll have to replenish anytime soon!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I loooved this product. I use vitamin c serums regularly, and this one has come to the top of my list! I noticed visible brightening of my skin w the c-firma. I thought the mixing aspect of the product was cool and I like that the shelf life is longer since you activate it upon mixing. It does have the sticky, funky smelling vitamin c thing that others (like skinceuticals or Vichy) also have. I recommend dampening your face before applying and then dampening again right after and then applying a moisturizer. Overall, I loved that I could see it doing it’s job! Would purchase on my own.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this cream. Wow, I was sent this from influenster to review, and it has been amazing for my skin. I have rosacea, which it has been so soothing on and I visibly have less redness. I love the lightly creamy texture, but it still manages to moisturize my whole face. I will say, if you are oily this probably won’t be the right cream for you. Even though it isn’t heavy, it’s extremely rich. A little goes a long way, and I’m really excited to see how it helps my winter skin this year! I also love that it’s fragrance free!

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this cream. Wow, I was sent this from influenster to review, and it has been amazing for my skin. I have rosacea, which it has been so soothing on and I visibly have less redness. I love the lightly creamy texture, but it still manages to moisturize my whole face. I will say, if you are oily this probably won’t be the right cream for you. Even though it isn’t heavy, it’s extremely rich. A little goes a long way, and I’m really excited to see how it helps my winter skin this year! I also love that it’s fragrance free!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Using this under my makeup made tons of creasing go away! I looked so much more awake and refreshed the past couple of days and I’m not needing to cake on the shape tape. I’m happy with it

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: One of the only oils I’ll put on my sensitive skin. It’s never once broken me out or made my breakouts that I do have worse. It’s a thick oil and a little goes A very long way it’s super spreadable. Love this skincare line and oil

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This is not a miracle product. It will slightly cover up major redness but you aren’t able to just put it on and go if you have major red spots like me. It’s really thick and kind of Turns ur face grey.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This is not a miracle product. It will slightly cover up major redness but you aren’t able to just put it on and go if you have major red spots like me. It’s really thick and kind of Turns ur face grey.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Incredible, my face loves this. On my second bottle!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Ok, Seriously— this stuff is great. I (reluctantly) purchased this after I ran out of my PTR CamuCamu serum. I bought the smaller bottle because I honestly thought I was going to return it (product better be good to justify the price, right?) Turns out is three weeks in and totally HOOKED. My face is so even, clear, and redness is basically gone (something I rarely ever experience). I went from using 2x a day to just at night.. because the serum is rather greasy.. but i’m alright with that considering how wonderful my skin looks. A tad greasy? Yes. Acne? No way. Love love love!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Obsessed doesn’t even begin to express how much I love this product. I use it both day (under SPF) and night. Since starting to use this product my skin has been glowing to the heavens. Love love LOVE. My only complaint is that I’ve been buying a new bottle just about every single month— so it’s getting pricy.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: Amazing if you have a damaged moisture barrier or are experiencing dry, winter skin. 10/10 my redness goes AWAY when I use this— almost immediately results. I have repurchased several times and will continue to— reminds me of the skinceuticals lipid repair moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Another gem by Clinique. love this stuff! I have oily, breakout prone skin and was scared that a heavy balm like this would affect the clarity of my skin but after massaging and rinsing it removes all of my makeup and preps my skin for thorough cleansing.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Another gem by Clinique. love this stuff! I have oily, breakout prone skin and was scared that a heavy balm like this would affect the clarity of my skin but after massaging and rinsing it removes all of my makeup and preps my skin for thorough cleansing.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: First I must say this is an amazing sunscreen to wear on its own or under makeup. I love the fragrance free, non greasy, colorless formula AND spf 40. But the real kicker here that has my jaw literally dropped is the fact that I’ve spent so much money on primers claiming to keep my oily skin matte and none of them help it last beyond an hour or two. I use this stuff as my primer or pair it with a pore blurring primer on top and let me tell you, I haven’t had to use oil blotting sheets in weeks! I don’t know what it is but I’m sold on this! To me, it’s like a matte primer with spf 40 that actually works and keeps me matte all day. I will repurchase this for as long as it is made! Highly highly recommended

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: First I must say this is an amazing sunscreen to wear on its own or under makeup. I love the fragrance free, non greasy, colorless formula AND spf 40. reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I am so impressed with this cleansing balm. It’s significantly cheaper than many other cleansing balms out there but it doesn’t skimp on the quality ingredients, it’s fragrance free, and I find that it removes all of my makeup and emulsifies well. I also love that it comes in a tube instead of a jar and you get a LOT of product for the price. I use this as a makeup remover/first cleanse before going in with my actual cleanser. This is definitely my new go to!

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I am so impressed with this cleansing balm. It’s significantly cheaper than many other cleansing balms out there but it doesn’t skimp on the quality ingredients, it’s fragrance free, and I find that it removes all of my makeup and emulsifies well. I also love that it comes in a tube instead of a jar and you get a LOT of product for the price. I use this as a makeup remover/first cleanse before going in with my actual cleanser. This is definitely my new go to!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: To me, Drunk Elephant is just an overpriced fad brand. I got a sample size of this and was not impressed. I have oily skin and this always left my skin feeling greasy, like it was just sitting on top. Also, the price is outrageous for a moisturizer. I have a $12 moisturizer from Target that works better than this. Would not recommend.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I got this as a free sample and have used it at night for the past few weeks. It irritates my eyes and has done nothing for my fine lines. I’ve noticed more of a difference in hydration and smoothing around the eyes using regular lotion or moisturizer. I cannot imagine paying full price for this product.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I hated this. The smell is overwhelming. It is HEAVILY fragranced and smells like verbena kitchen cleaner or bugspray. The texture is too thin for my liking and I felt like I had to use a lot to get all my sunscreen and makeup off. Just really unpleasant to use.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I hated this. The smell is overwhelming. It is HEAVILY fragranced and smells like verbena kitchen cleaner or bugspray. The texture is too thin for my liking and I felt like I had to use a lot to get all my sunscreen and makeup off. Just really unpleasant to use.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: The smell is amazing, just like a fresh mango. That’s really all it has going for it. This balm is sticky, generic and not very moisturizing. I use $5 Burt’s Bees lip butter every night and it’s more moisturizing than this. I find that many products from this brand are overhyped and overpriced. Save your money and get better results!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_title: Works well for my very dry lips
reviews.review_text: This is a great lip balm with a great smell. It moisturizes beautifully and also looks nice on top of lip color.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This is definitely one of those “holy grail” products for me. Calms redness and irritation. Most days I skip the foundation, just use this with concealer and I’m good to go.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This is definitely one of those “holy grail” products for me. Calms redness and irritation. Most days I skip the foundation, just use this with concealer and I’m good to go.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Really good for dry winter skin
reviews.review_text: Even with oily/combination skin, the Midwestern winters can leave my face dry and dull. I started using this at night, and I can already see and feel a huge difference. It gives me the extra moisture I need, and it hasn’t caused any breakouts. While I’m still using a more lightweight moisturizer in the morning, this makes an excellent night cream for me.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I feel like this product gets the hype it deserves. After just once use I knew it would become a staple in my collection. It’s the perfect base for everyday makeup. I love how it’s an spf with a glow in it but it always has a nice tint which does a good job of adding some color and evening out my skin tone. I achieve the perfect healthy glow with this product. It’s hard for me to find an spf that doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin but this one works for me!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love the instant hydration this lip product gives my lips. It glides right on and is very comfortable to wear. I also love the shine and color it adds! Perfect everyday lip product to keep in your bag. I have the shade peony which I think compliments my tanned summer skin very well!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I can already tell this is gonna be a new staple in my collection! I love how quickly it sets into my skin leaving no stickiness behind. As someone who hardly wears foundation anymore I’m always looking for good skincare. This helps smooth my skin, diminish fine lines & blur my pores.

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_title: I think I have found the best concealer ever!!!
reviews.review_text: I have been looking for a new concealer and I think I have found my match! This full-coverage cream not only provides my face with moisture but also covers all the uneveness in my complexion! Not only am I using a product that has SPF in it, but it also anti-aging! What a win-win for me! I haven’t been able to find another product that covers all my imperfections while also providing me with natural looking for an all day wear! I am so excited about this find and I can’t wait to continue using it!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this scrub! Not only does it smell absolutely amazing, it does wonders for your face! This scrub exfoliated my face in a way a scrub hasn’t in a long time. My face was so incredibly soft! Highly recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I was very interested to try this product when I received it complimentary from Influenster! This product is thick but goes on easily and blends into your skin. My skin is oily and this moisturizer felt very slippery on my skin. It gave a great deal of moisture to my face and looked great with my makeup! I do recommend it and look forward to adding it to my makeup routine!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried my fair share of lip masks (to combat Canadian winters) and of all the ones I’ve tried this one actually lasts overnight and feels so smooth in the morning. It smells so nice and even just feels so nice to apply. It’s a dream after a day of wearing a matte lip! Received this product complimentary to test.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: K I love this. I’ve seen it everywhere, it’s a cult favourite and I don’t know why I hadn’t tried it until now. I’m sensitive, oily and acne prone and this didn’t irritate my skin at all. It also didn’t strip my skin of all the oils leaving it with a nice balance. Probably my new go to cleanser I received this product complimentary for review purposes. Recieved complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: This smells like heaven and leaves the skin feeling refreshed - it was a bit more harsh than I had anticipated - but not so much that I wouldn’t use it again. It’s really nice paired with their rose mask afterwards to calm the skin a bit! I’m sensitive, oily and acne prone and I would use it again. Received complimentary from influenster to review.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Received this as a gift for my honest opinion. The cream is very lightweight, it’s not a thick cream. I been using it for a few days now and. I do like how it feels on my skin. It hasn’t made me break out, which is usually a concern with my sensitive skin. Looking forward to seeing smaller pore

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received this as gift for my honest opinion.Super formula! My skin is on the oily side and I was pretty surprised. My skin absorbed it pretty well and it was very light weight. Did not clog my pores. And no white cast. Good job she Shiseido!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received this as a gift for my honest opinion. Really great product especially for us oily skin people. This will be my go to summer spf. Super light weight non greasy!  Leaves your skin soft and protected.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using the the Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair for a couple weeks now. I received a 1 week sample from Influenster but it’s lasted me longer, as I only use what’s needed to cover my face. It definitely does hydrate my skin and make it feel plump. Although I have enjoyed using this and the way it makes my skin feel, I just can’t see myself spending that much money on a product when there are others that make my skin feel the same way. Had I been able to see other changes or improvements in my skin, I may have a different opinion. As always, this review is based upon my own experience.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have really enjoyed the Tatcha Dewy Serum! The scent is light and refreshing and it feels amazing on my skin. I have oily skin and this does not make my skin any oilier despite it being a “dewy serum”. This serum has really kept my skin hydrated and feeling great. I have used this daily every morning and at bedtime. I have also used this under my makeup as my moisturizer and it has not affected how my makeup applies or stays on. My makeup has stayed in place despite my face being oily. I received this complimentary from Influenster for testing and reviewing purposes, but as always my review is based upon my own personal experience. I would definitely recommend this product if you’re looking for a good quality serum!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I am LOVING this Charlotte TilBury Magic Cream! I have oily skin, and the recommended amount for my skin type is pea size. That small amount really is enough and does not make make my face any oiler than it already is. I have used this every morning, nighttime and under makeup and it’s great every time! There is a fragrance to it but it’s very light and smells powdery to me but it’s very refreshing and not overpowering. I would absolutely recommend this to everyone with every skin type!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_title: my eyes haven’t looked this good since my 20s
reviews.review_text: Been using this for only about a week and so far, so good. I usually apply it at night so it can work it’s magic while I sleep, and I’ve been walking up to more refreshed looking eyes and less prominent dark circles. I sometimes pop a little on in the morning too if I was out late the night before. It’s super important to know that you need just a very small dab for each eye. At first I was put off by the price but this jar could easily last at least six or eight months. With that in mind the price isn’t bad at all.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_title: Incredible if you don’t already have oily skin
reviews.review_text: This made my skin look AMAZINGLY clear and luminous. I have acne prone skin and didn’t break out at all. Used this for about two months. Unfortunately I have combo-oily skin and even though my skin looked flawless, it made me too oily to keep using long term. I’d recommend this for someone who is more combo-dry or dry.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_title: Incredible if you don’t already have oily skin
reviews.review_text: This made my skin look AMAZINGLY clear and luminous. I have acne prone skin and didn’t break out at all. Used this for about two months. Unfortunately I have combo-oily skin and even though my skin looked flawless, it made me too oily to keep using long term. I’d recommend this for someone who is more combo-dry or dry.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: This product is life changing, full stop.
reviews.review_text: After one night of use, my skin looked different and several people said my skin was glowing. I’ve been using this faithfully for about three weeks and my skin hasn’t looked this good in years. My lines around my forehead and mouth are considerably smaller and my skin looks smoother. I haven’t had any breakouts (and EVERYTHING makes me break out). It’s truly a miracle product. I know it’s expensive but you get what you pay for.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I do like the way this cleanser makes my skin look and feel, but it’s kind of pricey considering that it doesn’t last very long and the bottle design is awful: you just know there is more product in there but can’t get it out of the stupid bottle!

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I do like the way this cleanser makes my skin look and feel, but it’s kind of pricey considering that it doesn’t last very long and the bottle design is awful: you just know there is more product in there but can’t get it out of the stupid bottle!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is so conveniently packaged and easy to use, and it also works really well. I have gifted it to a few friends and coworkers (Hawaii sun needs a solid product), who all love it. My only issue is that when I wear it on my face the smell/formula makes my eyes water. And once a stream of sweat brought it from my forehead into my eyes and I couldn’t really see for the rest of the day. But if you are outside in strong sun doing something active, it’s SO convenient to pull this little bugger out of your pocket or beach bag and touch up your vulnerable sun exposure areas. It seems to be A+ for waterproof, but I have sweat it off (as described above). Overall a great product.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Despite the sticker shock and ridiculous packaging, I still keep buying this eye cream. It’s the only thing that seems to truly keep my eye area moisturized and smooth without irritating my eyes. The slippery tub has rolled around in the bathroom sink way too many times to count, but oh well the product is great.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wanted to hate this cleanser. It’s way too expensive for me to like. Unfortunately, as soon as I tried a sample I knew that I was going to have to buy the full size. I have oily, acne-prone skin that is pretty dehydrated, and what I love about this cleanser is that it’s not irritating at all and it doesn’t leave me with that tight feeling after I rinse it off. It feels luxurious, smells like a spa, and I’ll be purchasing it again begrudgingly.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: In a committed relationship with this product
reviews.review_text: This is an excellent product. I have oily, acne-prone, sensitive skin, and unlike most products with AHAs/BHAs this barely stings my face. While I’ve got my acne under control thanks to prescription medication, this product has taken my skin the extra mile: no more texture, the redness is less pronounced, and my PIE is fading rapidly. This combined with the Belif Aqua Bomb overnight mask leave my skin super glowy, plump, and smooth in the morning. Will repurchase forever!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this mask. I have historically had oily, sensitive, acne-prone skin, so I’ve been really wary of products that are meant to act as overnight occlusives, but in the interest of babying my skin I gave this a shot. Putting on this mask feels like splashing water on your face, except the water stays on your face and you get none of the dryness (if that makes sense). It doesn’t completely dry down, I’m definitely still sticky by the time I get in bed, but I wake up with plump, smooth, moisturized skin. Using this in combination with Farmacy’s Honeymoon Glow makes my skin look so nice in the morning. Will repurchase forever!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: The Belif Moisturizing eye bomb works well. It has a gel like consistency which I like in skincare. I don’t notice a real difference on my under eyes, it’s just like a normal moisturizer. It didn’t give any negative reaction to my eyes so that’s a plus. There’s really no cons, I just don’t use eye creams. I think any face moisturizer works under the eye as well, but if you do use eye creams, this one is for you!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: The Belif Aqua bomb brightening vitamin C cream is really nice! It has a gel consistency with a pale yellow tint. It also smells like a sweet lime though I know it’s supposed to be orange lol. I have combo/oily skin and it really hydrated my skin, though I don’t think it is the best choice for oily skin. If you really need some hydration and glow to your skin, check this cream out! I got the product complimentary from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: The KORRES Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream is a great mattifying moisturizer!!! It leaves skin feeling smooth and softly matte, but still with a natural sheen to it. It also blurred my pores! I took a picture with flash and my pores were gone, compared to using a normal moisturizer. It smells similar to like clay or play doh (not a particularly good smell), but goes away once applied. All in all I TRULY love it!!! If you have combo to oily skin like me, I really think you should try this product out! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: My first skincare that I ever bought, afew years ago, was an eye cream from Shiseido. I loved the product but I wanted to explore other brands. Now that I was able to try this brand again, I want to try more of their products. I really like this eye cream, it’s so smooth and absorbs fast without leaving any residues, doesn’t feel greasy and it’s not heavily scented. After using the cream for two weeks, I have noticed a brightening effect under my eyes, and less visible wrinkles. The formula has a rich consistency, it is super hydrating and moisturizing. Very effective!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: In love with this product, my skin never felt and looked this good, it truly does what it claims!!After using it, I experienced some immediate results, my face it’s super soft, hydrated and not greasy, it looks brighter, and plump. I have oily and sensitive skin and I haven’t experienced any negative reaction. I usually don’t like scented products but this one smells amazing, a subtle lemongrass aroma that I really enjoy. So far good!I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange of my honest opinion.

reviews.review_text: Thanks Influenster for giving me the opportunity to try Shiseido’s Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream. I own what I think may be the previous version of this product, the Benefiance WrinkleResist24 Eye Contour Cream. That was my eye cream HG before, but this new product tops it! First, a tiny amount goes a long way with this cream. My biggest issue with the WrinkleResist24 cream is that I had to wait a while for the product to sink into my skin as it was a bit heavy. The Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream remedies that problem as it is much lighter! To me, it is the perfect balance of rich hydration without heaviness. My eye area felt immediately softer and hydrated, but almost any eye cream can do that. To me, the proof is in continued use. I’ve used this product twice a day since I’ve received it, and I can truly tell a difference in my under eye area and minor crow’s feet. My fine lines are reduced and smoothed out, and although I didn’t think I needed anything for dark circles, my under eye skin looks brighter somehow. Do I look like I’m 18 again? No. I’m instantly suspicious of claims that a product can completely erase all effects of time. Is it the best eye product I’ve tried? Yes, definitely. Not miracles, but real results!

reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Skinfix in exchange for my honest opinion. It’s also become my go-to night cream for my neck and chest.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have used cleansing oils in the past (MAC and shu uemura) and have broken out. I had given up on cleansing oils, thinking that they just wouldn’t work for me because I had an oily tzone with large pores. I have been so impressed with the Tatcha line that I decided to give it a try after seeing the rave reviews. I LOVE IT! the oil is so luxurious. I use 2 pumps to remove make up at night and I honestly think it dissolves my makeup because my face is so clean after. The first time I used it I took a cotton pad to my face after and there were no traces of makeup left! The oil rinses off with a slight milky watery texture and leaves nothing behind except hydrated (not oily) skin. I follow with the calm rice polish as I like to make sure I give my nose a good scrub to keep the pores clean. I have sensitive skin and this combination is gentle enough for me to use daily. I then finish off with the essence, dewy concentrate and the silk cream. I have struggled with my skin all my life - being an oilslick in my 20s and have dehydrated/oily tzone in my 30s after having kids. For the first time my skin feels and looks hydrated and I’ve noticed my tzone is more balanced because my skin is satisfied finally! I look forward to my night time cleansing ritual every night. I don’t use the cleansing oil in the morning though as I’ve found layering with the water cream, Becca primer and Dr. jart bb cream is a bit too much moisture for me. Another winner from Tatcha!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I use this after the Tatcha cleansing oil for dual cleansing. I have very sensitive skin and have never found a product that is gentle enough to use daily... until now! I just discovered Tatcha and have been loving everything I’ve tried so I had to get my hands on this too. There are 4 polishes and they vary in the amount/type of enzyme. The other 3 polishes contain papaya enzyme with the highest concentration is in deep cleanse, then original, followed by gentle. I don’t think it’s noted on Sephora, but the calm version doesn’t contain any papaya enzyme. The active ingredient is Indigo which is great for soothing skin, but I’m  not sure if it is an enzyme as well. I was worried this would be ineffective without the papaya enzyme that I almost returned it for the original without trying. I am glad I did because my skin looks brighter but doesn’t feel sensitized after using it. I think i might try the original as well to see what the difference is, but i think this is my staple for daily cleansing at night. The instructions say to use 1/2 a tsp but i use half of that and find it’s enough to cover my face with a generous amount of foam. You’re only supposed to keep it on for 15 second and I believe this to be true because I left it on for twice as long and my face did feel a bit tight after.
