It moisturizes my sensitive skin without leaving it feeling greasy. I will definitely repurchase this product!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from skinfix. First off, the packaging is by far the best way I’ve seen tub moisturizers. Secondly, I absolutely love using this on my face. It moisturizes my sensitive skin without leaving it feeling greasy. I will definitely repurchase this product!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Sunday Riley. I was excited to use this in more of a preventative fashion, and have really been enjoying the results. I use it every night before bed and I have started to noticed smaller pores on my nose and a smoother under eye. It has a tiny burning and tightening sensation once you apply it, but nothing too crazy. I think this would work even more drastically on more mature skin.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Glow Recipe. This is a very lightweight and gentle serum that I immediately noticed great hydration properties to it. I don’t have any irritation or redness at the time or trying so was not able to see how that performed.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Fresh.  Living in a dry heat, this has been a lifesaver for my dry skin. I use this on my neck and face and it absorbs very well with no greasy residue. I also like that it is not extremely fragrant.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I love using this SPF under my makeup on days I know I’ll be in the sun a lot. While oil-free I can still sense a slickness to this and therefore wouldn’t wear it for any special occasions as it may impact the lasting power of your makeup, but for everyday wear - it’s perfect!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This has been our go to sunscreen for AZ pool days! It’s hydrating without being oily and doesn’t break my boyfriend out who has extremely sensitive skin. Really enjoy the ease to blend in and no white cast!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: This is a light and easy sunscreen that is perfect for the pool day with no makeup, but you don’t want a white cast. It would be a bit too oily to put makeup over top but as it is tinted, there is no white cast. Don’t expect a full/ medium or even light coverage with this though. If you have the money, it’s a nice product, but not necessary.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This product makes my skin feel AMAZING after just one use and I love the application of skin care and make up afterwards. The only gripe I have is that I personally hate powder skincare products like this cause I find them messy and I feel like I end up wasting a lot of product. Still don’t think it’s a deal breaker for me though since I love the results.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This product makes my skin feel AMAZING after just one use and I love the application of skin care and make up afterwards. The only gripe I have is that I personally hate powder skincare products like this cause I find them messy and I feel like I end up wasting a lot of product. Still don’t think it’s a deal breaker for me though since I love the results.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I received this product for testing purposes and WOW this is really an amazing product. I honestly didn’t think my pores were all that bad until I used these bad boys. They were able to extract all the oils and gunk from my pores. After application, my pores were noticeably smaller. Definitely a new fav of mine!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: My overall skin texture has improved so much since using this. My pores are noticeably smaller and my face is brighter. I don’t breakout as often as I once did and if I do it’s nothing like before.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is absolutely my new favorite facial cleanser. My face is more radiant since using it. This cleanser stops breakouts dead in their tracks and has improved any facial redness. I will continue to use and recommend.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Love it. I was skeptical at first because the moisturizer feels a bit on the heavier side but it drank beautifully into my skin. My face is brighter and my facial redness has improved. The only downside is that the packaging is unconventional and I’ve had problems pumping product out.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This definitely delivers great moisturizer to the lips or the optional eye area but it just sits on top of the skin. I’ve also noticed if I’m using this and not constantly reapplying, my lips look extremely dry and cracked.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Drinks beautifully into the skin and has improved my dark circles under my eyes.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Great product at a great price. This serum is super lightweight and drinks beautifully into the skin. My face felt tight and smoother after every application.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: Thank you Farmacy, for gifting me this lovely Daily Green oil-free gel moisturizer. This was my first time using a gel moisturizer and I was pleasantly surprised at how easily it drank into my skin.  I received this product complimentary from Farmacy.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe. I loved the Plum Plum serum it left my skin smooth and hydrated. I use it in the morning an evening before applying vitamin C and moisturizer. The packaging is lovely and convenient to pump the serum without making a mess.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Fresh. Great moisturizer that although thick, sinks quickly into the skin and smells like a rose field. I use it in the am and pm on my combination skin and I love it.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Good but not for my skin. The packaging is great, love that I can dispense the right amount without having to dip into the container. It is a bit too thick for my liking. It is not sticky and sinks into the skin well.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Good but not for my skin. The packaging is great, love that I can dispense the right amount without having to dip into the container. It is a bit too thick for my liking. It is not sticky and sinks into the skin well.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I usually don’t buy eye serums, so was intrigued to try this retinol + niacinamide one from Sunday R.The applicantor is great, easy to use and the cooling from cold ceramic is very soothing. After first use my under eye are started to peel. Would not use it daily or before big events.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Great first step gifted by Dermalogica. I used two pumps after splashing water on my face. Removed all my mascara and the rest of my makeup. Followed up with another cleanser to get rid of the oiliness.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Great first step gifted by Dermalogica. I used two pumps after splashing water on my face. Removed all my mascara and the rest of my makeup. Followed up with another cleanser to get rid of the oiliness.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Darker than I expected. So far I used it under foundation. Once I get some tan on my body I think this product will be great to give my face some color and glow because I avoid tanning my face and end up with a lighter face.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Great serum. Very moisturizing. I used it in the mornings before applying makeup and I could see an improvement in how my skin looked. I  have dry skin and all the usually dry spots looked smooth. The scent and texture are pleasant.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: Auto correct cream is my favorite and now first choice for eye skin care. This cream really brightens and can notice results before or by container is half way used. Does not bleed into your eyes during the day as some other brands can. You can use sparingly to last longer.Spreads easily. I use this on under eyes, eyelids and out to crows feet area. This continues to make me look young and sheds years. I would highly recommend and by again.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I had received a sample of this product and loved it so much I had to order even with the high price point. I am crazy about serums and the results start to show so quick on this that I had to have it!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Works great on dry patches and love the dewy look it gives my foundation ordered my second one!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Works great love the ingredients and that it is cruelty free!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Great summer time moisturizer I can feel a little tingling after applying but I wake up and my skin is not oily!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I used this for 15 minutes and then the oil it comes with I was amazed by the results the next day my skin was absolutely glowing I am very impressed!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I can wear this day or night smooths my skin out works well even with my dry winter skin

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: Brightens my skin I rotate between 2 other products first received a free sample then bought full size

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Received a sample packet and I am currently ordering full size amazing way to get your niacinamide gentle on dry skin

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: On the first try of using this product, it made me break  out into a pimple on my outer lip line making it look like I had lip herpes... It was a pimple with a really big white head. Anyone having that problem or is it just me? Plus, it’s a bit drying too!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love the packaging and functionality of it. I love the way it’s formulated! It glides so smoothly on my face. A little goes a long way. It takes 2-3 pumps to cover my entire face and neck. I am actually using my second bottle right now. Truly amazing moisturizer. Doesn’t feel too thick or greasy on the skin! For someone who suppers with dry skin in the winter, it made my skin feel super hydrating!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this product! I’ve been using it for almost a year already (going through my second bottle at the moment). I use it every other night as a sleeping mask. I love that the consistency is thick and cream. A little goes a long way so 2 pea size will be enough to cover my face and neck. This product has not broken me out yet! Highly recommended!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this product! I’ve been using it for almost a year already (going through my second bottle at the moment). I use it every other night as a sleeping mask. I love that the consistency is thick and cream. A little goes a long way so 2 pea size will be enough to cover my face and neck. This product has not broken me out yet! Highly recommended!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this because I love the watermelon sleep mask but this moisturizer broke me out so bad! it took me 2 months to recover from my breakouts... when I apply the moisturizer and used SPF (I don’t wear makeup btw), it would make me face peel so I had to return it.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this product so much! It helped lighten my dark circles. This product lasted me all year. A little goes a long way! I only used 1 pea size. I just hate that it’s a bit too pricey. I don’t think I would spend $60+ on an eye cream ever again LOL

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: I loved this product! I wear eyelash extensions and I noticed that my eyelids were starting to get dried. The Sephora employee recommended this product to me and I fell in love. This serum stick helped with the dryness and flaking. It feels like butter when I put it on. A little goes a long way. There is no scent to this product which I love as well. The only problem that I have with this product is the amount of product within the stick. You don’t get much out of it to be honest. For the price that I’m pay for it, I expected a lot out of it. I just need this product to be in a bottle form because that would be sooo much better for consumers!

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer so much! This product has hyaluronic acid as one of it’s main ingredients therefore it has hydrating benefits. When applying the moisturizer, it feels very lightweight and non-greasy which is why I love it so much! On days (especially during the winter seasons) when my face is feeling dry, I put one or two drops of The Ordinary 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil for extra hydration. Overall, The Ordinary Skincare Line has definitely helped my skin so much!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I suffer with dry skin during the winter but oil skin during the summer. Although this product made me break out at first, I would still give this a 4/5 because going back to using it again in the summer, it made my face super moisturizing without it feeling super greasy and sticky. The consistency is very lightweight hence the word “gel“. It does have fragrance in it but it is a slight scent, nothing too overwhelming. It honestly smells relaxing if you ask me.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this oil so much! Even though the instructions recommend that consumers use it during PM, I use it morning and evening. I have been using this product for a week now day and night and I have noticed results within my cheek area and acne scar. A little goes a long way!!! I use only 2 droplets and it will cover my entire face. Rose Hip Seed Oil also help with hydration and dark spots. I tend to use this right after my serums and before locking it in with my moisturizer. I noticed that when I put this on after my moisturizer, it causes flaking of the skin. Although it is an oil, it is super lightweight!!!

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for a full 2 months now. I wanted to test this product out to see the pros and cons within the product before writing a review. I apply this product after using The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% every AM and PM. Cons: it is a bit pricey compared to their other serums but you are paying for quality and this where it’s at! it is a bit sticky when you first apply itPros: This product is a combination of peptides to help hydrate and fix/prevent any signs of aging hence the word “buffet“, leaves my face feeling super healthy every time I use it, helped with my acne, did not break my out Overall, this product was amazing. I am currently on my second bottle. I am honestly so OBSESSED with this product! I have recommended this product to majority of the women in my life and they seem to enjoy it too! :)

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_title: I LOVE THIS PRODUCT MORE THAN I LOVE MY BOYFRIEND
reviews.review_text: I don’t even bother buying the 1oz anymore after finding out that Sephora carries the bigger bottle. You’re definitely getting your money worth at a reasonable price and with a high percentage of Zinc and Niacinamide combined!! I stock up on this product every time they have the 2oz! I will forever use this product. This is my ride or die

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I love The Ordinary products but I feel like this specific product didn’t do much to my eyes? I suffer from dark circles and puffiness on the eyes. I’ve been hearing a lot of hype about this product so I gave it a try. I’ve used it for 2 months and saw no results. My eyes look the same. Sometimes my dark circles look even worst than they were before. I apply this product on my under eyes and on my brow bone. I notice a thick sticky consistency that lingers with this product.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: As a huge fan of Japanese skincare, I was very excited to try Tatcha products. After using this serum for 2 weeks, my skin is smoother and plumper.  I love how face instantly feels hydrated and refreshed after applying it. Also, the packaging is gorgeous.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this serum complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review. I could see results already after 1 week of use of this all-in-one AHA treatment. It made my skin more clear, radiant and smooth. I had redness and dryness around cheek area. This serum soothed, hydrate skin and evened the tone. It also plump my fine lines.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received this free in exchange for honest review. It absorbs really good and skin feels hydrates and smooth. I’ve been using it in my nighttime skin routine. I could see difference in redness on my cheeks after first use. I also like the liquid formula, texture and the bottle.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this free from Fresh in exchange for my honest review. This moisturizer is a definitely a great find. I love how you skin is super moisturized, smooth and plump after using the cream. Also, it has a very pleasant scent.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Skinfix for testing purposes. I was excited to try this peptide cream, because it was 2019 Allure best of beauty award winner. Even after 1 day of use I felt how skin on my face and neck was very hydrated and stayed plump whole day.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Skinfix for testing purposes. I was excited to try this peptide cream, because it was 2019 Allure best of beauty award winner. Even after 1 day of use I felt how skin on my face and neck was very hydrated and stayed plump whole day.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This was gifted to me by Dermalogica. I wear sunscreen and makeup almost every day, so I have to use oil cleanser before the foam cleanser. It works great on my combination skin. It wipes off even waterproff makeup and sunscreen easily. I use it during my night skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This was gifted to me by Dermalogica. I wear sunscreen and makeup almost every day, so I have to use oil cleanser before the foam cleanser. It works great on my combination skin. It wipes off even waterproff makeup and sunscreen easily. I use it during my night skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this serum for couple weeks now. My skin needed that extra boost of vitamin C, especially during this cold season. I use this serum twice a day. My skin tone is more even and brighter. Overall condition of the skin got better, it’s more hydrated, which makes you look more youthful.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I am a fan of Fresh masks. This calming mask is perfect addition to my night skincare routine. I leave it on overnight for better results. My skin is glowy and radiant in the morning. The redness is gone. It also hydrates my skin very well. It is a great mask for times when your skin needs extra care.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I like this cream because I have pores, and it helps to reduce them. I like that it’s lightweight and doesn’t make skin greasy. The skin feels very hydrated and plump after using this product.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I love Clarins, and this serum is one of the best on the market. It is #1 bestselling serum for a reason. I noticed results after just one week of use. It visibly smooth, firm and plumps your skin. I also notice that fine lines are less visible. My skin has a healthy glow.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love Glow recipe products, and this toner is one of my favorites. It’s lightweight, non sticky and fast absorbing. I like how it smells, perfect scent for summer. My skin feels very hydrated and refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love Glow recipe products, and this toner is one of my favorites. It’s lightweight, non sticky and fast absorbing. I like how it smells, perfect scent for summer. My skin feels very hydrated and refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Fresh. Love the new serum! It works great on my skin. It plumps up and hydrates well. My face tone looks smoother and brighter. I use it twice a day and looking forward even better results.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has been so pleasant! When applying, I first thought this cream might leave a thick white layer on my skin because it is so rich and creamy, but much to my surprise, it did not at all! My skin quickly absorbed this cream and my skin felt softer, more plump and moisturized and looked radiant. I love the seaweed sodium hyaluronate because it really hydrated the skin!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has been so pleasant! When applying, I first thought this cream might leave a thick white layer on my skin because it is so rich and creamy, but much to my surprise, it did not at all! My skin quickly absorbed this cream and my skin felt softer, more plump and moisturized and looked radiant. I love the seaweed sodium hyaluronate because it really hydrated the skin!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a fantastic eye cream! It has a thick consistency and it is really easy to apply and glides on smoothly! The formula is gentle, smooth, and isn’t irritating at all! IMO it is perfect for every day use!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Dermalogica. I don’t usually like a cleansing oil, but I gave this one a shot and I’m not disappointed! I really like the light orang-y fragrance and that my face felt cleansed after just using the oil, and not after using a second cleanser. This left my face feeling clean, fresh, and hydrated. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Dermalogica. I don’t usually like a cleansing oil, but I gave this one a shot and I’m not disappointed! I really like the light orang-y fragrance and that my face felt cleansed after just using the oil, and not after using a second cleanser. This left my face feeling clean, fresh, and hydrated. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin feels so happy after using this moisturizer! My skin looked and felt dewy and glowy and stayed hydrated throughout the day! The cream texture is a bit thicker than a light gel moisturizer but still light enough to not feel heavy for my combo skin. Plus, it absorbed really quickly and didn’t feel sticky afterwards!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin feels so happy after using this moisturizer! My skin looked and felt dewy and glowy and stayed hydrated throughout the day! The cream texture is a bit thicker than a light gel moisturizer but still light enough to not feel heavy for my combo skin. Plus, it absorbed really quickly and didn’t feel sticky afterwards!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this Peony shade complimentary from Fresh. If ever there was a lippie for summer this would be it! It smells so good, the color is gorgeous, and with one swipe it’s a nice daytime shade, but if you apply two it’s such a cute darker shade for a nighttime outing! Plus this lip balm gives some awesome long lasting hydration - not sure if that’s from grapeseed oil but I’m digging it! I’m going to need one in every shade!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is amazing! It absorbs really well, smells like what a lot of tea based products smell like, which may hug some people but I don’t mind it. The texture is light and smooth. It layers well with other products also which is a must for me. I haven’t noticed a big difference in my skin (I’m sure with continued use I will) but it’s not dehydrated so that’s a win!

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this lip balm. It is incredibly hydrating, and it smells deliciously of delicate vanilla. It doesn’t have any sweet taste. It doesn’t feel sticky at all. The original shade is just shiny - no color. If you want a really amazing lip balm I promise you it will not disappoint!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is perfect for winter, it helps calm my skin and saves it from getting dry in cold weather. I’m obsessed with the packaging! Dispenses the right amount of cream in a very hygienic way. I also love that It’s rich in texture but doesn’t clog my skin, just perfect for as an everyday cream and there’s a lot in the container so definitely a great bargain!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is perfect for winter, it helps calm my skin and saves it from getting dry in cold weather. I’m obsessed with the packaging! Dispenses the right amount of cream in a very hygienic way. I also love that It’s rich in texture but doesn’t clog my skin, just perfect for as an everyday cream and there’s a lot in the container so definitely a great bargain!

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this exfoliator complimentary from the brand and I’m beyond impressed with it!! The micro particles provide deep exfoliation without irritating the skin. It feels so satisfying every time I use it, my skin is instantly healthy looking and glowing, it rids of my dry skin and helps my skin care products absorb better. HIGHLY recommend it!!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this exfoliator complimentary from the brand and I’m beyond impressed with it!! The micro particles provide deep exfoliation without irritating the skin. It feels so satisfying every time I use it, my skin is instantly healthy looking and glowing, it rids of my dry skin and helps my skin care products absorb better. HIGHLY recommend it!!

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I got to test this moisturizer out complimentary from the brand and it is everything I expected it to be coming from a brand that I love. It has a gel like consistency, delivers the right amount of moisture without any greasiness or residue left on the skin. For me this is the best morning moisturizer and it doubles as a makeup primer.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I usually don’t care for eye masks but this one I LOVE! I’m on my second jar! This cream has helps so much with my morning eye puffiness and keeps my under eyes looking refreshed. I also use it under my concealer and it’s so moisturizing, makes it blend really well! Overall great cream whether used as a night mask or a morning eye cream. This was gifted to me by the brand but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: 2 in 1 product! This is truly revolutionary, you get a niacinamide treatment and a skin highlighter in one product. It smells delicious and doesn’t irritate my skin, which other niacinamide serums have in the past. I wear it solo on no makeup days and as a last step on top of makeup for that natural healthy glow! This product was gifted to me by the Glow Recipe but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Cannot say enough good things aboutthis AHA! I go back and forth between good genes and a mandelic acid but I gotta say I see better results from Good Genes. Brighter skin for sure, I would say juzt ease into it as it can make your skin a little sensitive, also it comes with ths price tag but so worth it! This was gifted to me by the brand but I purchased this product on my own before and love it!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Great light weight serum with an almost liquidity texture which melts onto the skin. Love how it makes my skin feel, soothed and plumped without feeling heavy. Great when combined with their retinol eye sleeping mask!

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream feels and smells so luxurious!! As it should with such price tag!! My mom has used this cream for years and still does, she has dry and sensitive skin so this really has helped make it look hydrated. As for me, I have combo skin so I appreciate how it hydrated my dry spots but it looks a bit shiny on my forehead but not in a bad way. A little but goes a long way so although it’s on the expensive side, the jar would last a decent amount of time. This was gifted to me by the brand but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream feels and smells so luxurious!! As it should with such price tag!! reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I alternate between this serum and Good Genes, and it’s just as good! Makes my skin feel so smooth with a bit more hydration compared to GG with a hint of honey scent. I didn’t experience any irritation which is always a plus! This was gifted to me by the brand but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Love the applicator on this eye cream.It has a cooling effect and definitely feels hydrating under and around the eyes. The ingredients are also great! It contains niacinamide which helps brighten the skin and retinol which seems to be helping with the texture. I just wish there was more product in the tube  for the $$

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Great oil for double cleansing or when used alone on the days I only wear sunscreen. I alternate between this and my farmacy cleansing balm and they both equally do a great job at removing makeup! Only plus to this oil is that I’m using less then the balm so the value is there. I also like that it doesn’t sting my eyes! This was gifted to me by the brand but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Great oil for double cleansing or when used alone on the days I only wear sunscreen. I also like that it doesn’t sting my eyes! This was gifted to me by the brand but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This mask feels so good on the skin! My skin has been extremely dry and patchy lately so this was a godsend! It calmed my skin so much, the dry patches are less visible and my skin feels soft and looks more even.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love fresh lip products so much! I fell in love it them back in Christmas when I received a gift sample box and they didn’t disappoint! This one is super nourishing and I like that the color is buildble so you can from natural to glam. Highly recommend!! Gifted by Fresh

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m a big fan of Fresh products! This little serum is truly magic in a bottle. It has a milky texture that applies really easily and absorbs quickly but leaves the skin looking quenched refreshed and bouncy. Perfect as a makeup primer too.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: These little packets are great for on the go. I have the full size of this cleanser and already love it so it’s great to have these packets handy when traveling and on the airplane too. These are also good for people who want to sample it before they buy the full size. Gifted by Dermalogica

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: I am really impressed. I wasn’t sure at the beginning if i should buy it, because based on the reviews some people said it’s not moisturizing enough and that it made them break out. But for me it worked really well, i have oily combination skin, i tried it without face oil/serum and i also  tried it with face oil/serum like they asked us to, and both ways worked really well on my skin. This moisturizer makes my face soft and it is really moisturizing. Great quality and great price.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Wow i literally started using this serum 3 days ago and i can already see a little bit of difference. My blemishes and acne scars started getting a little lighter which is a really good thing. This serum is a little sticky but i don’t really mind because after putting on a moisturizer your skin will be good. Great product and amazing price.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample from Sephora. Honestly it’s okay!! It does the same job as any other cleanser that i have tried.To he honest, it reminds me a little of the St ives abricot scrub, because of the scrub that it contains (which is terrible) It might be harsh for the face. And i am not a big fan of the smell. Overall it’s fine. Wouldn’t think about purchasing it, because first of all it’s expensive for a cleanser that does an average job and second of all because of the scrub that it has (which i don’t trust)

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: Best tonner for blemishes and acne/acne scars!!
reviews.review_text: I have heard so many good things about this toner so i decided to buy it. I use this toner 2 times a week only and i can already see a difference in my blemishes and acne. I don’t use it every single night, because i am worried it would be too harsh for my face (because it’s an exfoliator) But so far i didnt get any bad reaction. Also if you struggle with back acne, this product does a good job at clearing it. Would recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this cleansing balm!! I use it when i want to remove my make up and then i use my regular cleanser and it completely removes all of my make well and it makes my face very soft and clean. To make sure that this balm really removed my make up, i used micellar water after using this balm for the first time,  to see if there is any make up or dirt left on the cotton pad and there was nothing. So this balm really does the job. Also it doesn’t burn my eyes at all, i was surprised to see some reviews saying that it burns their eyes because on me it didn’t. Overall this is an amazing cleansing balm. So glad i purchased this

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: This face oil is perfect as a last step in your skincare routine. I use this every night and it makes my face very hydrated and soft. It is very lighweight, does not clog my pores, does not make my face look oily and does not break me out. I actually realised that it helps prevent getting acne and even helps get rid of some acne scars. So glad i purchased this. Everyone needs this in their life.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this cleanser. it’s by far my favorite along with The ordinary one. Since i started using this cleanser, my skin has never felt better. I barely get any acne, my skin feels smooth and just amazing. This cleanser doesn’t stripp the skin which is awesome. doesn’t contain fragrance and is inexpensive.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample and i was excited to try it out but tbh i find this moisturizer okay. Like it does a good job at keeping my face moisturized and oil-free but the smell really bothered me especially during the first hour of wearing this moisturizer. Even though i don’t mind when a moisturizer has a scent but this one really bothered me. I probably wouldn’t purchase the big size.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This product honestly doesn’t really do that much. It doesn’t actually remove dead skin like it claims to be, it’s actually the product pilling. Like as soon as i put the product in my hands to put it on my face, It immediately pills (the product will turn into small balls). However after removing the product from my face, my skin became softer. That’s it!! This product doens’t really clean the skin and doesn’t even remove dead skin. Wouldn’t purchase this!! so not worth it.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this cleanser. It does a great job at cleansing my face. it didn’t strip my skin and i didn’t get any bad reaction. After using this cleanser, my skin feels clean, fresh and soft. It doesn’t contain fragrance which is awesome. I have oily combo skin and this worked perfectly for my skin.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Love this exfoliating face wash. I use it once a week and it does a great job at making my face very smooth and soft. It didn’t stripp my skin and i didn’t get a bad reaction. it is definetly a soft physical scrub that isn’t too harsh

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Meh! it’s fine. I received this as a trial size sample and i find this moisturizer okay. I wouldn’t say it’s a deep hydrating moisturizer, it is definitely lightweight. I feel like it’s not very moisturizing and doesn’t absorb well on the skin. It also leaves the skin a little sticky. It has a rose smell which i didn’t mind a lot. I didn’t get any bad reaction or any break out and it didn’t make my skin more oily (P.S: i have oily combo skin) I wouldn’t purchase this moisturizer because it is not really worth the price

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I got the chance to try this moisturizer as a sample fron my sephora order and i’m so glad i did!! I have oily combination skin and this moisturizer worked perfectly. It is lightweight, absorbed well on my skin and it’s very hydrating and moisturizing. i didn’t get any bad reaction (such as breaking out) which is awesome. It also didn’t make my face oily. Would recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I got the chance to try this moisturizer as a sample fron my sephora order and i’m so glad i did!! I have oily combination skin and this moisturizer worked perfectly. It is lightweight, absorbed well on my skin and it’s very hydrating and moisturizing. i didn’t get any bad reaction (such as breaking out) which is awesome. It also didn’t make my face oily. Would recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this moisturizer. I have oily combination skin and it works so well for my skin. It absorbs really well on the skin and does a great job at hydrating the skin. It also didn’t make me oily throughout the day. I also really love the smell. I put a 4 stars because it does leave the skin a little sticky but other than that it’s a great moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: i’m not very sure if i would repurchase this product. I bought it as a day eye treatment to help with dark circles but i didn’t really see a difference and i have been using it for 4 months. However it does wake your eyes up when your eyes are feeling sleepy so thats a good thing.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I actually enjoyed this night cream. it is a rich night time cream, does a great job at moisturizing the face. The only thing that i don’t like about this product is that it contains fragrance. I like my skincare products to be fragrance-free.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Unfortunately i did not enjoy this cleanser. I does a good job at cleansing the skin but the problem is that it is very dyrinh and strips the skin so bad. Even when you’re massaging the products in your hands to apply it on your face, you feel that your hands are also feeling dry. Wouldn’t recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this product! I have combination skin, i use it like3 times a week at night and it just gives my skin the perfecthydration and moisture. This product claims that it helps withpores but i’m not too sure it’s actually helping my pores. Theymight have minimized a little but nothing too crazy. It doesn’tbreak me out and i mostly buy it because i love the moistureit gives my skin. Yes it’s pricey but i only buy it when it’s onsale. Also the smell is amazing.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Dont see any benefit on my lips.
reviews.review_text: Is a nice mask, smells nice and feels great but I dont see the purpose of it. It doesnt make my lips smoother and they are a little bit more dry since im nor using my usual eos lip stick before bed. Im actually thinking of returning this product.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I like very much this formula as it locks the moister from the skin. I like to use it when I feel super dry like after a shower. I don’t use it everyday as it can break me out but its great to give a full glow and hydrate my skin. I love to use this after a busy day or before my makeup for a long day. I have the big version and the smaller for traveling and having it in my purse.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_title: One of my favorites from Tatcha
reviews.review_text: I love this Essence so much. Is one of my favorite products from Tatcha. It instantly hydrates my skin and after a week you can tell the difference of the daily use. I use it twice a day after my cleanser and I had notice my skin much more smooth, even, radiant and overall healthier. It’s definitely worth it.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_title: One of my favorites from Tatcha

I use it twice a day after my cleanser and I had notice my skin much more smooth, even, radiant and overall healthier. It’s definitely worth it.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I really like this eye cream. I feel it absorbs quickly, it is not greasy as other eye creams Ive tried, but it is super moisturizing and fresh. It runs smoothly and has no scent which I loved. Ive been using it night and day as it doesn’t leaves a greasy film and I can use it under my makeup. I haven’t use it 12 weeks to say if it really get rids of the lines but it sure gives you a soothing, refreshing feeling with instant glowing results.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing! I bought it after listening to my favorite skincare guru James Welsh recommending it. It has really changed my skin for good, my pores are smaller and my texture is more clear. Im so happy I found this product. I went today to buy the whole line as Im in love with this toner, hopefully they all work as good as this magic liquid.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing! I bought it after listening to my favorite skincare guru James Welsh recommending it. It has really changed my skin for good, my pores are smaller and my texture is more clear. Im so happy I found this product. I went today to buy the whole line as Im in love with this toner, hopefully they all work as good as this magic liquid.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Im in love with this moisturizer. It leaves my face super soft and  hydrated without leaving it oily or shiny. It doesn’t breaks me out and after a week of using it every night my skin looks radiant, it has helped with my texture and evened my tone. I wake up looking refreshed. I will definitely keep using this moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: This is your sign to get it!
reviews.review_text: This is the first time trying an eye serum and I loved it. It has a really nice cooling feeling and the applicator is the best. It does have a scent but its very mild and nice. After only a week of being using it twice a day I already see a difference in my skin. It feels more hydrated, brighter and plumper. It absorbs very quickly so its easy to apply it under makeup and its the best to use it before your eye cream at night. I will keep using it and I will definitely repurchase it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: The first couple of days using  daily microfoliant gifted by dermalogica sampling, I wasn’t that sure about this product because it left my skin a little bit on the drier side. After the fifth day and noticed the big difference! I was happily surprised that my skin felt softer, had a glow and it was much clear. The acne was completely gone and my skin looked radiant. The texture of the product reminded me like the tatcha exfoliator but this one helped cleared with my acne. I am very happy and will definitely repurchase it.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review. I like this product. It works well to exfoliate my skin and gives me a slight tingle just for a couple of seconds which goes away quickly. I don’t understand why it has arnica extract but that doesn’t really bother me as I find this an effective product and tend to like AHAs though I only use them about once or twice a week so as to not over exfoliate.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: I received a gift card to select a product of my choice to review. For context, I have dry skin and my main skin concerns include fine lines and dark circles. I thought this would be a great product to use because I have enjoyed eye balms in the past and figured since it had retinol I would be able to enjoy the format but with added actives to address my concerns. The concept of this is great but sadly it wasn’t emollient enough for me and tugged at the skin around my eyes. I think if they reformulated it to be more emollient then I would reconsider my review. It never really warmed up on the skin either to move smoothly as others have suggested. This is a hard pass for me.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Glow recipe gifted me the serum in exchange for my honest review. My first impression of this serum is that it’s great. It definitely provides a soothing feeling and has helped address redness when my skin is irritated. I have a habit of using too many actives (there are just so many good products out!) but unfortunately that often results in a compromised barrier so I have been really focused on repairing my skin barrier which is what attracted me to this product since I know Ceramides can help substantially. The formula also has rice milk and my skin is typically very soothed and happy with rice derivative products!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely move anything and everything that is made by this brand. Seriously. Their ingredients are always top notch and the textures just work so well layered together with products from the same range or other brands. This moisturizer is of course no exception. It sinks right into my skin and is not too light and also not too heavy. A repurchase for sure, though it was gifted.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely move anything and everything that is made by this brand. Seriously. Their ingredients are always top notch and the textures just work so well layered together with products from the same range or other brands. This moisturizer is of course no exception. It sinks right into my skin and is not too light and also not too heavy. A repurchase for sure, though it was gifted.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I was recently gifted this product in exchange for my review. I do love this serum so far, it absorbs easily and looks great on the skin. I need to continue to keep using it to see long term results but I know my friends absolutely love it and have seen long term brightening effects.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I originally tried the previous jet lag mask because I was sold on the packaging and saw it all over the internet. It has essential oils and I think it did more harm than not so I basically stopped using it. I heard it was reformulated and tried it recently. While I still think it’s kind of expensive for what it is, this version is much nicer! I would recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I originally tried the previous jet lag mask because I was sold on the packaging and saw it all over the internet. It has essential oils and I think it did more harm than not so I basically stopped using it. I heard it was reformulated and tried it recently. While I still think it’s kind of expensive for what it is, this version is much nicer! I would recommend this.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely eye cream. The texture is very nice and it layers very well with makeup. I have only been using this for a few days so I can’t share any long term views but if you like this brand you will probably like the eye cream.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really love this product. It is super hydrating and definitely plumps my skin. I would say this is great for normal skin, and I will probably need an oil or something a tad heavier for the winter dryness! Overall an 8/10 for me!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really love this product. It is super hydrating and definitely plumps my skin. I would say this is great for normal skin, and I will probably need an oil or something a tad heavier for the winter dryness! Overall an 8/10 for me!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this product. It is a really hydrating face product to use in the winter and is perfect for prepping the skin for makeup. I typically don’t apply TOO many layers of makeup underneath this because it can pill depending on the products used. Plus this is hydrating enough for most days. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Classic product and an overall great primer. I don’t and wouldn’t use this as a part of my skincare routine but it does help prime the skin for makeup once everything is on. It is great for dry skin and I would recommend. But it is fragranced so if you’re sensitive to that then this is a skip.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: This is one of my all time favorite sunscreens. It is so nice under makeup as a primer or on its own during the day. It’s great for sensitive skin too and has the slightest tint which makes it perfecting on days where I don’t need a ton of coverage. Note that it is slightly pearlized so just keep that in mind, it won’t be matte (duh, it is called GLOW screen). Highly recommend!! 10/10.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received the product free for testing purposes from Influenster and Tatcha. It is a wonderful addition to my skincare routine. It leaves my skin feeling moisturized but does not leave any sticky residue or leave my skin feeling oily. I also love the ingredients it contains and that it has received the Sephora clean seal.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Sunday Riley gifted me their Good Genes Lactic Acid Treatment in exchange for my honest review. The packaging is absolutely beautiful and showcases the high product quality. I apply it after cleansing and toning my face and the milky texture goes on smoothly and soaks evenly into my skin. I love the light scent of lemongrass as well. The lactic acid is gentle on my skin and has not caused any dryness or flaking. I am excited to see the long term effects it has on evening my skin tone and texture.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: This product is so easy to use! I love that I can just open the tube and glide it on without having to use my hands. Most retinol products advise to keep away from the eye area so I love that this product is specifically formulated to be gentle enough in that area.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: These acne dots are so easy to apply and stay put during the night. They also do not hurt as I am pulling them off. I have found that they work great on pimples that have come to a “head” and I can see the gunk that was drawn out when I pull them off in the morning.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: These product area great quick solution to absorbing excess oil and shrinking pores. As many have shown in the photos, they are very satisying to pull off and see the gunk that came out. However, these are not a long term product to shrink pores and you are likley better off with an exfoliating toner or something for that.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: These patches are a good size and easy to use. I have not had any problems with being able to keep them only. I do think it is only a temporary fix to wrinkles though.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask

reviews.review_text: Ok.. so first off the following is not suggested by DE, Sephora or its affiliates. Lmfao. Seriously, I love this facial. I know the bottle says... use it no more than twice a week. BUT.... Ive had really good results using it every other day (combo/oily acne prone and 2 month old acne scars). I also use a Banisher with this once a week (microroller). The once a week, I wash, dry, banish, facial, wait, rinse, dry and apply vitamin c (lilyana naturals from Amazon, but now Im trial running DE vitamin C) and bend soap goat milk lotion. I have acne prone skin, and so far, baby facial hasnt broken me out and its lightening some new scars. When this bottle is up, I will definitely be restocking.

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_title: A little goes a long way
reviews.review_text: You only need a few drops. As someone with combo to oily skin who has tried using coconut oils, olive oils (read trying to make home scrubs and moisturizers), this oil is nice. It shouldnt break you out as it has antibacterial properties. I found it to absorb fast, add extra “moisture”, and my other DE products which may initially dry tacky (im looking at you vitamin c!), in about ten minutes it all sinks in and youre left with a glow. The mini was just right for me, Im only applying it on my face. :)

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I got a sample at sephora. The consistency wasnt a smooth cream like what Im used to seeing with other sunscreens, maybe it was the container sitting on their shelf for awhile. It went on best for me when I mixed it in my palm with DE C firma and B Hydra. I only experienced pilling when I tried to put it on without anything mixed.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Im in love with the Drunk Elephant line. It has done so much for my pores and reducing my hyper pigmentation from an acne breakout 2 months ago. I use this mixed in my palm with the vitamin C and b hydra in the am. At night I use the tlc mixed with this and I have had really great results. I was using another vitamin c and retinol prior to finding this line, but, I am not looking back. I have not broken out since using this line. Baby facial, B Hydra, C firma, TLC, Protini, marula oil, and lippe balm. Im combo and was a little nervous about applying oil to my face, but everything sinks in quickly and doesnt dry tacky.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I tried the Shaba for a month (for comparison to this). I liked the texture, didnt notice any changes, and if I applied before bed, it had a tendency of making its way into my eyes. C tango is thicker, and I can apply it day or night. It doesnt seep into my eyes at night. I did notice a little tingling/warmth when I first started using it, but its been doing well on my under-eye area. No redness or irritation and its been a week so far.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this for my under eye area. I got two trial bottles in my previous orders and I have been using it for my under eye area since. I have 3 lines in my under eye area on my left eye, and 2 lines on my right eye. I use it twice a day, and the lines are greatly diminished. Belif hydrates, doesnt smell overwhelming, and sits well under sunscreen. It is non irritating and absorbs quickly. As much as I love Drunk Elephant, this was perfect for the under eye and eye lid areas.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: My under eye area is super dry. This is the one cream that has done a great job of hydrating. I use it in the am under sunscreen as well as before bed.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: For the brief amount of time I have been using this eye cream, it seems good.  It has a thick, creamy texture which feels nourishing on my mature dry skin.  I use it under my eyes, on my lids, and apply any extra to my top lip line (getting plenty of wrinkles there that need attention!).  Since I haven’t been using it that long, I can’t speak to long term results such as a reduction of fine lines or softening of deeper wrinkles, but it isn’t irritating and does feel hydrating.  It has sort of a squeeze tube flat top plastic applicator, which could apply it directly from but I still prefer to squeeze a small amount onto my finger and apply it that way.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I have never met a Belif product I don’t like and this lip mask is no different.  Thick and hydrating with good lasting power.  It does everything I want a lip mask to do.  The only thing that could improve it is a squeeze tube or stick packaging - I’m kinda over applying lip products with my finger.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Primer for a dry skin gal that doesn’t use primer
reviews.review_text: Love love love!  I am not someone who generally, if ever, uses primers but this has totally changed my mind.  I have dry skin so this feels rich and hydrating while providing a great base for my makeup.  I noticed immediately that my usual tinted moisturizer felt much more “set” and less tacky than usual after applying it over the base.  Also, a little goes a long way so I think the 1.7oz jar will last a while.  It does have a fair amount of fragrance, which is bright and fresh, but I know for some that can be a problem.  As I mentioned before, I have dry skin but I wonder if this would be too rich for oily skin folks.  For me, this is a new must have!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for about a week and it is lovely!  The formula is super silky and smooth.  It absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave any film or tackiness.  I absolutely love the fragrance and even add a pump on to the back of my hands.  Since I haven’t been using it for very long I can’t speak to long term benefits but when I wake my skin is smooth and calm with no redness or irritation after layer the serum with moisturizer and facial oil.  Looking forward to continued use!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for about a week and it is lovely!  The formula is super silky and smooth.  It absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave any film or tackiness. reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: As someone with mature, dry skin that can get red and uneven I was so excited to try this overnight mask.  It has the classic Fresh “cucumber spa water” scent and a rich texture.  I would say it is sort of mid-weight, not too light but not super heavy and occlusive.  Really, it just feels so nice in my skin layered over my usual evening skincare.  In the morning my skin is smooth and soft!

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I am 43 with genetic dark circles so any eye cream that says it with brighten and de-puff is going to be in my wheelhouse.  This cream, gifted by Algenist, is very thick and rich in texture, but what I found interesting is how quickly it absorbed and dried down.  I have dry skin so I usually use very rich and emollient skincare that leaves some sort of residue but this cream seemed to just vanish.  It worked well under makeup and didn’t cause any irritation.  I can’t say that I have seen a drastic reduction in my dark circles but I am hopeful that with more time I might.  I would say that if you want a nice eye cream this is great but if you are looking for dramatic results I can’t say this cream will provide them.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin that can get more textured and combo during the summer.  I still need a lot of moisturizing though and this cream is it!  It manages to be rich but light, nourishing but easily absorbed.  For me it is a great summer moisturizer for day and night.  Just a smidge in the morning wears well under makeup.  I can go a little heavier at night.  During the winter I would probably layer this up with an oil to combat dry winter skin.  So glad I tried this!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have used several Fresh Sugar Lip balms and treatments over the years so was excited to try this shade Peony, gifted by Fresh.  In the past I have had trouble with the formula being too soft and mushy but the first thing I noticed with this lip treatment was that it is a little stiffer and firmer, which is a huge plus in my book.  The shade is a lovely, natural, buildable mauve rosy with a hint of brown.  I prefer it as just a slight wash of color - a perfect my lips but better - but you can build it up to a much deeper shade.  As I have aged my lips have lost pigment but this lip treatment brings them back to life!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_title: Beautiful serum in a beautiful bottle

Redness, texture, and uneven skin tone are issues that I look for skincare to address.  This lovely serum has worked great under my nighttime moisturizer and even as a morning moisturizer on its own on hot days.  I wake up with skin that is much smoother and has less texture.  It absorbs fast and works well under makeup.  Also, the bottle is gorgeous!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Glow Recipe, this moisturizer has made an incredible difference in my skin. My skin feels more bouncy and bright after using this moisturizer. It definitely helped with making my skin feel more hydrated and soothed as well. Since this moisturizer is so lightweight, it wore very well underneath makeup and worked well as a makeup primer. I liked the texture as it was very thin and easy to apply and also smelled delightfully of watermelon. I have a normal-combo skin type and it worked very well for me, I definitely can see girls with oilier skin loving this during summertime or layering this for winter!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_title: Love it for brightening the skin!
reviews.review_text: Like all of Glow Recipe’s products, their new Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Drops smell heavenly. Their products always smell like delicious candy and have beautiful packaging.Their new product claims to lighten hyperpigmentation due to the niacinamide ingredient. While I generally have issues with niacinamide breaking me out, this product luckily didn’t do that. I also appreciate that this product layers well under makeup, but you need to make sure that it’s completely dry before applying any primers or foundations. This product is mildly tacky so it will allow your products to adhere better as well.Overall, their product is fantastic and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to reduce their dark spots and brighten their skin for a more even and radiant complexion. reviews.review_text: It took me a while to become a believer everyone but I’m hooked! The hype is too real. These past 6 months I have been dedicated to acid exfoliation and have used so many overnight products and face masks that make the same claims as this product. The baby facial is the only one that gives the results. I got this product almost a year ago in a holiday set and used it every so often and never saw any outstanding difference that brought it into my routine. It’s so expensive that I was barely using any and that was my problem! No you do not need to slather a thick layer of this mask on for results- and I don’t recommend ever doing that esp with its potency. You need a thin layer that coats the face and leave it in for 20 mins (I usually do an hour because my skin is so accustomed to acids-don’t do this either!). Baby. Skin. OMG. Guys my skin was smooth, supple, and felt better than any mask I have ever used. This mask performs every time and produces amazing results without question. Get a sample and try it out. Give it a chance. The price tag is deep so wait for holiday sets if you can like I did :)

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_title: beautiful skin at an amazing price
reviews.review_text: I wrote a disappointed review on this product the day after my first use of it but I don’t know where that went, and I’m kinda glad about it. This product had a learning curve to it, but I’ve finally figured it out. I first used it after the Tarte Knockout Tingling toner which I saw had niacinamide in it and I wanted to use them together for whatever reason. First off, That toner is STRONG. When I put the niacinamide on after that, my skin flushed, burned, itched, and stung for hours. I put makeup on later in the day and had flaky red skin and Looked like I sat in the sun for wayyyy too long. GUYS BE SMART. I caution you to wait a while after using acids or acid toner before you put this on because it can irritate. Also don’t use vitamin c because it can cause flushing as well. So when I finally decided to give it another try, I used it sparingly and carefully. One day I put a small amount on and washed it after a few hours. Used it again the next day and left it in overnight with a good moisturizer. This serum is so beautiful! My skin is clearer, brighter, and not irritated or dry. I love it! I would say this is a nice middle of the road option. It’s thick but not heavy. It’s hydrating and nice to use.
