reviews.review_text: I love this new serum from follow recipe. I’ve been using it on days when I’m not using any actives on my skin and it’s so nourishing and calming. Feels light and sinks in easily which is great for the warmer weather coming up.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this mask by Herbivore botanicals in exchange for my honest review. New favorite exfoliating mask! My skin felt really dull lately and I thought I would try this mask out. Wow my skin was glowing after using this! Absolutely love it and it’s now a staple in my weekly mask routine.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Have been using this avocado serum or a week now. Isn’t this have the most beautiful packing? Perfect serum for summer use. It absorbed into the skin quickly and can immediately relief skin dehydration. Works great with other toner and moisture. Will definitely recommend this for everyone!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Received this Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer complimentary from Fresh!  Have been wear it every night since then. Love the rose smell, make you feel calm and floral. As it says, it’s a lightweight face cream, great product for the summer time. Apply it on your skin and keep it hydrate for up to 72 hours! I would recommend this one to everyone! Plus, it’s from Fresh!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: Better use it as sleeping mask!
reviews.review_text: Have been using this Jet Lag mask for a week.This is a washable mask and supposed to be washed then apply your routine skin care products.  I usually apply this mask after toner and serum, use it as a overnight mask. I’d recommend this method to everyone who bought this. You can feel your skin glowing the next day! Love this product!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: Better use it as sleeping mask!
reviews.review_text: Have been using this Jet Lag mask for a week.This is a washable mask and supposed to be washed then apply your routine skin care products.  I usually apply this mask after toner and serum, use it as a overnight mask. I’d recommend this method to everyone who bought this. You can feel your skin glowing the next day! Love this product!

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: Big fan of the Origins band! I love the mushroom collections. First time tried the Ginzing eye cream. Just take a little amount and warm it up then apply it around your eyes. Feel moisturizing and smoothing.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this daily microfoliant cleanser as a complimentary  from Dermalogica. I really love this powder texture cleanser. Scent free and rich foam. Feel really clean after using it. Would recommend it to oil and combination skin type.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this daily microfoliant cleanser as a complimentary  from Dermalogica. I really love this powder texture cleanser. Scent free and rich foam. Feel really clean after using it. Would recommend it to oil and combination skin type.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Received this squalane Marine Algae eye cream as gifted by Biossance. This one is more suitable for oil& combination skin type. Light and moisture, goes along well with other serum and creams. Would recommend this to sensitive skin type.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Sunday Riley of this C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum. A little bit pricy but I’m always a fan of this brand. I myself feels great about this vitamin c serum, always use it in the morning and after this, do a better sunscreen protection, hopefully it helps to brighten my skin tone.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I have used this Vinoperfect radiance serum for almost a month before I review! I have some dark spots under eye and on the checkbone. I used this serum 2 times a day and it can helps to brighten my skin tone and that’s all I expected. As for the dark spots, same as usual, probably I should give it longer time! Overall, I would recommend this serum to everyone as it can surely help make your skin brighter!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this T.L.C. Framboos glycolic Re surfacing night serum as a complimentary from Drunk Elephant. This is  An AHA/BHA night serum, I can clearly find myself skin getting smoother and minimizes pores after 2 weeks use. Love it! Would recommend it to my friends.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: It’s nice, smells good, but for the price you can find other options that moisturize just as well. For the cold Canadian winters that I live, it’s not THAT great. But it was nice trying it.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Holy, this stuff is good. I got a deluxe sample of it. It takes literally everything off even mascara! I use this followed by my philosophy cleanser and my face feels so clean. You only need a tiny bit of this stuff!!! Wow!! I’m impressed

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Holy, this stuff is good. I got a deluxe sample of it. It takes literally everything off even mascara! I use this followed by my philosophy cleanser and my face feels so clean. You only need a tiny bit of this stuff!!! Wow!! I’m impressed

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: The mask isn’t heavy and doesn’t smell bad, it makes your skin smooth and feels very clean after. It’s a little hard to wash off though

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I heard Great things about this so I tried it. Bought the grapefruit one. The scent is pleasant and not too strong so it’s not giving me a head ache. At first when u apply it it’s very thick and moisturizing, but when I wake up, it doesn’t do much for my lips... it’s a huge tub. Will last you FOREVER!!!! But I will not buy it again. Just use a chapstick for the same results.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I was sceptical about buying this for 3 months. After reading rave reviews and seeing so many people obsess over this mask, i bought it. It is very expensive. It’s thick and i feel like you need quite a bit to cover your whole face. It has a minty smell and tingles a tiny bit for 1 minute but goes away. It’s very creamy and feels soothing but after taking it off I didn’t notice much difference. It feel nice and luxurious but I wouldn’t repurchase it because I don’t see long lasting effects and it doesn’t moisturize my face to the fullest. Definitely not worth the 60$... but it was nice to give it a try.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I was sceptical about buying this for 3 months. After reading rave reviews and seeing so many people obsess over this mask, i bought it. It is very expensive. It’s thick and i feel like you need quite a bit to cover your whole face. It has a minty smell and tingles a tiny bit for 1 minute but goes away. It’s very creamy and feels soothing but after taking it off I didn’t notice much difference. It feel nice and luxurious but I wouldn’t repurchase it because I don’t see long lasting effects and it doesn’t moisturize my face to the fullest. Definitely not worth the 60$... but it was nice to give it a try.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: So I was very sceptical about this mask, when I put it on it burned so I thought my face was going to react terribly to this. But I read the instructions and it says it’s normal for it to burn because of the resurfacing. I left this mask on for 20 minutes. It has a herbal smell, I don’t love the smell but it’s ok I can get over it. The burning went away after 15 minutes. When I rinced with hot water, I WAS SO IMPRESSED! I NOTICED RESULTS RIGHT AWAY! Amazing glow, resurfaced skin and amazing texture. You need this mask! It’s a holy grail. A little goes a long way also!!!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: It cools down your skin and it’s a beautiful colour. Smells minty and fresh. It tingles a bit while it cools your skin. A little goes a long way. I didn’t notice too much of a difference in my pores but my skin felt clean and refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: amazing. but why the price jump????
reviews.review_text: This product does burn upon application but it gets better after about 10-20 minutes. It has a light lemon ginger grass scent and after application u can’t smell it so it goes away/ this product left my skin feeling so soft and smooth, it has improved my small bumps on my Forehead which I couldn’t get rid of with a physical exfoliator, so this definitely helped me a lot. I’m taking off one star simply because I purchased this when it was 64$ but I would not do it again because the price jumped by 13$, completely unexpected and unreasonable. I also see all the comments about the price jump being removed! Not cool.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This is honestly the best lip balm I have tried hands down. Wasn’t expecting much but it blew me away! It leaves my lips so soft and supple!!! So worth the price it doesn’t compare to anything else on this market. I went threw it sooo quickly cuz I love it so much !!!! Has a light scent nothing crazy or gross. Big applicator covers your whole lip! So good

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have the full size , I’m glad they finally came out with a travel siZe. Very gentle cleanser, helps to soothe skin and gets rid of makeup. Great smell too! Great size to get introduced to the brand and the cleanser

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have the full size , I’m glad they finally came out with a travel siZe. Very gentle cleanser, helps to soothe skin and gets rid of makeup. Great smell too! Great size to get introduced to the brand and the cleanser

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Silky, soft, luxurious and amazing smell. This face cream sinks right into my skin and provides moisture all day. I love this brand!!!

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: Hydrating, comforting , relieving! Such a good toned ! I totally recommend this beautiful product and it lasts so long guys

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: Love this mask I use it when I feel like my skin needs a deep clean, and it does the trick. It does leave my face feeling dry but that’s how it helps my pimples, and then I just use a good moisturizer after the mask to hydrate. There’s no smell to this mask after it dries down and it’s very soothing

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for a few weeks now and am impressed. It has a light scent that I think smells great and my skin tone is looking better than before. Defiantly will be keeping this in my anti-aging skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for a few weeks now and am impressed. It has a light scent that I think smells great and my skin tone is looking better than before. Defiantly will be keeping this in my anti-aging skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: Love this scrub and it smells great! It did a great job exfoliating my skin and I felt refreshed and smooth after every use! I have normal skin and didn’t find this scrub too harsh and didn’t leave me feeling dry like other face scrubs I have used. I received this product complimentary from Influenster and so glad I did!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Love that this moisturizer keeps my face moisturized and hydrated all day. I I use it after washing my face and using the Kiehl’s ferulic brew facial treatment essence. My face does look more smoother and looks more moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Love that this moisturizer keeps my face moisturized and hydrated all day. I I use it after washing my face and using the Kiehl’s ferulic brew facial treatment essence. My face does look more smoother and looks more moisturized.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product does what it promises: hydrates, resurfaces, softens and plumps skin! It is simple to use and add to your beauty routine. After using for a few weeks now my skin is looking more hydrated and radiant! I love that it is vegan, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging. I definitely recommend! I received this product complimentary for review purposes from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product does what it promises: hydrates, resurfaces, softens and plumps skin! It is simple to use and add to your beauty routine. After using for a few weeks now my skin is looking more hydrated and radiant! I love that it is vegan, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging. I definitely recommend! I received this product complimentary for review purposes from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this moisturizer and I really like it. It was easy to spread on my skin and absorbed easily. I has a light pleasant scent not overpowering at all. Works best if applied after the serum!

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this moisturizer and I really like it. It was easy to spread on my skin and absorbed easily. I has a light pleasant scent not overpowering at all. Works best if applied after the serum!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: Love that this serum is made with 21 plant extracts! It absorbed into my skin very easily and left my skin feeling great. It helped make my skin look firmer, smoother and more radiant.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream was easy to apply on my face and neck and absorbed right into my skin! It has a silky-cream texture and pleasant scent. It  leaves my skin hydrated all day and I love that it is free of sulfate and paraben. It is better than other face creams I have tried and will definitely be recommending this product and purchasing it for myself!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Love it! I use Tretanoin which can leave me with dry and sometimes flaky skin. I apply this at night after my Curology/Tretanoin, it takes 10/15 minutes to absorb into my skin. I wished it didn’t have fragrance but the smell is pleasant and it dissipates quickly. In the morning my skin feels very hydrated and soft. A little goes a long way, i use a lighter application before applying my makeup and find that it stops my foundation making any dryness look worse.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Awesome product. This is cranberry colored watery liquid. I find that 6 drops covers my entire face. I smooth a layer of this on my face once a week, I leave it on my skin for 15 minutes. This can give tingling or a mild burning sensation initially, be very careful if you have irritated, sensitive skin or use retinol. I rinse this off and my sling is always incredibly soft and glowing... I also believe this helps to keep my skin clear.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I purchased these strips on a bit of a “whim”- I’m surprised at how much I like them. They are quite expensive for what you get in the box. To use them on all the areas that I wanted to meant using 6 of the 8 strips in the box. They easily peel of the backing paper and apply securely to your skin. I left these on overnight on clean dry skin, I didn’t find them uncomfortable to wear. In the morning I gently peeled them off, there was clear circles of pale color on the strips. The white/pale “dots” did match up to where my more congested pores are. I was pleasantly surprised to look at my skin and see a definite, smoother look, to these congested areas.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_title: A good Re-Set for congested pores
reviews.review_text: Sometimes, my skin feels like it’s congested, oily and dirty- no matter what I do. This usually happens on vacation, loading up and reapplying sunscreen all day, then using heavy moisturizer at night. When I get that “icky” feel, this mask is the solution. The mask is a creamy, easy to apply, black cream that doesn’t seem to be fragranced. As it dries it does become tight and it can take an awful lot of washing off! Once washed off, skin does feel a little stripped but it definitely has a pore clearing effect and removes all trace of “ick”. I don’t use this mask often because it does seem a bit harsh but when I need a deep cleaning mask - this is the best.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: This is the only vitamin C product that my skin will tolerate. The texture of this is slightly gritty, I apply it in the morning before sunscreen, every other day. I have definitely noticed a brightening effect, the only negative is that gritty texture.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wanted to use a salicylic acid face wash but was struggling to find one, that wasn’t really harsh and drying. This face wash is a clear gel, I find you only need to use a small amount and it is very gentle. I use this every evening.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have fallen in love with this oil. I don’t use it to remove my makeup, it’s not the most effective at that. It’s great for breaking down my sun screen at the end of the day. You only need one pump of this clear oil, the bottle is huge and has a pump dispenser. So why do I love it? Well… the smell, I try to avoid fragrance but this smells amazing. I massage it into my skin for a couple of minutes and rinse. My skin instantly feels softer. I follow with the Tatcha rice scrub and then The Inkey List salicylic face wash. I resisted Tatcha products for a long time- sadly for my bank account- they are winning me over.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: This is another product I avoided due to the price tag, like the baby facial, I gave in and purchased for my Birthday. It’s a cloudy, extremely hydrating, gel type consistency in a pump bottle. A little goes a long way. This is a product that doesn’t remain greasy on the skin, it soaks in. It’s beautiful, I will buy this over and over again. I use it under my eyes and on my top lip, every night, I apply it to my entire face a couple of times a week. This product is especially great if you have any redness or surface dehydration.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I wanted to like this product as a cleanser but I don’t. The balm separated so there is always an oily liquid that comes out before the balm, shaking… if you remember, does help this. The balm is like an ointment consistency, it feels like you are applying diaper cream to your face. Makeup is melted away, particularly waterproof eye products but I found I had to use a cleansing cloth to remove everything. Skin is soft and this balm is gentle, it seems to be quite difficult to rinse off the skin. Unless I washed my face, at least twice, with another cleanser… this remained as a greasy layer. For extremely dry skin, I imagine this would be really loved. For me, I can’t stand the greasy feel, the oily separation and the residue feel.

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I wanted to like this product as a cleanser but I don’t. The balm separated so there is always an oily liquid that comes out before the balm, shaking… if you remember, does help this. The balm is like an ointment consistency, it feels like you are applying diaper cream to your face. For extremely dry skin, I imagine this would be really loved. For me, I can’t stand the greasy feel, the oily separation and the residue feel.

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I am on my 3rd tube of this, it is a light pink, slightly shimmery cream. You squeeze a small amount out into the metal applicator, this feels great to swipe on lids, upper lids and particularly under the eye. This isn’t incredibly hydrating but it absorbs quickly, definitely depuffs, feels cool and gives a subtle brightening effect. I have found that it improves application of concealer, I get a smoother application of my thicker more pigmented products.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I used my points to get a decent sized sample jar of this moisturizer, I was able to use it for a couple of weeks. Expectations were high because of the price point and the name “Magic Cream”. The first time a tried it, the scent was overwhelming, it was months before I decided to give it another go. I used this cream twice a day, I saw zero magic, I could smell it for hours after application. I’m not against fragrance entirely but this is similar to a perfume body lotion. This cream was hydrating and reminded me of Elf Holy Hydration products. After 20 minutes I still had an oily film on my skin and looked greasy, my skin felt greasy too. About 10 days in I started to break out on my cheeks and forehead, I used the rest of the little jar on my legs. I didn’t feel any magic from this overpriced, overly scented, very basic cream.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_title: Quite Gentle but Effective Glow Giver
reviews.review_text: This is a peachy colored, quite thick cream in a pump dispenser. I use this as a weekly mask, usually Friday night, because I don’t apply my Retin A at the weekend.  I apply a thin layer, usually 2 pumps, to my face and leave it on my skin for 10 to 20 minutes and rinse away thoroughly. I wash my face afterwards with a gentle cleanser. Sometimes it will give me a slight stingy/tingle for a minute but most of the time I feel nothing. This leaves my skin glowing, smooth and I feel as though I have better oil control for a few days after using. I do follow this mask with a very hydrating moisturizer and I only ever use it at night. This product doesn’t sting or redden my skin like other AHA BHA products but I do feel that it is effective. It’s expensive but lasts me an entire year, I always repurchase in the spring VIB sale.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I knocked one star off for the fragrance, it’s pleasant and not an overwhelming, lavender smell and it does dissipate after application. This is a thick, light purple colored, cream. I have repurchased twice now, I do really enjoy it, it is very hydrating and I have never experienced any negative side effects. This is actually one of the few heavier creams that I can use daily without breaking out. I avoided Tatcha products for the longest time, the price and reviews stating they weren’t great considering the price. There is something about them, they give a noticeable hydration and glow to the skin. I don’t need to apply much of this cream, the jar always lasts a very long time. I have been using Tatcha moisturizers and Drunk Elephant F Balm for almost a year now, I can honestly say that my skin has never looked better.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I didn’t know I needed this exfoliator in my life!!! I am always on the hunt for a great exfoliator that gently removes dead skin and oils that also does not irritate or over-dry my skin. It has been a shower staple since I got it and I am loving the results! My skin feels so smooth after and I have even caught my husband using it!!!*This was kindly gifted to me by the brand. Thank you!

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I didn’t know I needed this exfoliator in my life!!! I am always on the hunt for a great exfoliator that gently removes dead skin and oils that also does not irritate or over-dry my skin. It has been a shower staple since I got it and I am loving the results! My skin feels so smooth after and I have even caught my husband using it!!!*This was kindly gifted to me by the brand. Thank you!

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. Since I have a lot of time at home, I have been masking at least 4x a week! I was super excited to try this out as I have heard amazing things about this brand, especially this line. The mask left my skin super soft and feeling extra refreshed and cleansed. My pores looked clearer than before and it did not leave my face feeling tight or dry. Def recommend this mask! Loving it during quarantine :)

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. This is my first product I’ve tried from this brand. I love the light-weight texture of this gel-cream - perfect for the upcoming warmer months. This formula instantly absorbs into my skin, leaving a soft and plump complexion. I really enjoy this moisturizer and it will be a staple part of my skincare regimen this spring/summer!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. So far loving this moisturizer! Has a great consistency & quickly absorbs right into the skin! My skin feels plump & hydrated. Excited to use this as the fall & winter approach and my skin gets dry!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: First off, how adorable is this packaging?! I love trying out new kbeauty products and I am already a huge fan of this, so I am thankful for Glow Recipe for for gifting me this eye cream. Love the unique gel texture and how it absorbs right into the undereye area. Def a must try! *complimentary from Glow Recipe

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This was kindly gifted by Sunday Riley. I love testing out new serums and was very excited to try this hyped product as I have heard amazing things! While I have not noticed a huge difference in fine lines or wrinkles, my skin does look clear, texture has subsided some and my pores look minimal as well. Going to keep using this consistently, but first impressions, I am very pleased!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The fresh rose collection is my favorite so I had to try the new reformulated rose face cream! It is more rich and definitely more hydrating yet it still absorbs right into the skin. My skin feels plump, hydrated and silky soft after I use this!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: So impressed already with this eye cream. Used it for the past few nights in my PM routine and my undereye area already looks more bright & from. Doesn’t give me milia and absorbs right into the skin!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So impressed with this hyaluronic acid cream! Love using it especially in the dry cold winter months as it leaves my skin looking and feeling plump healthy and hydrated! Smells so good and absorbs right into the skin!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So impressed with this hyaluronic acid cream! Love using it especially in the dry cold winter months as it leaves my skin looking and feeling plump healthy and hydrated! Smells so good and absorbs right into the skin!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: A huge fan of fresh beauty so knew i was going to love this! Such a nice gentle mask that makes my skin feel so healthy, soft, smooth and hydrated. The perfect winter addition to my skincare routine as I suffer from redness and dryness!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I am a huge fan of these lip balms so was so excited to try this tinted balm! It leaves the prettiest tint to the lips perfect for everyday but most importantly hydrated and leaves my lips super soft and smooth! Gifted by fresh!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love fresh - one of my fav skincare brands! I knew I would love this serum. My skin drinks this right in and it leaves my skin feeling hydrated, firm and refreshed while making it look more youthful and plump. So good!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: I got this cream for free for testing purposes. This cream is so smooth & moisturizing. I used it to prep my makeup look. My makeup looks flawless and silky smooth. Im loving this cream so far.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_title: Nice thick cream for dry skin

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Save your money. Not worth the hype.
reviews.review_text: first off, this product has a strong fragrance and while that’s not necessarily a deal breaker for me, i prefer products that dont have one at all and thought that point would be helpful for some of you to be aware of. next, I wanted to love this. I was prepared to become a fan of all things tatcha. but the truth is, after doing a ton of research, the price point cannot be justified and it’s just overall an ok product but definitely not worth the money. there are tons of products out there to try so dont settle on this one. yes it felt great going on despite a slightly tacky residue it left behind but the moisturized feeling didn’t last nearly as long as several other moisturizers I’ve tried, such as the Lotus night cream, for instance. or Kiehls ultra. also, I don’t have sensitive skin but this caused my skin to fuss a bit- there was definitely an adjustment period that’s for sure. the other major detractor for me was how heavy this felt and how greasy it made me look and feel for hours on end. yuck. definitely does NOT play nice under makeup. made everything slide around and also seemed to interact with some of my products causing further irritation and the need to adjust my routine to accommodate it. ugh. more trouble than it’s worth in more ways than one. so your research on this product and the tatcha line in general to decide if its money you think will be well spent for you or not, dont just fall into the hype because this could very well be an expensive mistake.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: omg this stuff is a GAME CHANGER!!!!! I am in love! you dont understand how insanely easy and effective this product is and the price point for this mini size is just unreal in the best way too because you need SO little of this product to take off even the most stubborn of waterproof mascaras (hello, lash paradise,  I’m looking at you.) i was expecting a greasy film to be left behind but my face felt SO clean and refreshed when I easily rinsed this off. I was shocked honestly because I was expecting an experience similar to using coconut oil to remove makeup which I have historically done but I dont like the heavy and residual feeling that leaves behind thus why I looked into this product. while it does morph into a watery consistency when you rub it, there is zero sticky or residue feeling. somehow makes no mess either- mascara and foundation wasnt sliding all over and down my face or anything. it literally just lifted it and rinsed clean away! what is this magic?! this is probably one of my best finds in awhile. I’m always looking for ways to simplify my night routine while still achieving maximum efficiency and effectiveness,  and this fits the bill perfectly!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Why is this so expensive? it’s an okay face wash in that it has no smell and it leaves my skin feeling semi clean. however, it definitely does not live up to it’s own claims and is in no way justified to be the price that it is. as far as claiming to take off makeup LOL no, it doesnt do this. every time I wash my face I still get a ton of product and dirt left behind that my toner is able to finally fully remove. sometimes my pores look clean after using this and sometimes they dont, so not a consistent performer by any means. it definitely did zero for my combination skin-my skin was still just as dry and just as oily in the same respective areas after using an entire full size bottle of this product day and night as they were before I used it at all. not impressed overall. I’m glad I didnt pay for the full size I used (thanks boxycharm) save your cash, this isnt worth the hype or price.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: MEH. maybe my expectations were too high because their peat eye cream is my holy grail. so I was beyond excited to try this moisturizer.  until I actually tried it. it didn’t wow me you guys. not at all. it was just okay. a little less so considering that there are plenty of moisturizers out there that perform the same that are a lot cheaper. nothing stands out at all. i can definitely say their claim that this moisturizes for 26hrs is definitely not true. I dont have combo skin but this settled in quickly and within an hour my skin felt just as it did before putting it on- oily in my tzone and dry around the rest. plus side, there wasn’t really any scent. back to the drawing board!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: as always, the ordinary is anything but. this product has definitely helped my skin by keeping it blemish free and reducing oil in my tzone.  make sure you put this on after your acids but right before your moisturizer and only use a little- you’ll know if you use too much because it will become sticky if you do. great product and you can’t beat the price!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: this is no joke so handle with care! it really does work- can cause some flaking and dryness after use so follow up with a strong moisturizer. I use this once every other week and have seen improvement in my overall skin texture and complexion. another happy purchase from the ordinary!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: this is an awesome product! I quit using sun beds years ago and since I started using retinol about a year ago I now avoid the sun as much as possible too. I do like a nice bronzed glow though and don’t like self tanners as they are too much work in my humble opinion, so I was excited to give this a try. it definitely delivers a nice sun kissed appearance to my face which is exactly what I was hoping for! I mix a drop or two in with my last serum and then my moisturizer too. its super easy to apply, not heavy, no streaks and didn’t break me out either. this is also one of the more affordable products from this line so overall id definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was in need of a thick, unscented moisturizer that would not leave a heavy film behind nor feel greasy going on and this checked all the boxes! you need very little of this (you will know if you used to much because it will take a long time to sink in if you over apply.) I mix a little bit with two drops of rosehip seed oil at night and i wake up to skin thats still moisturized, balanced and soft. this did not break me out either which most heavy moisturizers do. since I began using this, I no longer have dry spots around my nose or corners of my mouth. very pleased and it doesnt break the bank either- cant beat that!

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: this is a fantastic quality retinol. I am in love with the smooth, silky texture of this product so much so that I genuinely look forward to using it. it contains some retinol boosting ingredients which I also can appreciate. i use this after my niacinamide serum and before my face oil+ moisturizer mix. there is no piling so it layers well. I always wake up glowing the morning after I use this; coincidence? I think not:) I love that you can purchase this in a mini size to.try it out- it’s totally worth it so if you’re on the fence. go.that route. I don’t have much to add about the serum it comes with-it’s refreshing when you first put it on but I don’t find that the hydration is deep nor lasting. it’s nothing spectacular so for that reason I wouldn’t repurchase that item alone. I will definitely be purchasing the large size of the retinol though!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: this does the job- it removes my stubborn waterproof mineral sunscreen I slather on throughout the day and it also takes off my waterproof mascara. the only cons here are that it has a medicinal scent (obviously this isn’t bad if you’re into that sort of thing) and that I feel I have to use a lot more of this to achieve the same results I get from my Clinique Take the Day Off. this is pricier than that one too. the other one is not scented either. so all around, this is a good product that does what it says it will do and rinses away clean, but in my opinion there are better products out there that do the same thing for less money.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m a huge fan of almost all the ordinary products, but this is definitely one of my top 3 from them! I love how quickly this sinks into the skin, how nourishing it feels- it has fantastic slip to it so a little goes a long way, and the price point! Who DOESN’T love the price point of this line, period? for this product in particular you get a lot of bang for your buck. my skin feels hydrated, bouncy, and more firm since I incorporated this into my routine (I typically use it both am and pm.) I have a pretty extensive skin care routine so another major plus of the buffet is ZERO piling, ever. i have used this in combination with a ton of other products and never had piling.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: this does the job- it removes my stubborn waterproof mineral sunscreen I slather on throughout the day and it also takes off my waterproof mascara. the only cons here are that it has a medicinal scent (obviously this isn’t bad if you’re into that sort of thing) and that I feel I have to use a lot more of this to achieve the same results I get from my Clinique Take the Day Off. this is pricier than that one too. the other one is not scented either. so all around, this is a good product that does what it says it will do and rinses away clean, but in my opinion there are better products out there that do the same thing for less money.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: feels great going on with no burn or anything but unfortunately this broke me out every time I used it. every.time. made zero difference in my skin otherwise too. it’s a shame because my aging skin was prepared to fall in love with this “cult favorite.“ on to the next product!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: feels great going on with no burn or anything but unfortunately this broke me out every time I used it. every.time. made zero difference in my skin otherwise too. it’s a shame because my aging skin was prepared to fall in love with this “cult favorite.“ on to the next product!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: GIRL U BETTA BUY THIS OR ELSE
reviews.review_text: This lip mask tops all, especially for the price, the amount of product, the low key delicious smell, the fact that it stays on ALL night long and you wake up to lucious lips. If you use a lot of lip products and lip scrubs this is your saving grace.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: The ultimate treat yourself for the face.
reviews.review_text: I will live and die by this product. I started off with the lip mask because my lips were super crusty and I needed immediate ambulance for my lips, the original bubblegum flavor is yummy and sexy yet still subtle. Not like a dentist bubblegum. The vanilla I just got and it’s even more subtle. You can smell the vanilla buttercream but once it’s on your lips you can’t taste it and can’t smell it. If you’re someone who prefers the more subtle and fragrance free this will be your bestie. There is an aroma of vanilla but it dissipates when applied. I have a ton left in the original which I purchased a few months ago and I have a brand new one, one of these would probably last me a half a year if not more and two of these were for sure last me the entire year. Are used to not give too much skin care when it came to my lips but after I picked up the bubblegum product I noticed over a few days to weeks that my lips were absolutely plump and healthy and without any product on them they were healthy and plump and not cranky or dry or needing something to be on them. I don’t know what kind of magic is in the Laneige lip masks, But they truly do work magic to reviving deadlifts. I love both flavors equally I think they both serve a different purpose, one is tasty and sexy and the other is subtle and sweet. Both make your lips look glossy, and I believe this brand has lip glosses which I’ll definitely try because the formula is so good it’s ridiculous. A forever buy.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This comes out of the bottle like a whipped cream, not liquidy, not creamy thick, but in between. No real fragrance that is strong or off putting, smells like skincare. The actual product itself goes onto the skin like a subtle sunblock would, very easily glides over skin so there’s no tugging or immediate absorption into the skin, so you’re able to work it into all areas of the face, not hard to blend it into skin to remove residue. After applying this and another product from this brand my skin feels like the best, most smooth, non-tacky, non-oily, but very dewy protected and plump. For $<7 I will definitely be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum spreads easy all over the face and sinks in without fully absorbing into nothing, it leaves a dewy tacky texture, great for morning wakeup skin routine. Love it.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I wear natural makeup everyday: blush/bronzer, highlighter, no foundation. And I always have trouble blending my cheek products even with moisturized surface. This is a yellow tinted product, it is incredibly smoothing and hydrating, putting this on the back of your hand you can really feel how plump this product makes your skin feel. I let it sink into skin for a minute or two, and apply blush and it allows for a seamless application / blend (In the words of John Maclean). This has made all my expensive cheek products look even more gorgeous and flawless and natural on the primed skin. It only takes a small small amount to smooth on the skin. I bought the largest size, but honestly the small size would last you a month or more so I might opt for that next time. Overall this is a great skincare and makeup enhancing product.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_title: The Best Cleanser On The Market
reviews.review_text: I have never used a cleanser that didn’t dry out my skin, I have tried far and wide in hopes that it would 1) remove my makeup, 2) not cause my skin to dry, 3) not cause my skin to become red, flakey or tug and 4) burn my eyes. This is the first product I’ve tried from the brand, I stopped at the little section and decided to take a chance. I’m so happy I did. It’s affordable, takes off all my makeup, makes my skin baby smooth, does not leave it super dry, tuggy or red. 5 oz will last me months! My holy grail cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Con’s:The applicator is small, so dispersing product takes a minute and the way it applies feels odd.If you don’t like fruity fragrance or fragrance in general SKIP. The flavors are potent tasting, they’re subtle in smell. If you lick your lips you will be tasting the flavor.Pro’s: Laneige is one of my favorite brands for lip treatments. This is a wearable gloss for work/overnight with a good staying power.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I saw this on the Sephora app and went in store to test the 4 different scents of this lip balm. When I tell you I opened up the Lemon tin, and was immediately put back in middle school with the Lemon Girls Scout Cookies / homemade Lemon Vanilla Cookies scent and taste... I immediately grabbed two. Out of all the scents this was the absolute best, followed by the Caramel (which kind of smells like a less potent version of this balm). To compare, the texture of this product feels like a less thick Laneige Lip Mask, and a bit tackier than the Jouer Lip Balm. It’s a perfect lip mask to use over night or around the house because it’s super hydrating and rather than staying on top of the lips it also sinks in, so your fine lines or cracked lips are smooth to the touch. But I probably won’t take this outside because you need to dig your finger in the product. Honestly between the Fresh Face Mist and this Lemon Lip Balm, Fresh is my favorite brand. It feels good, smells amazing, product works wonderfully, it’s a brand that I know has my back!

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Every eye cream out there is like $50 for .1oz, this on the other hand is $10 and has a ton of product. It applies so smooth and creamy to the eyes. Has no smell, no real trace of caffeine. I have noticed a huge difference in my eyes in the morning. I use this AM/PM, to reduce the puffiness and unequal-ness of my eyes when I wake up (one puffy and the other not), and it works amazing! I’ve also noticed my dark circles under my eyes not appear as grey or deep. The skin looks fresh and tight compared to when I used no eye cream at all. Definitely repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Pros: Gorgeous packaging Sticky yet thin, not globbyCon’s:Super hard to open the tiny packaging, I had to stop closing it tight because I couldn’t get it back open.The product is quite expensive for so little of product in comparison to other lip masks.The actual formula is nice, but it does not last all night. I woke up with the product totally gone with dry lips. The formula is like a sticky gel that smooths quickly and is very shiny, and if it had long lasting power it would make a great daytime lip shine as well as night, but unfortunately it only lasts for like an hour before my lips feel dry with sticky residue.I wanted to love this lip mask as it is new and from a high end brand, but I think the Laneige lip mask is much better due to price, larger amount and the fact it stays on all night. Also, Glossier’s balm lasts all night on my lips, so I will be returning this item. I wanted it to work and it’s so cute and the formula is so silky, but it is not the best and it’s price and size is claiming that it is.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical of purchasing this product, so many differing reviews of it causing breakouts, stinging, not for sensitive skin - and the other side saying it’s a holy grail skincare product. So, I decided it was time to see for myself! My skin type: Oily, rosacea cheeks, enlarged pores and blackheads, light skin tone w/ uneven texture. Basically my cheeks and nose have the largest pores and blackheads and rosacea. Review: None of my physical exfoliators have accomplished what one use of the ordinary peeling solution has done. I left it on for five minutes, less than the standard time, just to test how it would interact with my skin and barely felt a tingle on my face from this formula. When I washed it off my scratchy blackhead prone skin felt smoother than my shaved legs. My pores went from a 5 to a 2 in terms of visibility. My skin was not stripped, and it was smoother than butter. It is just enough to remove the imperfections from the surface layer without coming close to damaging your skin. Out of all the skincare I’ve ever owned, this product showed instant, immediate, visible results. My nose and cheeks do not have the same uneven and scratchy texture as before, my pores and blackheads have exited the building and I’m living my truth. However, I did hear that this product might not be suitable for those with medium to deep skin tones which could affect melanin differently so please research! Hope this helps.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I purchased this moisturizer at the beginning of the winter and the primary reason was to have a moisturizer that wasn’t oily or greasy. In that regard it is moisturizing enough and completely absorbs into the skin with only the subtlest tack left over, barely noticeable to the touch. I think I purchased this moisturizer at the wrong time because I can totally see myself using this in the summertime when I don’t want the grease on my face and I want just enough moisture but my needs for the winter are pretty hefty so this did not do much for me to protect my skin from the cold/dry elements. This is what I would call a light weight night cream, which I paired with other skincare products but it did leave my skin needing more moisture barrier. So I do recommend this to those that are oily and might want to use this during the day, it dries down smooth and absorbs quick so this could also be a great base for makeup, as well as a summer time night cream. But if you’re looking for a deep penetrating moisturizer I would keep looking.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My experience with moisturizers have been truly a rollercoaster ride over my lifetime, with many needs fluctuating with the the seasons and budget, but this moisturizer right here y’all... Butter. The packaging - I never knew how much I needed a magnetic lid - not for the purposes of closing the product but of the steel spoon that comes with it to stick to the top lid that way it never goes missing and picking up product is simplified, life changer. The packaging aside (which I love it’s minimal woodsy vibe) is the formula, which I’m still not done processing how much I love it. I use a good pinkie’s worth every night, at first I wanted to test the dry down without other products and results are that it fully absorbs, you can’t see any product on your pillow or even finger if you rub your face, it might feel the slightest bit tacky but it just feels like your skin is hydrated and is still transferproof (which for someone like me with a love of sateen and silk is a must). My skin is rosacea prone, light to medium, and can be super dry and tight in the winter. I noticed that this not only fully absorbed but also calmed my red-orange spots and fine lines over time. Obviously it’s not a cure for those issues but if it’s soothing the agitation and inflammatory flush, it’s doing it’s job. The smell is like a subtle aged honey, not my fave but not at all a deterrence from daily use. I purchased this a month back and I suspect have a few weeks left before I need a repurchase, which could cost you a good couple hundred per year (I’d wait for the sales season to bundle up) but definitely mid range affordable and best of all EFFECTIVE for dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: My friend put me on to this product claiming they’ve used it forever and enjoy it so I wanted to explore different SPF’s to see if something was better than my tried and true SuperGoop. I’ve used this for a month or so and I don’t love it or hate it but I don’t think I’d ever repurchase. The scent alone is enough to make you totally dislike putting on SPF in the morning, it’s every bad scented SPF that you could imagine. It’s chemically, it’s pungent, and feels like you’re smearing an incredibly oily chlorine scented SPF on your face. I don’t know if this is an effective SPF comparatively with other brands, I do think it works well under makeup. Sometimes other SPF’s are patchy or leave uneven residue on top of the skin but with this its pretty evenly coated once on the face so that’s a plus, but depending on the powder you use over it, the powder might not be strong enough to mattify the sheer dew of this SPF. I thought my SuperGoop SPF was dewy on the skin but this is twice the dew and it never dries down or gets less dewy, and it also can burn if you sweat and the sweat gets in your eyes. For this reason I get my use out of this for daytime errands, but never apply before working out unless I want to suffer. Do not recommend.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The texture reminds me of the Cremo shaving cream at the drug store, it’s got no fragrance, easily spreads across the face, easy to use application and accessible price point and succeeds at cleansing foundation but fails to be that all-in-one cleanser that can take off mascara (waterproof or non-waterproof). I use minimal foundation and powder so I’m not sure this would be able to take off all foundations and powders, it’s pretty lightweight - the needs I have for a cleanser aside from mascara removal, which is a bonus for my needs. If you’re someone whose looking for a strong cleanser to take off thicker foundation/layers I suggest other cleansers, definitely won’t take off mascara but a staple for every day cleansing if you don’t wear makeup as it cleanses but doesn’t strip the skin at all + the price + size + ingredients, it meets the standards of a cleanser but doesn’t go above and beyond. Hope this helps.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I have passed by this cleansing balm for a year and have been skeptical due to balms not being my favorite method of removing makeup. However, I used this last night to take off my mascara and it was absolutely positively glorious, the way it glides over mascara is a gift I will cherish every night. Like butter my hardened mascara with a dash of water flew off, and after looking in the mirror for any left over clumps there was nothing to be found. Don’t sleep on this brand because the honey moisturizer is a knock out too! The only slight downside is for those with sensitive skin to elements like fragrance as this line is moderately perfumed. For my skin it’s not a problem. 9/10

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I have passed by this cleansing balm for a year and have been skeptical due to balms not being my favorite method of removing makeup. reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I understand why certain beauty & skincare products are cherished for decades, this is one of those for me. I was expecting little outcome when I purchased this years ago because of the price and the brand and the fragrance. But I’ll be the first to say that this is a glove of moisture before you actually apply moisturizer. It sinks into the skin quickly, plumps it up and makes your skin feel less tight and dry all season long. This is probably my 4th jumbo because 2 of them lasts me all year long whether it’s applying both day and night - don’t be fooled, this stuff lasts and lasts! 10/10

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I think this is my favorite SPF I’ve tried from Sephora or Ulta because it sinks into the skin so quickly and doesn’t have a white cast or heavy grease. However, I can easily use up an entire 1.69oz in 2 weeks over the summer or 1 month over the winter, which if you calculate is a loooot of money in comparison to other brands that have more oz per $. Still, I just find myself thinking it’s cheaper on immediate purchase and get looped in again. I still recommend !

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: For a year I’ve been into Lancôme’s pink toner - it made my skin feel refreshed without leaving residue which I like. However, I finally decided to give this toner a try and there’s no going back. This has moisturized my face more in a few uses than the year of using Lancôme’s toner. It has this beauty milky formula that smooths over the skin and leaves a slight layer of moisture that is not sticky but slightly tacky, which I love. My skin doesn’t just feel damp or dewy but after a day of heavy makeup and makeup cleanser my skin was so happy with my decision. It’s the next day and wow, hydration I never knew a toner could provide. This is a fraction of the cost of my jumbo toner, with ultra hydration and minimal fragrance, I understand now why TikTok skincare experts love this product. I will say it smells like horchata, I’m obsessed with it but if you’re sensitive to any fragrance this might not be it for you. I can’t keep swiping my soft cheeks, highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: I love the clear version, I buy like 5 at a time so I’m never without, it’s not the longest lasting but it does the job for at least 2 hours at a time. The pink version is a mid tone pink, not milky sheer but not fuscia bright. Paired with a deep lip liner and/or lip tint your lips will look irresistible . I was asked if I got lip filler done and all I had changed in my lip combo was the gloss - same liner. I hope they come out with a sheer milky pink gloss in the future!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample. I have sensitive skin and easily breaks out. I haven’t had any reactions and it felt so good on my skin. It is a clean product which I love! The packaging is amazing! I wish that every cream has this kind of packaging. It is worth trying out this product. Recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample. I have sensitive skin and easily breaks out. I haven’t had any reactions and it felt so good on my skin. It is a clean product which I love! The packaging is amazing! I wish that every cream has this kind of packaging. It is worth trying out this product. Recommend!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I have used this product for several days and so far I love it. It feels great on my skin and doesn’t irritate it. The applicator is amazing. I don’t use my fingers at all. Also, the applicator gives a cooling effect which I really love!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream is lightweight and absorbs quickly. A little goes a long way so it will last months. It does plump up the face a bit which I love.  If you’re looking for a thicker cream then this is not for you. My skin feels moisturized and light and I really like it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream is lightweight and absorbs quickly. A little goes a long way so it will last months. It does plump up the face a bit which I love.  If you’re looking for a thicker cream then this is not for you. My skin feels moisturized and light and I really like it.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really like the texture of this product. It goes on smoothly and little goes a long way.  The smell is subtle and really nice. My make up looked great all day. I have combination skin and it works great for me.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I used this mask for a few nights and I’m really happy with the results. It goes on smoothly and have very subtle scent. Feels really great on my skin. In the morning I noticed less redness and my skin was youthful and vibrant.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_title: Perfect natural looking tan and glow
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love that you can adjust how much tan you want. You don’t have to buy multiple tanning products. I use 1-2 drops twice a week but during the summer I will probably use 4 drops. It gives the best natural looking tan. I love when I wake up refreshed.:)Complimentary from Isle of Paradise, my review is honest.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this product for 5 days and so far I love it. I use it in the shower every night. I find that the easiest way to do it because it is the powder form that you need to activate with water. Sometimes that can be messy above my sink. It made my skin look and feel much smoother. Great for sensitive skin. I would prefer is the smell was a little bit different but not a big issue. Love it!complimentary from Dermalogica Sampling. - honest review
