reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: This might be my favorite Algenist product! It shows instant results! I used it for 7 days so far and I love it. It doesn’t irritate my skin at all. I use it at night and apply moisturizer after. Awesome!Gifted by Algenist - my review is honest

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: i use this daily - efficient dispenser too - i will be repurchasing

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the TLC Framboos, it gives the effect of tightness on my skin without feeling too tight.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: love how this feels and it definitely helps my skin !

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: this feels great and doesn’t react with my sensitive skin

reviews.product_name: Mini Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: i love this toner, it feels so natural and fresh on your skin and it smells so good. always makes me feel refreshed

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Works somewhat. I typically put this on prior to bed and wake up with my lips still dry. going to still give it a shot

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this product from Fresh within the Holiday Gift Set. I loved the beautiful, elegant packaging. The toner itself has a very pleasant smell, and is gentle enough for sensitive skin in the winter. The potpourri in the bottle is a nice touch too!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum has a wonderful texture and sinks into my skin very quickly. It layers well under moisturizer and the product size is generous. I’m sure this will last me several months. I can’t comment on the efficacy of the anti-aging properties, as it will have long-term effects, but the ingredients seem solid and I’m excited to see how it works!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is the PERFECT winter base for makeup. It feels really moisturizing and gives me a super smooth finish for my foundation. I love that it’s not greasy at all and the light scent is really pretty and fresh. Bonus points as always to Bobbi Brown for the pretty packaging! Looks so cute on my beauty shelf.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is such a luxurious upgrade to my morning routine! The hyaluronic acid makes it a perfect choice for winter and early spring when my skin tends to get dry and can flake under my makeup if not prepped properly. This would be an amazing Mother’s Day gift if you’re looking to really spoil the mother figure in your life!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: This super cute little bottle houses a classic sunscreen with a fun twist. The texture is the more “classic” sunscreen feel. It’s an opaque cream with a medium weight consistency. I love the smell of it and the fun twist of having niacinimide! I think this will have positive long term results on my complexion and I like that it doesn’t leave a white cast on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This feels light on my face and as always with Fresh products smells amazing. There’s no other brand that makes me feel like I’m in a spa than Fresh! I love that this serum adds a little bit of glow and plump to my skin before my morning makeup. It feels so luxe!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this produce for free and I like the difference it has made. It’s not a sticky feeling, and the smell isn’t so powerful but has a great light scent to it

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this produce for free and I like the difference it has made. It’s not a sticky feeling, and the smell isn’t so powerful but has a great light scent to it

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I really liked this mask! It was a bit skeptical that it could possibly burn when applied but I only got a tingle in my T zone area. Its definitely good to try out if your lookinh for a glow

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I really liked this mask! It was a bit skeptical that it could possibly burn when applied but I only got a tingle in my T zone area. Its definitely good to try out if your lookinh for a glow

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: This product is definitely a 5 star. After just 4 days I saw a great transformation on my skin, from brightness,  less redness, my dark spots were starting to fade away. If you have the cash I would definitely recommend this product

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved this moisturizer! It made me skin feel so refreshing. I have combination skin and it never made me face oily or dry! I would definitely recommend it

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: It was very moisturizing! I have combo skin qnd it never left me only or dry. Was really refreshing when applied! Love it

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Not the same; bottle needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: I first tied this cleanser when I bought the travel/ mini size and I loved it.  Made my skin brighter and I think it improved the overall quality of my skin.  After I got another bottle of the same cleanser, I didn’t notice the same results I had when I first purchased it.  Could it be that I had a different formula??  I’m not happy with the bottle dispenser, very hard to get the last of the product from the bottle.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I received a deluxe sample of this product and so far it’s working well.  The sugar particles dissolve in warm water as you wash your face so it’s not very abrasive.  It doesn’t seem to dry out my face, it does make it look smoother and brighter.  Will purchase the full size.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I was excited to see that Tatcha came out with a new lip balm, as I never got the chance to try the older version that was discontinued.  Unfortunately after trying it for a few days I had to return it as it didn’t do anything for me.  It was not moisturizing at all, it had the same effect as my drug mart lip balm.  Sorry to say but this product is not worth it.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: A very nice lip balm, leaves lips soft and smooth.  I’ve tried other popular lip balms, such as Tatcha lip mask and Clinique Moisture Surge, and I have to say this one works much better and is worth the price.  I took off one star because I wish it came in a tube.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Greasy balm that leaves an oily residue.  Definitely need to follow up with another cleanser.  Doesn’t have a nice smell to it.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m a fan of this brand and this cream.  It makes my skin brighter and plump.  One thing that I’m not crazy about is its consistency, it is very greasy.  I have to use blotting papers to remove excess oil and shine shortly after application.  I would definitely recommend this cream, I just wish Algenist would come up with a lighter version of this cream.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It’s a nice moisturizer, lightweight and hydrating but overpriced.  When I opened the container I saw that it was not full, it was quite noticeable.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: It’s a nice moisturizer, lightweight and hydrating but overpriced.  When I opened the container I saw that it was not full, it was quite noticeable.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a lightweight cream that moisturizes really well.  It’s not greasy or oily, it makes skin glowy and plump.  The scent is simply divine.  Within minutes after application, my  face looked even toned and fresh.  I have normal/combination skin (combination in the summer) and it is not too heavy for me.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this moisturizer for two summer years now.  It is lightweight, absorbs fast and doesn’t leave any oily residue.  I gave it four stars because I don’t feel  any effect of the hyaluronic acid.  It’s best for oily/combination skin.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I have normal/combination skin, depending on the time of year.  In the summer my skin gets more oily, I end up having blackheads on my chin area and larger pores.  Can’t say this serum had any effect, it made my skin look “thin” and dehydrated.  I would recommend this serum to anyone with a normal skin type and who is not sensitive to these peeling acids.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Not sure what happened but whatever I received did not look like the normal YTTP Adaptogen cream.  The color of the cream was light brown, like dulce de leche, and it was smeared at the bottom of the small container.  It was unopened so I returned it.  I’ve had the larger, 50 ml cream, before so I know what it should look like.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Not sure what happened but whatever I received did not look like the normal YTTP Adaptogen cream.  The color of the cream was light brown, like dulce de leche, and it was smeared at the bottom of the small container.  It was unopened so I returned it.  I’ve had the larger, 50 ml cream, before so I know what it should look like.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I love Fresh masks but sadly this one didn’t do anything.  In fact it made my skin even more red and irritated.  It is a rich in texture and has a nice scent, however, it made my face all shiny and puffy in the morning.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum has a thicker texture, it’s more like a lotion, and it does leave my skin a bit shiny and gives that greasy feeling after an application.  After it absorbs, it does even out my skin tone, and I can see quite a difference.

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: Works well but smells too strong with a fake citrus/orangey smell.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: Works well but smells too strong with a fake citrus/orangey smell.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Although I have tried and loved at least 70% of drunk elephant products, for some reason this did not agree with me and after 5 days of use I had little tiny whiteheads all over my face so I’ll be returning it.  Lala retro cream however I’ve been using for 2 years and is fantastic!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I use this occasionally, perhaps twice a week, and a thin layer to my entire face and neck has been excellent for exfoliating and working on live acne as well as removing old acne scars. I thoroughly recommend this and will continue to buy (better them good genes!)

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love almost all of the DE products including this. Great price point. Love the little bottle of exfoliator! You only need a tiny sprinkle.I like to use a selection of cleansers (my usual is SR Ceramic Slip) but this is a nice treat every few days. Really does metamorphise from a creamy balm to a milk! Be sure to rinse well with warm water to remove all cleanser if you have acne prone skin like me. I use a cloth just to be sure and have never had any problems or breakouts. LOVE that DE is fragrance free.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: This serum stick is wonderful! I mainly use it for post-acne area when the skin is still flakey and uneven. This does not block pores or cause greasiness or more acne. It also helps me not to mess with my face as it moisturizes imperfections and healing skin. I tried this as “The Skincare Edit“ kept on recommending it, and yet again, she was right! Scentless and also looks cute! should last a long time as it is expensive though!

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: i usually hate masks and masking (often a total waste of time) but this one is such good value and really takes down the redness and grease associated with hornonal acne skin. don’t leave it on too long, it doesn’t need to dry on your face. i find warm water and a black face halo the best way to remove this. be careful of scrubbing too much as the walnut particles could possibly cause micro-tears in the skin, so be gentle. really has helped with my acne.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love the brand so I was very excited to try this out. It is pricey but a little goes a long way and the packaging feels very high end with its weighted container and little spoon. I do think it is very good at moisturizing and I did notice the difference in the morning after applying. You will have to use consistently for several weeks to see results but I did notice slight smoothing over time with the product. I like that it is not greasy and does not leave residue behind but instead absorbs well Into the skin.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Good Genes was gifted by Sunday Riley to me. I have noticed that my skin texture appears smoother when using this product. If you have not used a similar acid on your face be sure to follow instructions about easing into it. The product is very strong and can burn on sensitive skin. I am currently using it in the mornings several days a week for next results and noticed my pores looking smaller. I also love the subtle glow it gives my skin for the day.

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Paula’s Choice. This was my first product from them and the one I have heard the most about! I suffer from really bad blackheads on my nose area and I was hoping this would help. I like that compared to other chemical exfoliators this did not leave my skin feeling irritated. It actually felt very smooth. I have been using it every other day for about a week and have seen slight progress in reduction of pore size that I hope continues.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by La Mer. I want to note that you really need to follow the instructions to get the best out of this product. They note a little goes a long way which is very true! It is expensive but since you do not need much it will last a long time. Also, make sure to warm up the product between your fingers to make sure it is at its prime consistency when you apply. I hate when products leave my skin oily after applying but this absorbs in so nicely.  I love the glow it gives me for no makeup days. I have dry skin and this definitely provides enough daily moisture. Worth the splurge.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by La Mer. I want to note that you really need to follow the instructions to get the best out of this product. They note a little goes a long way which is very true! It is expensive but since you do not need much it will last a long time. Also, make sure to warm up the product between your fingers to make sure it is at its prime consistency when you apply. I hate when products leave my skin oily after applying but this absorbs in so nicely.  I love the glow it gives me for no makeup days. I have dry skin and this definitely provides enough daily moisture. Worth the splurge.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Dermalogica. This is a unique product I have not tried a powder exfoliant before. I love how gentle it is for a chemical exfoliant. My skin did not feel irritated and definitely much smoother after use. The only downside is that it is slightly messy to use and you have to be careful to not get any of the beads in your eyes when you are rinsing this off.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Dermalogica. This is a unique product I have not tried a powder exfoliant before. I love how gentle it is for a chemical exfoliant. My skin did not feel irritated and definitely much smoother after use. The only downside is that it is slightly messy to use and you have to be careful to not get any of the beads in your eyes when you are rinsing this off.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I received the berry flavor of this amazing lip balm . I absolutely love this formula, it’s so smooth on my lips and the way it smells, oh my goodness. I love it, makes my lips so hydrated and it lasts a really long time. I would love to try all the flavors. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I used it for 3 days and honestly I’ve noticed such improvement in my skin. My face looks more moisturized and youthful. The only small thing I don’t like is the stickiness. Wish it was more silky than sticky. Over all it’s a great product

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I think this is a good product but not for the price. It doesn’t work better than a regular chapstick or other lip masks I used.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product is so amazing, been using it for a couple of weeks now and my skin looks so good. I am repurchasing as soon as it’s back in stock. My favorite skin care product from now on

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product is so amazing, been using it for a couple of weeks now and my skin looks so good. I am repurchasing as soon as it’s back in stock. My favorite skin care product from now on

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Honestly one of the best sunscreens I’ve ever tried. It goes so smooth on my skin no greasy feeling. protects my skin very well from the sun. Definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen, goes on smooth and gives no greasy feeling.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a great everyday moisturizer. However, if you have dry skin or live in a dry climate, this may not be the one for you. I can use this in the summer time, but come every other season, I need lala retro. Both are good paired up with the light blue moisture serum and the vitamin C serum.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This has become my absolute favorite daytime moisturizer. I have dry/combo skin, nw Ohio weather. In the winter I will add the moisture serum to it, but overall perfect.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this cream. It is a tried and true amazing moisture bomb. My skin is so radiant in the morning. I love to pair it with Sunday Riley’s A+ serum.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this cream. It is a tried and true amazing moisture bomb. My skin is so radiant in the morning. I love to pair it with Sunday Riley’s A+ serum.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I use this mask every Sunday. It’s become an absolute staple in my skin care routine. Helps keep breakouts at bay and my skin is the softest/smoothest it’s ever been. Absolutely recommend 10/10

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: So, it’s a bit different. It’s thick for a micellar water, like a milky cream. It does a great job removing all my makeup, but I have for sure struggled with the consistency of it.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: So, it’s a bit different. It’s thick for a micellar water, like a milky cream. It does a great job removing all my makeup, but I have for sure struggled with the consistency of it.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this moisturizer for about two years now. It’s my go to night cream and works amazingly well paired with a retinol.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This definitely helps to break down your makeup, however, it leaves an oily residue so you HAVE to double cleanse to get it all off. I don’t love it or hate it, and am kind of surprised it gets so much praise.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I got the mini trial size and I love it so much I’m buying the full size! It’s hard to find a face oil that isn’t too oily/heavy. I have oily and acne prone skin, but it’s also dehydrated and this rocks! I actually use a tiny bit in the mornings under my makeup and my makeup goes on beautifully and has helped with flakiness.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This is magic in a bottle! I don’t generally like scents in my skincare products but yowwwwwza this smells so good. I’m convinced this is the product that makes my skin so juicy and bouncy looking. I just love it!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a solid eye cream. Nice and emollient. Hard to tell if it’s making a difference so far, but non irritating and no complaints. I wear this at night with the rest of my evening skincare.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my go to night time moisturizer! I’ve tried so many but this one takes the cake. It checks all the boxes. It feels like velvet. It smells divine without being irritating or “scented.” It comes with a spatula so you don’t have to dig your grubby little fingers in it. The packaging feels lux and is recyclable. I don’t think I’ll ever need to try another moisturizer. The price point is a little higher than some others but you get more product.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: Okay this is a NICE cream, but for me, it’s too heavy/thick and gave me milia. Because it’s so expensive I didn’t want to waste it and I’ve been using it as a neck/décolleté cream and it’s very nice for that. My preference for a night cream is the Farmacy honey halo.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: Okay this is a NICE cream, but for me, it’s too heavy/thick and gave me milia. Because it’s so expensive I didn’t want to waste it and I’ve been using it as a neck/décolleté cream and it’s very nice for that. My preference for a night cream is the Farmacy honey halo.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a nice hydrating moisturizer I tend to use at night on my oily acne prone skin with no problems. No strong fragrance and does the job!

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!! My new face wash fav. I have combination skin

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!! My new face wash fav. I have combination skin

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My absolute favorite moisturizer! I have dry, oily, acne prone skin and this cream leaves my face soft, not greasy

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: My absolute favorite moisturizer! I have dry, oily, acne prone skin and this cream leaves my face soft, not greasy

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: LOVE everything about this exfoliate. I am a HUGE Tatcha fan

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: BEST makeup remover out there! Hands down the most effective remover on the market. I am obsessed with Tatcha

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this product! I am a tatcha junkie and this doesn’t disappoint. I apply 2 a day and it leaves my skin so soft and my makeup goes on flawlessly.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this product! I am a tatcha junkie and this doesn’t disappoint. I apply 2 a day and it leaves my skin so soft and my makeup goes on flawlessly.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Stunning. I love this moisturizer, it’s light but still effective. The smell is absolutely to die for. I’ve had only good luck with this product and I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: After using this product every night for almost a month, I’m finally starting to see my lips more plump. They’ve sure gotten softer but it took quite some time to see plumping. Is it nice and softening aka a moisturizer? Heck yes! Is it worth $28? Ehhhh, no. The size is quite disappointing for the price. When I run out I doubt I’ll be purchasing again. Save your money!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Let me tell ya, this product is phenomenal! I struggle with oily and blemish prone skin- this moisturizer doesn’t add excess oil during my day, it keeps my skin nice and moisturized which helps to reduce my blemishes, and it lasts forever. If you’re concerned about paying a good amount of money and running out of product withinin a month, worry no more!! I bought the $68 1.7 oz. and the jar has lasted me over a year. I highly recommend this product!! (pic is the 1.7 oz jar compared to a standard tennis ball)

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Phenomenal! I’ve always loved Glow Recipe but this is by far my favorite product. I’ve always struggled with dull skin but this product has blown be away. My face is so dewy and luxurious! Highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was in search of a new moisturizer after recently starting a very strong retinol which took my previously oily/combo and acne-prone skin to Sahara desert level dry. My skin was flaking and angrier than I’d ever seen and my previous cream wasn’t cutting it anymore. I was recommended this moisturizer and I absolutely love it. After a full day of use, my skin was way more soft, not flaking anymore, and no breakout to be found. I’ve been using it for a few weeks now and it has become my favorite moisturizer so far. I pair it with Tatcha’s ‘Dewy Skin Cream’ and they work beautifully together to keep my skin balanced and refreshed. It’s very light feeling and doesn’t really have a smell for those of you who don’t like fragrances. The price is a little steep, but well worth it for the amount of product you get and the effect it has. Highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive combination skin, and I got a few dark spots on my chin and cheeks. I did used a few serums to blur my dark spots, and they slowly did the job. Then, I tried this toner out, and the result seems much faster! After a week using it, the dark spots on my chin are gone. After two weeks, most of the dark spots fade and almost gone! The toner makes my skin softer and brightening. If you have not use any AHA/BHA products before, you may expect a little sting in couple first uses. P/s: I do received this toner from @influenster and @olehenriksen for testing purposes! So, above is my honest review to see the effect of the toner on my skin! #buhbyedarkspots #contest #complimentary @olehenriksen @Influenster

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Fresh strawberry scent is absolutely amazing! The product is so gentle on my sensitive combination skin. The scrub melted when I massaged on the skin and made my face felt so soft and refreshing. I switched between the sugar strawberry exfoliating face wash and soy face cleanser during a week. Love FRESH and absolutely recommend it. P/s: I received this product from Influenster for testing and reviewing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this serum! It has a lightweight cream texture, which quickly absorb into the skin. The container design is very convenient and easy to use. After using this product for 2 weeks, only at night time, my dark circles is lighter and my under eye skin seems much softer.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: Love Squalane!I absolutely love this oil, especially on the lazy nights...just clean my face, follow with toner, then apply this oil...that’s enough to hydrate my skin over night! Also, my skin seems more sensitive with Vitamin C these days, so having Vitamin C in the oil is a plus for me!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen makes my skin glow and moisturizing all day long. I need to apply less moisturizer when using this product, so it’s not too oily. But overall, it’s a good invisible sunscreen with SPF 50+, easy to blend, long lasting!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I have used Shiseido sunscreen for the last 5 years, and I was so excited to try out this new clear stick! This is the best sunscreen with SPF 50+, invisible, and very easy to apply!! I definitely switch to this product and highly recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: So I gave into the hype and purchased this along with the ceramic cleanser and the good genes. I’m a skin care junkie and own lots of high end to drugstore serums and moisturizers. To me it’s all about the ingredients, basically im one of those people that read labels of ingredients and know exactly what’s in the product not just what it claims. So I’ve been using the Luna oil for a few days now and I must say I’m really impressed, mostly with how much it decreased the redness on my face, I have rosacea and sensitive skin but I’m used to ingredients like retinol and AHAs. It’s helped with my hormonal breakouts and skin clarity as well. The ceramic cleanser I didn’t like at all and the latic acid serum is average. Not worth the price. However this seems to be worth the money, I’ll give it more time and see but so far I’m liking the results. I also received Sunday’s CEO serum in my allure beauty box and have been using it during the day with great results as well. So far I’m happy with the results just wish the price was so expensive

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this from Influenster complimentary and I was so excited to try it. I always looks for good anti aging serums, and to hear that this particular serum was an alternative to retinol I was even more excited. I have fair skin and some retinol products do tend to irritate my skin and make it more sensitive to the sun. Love the packaging very clean, and straightforward. I was pleasantly surprised by the pastel purple color of the serum and it smelled amazing. After cleansing I applied it and I could see right away my skin looked more luminous. I’d have to give it more time but so far this product has done what it promised, and I will continue to use it and would absolutely purchase this product if it continues to show me great benefits! Thanks Influenster I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a couple of weeks now as my daytime eye cream. Its really hydrating and adds a lot of brightness to my under eye area. I also really like the texture. Not too thin not too thick and made my concealer go on really well. I got this product  complimentary from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a Great Multi-Functional Serum, is specifically formulated to support the skin’s natural night-time repair process through deep hydration. Plus, it delivers a super-dose of antioxidants to neutralize the free radicals that can cause premature aging. I definitely saw a difference in my skin within a week. My skin was brighter, more even toned and was dewy and hydrated. I received this complimentary from Influenster for reviewing purposes.

reviews.review_text: I’ve never tried a Tatcha product before, until I got the email I was receiving this Tatcha essence from Influenster. In my daily skincare routine I wear an essence everyday, So I was no stranger to how essences work. Which is to hydrate and prep the skin for your next step in your routine which mine is serum. My favorite essence that I’ve been using for years even before K Besuty became popular is a Murad Hydro-Dynamic® Quenching Essence . I  love the packaging, the bottle itself looks very sleek and expensive. Also my favorite part is the spout type opening so when you apply it to your hands it doesn’t all pour out too quickly. I do normally prefer essences that have a light serum like texture, & this one has the consistency of water basically, and there’s no scent, at all but it does feel hydrating. Tatcha made their own formula of  fermented foods based on the Japanese diet. Rice, Algae, and one of my favorite ingredients Green tea. It boosts hydration, resurfaces the skin and moisturizes to plump the skin and prime it for skincare. I can’t wait until I’ve used this for more than a few days so I can see the benefits.

reviews.review_text: I’ve always been a big fan of thick, luxurious, super hydrating night creams. Since we can lose about 40% of our skins moisture while we sleep, this Estée Lauder Cream is moisturizing, has anti aging peptides, and replenishes your skin while you sleep. With ingredients like Squalane, Moringa Seed Extract, Hibiscus seed extract, Vitamin C, Algae extract plus anti aging peptides to get rid of fine lines and wrinkles. After using this for a week, my skin is dewier, brighter and more even toned. Loving this new cream!

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: i was super skeptical when i received this product for free from influenster. i LOVE toner and this one has a thick moisturizer feel as opposed to the stripping toners im used to. i was concerned it wouldnt provide me with enough of that stripping. i was so wrong! this toner is a joy to use every morning. i seriously look forward to applying it to my face. it glides on and my skin just absorbs it up! i was worried it would make my oily skin worse but this in combination with the hydra zen moisturizer and my oily skin has actually toned down! using these two products ive noticed a reduction of the lines on my face and just a general healthy plump glow of my skin. i never knew how much i was starving my skin until i got these products. i am officially hooked! for anyone who needs a toner that isnt an astringent at all and is actually super soft and comforting i cant recommend this product enough!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: my new favorite moisturizer! i received this product for free from Influenster and i am hooked! it is the first moisturizer that gives me enough hydration with zero oily residue and zero breakouts! i have oily skin so i often dont even wear moisturizer (bad me i know!) that all changed the day i got this product to try. ive been using it every morning for over a month and can honestly say ive noticed a huge difference in my face. no more dry patches! my skin went from combination to really being almost normal. plus it feels amazing on! super light cream that blends in and absorbs immediately! i highly recommend this product for oily acne prone skin. it’ll make a moisturizer believed out of you just like it did me!

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: i loved how it evened out my skin texture and gave it a amazing healthy glow with zero down time. it felt better on my skin and way less harsh than many other masks with these ingredients. it had the biggest impact on my pore size, something ive struggled with my whole life. it visibly shrunk the pores on my nose and greatly improved my makeup application. it didnt do much for my fine lines and was a bit drying for my skin, i ended up putting a hydrating mask on immediately following just to prevent any potential redness and dryness but overall i really like this product.  i did get this for free for testing purposes but i do genuinely like this product and will continue to use it. also heads up, it is sticky so make sure to keep your hair out of your face!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this. I got it for free to test and have fallen in love. I swear by the skinceuticals CE ferulic but this is an insanely close second. It immediately hydrates and brightens my skin leaving it perfectly dewy and glowy. It smells good and absorbs really easy. I have zero complaints about this product and highly recommend it. When I use this I literally just cleanse. Apply. And top with moisturizer and spf. Your skin doesn’t need anything else and it will look fabulous.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: So I received a sample pack of this product to test for free from influencer. I chose to take it on my honeymoon and use it exclusively to see how 6 days of consistent use could affect my skin and honestly I’m a believer. It’s a great product and I noticed increased brightness in my skin and a better more supple texture overall. It was not drying and I found it soaked in really well to my skin. I went and bought a bottle to have now so I clearly recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: Pores have always been a concern of mine but I have never really found a product that helped.  I really did notice an improvement in the size and appearance of my pores after using this product.

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Helps brighten those dark areas under eyes
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is great for middle aged women.  I have small hints of dark circles under my eyes and this cream helped brighten the area so that you could not see them.  The cream is lightweight also, which is nice.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_title: Easy way to get brighter skin
reviews.review_text: This Glow Peel was complimentary from GOOPGLOW.  I have never tried an overnight product that would brighten my skin before this.  This was easy to apply and I could feel the tingling right away as it started to work.  I left it on overnight as directed and washed it off in the morning.  Once I washed this off, I could immediately see a difference in my complexion.  My face had a nice glow that was not there before.  I am really impressed with Overnight Glow Peel and would recommend this to anyone desiring brighter skin.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream! I found it very easy to add into my skincare routine. It absorbs well into the skin so you don’t feel it there shortly after application.  I am 42 years old and starting to show some wrinkles around my eyes. This cream helped smooth those out. I look and feel younger.  The cream really doesn’t have much of a fragrance to it, so perfect for those that prefer unscented items. Overall I think this item is great for your anti-aging skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree.  This sunscreen is water-based which is evident upon applying to your skin.  It absorbed easily into my skin.  It is made with sunflower seed oil but this does not feel oily at all.  There is just the lightest scent to it, which is pleasant.  I’m not a fan of those sunscreens that everyone around you can smell.  This is not one of those.  This is not water resistant, but I will be using this at the ball field this summer.  This is made in Korea, which is known for their great skincare products.  This is just another example.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum was easy to use and add to my current skincare regimine.  It absorbed well into my skin.  I did notice an improvement in the strength of my skin using this.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: The product felt great going on my skin. My skin felt hydrated and smooth. I got this as a sample so I feel like I needed more to actually see any real difference to my skin. What I used of it did make my skin soft.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product left my skin feeling flawless and smooth. I use this product in the AM before applying my makeup but after I cleansed my face. Made putting my makeup on smooth and didn’t leave my makeup feeling cakey.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this as a complimentary gift from Biossance. This eye cream left my eyes feeling less puffy and more relaxed throughout the night. I used this at night with my night cream routine. A little of this product goes a long way.  I used a little cream and patted around my eye line. The product was not greasy and went into skin quickly. The scent was a little different but I liked it. It really helped give my eyes a more firming look. Left my skin smooth and that is great in my book.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this as a complimentary from Sunday Riley. This Sunday Riley C.E.O 15%  Vitamin C brightening Serum is a great product.. This was an easy to use product to use twice daily. The scent of it smells exactly like sweet citrus. The texture is milky and shiny. Goes on skin smooth and it is not tacky like some serums. Goes on smooth and goes into your skin without leaving it greasy. Gives skin a perfect glow throughout the day. Just use this twice a day after cleansing. Left my skin feeling hydrated all day.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This product left my skin super smooth. Definitely a great product to use. Product is very elegant to use every day in my skin care routine. My eyes look firm and look younger.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Great product! It’s really nice before bed. I wake up with moisturizer lips. It’s not like some other products that sit on top of the skin and make your lips “lazy” to produce their own moisture. I find my lisps hold on to their own hydration more effectively throughout the day, since using this product. I also keep a jar at my desk at work, works well on top of matte or liquid lipsticks to revive them mid day. Glad to see they have other flavours available! The original smells really pleasant, not like anything in particular to me. Not floral, not bubblegum, just... pleasant. Can’t wait to try the grapefruit!I only gave 4 stars because I can’t believe I spend $24 on a lipbalm...but I loved it so I will buy it again.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I got this in a kit with he radiance mask and silk primer. This spray is nice, smell is mild (smells like the rice polish) which I don’t mind. It does give a dewy glow but nothing crazy. I wouldn’t have bought it as I have combination skin and this is a no for oily areas. If you have dry skin you might like it. I use it on no makeup days for a bit of extra moisture.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: This stuff is so good. I got the little bottle on a impulse and had to go back for a big one. It’s pricey for me, but it does last a while. I use it every other day, or when I feel I need a bit of a deeper clean. It exfoliated a bit, but quickly turns to a paste. Skin feels soft afterwards, but not stripped which I find with harsh scrubs. I’ve tried the original, but went back for the deep clean. I didn’t notice a huge difference between the two, other than the colour. Would recommend! I have combo skin.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have a fear of commitment when it comes to cleanser monogamy. By the time I finish the tube, I’m bored and I want to try the next new thing. I’ve flipped back and forth for years, but this has always been on rotation. In the last year, I’ve developed an onset of cystic acne they seemingly cane without warning. I decided to simplify my routine and focus on gently ingredients with purpose. I’m proud to say that I am on my 3rd tube of this and my skin is happier for it. It’s very gentle and effective without stripping the skin. I remove my makeup off beforehand, but this does help to get the excess bits off. It also has a very pleasant scent, very reminiscent of cucumber water. For reference, I am mid 20s with combo skin.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: What can I say? It does the job. Smells like fresh salad and cleanses without stripping. I’m on my second bottle. I love that plastic is minimal and you can refill your pump bottle. I use day and night and have dry to combination skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: What can I say? It does the job. Smells like fresh salad and cleanses without stripping. I’m on my second bottle. I love that plastic is minimal and you can refill your pump bottle. I use day and night and have dry to combination skin.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I have only used this a handful of times, so please take this review with a grain of salt. This is overall a good SPF. I love that it’s SPF 50. The texture is what you would expect of typical sunscreen (i.e not gel) but not sticky or greasy at all. I have combo skin but dehydrated and my skin is not dry nor is it oily with this. I don’t know why a lot of reviews are having pilling issues. I have worn this with different variations of skin care underneath and no pilling. I don’t wait for my skin care to set before putting this on either. Today I wore it with three serums and a moisturizer and it worked perfectly fine. I would also argue that it’s almost un scented, which I like. Certainly  nowhere near the other watermelon products that glow recipe has. Overall a good product!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I had hugh hopes for this. First of all, the green turning beige is very limiting in terms of skin tones. I can’t see this working unless you have a very specific light skin with golden undertones. It’s not so much cancelling red as it is pasting beige over top. Apart from that, this is sticky, thick and greasy feeling and it looks streaky when applied. I would rather just wear a full face of foundation. I am returning this.

reviews.review_text: This product is good very lightweight and great for summer but I live in New York and it’s just not hydrating enough for winter

reviews.review_text: Highly recommend if you are looking for a moisturizing eye cream! Does not appear to do much beyond that though so would not purchase if you are looking for additional benefits reduce dark circles, puffiness, etc. Excellent moisturizer though

reviews.review_title: Great cleanser for sensitive acne prone skin!
reviews.review_text: Great cleanser, one of the few cleansers that work for sensitive acne prone skin which is a difficult combo for obvious reasons. Used this cleanser for a year or so and it’s done wonders for my skin. Definitely need an exfoliating peel or treatment once a week though but otherwise this is great

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Definitely adds a glow to the skin and moisturizes really well! Doesn’t bother my sensitive skin either which is a bonus! Highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

reviews.review_text: Great eye cream, definitely punches above its weight. Not super moisturizing but not sure that it’s meant to be. I use it during the day anyway

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this since it came out and it works extremely well for sensitive skin. I occasionally use the much stronger Skinceuticals 1.0 retinol and it is so hard on my skin that I usually end up going back to this one. Definitely a favorite

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This serum is so soothing and hydrating on the skin. I love adding a pump into my moisturizer before bed. I wake up with soft, baby skin. My acne looks immediately healed and less red after overnight use. Plus, the bottle is so cute and looks great on my vanity.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: What a dream this moisturizer is! This gel-cream is so lightweight and melts in the skin. It keeps my skin hydrated and dewy all day without feeling greasy. I love that it’s refillable. I will be buying a refill pod as soon as it’s finished!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: What a dream this moisturizer is! This gel-cream is so lightweight and melts in the skin. It keeps my skin hydrated and dewy all day without feeling greasy. I love that it’s refillable. I will be buying a refill pod as soon as it’s finished!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum totally changed my skin! I am beyond obsessed with how well it work. My skin feels more plump, lifted, and clear than ever. I love the texture, as well. It’s milky, creamy, and very hydrating.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with these pimple patches. They make every pimple and spot go away so quickly- like overnight or just a few hours. They come in handy and I always have them near my vanity. A total must have!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: What a lovely primer. It works wonder and hydrates and smooths my skin so well. My makeup applies on top perfectly. It looks so dewy and moisturizes. My skin has never look healthier. I am so obsessed!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Let me start of by saying this cleansing balm is hands down the best on the market. It blows every other balm out of the water! It removes literally every trace of makeup and then emulsifies completely off with zero residue. It’s also cruelty-free and vegan! However, I will NOT be repurchasing. This contains micro-plastic (polyethylene) which gives the balm it’s solid form but is completely unnecessary (Drunk Elephant Slaai=No polyethylene). It is extremely terrible for marine life and water. Polyethylene is normally too large to penetrate your skin..BUT if you have open acne spots or microtears it can make it’s way into the open skin and into your body. This is NOT A CLEAN INGREDIENT. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PRODUCT!!!

reviews.review_text: I have acne-prone, combination skin that’s extremely sensitive due to Retin-A. I’m in need of a heavy hitter that won’t break me out. This cream checks all the boxes! I’ve been using it for a while now and it’s hands down my HG and worth the money. This cream is extremely nourishing and hydrating and within a few minutes sinks into the skin, leaving a beautiful glowy canvas that works for day or night and plays well with makeup! reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for months trying to make myself love it but...this product misses the mark. It all but doesn’t emulsify. reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This is by far the best of all oil/balm makeup removers. It removes all makeup, emulsifies beautifully, washes away completely and leaves zero residue. BUT it unfortunately contains polyethylene, a microplastic. Come on Farmacy!!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: It’s a SERUM, not a moisturizer!
reviews.review_text: Don’t listen to 90% of the bad reviews, they’re using it wrong. This is not meant to be a moisturizer, it’s a hydrating serum. Use after toner when the face is still damp and follow with your routine as normal. It’s a game changer for hydration and nothing compares. The added ceramides are great for skin health and this plumps like no other.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Truly a staple. Nothing compares to this OG (no, The Ordinary one is not even close). I use this once a week, sometimes twice if my period skin is coming. This keeps texture a thing of the past and truly gives baby soft skin.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is trash! I honestly cannot grasp the hype..I have tried it every way possible and no matter what this product pills and balls-up right off the skin.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is my go-to cleanser when my skin is freaking out. It’s a basic, no-frills cleanser that I know will not irritate my skin. It has a thick, silky texture that does a fantastic job at cleansing & not stripping.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Eh. It’s a great idea but this mask literally burned so badly..it was beyond the typical acid burn. After using it for 7 weeks I tossed it..the results were minimally smoother skin and not worth the burn. Babyfacial for the win.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This is a pretty decent beginners acid. Though I much prefer to use this on my body. After showering I slap this all over my body and follow with lotion. It’s great for softening skin and also gets rid of dark underarms!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: This eye mask is fantastic! The moment you apply it to the under eye area, you experience a cooling effect that is soo relaxing! I also noticed when I woke up in the morning that my eyes were less puffy and that my dark circles were basically non-existent. Worth the money in my opinion! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes from influenster.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This exfoliator has done wonders for my skin! It has efficiently reduced any dullness or dryness, as well as given my skin such a beautiful glow! I have been using this in tandem with my Cera-Ve moisturizing cream and my skin has never looked better. It is quite pricey, but if you have the means, this is a worthy addition to your skincare regimen. I received this product for testing purposes from influenster.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This exfoliator has done wonders for my skin! It has efficiently reduced any dullness or dryness, as well as given my skin such a beautiful glow! reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I’m so happy that I stumbled upon the Shiseido sunscreen line because not only is it a great value for the price point, but I would say that it is one of the best sunscreens that I have ever used. My face is sensitive, so sunscreens tend to cause breakouts because of the oiliness of their formulas. This one is so lightweight that I had actually forgotten that I had applied it in the morning when I was taking off my makeup at the end of the day. It has a slightly strong smell, so be aware of that if you are sensitive to fragrances, but besides that I wholeheartedly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I had been searching for the perfect sunscreen to wear under makeup that wouldn’t cause a breakout or cause my makeup to move around. I’m so glad that I discovered this! The consistency of this product makes it feel like you are wearing nothing at all, while providing great protection against damaging UV rays. The best part is that the stick packaging is so convenient. I just throw this into my purse and I’m set!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this exfoliator for a week and my skin has such a GORGEOUS glow. The texture is like a finely ground sand and has a really invigorating citrus-y smell. I took one star off because it’s a little pricey for what it is, but it definitely does everything that the description states.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this exfoliator for a week and my skin has such a GORGEOUS glow. The texture is like a finely ground sand and has a really invigorating citrus-y smell. reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I had heard about the SK-II brand prior to receiving this product to test out and the reviews were always nothing short of stellar. I’ve always wanted to try this product, but the price point has always led to an unsuccessful hunt, searching for a comparatively cheaper dupe. Believe me when I say I have tried many an essence and am flabbergasted at the efficacy of this product. Believe me when I say this product has absolutely transformed my skin. Every morning when I wake up, my face is dewy, fresh, and astoundingly clear. I previously had dry skin with sporadic acne and breakouts that happened routinely every 2 months and this has all but eliminated them. I am honestly in disbelief over how incredible this is. I hate that it is so pricey, but I’m going to have to add it to my permanent skin routine because I never thought I would find a product that worked this well with my skin. I am so grateful that I’ve finally had the chance to try this product.

reviews.review_text: After a few weeks of using this essence in tandem with the Peach and Lily Glass Skin Serum, I have noticed that my skin is clearer, brighter, and more bouncy than I have ever experienced. I cannot stress enough how much a quality essence can do for your skin. The quality of the packaging is superb, as it always is with Tatcha, and the little spout that distributes the product prevents too much from pouring out into your hand. This is very comparable to the SK-II essence and I would say it is definitely on the same level, without a doubt.

reviews.review_text: smells like cucumbers and free of all harsh chemicals. it also lathers so creamy and silky instead of frothy. love it

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I use this after I double cleanse, with a bit of water on my fingertips so it doesnt feel tacky on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I love love love the smell of this face wash, but it leaves my skin a little bit too dry :( I still use it from time to time.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: this moisturizer is crazy! i LOVE how hydrated i feel instantly and it smells delish. i feel like it plumps up every fine line and makes my face smooth and supple

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this product, even though i actually tend to use it in the summer and not the winter. It all started when i was using Sunday Riley Good Genes and was LOVING the dewy  clear skin glow due to that lactic acid. obviously Sunday Riley being so expensive, i had to look else where and found this little gem! will be repurchasing now that the summer is approaching

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: This goes on natural without over-drying lips like others. Does not leave any waxy residue. I keep them hidden everywhere.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Having tried what feels like nearly every other similar product this one is near the best. Applies like a dream and really does offer sun protection.

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Having tried what feels like nearly every other similar product this one is near the best. Applies like a dream and really does offer sun protection.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: Shocked these worked so well. There are others that cost more. Don’t pass these over.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Where has this been all my life? I can’t live without. One word of caution it will stain any clothing but I forgive it for this. It helps even out skin tone and doubles as a moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Where has this been all my life? I can’t live without. One word of caution it will stain any clothing but I forgive it for this. It helps even out skin tone and doubles as a moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: This is super powerful and I love. Not for everyday use but for those stubborn spots that just won’t go away.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: Definitely a good buy if you’re looking for something that helps reduce oil and clear pores on your skin. My whole family really liked the tingly clean feeling afterward and it left our faces clearer. I had used this product for at least a year and switched to Bobbi Brown as it was even more effective and more luxurious. If I never used the Bobbi Brown product I probably would have stayed with this one. I would recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: My lips are in heaven after applying this! Very moisturizing and it stays on throughout the night. I no longer wake up with chapped lips anymore, and my lips are supple!!Little goes a long way, too. You don’t need a whole lot to experience this luxurious lip mask. I wear it every night before I go to sleep, and my lips never felt better!Thank you Sephora for carrying this product!

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_title: You need it if you wear makeup!
reviews.review_text: I love how thoroughly it washes off all of my makeup, including mascara and eye makeup. I do have to rub it vigorously with water to wash it all off, but when it comes off, my face feels very clean and brightened.The only downside is that it tends to irritate my eyes a little bit when I try to get the eye makeup out. With that said, it definitely gets the job done, even with strong waterproof makeup. Since I don’t wear makeup every day, I wish they had a smaller bottle so I don’t have to have this giant jar with me when I bring my makeup bag.

reviews.review_text: Love this as a body wash! Okay, I know, I didn’t know this product was marketed as a face wash but I used it as a body wash and absolutely loved the luxurious shower with light scent and its moisturizing effect.However, when I tried to use this as a face wash, it was way too drying for me. I would continue to use this as a body wash but nothing more.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_title: Ready for a Glowing, Smoother, Brighter Skin?
reviews.review_text: I’ve been wanting to try the SK-II line ever since I found out SK-II is the best selling skin care product in entire Sephora. I got a sample one as well as part of a kit and never looked back!Facial Treatment Essence is the big deal. It’s not called “Miracle Water“ for no reason. I had been using this for 2 weeks and everyone is noticing that my skin is glowing, smoother, and overall has much better tone than before. Even my dark spots and scars are slowly disappearing with this essence. I’m so sad that normally this bottle is so pricey but it’s so worth it. I’m looking forward to a larger bottle so I can get a better deal. This would be part of my daily routine for sure!

reviews.review_text: I have combination skin and was excited to try this product. It seemed okay at first, but now I am having a slight burning sensation when I apply this and my skin does not feel moist after applying. I’m not sure which ingredient my skin is reacting to, but I will be going back to my previous moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I really do love this sunscreen. I wanted to give it give stars, but the few points I had against it bothered me enough to bump it down to 4. I live in the sunny South and definitely felt like it protected my skin. I put it on after using the whole DE morning day routine. It was a bit tackier/gummier than I’d like while it was drying, but it absorbed quickly. It’s really important to only use a little though, especially if you’re on the oily side, I felt that because I used it in moderation (small chickpea sized drop) it left me looking dewy but not slick. The smell is soft, natural, and very pleasant. If you’re oily I’d be cautious but if you have dry skin I think this would be perfect. I’d love to try the tinted sunscreen next.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: a love letter to good hydration
reviews.review_text: Absolutely adore this product! I mix it in the mornings with my c-firma to give me a little extra hydration without turning my face into an oilfield. It’s perfect! I haven’t even grabbed for my Kiehl’s moisturizer after my routine since I started using this. I use half of the recommended amount, I’ve never had a product go so far, they definitely give you value for the price. I noticed an almost immediate improvement in hydration. My skin is so lush it minimized my pores, and together with the c-firma it makes the perfect one-two punch to fight sun damage and pores. I love this product!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: My HG lip mask! It’s perfect in almost every way in my opinion. A little bit really goes a long way, so you get the value for your money. It’s ACTUALLY incredibly hydrating, it’s my go-to for chapped winter lips, and it works literally overnight. One night. That’s all it takes to see a huge difference in softness and hydration. And the flavor oh my gosh. It’s like the best watermelon bubblegum you’ve ever had. I’m not sure if that’s the actual flavor but that’s the best way I could describe it. The formula is silky smooth and easy to apply with a fingertip. It would take a LOT for me to switch to a new nightly lip mask, this one is pretty much perfect like I said to begin with.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Fantastic for twice a week (at most) clearing treatment. Use way less than you think and it won’t be unbearably tingly. If you have sensitive or reactive skin I’d avoid it, but it helps me keep breakouts and oil under control. I have reactive skin and it stays red for a while after, and I have to follow up with a hydrating mask. I suggest the Tatcha Dewy sheet masks.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I thought this wouldn’t measure up to my Farmacy Green Clean but I absolutely love this! GC isn’t as hydrating as this and I love that just a little gives you quite a bit of mileage. It’s not too harsh on my sensitive skin and the perfect cleansing balm to double cleanse on days where I wear a full face. It was so easy to use and broke up even my stay-put foundation very well. Absolutely a new fave! I received this complimentary in a VoxBox.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_title: 2 layers seems to work best for me
reviews.review_text: I use this in my morning routine, and it has helped me out quite a bit I think. My acne has improved so much over the time I’ve been using it!I apply one layer, and apply a second one, waiting for the serum to soak in/ dry down after both applications. I follow with sunscreen and it’s been working great!

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This is so soft and gentle. Though, it’s a little thin when it melts down, and can get a little messy.I like using this as a FIRST cleanse to remove my sunscreen at the end of the day, and it works. So I can’t say how well it removes makeup, but I’d think it would work pretty well.Please do make sure you do a second cleanse if your skin doesn’t get along with oily cleansers!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Great, but not thick enough for me
reviews.review_text: This is a great moisturizer don’t get me wrong. It’s just not quite enough for my dry patches. The formula would be great for someone with less dehydrated skin, but it was really nice to use, and has a great texture.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer

reviews.review_title: Only SA product I can use!
reviews.review_text: LOVE! I’ve never been able to use anything with SA in  it, but I decided to give the sample packet a try, and it was so gentle on my skin! The texture is dreamy, it’s definitely more of an essence (ie. between toner and serum) than it is a toner, but holy I love this product. I decided to buy the full size and it’s still just as pleasing to use!P.S. I’m even able to use it after my benzoyl peroxide wash with no issue at all! No stinging, itching, or burning!! Nothing but happy hydrated skin!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: So silky and smooth! Not sticky or greasy after it’s set up, and layers over other products fairly well. It’s a little tingly and feels cooling on the face and I love it. I don’t feel like I look greasy, even over my acne/ oily areas, it doesn’t even burn my acne spots! The glow this gives just looks like healthy happy skin, and I think this’ll be my favourite sunscreen for years to come!!It does ball up when you try rub it in, but I usually blend in my SPF with my fingertips, I just thought I’d test it to see if that’s why people were having issues.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I liked that it didn’t burn or irritate my skin or make it more red. My skin is pale and prone to redness. The first step wipe had a strong medicinal smell. It said it was supposed to exfoliate but didn’t look scrubby or have any grit in it. The second wipe was refreshing. A few minutes after using my skin did look brighter.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: My two favorite things about this scrub: it is gentle and it is convenient. I dont have a ton of time for a complicated skincare routine so I like that I can keep this in the shower and use it a couple of times a week.The exfoliation is small and gentle- not like rubbing gravel on your face at all!! My skin felt much smoother after using it. I did have to use a little extra moisturizer after.The instructions say to use a cleanser first, and I wouldn’t skip that step or your skin won’t feel clean. There is a lot of product in the container- it should last a long time.

reviews.review_text: I think this moisturizer will be a really good fit for my combination skin. It sinks in well and is not greasy. I didnt notice any irritation of my uneven skin tone with this and it layered well under my foundation. The rose scent is STRONG,  which isnt my preference but also doesnt bother me too much.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This was a really easy boost for my undereye area! My skin tends to thin out there and show blue veins and dark circles. I applied a really thin layer of this jet lag mask just under my eyes. You only need a little. It did take a while to absorb but I didnt blot. I will use this as part of my nighttime routine. After only using it once, my undereye area does look firmer and brighter.  Complimentary from Summer Fridays in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.review_text: This creme definitely has some strong anti aging ingredients, which means now might be a good time to add it to my routine. It is moisturizing,though not as thick as some I have tried. It has a very mild scent and isn’t sticky. A little bit goes a long way so I think this container will last a long time.
