reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I liked the texture of this sunscreen/primer a lot. It’s not runny but it also is easy to spread and absorbs well. The packaging says a dime sized amount but I didn’t need that much. It worked well as a primer - my foundation stuck to it well. It is VERY glowy so when I applied it my face looked really shiny. I prefer a matte finish so I probably will only use this when I plan to wear makeup overtop of it.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I live in Alberta, Canada, where the weather is dry almost year-round. I typically buy organic rose hip seed oils from natural foods stores to keep my skin moisturized under foundation, and have been very happy with the assortment that I’ve tried. With this item being half the price of already inexpensive oils that I was using, I was skeptical but decided to give it a try. Overall, I’m really pleased. It has a lighter feel than most others that I’ve tried but sinks in and absorbs quickly. It’s still as moisturizing as the others, but less greasy than many. On very dry winter days, I’ll put on another layer after the first has sunk in, and then wait another 10 minutes to do my foundation. I came in expecting not to like it because with the price I thought ’it must be too good to be true’, but I’m really happy with it. I have to hand it to them. I also love to use it around my eyes in the morning. Using just the pad of my thumb with a medium touch, I massage from the outer right corners of my undereyes inwards, than across the eyelid in the crease, than backwards up through the eyebrow. Once I get to the inner corner of my nose I just bring my thumb up to my hairline. Super awesome de-puffing method try it! Just don’t get this IN your eyes, obviously, and check your other eye creams for ingredients that might compete. I find it’s moisturizing enough on it’s own in the mornings before makeup to skip eye cream.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I have been using NeoStrata’s Toning Solution for a few years now but decided to give this a try for the price. I’m impressed! It actually exfoliates the physical dead skin off of my face, which many chemical exfoliators claim to do but never actually pull through on. I apply it on a cotton ball and I do rub it more  firmly in areas with lots of dry skin. The smell reminds me of rum (not great), but most skincare fanatics would agree that it’s the results, not the smell, that we’re after. It isn’t *quite* as strong as I had hoped, but as with many of The Ordinary’s products, it’s a slower process ending in great results. And maybe if it were stronger it would be too much- I’m sort of a masochist in that I love strong-feeling products, and my skin can now handle a lot. I see this as a practical product for pretty much anyone who wants to improve the look of their pores/blackheads and slow pesky spots down. It keeps things under control. I apply it on nights that I don’t use retinol, followed by lactic acid and a deep moisturizer. For the price, this is a great tool to have on hand. Bravo again, TO, for making good skin accessible.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love clean beauty products where I can, but this product didn’t wow me. It IS a very moisturizing, thick cream, as it claims to be, but it didn’t give my skin any sort of special glow or amazing results. The mornings after I apply it I find that my skin is well-moisturized, but not glowy. I would even go as far as to say it makes my skin look matte or dull. For the price, I think that there are far better moisturizers on the market that will moisturize just as well and give you some added benefits. Sorry Milk, I still love you!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this product! I never tried the old version and from what everyone says I can actually picture it and want it. But this version is the only one I’ve tried and it’s pretty much perfect. In my routine depending on the day or week I’ll rotate retinol, lactic acid, glycolic acid, Vit C, and a salicylic acid cleanser, so I definitely do a bunch to my skin. Although it’s a lot of products I take a lot of break days from any actives depending on what my skin looks like and feels like it needs. This is my nighttime ’break day’ cream, and it’s amazing for day-after-retinol skin. It is really soothing and it soaks all the way in without disappearing and leaving your skin dry again. For myself and all that I put my skin through with building up a tolerance to retinol, it’s been like a spa break for my face. It resets things and when I wake up my skin just looks as it should.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Really happy with this! I don’t use it daily but a few times a week when my skin starts looking a little congested. It’s quite simple but very effective. Leaves my skin looking and feeling super clean. I love to have this on rotation, especially for the price point. It just cleans everything up! When I use it multiple times in a row (morning + night a few days) it’s too drying for me, so I mix it in when needed.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: Apply first thing to damp skin
reviews.review_text: This product is nice, but it took me a really long time to learn that it will pill like no other unless it’s applied first thing to damp skin, right after you wash your face. Its fabulous in that case! But it has been so grossly pilly all over my face in any other layering situation (have tried it before oil products, after oil products, to dry skin, etc.). I’ve had other hyaluronic acids that I didn’t have to rush to apply before, so for that reason four stars.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I received a trial-size of this in a sample bag, and it was love at first use.  I’ve never used a cleansing balm before, but i like it SO MUCH better than liquid make-up removers.  Doesn’t sting the eyes and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean.  I quickly ordered the full-size so I could save the sample for travel.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I received a trial-size of this in a sample bag, and it was love at first use.  I’ve never used a cleansing balm before, but i like it SO MUCH better than liquid make-up removers.  Doesn’t sting the eyes and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean.  I quickly ordered the full-size so I could save the sample for travel.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I first received a trial size of this product in a sample bag, but I soon came back and purchased the full size.  It’s not quite an instant miracle-worker, but if I apply a couple times early in the day, I find that my lips are not only hydrated, but also significantly smoother by late afternoon/evening.  I’ll soon be swapping this out for my overnight treatment.  And it smells great.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: great every day gloss. it’s earned a place in my purse. smells great, stays on for a while, gives my lips a nice little moisture boost.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: makes a visible difference on my dark circles, and you can’t beat it for the price.

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Can't beat it for the price point.
reviews.review_text: Goes on smooth and cool.  Very soothing, instantly brightening.  I’m also a fan of the Inkey caffeine serum.  I’ve never seen such an immediate difference from more expensive products.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love the consistency of this eye cream. It is light, smooth, and creamy. I received a sampple and absolutely loved it, so I purchased the full size. That said, I have not noticed an improvement in the texture around my eyes, or those dreaded dark circles. It does not irriate the eye area, which is a definite plus. However, I will use this until its gone then decide whether I want to repurchase. As of now, I think I will continue my search for the ultimate eye cream.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: There is just something about the smell of Estée Lauder products that I love! This cream smells so dreamy, but the scent doesn’t linger or overpower after application. Although I only used this for about 10 days, I could see a difference in my skin almost right away. It feels smoother, more bouncy, and brighter. I am very impressed with the quick results of the cream! If scent isn’t a deterrent, I would encourage anyone to give this cream a try. Amazing results! I received a free sample for review purposes, but opinions are truthfully my own.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: There is just something about the smell of Estée Lauder products that I love! This cream smells so dreamy, but the scent doesn’t linger or overpower after application. reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_title: Finally!! A sunscreen my skin likes!
reviews.review_text: Finally!! I’ve finally found a sunscreen that my skin likes! I wouldn’t call it mattifying, but the Shiseido Urban Environment Oil-Free sunscreen dries down smoothly and works well under makeup. I prefer a matte face, which has made finding a daily sunscreen I like nearly impossible. Everything I’ve tried leaves me so greasy. I’m so happy to have received this oil free version from Shiseido. It’s exactly what I’ve been looking for! The consistency is a think liquid that sinks into the skin and dries quickly. I haven’t noticed a white cast either. ***** 5 Stars *****

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: The Shiseido Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture sunscreen is very velvety, dewy, and applies smoothly. It has a light fragrance, but not too powerful. I enjoyed the application and it wears well. It does feel very moisturizing. However, it’s a bit too dewy for my preference. I like a matte face, so I don’t like this for daily wear beneath makeup. I’ll save it for the poolside and days at the beach.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I’ve thought about buying this moisturizer for quite some time. I always look at the reviews, and they’re split 50/50 on those that like it and those that don’t, so I usually talk myself out of buying it. WELL, I took a leap of faith and bought it and I’m so glad that I did! My skin really likes this! I use it in the a.m., under my foundation (after toner, before the REN natural primer). I have combo skin that tends to be very oily in my T-zone and I live in a very hot, humid environment. I’ve noticed my makeup stays on longer and I need to blot way later than I usually do with other moisturizers. I am a huge fan of this!! (I also love their foaming face wash)

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really love the texture of this product. The fragrance is so beautiful, gorgeous and fresh! It feels like you are in the middle of a roses field!  Also it leaves my skin very smooth and hydrated which is amazing.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I am absolutely in love with this eye serum! My skin always get so soft and refreshed. After using it a couple weeks I could notice that my black circles were gone!! I’m really glad of these amazing results!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I really loved this product!! It’s amazing the way it removes every piece of makeup. This cleanser melts away all the layers of my makeup, even the waterproof one. And the best of all is that it doesn’t leave any residual on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I really loved this product!! It’s amazing the way it removes every piece of makeup. This cleanser melts away all the layers of my makeup, even the waterproof one. And the best of all is that it doesn’t leave any residual on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really loved the texture of this cream! It’s amazing that is a primer but also it’s a moisturizer!! Best primer for winter time and people that have dry skin. It blends perfectly with my foundation and makeup!!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I really loved this product!! It makes my skin feel so fresh, smooth and super hydrated!! My skin looks super gorgeous and beautiful. I’m really impressed with the results! I use it on my morning routine.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Glowing and loving it

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: Wow this did such an amazing job at smoothing out my dry skin and giving my skin the thirst it needed! The smell is phenomenal as well, gives you a good feeling when using! I noticed results right away with my skin when usuing this and I couldn’t be happier. I noticed my skin didn’t get dried out when I got out of shower! Definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Wow I have always been searching for the perfect lip mask that won’t keep my lips sticky or too heavenly scented and this mask has been the answer! So soft on the lips and has given me results right away!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Omg wow I am in love and in shock with howAmazing this product has changed my skin in the most loving way! I feel my skin glows and shows a beautiful side of me I’ve never seen. So easy toApply and blends beautiful with my foundation! Doesn’t leave a sticky feel or heavy feel which is very important to me! Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Wow this has done my skin wonders and has made me feel like a new woman! Super impressed with the texture and how it doesn’t leave a sticky feeling definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_title: An absolute must for acne prone skin!!!!
reviews.review_text: Amazing! I don’t think it really helped with any of my cystic acne, but it made all the smaller acne I get disappear!! It’s not the easiest to use with other products. It really needs to go on first and then you need to let it dry before applying anything else. It’s well worth that little annoyance though. And the little bottle goes a long way!!  I’m so bummed that it’s continually out of stock right now. I’m rationing what I have.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Gave my blackheads and cystic acne
reviews.review_text: I initially got a sample of this and loved it. My face felt a little tight after using it, but it got rid of all my makeup. Then after purchasing the full size I noticed that I was getting a lot of blackheads.....then came the cystic acne. I sometimes get it on my chin, but never on the bridge of my nose!! worse yet none of the products I normally use on cystic acne would work. It wasn’t until I realized it was the soap and stopped using it that my face calmed down. Months later and I still have red marks from the acne and only now are some of the blackheads finally gone. I’ve since found out that they use a pore clogging oil in this product, and that slowly over time it was irritating my skin and clogging pores.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I noticed an immediate difference after using this product. My skin is sooo soft now and some of my wrinkles are less defined. And best of all I’ve only been using this product for 3 days!!! I’ve been cautious about using this product on my chin because that area is really sensitive and I can get cystic acne if I used the wrong product there. So far it hasn’t given me any breakouts. And even if it does I’ll keep using it in other areas because it has been wonderful!!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_title: It's great but make sure you use it properly!!!
reviews.review_text: I love this product!!!! I don’t use it daily or weekly, but I bust it out of the cabinet every time I feel that my face is about to break out or just looks a bit dull. It really helped me after a major cystic acne breakout that left big red marks and scars on my face. Each and every time I used the peeling solution the acne marks got more and more feint. I actually (since it was crazy bad) used it as a spot treatment for post acne marks daily at one point. It is strong and if you use it more than it recommend it will leave your face red and peeling (but the spot treatment did work). Its amazing that such a powerful and effective peel sells for so cheap!! I have other peels now that I like using daily, but this will always be somewhere in my cabinet. A bit of warning though, this does tingle and sting like crazy if you don’t use it properly. Read the label, don’t use it on wet skin!! Your face need to be clean AND DRY!!! It stings like crazy when you put it on wet skin. I sometimes put masks on my face before jumping in the shower to wash it off and this is not the item to do that with. When I did that my face looked awful afterwards. If your face is really stinging badly it might not really be dry or you may just need to use it for less time. I worked my way up to full time. It can also be difficult to wash out completely. The red coloring is actually very useful in that sense because if you can still see it the peel isn’t off your face.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: In the past I paid 16 euro for rose hip seed oil of this quality that didn’t have another oil added to it. It’s great that I can get the exact same thing for a much cheaper price from this brand. I love rose hip seed oil!! I have cystic acne and this helped keep some of my cystic acne at bay!! It also helps with my dark spots (from acne), acne scars (stupid cystic acne) and early signs of ageing. I highly recommend this to anyone suffering from cystic acne or any type of acne. Its one of the few oils that won’t make that problem worse and really does help!

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I feel a bit mixed about this product. I did notice a difference. But it may have just been from the sticker immobilizing that part of my face. However after using the stickers 3 times in one area there was more of an improvement. They are a bit expensive if you’re using them all over your face. I decided to focus on one fine line/wrinkle that really stands out and that makes the price feel a lot more reasonable. I liked it enough to buy another box. So all in all I think it’s worth the try if you have the extra money and aren’t planning on using it all over your face. It also didn’t cause any breakouts! So a big plus!

reviews.review_title: Works, but not worth the price
reviews.review_text: It works great. But it’s very watery. You need to use some sort of applicator like a cotton pad to apply. It’s also sticky. Although I think it works It doesn’t work as well as some less expensive products. Like the Ordinary.

It feels more moisturizing than the extra moist refiner in my opinion, which makes sense because it’s supposed to act as a toner/cream hybrid. Overall great product that I absolutely would continue to use. I received this product as a free sample

reviews.review_text: I loooove this pre cleanse oil. It does such a good job at taking off makeup and sunscreen effortlessly without causing irritation. Definitely recommend for anyone looking for a makeup remover! You won’t regret it. Gifted by dermalogica

reviews.review_title: A Must Have for Lipstick Lovers!
reviews.review_text: This was such a game changer for me, honestly. I wear so much lipstick, every day and sometimes two different colors depending if I’m going out that night. I also wear a lot of lip primer. My lips were always dry and I didn’t really want to give my lips a rest (lazy, I know). So I saw this online, bought it, and wow, I love it. I keep it next to my bed and put it on every night. I wake up with just lush feeling lips and now my lipstick goes on better, stays on longer, and just overall feels so much better. I will continue to buy this.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I really love how this product feels. Honestly, I use this more as a moisturizer and have recently used as an under eye mask. Both really make me look fresh and awake! PRO TIP: Use this after you’ve been out in the sun a bit! It really brought down the redness in my face and worked wonderfully. I love using this at night. Just a lovely product.

reviews.review_text: I had never used oils before, honestly very scared that it would break me out. I had used a sampler of Herbivore’s Lapis oil and enjoyed it but wasn’t too sure of it. I bought this and the Good Genes serum and WOW, this CHANGED MY SKIN FOR THE BETTER. I don’t think my skin has ever looked better. This has cleared up any acne I have and has brightened me up. I just have excellent skin now because of this. It smells great, I love heating it up between my hands and putting it on my skin. I really feel it absorb. I know the price tag is scary, but it lasts a long time and is worth it.

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: I first used IT Cosmetics when I bought the original version of the CC  cream, and I loved that. I live in DC where it is so hot and humid and I just wanted a foundation that wouldn’t make me breakout. When I saw this was coming out, I immediately went out and bought it. I’M OBSESSED. I will always be oily, but this keeps looking less shiny and doesn’t cause breakouts when I am sweaty (which happens as soon as I walk out the door most days). It has lasted long hours in the New Mexico sun, long days and nights in the D.C. humidity, and the odd weather of Ohio. It controls my shine, goes on great because it still makes you look natural. I used to use the Urban Decay Naked Skin CC cream but I have to say, this is my favorite. I definitely see myself using this going into other seasons as well.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Gosh, what couldn’t I say about La Mer? Look, I bought this for myself and for my mom because I saw celebrities using it. So yes, at first I thought it was gimmicky or I was just being lame. But man, this has CHANGED EVERYTHING. I bought a huge jar for my mom for her birthday. She literally cried over it. A little goes a long way. Your face just automatically feels as if you were a baby again. It stays with you, but not in an oily way. Its just an amazing product and yes, worth the price when you are ready to treat yourself.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this product, however, my skin did not. If my face hates a product, it will breakout like crazy, even if the product should not cause breakouts. After one night of using this product (with an otherwise unchanged cleansing routine), I had new breakouts in the morning. I continued to retry the product, and got similar breakout results every time. After stopping using it, no new breakouts. I also found this lotion hard to wear under foundation, as it caused my foundation to look very greasy even though it was a matte foundation. I would say it is more if a night cream, as I personally prefer something lighter during the day. On a positive note, I liked the neutral scent of the product. It was very rich, creamy, and is very moisturizing. I have actually tried it as a hand cream and it worked amazing.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: The best skin care discovery in a long time for me. I am very bad at wearing sunscreen on my face, typically annoyed at over oily, breakout causing, sticky mess in a lotion bottle.... that is, until I found this product. This has become the favorite part of my makeup routine every day now. It feels like soft clouds caressing my face when applied, drying down to the perfect texture to be worn with or without makeup. I have tried pairing this with three foundations, and have noted that it actually made the foundation stay longer and no added oil by the end of the day. After starting to use this, I get compliments on my skin at work. A little goes a long way. I would say I use about 1/2mL each use (give or take), so with daily use, this bottle would provide 100 applications.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a basic cleanser that does what it is suppose to do. Great for sensitive skin. This cleanser does not dry out or break out my skin. Will purchase again.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_title: Nice peel at a nice price.
reviews.review_text: Great product at a great price. I use this twice a week with the No Brainer set by the Ordinary and have seen very positive results. It can tingle at first (do not use over broken skin), but that goes away. One bottle lasts me quite awhile. The only reason I deducted 1 star was because the red color and viscosity of the solution makes it kind of messy.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: Lovely general use moisturizer. In the am and pm I use a serum and follow-up with this product (I have normal to combination, acne-prone skin). After a few minutes, the product settles in to the skin nicely. I have found this product sits under my foundation nicely. The moisturizer is slightly thicker, but I don’t find it heavy. I use it now in the winter and will probably also use in the summer. I suffer from very acne-prone skin, and have not had any issues with using this product.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is a great addition to my skincare routine, and has helped greatly in soothing and controlling my adult acne. I typically use this mask after my post-workout shower. The mask has a wonderful cooling affect which feels nice after cardio. Pre-mask I use a cleanser (or cleansing oil followed by a cleanser). Post-mask I use a Niacinamide + Copper serum and a moisturizer with HA. That routine has proven to work to reduce new acne from forming, ease lingering red spots, and heal any active acne. I find myself reachung for this mask over my other AHA+BHA treatments/masks. Unlike those products, this product has been much gentler on my skin, and for me, this product has been more proactive/productive. Note that this mask is of a gel like consistency that can range slightly in both consistency (some batches being slightly more gel and some a little more liquidy) and color (ranging from blue to dark green). This is normal for this product. The smell is not my favorite, and I found it quite pungent for the first couple uses, but I’m better able to tolerate it now. It doesn’t smell bad, just different.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: When I was getting the perk facial in store they used one of these acne dots on a breakout I was having and it was seriously like the before and after pictures they use for marketing. It went from being a pretty large zit to completely flat, I was amazed and I’m definitely going to pick them up.

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_text: I don’t use this on my face because I’m quite oily but I actually use this on my nails! It’s absolutely wonderful to keep the cuticles moisturized so they don’t get dry and flaky. It’s been a game changer for my nails and this product will last at least a year just for manicures and pedicures.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This is the most beautiful lip balm/lip gloss. It so comfortable and not sticky and the berry color gives the perfect sheer color that looks good without makeup and for natural makeup days.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing eye cream! I use it night and day and it wears great under makeup.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: This is a product I can never go without, I put it on every night and it is absolutely amazing! I have combination skin that gets super dry in the winter and this is a life saver.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this all in one lactic acid treatment for a few days now and the one thing that is most noticeable is how soft my skin has gotten. Before I started using it I made sure to pay attention to how the pores looked on my nose and chin as the product claims to target those in addition to reducing the look of fine lines and wrinkles. With that said, I have noticed how my nose pores specially have cleared up, the ones in my chin look like they need more time but I’m definitely starting to see a difference. Overall my skin does look and feel nicer and in a way rejuvenated. I’ll continue using it until the bottle is empty. The product  was gifted by Sunday Riley but my thoughts on it are genuine.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I’ve been consistently using the avocado Ceramide serum for the past two weeks to help mostly with the mild redness on my face. I’ve noticed that it does help reduce the redness but I’m still waiting for it to help with the dry spots though I think that might take a little longer. Overall I like the serum and will continue using it. It absorbs quickly into the skin and does not leave my face feeling sticky like other serums I’ve used in the past. Ive also applied makeup (after moisturizer and primer) and it did not affect the finished look. Thought I would mention that because in the past I would never wear makeup whenever I applied serum since I thought it would somehow affect the outcome. In regards to scent, it has a slight scent to it but not overpowering at all.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has a thick consistency and when you first apply it, it feels sticky. If you give it a couple of minutes, it will absorb into the skin and feel like it’s not there anymore when used by itself. I also layered it with other products, essence, serum and then moisturizer and though once again the end result was a beautiful glow, non greasy looking but as expected I do feel the product sitting on my face but not in a bad way. It’s layered so I wouldn’t expect the moisturizer to dry up completely. I felt the need to say that so that hopefully others who felt it’s too sticky and greasy will realize that it doesn’t stay like that at all. My initial reaction was to immediately ditch the product but I’m glad I allowed it to absorb into my skin and gosh now I love it. Its very rich texture is what my face needs! I have combination skin and it works great for me, though I’m not sure I would recommend to someone with oily skin. In addition to that, I’d like to point out that a small amount goes a long way, this is not a moisturizer that requires you to apply large amounts as other moisturizers I have tried before.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Ive been using this serum for a few days and I love it. It’s lightly scented, but not over powering at all. It dries fairly quickly and does not leave a sticky residue. If you look at the first picture, you’ll notice some skin dullness but on the second picture my face is glowy and full of life after using it consistently day and night for about a week. Definitely recommend it. For reference I have combo skin.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This is such a great moisturizer for those that want the extra hydration without looking or feeling oily. My skin got a bit dry because I over exfoliated (too many times a week) and this unscented face cream quickly got rid of the dryness.I’ve tried so many face creams that I can now easily differentiate the good ones from the crowd and this is definitely a 10/10 for me! I definitely recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This is such a great moisturizer for those that want the extra hydration without looking or feeling oily. My skin got a bit dry because I over exfoliated (too many times a week) and this unscented face cream quickly got rid of the dryness.I’ve tried so many face creams that I can now easily differentiate the good ones from the crowd and this is definitely a 10/10 for me! I definitely recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this sunblock for a few weeks now and have used it when I go to the beach. Though I have forgotten to reapply, surprisingly I have not gotten sunburned.It’s oil free, but in my experience I didn’t find it up be matte finish, nonetheless I still like it a lot.You won’t regret purchasing it.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a very luxe, rich, emollient type eye cream that in my opinion really moisturizers the eye area. I’m very picky about eye creams and have a very hard time finding one that I feel actually works. This one does. I have been using it on my husband and myself for 10 days, and it promises a reduction in fine lines even in one week!! My husband has deep smile wrinkles at the corners, and we saw no difference at all in his wrinkles, but I have little “crinkle” lines under my eyes...a sort of “crepe” texture, from squinting, and I did notice a difference in those. They are smoother and my under eye area feels softer and plumper. I have used other eye creams that have similar results, for more than half the price of this cream, so even though I feel it did do what it promised, it is quite expensive. I took away one star for the price, and one star for fragrance. It has a lot!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Thick and creamy, very luxurious, as you would expect from Tatcha! Smells great but a little strong.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Thick and creamy, very luxurious, as you would expect from Tatcha! Smells great but a little strong.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: “Gifted by Glow Recipe” Really lovely Hyaluronic Acid Serum. I love that it has five weights of hyaluronic acid in it so that it reaches different levels of your skin. I usually don’t like Glow Recipe products due to fragrance but even though this has fragrance as the last ingredient, I truly smell nothing at all! My skin felt plump and moist after using for a week on damp skin. -1 star for unnecessary fragrance

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Fantastic cleanser. Gentle but effective! Gets everything off my face, and smells so clean!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser

reviews.review_title: Very nice but a bit soon for results
reviews.review_text: Received this complimentary for honest review. Love the applicator so much, as it reduces the tugging at the tender under eye skin that can often happen with fingers. The formula is creamy and smooth and contains both niacinamide and retinol for a good punch or power! I have super sensitive skin so have to be careful using this and use it every other night to avoid sensitivity. I like it a lot but haven’t seen huge results yet as it has only been about three weeks total.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Beautiful product and even a beautiful bottle! The product was given to me #complimentarybyfresh for my honest review. The serum is a thin, milky consistency and is meant to help plump and hydrate the skin as well as ease fine lines. I did find after ten days of use that my skin felt hydrated. I don’t like that it has linalool, limonene, and a couple other things that can be sensitizing though it did not cause me any trouble. It does seem pricey for what it is, but I enjoyed using it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Finally! My lips couldn’t wait any longer. My lips where dying to get smoother and hydrrated. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I can hear my face screaming “THANK YOU!”  After cleaning with this face was my skin feels fresh and smooth and brand new!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

reviews.review_text: I recently started my skincare routine and I already love this toner. I don’t know If I would want to try another one, this one feels good in my skin.

reviews.review_title: def recommend it! will buy it again!
reviews.review_text: i thought something this pretty is probably useless and only for gen z, but i was wrong!! this actually works! i have tried different moisturizer, but this really give your skin the extra hydration. and it does smell like watermelon, which i have no problem (cough cough harry styles). and yes, it gives you a very nice glow!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_title: broke me out. made me oily

reviews.review_title: lovely, moisturizing and doesn't give me acne!
reviews.review_text: amazing, smells like real honey. moisturizing but breathable. i have used many high end products, but this one really surprised me! will always keep one on my vanity desk!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: i was skeptical but now I am a believer
reviews.review_text: I didn’t believe the hype. I usually hate oil or oil based makeup remover because they either cause blurry vision and hard to remove completely, or they make my eyes sensitive or dry out my skin. For really stubborn eye makeup (like urban decay 24/7 eyeliner and Armani waterproof mascara)I’ve tried Lancôme eye biphase, channel eye makeup remover, bobbi brown’s, mary kay, Garnier micellar water, bioderma Michelle water, and tatcha makeup remover oil. Nothing worked as wonderfully as this one. No redness, no dryness, and makeup melts instantly so no too much rubbing. It goes away with water, or you can wipe it away. I will say make sure you really wash it off, which you can actually do that unlike cold cream… otherwise, you will have blurry vision. I only made that mistake the first time I used it. Now I only open my eyes if I feel complete clean when touching my eyelids. Trust me, this is The One. Look no further. Trust your friendly neighborhood perfectionist makeup maniac. P.S you don’t need double clean with this, but if you are ocd like me, double clean (follow up) with a regular face wash.Oh and I have combo acne prone fair skin.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_title: i use it on my dry neck since I am acne prone
reviews.review_text: It’s super lightweight but extremely hydrating and no greasy at all. I have acne prone skin so I don’t use it on my face after looking up the ingredients. But I use it on my neck and it’s amazing and very effective and  super affordable!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I had heard of Drunk Elephant but never tried it. I wish i wouldn’t have waited so long! I have combination skin, with stubborn dry patches that form in the winter. I have tried so many brands but I am certain Drunk Elephant is the one for my skin! Usually the other brands just temporarily resolve the dry patches only for them to come back the next day. I didn’t use this last night just to see if the dry patches would come back and they didn’t!! This is amazing! I no longer have to struggle with the gross dry patches under my foundation this winter.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I had heard of Drunk Elephant but never tried it. I wish i wouldn’t have waited so long! I have combination skin, with stubborn dry patches that form in the winter. Since using this line, my skin has never looked better! My husband actually noticed and asked me if I’m pregnant because my skin is “glowing”. I’m definitely NOT pregnant. Lol

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I had heard of Drunk Elephant but never tried it. I wish i wouldn’t have waited so long! I have combination skin, with stubborn dry patches that form in the winter. I have tried so many moisturizers for the dry patches on my cheeks and forehead and they just temporarily fix the problem. The patches come back the next day. NOT with this moisturizer! They are completely gone. This has saved my skin! I just wish the packaging wasn’t deceptive and fit the amount of product you actually get.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_title: My lips feel good even the day after applying!
reviews.review_text: I’ve used many lip balms and most of them just feel sticky and end up coming off within the first half hour. With this, I don’t have to reapply as often and my lips aren’t peeling and cracking like they usually do in the dry and cold Wisconsin winters. The only off putting thing about this is the price, but you do get a pretty good amount of product. The price also has me guarding it with my life instead of losing it like I usually lose my cheap lip balms.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have VERY dry skin in the winter due to living in Wisconsin aka the frozen tundra. My eyelids even get dry and that makes applying eyeshadow look horrible. I have been using this cream for a week now and my eyelids are no longer dry or getting flaky. My fine lines look a bit blurred as well. I definitely recommend this to anyone with dry eye area. The packaging is also great because it closes into itself so it’s perfect for travel. No mess!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I always want to like Fresh products because I like their ingredients and everything smells SO GOOD, but this face wash didn’t work for me. I have combo skin with zero history of acne/not prone to break outs, and this stuff made me break out within a week. I kept it around as a body wash and that seems to work better for me.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I’m very picky with my face washes— I have clear skin and want to keep it that way! This wash is great. The smell is clean and refreshing, and it doesn’t dry my skin out or make it oily. Origins might not be the trendiest brand right now, but it is very consistently good. I’m always trying new skincare products, and still come back to this every time (especially when a new product seems to mess things up, this wash seems to fix it). Coupling this wash with the Origins charcoal mask or GLAMGLOW youthmud mask is my favorite combination for keeping my skin clean and bright.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: This is a great no-frills mask. Doesn’t really smell like anything, does a great job of deep cleaning, and helps to make oily skin a little more matte. It’s not going to be some miracle cure for breakouts, but given a few days of use I’ve had success with it reducing zits by drying them up a bit. Probably not great to use when your skin is super dry, but I’ve never had a bad time with this mask either way. Been using for almost 15 years now, and will continue using for just as long.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_title: shut up and take my money
reviews.review_text: Skin has been regaining its regular supple texture again after a gross dry winter! This moisturizer is light, non-greasy, and goes well under make up and sunscreen. I buy in bulk because I never want to be without it again.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: This stuff is fantastic. I made sure to read a bunch of reviews on multiple websites, as well as The Ordinary’s instructions on their official site, and it completely works. My skin was getting weirdly dull and dry this winter, pores looking a mess too, and using this every other night works! I definitely diluted it with moisturizer the first few tries, but now my skin has no issues with direct application. Layering this under the 2% retinoid product, Indie Lee Squalane oil, and a good moisturizer has brought my skin back to life. I’m going to be buying this forever as far as I’m concerned.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: I really love this brand and am so thankful to have it in my life. I’ve been developing a couple sun spots that have progressively been getting darker throughout my 20s, and this is the only product to start to eliminate that. I use this every other night (the lactic acid is the other night product), and am having great results on the rest of my skin texture as well. I have generally good skin to start, and I appreciate products that keep it that way.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Got this as a sample and I’ve used it religiously. I originally used the Clinique charcoal wash but can’t go back after this. My pores went away and it smells like heaven without drying me out.

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: I received a free trial of the new CC cream from IT! and I am astonished by the results. It is long wearing and sheer perfection, I must say. I live in the arid, sunny desert and it is a must have! The sunscreen is a plus.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This was gifted by innisfree. It’s such a great cream. I love that it contains the ingredient Cica and that it is so full of moisture. It’s lightweight and keeps me procreated and SPF also keeps my skin looking young.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is a stellar product that left my skin feeling rejuvenated and brand new.  It went on smooth and felt so fresh and clean. My lines have diminished and I feel like my skin is flawless. This is a miracle product. This was gifted by Sunday Riley.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer

reviews.review_text: I’m really impressed with this. It doesn’t have much of a smell, it’s more of a lotion consistency than water like most toners, and it doesn’t block my pores which is a huge plus. I have cystic acne and dry spots, and it genuinely seems to be hydrating the dry spots enough to make them stop.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_title: Doesn't bead up on my face! Yay!
reviews.review_text: I’ll start by saying I don’t often write reviews. I have super dry skin and live in Arizona. Every moisturizer I’ve tried usually beads up on my face, even when I use very little of it. This is the only one I’ve ever found that actually sinks into my skin and stays where it’s supposed to. I think it’s also helping to clear up my cystic acne, another first for me. I think the price is worth it, you don’t have to use very much, so I could have gotten the smaller size (not the 1.68 oz) to start and been fine for quite awhile.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_title: If you're looking for a primer, yes. Sunscreen, no
reviews.review_text: If you’re looking for a makeup primer, this is totally it. If you’re looking for something with more of a sunscreen consistency, back away slowly. If you’ve ever tried Smashbox’s primers, the clear ones, I think it’s called photo finish, that’s exactly what this feels and looks like. I didn’t enjoy the silky feeling, however, I can see how it would be great for people who wear a full face and still want the protection. I just wasn’t a fan.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_title: Allergy and watery eyes, read me
reviews.review_text: I don’t really like writing reviews but I feel compelled to because I have super sensitive eyes and dry skin. My eyes are either constantly watery or itchy or otherwise irritated. I didn’t realize when I bought this, but it says on the label “our unique concentrated texture doesn’t migrate into your eyes.” They’re totally telling the truth on this one. Everything usually runs into my eyes, moisturizer, you name it, and my dry skin doesn’t usually let products sink in very well. This eye cream is heavily hydrating and pretty thick. I can definitely tell the difference in how moisturized my under eyes are. Also, my dark circles have diminished a little bit. Not something crazy, but definitely enough to notice. I’m 26. I attached a photo to show how thick it is and most of it has sunk in but I usually leave a thin layer over my under eyes before I sleep, I don’t rub it in at all. It eventually sinks in completely. A little goes a super long way because of how thick it is, I have the .5 oz jar and I’ve not made a dent in it after having it a week.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: I use it a little different
reviews.review_text: I think I use this a little differently than directed, but it seems super effective. I used it two weeks ago, three nights in a row. It does burn, but that’s going to happen with something that basically has acid in it. By the next week my skin was super flakey. By this week, the third week, I’ve definitely noticed a difference in acne scars and overall texture. It does give a plumping effect when you’re using it. For reference I have dry skin and suck at washing my face. If a product can make this much a difference for me with little effort, it feels worth the price. I also use Farmacy cleansing balm and Wishful honey balm. It seems to be a good combo of products. I would say the biggest thing to know is this product is strong, for me it’s more like a peel than a serum. I’ll use it again next week when my skin barriers back to normal. Definitely like the results. Four stars just because it’s freakishly expensive.

The smell is also very nice and soft so it won’t irritate you or anything like that!! The ONLY thing I wish It had was a pump but other than that I love it :)

reviews.review_title: love it but not a fan of the smell
reviews.review_text: I have extremely dry skin so this toner really put helped to hydrate my skin a lot more. It felt really sticky and weird when I got it into my hand but when you put it on your face it really just melts right in and makes your skin feel so soft and smooth! The only reason I’m giving it 4/5 stars is because the smell is just not something I like. It doesn’t really smell like watermelon? More like a cactusy spicy smell? Idk how to describe it. In general i loved the product and will buy again but the smell is just not what I expected.

reviews.review_text: I received this as a complimentary gift. My skin type is dry-sensitive. I feel my skin hydrated and soft and I’ve only been using it for a week. The best thing is that the skin absorbs it quickly and does not feel sticky. I try it with makeup and it doesn’t feel heavy. The only negative thing I can say is that it has a fragrance, but it is very light and pleasant.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this as a complimentary gift. My skin type is dry-sensitive. I feel my skin hydrated and soft and I’ve only been using it for a week. The best thing is that the skin absorbs it quickly and does not feel sticky. I try it with makeup and it doesn’t feel heavy.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: For me, it has a soft matte finish. I really like how lightweight the consistency is. Don’t leave me a white cast and not greasyfeeling.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This is a lightweight cream formula with a radiant dewy finish.I love how easy it blended into my skin. I also liked the scent of it, it is like a flowery scent. My skin is dry and it feels hydrating and leaves a nice luminosity without being sticky.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product complementary fromInfluenster and Estée Lauder in exchange for myhonest opinion. I had Estée Lauder repair eye supercharged complex in the past and really liked it. This product feels like a smooth silky gel version of that and perfect for dry skins. It does wonders for fine lines and reduces dark circles. It’s light, not greasy, hydrating and a little goes a long way. I have used it for about two weeks and can see the results already. I really love Estée Lauder eye repair products and this samplereminded me that I should buy them again.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Sunday Riley - I regularly use Vitamin C serum and have tried many different brands. This is one of the best ones that I have used. Those reviews that say it’s sticky should know that the products with high concentration of vitamin C are sticky. This is a serum you need to apply moisturizer right after it before letting it to completely dry. My only concern is that I think it’s on the pricey side.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Sunday Riley - This eye cream has a great depuffing effect. I have used it for a week now and I have noticed slight brightening in my dark circles as well. But I think the price is high for the amount.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely face base. My makeup looks amazing on this.  It is kind of  thick but a  little goes a long  way. It goes smoothly on my skin and my foundation looks amazong in it. It smells amazing as well.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is a lightweight exfoliating cream. I like that it’s lightweight and doesn’t dry out my skin but I haven’t noticed any improvements in my skin. I also think the price is quite high for the product.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This stuff WORKS. Miracle eye cream!!! Before I found this, I’ve never had an eye cream that produced ANY results (I buy high end luxury skincare). The price is right on this and it is SO hydrating.  I sometimes use Tarte Shape Tape for concealer, and it really dries out my under eye. This rehydrates and plumps the under eye OVER NIGHT. AMAZING PRODUCT!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Holy grail product. I started using Sunday Riley products approximately five years ago and my skin has completely transformed. I can wear zero makeup and my skin is glowing, dewy, and clarified. Good Genes brightens my skin and instantly plumps my fine lines. I always notice an immediate difference once GG soaks into my skin. The directions say two pumps - I use a half to one pump in the morning (let the product absorb for a minute or two) and continue with the rest of your skin routine. If I use the product at night (I wouldn’t use it in the morning that day) I will layer it on after I have let Luna absorb into my skin.  Get this product - you won’t regret it!!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Holy grail lip mask. This is the only lip product I have ever used that actually leaves my lips feeling nourished and revitalized (and I have used EVERYTHING). I struggle with chronic dry lips (likely from using liquid lips and matte lipstick formulas). This product immediately melts into your lips and when I wake up the product is actually STILL THERE. This product leaves my lips feeling smooth and healthy. I seriously will NEVER stop using this lip product.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This product is massively over hyped. There are so many other great products out there that will do so much more for this price. Maybe it is just me, but this  mask was very run of the mill with a generic drug store quality and results. I also do not like the packaging at all.

reviews.review_text: This product is massively over hyped. There are so many other great products out there that will do so much more for this price. Maybe it is just me, but this  mask was very run of the mill with a generic drug store quality and results. I also do not like the packaging at all.

reviews.review_text: Most unique facial moisturizing experience, with amazing results. The texture of this product is light and the scent is phenomenal. Pressing this into my skin feels like a splash of water on my face as the lotion essentially “bursts” into a hydration bomb. This product quickly absorbs and leaves the skin dewy and soft. I believe this product is perfect for humid climates. I love using this moisturizer before I apply primer when I am doing my makeup routine.

The product leaves a gray cast and feels heavy and extremely greasy (don’t think dewy). It didn’t absorb into my face and left my pores looking exaggerated. I hate when my skin flushes - but honestly my flushed face looks better bare than with this product. Unsure how it worked for so many people.

reviews.review_text: I was pleasantly surprised that this gel moisturizer worked for my skin type. Most products with salicylic acid make my skin dry out too much and this one didn’t! It is extremely hydrating and a little goes a long way. The texture is great and I like the packaging as well. Would definitely get this again.

reviews.review_text: This primer is excellent for the price point. It has a nice dewy, almost pearly finish and is very moisturizing. I did have trouble with some foundations sort of melting off of it because of how moisturizing it is but it’s still one of my go-to primers

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I was so hesitant because I have super dry lips and nothing has worked. STICK WITH IT! It took about 3 nights, and the first morning I woke up feeling more dry, but now they are super soft and juicy. The scent is also not overwhelming

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I usually avoid eye creams as they tend to make my eyelids really puffy like I’ve been crying. So when I saw this product was brightening and well as depuffing, I was intrigued. I’ve really been enjoying the product and it’s a rare eye product that doesn’t make my eye puffy. This product is also great for hydrating my eye area and hopefully preventing any future wrinkles while brightening the area as well. A little goes a long way which makes this pricey eye cream more worth it.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_title: Makes My Fine Forehead Wrinkles Disappear!
reviews.review_text: I love love this cream. It wasn’t initially on my list of skincare products to try due to the price but I’m glad I did. This is a thick heavy cream perfect for winter and/or dry skin. I have really dry skin so am always on the lookout for a thick hydrating cream with ceramides. I loved the results from this cream. I apply at night before bed and I wake up in the morning with visibly noticeable plump skin and reduced fine forehead wrinkles! I was not expecting such noticeable results from a cream but I love it. I know my fine lines are due to dehydration and this cream addresses all those issues. The cream has a slight fragrance but it’s pleasant. It also comes with a cute small spoon to scoop out the cream hygienically.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Hydrating and moisturizing, what more can you ask for from a facial cream? I have dry skin and really enjoy using this facial cream with squalane in it. It is a heavier cream in texture but doesn’t feel heavy on the face. It absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave my skin greasy. I still enjoy using it during our hot Socal summers. My skin feels great when I use this cream and the effects are long-lasting. I don’t feel any tightness until the next time I wash my face. I also find that this makes my skin feel softer and helps fill in fine lines by hydrating my skin. I like that there is squalane in here as I’m always trying to incorporate highly effective ingredients and have heard great things about squalane.

This cleanser never makes my skin feel dry, plus it’s a natural product! Highly recommend you try this product, it’s worth the money and the bottle is quite large!

Highly recommend this moisturizer over the other drunk elephant one if you have very dry or combination skin.

reviews.review_text: This makes my skin feel so hydrated and makes it look so smooth. It keeps it glowing and better hydrated. The texture and blend-ability seems very typical.  It does seem lightweight and does not make my skin greasy. I can’t wait to see if this helps my skin over time.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I love Supergoop!, and this product is no exception. I would say if you are between this and the other Supergoop! products, the clear ones are better and smoother as opposed to this since it is tinted. However, if you are looking for a tinted sunscreen, this is definitely one of the best options!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is not watery like other luxurious moisturizers and it works very well so i would definitely continue using!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I have received samples in the past, and I always go into it with an open mind, but typically end up not seeing much of a difference. That was not the case here!! Not only did I notice a difference, but I noticed it quickly! Within less than a week, my pores were tighter and smaller. I have extremely large pores, so I figured nothing could help them. Though this is a large price tag, I feel it’s worth it and definitely will splurge for this when I run out. If you have big pores like me, this is for you!! Bonus - it caused no breakouts and had no negative side effects.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is honestly a game changer! I have been using it nightly, and my bags have been less dark and less deep. Makeup goes on so smoothly, and I feel like it’s honestly made a huge difference. The price tag is steep, but well worth it. I received this complimentary for testing purposes, but I would definitely buy it.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I really like that my dry skin seemed to be smoothed out by this product. I liked that it is just two wipes, and so easy to use. I wouldn’t recommend it for daily use, as it does burn slightly, but afterwords, my skin was like a smooth canvas. I purchased some already. Very excited about these.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: This eye cream went on smoothly, and seemed to brighten my undereye area. I love, and for the price, definitely worth it!

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: My skin is brighter softer and healthier looking with this amazing serum. It’s very Moisturizing too.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A celebrity product that lives up to the hype. The king of all moisturizers. I used to travel all hours away to get it and it’s soo addicting to put on I have to stop myself because it’s pricey but worth every penny

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A celebrity product that lives up to the hype. The king of all moisturizers. I used to travel all hours away to get it and it’s soo addicting to put on I have to stop myself because it’s pricey but worth every penny

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: Wow!! Received a sample of this and instantly I noticed results. I forgot what a difference younger fuller skin makes this helped me remember. I can’t wait to get a full size.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: If you like thick creams this is definitely for you . I personally love thick creams gel moisturizers aren’t moisturizing to me personally. It takes a little rubbing in to absorb but that’s fine with me . The consistency is a bit like butter . Love this stuff

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I recieved this as a free product, it was 7 day trial pack. it was gel oily kind of consistency but after application it absorbed pretty well. I had few rashes on my face from another product but this worked well and it helped me recover pretty well. Maybe if I had used it for long time I could say something about wrinkles but it hydrates well and leaves skin brighter. I love Clarins product.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I recieved this eye cream as a #freeproduct from #topboxcircle. As i got a very small sachet so it was hard tot tell but it absorbed pretty well. I used it in the nights anf next morning i dint feel any puffiness and less visible lines.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I recieved this #freeproduct and i loved using correcting cream as it was light skin like feel. This cream worked for me it did brighten up my face and did work for wrinkle.Clinique is a great brand.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I recieved this as a #freeproduct from #topboxcircle and i loved it this serum does reduce the wrinkles and brighten up face. I used it in the morning and evenings. It is not sticky and settles well onto your skin.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Great product! Especially for my first experience.
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Sunday Riley is a new brand to me, this is the first product of their’s I’ve tried and wow! I absolutely love the smooth texture and it glides with a good slip. I’m not seeing too much of a difference thus far as fine lines but my overall texture has improved along with the brightness. Hopefully that’ll help with my fine lines with continued use. Oh and it smells so good!! 2 pumps covered my entire face, neck , and décolletage thoroughly. I’d recommend this to anyone looking for a great Lactic Acid Treatment to brighten and tighten! Mahalo!! Xoxo

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Sunday Riley is a somewhat new product line to me, I’ve experienced a few products but I’m absolutely obsessed with their new Retinoid Complete Eye Serum makes my eyes feel so good and hydrated too! Of course I like the packaging and application, squeeze tubed. Perfect for just the right amount of serum to coat your entire eye area. It’s a great one and a great size as well!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This was my first experience with Bobbi and I have to say I’m pleasantly surprised (I went on their website and ordered a bunch of products) and beyond grateful to experience this Vitamin packed Primer! It’s so good! Plus it’s a moisturizer and primer in one she fills pores, blurs subtle lines and definitely makes my skin feel good and ready for makeup! Can be used with or without but a day moisturizer is a better deal, plus it’ll last longer. Either way she does what it says and feels great. As for my makeup longevity, it was great! I’ll be repurchasing her! Fabulous 2 in one formula!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I thankfully got to try Freshes newest serum call T. elixir skin resilience activating serum which is exactly what it is because I really love James skin feels after using this and alone overnight. She kept my skin hydrated and plump throughout the night cause I’m the morning, My skin was just growing and hydrated I love it!

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: This is my go-to daytime moisturizer for summer! I love the way it absorbs into my skin and dries down. It doesn’t leave your skin feeling greasy or sticky, it dries down and my skin just feels so smooth and perfect. I pair this with my C-Firma from drunk elephant daily and I can’t tell you how glowy and perfect my skin looks throughout the day!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was shocked by how hydrating this is. If you have dry skin you need this! It’s perfect for winter and it smells like honey which is amazing. Just found my favorite new moisturizer for sure

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried MANY cleansers and I always come back to this one. It is pricey but it’s worth it in my opinion. Love it for my dry skin

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I actually really enjoy this product! My skin is so glowy the morning after I apply it. I only need one drop of it to cover my entire face which is nice

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: I heard such great things about this but the day after I used this my skin was so dry, flaky, and irritated. My cheeks were so red and my skin honestly hurt. I just couldn’t put it on again. I don’t even have sensitive skin either and I’m not sensitive to retinol. Not sure what happened here but it definitely wasn’t for me. A lot of people swear by this though.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: I heard such great things about this but the day after I used this my skin was so dry, flaky, and irritated. My cheeks were so red and my skin honestly hurt. reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary through Influenster and ALL opinions and review are my honest opinion. My first impression on this serum is wow! Sinks right into the skin and gives a plump dewy feel. I’ve been using x2 daily and my skin feels super hydrated! As a first impression I’m loving it. Will update as I use for x4 weeks! So far so good!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: After using these for one night I’m so impressed! As soon as I woke up I needed to review. You wake up and see a little spot where the product pulled out of all the nasty stuff and when you remove it the pimple is completely flat! It’s not going to take away the acne mark itself that needs time to heal obviously, but it completely removes the active pimple! AMAZING holy grail product.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: Honestly 10/10. Only use 1-2 pumps or it will over saturate your skin. When used correctly this is a miracle! I received this product complimentary for review. All opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: This is a 10/10. I prefer the bottle formulation over the tub. I suffer from severe eczema and dry patches on my eyes and cheeks and this literally healed it in less than 2 days!!! It’s literally a miracle. Absolutely fabulous for dry sensitive skin. I’ve tried it all and this has to be the best.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is actually going to be my new summer cream! The light gel like consistency is quickly absorbed and leaves the skin super smooth. I highly recommend to use with toner - a power duo. I’ve noticed that my uneven skin caused by dry spots is slowly disappearing after a couple day and nights using the cream. Happy I found this in time for summer!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: This really does purify your skin!  I am someone who suffers with milia and uneven skin texture - so I was surprised how well this product worked in feeding my skin hydration while not irritataring it. The smell is so fresh and feels super light weight. I’m genuinely surprised with how well this works - I would recommend! Think I found a new toner to add to the routine.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_title: It’s like an at home spa in a bootle!
reviews.review_text: With everything thing being closed, this is exactly what my skin needed! It’s feeling so fresh and smooth! I really enjoyed this product- a great one!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask

reviews.review_text: I’ve had super dry skin my whole life and am always in search of moisturizing products. I love how easy this mask is to use! Just apply it like moisturizer and you’re good to go. Keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day and smells amazing!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Been recently getting more into sunscreen and was super stoked to try this one out! The smell is amazing and not too overpowering. Definitely worth it if you’re looking for an awesome and pretty sunscreen!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: This is what I always wanted. I have found it.
reviews.review_text: This is the one for me. I’ve tried everything for my dry raw cracked lips. And now I’ve found my cure. I love this balm. I use it every night. my lips are gorgeous now.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Love my Good Genes. A little dab will do you!
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff. I even love the smell. It doesn’t bother me one bit. I use it with Luna almost every night. I find using tiny drops of this keeps it from overwhelming my skin while still giving that refreshed glow in the morning. I may switch to something Ordinary when this runs out, but I bet I’ll be back again.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides

reviews.review_text: My favorite go to face cream. It’s thick and moisturizing without being heavy or greasy. Makes my skin look so much better

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary product from Influenster to test and review!First impression:Packaging is very simple, nice, and elegant. Upon opening it, the interior packaging is so luxurious and well thought out! I love that the packaging features a pull tab to help you transit the bottle out of the box. I love that they include a rice paper tape to show that’s it hasn’t been tampered with. The bottle feels lux and looks great on your vanity.First Impression Upon UseWOW is all I can say, Tatcha really nailed the design of the bottle and thought of everything! I love their nozzle that drips the essence out and onto your hands. It doesn’t waste any product and makes dispensing it mess free! Other essences I’ve used such as SKII and Time Revolution doesn’t have it, and now I really wish they would! After patting the essence onto my face I feel it instantly softening my skin.After a week of useMy skin is so much more plump, hydrated, and soft! I paired this with the Tatcha Vitamin C serum as well and oh my god my face is really just glowing! I religiously have a day and night skincare routine that I follow as well and typically use Deciem’s The Ordinary. I feel like I don’t get as quick of results as with Tatcha and that’s amazing! I highly recommend this product, it is on the pricier side but it is def worth it! Unboxing is also quite the experience. Great job Tatcha!

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I didn’t believe in eye creams until this bad boy came along! I got a small version of it in one of their holiday packages and noticed a difference almost immediately. My dull dry undereyes came alive and now I’m hooked! I just finished my smaller 5ml bottle so purchased this full size one. I am impressed that a little goes a long way, especially when you’re paying this amount. Highly recommend getting a sample and seeing if it works for you after using it for just a week!

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: I spent a fortune on a chemical peel and just a couple days of using A-Passioni made me see better results than my expensive peel! Be warned though, if you want a deep exfoliation/peel you can use it a couple days in a row and then a couple days later will feel the burning and the peeling. If you DON’T want that, then just use a tiny bit of this product and I recommend mixing it with a moisturizer like LaLa Retro and easing it into your nightly routine every other day. I now use it nightly. Don’t forget your spf in the daytime!

Only need a few drops, but if I accidentally squeeze out more than I need, I just use the rest on my hands (especially around my cuticles). I have bought 3 bottles so far and am not looking back
