reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I am a huge fan of the Tatcha water cream and was excited to try this to see how this product compared and I was not disappointed! At first I noticed that this cream has a very similar texture to the Tatcha Water Cream but I would say that this product is even more hydrating. It applies smoothly and melts right into your skin. After applying this product my skin felt instantly (and I mean instantly) refreshed and hydrated! It has a cooling effect on the skin and caused no irritation.The fact that this product is clean is a huge bonus as well! I use this product as a nighttime moisturizer as I worry it may be a little too heavy for daytime use. I’ve been pairing this with Belif’s Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner and I have seen a HUGE improvement in my skin. I have had dry patches for several years and very few products have helped but I can say with certainty that this works!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_title: The product I didn't know I needed!
reviews.review_text: I have pretty good skin (no blemishes) and didn’t see the need for toner in the past because of that! I was excited to try this toner since it is hydrating and I do have dry skin and it definitely provided extra hydration to my routine! The toner takes off any oils or makeup that were still left on after cleansing which is a huge win in my books! It leaves your skin feeling super clean and refreshed which is the perfect way to start or end your day! I followed this product with Belif’s True Cream Aqua Bomb and I have seen a significant improvement with the dryness on my skin! I definitely recommend this product for anyone with dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: I have been using this moisturizer day and night for about three weeks and my skin has been loving it! I have dry skin and it was hydrating enough for me and I did not experience any reaction or breakouts. It is extremely refreshing and I find it wakes me up in the morning! That is the standout feature of this product for me. I didn’t notice any dramatic results with my pores, but there may be some slight improvement there. Taking away one star for the price point only since it is rather pricey.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the typical hyaluronic texture which is watery, bouncy and soothing. The product is clear and spreads easily and absorbs quickly. It feels good on my skin and it layers nicely with other serums. Would def recommend as your can’t beat the price! I received this complimentary

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this product for its texture, color, and scent. It smelt clean and efficacious but not overpowering. It smooths on easily over other products and it feels light so it’s nice even for oily or combination skin. The only con of this product is that the product claims are not super compelling for example the moisture boost I have seen competitors with higher results.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I work in the beauty industry and have tried MANY crèmes. This creme is a holy grail. It has a transformative texture that spreads easily and smoothly all over skin. Doesn’t tug at all and a little bit goes a long way. My skin feels super plumped, hydrated and smooth. The smell is also beautiful, and not too heavy.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this sunscreen lotion!! First off, the smell is good. Even though it does have undertones of the chemical sunscreen smell, the main scent is more citrus-like orange. It is soft to put on and not too greasy. It goes on more like a serum than a thick sunscreen. It blended into my skin really well and there was none of that dreaded “white“ cast. I tried it in the winter so I didn’t get much opportunity to try the heat reaction but it worked well when I was outside an hour plus. Lastly, it lasted quite awhile. I put it on at 3 pm and when I washed my face at 9 pm it was still there. Solid choice for sunscreen!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen stick is my favorite convenient sun protection yet! It goes on very smooth and isn’t sticky or greasy. There is also no scent so it almost feels like you’re not wearing anything. I put it on my tattoos on my arms so they stay nice and vibrant. This is a really great option to keep in your purse and reapply as needed without worrying about liquid spilling in the purse . I really recommend this!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Influenster and Tatcha be sent me this to try out and WOW! I’m so glad they did! First off, the packaging just screams luxury- the heavy, smooth weight of the glass and the spout that controls product dispensed so you don’t end up with a huge amount in your palm. It has no smell which is great for a product that goes on before moisturizer. I struggle with dry skin and I felt like this did help keep my thirsty skin more moisturized for longer. I’m not sure if I saw a huge difference in “plumpness“ and wrinkles but that’s not a huge concern to me at this moment in life. Overall I’m really happy with this product! I also feel like it will last for awhile because the top prevents over pouring . Win-win!!

reviews.review_text: I have gone through one full bottle of this product on and off in the past year or so. I certainly notice a difference in my skin when I am using it - it feels more balanced, smooth, and hydrated. Overall this is a great addition to your skincare routine if you can fit it into your budget, but I do not feel that is it necessary (especially given the price).

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The texture of this cleanser is really interesting, which is one of the reasons I like it - it is very gel-like and doesn’t seem to foam or sud as much as other cleansers I have used. It is gentle and does a decent job of cleaning, but that is about it. There are no additional benefits I see from this product. It gets the job done, but I have found more value from oil cleansers. I will say this is a huge bottle and lasted me nearly a year!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: These literally got rid of pimples overnight! They are pricy but if  this product is within your budget, give ’em a try!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is amazing! It is great for almost every skin type, and age group. It is hydrating but not greasy or watery. If you are oily DO NOT BE SCARED  of the words “intense hydration“ it won’t break you out or make you too oily, and if you are dry it still provides enough daily hydration. I used to have a very complicated skin care routine filled with oils and serums and scrubs for my oily skin. Once I committed to using this as my only moisturizer I saw a huge change. Now this is part of a two or three step skin care routine I do every day which is a big change from my previous seven/eight steps. There is no secret to this product, no special protein from the sea or water gathered from the purest cloud or something, it is just simple plain ingredients. If you don’t like the pot they also sell it in a squeezy tube. As moisturizers go, this is really reasonably priced! The pot or tube lasts forever so the cost per use is brought down to pennies.  If you are even mildly considered it, regardless of age or skin type I would definitely recommend giving it a try. TL/DR 10/10 would recommend to ANYONE

reviews.review_text: This is a good product, I’ve gone through two jars but it doesn’t play nice with all makeup. If you don’t wear makeup or have the time to figure out what make up will work with it then definitely try it, but it’s too expensive for me to not be able to use it every day.

reviews.review_text: This broke me out really bad, but my mother (50 ) loves it and I have to say, her makeup looks glowy and great

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Superb balm, it does it all! It’s pretty expensive for 0.35oz of lip balm but a lovely treat!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I can’t say anything bad per se, but the price does not seem worth the payoff.  I feel as though the name has gotten so much press and attention that one is expected to find their skin changed after using these products, but I actually laid down a couple hundred on 5 of them on a whim and it did not make a difference in my skin as compared to other products.  Quite frankly, I think my belif bomb is better than this as far as moisturizerizing and softness.  I’m afraid I bought into the hype, which in my opinion is NOT worth $300 a month  if you were to keep up with all of the basic products.  And as great as I’ve heard this company is, I don’t trust a scheme that preaches you should only use their products to get a response from your skin.  I’ve actually started using Ordinary products and love that their site encourages you to purchase other products that you happen to love.  My skin is doing well on the their HA cream and buffet alone!!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Now I know why I kept buying failing foundation...
reviews.review_text: I have spent the past year purchasing foundation after foundation looking for something to sit well on my skin.  My old foundation just quit on me and I decided to find a replacement.  I’ve literally spent at least a grand (maybeore??!) on different foundations over the past year and some were ok and others just terrible (I returned the terrible but it was time consuming).  I just went back to return yet another foundation that had received almost perfect reviews but failed miserably and found a different employee in the store.  I’ve asked about my primer being the problem in the past and never received a definitive response- was merely shown even more foundations.  Well, this employee recommended that I NOT purchase the next foundation and try this instead.  My prayers were answered!! This has solved my dry aging skin foundation dilemma!! I am 43 with quite good skin, but it’s soooo dry... but with this on my skin, my huge collection of “ok“ foundations started performing big time.  My problem was lack of a sufficiently hydrating primer, even though my collection of other primers were dubbed “hydrating.“ What a difference! I didn’t realize this was even meant to be used as a primer but it has just given me the ability to use, with confidence, the 15 or so foundation products I’ve decided to keep “just in case“!! And it provides staying power.  I am so impressed, mostly with the fact that this is not outrageously expensive.  I’ve paid double for far worse.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I am amazed at how much this has made my foundations go on smoother.  I’ve suffered from dry skin for a long time and was always told to exfoliate, but have been doing so with chemicals.  After another bad patch of trying to find foundations that would work with my skin, I decided to try a daily exfoliator- something I could use in the morning, instead of at night- and found this.  I’ve been using it for 5 days now and they have been the best 5 make up days of my life!! This along with the First Aid coconut primer have literally changed my “make-up“ life.  And I love make-up.  This will become a daily product for me forever.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I really really have appreciation for Geneifique. Immediate skin softening results. And really a multi Tasker. add some to foundation or just wear alone. I definitely trust this brand and the importance of a product like this maybe missed.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Sunday Riley and Wow, a stable 3 in 1 lactic Acid treatment. My skin went from looking a little dull, to glow and smooth and as texture free as glass. I’m so delighted that this treatment can be used as a mask, bc I love masks. This is such a creamy mask it was a much needed innovation in the mask space.  This is low to very natural scent. And such a fast mask. Just 15 minutes and done.  It’s also the most gentle lactic acid mask I have used. Recovery time was like zero seconds and soothed by lotion. I’ve asked around about using this as a daily, and the gals said it’s great, but I personally use it as a mask.  Soft texture free skin for days.  I’m holding back,but I will most likely be replacing my current fav peel for this.  It’s so so good.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Gentle and Great Results eye serum
reviews.review_text: it’s 5 Stars for  Texture Tuesday. This under eye serum is awesome. It’s not drying which seems like a huh? fact about Retinol, but the nicinimide really brings on the moisture lock in. I love that. It does it’s job w/o night cream hush, don’t tell anyone I skipped to test this. My favorite part is my under eyes seemed to not look darker either. The texture feels light on the skin and glides on smooth, but the effects are still there in the morning.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_title: Good Product, But Not Worth It
reviews.review_text: This is a good exfoliator. It has a unique thick, creamy texture but you can still feel it exfoliating your skin. I took off a star because of the price. I have used some really nice exfoliators for a MUCH lower price. I just don’t think there’s enough of a difference to want to pay that much more. I also can’t help but think about & be TOTALLY creeped out by certain other products from this company every time I see the brand name on the front. I took another start off for this.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster & Tatcha in exchange for my honest review. I can’t believe I was blessed with such an amazing, high-end product! First of all, this is a big bottle! I’d be intrigued to see how big the larger size looks! Before trying this, I thought, how different could this product be from other serums & treatments that cost about half this price? Well, I tried it & found out! It is a liquid consistency with an almost silky feel. It leaves skin feeling extra smooth, silky, & healthy, on a level that other serums & treatments don’t compare to! It also does better than others to help absorb & amplify other products. The shape of the dispenser is pretty cool too! It is a slanted hard silicone spout (for lack of a better word), which is shaped where it can fit comfortably in your hand out even directly on your face. I can’t afford to always buy this, but I would definitely buy it if it goes on sale or as an occasional splurge! I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received this for free from Influenster & Shiseido in exchange for my honest review. This is a great sunscreen but it’s not unique/special enough to pay this much for it, which is why I only have it 4 stars. I really need an SPF of at least 100 (I’m literally the color of snow) but it’s nice to have any level of spf around! A few weeks ago, my mom & I painted my grandmother’s front door and I had just received this voxbox. I used that as my first opportunity to try these sunscreens (this one & the other similar one they sent along with it) out. They can be used on the face or body. I put some on under my makeup, as well as on my arms, legs, chest, neck, shoulders, & ears. These sunscreens worked as well as any other sunscreen, but I didn’t see anything special or unique about them. I’d personally rather just buy the Equate brand clear spray-on sunscreen in spf 100, which is WAY cheaper & has the level of spf I need.

reviews.review_text: I really love this cleansing balm. It has a fresh scent, is gentle, and removes makeup and impurities really well. The scoop included is also super handy. This product will be in my skincare routine for years to come.

reviews.review_text: I really love this cleansing balm. It has a fresh scent, is gentle, and removes makeup and impurities really well. The scoop included is also super handy. This product will be in my skincare routine for years to come.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This is a great balm that gets rid of impurities and makeup easily. No fragrance so it kind of smells like old playdoh to me but I could get past it. There is no scoop included so you have to use your fingers or get your own tool. Be careful of using this to remove eye makeup as your vision will be cloudy afterwards for a couple minutes. Eye drops can offset this quickly. I finished the entire container but will not repurchase only because of the smell. If you have sensitive skin and need something no fuss this is a great option.

reviews.review_text: This is a great clay mask that helps remove impurities. As one review recommended, I keep this on my face for an hour. It is a bit messy to remove but most clay masks are. I always see an improvement in my skin after using. It is also a great price.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Adore this product. I was having really deep blemishes and just generally lousy feeling skin. I saw a huge improvement in the texture and clarity of my skin with regular use of this serum.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this product. I was having sporadic, very deep and painful blemishes, and tried this product on a whim. It cleared up my skin so well. The texture is light and doesn’t leave a residue, but takes a while to work into the skin. I started with the smaller bottle and have since bought the bigger one when my first was finished. Price point is also amazingggggg.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is fantastic. The first few times I used it, there was a VERY strong, almost alarming tingle. My typically sensitive skin didn’t freak out at all though and looks amazing. The texture is so much smoother and brighter. I repurchased after finishing my first bottle because I loved it so much.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_title: Great price for a Good Product
reviews.review_text: This works well to leave my skin glowy and soft, and the price is great.  The texture could be better, so I mix it with another serum I use to improve it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Really hydrating, this product stays on over night and gives my lips a really plump and hydrated look in the morning

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I got this as a testing sample, and I was quite cautious at first, as I use retinol and didn’t want to give that up when adding an AHA.  I’m not totally clear on what the strength is, but based on my skin’s response, I think this is quite a strong AHA, and I needed to use it only every second day.  It’s a bit drying, but with the complete skin care routine I use, I was able to add this to my route, and have the extra exfoliation without adverse effects.  If you are looking for a new AHA, this is a simple one without a lot of extra frills (I consider that a good thing, as many companies add a ton of essential oils, fragrance and other things that can cause additional irritation, or reduce the effectiveness of the product.) Overall, I kept this in my routine, it’s a good price point compared to other brands, and it’s effective.  I bumped it down one star as it’s not easy to use a small amount and I think it would be more easily used as a gel.  I went through it pretty quickly as using it with cotton means you waste a lot of product and go through it really quickly.

reviews.review_text: This brightened my undereye area and helped reduce the puffiness I have been experiencing.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: This makes my skin feel so soft and smooth.  My face stays feeling moisturized all day long.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer!  I love that this moisturizer doesn’t have a scent and doesn’t feel heavy on my face.  I use it at night because there isn’t SPF in it, and I prefer a moisturizer with SPF for use during the day.  This has improved the look and feel of my skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I receives this free for review from Influenster and Tatcha. I have already been using Tatha for years! It is my favorite brand and keeps my skin clear. I was happy to add this to my skin care line up. Perfect for keeping my face hydrated in the winter in the midwest! The formula is very light weight too!

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: This ws received complimentary from Paulas Choice. This is a cult classic for a reason. Affordable and works! Kept my skin clean and no irritation, I see this being good for all skin types, mine is mildly sensitive.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received the Rose & Hyaluranic Acid Deep Hydration Reformulation complimentary for review. This is great for hydrating with out any irritation to the skin. Amazing addition to Fresh and glad to add it to my summer skin routine.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing eye cream if your goal is to combat dry, crepey, aging skin under the eyes. The texture is super silky and luxurious and the smell is reminiscent of a 5 star spa. It is a little bit on the thicker side, so you only need a tiny bit for both eyes. Most fine lines under the eye are caused by dehydration, so this product will make a dramatic difference pretty much instantly because it is just that moisturizing. I noticed the most dramatic difference though to the upper lid area, below the brow to the crease. It pretty much  completely transformed my skin in that area and it feels so much tighter and firm. I’m in love with this eye cream and will continue to purchase. I did receive this product complimentary from Influenster, but I reviewed honestly and critically.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: So the packaging of this product is beautiful and the glass bottle looks wonderful sitting on my vanity. I also like that there is a pipette to dispense the product as it prevents waste. The serum itself is super light and smells divine. My skin felt very hydrated and looked very dewy and glowy. My fine lines appeared diminished and my skin was nice and plump. I think the serum can be used for day or night, but daytime was my preference as it also makes a great primer. Definitely recommend and will be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely loved this eye cream. It’s super moisturizing and immediately made my under eye area lool a lot less crepey. It also dried down to a nice tacky finish which worked perfectly under my day time makeup. What I liked most about this eye cream though was the consistency. It’s almost like a creamy gel and it really does sink in and plump up the fine lines. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This stuff is so amazing and I’ve only used it one time! My lips get so chapped and dry all through out the year, especially in the winter. I’m always going through chap sticks and reapplying chap stick numerous times throughout the day. I applied this last night before going to bed. I know it says to wipe off the excess in the morning, but there was nothing there and it looked fine so I didn’t wipe my lips off. Let me tell you I’ve only had to apply chapstick once today, amazing! Can’t wait to see what the results are like in a few weeks. I’d definitely repurchase this. Also it smells great!

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: doesn’t really do too much for me. I got the smaller size and you don’t get that many uses out of it. the product gets used up very quickly

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I don’t break out that often, but when I do.. it’s bad. I get spots on my chin and under my nose. I figured I would give these shot. My first reaction, was that these dots are small. so if you have a large spot, you may need to use 2 of them. I’m not sure if it was just me who experienced this, but it made my spots itchy after I put the healing dots on. It was for a short amount of time and eventually went away. I put these on before I went to sleep (cleansed my face first) and slept with them on. They didn’t make the spots go away completely, but it definitely made a huge difference. It flattened them and the redness went away. I think after a 2nd night of using them, then they should be almost gone tomorrow. I will for sure be buying these again. They are on the pricey side and you will use them up fast, but they are so worth it

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: although, they’re a lot smaller than what I had imagined.. these work really well with taking makeup off. it makes my face feel nice and clean. A bit much though for 3.00$ when you only get 10 wipes

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this product! I will point out that this is a surface exfoliate so if you are wanting more this won’t do it. as a surface exfoliate, it is best one I’ve used. i use it nightly and had some minor tingling and minor discomfort in beginning, it doesn’t irritate or bother my skin at all now. it keeps my skin looking healthy and radiant. I’ve used other resurfacing AHA and they didn’t compare to this at all once I tried this. it’s hard to find in stock so I always order directly from the ordinary now so I can get all the products that I use and be in stock

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: ive used quite a few luxury skin care items and don’t care to spend money on products I feel are worth it. this isn’t one of them. I replaced a product I used for skin radiance with this one and after a month of consistent use, I noticed no difference. in fact my skin was losing the radiance I had worked so hard to get and I discontinued use of this and went back to my trusty product to bring my skin back to it’s optimal health. I had read so many great reviews that I was so disappointed in this. I didn’t have unrealistic expectations but even realistic expectations weren’t met. I have normal to combination skin wothout noticable wrinkles and slight uneven skin tone with some dullness if not treated so maybe my skin wasn’t severe enough but if yours is like mine then save the money. there are better products for cheaper than this

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: this is one of the more expensive skincare products that I think actually really is worth the money. it is a staple in my nighttime skincare routine and my skin is better for it. I love that the oil absorbs quickly without leaving an oily residue to my skin. it is so light unlike other oils I’ve used that feel heavy on the skin. results weren’t necessarily instant but most products take time so I stuck with it. now months later, my skin looks healthy and more hydrated without stressor signs that skin tends to show. this oil helps give me a healthy looking, even toned skin and I would recommend this to anyone to boost their skins health.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: oh my gosh this is a game changer. I’m not cheap by any means, I wear quality moisturizer but I’ve never spent this much until I had to try this. I can tell a difference in my skin from day one. my skin looks hydrated, feels hydrated and more importantly my skin looks dewy naturally! I’ve been trying forever for that and this product gives me that. a lady in line at the grocery store told me I had the prettiest glow to my skin (no makeup on) and that has never happened to me in my life. this gives a youthful glow and I’m almost 40. it absorbs great, lasts thru the day and really enhances my makeup application helping my foundation look more natural and second skin like. I found no negatives to this product and I mean come on isn’t there always something. nope not this time. I am tickled and yes it’s worth every penny. before you disagree, it’s a good sized jar of cream and the amount you apply isn’t much each time so it will last and definitely is worth it. I’ll rebuy again when I run out..I’m glad I got my hands on it before it went out of stock. definitely recommend this to anyone because who doesn’t want skin that actually looks dewy and happy naturally right

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: At first, the scent of this product was overwhelming but after actually putting it on my face, the scent was very nice and relaxing. The moisturizer really helped make my pores less noticeable and it made my skin very soft and smell nice.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: This is the first serum that I have ever tried and I fell in love with it the second that it hit my skin. This serum is amazing and makes my face feel incredible. It even helped heal my breakout. Would suggest.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: From the moment i opened this amazingness, i knew that i was going to love it! It smells amazing and it has made my skin so soft and bright.

reviews.review_title: Will order more when I run out
reviews.review_text: Very nice peptide treatment. Am I liking this and will continue to use it.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a great mild exfoliator with hyaluronic acid which keeps my skin from drying out. I use in conjunction with the weekly 10-minute intense 30% AHA peeling solution.  My 58-year-old skin is thanking me.  Really liking all of my The Ordinary products so far.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Fine product, nothing special. Way overpriced for something that lasted me exactly a month. I have Chap Sticks that lasted longer and worked better.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: A classic. Light weight and not greasy. Really absorbs into skin and doesn’t leave a sticky feeling.

reviews.review_text: Perfect for layering! Absorbs nicely and stays on. Doesn’t feel heavy under my makeup.

reviews.review_text: Layers really nicely under makeup and feels like it actually absorbs into skin rather than sitting on top. I will definitely buy this again.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: This product was complimentary from Innisfree. Has a creamy texture and cooling effect on skin. It is unscented which is great. I did not experienceany tightness or drying. I have noticed less oil production in my pores so I know this has been deeply cleansed. Since this is a clay mask always follow up with a moisturizer afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe. I have only tried this a few times. My skin feels a boost of hydration & wears well under makeup. The light weight gel texture spreads easily, absorbs well without any stickiness, skin felt bouncy and fresh. Leaves a nice luminous healthy glow on bare skin. This supposedly doubles as a makeup primer + highlighter but I prefer to use this as a skincare serum. Too soon to tell on pore reduction and dark spots. Has same scent as their watermelon sleeping mask.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This works well as a daytime moisturizer and in the evening I pair this over their serum. Very nourishing texture on my sensitive dry skin and hydrating. Moisturizes nicely on days when I am taking a break from actives. I like that this in unscented and clean formulated with peptides, red seaweed, and squalene.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This works well as a daytime moisturizer and in the evening I pair this over their serum. Very nourishing texture on my sensitive dry skin and hydrating. reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Very luxe like packaging. I enjoy the milky texture in this serum and it has a light tea scent. It applies well and absorbs very quickly. This serum has increased hydration and cleared up texture on my skin. Gives my complexion a healthy look.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: Easy to use squeeze packaging. Smells so vanilla yummy.  The silicone tip hugs nicely against lip. Medium thick texture. A tiny amount keeps my lips hydrated for hours plus it has a nice shine. Summer Fridays make my lips soft & glossy!

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I was looking for an inexpensive serum to start using and gave this one a go. I really love it, it only takes 2-3 drops to cover my whole face. It absorbs in nicely and I haven’t had any issues with the tackiness some have mentioned. I’ve noticed improvements in my skin over a few days of use as well. Great for the money!

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: This is a great toner for my combo skin! A little goes a long way, it smells great, and it has helped with controlling the oil on my chin without drying out other areas of my face. A great addition to my olehenriksen face routine. The only downfall is I hate the cap on the bottle, I usually unscrew it to put some toner on a cotton pad, the set up with the lid is annoying to me.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample a couple of times, I liked its moisturizing properties but the scent was too perfumey and strong for my liking. I will stick to other moisturizers that were just effective and less m/more appealing scent wise.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I bought these while having terrible pimple problems on my chin. I would put them on overnight and could see how much gunk they were pulling out when I woke up. I did feel like they were drying things out which was good, but sometimes almost drying out too much to where it became a separate problem. All in all a good solution when an unwanted pimple became too big/red but not a long term solution or something I would use constantly.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: My new favorite toner! I had been waiting to try this but it was constantly out of stock. Finally got my hands on it and love it. I am able to use to every night without irritation or over drying. I like that it doesn’t sting or feel like an overly “burning” sensation when applied like some toners. You really can’t beat the price, a little goes a long way, and I’m still loving it and on my second bottle now after using it for months. Highly recommend giving it a try!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_title: Exfoliating, Refreshing, and oh so Good.
reviews.review_text: I love this scrub, it is exfoliating without being too harsh. I use it in the shower (roughly 3 times a week) and it leaves my skin nice and smooth without being too dried out. It smells great and refreshing and a little goes a long way. Incredibly happy with it and glad I gave it a try!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I decided to try out the Unseen sunscreen after loving the defense refresh setting mist. This is a clear gel that glides on very easily. reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is my favorite! I was testing out quite a few to see which I liked best and this was the winner. It is super lightweight, soaks in quickly and I don’t need to reapply throughout the day either. I love how lightweight this one is! It doesn’t leave me greasy or oily looking either. Mixes well with other serums at night as well and layers great under make up.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask was amazing! It had a beautiful cooling effect and didn’t make my skin feel tight or dry-during and after! After I rinsed the mask off my pores were smaller and my skin was smooth and soft. The next morning, there was no oil on my face at all! Which is rare! My face stayed oil free the rest of the day. I will definitely repurchase this product again and again!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This dream face cream is amazing! I have very dry, flaky skin. Using the cream every night has helped my skin during the day. I wake up with hydrated skin and find that I do not need to reapply or use as much moisturizer throughout the day. It is a heavier cream that is great for dry, winter climates but it feels lightweight! The smell is light and fresh. I would purchase and recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely moisturizer! It has a light and clean fragrance. When I use this moisturizer in the morning, there is little to no need to reapply throughout the day. I have dry, sensitive skin and live in an extremely dry climate. The only thing that I disliked about this product was that sometimes my skin would burn momentarily, and I think that’s from the fragrance. I will still continue to use this product!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I was gifted the Sunday Riley 5 Stars retinol under eye serum. I absolutely love this product! I’ve been using it for a day or two now and I would highly recommend it to my friends. It’s a great retinol under eye serum and I will definitely be buying again.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this product a few days ago from Glow Recipe and I love it. I also love that its environment friendly as its refillable. It smells amazing and also goes on so smooth. I would jump on this product once it comes back into stock!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this product a few days ago from Glow Recipe and I love it. I also love that its environment friendly as its refillable. It smells amazing and also goes on so smooth. I would jump on this product once it comes back into stock!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the Floral Recovery Calming Mask. After using it a few uses I would definitely say my face felt softer and more hydrated. I would highly recommend this to friends and family. 10/10 would buy!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received the Vitamin Enriched Face Base by Bobbi Brown. I actually really like it. I put a very small amount day and night as a base before my lotions. I would recommend this to my friends and family.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the Retinol Youth Renewal Serum. Its light wear before putting on before my moisturizer and it doesn’t make my face sensitive or breakout. I would highly recommend if you’re starting to see any signs of aging.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the Retinol Youth Renewal Serum. Its light wear before putting on before my moisturizer and it doesn’t make my face sensitive or breakout. I would highly recommend if you’re starting to see any signs of aging.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I received Fresh New Serum and I couldn’t be happier. Fresh is always a brand I trust and every time I receive or buy a product I’m never let down. If you’re thinking about getting it I would recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: I use this to the last nub. It is one of my favorite lip balms. IT is not ot greasy or strong smelling. and it works.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: I find this to be exactly what the description says, it’s hydrating and soothing. Fresh has always been a standby for me, they are always natural feeling great for sensitive skin they never seem to be too harsh or chemical. They are just solid and easy to use every day. I tend to use all of the product which I never seem to do with other products I have. I love their brand philosophy and what I get for the price. The only reason I don’t give this five stars is because I’m extremely selective about what I give five star reviews to. This is great but I could live without it as far as what I’m looking for in a toner, it doesn’t exactly meet my expectations for what I personally prefer. I want a little more cleansing, more shrinking of the pores. However, I find it works perfectly for night time skin routines better than before makeup or day time. The toner is wonderful for prepping your face for a more hydrating routine at night. Dry skin just drinks it in.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I’m impressed immediately by putting it on. It feels silky and smooths the appearence skin. The texture glides and hides and will melt under makeup. It is terrific that this brand also leaves out so many harmful or filler ingredients and I feel it gives good protection although I haven’t used it at the beach or hiking, just in the hot city. This is what I’m looking for in an everyday product.

reviews.review_title: Good cleanser but won't knock your socks off
reviews.review_text: I give it a star for it’s cleaning ability. Not stripping but it does clean well enough. I find it leaves my skin a tad dry but not like traditional cleansers. However, not as moisturizing as others I have tried. A star for the smell and gentleness. A couple stars for the ingredients and the natural philosophy of this brand. I just wish it was better because I wanted to like it more but it’s not a wow product. I have a cheaper cleanser with no sulfates ect, that cleanses similar of not better and leaves my skin softer.

However, not as moisturizing as others I have tried. A star for the smell and gentleness. A couple stars for the ingredients and the natural philosophy of this brand. I just wish it was better because I wanted to like it more but it’s not a wow product. I have a cheaper cleanser with no sulfates ect, that cleanses similar of not better and leaves my skin softer.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Yes this immediately makes your skin softer and feels momentarily moisturizing in the face. It has a lovely finish and is perfect for under makeup. Yet with consistent use, I found my skin was dryer and I had to continue to moisturize. That’s when I read the ingredients. So much silicone. So much. It blocks my other skin which can seal it up but the natural process of hydration is also hindered. You also need to make sure your completely cleansing your face otherwise your other skin care products can’t penetrate. I know people are on the fence about dimethicone, it’s not really harmful but it isn’t that great either. It’s best function is the texture and ease of application it gives the product. Some have said that it locks moisturize in but I don’t find that to be true for myself and in theory, it’s suspicious. I can’t recommend it but it does give skin an even finish and is the perfect canvas for make up. Just make sure you’re not using it as your sole hydration, and cleanse your skin well after you use it. I’m just going to stay away from silicone. Doing so has transformed my hair and I hope it does the same for my skin. I’m looking for something that will actually nourish my skin with ingredients that are natural to the body.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Light and Breezy but not a heavy hitter
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this product because I’m very picky about moisturizers. I look for moisturizers to be lighter in texture and sink right into the skin not too heavy. I use a lot of other oils and skincare products and my last finishing step I prefer to be on the lighter side, yet actually effective in keeping my skin hydrated throughout the day. This moisture cream definitely fit the bill. I’ve used it for about 2 weeks and have really enjoyed it. it’s cooling and feels so good has the last application to my morning process.  I feel it’s perfect for summer or as a lighter moisturizer. However, I do have dry skin and if I didn’t have other oils and products I would say this would not be enough on its own for dry skin. I’m also really happy to support a brand like Herbivore. They are mid-range pricing and inaccessible way to transition to Green Beauty.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is effective, extremely gentle and easy to use cleanser. You only need a pea sized amount and it takes off everything. I use it every day and without fail, it takes off all my makeup and grime without skipping a beat. I have accidentally gotten it in my eye and it does not sting at all! I don’t wear a ton of waterproof makeup so I can’t speak to that but it does leave my skin softened and clean from mascara, eyebrow pencil, foundation and powders. It foams lightly but I don’t see it stripping my skin in any way. I have normal to dry skin and it does not rob it of it’s natural oils. It could perhaps be drying on very dry skin but since I follow it up with a moisturizing routine I prefer my first step be as effective as possible. I don’t even need a first cleanser! Such a time saver. And it’s a good value. I’m happy.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I’ve only been using this product for a few days,  but I can tell you that it’s so soft and smooth! I’m excited to see more pronounced results,  but I can already tell there has been a reduction in fine lines.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is so luxurious!! My skin is so dry during these Midwest winter months and this product feels amazing.  It isn’t greasy or oily and goes on so smoothly with a really pleasant smell.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is so luxurious!! My skin is so dry during these Midwest winter months and this product feels amazing.  It isn’t greasy or oily and goes on so smoothly with a really pleasant smell.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I liked this product as a moisturizer,  but I didn’t notice any real pore reduction.  The smell is nice and it’s really lightweight.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen.  It’s light and absorbs quickly. It definitely earns its place in my beach bag.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I have been using this as a daily moisturizer because it it so light and not greasy. Its great to know that I can protect my skin and not clog my pores.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this cream! It’s definitely reduced some fine lines and wrinkles and brightened my skin tone. It goes on so smooth and smells great.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I wish I would have known about this mask sooner. Not only is it all clean, green ingredients but, it completely rid my skin of texture and bumps. I feel so hydrated, dewy, and gorgeous. This mask has given been skin confidence I haven’t had in years. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff. I use The Ordinary squalene cleanser in the mornings and evenings, and then double cleanse with this afterwards in the evening. It really removes all of my makeup well. Another one of Fresh’s that is great, but maybe a little pricey for what it is.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: My god I wish I would have known about this sooner. All the time I spent crying over my skin, solved by this in a matter of days. My skin hasn’t looked this good in years. I used the ordinary squalene cleanser, followed by fresh ph balance cleanser, then fresh kombucha essence, then this, then fresh moisturizer (although I’m hoping to try the ordinarys moisturizer soon!). such a great product for a great price.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I was about to book an appointment for a $250 professional chemical peel and I’m so glad I didn’t. This stuff has been life changing just in the two times I’ve used it. The first time did sting some and it made my skin purge, but only for a couple of hours before calming down. Next day it look so much better, and the second time didn’t make me purge at all. My skin hasn’t looked this good since I was pregnant lol.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a great moisturizer. It hydrates without feeling too heavy or sticky. Maybe not something I would pay for/re-order consistently because of the price but, a little definitely goes a long way so you don’t have to re-order too often anyways.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This stuff really does work and pretty quickly too. I would imagine it would work quicker if I used it twice a day but it makes my makeup pill under my eyes. Love it for nighttime use.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love it. I have dry skin so it feels great on the skin without looking oily

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer. There might be cheaper options but this is a good one

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Now I don’t know if there is better ones but I love this one especially for the price.

reviews.product_name: Mini Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: If you buy anything it should be this. You will feel and see the difference the first time you use it.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Sadly it is good :(  if it was cheap I would be happy about that. If you have the money buy it but otherwise you have to look for cheaper drugstore options

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was so happy to receive this complimentary from Influenster as part of a testing program because I probably would not have tried it otherwise. I currently use Origins Ginzing moisturizer and this has almost that same beautiful consistency only silkier. This is the perfect moisturizer for the summer.  I am excited to have the vitamin C to help even out the dark spots caused by the sun. It has even started helping above my upper lip.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster in my Vox Box for testing purposes to give an honest review. I did not have high hopes for this because I have been to a dermatologist and have used pharmaceutical Retin-A. I was really surprised how wonderful this actually worked. It delivered results without the initial damage that retin-a does to your face. I have seen a reduction in pores, slight brightening and increase in even tone. I would say if your skin is in really bad shape, this is not going to work miracles, get the real stuff initially but then definitely use this as a maintenance to keep that glow!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have been searching for a good eye cream that actually works. I don’t mind paying a lot for an eye cream if it actually does something and this does. I received this in a Vox Box from Influenster to try a little over a week ago and I have seen a huge improvement in my dark circles and bags. I don’t really have deep wrinkles but the fine lines look smaller when I smile and I can finally put setting powder under my eyes without it looking hideous. I will definitely repurchase. Would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I did not have high hopes for this because I have used other C serums before and they have seriously fallen flat but this one in only one week made my skin super bright. Also smells amazing and you only have to apply once a day. I apply more than once because it smells so yummy!!! I will definitely purchase again!  Please make into a body cream!!!!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: It felt super soft and smooth on my skin right out of the packaging? It immediately helped blur my skin almost like a primer? It is supposed to help with dark spots so I am excited about long term use but I have only used it for 5 days. I have not seen dark spots fade but I have noticed my skin a lot firmer and plumper. The packaging is extremely elegant and expensive looking. Also since It has that blurring effect. I did not need to use a primer. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I did have high expectations because of the price tag but it is just sunscreen. There is no smell which is great but maybe I am not a fan of the stick for the face. It is easy to carry in your purse but typically I put my sunscreen on during my makeup routine. I gave it 4 stars because this is great for my surgery scars. I have to use a stick for those. Don’t know if the price tag is worth it but over time I may see a difference. If you like the stick application. The unscented alone is worth it. I received compliments of Influenster for a contest and the opinions are all my own

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I love how lightweight the serum is on my skin. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and soft. Definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: The Inkey List Caffeine Eye Cream has definitely improved the appearance of dark circles, puffiness and fine lines. It leaves my skin moisturized and feeling soft. I definitely recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Sunday Riley. I love Good Genes by Sunday Riley. Honestly the smell kinda threw me off at first but I tried it anyways and I’m glad I did. My skin is dry and sensitive and this product doesn’t irritate my skin at all. The texture is light and absorbs really well on my skin. I only use one pump and I’m able to apply it all over my face. A little goes a long way for me. I prefer to use this as a mask at night. My skin looks smoother and more radiant. If you’re on the fence about it I would recommend getting a smaller size. I’m happy with this product.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Bare Minerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum works wonders for my dry and sensitive skin. I recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: After using the Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant on my dry skin. I can definitely tell an improvement on my skins texture. My skin looks brighter, feels so much smoother. I use this once a week because my skin is super dry and sensitive. There’s no fragrance to irritate my skin. I’m very happy with this product and the skin smoothing results. Complimentary from Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: After using the Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant on my dry skin. I can definitely tell an improvement on my skins texture. My skin looks brighter, feels so much smoother. I use this once a week because my skin is super dry and sensitive. There’s no fragrance to irritate my skin. I’m very happy with this product and the skin smoothing results. Complimentary from Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream feels amazing when it’s on your face. Feels great the next day. It is great for a night leave on mask. I bought a small size then I was lucky to receive this in a box from Influenster for free and I was thrilled to try other products from fresh. I would def recommend this cream to anyone. I enjoy all of the products I’ve tried from fresh. I have sensitive skin and this doesn’t bother me at all. It also smells really good

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this as a free trial from influenster to try out and boy I’m glad I did. It is great. A little pricey but worth it. It smells good. It’s light but hydrating. You can use it at am and pm. Good for under makeup and everything I would definitely purchase it after I run out !!

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this from influenster and I was glad I did. I love Estée Lauder so I knew I would love this. It is pretty small size but good enough to try and see if you like it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I received this from influenster and I was glad I did. I love Estée Lauder so I knew I would love this. It is pretty small size but good enough to try and see if you like it.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
reviews.review_text: I received this from influenster and I was glad I did. I love Estée Lauder so I knew I would love this. It is pretty small size but good enough to try and see if you like it.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: So I received this from influencer to try out for free and I’m so happy I did. It’s super thick like a lotion with little exfoliating beads in it. I like it because it seems to make my skin feel very smooth after it helps with getting rid of the excess dead or dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: So I received this from influencer to try out for free and I’m so happy I did. It’s super thick like a lotion with little exfoliating beads in it. I like it because it seems to make my skin feel very smooth after it helps with getting rid of the excess dead or dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I received this as a free sample to try out and I’m glad I did. I know the skin around your eyes is a very thing layer and you should take care of it. I have dry skin and this hydrated my skin around my eyes which is great !

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The best stuff ever. My skin can be sensitive to cleansers but this is so gentle that I don’t feel the obsessive need to moisturize as soon as I wash my face. I usually use Cerave cleanser, but I buy this when I want to pamper my face a bit more. It especially helps my skin when I’m experiencing a rosacea flare up.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This product initially felt very nice. It soaked into my skin well, making it feel smooth and hydrated, and the smell was hardly noticeable to me. After a few nights, I began to have small breakouts in areas that I typically don’t break out. I have since stopped using this product and my skin has returned to normal. I think this would work well for others even if it didn’t work for me. For reference, I have dry skin that generally isn’t sensitive to new products.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This product initially felt very nice. It soaked into my skin well, making it feel smooth and hydrated, and the smell was hardly noticeable to me. After a few nights, I began to have small breakouts in areas that I typically don’t break out. I have since stopped using this product and my skin has returned to normal. I think this would work well for others even if it didn’t work for me. For reference, I have dry skin that generally isn’t sensitive to new products.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I really like these pads. They definitely even out my skin tone a bit better than my typical toners that I use. I like how my skin feels after I swipe these pads over it. They’re significantly gentler than SA pads you may buy from the drugstore. That said, these aren’t a miracle product for me. I buy them every so often to splurge but they don’t completely transform my skin. I still have redness and dullness even when using these. If you are considering purchasing this product, manage your expectations as you may get good (but not amazing) results like me.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin and rosacea, so I am always on the lookout for gentle ways to add hydration to my routine. This product does a fairly good job of hydrating. I would say it has the same feel and results as FAB’s hydrating serum, which is $10 cheaper. As far as hydrating serums go, I greatly prefer Caudalie’s Vinosource S.O.S. serum. However, that serum is more expensive. If money is no object, I would recommend the Caudalie. If you’re on a budget, I’d recommend the FAB over this product. This just doesn’t perform for the price.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_title: Works well if I use a lot
reviews.review_text: When I first started using this product, it felt nice and soothing on my very dry skin, but I didn’t feel like it offered as much hydration as it claimed to. I started bumping up the quantity I used and wow- it delivered on its claims. I use this nightly after toning and a serum. I use about two tablespoons to coat my entire face. I really slather it on and allow it to sink in. The result is super hydrated, bright, calm and happy skin. Each container lasts a few months of nightly use. I typically wait until it’s on sale and then stock up, thus justifying my heavy usage and the price. Regardless, you get a ton of product and it works well. If you have extremely dry and sensitive skin like me, give this product a try. Just be aware that you may need to use more than you’re accustomed to.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: The pros: this product sinks into my skin well. I do feel like it helps my dry skin stay hydrated. The cons: this doesn’t seem to do anything to help out with large pores, dull skin, or fine lines. All of the claims it makes (besides hydration) fall short. Also, the smell is pretty off-putting, though it goes away after a minute. This product contains blue tansy. You’d be better off spending the $15 for Pacifica’s blue tansy oil. It delivers the same results (hydration) at a fraction of the cost. For reference, I have very dry, sensitive skin. This product did not make me break out. It just didn’t do much.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Good for sensitive skin, not great for makeup
reviews.review_text: This is a very nice, gentle cleanser. It doesn’t strip my face nor irritate my skin or make me break out. I will say that the makeup removing claim is a bit unfounded. This cleanser works well enough when I’ve only worn powder. But I’ve never been able to adequately remove liquid foundation or eye makeup with this product alone. If you’re sensitive to scents, be aware that this is moderately cucumber scented. For reference, I have very dry, sensitive skin and rosacea.

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I’m a fan of this product! I have sensitive, acne-prone, dry skin and rosacea, so I tend to be very wary of products that may be drying or cause my skin to flare up. This product doesn’t do that! I use it every morning with a cotton pad. I feel that it gives me a nice glow and evens out my texture and complexion over time. It doesn’t sting, doesn’t leave my skin feeling tight or overly dry, and it hasn’t caused a breakout. The product is scented, so keep that in mind if you’re sensitive to that. I personally enjoy the scent; it’s very citrusy and a nice wake up in the morning. I would say the results I get from this are similar to FAB’s Facial Radiance Pads - slow, but gentle, results over time.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I’m a fan of this product! I have sensitive, acne-prone, dry skin and rosacea, so I tend to be very wary of products that may be drying or cause my skin to flare up. This product doesn’t do that! I use it every morning with a cotton pad. I feel that it gives me a nice glow and evens out my texture and complexion over time.
