I personally enjoy the scent; it’s very citrusy and a nice wake up in the morning. I would say the results I get from this are similar to FAB’s Facial Radiance Pads - slow, but gentle, results over time.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum applies well and plays nicely with my moisturizer and makeup. However, I’m giving it three stars because I saw no results after using it each morning. My complexion is just as uneven, dull, and unfortunate as ever. On the plus side, this did not irritate my sensitive, dry skin, nor did it make me break out. It just didn’t have any effect. For those sensitive to fragrances, you may want to steer clear of this product. I find the citrus scent to be pleasant, but it could be too much for some people.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I love using the acne healing dots because it does majority of the work for you OVERNIGHT and all you really have to do is stick them over your whiteheads/pimples. I notice a significant different in swelling and reduction in the whitehead/pimple when I use these dots. I would definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I was a little hesitant on whether this product would conceal some of the pink and redness. I thought it would be similar to other green color correctors that are more makeup driven which are thicker. But this is more lightweight and easily blends on the skin. It reduces the amount of pink and redness on my face. I feel like I don’t necessarily need concealer or foundation to cover on top compared to other  green color correctors. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I was a little hesitant on whether this product would conceal some of the pink and redness. I thought it would be similar to other green color correctors that are more makeup driven which are thicker. But this is more lightweight and easily blends on the skin. It reduces the amount of pink and redness on my face. I feel like I don’t necessarily need concealer or foundation to cover on top compared to other  green color correctors. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: The cream is a little thicker than the gel cream but still lightweight and moisturizing. It has a nice and light scent that isn’t overwhelming. It took a little bit longer for the product to sink into the skin. But it didn’t leave my skin feeling oily or sticky. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: The serum is lightweight and doesn’t leave my face feeling overly oily and shiny. It has a really cool applicator/pump - when you twist the top, the pump part of the applicator pops up. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Really lightweight and moisturizing. My skin leans more dry/normal so I usually use the moisturizing bomb, but the aqua bomb is nice and lighter to use for the warmer months & for people have oily or combo skin.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: A nice lightweight serum. Absorbs into the skin pretty quickly and leaves a slight glowy but a little tacky finish on the skin. The fragrance isn’t as nice as the Double Eye Serum, which I would prefer more. I received a sample of 7 packets - the material of the packet is like a plastic card that you fold in half, squeeze the serum out and mix before applying to the face. The plastic card packaging is slightly difficult to get the product out. I didn’t see any significant or notable differences from using the product since I was only able to use for a week.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love how it feels the cream is whipped and light. It absorbs so well into the skin, feels so hydrating & lightweight on the skin. It does have a slight weird scent but not noticeable when it’s applied on the skin.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Thin moisturizer - goes well with sheet masks
reviews.review_text: This pairs really well with sheet masks, for when you have to apply a moisturizer on after to lock in all of the hydration and essence from the sheet mask. It’s thin, almost like a serum, but it has that beautiful watermelon Jolly Rancher smell. I don’t think that I’d recommend this for every day, since it doesn’t pack a punch by itself, but I think this is good for people who don’t like to feel weighed down.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_title: Finally, something that clarified the cystic acne!
reviews.review_text: At first, I was unenthused upon reading the description of the product and ingredients -- salicylic acid has been around forever. However, I thought I’d try a sample anyway because I like this product line; Caudelie was highly recommended by the skincare girls at Sephora. So I used this sample while I was traveling (usually a time of stress and unpredictability for my skin). The first day I used it, it shrank two of my whiteheads into oblivion. The second day I used it, I noticed the giant patches of cystic acne that had been plaguing me start to shrink. Right when you put it on, your face feels like it’s shrinking, but it doesn’t feel dehydrating at all because of the soothing ingredients. When I realized what I had found, I cut out all the other makeup products and skincare items except for cleansers and eye cream. Truly, this product was the beginning of my skincare revolution and a real turning point for me. I picked up a bottle as soon as I got home, but the texture of my skin is smoothing out for the first time in months. I still have dark spots, so I’ll probably use the Vinoperfect in the morning to help with that. I’m sold and devoted to this product now. It’s been three weeks, and I’m finally getting the skin that I want. I would recommend this product even to people who have tried other AHAs or BHAs before and found themselves unimpressed or irritated. There is just something about this product that healed me.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_title: Game-changer for my acne and hyperpigmentation
reviews.review_text: Completely blew any cleanser I had used before out of the water. I tried out tons of K-beauty cleansers (as part of a double cleanse   occasional exfoliation) to try to clear out some blemishes, but this replaced everything and stopped my search. Will try out the other polishes from this brand, but glad I switched over to J-beauty.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Surprised I liked it so much.
reviews.review_text: Just a really good cleanser for getting your acne under control. Works well with a konjac sponge or Foreo.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_title: Gentle clay mask -- comfortable but effective
reviews.review_text: As far as clay masks go, this is pretty gentle. My skin is very acneic, so I wanted something that I could use on a semi-regular basis to draw out the pimples before a decent extraction session. However, I didn’t want anything too stripping, so this worked out great. It isn’t a hydrating clay mask like some Korean brands can be, but it’s not as harsh as a GlamGlow or an Aztec Clay. There is a tingling sensation when you put it on and it still does manage to draw things out and leave your face feeling super-clean. I use this once a week at most because I don’t like drying out my already dry skin, but it definitely feels like it pulls stuff up. In the long term, this is a good once-in-a-white product for people who are battling long-term acne and are still waiting for their prescriptions to finish purging. I can’t comment on how it is for non-acneic skin.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Since starting Curology 4 weeks ago and following their recommendation to strip your skincare routine down to just the basics they provide, I decided my skin is healed enough and stable enough to introduce an oil cleanser back into the routine in addition to the gentle cleanser they provide. I would recommend adding the double-cleanse to anyone who might be going through an acne phase because of stress, environmental changes, or anything else. I had used other oil cleansers before, which I liked better; hence, only 4 instead of 5 stars -- Then I Met You, Farmacy, E Nature, and mostly Korean brands. However, this DE is not bad -- it does soften, even though it’s a bit harder than Farmacy Green and you may be left with some clumps that you might need to work more to break down. However, the thickness does have some benefits. I would really recommend this to people who have really dry skin. When you oil cleanse, you must work it into your skin (straight onto makeup or bare face is fine) for at least 60 seconds, ideally up to a couple minutes, and even longer if you have trouble areas or a lot of sebum plugs. The thicker DE formula makes it easier to coat entire areas while the facial massage slowly works out the sebum plugs and sunscreen on your face. There’s not as much slip to it, but it does feel melty and luxurious (and a bit of a handful on the days when I don’t feel like doing that much work). Follow with foaming wash; too thick a film for a milk.But as for the bamboo/charcoal exfoliant, I found that it was too gritty and rough for acneic skin. Really, it’s too rough a powder in general and I don’t think I would recommend most people put it on their face even though this is a thicker carrier. Now that my tub is out, I might mix it with a body oil and use it to exfoliate chest/legs.Another benefit is that this jar does last a long time because the oil is so thick and spreads around without melting off. I also like the little magnetic paddle it comes with.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Good moisturizer! Good for sensitive skin and combo skin and product absorbs amazingly. However, nothing super special about it and it’s expensive so I won’t be re-purchasing

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This was my go-to for 4 or so years! I have dry skin and I love how thick and hydrating this was. I didn’t really see any other benefits besides hydration so if that’s your main concern, definitely try this. If you are looking for more anti-aging or brightening benefits, this cream alone won’t do it

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I cannot live without this!! It’s strong and helps smooth out my skin and prevent breakouts. My skin has been super sensitive lately and I can still use this no problem. Price tag is hefty but worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I looooove the texture of this eye cream! Super light but so moisturizing. Only complaint is that when my skin is super sensitive, this will break me out. I can only use this when the rest of my skin is healthy and non-problematic.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: AMAZING EXFOLIATOR! I use this 2-3 times a week and it leaves my skin soo clean, smooth, and radiant!! Smells amazing too. This helps to keep my breakouts at bay. I alternate this with Kate Somerville daily cleanser

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Easily takes off my not waterproof eye make up, rinses very clean.  I use it with my Clarisonic and could not be happier!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I really did a number on my sensitive skin the other day, and ended up with wind and sun burn the likes of which I haven’t seen in years. I gently cleansed, used the Cicapair Mist, Cicapair Serum, and Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream. Then I put the Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment on my most red areas (nose, cheeks, chin). Not only did my skin feel so relieved, my redness all but disappeared. Could not believe it! I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review, and i wholeheartedly think that the Cicapair product line is exceptional for its price point, and will not hesitate to purchase the products on the future.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I really did a number on my sensitive skin the other day, and ended up with wind and sun burn the likes of which I haven’t seen in years. I gently cleansed, used the Cicapair Mist, Cicapair Serum, and Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream. Then I put the Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment on my most red areas (nose, cheeks, chin). Not only did my skin feel so relieved, my redness all but disappeared. Could not believe it! I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review, and i wholeheartedly think that the Cicapair product line is exceptional for its price point, and will not hesitate to purchase the products on the future.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: I like this cream. It’s not quite enough moisture for my very dry skin, but I’ve been using it with a little bit of my regular moisturizer, and love how it feels on my skin. I think normal and oily skin would find the level of moisture sufficient. I received this product in exchange for an honest review and can say that it’s a fantastic product, but I don’t know if I would personally buy it again only because my skin is so dry.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: Sometimes serums are too oily to use in conjunction with foundation. This one isn’t. It has a nice amount of calming moisture that could be enough for those whose skin is a little oily, but for me it is a great base for another layer of moisturizer. I am sincerely impressed by this entire Cicapair line. I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review, and I’m so grateful to have found effective products at a very good price point.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I bought this to wear during the day under make up, and didn’t really like how this and my foundation worked together.  So I stuck it in a drawer until a few days ago when my nighttime moisturizer ran out.  I’ve been using it at night and LOVE IT!  My jawline looks firmer and my skin has a glow.  What a nice surprise.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I use a 2% BHA liquid to even out my skin and can’t begin to explain how good it feels to apply the Guerlain Advanced Youth Watery Oil after.  The two work so well together and after just a week I’m seeing a dramatic difference. This oil works well with the rest of my makeup and definitely has a brightening effect. Today I was in a hurry and forgot to apply the Youth Watery Oil, and my skin feels tight and dry, and it’s not glowing like it was yesterday. This is all the evidence needed for me to declare this product a winner!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I use a 2% BHA liquid to even out my skin and can’t begin to explain how good it feels to apply the Guerlain Advanced Youth Watery Oil after.  The two work so well together and after just a week I’m seeing a dramatic difference. This oil works well with the rest of my makeup and definitely has a brightening effect. Today I was in a hurry and forgot to apply the Youth Watery Oil, and my skin feels tight and dry, and it’s not glowing like it was yesterday. This is all the evidence needed for me to declare this product a winner!!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Hello summer! Love the smell, so hydrating and smooth on the lips (currently have been and still use the Carmel one) this is equally as good.  Not sticky, wears well.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: does what it says, slightly drying
reviews.review_text: I first received this in my play box and was eager to try it. It does somewhat lighten (dark circles) the under eye area and firms it some too. However it needs another cream that adds hydration bc it can be very drying. Once I figured that out I went and purchased the full size. It didn’t irritate my sensitive skin or cause milia.  I can notice a slight improvement and I’m using this just under a month with smoothness.  I’ve tried more creams then I can list so for me this one is amazing bc it actually works with out any negative side effects as long as paired with another cream to moisturize. I use clinque pep start with it and no issues with them being put in together. Each cream has its purpose and together they work for me In Harmony .

reviews.product_name: Mini Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I use la Mer as my primary fave wash, however I was looking for something a bit  more deep cleaning for my nose. This fits the bill perfectly. I have dry sensitive skin that hates nearly every wash I have tried ( la Mer and sk ii work with no irritation, lamer just cleans better). This wash gives that extra clean I was look for on my most “oily” area. Scent is fruity, gel like texture, very small amount need to get it to lather. Rinses off with out residue and leaves skin smooth, soft and clean. Did notice my pores on my nose looking less visible after use. Does give a slightly tight, almost toned feel.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: After seeing so many good reviews on this I thought why not give it a go. This is nothing more than a shiny lip gloss that last maybe 30/45 mins. There is zero pear flavor or smell. Lips are no more hydrated after applied then before. Glad it was inexpensive so I don’t need to return it. I’ll stick with my la Mer balm and tatcha  gold spun balm,both of those give soft hydrated lips and wear for hours. Guess if you want a basic clear gloss this is ok, or maybe to top off a matte lipstick?

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: first break out I had in years
reviews.review_text: I take exceptional care of skin, haven’t had any break outs in years. Follow the same skin care regime (lamer and skii).. and didn’t use any new makeup when I tried this primer. After one use of this primer I got 4 pimples one with hours (while wearing the make up I noticed the first one). Once I removed my makeup I was shocked, 3 more pimples appearing, face was red and looked dull. I couldn’t believe how fast this product wrecked my face. I don’t know what ingredient is in this but my skin does not want any part of it. Product wise it felt light, gave a slight glow and seemed to blend well with foundation (lamer I used). But no product is worth messing up your skin for, therefore this is a big no for me. So glad I got this as a sample bc it saves me a return to the store. I’m hoping I can get my skin back to normal bc it’s 3 days now and the pimples are still there. Fortunately the lamer mask made my skin glow again and no more redness.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This will remove your makeup with out burning your eyes (will make eyes cloudy briefly if u get it in). It does take off stubborn makeup very easily. Also quickly removes matte lips .It doesn’t make my skin red or burning like other balms/wipes/oil do. Price per product is good, packaging is standard.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This will remove your makeup with out burning your eyes (will make eyes cloudy briefly if u get it in). It does take off stubborn makeup very easily. Also quickly removes matte lips .It doesn’t make my skin red or burning like other balms/wipes/oil do. Price per product is good, packaging is standard.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Hydrating, smooth and feels light. I have been using  Tatcha  gold spun lip balm and lamer lip balm for years. I added this into the mix and can’t say I see any difference but my lips are soft after application of this so I’d say it’s equal to their balm(Tatcha ). Doesn’t last as long as lamers balm. No sensitivity, smell or taste. If your looking for a lip treatment this is a good inexpensive one that does actually work (hydration soft lips). I like the container packaging  and wand that comes with it for application, you don’t need much product to cover lips bc it’s disperses nicely.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ll start with the positive.This does provide some hydration and smoothing to the skin. It doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. Price per oz is ok. I use lamer For everything from wash to lotion /essence serums to creams but find Tatcha is a good pre makeup step. Meaning I do my usually skin care routine (am /pm)but before I apply makeup I put a small of this cream on and then prime my skin, i find the makeup is more radiant, applied smoother , and skin is softer looking. It doesn’t hydrate as well as the lamer oil but I have dry skin so if your skin is normal you may really like this. (I also tried their water cream one but that’s even lighter of a moisturizer so oily skinned ppl would love it ). Packaging is pretty. If you don’t have a go to cream and want moderate to light hydration you will like this.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: Applying this pre make up makes skin  slightly smoother and softer. Applied just for serum pre moisturizer also ok but no where near as good as Lamers serums. It’s doesn’t have enough hydration for my skin. Putting over makeup is a no go for me as it just melts  and smears the makeup. Price per oz is way to high for what it is. Unsure if I’d repurchase it due to its minimal improvement to makeup look. Overall it’s an ok addition to pre make up routine if you want a smoother canvas but not a necessity. I find the lamer renewal oil works better for a glowy hydration look vs this( I have skin that leans dry). If your skin is combo vs dry  I can see you really loving it. Applied under eye seems to make concealer lay smoother .Doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. Packaging allows for easy travel with it. I took 2 stars off bc of price and amount of product and minimal effect for my skin type. Can’t say if it actually minimizes fine lines or any other serum benefits bc I haven’t used it long enough. Overall if you don’t have a serum that works for you already, have combo skin even oily, or need a travel serum in a pinch this could be great for you.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Got this as a sample and tried it. It was easy to apply and didn’t feel harsh. However once I rinsed my face it felt tight (not in a good way) dry and dull. I quickly applied my lamer regime( watery lotion, concentrate and soft cream) to counter act the dryness but it still lacked the glow soft skin I’m used too. I’ll stick with the lamer exfoliate scrub bc it doesn’t dehydrate my skin. Smell of this is light, texture is gel with small sugar grains. Maybe if you have combo oily skin this may work well for you but I’m normal that leans dry this was to harsh.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This instantly made my face burn and red. It felt hot and dry, taking 3 days to go back to normal. I didn’t see any glow, skin wasn’t any smoother either. Def didn’t work for me. I have sensitive skin that leans dry. Glad I got this sample from huda to try before I buy.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This instantly made my face burn and red. It felt hot and dry, taking 3 days to go back to normal. I didn’t see any glow, skin wasn’t any smoother either. Def didn’t work for me. I have sensitive skin that leans dry. Glad I got this sample from huda to try before I buy.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: The best lip mask ever. I don’t remember if I already wrote a review of this before but well. I have had this lip mask for months like 5 or more and no kidding haven’t even used half of the jar. I apply it every single night and most mornings brcause I really feel anxiety when my lips are dry but this product plumps, moisturizes and gives a shine to my lips. It doesn’t go anywhere at night, you wake up and still feel the product on. what impresses me the most is that for the price you really get a lot of product. enough for a year. I think, no exaggeration. oh and the smell is not strong. hate many lipbalms and stuff that you will smell all of the time while is on your lips.

reviews.product_name: Mini Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: omg this has been my go to cleanser for a while. I have ver dry and sensitive skin and this cleanser is super gentle. It doesn’t dry out my skin and helps with redness. the best is that I only use 1 pump to wash my face every day and 2 or 3 to remove my makeup and it doesn’t have a strong scent at all.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: It really does what is suppose to do.
reviews.review_text: This serum is amazing!! I have been using it for 2 weeks. At first I didn’t read the instructions so I put it for 3 nights straight and I noticed my skin pretty dehydrated and my pores look bigger. but this has so good reviews so I knew I was doing something wrong. then I read the instructions I found out you just need to use it 2 or 3 times a week so I did that and it does what it says in a very short time. It’s like gently peeling off the dead skin and giving you a very natural glow and even the dark spots I had from previous beak outs are gone. really love it. Cannot wait to see what it does to my face with more time using it. I received this product in my June boxyluxe from Boxycharm

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This is a very nice balm. I like it, I just don’t love it as much as their night lip mask. I know this is a lip balm and it won’t be as heavy as the mask, but it just doesn’t last that long on the lips, I got the peach one and it does not smell like peach and the scent actually goes to nothing once you put it on. My lips feel hydrated but I have to put a nice amount and I find myself reapplying very often. also because of the amount you can feel the product on, won’t absorb very well. I have tried really soooo many balms, cheap and luxury lip products and this is not worth CAD$20. Maybe $13. I’m sorry laneige, will keep it because it’s nice and I love lip products and at least it doesn’t irritate my lips. The lip mask though is my number one lip product. I have full and mini sized all over my apartment and I prefer to use it as a balm too.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I redeemed this serum for 100 points. I didn’t think it would work on me. many Caudalie products just break me out or don’t do anything at all on me. but OMG I have been lonving this so much. it minimizes my pores and if I have a minor break out, next day it looks almost like nothing. really good and the prince seems very good. usually serums are very expensive. the scent is very pleasant too, not sticky and absorvs super fast. will purchase full sized

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: This cleanser beated my ultime favourite cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best cleansers I have ever tried. my favourite has always been the glow recipe blueberry and I have seriously not liked anything else since it first came out. i have tried and tried but never like other, until this one came out. omg it is FANTASTIC. it has the scent of all Tatcha products kind of spa scent. It a cream cleanser but it just looks like It’s foaming not like those cream cleansers that you feel you are washing your face with moisturizer. oh and just a tiny bit is enough for all your face. It leaves your skin super soft and feels completely clean, super gentle on my combo skin. Tatcha products are very expensive but honestly, this is an amazing price for their products. I just love it so much and I cannot believe I prefer to reach for this one rather than my glow recipe which I will also love forever.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: This cleanser beated my ultime favourite cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best cleansers I have ever tried. my favourite has always been the glow recipe blueberry and I have seriously not liked anything else since it first came out. i have tried and tried but never like other, until this one came out. omg it is FANTASTIC. it has the scent of all Tatcha products kind of spa scent. It a cream cleanser but it just looks like It’s foaming not like those cream cleansers that you feel you are washing your face with moisturizer. oh and just a tiny bit is enough for all your face. It leaves your skin super soft and feels completely clean, super gentle on my combo skin. Tatcha products are very expensive but honestly, this is an amazing price for their products. I just love it so much and I cannot believe I prefer to reach for this one rather than my glow recipe which I will also love forever.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: Magic all I can say is that this is magic. I put them on a pimple when it’s very swollen before going to sleep and in the morning thr pimple is almost gone. I couldn’t believe it. The other day I got a blemish on my back that sorry for the exact description but those you cannot squezze, they are so swollen that even hurts touching it. well I put one dot at around 12 pm by 8 pm I had nothing. it was magic honestly. really recommend these for those especial ocassions that the blemish is just a nightmare.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: this is by far my favorite moisturizer. I use it morning and night. at night I put a pretty generous amount on and just let it work its magic. during the day I put the tiniest amount. a tiny bit on my fingertips will easily spread among my whole face and neck. it doesn’t disturb my makeup as long as I don’t use too much. my skin is very dry and this makes it soft and supple. I’m nearly 40 and have no wrinkles or fine lines and I take skincare very seriously. this is a must have in my routine.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: there’s something about this that just makes me feel icky. it seems to just form a film on my skin and block it from breathing. I end up with a layer of sweat on my face every single time I use this. I can’t figure it out. I thought maybe it was the dimethecone but my favorite moisturizer has that too, granted way further down the ingredient list. I know this has such a huge following but it really just isn’t for me

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve seen a review or two regarding the alcohol in this. cetearyl alcohol is a fatty alcohol and has benefits for the skin. it isn’t drying or damaging like other alcohols. I love this cleanser. it’s ultra gentle and leaves my skin feeling fresh and smooth. I use it in the morning and as a second cleanse in the evening. it’s really a great product.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I didn’t like this at first. it didn’t seem to do much. But after a couple of uses I really do like it. it isn’t super moisturizing but it’s great under makeup, sinks right into my skin and keeps me hydrated all day. at night I use a more intense cream but this one is perfect for day use. I won’t buy it again because the price is ridiculous but I’ll use up my sample and enjoy it. if it’s in your budget I say go for it. this whole line is great. I buy a couple things from DE and won’t go without them (c-firma is a must have)

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: I got this as a package deal with the bum bum cream I love so much. I really enjoy the scent of this. is like creamy buttered popcorn and a hint of coconut. it’s moisturizing, the tube is huge and everyone who sees me putting it on is intrigued by the packaging. unfortunately I don’t think I’d buy it again. it has a gritty texture on my lips. love everything but the grit. if you don’t need your lip balm to feel completely smooth, you’ll like this a lot.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I’m actually pleasantly surprised with these. everything I’ve tried from this brand has been a miss for me but I got these as a deluxe sample and really enjoyed them. my biggest issue with acid toning pads is they rarely seem to do anything other than remove any remnants of dirt and makeup lingering behind. these, however, make my skin feel noticeably better. I like them even better than my current acid toner and when that’s gone I will make the switch to these. I cut these in half because there is more than enough product saturated on the pad for two applications per pad. I like that there is texture on one side and the other is flat. I like the price even better. for $30 you can’t find a better cost for such a nice product

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I bought this because the Bite Agave lip mask was not in stock. it does hydrate my lips but I find it gets gloppy if you use too much (somehow even a tiny amount can be too much which is a good thing) and I wish it was a tad thicker. but my lips feel great and I’d buy it again for sure. I don’t notice a scent to it but that’s fine with me. it keeps me from licking my lips!  I also like to use this over drying lipsticks. a pot will last forever and it comes with a spatula so you don’t have to stick your fingers in it

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Tastes and smells like a visit to the dentist
reviews.review_text: I was very much looking forward to trying this product as it is highly reviewed.  The consistency and moisture provided is great.  However, the scent and taste are potent and synthetic and strike me with olfactory memories of visiting the dentist and getting my teeth cleaned.  I do not like the taste at the dentist (but at least I’m getting a health benefit in that situation) and I do not want this on my mouth on a daily basis.  It is awful.  I hope more scent/flavors come into stock so that I can attempt to enjoy this in the future.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: This tastes bitter.  The balm feels fine, nothing special.  The product was brand new, so I would be surprised if it spoiled.  It is also the second time I’ve tried it and had the same experience.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I didnt think this would work for me but I received it in a Play box, so I tried it anyway.  I expect my moisturizers to quench my skin throughout my waking day.  It’s a bonus when I notice longevity onto the next.  I put this on my face and noticed hydration immediately.  However, two hours later (literally) my skin went back to square one.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I used this for four weeks using a hoard of samples and deluxe sizes.  It was so good.  I saw a visible improvement in texture, evening of my skin tone, as well as improved moisture in my very dry skin.  There were even some days that I skipped moisturizer and I was totally fine; which I found unusual, but encouraging.  I do really enjoy this formula but I’m going to wait for a sale either through Sephora or through Algenist brand website since it’s such a pretty penny!

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: Gel moisturizers vast majority of the time are not enough for me but I’m not mad at it.  It’s probably perfect for someone else.  It doesn’t irritate my skin or break me out.  I can feel it moisturize my skin but it doesn’t last.  I find myself having to reapply.  If you’re looking for a light moisturizer but have dry skin, try Tatcha.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Not as moisturizing as their regular formula
reviews.review_text: I do tend to have redness issues with my skin so I was looking forward to trying this because I LOVE their standard moisturizer but this didn’t do it for me moisturizer wise.  I have very dry skin.  I do appreciate the way it looks and tones down the redness in my skin but I can’t wear it by itself because I need more moisture.  I’m going to try the drops next and see if I can mix those in with their regular formula.  That might work better for me.  I do appreciate that this formula has SPF.  Overall, not a bad product; just not ideal for my dry skin needs.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Not as moisturizing as their regular formula
reviews.review_text: I do tend to have redness issues with my skin so I was looking forward to trying this because I LOVE their standard moisturizer but this didn’t do it for me moisturizer wise.  I have very dry skin.  I do appreciate the way it looks and tones down the redness in my skin but I can’t wear it by itself because I need more moisture.  I’m going to try the drops next and see if I can mix those in with their regular formula.  That might work better for me.  I do appreciate that this formula has SPF.  Overall, not a bad product; just not ideal for my dry skin needs.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I just used up a generous deluxe sample of this to get my skin out of an irritated state and even around my eye area, it never stings.  I’ve used this on and off many times.  It might not be the most hydrating moisturizer ever but it is one of the best for dry skin.  It doesn’t break me out or pill up or leave a sticky residue.  It’s great.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This doesn’t irritate my eyes and my dry skin loves it.  It doesn’t pill up and soaks in nicely without feeling like I have nothing on my face hours later.  It keeps my skin feeling moisturized all day.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This doesn’t irritate my eyes and my dry skin loves it.  It doesn’t pill up and soaks in nicely without feeling like I have nothing on my face hours later.  It keeps my skin feeling moisturized all day.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I was so excited to try this.  A customer rep at Nordstrom said this cream was made in the same factory as La Mer.  I don’t actually love La Mer either but at least that one doesn’t end up stinging my eyes of pill up on me.  This is a very generic moisturizer.  It doesn’t provide enough for my dry skin.  I would skip skip skip.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: LOVE It aside from the fact that it stings my eyes.  I’m careful to not apply near the eyes but inevitably every once in a while, maybe because of sweat of makeup application, I end up getting some in my eyes and it STINGS.  I really like how it moisturizes though.  Its a lovely creamy thick texture that’s easy to rub in and you can feel it working all day.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen has everything I wanted in a sunscreen. I personally really like the way it feels on my skin. For reference I have a medium skin tone ( MAC Nc37 /Nc40) and I didn’t feel that it left a film on my skin like some of the other reviewers have mentioned. Actually i feel it gives my skin a nice glow/dewy look! My skin can be a little dehydrated and what I really like about Umbra Sheer is that it leaves my skin dewy looking like it’s really really hydrated. I am very particular about sunscreens and some of them can feel soo goopy and heavy. Not this one for sure. When I use this on my skin I feel like my skin can still breathe and that’s a big big plus in my opinion.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Amazing serum for my dehydrated skin!!
reviews.review_text: I am in love with this serum. I have pretty dehydrated skin all year around and am always on a lookout for something hydrating without it feeling goopy on my skin. In this serum I have found it all. It barely has any scent which is a big plus for me . It has more like a gel like texture which is really smart coz unlike some other hydrating serums that can be too watery , this serum spreads smoothly without dripping hence no wastage. I do have to layer it with a richer moisturizer. But I feel someone with oilier skin could get away just with this serum alone . Overall it’s a really nice serum and I will definitely recommend it!!!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Let me start off with the packaging first. The little box it comes in so pretty and the jar of eye cream itself is soo beautiful and elegant! The  Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream  feels extremely luxurious on the delicate under eye area. It’s texture is very creamy yet it doesn’t feel goopy. It gets absorbed in the skin very nicely and sits beautifully under makeup. This is the biggest positive for me as I wear concealer everyday . It definitely has made my really dry under eye area super hydrated and even without makeup I look more alive( like I had a great 8hr sleep). I didn’t notice a huge difference with my dark circles but I guess they are hereditary and nothing really can fix those. Over all Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream is a superior product that really works on hydrating the delicate skin around the eyes and fighting those wrinkles!!

reviews.review_text: I am soo in love with this product. Right away I noticed my skin felt and looked plump. It made my skin glow and gave it that well hydrated dewy look!!! reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: It’s an anti-aging facial oil that combines the power of a serum, the richness of an oil, and the freshness of a toner to visibly smooth, plump and revitalize the skin.First impression: The oil is super fragranced, so if you’re ultra-sensitive to scent in your skin-care products, you may find this option off-putting. The product comes with a dropper which helps you pick up the liquid and just use 2-3 drops. Apply them on the palm of your hand and gently massage it so you can break up those little seeds and afterwards put it on your face. I like to gently pat the product onto my skin and then massage it.It has a very watery consistency and it just doesn’t feel like a typical face oil. It’s a super hydrating and moisturizing product .It left my skin smooth, soft and with a super comfortable feel. It plumps my skin and I also love that dewy glow. I love that it dries down and penetrates the skin super quickly so I can follow up with another product if I want.Final thoughts: this is an amazing oil  that does have a heavy scent but it works wonders for hydration and glow. If you can afford the price point then it definitely a great product!!!!

reviews.review_text: *I received this product free from Influenster*It was so exciting to receive this product because I was in the market for a new toner! Packaging is again, gorgeous. With the pale pink color and the rose emblem. Beautiful. And it is a good sized bottle. The consistency is different than a typical toner. It is a lotion toner. Liquid enough to apply with a cotton pad but thicker than water. Toner is used after cleansing and my skin immediately feels hydrated and refreshed. It’s not hydrating enough that I’d go without a moisturizer but it defiantly offers some pre moisturizer hydration. The toner and Hydrazen moisturizer are a beautiful combination. I also love anything with hyaluronic acid. If you’re looking for a toner to even skin tone/help with acne this probably isn’t the toner for you. This toner helps clean your remaining skin after cleansing and begin the moisturizing process.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: *I received this product free from Influenster* I loved this moisturizer. First off, the packaging is gorgeous. The jar is a beautiful shade of pale pink with sweet rose on the lid. The actual moisturizer is a similar shade of pale pink presumably because it is rose infused. It has a floral scent but it not overpowering and goes away once rubbed in. It has a gel texture which I don’t normally love but this actually does hydrate my skin without feeling like it melted away into nothing. It’s spreads quite easily and I normally bring it all the way down my declitae. It’s moisturizing without feeling greasy but I also feel like my skin is actually hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have very tired, dry, dull, and dark under eyes. Needless to say I have tried a lot of under eye creams. And I have found the one. No eye cream has ever moisturized my under eye and eye lid. I honestly feel like my eyes looked brighter and fuller. It has a gel like consistency. I tend to prefer products that feel “cold” when applied to the eye. The cooling effect helps depuff. I think the gel is particularly beneficial to the eye area because it’s hydrating without feeling too heavy. Have and will continue to repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: These are the most wonderful lip balms I have ever used. On top of smelling delicious they keep my lips hydrated and supple and even add a hint of color (depending on which flavor you choose.) Initially I bought grapefruit and I went back today to buy the remaining scents. Absolute recommend! Fantastic lip balm!

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_title: good product! minor issues! would repurchase!
reviews.review_text: *I received this product free from Influenster* This is a really beautiful product! I love that they put a serum in a stick form - way less messy. I use this product primarily at night before my moisturizer on my fine lines and wrinkles (forehead and mouth). I see a difference when I wake up in the morning. My wrinkles are filled in and makeup does not collect in them as much throughout the day. I only rated it 4 stars because it says the product can be used as a “touch up” stick over makeup and that is not true. It takes my makeup off if used over top. I also love/hate the packaging. The stick is convenient but the cap is slightly difficult to take off. I also wish it was slightly creamier. It pulls at my eyes a bit. Overall fantastic product!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been loving glow recipe products, I have a pretty dry skin and the gel. Insistence of this brand products works very well for my skin. Smells amazing not too strong and I see the difference in hydration. Packaging is cute and since is glass can be recycled.

reviews.review_text: I loveeeee this product. I really wanted to get into retinol, and was worried my skin would be irritated so I decided to try this product. I don’t need to use spot treatment anymore because it gets rid of blemishes or makes them 90% less angry by the morning. I’ve been using it for almost 2 months (with a one week break for vacation) and can’t imagine not having this in my routine from now on.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Beautiful cream. I love the texture, it feels rich and smooth without being heavy. I was using a gel eye cream before this and felt like that just sat on my skin and didn’t do much. I’ve been using this for less than a week and I already see a positive difference.

reviews.review_text: I got this in one of my Play! boxes and didn’t think I would use it. I figured it would be one of the samples I tossed aside. Needless to say, it has graduated to being one of the face creams i use regularly, and I always scoop it up if it’s available as a reward or beauty offer. It wears beautifully and really calms my sensitive skin. Love.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this from Algenist to try for 10 days. I used it AM & PM. First, I’ll say the texture of the cream is amazing! It’s suuuper soft, and luxurious without feeling greasy or heavy. The cream was great for my skin, I had zero issues or reactions using it. The only thing I detract from my score is that I didn’t find it THE most hydrating, but honestly I really enjoyed using it and could see myself purchasing this going forward. My under eye area looked really nice and definitely brighter with consistent use.

reviews.review_text: I was kinda skeptical buying this product and didn’t believe that it would do the miracle it does. Now, I’m pretty sure I’ll remain addicted to it till the end of my days. reviews.review_text: If you’re looking for a nice gentle makeup remover that’s not gonna dry out your skin, this is the product for you! Although if you are acne-prone, I do recommend using this as a first cleanser and then double cleanse with some reallyyyy gentle soap or another cleanser.

Plus, I’m very sensitive to moisturizers, most moisturizers make my skin break out like crazy (although my skin is very dry) and this one never caused a single pimple on my face. I think people with oily skin will also be able to enjoy this cream, as it’s very light.I will most probably repurchase.

reviews.review_text: Ok I love this. reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I love this toner so much, it makes my skin beautiful and glowy and keeps those little bumps at check. The skin absorbs it nicely, leaving my face feeling hydrated and clean.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I’ve been struggling with breakouts recently and decided to give this product a try. At first, I was considering returning it because the smell is absolutely horrible (and lingers; if you’re very sensitive to smell you might want to avoid this). I also didn’t realize it’s targeted for oily skin, which is not an issue I have. I settled on the fact that I would return it until I woke up the next day. I had a fairly large pimple on my temple and it shrunk down immensely. I plan on giving this a go for a little while longer to see if this is what’s doing the trick; so far I’m pretty impressed!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: If you’re someone with sensitive skin, but require an exfoliator for deep cleansing then this might be a good option for you. This product is great for gentle exfoliation and will leave your skin feeling smooth. As someone who breaks out easily, this is one product I can depend on. I’ve heard some people have trouble working with this product. The best way I’ve found is to pour a very small amount of powder in your hand, add a touch of water and then rub your hands together; apply to dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This mask is the best. I use it on myself and my daughter at night and during the day. It makes my lips soft and it smells so good. Very healing.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I used my whole jar of this but I wouldn’t say it was a miracle worker. My skin is just so dry nothing helps. It was very kind to my daughters skin though and I got my friend hooked on it.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Best sunscreen ever!!!!!! Everything about it is just perfect. Smooth finish just like primer. Not greasy and no whiteness. Finally something that my daughter can tolerate. She’s 4 and hates it when I put sunscreen on her so this helps because it’s not wet.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Best sunscreen ever!!!!!! Everything about it is just perfect. Smooth finish just like primer. Not greasy and no whiteness. Finally something that my daughter can tolerate. She’s 4 and hates it when I put sunscreen on her so this helps because it’s not wet.

reviews.review_text: I do like this moisturizer but it’s kinda sticky or something. I put it on and it doesn’t sink in very good. I only use it when going to bed. I wouldn’t use it before makeup. But it does moisturize and perks up my skin.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser. It gets all my makeup off and doesn’t make me feel oily or like my skin is stretched. I use it every night even when I don’t wear makeup. Not much of a smell either.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The most perfect cleanser! I love that it doesn’t leave my skin feeling striped but cleanses and minimizes my pores at the same time. My skin feels soft and the scent is very subtle. I use daily morning and at night to clean my makeup off. I find it works well to cleanse makeup off of my face. So far the whole Drunk Elephant skin care line has been amazing for my skin.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I was looking to replace my old hydrating mask because I found it wasn’t working as well since I moved the to east coast. This one did the trick! The harsh winters here always leave my face feeling dry and tight. This mask cured all of the issues I had. I used this product along with the T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Night Serum before I go to bed and I wake up with the most hydrated glowing skin. The Drunk Elephant skincare line has saved my skin.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have tried so many products for hydration. This is the one that finally did the trick! I have very dry acne prone skin and since using I have noticed my skin no longer feels dried out and tight. I use it every morning with Drunk Elephant C-Firma Vitamin C Day Serum. The combination gives me an amazing glow every morning and does not make my pores feel as if they’re clogged. This product was a skin saver!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: A Little Goes a Long Way
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way with this moisturizer! This works throughout all seasons for my skin. After application it sets in immediately and leaves my skin feeling replenished and clean. Will definitely be buying again!

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is incredibly lightweight! I use every morning and find it greatly reduced any dark circles and my eyes appear brighter. When it first comes out it feels like it will be very heavy but it sets in very light. Will definitely buy again!

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love love love this butter cleanser! I use it daily to take my makeup off. It works very nicely and doesn’t leave my skin feeling stripped and dried. The Bamboo Booster is also a great exfoliant. It is very gentle of my skin, I just wish they would make a normal size of this product.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I purchased this product with trendmood box. And it definitely didn’t disappoint. I am in love with this cleanser. I have sensitive skin so I’m limited to what my skin likes but this was a knock out for me.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser

reviews.review_text: I purchased this product with trendmood box and have no regrets. I love this stick its so easy to apply and it helps my routine go by faster since it’s in a stick. Perfect for my dry skin.

reviews.review_text: This is by far one of the best lotions I’ve used. I have dry skin and it has helped bring back some of my oils. reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by innisfree  I like this cream because it’s spreads easy. It seems to me that it is a good product for daily use but not for use in water. It has not caused me any side effects or allergies so I am very happy with my facial sunscreen.

reviews.review_text: Gifted by Sunday Riley.  I’ve tried a lot of good products but this one from Sunny Sunday is a blast. reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was super excited to have moisturizer gifted by Glow Recipe to try! I’ve seen so many people use this moisturizer and love it, so I knew I had to get my hands on it. I’ve used this moisturizer a couple of times and was pleasantly surprised. First, if you love how watermelon smells, you’ll totally love this moisturizer. Like most people have said,  it smells exactly like a Watermelon Jolly Rancher (which is my favorite flavor) so I love it! I have used it in the morning after my vitamin C serum and I have found that it sinks into my skin extremely fast and is hydrating for my skin. It’s not heavy and more of a “liquid” moisturizer which I tend to veer towards for my AM routine as I feel like if I layer my makeup, it won’t be cakey.I haven’t tried it as a makeup primer yet, but I can see why people love to do that because of the consistency and how it feels on the skin. It’s light enough to layer and it doesn’t leave your face too oily.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This is one of my favorite niacinamide serums! This serum not only helps to brighten the skin and prevent dullness, but it also gives the most amazing glow! It’s extremely lightweight yet is very effective and absorbs into the skin extremely fast. I haven’t used this product under my makeup yet, but I know it will do wonders on my skin! The smell is also amazing!This product was gifted by Glow Recipe to try and I will definitely repurchase!

reviews.review_text: I’ve been obsessed with SuperGoop for a very long time and have been dying to get my hands on their glow screen sunscreen! This definitely lives up to the hype. reviews.review_title: I'd bathe in this if I could
reviews.review_text: If you have textured, problem skin - this is a gamechanger! I use it once a day at night, and sometimes in the morning w/ SPF if i’m feeling saucy. I even put some in a spray bottle so I could apply to my back and shoulders, where I also get clogged pores. My roomie found it a bit too irritating for her dry, sensitive skin - but my skin is a oil slick and this product is the perfect foil! Life hack: it’s great for preventing ingrown hairs too.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_title: The product I didn't know I needed
reviews.review_text: Man, that Dr. Jart really has things figured out. Chemical exfoliation is a huge part of my routine, as my skin is textured and my pores clog easily. So, with all those acids and peels comes the occasional redness and I was looking for something to calm my skin after I do a number on it in my exfoliation step. I apply this at night, about 30-60 mins after my chemical exfoliant and it really helps to even things out and calm my skin. Then in the morning my skin is not only smooth, but also even-toned and glowing! Also, I know this is trivial, but I love the bottle and dispensing dropper. The only challenge that comes with this is balancing it in my routine with retinol, as the two shouldn’t be used together. Even if you don’t think you have irritated, sensitive skin - give this a try! You might not even know you need it.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: What else can I say? This product is perfect. I got hooked on Lactic Acid after getting a sample of Sunday Riley’s Good Genes. This is the perfect concentration, it’s strong but doesn’t cause irritation on my oily skin. And the price point is fantastic.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: I’m pushing 30 and Vitamin C has become a huge part of my routine to undo the sun damage I acquired in my twenties. This is my absolute favourite Vit C product - it’s super potent and improves the texture and tone of my skin. I’m docking a star only because it’s got a bit of a learning curve - you have to be careful about what products you use it with, and the grittiness is a huge turn off at first. But if you stay dilligent and stick with this product you may learn to love it like I have.

reviews.review_text: sticky, overly-fragranced and doesn’t last through the night. get Bite’s Agave Lip Mask instead!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: i like that this product contains papaya, i think it’s rare to find exfoliators/enzymes in a balm cleanser and it does leave my skin smooth and soft. but let’s be completely clear - this is NOT a clean beauty product. it contains the stabilizer polyethylene, which is the same kind of toxic plastic which can leech out of bottles and packaging into your food and drinks. “green“ is in the name but it is NOT a natural product. if that doesn’t freak you out, you do you, but i think you should definitely be aware of what you’re buying. if you want a balm cleanser that’s actually “green“ then just use coconut oil or something? if you’re not seeking out clean beauty then buy Albolene instead - it’s half the price, fragrance-free and has like 5 ingredients.

reviews.review_text: K-beauty brands have been doing this for YEARS, so the formula isn’t exactly unique, and it is SO overpriced for what it is. reviews.review_text: I am quite picky about my moisturizers, but I love to mix them up and try new ones all of the time. I’m currently writing this review an hour after applying for bed and my skin feels soft and moisturized, but smooth and not oily at all. I would highly recommend. I can’t attest to a “glow”, but to be honest I can’t really say that with anything I’ve tried.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil

I did feel like it had a good combination of absorbing and not feeling too oily, but I don’t know that it has enough to rely on this for a daily product on my face. I would highly recommend for neck and I even take the leftover product and rub into my cuticles.  I think it works great mixing with your foundation for a highlighter or even on days that you don’t want to wear much makeup for an extra glow.  I spend a lot of time on the boat and this works for those days without makeup.

The only con is it is like having a deodorant stick and it would take longer to use for the whole body. I loved that I could use on my face and shoulder touch ups in between though.

The consistency is gel like, lightweight and doesn’t leave a sticky residue. I feel like I’m unable to provide a two week or even 48hr skin difference.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing the way it melts into my skin. It’s not heavy or oily & provides a smooth matte finish. It smoothed and blurs light blemishes, dark spots, overcomes dryness and leaves a uniform slightly glowing texture.It can also double as a primer or a base make-up & the product is so versatile that it can be worn by itself or underneath sunscreen. All in all it’s an incredibly good and sophisticated product. The product comes in a classy rose gold packaging and looks incredibly more expensive than it is & brightens up my whole vanity. Almost looks like a high-end perfume. The bottle is sturdy and refillable so it’s better for our pockets and for the environment too!! Overall this is an incredible product that l’m probably going to be using forever. I received it as a trial from influenster and I’m in love with it!! This product is really incredible!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received bareminerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum free from PINCHme and this is my unbiased opinion. I have combination skin type but prone to dehydration; especially during the cold/dry months. I use this product by applying it to wet skin after I shower and let it seep in. The serum is amazing. I feel like my face has a layer of protectiveness on it. I highly recommend it for all skin types.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer Reformulation complimentary from the brand Fresh and this is my unbiased opinion. Okay I LOVE THIS PRODUCT! Probably one of the best hydrating moisturizers I have ever used. I love putting this on my face and leaves a dewy finish! This cream is smooth and luxurious and comes in a very classy glass container that you can recycle. Super moisturizing on my face, has a very fresh soft rose scent and it’s not too heavy on my skin. The smell is very gentle and not overwhelming. I apply it in the morning and at night before bed and it leaves my face and neck feeling hydrated all day and night. This is great for my dry dehydrated skin in the summer and winter because it absorbs so well. I absolutely love this moisturizer and I feel how moisturized my skin is. I’m loving the glow it has given me! I highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: Nicely packaged and sealed. It’s very moisturizing. I have noticed less puffiness and no more dark circles. It’s perfect for daytime as it’s not too heavy and absorbs fast. Wears well under makeup. It definitely helps with puffiness and just makes your eyes look more awake. Reduces puffiness quickly and I love the sheen/shimmer effect that helps to reflect light. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I was first introduced to Shiseido through their sunscreen line in my early twenties. Now in my late twenties, early thirties, their other products are more on my radar than before including this eye cream. I started using eye creams about two years ago when I started noticing my foundation settling in a few fine lines around my eyes as well as getting eczema outbreaks more frequently due to dryness. My last eye cream didn’t have too much to it, more importantly it didn’t have any fragrance (it was only $18) which was great for my eczema. This on the other hand does (similar to Lancôme’s rose scent found in many of their skincare line). It also lists a lot more benefits given the much higher price tag. It’s more hydrating than my last one, which makes it great for waking up with moist under eyes but making it terrible for under powder. Given I have super dry skin and only use cream products now, it works quite well under my creams when I decide to actually put makeup on (working from home). It hasn’t irritated my skin or eyes and the scent doesn’t bother me as much as I anticipated. My fine lines aren’t terrible, if I’m honest, so I’m not in a position to state whether the seven day challenge to see a difference worked or not. I do love this eye cream though and will be repurchasing it once my stash of eye creams are used up. It’s very rich which is perfect for dry weather and dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: When I first read about this product, I wasn’t sure if this was a skincare product or just an expensive primer. Truth be told- it really works as both. If you don’t want to wear makeup, this will help blur your pores and mattify your complexion. It also has niacinamide listed near the top of the ingredient list so with continued usage, you should see a brightening effect. I’ve only been using it for about two weeks so I can’t really comment on that aspect of this product but I can comment on it as a primer. I love it. My makeup looks fresh for hours, even with powder products on top. It keeps my foundation from sinking into my pores and fine lines, particularly around my eyes (big deal for me). Downside, it’s expensive and it’s heavily fragranced.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: When I saw that Glow Recipe was coming out with a hyaluronic acid, I couldn’t wait to get my hands on it. Results were as advertised. All of their products have done wonders for my skin, normal to dry. My skin has been crazy dry recently from the weather change and over exfoliating and this serum, along with their vitamin C one, has helped get my skin back to normal. Definitely will be repurchasing when I run out.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Things I love about this sunscreen for my face, it has a high SPF, doesn’t leave a white cast on my skin and for the most part, feels hydrating. Things I don’t love about this sunscreen for my face, feels a little sticky if I don’t put a primer over it throughout the day and it aggravates my eczema around my eyes. Might not be the perfect face sunscreen for me, but works wonderfully everywhere else and feels hydrating on my dry skin. Will not be repurchasing this in the future as I do have a bit of a reaction from the formula but would recommend for someone else who doesn’t have issues with eczema, particularly on the face.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This is my first try of this brand and I will definitely try their other products. It feels light and absorbs quite quickly without letting your skin with a dry feeling.

reviews.review_text: I only started using this eye serum recently but I really enjoy it. The applicator is super interesting… Kind of like a slanted lip balm applicator. reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This mask is absolutely LOVELY. It has the most beautiful, light honeysuckle fragrance and my skin drank it right up. It goes on like a dream, doesn’t irritate the skin at all, and leaves my thirsty cold-weather skin soft and hydrated. It’s a winter must-have.

reviews.review_text: I am really enjoying this product in my nighttime routine. It has a really light, fresh scent and goes on evenly and easily. reviews.review_text: This has a light refreshing scent! The gel had a smooth texture and it was ver lightweight on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m not too keen on fragrances in skincare, but I will let it be in the once because the citrus scent just wakes me right up in the morning. It’s lovely. Besides that, this has been fantastic for my dry skin. Recently I have experienced more flaking on my face but that has been drastically reduced (to essentially none) with this product. I love it and will continue using it for that alone. As for brightening, I don’t see as much of an improvement but I think that is because I haven’t used it for long enough. If you have dry skin that needs some tlc and you don’t mind orange scents, get this!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: I love how this makes my skin look! It gives a nice matte yet glow look that I quite enjoy. The fragrance is a little much although I was aware it would have a strong scent as that’s on brand with Dior. I can’t say I can attribute this product to any major changes in my skin as I was more looking for it to make my skin look nice throughout the day - which it does and makes it feel very velvety all day long. But it doesn’t clog my pores or cause me to breakout. Also would like to mention that the feel of the bottle is amazing

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer for the summer! It’s light and is the perfect amount of moisture for the humid climate I live in

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It took my skin a few days to enjoy this, but now it has replaced my usual moisturizer! This moisturizer wasn’t cutting it on its own for the first few days, but I stuck it out and my skin adjusted. Now, two weeks in, I find myself reaching for it over my other products. The smell is weird but I only get a whiff of it every once in a while. The texture is the clear winner! It’s stark white and of so creamy, but when it hits the skin it’s a tiny bit cooling like a gel. Truly lovely!

reviews.review_text: I really like this spf, it is not greasy and goes on smoothly. I trust that it is protecting my skin and also hydrating at the same time. I use it when I know my skin is going to see more than 30 mins of sunlight.

I still have some redness but I anticipate it’ll improve as I continue to use this day and night. I have combo/normal skin that lends more towards dry and very prone acne. I haven’t broken out at all from this serum at all.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Great cleanser! A little goes a long way, it lathers, the glass packaging elevates not only how truly clean the product is but also elevates the price point to me. I buy a lot of mini sized products simply because I’m so frequently “on the go” but I’ve purchased the larger size so I can refill the minis so I can always keep it with me. It smells great and fresh and always leaves my skin feeling clean after one cleanse. It’s moisture balancing, non stripping, and never ever clogs my pores. Excellent product and would recommend it to any akin type for sure.

You have to press, press, press this in to really gain full effect. I love pressing it in with my dermapore serum infuser when I’m willing to take that extra step. It seeps into my skim much quicker but the results are what you really want! I use it on drier skin days or over dry areas on my skin. I also use it after I use my PMD treatments and also before a flight, and when I’m healing any extra sun I’m getting. Excellent price point as well. And a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Very hydrating and smells amazinggg. I got this as a sample and will definitely buy!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: My skins feels really clean after, but have not noticed that my pores/blackheads are getting any better.  I still like the mask though!

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: Love! Smells amazing and absorbs really quickly. I have been using this for about 3 months now and my skin feels very soft.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: My skin feels great after using this product, BUT after you apply you really need to wait a long time before applying any make up - otherwise the make up doesn’t sit nicely. I recommend only using this at night time.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: Makes my skin so soft and it comes in a beautiful bottle ! However, deducted a star as it does make my skin break out occasionally.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant to get this moisturizer because I thought it was only for seriously dry skin based on the description BUT it is an amazing product and works great for my skin. I use it only at night and I wake up to fresh and hydrated skin every morning. I pair this with Drunk Elephant’s hydration serum. It also is huge so will last a long time and is not insanely expensive like some other moisturizers at Sephora. Honestly like this better than Drunk Elephant’s protini moisturizer which I used before purchasing this.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: So I haven’t tried all DE products, but this is by far the best one I have tried. It feels like amazing on my skin. I put this on every night with FAB’s moisturizer, and I wake up every morning with extremely hydrated, moisturized skin. There is a lot of hype around DE products that I’m not always sure is justified, but it is with this serum.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: The best sunscreen/primer combo. I use this every single day whether or not I wear makeup and know my skin is protected, while also not looking greasy or shiny which happens with most other sunscreens. The texture is amazing. It works great as a primer as well, I use it with the Illia skin tint and it makes it go on soo much smoother.
