reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I love using a lighter moisturizer in the morning, and this one is perfect!! It smells absolutely incredible and it’s super light while still being moisturizing. FAB products are all pretty great, but this is one of my favorites.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Glow Recipe gifted me these Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Niacimide Dew Drops and after testing them out under all sorts of foundations and on bare skin I am happy to say I’m a huge fan!This product is gel like in texture and absorbs into the skin fast leaving it looking like you just drank a gallon of water daily for the last month (healthy, glowing and smooth). On days when I am wearing little to no makeup (a little concealer under the eyes and lining my brows) this is ALL I NEED to give me confidence in my bare skin. I have also tried this product as a primer under all sorts of foundations from the lightest coverage Glossier skin tint to the fullest Revlon Colorstay foundations and because of how hydrated this makes my skin feel, the foundation doesn’t settle on any dry patches or fine lines. It applies like a dream!The incredible part about this product is that there is NO shimmer/glitter or reflects on it of any kind. It simply gives your skin a glow from within look by hydrating it! Such a simple yet brilliant concept and Glow Recipe nailed it!

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Got dry skin? Looking to invest in better quality skincare? THIS IS THE PRODUCT FOR YOU! La mer gifted me this face cream and I completely understand the hype now. This luxury product is high end in price for a reason. This face lotion makes my skin feel like I’ve been gulping a gallon of water a day. I slather it on all the way from my hairline to my décolletage and feel incredible all day. There is nothing like this out there and it does work great under makeup too.

reviews.review_text: This cream is extremely moisturizing but also magically soaks into the skin incredibly fast. On top of that usually with thicker lotions, anything you apply above it just won’t apply quite right but you will not have that problem with this cream at all plus it smells LOVELY.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the shape of the applicator of this serum so much! I also think they nailed it with the consistency; how thick and rich it feels in a moisturizing way and not a way that feels like it would weigh your skin down. My under eyes certainly felt more hydrated after wearing this and concealer just applied better too!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: The inkey list anti aging serum was perfect for using as a way to help slow or improve the effects of aging. The serum itself was not too thick nor runny it applied evenly to the the skin and kept my skin feeling mositurized.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: Peace out microblading anti wrinkle retinol patches were easy to use they applied with ease and stayed on with no issues. With continued use you can see an improved appearance of the skin.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Dr. Dennis Gross skincare alpha beta extra strength daily peel was a nice skincare product I didnt felt like it was to abrasive to my skin. It made my skin feel healthier and almost like having a professional spa experience. I think with continued use this would really help improve my overall skin appearance.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: The Kiehl’s ultra facial cream with squalane has a great hydrating factor. When applied to face it does not feel greasy and absorbs into the skin quickly. I feel like this Kiehl’s product works on par if not above from other brands I have tried. It doesn’t have an overbearing scent to it its a very natural  fragrance  free smelling cream. I love how hydrated my skin has felt since using this.

reviews.review_text: Thank you for letting me be a part of this campaign I completely enjoyed it it made my face feels so nice and shiny.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Sunday Riley is a very good product I have noticed my pores starting to get smaller and my wrinkles are fading.  It makes my face feel so smooth and healthy! I wish I had longer to use thr product before reviewing it. I feel like l do not have longer to find out what the real results.

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I received the 25% + 2 BHA Exfoliant Peel gifted by Paula’s Choice. As I get older, my face has been going through changes and I’ve been trying to find the right product to reduce those unwanted lines and wrinkles. I’ve noticed a big change in my skin since using the exfoliant peel. I love that I only have to use it once a week and it’s not a long process. I also love that the color is purple, it’s one of my favorite colors! After 10 minutes, I can rinse and continue with my normal skin care routine. My skin has felt much more hydrated and clean recently. I really like Paula’s Choice and the benefits they bring to my skin.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This Shiseido Urban Environmental oil-free sunscreen Broad Spectrum. I am a first time user and I was very impressed with the sunscreen it felt very light. The smell could be improved I was not a big fan of the smell at all.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This is a really cool product. Sprinkle a small amount on your hand and then mix with water, and then rub all over your face. Made me feel like I genuinely walked out of a spa after a facial. Love this product, and despite having to do a little pre-ritual mixing, it’s completely worth it to me

reviews.review_text: i wasn’t sure initially what effect a cream could have on the dark circles underneath my eyes. kiehl’s proved me wrong, in dramatic fashion. the cream felt nice and firm when putting it on each morning and night, and within about 2 weeks, i noticed small improvements, and as the weeks went on, i found a remarkable improvement. i loved this cream!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: there are lots of skincare products on the market, but if you want the best staple for your regiment, this is it. it is so natural and classic, with a really light buttery scent, and leave my skin fresh for up to 24 hours. there’s no fancy ingredient claims here, but Kiehl’s doesn’t need to make any claims to fancy ingredients or technology - this is the real deal.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I found this cream to be very helpful in ensuring that my face was blemish free and feeling refreshed, and at the same time made my face feel firm and youthful

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: No lie, I have probably purchase close to 50 different tubes of this cleanser over the past 12 years since I first started using it. This is holy Grail, this does everything it says it will while being sensitive and never ever irritating the eyes. I will never be without this cleanser.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: So far, so good! I needed a serum that was fairly clean as I have such sensitive skin and break out so easily. This has been fantastic so far! Would recommend to anybody, but especially those who are sensitive. I love Drunk Elephant products and this is another win!

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I am on my fourth bottle of this. I love it! It is lightweight but gets the job done and most importantly it doesn’t cause any sensitivity around my eyes. Would highly recommend, but especially with those with sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: I really wanted to love this
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to love this, as I’ve been trying to use clean skincare, and have quite a few DE products. Sadly, every time I add Protini, I end up breaking out. My skin isn’t overly sensitive and can handle actives, but for some reason this just simply doesn’t work for me. I’ve tried it alone, every other day, cocktail with LaLa, and regardless of all of these, I wake up with breakouts. Will probably have to use as a neck cream. Total bummer.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: Whenever my skin is feeling a little dry, I use this at night and within days it is right back to normal. I  recently started using this every single night after my BHA)AHA treatment, and. Skini has never looked better. This is holy grill status for me for sure.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: Whenever my skin is feeling a little dry, I use this at night and within days it is right back to normal. I  recently started using this every single night after my BHA)AHA treatment, and. Skini has never looked better. This is holy grill status for me for sure.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is similar to a gel/creme moisturizer and is really light weight and hydrating. Absorbs beautifully into the skin. A little goes a long way and will last awhile even with double daily use! Not really scented which I prefer and it’s amazing with sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Definitely a creme moisturizer, it’s a little thick but still absorbs into the skin and leaves it feeling hydrated and glowing. Absolutely love that this has no scent and works really well for oily/sensitive skin. A little goes a long way even with double daily use.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_title: Perfect for a moisturizer and a primer!
reviews.review_text: I use this as a moisturizer and a primer! Definitely helps my pores look better and hydrated my skin. Doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. Has a very light scent and absorbs beautifully into the skin and leaves it glowy and soft.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Cleanses deeply and effectively while still being very gentle. It smells like cucumber and has a gel like consistency. My face feels very refreshed and cooled after using this.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this and loved it so much that I decided to buy the full size bottle. Pleasant citrus smell and has an exfoliating texture in it. I feel like my face has a healthy glow and softness after using this mask.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I cut these pads in half because they are really hydrated with the solution. I didn’t notice a difference when using on my face for several weeks. Instead I have been swiping them on my underarms right after showering and they really help with odor! Very convenient and effective and I don’t need to worry about any residue transferring to my clothing.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: After 1.5 weeks of using this my skin looks so young and moisturized! Any fine lines have gone away! My skin looks so much better! I received it as a free gift to try from Influenster to review

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I first saw this product blow up on TikTok, which means it was going to be out of stock for a while. I gave up on trying to get my hands on it, and it sounded too good to be true. I ended up receiving a sample size for free and I really like it! It doesn’t provide as much coverage as people made it sound initially, but it has a great smoothing affect on the skin, it just makes everything look more smooth and even toned. I am not sure I will be repurchasing at the price, and the packaging (I don’t like dipping fingers into products) it doesn’t quite seem worth it to me. I saw a lot of people with concerns for breaks outs, I personally have sensor and breakout prone skin and have not had any issues! Even when wearing a mask that is rubbing it deep into my skin!

reviews.review_text: Unscented but really easy to apply and buildable. Also it gets absorbed into the skin really well. I do feel that the skin get tightened right after applying. Really helps with my pores and also gives my skin a clear look. Love it.

reviews.review_text: It’s a bit oily for my skin but it really hydrates my skin after use. Lightly scented but not unpleasant. Spreads smoothly on my skin. Don’t see very obvious anti aging benefits for me yet but I just started using it like 3 weeks ago

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this scrub! I have oily and sometimes combination skin. This works great to remove dead skin and exfoliate my face. reviews.review_text: I like how light this feels under the eyes. The gel formula is nice. Some eye creams sting my sensitive skin but this one is gentle. This is definitely a great go-to for someone who wants something gentle yet effective at targeting fine lines.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a nice, lightweight moisturizer. I have oily skin and I don’t like really heavy creams, especially in the summer. This one definitely feels moisturizing without making my skin feel greasy. It also doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Good product and makes a slight, but noticeable difference. Worth keeping in my rotation!

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: These are great! I bought them for my 13yo, and they have helped get the beginnings of some breakouts under control. They’re pretty pricey, so we use these half the time and a drugstore nose strip the other half the time. These hydrocolloid ones are definitely much better, especially when there are more pimples than blackheads, but the combination has been working well to keep his nose clear!

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: Great for breaking down heavy makeup, gentle
reviews.review_text: This is a great product! I have really oily skin and while I don’t use it daily, I love it for heavy makeup days, or days when my skin is feeling extra sensitive or dry. It’s also awesome for getting rid of stubborn lash glue!It breaks makeup down so well, and really gently. I follow it with the ordinary’s salicylic cleanser, or another soap-based cleanser, because I don’t want any oily residue left on my skin. I’ll definitely buy it again!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Normally, my skin is extremely oily and I have the rather large pores that usually go along with it. I’ve been looking for a night cream to add to my routine, and decided to give this a try before I busted out the big bucks for something else. When I started using this product, my skin was pretty blemish free, and each day for about a week I found myself waking up with breakouts. Eventually it subsided, but with this being the only change to my routine, I chalked it up to this. I decided to keep using it, and like I said, it’s subsided, and my skin is back to normal, but I haven’t noticed any real big changes, good or bad. Skin is pretty well just like I’m not using anything at all. I figure it’s better to use this than nothing at all, and it’s worth it for the price. I’m not necessarily sure if I’d “recommend“ it, I’d say give it a try, but try other options, as well, as I’m still looking for a night cream.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: Having received one of these as a sample, I returned to purchase this, the next larger size. I haven’t attempted to use to remove eye makeup or waterproof makeup, but just a quick freshen up swipe or something along those lines, works great. Especially considering the next type of wipes (from a different brand) are more money for less wipes, I think it’s a win.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: Like many, I purchased looking for an affordable alternative to my regular lactic acid treatment. I’ve been mixing it with the remainder of the cream I had, both to reduce any transition effects and because this stuff is literally like water, whereas what I currently use (a certain popular product with the initials GG) is a cream. So far, it’s been just as good in effectiveness, but I’m still adjusting to the liquid. When I say it’s like water- I’m not being dramatic lol. I’m still figuring out the most effective way to put it on, because dropping some on your fingers and then applying to your face (what I did with BHA serums with the same applicator) don’t cut it. Applying directly to face seems to waste product, because a very little goes a long way. I do recommend, though. It’ll be great as soon as I can figure it out lol

reviews.product_name: Mini Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I’ll be honest, I just don’t understand what this is :’) it’s not a toner, it’s not a treatment...I just don’t know what to do with it. I have oily skin and thought I’d pick it up to try out as an all over BHA treatment, but it’s literally liquid. Not a gel, not a serum...a liquid. If I’m using a cotton pad to apply it, doesn’t that make it a...toner? Well, no, it says. Ok, then...? I’m glad I picked up the smaller size as opposed to going for the full. What I’ve ended up doing is applying it directly from the bottle (literally) to my face before I put my treatment on, and...ok? I guess? It’s just an added oomph to boost whatever I happen to be using that night (I rotate.) I guess it works well for that use, but definitely not necessary, and I won’t be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This night cream is my new go to ! The texture is rich and it absorbs well. I wake up in the morning GLOWING !! I also like that there is no fragrance as I have sensitive skin , this caused me no irritation .

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This night cream is my new go to ! The texture is rich and it absorbs well. I wake up in the morning GLOWING !! I also like that there is no fragrance as I have sensitive skin , this caused me no irritation .

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I have oily sensitive skin with large pores . This cream has a great texture, nice light  scent,  absorbs quickly and sits wonderfully under my makeup while also hydrating . This will be a new staple in my skincare routine !

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This serum is wonderful! Absorbs well and makes my skin fresh and hydrated for makeup prep . Did not cause my sensitive skin any breakouts and it has a lovely scent !

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I never thought I would spend money on a makeup remover like this... I had used a makeup eraser for a very long time, having never come across anything better. When I ordered a deluxe sample of this with points I used the sample for 3 months daily before running out. I tested a few other makeup removal methods before ordering the full size. This Removes everything and rinses off soooooo easily, it’s faster and more efficient than a makeup eraser, and one tub lasts forever. I cannot believe I am spending this much on a product, but I cannot find anything that works this well. The cost is worth it, especially with how long this lasts. you don’t need much to take off a full face including eyes of makeup.

reviews.review_text: I am trying to decide if this has led to product addiction like so many other lip masks i have tried where it become necessary to use this product constantly without a withdrawal. That being said the results in the morning are always super soft and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for nearly two years now and can say I can see a difference within three days of stopping using this in my routine. It is not an acne saviour but as I get my skin more and more under control, the difference the active ingredients make is noticeable. I take a drop or two on my fingertips and pat this into my skin as part of my serum step in my skincare. Every time i try to quit using or replace with other products at lower concentrations I regret it and order more. This review is only 4 stars because of it’s reactions with some of my other skincare (pilling or hypersensitive reactions)

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love this SPF! If you’re worried about it making your skin oily, don’t worry it won’t! It gives absolutely no shine, I like to say it goes on matte! No crazy scent!

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love this SPF! If you’re worried about it making your skin oily, don’t worry it won’t! It gives absolutely no shine, I like to say it goes on matte! No crazy scent!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: Ok! This dark spot toner I feel has helped even out my skin, and at the same time has cleared some dark spots I had from previous acne. It does sting a little but doesn’t burn or anything, I first purchased the small bottle to try it out, but then went back for the large because I love it so much!

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: This quick facial smells amazing! Minimized the appearance of my pores! Leaves skin feel soooo soft! I love it!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: There are not enough words to describe the incredible results I’ve seen from using Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel for 2 WEEKS. I received 3 uses from PINCHMe. After one use, I had to order a month supply because I knew I could not live without it. I have dealt with hormonal, chronic, and cystic adult acne for 4 months and was at my wits end. When I started using this product, my daily breakouts were very literally a thing of the past. I could not believe it. The first use I immediately saw my skin brighten up, and I actually got emotional because I had been fighting for months for my skin to feel and look the way it did after ONE use with the Dr. Dennis Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel. With regular daily use, it very literally transformed my skin. I still get emotional talking about the amazing things this product did for my skin.I have tried multiple, gentle exfoliation products on myself and on my clients to no avail. This one ACTUALLY works, is incredibly gentle, but miraculously effective. No redness, no dryness, and not a single bit of irritation. It is a product I will forever recommend. It is a life changer. I want everyone to experience what I have. From the bottom of my heart...THANK YOU!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This product has really changed my skincare game, my skin is so much smoother and more glowing when used 2-3 times a week. It’s the first retinol product I’ve tried and I was worried how my skin would react but it’s amazing. I use the inkey list hyaluronic acid afterwards to lock in moisture. Absolutely love this product!

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for 2 weeks now and WOW WOW WOW. I’m usually a tough critic with skincare but I have to say that this product is worth every penny. My skin feels renewed, soft and glowing without any irritation whatsoever. Really impressed.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I really love the texture of the product. Not too heavy and soothing to my skin. I haven’t seen the results as far as pore refining goes yet but I’m willing to try this longer just because I like it so much.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I love that these are put into individual packets, it keeps them fresh and easy for storing.

reviews.review_text: I got this as a free sample from Pinchme. I’m not typically a serum user, but I did enjoy this one. The fragrance isn’t overpowering and it made my skin feel smooth and not greasy afterwards.

reviews.review_text: This product has been working wonders for my sensitive, oily

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Great Summer Moisturizer For Oily Skin!
reviews.review_text: Lightweight formula that’s great for oily skin! I have pretty sensitive, oily and acne-prone skin and this has been perfect for me to use in the summer. I typically gravitate to gel moisturizers and this is one of the thinnest I’ve found that still give great hydration and replenish skin with good for you ingredients. This is the second or third bottle I’ve purchased, I just wish that it didn’t have such a strong watermelon scent!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: After seeing this product everywhere the last few weeks I was excited to finally try! First of all, let me tell you that the glow is REAL. Even when applying a moisturizer or makeup after the serum, a natural amount of glow shines through. It’s honestly the healthiest my skin has ever looked! I did find the finish to be quite tacky, as is normal for niacinamide products, so I can’t imagine wearing this as the last step in my routine. I was also concerned about the scent being watermelon, but this is light and dissipates quickly. Gifted by Glow Recipe.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Works well for acne-prone skin. It helped to clear my skin up.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Makes your lips super soft and hydrated! Loved that you only have to put it on at night for it to work. downside is the price of the product

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Smells good. I liked how it helped to minimize pores, it didn’t break my skin out and I have acne prone skin.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: Great clay mask! Love the smell of this clay mask. Once applying on this clay mask, it does dry down very fast, therefore, you do need to work quickly with it. Once the clay dry up, it almost seem as if your face is getting a Botox, since it tighten the face. This can be a 2 in 1 as it does exfoliate the skin too, which is a plus to this rose clay mask. I really like how it feels after washing my face as it is super smooth and flawless. Great claymask. Will be purchasing the full size.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Nice great cleanser. First time using it, I felt like it did nothing as it was super gentle!!! This did not strip my face as making it super dry at all, it felt nice and smooth. Second and third use, I finally had some makeup on, and oh lord, this is my new makeup cleanser! This remove all of my makeup and mascara! I’m shock as this is super gentle! It has a scent of cucumber smell to it, which doesn’t bother me. So far, I love it! With this I don’t have to go in with my face wipe and cleansing oil, I can just dive into this cleanser to do all the work! Amazing!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: This is a very very gentle exfoliating scrub!!! I love how gentle it is. Doesn’t strip my skin apart. It is very gentle to use it every day as an exfoliating scrub as it is not harsh at all. Because it is so gentle, I felt like it doesn’t cleanse the face that well. It is true that the sugar crystals along with the strawberry extract melt away as you scrub your face with it. The smell is delicious! For someone with sensitive skin, this hasn’t cause any reaction to my face yet. It is a good exfoliating scrub but not the greatest. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Where to start? So the smell is reminiscent of watermelon Jolly Ranchers mixed with a bit of earthiness. The texture is a little stickier (and somehow simultaneously slimy?) than other toners I’ve used. They recommend using your hands to apply but also say you can use a cotton pad. I tried both and I’d say your hands is a better bet because it soaks into the pads and doesn’t release much onto the skin so it wastes a lot of product. But does it shrink pores? Maybe I just have monster pores, but I haven’t noticed much change in my pores. It is nice and summery though and doesn’t dry out your skin so it’s  a nice product but probably not a staple for my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Where to start? So the smell is reminiscent of watermelon Jolly Ranchers mixed with a bit of earthiness. reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I was actually surprised by the results after one use. I didn’t think it’d make much of a difference having only one pad to test it, but the texture of my skin in the morning after using it was oddly soft and smooth in a way that my skin hasn’t felt in a long time. But I have to say the smell was not nice. I’m 100% not a fan of fake perfumey smells, but this pretty much smells like glue. That was a huge turnoff for me. If you have sensitive skin the glycolic acid might be a little strong for you, I definitely felt some burning/tingling and my skin is not sensitive at all. But that stopped pretty quickly. I probably won’t buy a full size package because honestly it’s way out of my price range, but this product does work.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: The first time I used this I had to stop myself and ask if I was just tricking myself into thinking that my skin felt different the next day. But after more uses I realized that it did indeed make my skin softer the next day. However, I’ve had to limit myself to one use per week so my skin doesn’t get irritated. The more I’ve used it though, the less impactful it feels. My skin texture doesn’t feel as nice the next day now as it did when I first started using it. I’m not sure if anyone else has run into that or if it’s just my skin.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This is the best makeup remover I’ve tried. I only had to use a small amount for my entire face so I think this tub will last quite a long time. It removed every bit of makeup without leaving me feeling oily. I always double cleanse but with this I feel like I wouldn’t have to. I’d definitely repurchase and recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This is the best makeup remover I’ve tried. I only had to use a small amount for my entire face so I think this tub will last quite a long time. It removed every bit of makeup without leaving me feeling oily. I always double cleanse but with this I feel like I wouldn’t have to. I’d definitely repurchase and recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant to try this because of the price but I splurged during the VIB sale. I have oily, sensitive skin and after one use my skin looks fresh, less congested and my pores appear smaller and more refined. I’m excited to see the results after a month or so of use. If you can afford this give it a try! It’s worth all the hype!

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This does exactly what it says it will. Awesome product, would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This does exactly what it says it will. Awesome product, would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: These are amazing. I bought the small packs a few times, but have bought the large pack twice now. I have very oily skin, so dead skin cells dont slough off as they should, and my skin will look dull and textured because of it. The Extra Strength peels are something I will not be without. They have minimized my pores, reduced the number of breakouts that I get, and my skin looks bright, healthy, and flawless. I recommend them to everyone, but be mindful of getting the appropriate strength for your skin type. Someone who is dry or dry-combo should gravitate more towards the gentle/normal formula, and start out with only a few times per week to avoid over exfoliation and irritation. You can increase use once skin has become acclimated to the product. I use them at night only, and one must use an SPF during the day as AHAs cause increased sensitivity to the sun.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: Didnt work for me but it may for you.
reviews.review_text: Unfortunately this product did not work for me. But that doesnt mean it wont work for you. I regularly use my Dr Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Peels, but was curious about DE products, so I decided to splurge and get the large Framboos. I had used the Sukari Baby Facial without any issues, but this one gave me some issues. Woke up with clusters of milia/whiteheads all over my face that did not go away with continued use (hoped my skin would acclimate to the product). Once I stopped using it my skin went back to blemishless. Tried using it again and same result. Had to return and swooped up my Alpha Beta Peels. Was super sad because I love DEs philosophy and their packaging. Which is why I gave it 3 stars.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_title: Works well, great for the price point.
reviews.review_text: I really like this product.  I am experienced with peels and have a very oily skin type that is not sensitive to acids. This product is meant to be used as a mask after cleansing. Alpha hydroxy acids work above the skin to slough away dead skin cells and beta hydroxy acids work below the skin to decongest pores (alpha=above, beta=below). I will actually use this product after using Peter Thomas Roths Firm X Peel Gel  To remove the bulk of dead skin from my face. That way I can ensure that the Beta hydroxy acid so get down into my pores to clean them out. This might be too much for some, but it works great for my skin type, dermal thickness, and sensitivity level. There is some tingling with this product that might be more intense for people with skin sensitivities. Always make sure to use SPF when using a product containing AHA’s or BHA’s as they increase skins photosensitivity.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer. It doesn’t have super strong fragrance, which I like and is very light for my oily/acne prone skin. A little goes a long way on my skin. If I overdo it, my skin feels a bit too greasy. I used to use Clinique Dramatically Different moisturizing gel, but this gives me just a little more TLC. I give this 4 stars because it’s a little costly. Definitely worth trying!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Really love this product. It really helps my acne prone/oily skin. My only complaint is it could feel a bit more moisturizing. I suppose I’m used to water and gel-based moisturizers making my skin feel uber revived in the morning, but this just isn’t as moisturizing as I’d hoped. Otherwise, I love it. It evens out my skin tone and makes my skin look plump and full. Will repurchase

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product. It has brought fullness to my skin that I was lacking and helps a little with wrinkles. The smell is light and fresh, I don’t feel like this is heavily perfumed. Not sure what these other users are smelling. I have used this for at least 4 months and I just love it in my routine. I can see a difference in my skin if I miss a day. I use this day and night but would really love to try the night cream soon.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This product works amazing, but definitely follow the instructions and watch your skin. Do not overdo with this product or it will irritate your skin. I use this at night and follow it with soothing oil/lotion, I also recommend doing this every other night, or so, and going up to every night, if wanted/needed.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I am so happy to have found this product! I have struggled with acne, all my life, and nothing worked for me... I even broke down and put the dent in my wallet to buy proactiv just because I was so desperate for something to work. I found this product, after hearing about this brand by someone I watch on youtube, and I was amazed with how cheap it was... then I stayed to use it and I fell in love and almost cried when I saw the difference it started to make. This cleanser and the omega water cream lotion (from the same brand) is absolutely amazing together.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_title: Definitely a need on my list
reviews.review_text: This was a game changer to my skin routine, absolutely love this. I even got my husband hooked on them too.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This product is absolutely great for reducing under eye puffiness and giving your under eye area a huge moisture blast! I personally prefer to use it before bed as opposed to in the morning because I feel like the product is able to be absorbed by your skin better. I did notice that when I applied it in the AM before makeup, my under eye makeup tended to settle into my fine lines. I did receive this product as a gift, but I would suggest it and use it again.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_title: SPF that feels like a silk veil
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is absolutely amazing. It’s effective as a sunscreen, I wore it while a rollerskating and it stood up to the brutal NC sun. When used in your face, it gives you this amazingly smooth complexion and feels like a silk canvas. It’s perfect for layering your daily makeup and BB creams on. It is kind of liquidy, so just be aware of that, but beyond the consistency it’s absolutely fantastic.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_title: no fuss and goes on super smooth!
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is absolutely amazing. It’s no fuss, clear, and goes on smoothly and evenly. The sunscreen stick itself is very firm and doesn’t seem easily breakable or flaky. The sunscreen is very effective and even makes your face feel silky smooth. Makes for a great base for daily makeup, while protecting you from harmful UV rays!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I initially got this as a points perk, and I loved it so much I got a second one!  And my first one (which was only 0.1 oz) literally lasted me 2 months!  I caved and bought the full size during the VIB sale, and I have no idea how I’m ever going to use all of it.   I can tell when I’ve been lazy and haven’t worn it in a few days; my lips will start to peel a little (gross, I know) and my lip products cling to flakey patches.  But as soon as I use it again, I have beautiful, hydrated lips with zero peeling in just a day or two.  Plus it smells like berries!  So worth the money, especially for the amount of product you get!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I bought this along with the companion serum, and I really like them both.  I’ve always had redness in my cheeks and nose, and wanted to see if these products could minimize it at all.  I like to wear this on days where I’m going for a quick and natural makeup look.  I find the coverage is similar to a tinted moisturizer or a BB cream.  It does a fantastic job of neutralizing redness while still being natural enough that I don’t look like I’m wearing a mask.  The only complaint I have is that my face is still oily at the end of the day, more so than when I do my face with my normal foundation.  It also tends to wear down around my chin and nose after several hours, but I find that setting it with powder helps keep it matte and in place longer.  Overall its a really fantastic natural base product with skincare benefits, but you may run into issues with longevity if you have very oily skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I bought this along with the companion serum, and I really like them both. Overall its a really fantastic natural base product with skincare benefits, but you may run into issues with longevity if you have very oily skin.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I really love this serum!  I initially purchased this to reduce redness in my cheeks and nose, and I have noticed some improvement over the last month.  I think the improvement in your skin really depends on how severe your redness is to start with.  My favorite part about this serum is how calming it is on irritated/inflammed acne; I find that it’s fantastic for reducing inflammation I get from my cystic acne flare ups, and it feels soooo calming on any irritated spots.  I bought it to reduce redness, but I’ll be repurchasing for the soothing anti-inflammatory benefits!

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this product.  I bought it thinking that it would be a long-wearing CC cream, however it transferred more than any other foundation product I’ve used.  It never set on its own, and even after powder it still didn’t lock in.  Plus it looked grainy and patchy on my skin, and when I tried to fix the patchy areas, it just pulled more foundation off around it.  I plan on returning it because I just can’t find a way to make it work for me.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I received this eye cream for free to review and I must say...this stuff is amazing. I went from exhausted looking due to dark circles to bright eyed and presentable. I found my new favorite piece of make-up.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I was super shocked at how great this was. This smooth cream brightened up my skin, it was glowing and super soft. This is the best my skin has looked in many years. Will definitely be buying.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Well what do you know...confidence can be bought. This cream cleared up my acne and masked acne scarring. I was a whole new person.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is the best moisturizer I have ever tried. My skin is super oily (cystic acne as well) and it is so lightweight, silky going on and literally 30 seconds later my skin has absorbed it. 2 hours later and my skin isn’t oily at all.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This is the best moisturizer I have ever tried. My skin is super oily (cystic acne as well) and it is so lightweight, silky going on and literally 30 seconds later my skin has absorbed it. 2 hours later and my skin isn’t oily at all.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

reviews.review_text: I have a cystic acne, but also have very sensitive, oily skin. This is the first cleanser that has really worked for me.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Absolutely LOVE this cleanser! I really only use it at night after using a cleansing balm to break up my sunscreen and makeup, and this cleanser helps gently remove any remaining gunk on my face without making it feel stripped. It does have a scent/fragrance, but it is not overpowering and smells like fresh air in a good way. I cannot recommend this enough!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Absolutely LOVE this moisturizer! My skin type is combo with a super oily T-zone, but my face tends to get very dry and dehydrated in the wintertime. This moisturizer is one of the best ways I keep my skin hydrated in a cold winter climate! At first it feels like it would be too heavy and thick for my skin, but after application it goes on as smooth as butter (but in a pleasant way!) and melts right into my skin. Could not recommend this more!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_title: Received this product as a tester
reviews.review_text: I love this product and have nothing bad to say about it! It smells great and has made my skin super soft. It’s not heavy and dries fast so I can put my makeup on above it, will definitely be purchasing this product

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this cream and use it on the daily. It smells amazing and it leaves my skin feeling baby soft. A little definitely goes a long way so it is definitely worth the money. I received this product complimentary for reviews but these opinions are my own and I would definitely buy the product when I run out!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample but I would definitely purchase it again. It smells amazing and leaves my skin feeling smooth and hydrated. I use it before applying makeup and my makeup looks really good after application. I would highly recommend this if you don’t mind a smell in your facial products!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample but I would definitely purchase it again. It smells amazing and leaves my skin feeling smooth and hydrated. I use it before applying makeup and my makeup looks really good after application. I would highly recommend this if you don’t mind a smell in your facial products!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Love Love Love this fantastic lip balm!!  I usually prefer stick lip balms cuz the thought of using my finger kinda grosses me out, but after seeing all the positive reviews of this product (and I’m a fan of Fresh’s tube lip balms) I decided to try this one.  I just make sure to wash my hands every time before applying lol.  Anyway, this is feels so good on your lips - it’s smooth, creamy, moisturizing, and smells amazing!  I use it throughout the day and every night before bed.  I also have the limited edition Lemon, and Peach, and sometimes I will apply the Coconut to one lip and put either Lemon or Peach on the the other lip and the combination is simply wonderful!! I plan on buying the Caramel, and Chocolate, to mix and match with this one.   The only ’negative’ with this balm is the price.  Definitely a splurge to spend $18 on a lip balm.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Ok this face cleanser does EXACTLY what the description says, and I love it!!  I have a trial size that I got with my points a couple weeks ago and it’s almost gone so I’ll definitely be getting the full size very soon. It is pricey imo but I will go ahead and make the splurge.  I’m loving this cleanser because it gently yet effectively removes all of my face makeup (moisturizer, primer, foundation, setting spray - the works), and it rinses away very easily and quickly (not like other cleansers that seem really ’soapy’ and take awhile to rinse off).  I use it by squeezing some cleanser onto my palm, adding a little bit of water, then rubbing for a couple of seconds til it becomes a light lather. I then massage it onto my face for a minute or so, then rinse.  I do use a separate remover for my eye makeup, but accidentally got some of this cleanser in my eyes and it did not sting! OMG

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This may very well be THE BEST face cleanser of all time. I’ve used it for a few years now and it works amazing at dissolving away literally ALL of your makeup, yet it’s gentle and rinses off easily. A little goes a long way so this tub does last a long time for the price. Bonus points for it being spill proof because it’s not a liquid, and it smells like it’s unscented (or fragrance free? there is a difference but I forget what it is lol) I have oily sensitive skin with mild rosacea and this cleanser balances it perfectly - it does not irritate, strip, or break me out.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

A little goes a long way so this tub does last a long time for the price. reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I am an acne prone teenager and this has absolutely saved my skin. I used to suffer from cystic acne and tons of pimples around my cheeks. I now only get the occasional breakout, but no more cystic acne!! I apply this at night and I pat it in (I found it worked better if I gently patted it into my skin opposed to rubbing it in). This serum is a staple in my everyday skin routine.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I love it! I wet my face first and that helps the serum retain moisture. I also apply it in the morning. It really plumps the skin and is a great price! I’m a teenager and acne prone but this does not make me break out at all.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this oil! I apply it every night after I apply my moisturizer and I wake up with glowing skin. I am pretty prone to breakouts but this oil has not given me any. It is a great oil choice if you use a gua sha and is also great for relieving sensitive areas of the skin as well as dry patches.

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water
reviews.review_text: This stuff is pretty amazing. I tested it at Sephora and was a little hesitant, but I REALLY liked it. Now I have a bit of a farmers tan because I only sprayed it on the skin that was showing...oops. Definitely going back and picking this up! I also love how it’s cruelty free and vegan.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: Honestly I wasn’t sure what to expect, when you hear that a sticker can help cure pimples it sounds too good to be true, but oh boy I was wrong. This product is amazing. It doesn’t 100% take away my pimples, but it stops it from growing and getting worse. I have had smaller pimples where it did pretty much take it away, which was amazing. But I’m impressed, this is my 5th purchase and I’m gonna keep telling my friends about it because they really WORK!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have oily skin, so I’m always hesitant when trying a new moisturizer/cream. I was pleasantly surprised with the way it stayed on my face overnight. I woke up and my skin was a little oily, but not something I couldn’t handle. The consistency is quite watery. It also has a very strong fragrant smell, which is the only reason I gave it 4 stars. I wouldn’t recommend this product as a primer for foundation, if you have oily skin, but it’s a great moisturizer to put on before bed! Full disclosure, I received this product through VoxBox.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I got this product complimentary of Influenster and Tatcha to review. Let me just start off by saying, I waited over two weeks and used this product every morning and every night in my skin care regimen. And WOWOWOW. I can REALLY tell a difference already. It makes my skin feel so hydrated and plump. After two weeks, I can tell that my skin feels softer, my skin tone is evening out, and I don’t have as many textured spots or dry patches. This product really is nice, and I am not one to splurge on super expensive skincare that I know I will go through quickly, but I know for a fact I will be saving up to repurchase this.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I actually enjoyed this. I feel like it really moisturized under my eyes and I did notice a difference when I used it. I’m only 21, so I hadn’t hopped on the eye cream train yet, but this might’ve pulled me in.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: Nice smell, absorbs quickly and did its job! I really enjoyed this because it’s getting hotter where I am and this was a nice, simple addition to my every day routine. Never felt greasy, didn’t break me out. I enjoyed it but I didn’t see enough of a difference for me fall head over heels for it.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed this serum a lot. Assembling it was actually so cool! My main issue is the stinkkkkkk it has that lingers for a while. It also kind of stings every time I use it. I’ve had good results though! I am glad I had the chance to try it out.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I can’t say enough about this cleanser. I have super dry, sensitive skin with rosacea so finding a cleaner that does irritate my skin or dry me out even more is a challenge. This cleanser is more than up to the task! It leaves my skin feeling soft and doesn’t irritate the rosacea.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I can’t say enough about this cleanser. I have super dry, sensitive skin with rosacea so finding a cleaner that does irritate my skin or dry me out even more is a challenge. This cleanser is more than up to the task! It leaves my skin feeling soft and doesn’t irritate the rosacea.

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: While this product did everything as advertised I couldn’t get past how strong the scent was. I was expecting a lighter fragrance like the rose mask but this was too much. Even the next morning all I could smell was the rose and it was just overpowering.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen. I have super sensitive skin and also rosacea so finding a sunscreen that works for me can be a challenge. A lot of sunscreens contain ingredients that can aggravate rosacea, but I’ve not had any issues or reactions to this product. I love that it’s fragrance free since my skin can also react to some ingredients that are used to add fragrances.  This goes on nicely and leaves my skin feeling soft.  Since it’s clear I don’t see any type of discoloration that can come happen with other sunscreens. I took one star away simply because I don’t feel that this works as a primer like the packaging claims. I definitely notice a difference when I use a primer on top of this than when I apply my foundation directly over this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen. I have super sensitive skin and also rosacea so finding a sunscreen that works for me can be a challenge. reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I have overly dry and sensitive skin with rosacea. I’ve been using this for a couple of weeks now and it’s made a huge difference. This evens out my skin tone and covers the red without needing to use multiple products. It is perfect for “no makeup” days, but I do follow it up with the It Cosmetics setting spray to add some extra staying power and hydration. It also works wonderfully under my foundation. The cream itself has a fresh herbal scent that is pleasant without being medicinal. A little goes a long way as the product is quite thick. I’ve found the best way to apply it is pat it into the skin with my fingertips. I tried using a brush and a sponge, but both left the coverage too heavy and even patchy in spots so it looked discolored. It definitely took me several days to get the hang of applying the right amount correctly to get a natural look.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I have overly dry and sensitive skin with rosacea. I’ve been using this for a couple of weeks now and it’s made a huge difference. reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant to try this because I didn’t think it would live up to the marketing, but it surpassed all of my expectations. My skin is super dry and sensitive plus I have rosacea. The rosacea has caused quite a bit of texture where the redness is the heaviest. The cream is rich and unscented which I prefer in my products. It absorbs quickly without leaving any film, grease, or residue. I like the packaging with the push down dispensing - no worries about contamination and always get the right amount of product.  On the first night I used this I could immediately feel a difference in how soft my skin felt. After using this for a week my skin is noticeably softer and smoother, with my family commenting on the difference. I also no longer need to moisturize multiple times throughout the day as my skin feels hydrated all day long. I’ve even stopped needing to use sleeping masks for additionally hydration.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant to try this because I didn’t think it would live up to the marketing, but it surpassed all of my expectations. reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I’ve always suffered with dry, flakey, semi textured skin. Particularly on my forehead. Before I do my makeup, I’ll always exfoliate, use an intense moisturizer, a moisturizing primer, no foundations that are drying and a moisturizing setting spray. My makeup will look flawless... for a short time. Then all the sudden, my forehead starts flaking. It looks terrible and I’ve never found a remedy. Until I bought this gem. Used twice a week, I have no flakes, no rough patches, nothing. It’s honestly a godsend.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: When I first received a trial size of this, I thought it was just a sunscreen. I’m a huge SPF girl, super pale, burn like bacon in a hot pan. So I wasn’t at all opposed to getting a free sunblock, even if it was a tiny amount. Then, I went to apply some before my makeup and realized it was a primer. That honestly excited me sooooo much. Even more exciting was the fact that it preforms almost exactly like the Smashbox primer we all know and love. So not only is it a sunscreen, it’s also an awesome primer. I’ve used this everyday this summer and the only other SPF product I’ve used on my face is the Tarteguard SPF powder and not only have I remained completely burn free while still spending quite a bit of time outdoors, I haven’t darkened at all. I get most people probably want to be tan but I try my hardest to maintain a fair complexion year round for anti aging purposes. 10/10 combo. I’ll continue to buy and use this every summer

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: When I first received a trial size of this, I thought it was just a sunscreen. I’m a huge SPF girl, super pale, burn like bacon in a hot pan. reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was that girl who had up to 20 different primers and used them all. I would go in with a priming moisturizer then a pore filling primer or a silicone one of a hydrating primer or a stay all day type. To be honest, I’m not sure any of it ever made a difference. But I then, after really loving the smell and feel of a trial sizes tub of this, I decided to take the leap and buy the big tub. Then, I just used a liberal amount of this in lieu of my normal, elaborate primer routine. And OMG, my base makeup looked flawless. After never really believing in primer but wanting to so badly, this honestly made my day. No wonder it’s so many people’s HG. It’s now mine as well.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: I'll stick with BB Face Base
reviews.review_text: Everyone raved about this cream as being the best primer so I had to buy it. But honestly, I’m not very impressed. I think if I had never used Bobbi Brown Face Base, I would probably love it. But since I have and they’re the same type of product (a heavy moisturizer cream to be used as a primer) I can’t help but feel the Face Base is worlds better. It smells better, has a better texture, feels more soothing. Do both of them hydrate? Yes. Do both of them create a good base for makeup? Yes. Are they to be created equal? No. Face Base is 3 dollars cheaper for nearly twice the product and I honestly think is twice as good. But this is a good cream. If you don’t like the scent of Face Base or you’re just really into beautiful packaging, you’ll most likely be happy with this. But if you’ve never tried either and you’re in the market for this type of product, go with the Face Base. It’s a holy grail item and has been on the best seller list for years for a reason.

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_title: the night mask to end all night masks
reviews.review_text: This. Cream. Is. Life.Holy guacamole, I’ve never fallen in love with a night cream like I have this. Usually, when a cream is marketed as a “night mask“ it just means its thick and takes hours to absorb so don’t wear it during the day. But not this bad boy.The texture is unlike anything I’ve ever experienced. It’s a gel-cream hybrid that leaves the strangest, silky, slippy feeling to the skin. In the most wonderful way possible. And I wake up practically glowing. This is honestly the only night cream I want to use nowadays and I have sooooo many. Hundreds of dollars worth of creams are going to be purged from my collection because this is all I’ll ever need

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Bought this because half the money you spend on the Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream is on the packaging and the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Cream is great but not for nearly $100. This stuff is just as awesome if not better. Moisturizes well, not heavy, no real scent to my nose, layers well. Top marks.

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: You Say Cheap Like It’s a Bad Thing
reviews.review_text: Cheap? Yep. Great quality? Mmhmm. Fantastic applicator? Check. Helps your undereye not like a saggy sac? 100%. Can’t ask for more.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Good (Genes) but is it the best Lactic Acid?
reviews.review_text: I have cystic acne-prone normal to dry that used to be oily with lots of unevenness, scarring, and large pores. I’ve used up one sample tube and two regular bottles of this stuff. It really is great. It has helped refine my skin’s texture far sooner than the prerequisite three months needed for skincare to work. It brightens overnight. I have used The Ordinary’s Lactic Acid (the higher %), and it didn’t seem to deliver the same results, BUT I had already been using GG a good period of time, so a lot of work had already been done.My sister is now finishing up the current bottle I have, as the effects have plateaued a bit. She is extremely cheap, and she’s happy to buy this when she runs out. She’ll be buying both GG and TO to test side-by-side, so consider trying it before spending on this.The scent debate reminds me of the cilantro debate: “does it taste good or like soap?” Except this debate is “does it smell like pet urine or citrus?” The sample smelled more like urine and the regular bottles like citrus. This isn’t to say the sample actually smells like pee - it just has a hint that makes you side-eye what you’re experiencing. How did we get to this point? Anyway, the inclusion of the scent itself is a downside. It isn’t needed, and scents irritate the skin over time.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Fairest skin with cystic scarring, occasional breakouts, large pores everywhere. There’s nothing I can say about this that hasn’t already been said. It’s truly fantastic. A bottle lasts you months with daily application, it somehow makes my acne scarring fade faster where other hyperpigmentation-focused skincare do not, and it’s cheap. Works on any part of the body. Give it time to sink in before you apply anything on top, and you’ll be golden. This is my fourth bottle, and repurchasing things is rare for me.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: My favourite lip mask for overnight, nothing can change my mind! The vanilla scent is my personal go-to.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: Smells amazing, a little goes a long way
reviews.review_text: This smells AMAZING. It does a great job of taking off my makeup, literally “melts” it off my face. Little goes a long way for me. Will definitely be purchasing the full size.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

reviews.review_title: Great cleanser, could be more hydrating
reviews.review_text: Nice cleanser, love the feeling of the foamy cream on my dry skin. Its as hydrating as I would like, but leaves skin feeling refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Love the dewy effect this gives! Personally I won’t repurchase because it feels like an unnecessary step but it is beautiful on the skin.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: not enough for my dry skin
reviews.review_text: Decent moisturizer, probably better for people with normal or oily skin. As a dry skin girl this is not enough, especially in the winter.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I LOVE it! This product is super easy to use and perfect for everyday use. This product is so smooth and feels amazing under my eyes! Also, the packaging is so adorable! Definitely a new staple of mine!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing!! Fresh skincare is the best, but I love how this mask made my skin feel. Super easy to apply and when you wake up, your skin is extremely soft! Definitely a new essential in my skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Super nice product to use! I love glow recipe so I am always excited to try their new products and this product continues my love for glow recipe! Left my skin feeling so smooth, definitely a must have.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this product!! This sunscreen is so lightweight and makes my skin so glowy! The hype is so real for this product I love it. This is a perfect summer essential that you need to add to your makeup routine!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my newest go to product to apply before makeup. It works both as a primer and a moisturizer and it smells oh so delicious!! The bottle was smaller than expected but no worries you only need to use a little bit

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this new product!! So interesting to put together with the powder and liquid but it was fun. I’ve been using it for a bit and already see my skin tone is more even. It’s really helping with my hyperpigmentation.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is magic in a bottle. I didn’t realize how much moisturizer my face was lacking. By using this for a few weeks I have noticed my pores are smaller and my hyperpigmentation and fine lines have gone slightly away. This also doesn’t cause me to break out which is huge because I have a lot of other serums that I use occasionally and immediately see break outs around my chin area.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I’m really enjoying this product! It’s also perfect for this time of year for my skin. My skin in the cold weather is super dry and red and irritated. I’ve been using this in the morning and at nighttime after my skincare routine and I has really helped the overall feel and look of my face skin.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Amazing moisturizer! Ive already finished one jar and repurchased a second a while ago. I have sensitive and dry skin and this product really sinks into the skin instead of sitting on top or being greasy. Also acts as a great base before applying makeup and its super cooling and refreshing. Love!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer so much, it is quite pricey but it’s so great - my skin always feels so soft and hydrated after using this and i’ve even noticed my skin clearing up after using this for a while!

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer to use at night, it makes my skin super hydrated and overall it’s a great product. My skin is quite sensitive and I don’t have any issues using this product.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is great, my skin is more on the dry side and I found this really hydrated my skin. I do prefer the protini polypeptide drunk elephant moisturizer but this one is also really nice

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product in gratis, but I am in love with it and will definitely be repurchasing! It applies super lightweight but also provides tons of moisture for my super dry/dehydrated skin. My boyfriend even uses it and loves it! It’s really perfect for daytime and it wears beautifully under makeup. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a moisturizer that’s going to hydrate while notfeeling heavy!

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: This eye cream makes such a huge difference in the wear of my concealer. I get really dry under my eyes (and everywhere lol), and I really notice a difference when I’m wearing this on my under eyes! Also a little goes a very long way! Just make sure you warm up the product in your fingers before applying to help melt it into the skin.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: i ordered this a few weeks ago, and i’m obsessed. since quarantine started i’ve been eating really poorly so i’ve had a few more breakouts than i’d like to admit. i have sensitive skin and i am acne-prone. once i received this product, my face cleared up within a week! i cant believe it. my skin is the clearest it’s been in a really long time and i couldn’t recommend this product enough.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_title: A M A Z I N G G G
reviews.review_text: i love this moisturizer! it works well for daytime, nighttime, and under makeup! it isn’t heavy, and it’s really comfortable on the skin. i love how my skin feels using it, and as someone that’s super dry, it’s hard for me to find the perfect balance of moisture and comfort in a moisturizer. i also really love the scent, it reminds me of lemon cleaner or something. would def recommend!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: i’m not normally affected by textures as long as i notice a difference with the product. this is somewhat refreshing when it’s first applied, but it leaves your skin sticky and uncomfortable for not a whole lot of impact. i love hyaluronic acid as a skincare ingredient but this missed the mark for me.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: In love with this product!!Super soft on the skin, easy and smooth to apply. Leaves your skin looking fresh and radiant as well as supple. I love that I can use this right before applying makeup if I wake up looking full.I’ve had this product for around 2 weeks now and I’ll be purchasing as soon as it runs out.A new favourite for my skin care line up!!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: This serum has a very different texture to what I am used to but I was pleasantly surprised with how rapidly it absorbed and sat in my skin rather than slippery on top of it.My skin immediately feels supple and plumped and stays that way all day.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: Double Serum is Clarins worldwide best seller and once you’ve used it you can totally understand why.The two serums mix together beautifully for a radiant finish on the skin that feels plumped and smooth immediately. reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_title: Thirsty skin? This is your answer!

The radiance of my skin was definitely increased and I love the way my skin looked even before putting on other products.7 day results - my skin looks brighter and more plump with a really healthy and even tone. reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I got this product as a sample to tried. The scent is pleasant with soft citrus, the texture is sosoft milky cream. When cleansing, it leaves no residue butI still feel like to make another cleansing routine on my face. I had tried this few more times and I still think I need to apply more strong cleansing product to feel clean.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I enjoy products that is fragrance free but this I find this cream is very rich, it’s great to use in winter time but probably not so much during summer. I did not find my skin absorb the cream right away so I felt a little heavy after apply. Since I got this cream as a sample size, I do not see any improvement for less wrinkle. But this cream is good for skin protection from dry environment.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I got this as an sample to try so I cannot comment about if the wrinkle repair works or not, but it is a nice smooth cream when apply. The cream thickness is just right and it’s not too greasy. The scent is just right and it does not irritated my nose. For pricing I think it’s alright, it’s not too expensive. I would consider to buy this to try for regular size product to see if it improve the wrinkle part.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I enjoy trying this cream specially coming in the season of fall. Applying this serum gives my skin very soft, smooth and hydrated feelings. I like this cream that the fragrances are not strong(fragrance free). But Im not so sure about having less wrinkle since I only have sample amount of trying this product.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: This makes my hand feel super smooth and soft. I also use a small amount this on my arms and my legs and I absolutely love it! It’s not oily at all. I have not tried it on my face yet since my face is prone to breakouts from lotions but I somehow feel like it would be OK. It’s a bit pricey for cream but I’ve switched over from the L’Occitaine body cream and love this one better.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I like the texture of this product. It has a matte feeling and it glides right on. A little goes a long way. I have not had an allergic reaction to this product so that is a plus. It has only been 7 days so I don’t really see a difference but it does feel more hydrated on my eyebag area. I’ll keep using it for longer to see if my skin improved.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This product is free of parabens, phthalates, sulfates, etc + & reef safe! One of the many reasons I’d be repurchasing. I liked this better than the lotion since it does not contain parabens. This glided on my face even after applying toner, serum and lotion and left me a matte type of feel and did not break me out at the same time. I really like how I don’t need to use my hands to apply & it is compact! I have a couple of large dark spots on my face so I thought it was very useful how I could just easily apply on those spots. For some reason, i thought it smelled so good and didn’t smell too strong to me. The smell isn’t for everyone!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen

I did not get a sunburn while wearing this in the winter months so far. It is reef friendly * compliant with Hawaii regulations!! Overall, not a bad product and did not have any allergic reactions. It is definitely better than the shiseido spf cream I’ve used in the past.

reviews.review_text: I LOVED this product, I cannot stress it enough! Speaking of, it literally has gotten me through stress breakouts. I have hormonal, under the skin acne. reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: If you have dry skin, this should be a staple in your skin care!
