I typically don’t like the thicker consistency creams but this one gives my skin life back, so it is totally worth it! Also, has been great on my more sensitive days, sometimes I can get redness or dry patches that burn after putting products on and this is not a problem at all! I received this product for free for testing purposes via influenster.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this product and I wasn’t sure that I was going to. But it works so well. It blends so well and feels so great. I have added it to my daily routine now. It is definitely one of my newest favorites.

reviews.review_text: This product was super refreshing! I loved using it in addition to my regular skin routine. It gave my skin a great texture and made makeup application super easy after! I love it and it makes a good add on to any skin care routine. Gifted by dermalogica sampling.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: Always have been a fan of drunk elephant products and this one is no exception! A little pricey for micellar water, but it feels nice and gentle on the skin.  I also appreciate the absence of silicones and essential oils (my skin can be sensitive to essential oils).  Overall, lovely!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: Always have been a fan of drunk elephant products and this one is no exception! A little pricey for micellar water, but it feels nice and gentle on the skin.  I also appreciate the absence of silicones and essential oils (my skin can be sensitive to essential oils).  Overall, lovely!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love love love!  I’ve bene having problems with dull skin and stubborn dryness, but with adding this to my skincare routine, I find it has really helped fight off those stubborn flakes!  Smells good, and I love the pouring spout!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love love love!  I’ve bene having problems with dull skin and stubborn dryness, but with adding this to my skincare routine, I find it has really helped fight off those stubborn flakes!  Smells good, and I love the pouring spout!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I love the grape concept, and found the gel moisturizer to be light and refreshing.  I think I could have done without the salicylic acid, but it doesn’t hurt I guess.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed with these. I’ve tried several other brands, but none have pulled as much gunk out of my skin. I have had the experience several times of slapping one of these things onto a sizable pimple before going to sleep, and then waking up in the morning to a full healing dot (sorry so gross) and a totally flat, healed patch of skin. Sometimes it takes a couple of days. I wish I had had these when I was a teenager.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This is a good moisturizer. It’s gentle on my sensitive skin and absorbs well. The only reason I didn’t give it five stars, is that it doesn’t leave a particularly quenched feeling. When I use this in the morning, I usually have to reapply by evening.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is an incredible primer and an incredible moisturizer rolled into one! My skin drinks this up and it leaves a beautiful pearlescent sheen that translates to a subtle healthy glow when you layer foundation on top of it. It’s a little bit too shiny and pearly for my taste to wear on its own, but I know some people love that look. I sometimes also pat this on as a highlighter over my makeup.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This is it for me. It’s the holy grail of make up removers. I don’t know why I ever try to use anything else. This is so moisturizing and refreshing. The tiniest pump takes everything off with ease. When I’m feeling lazy, I don’t even bother doing a regular face washing after this, and my skin is fine with it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This is it for me. It’s the holy grail of make up removers. I don’t know why I ever try to use anything else. This is so moisturizing and refreshing. The tiniest pump takes everything off with ease. When I’m feeling lazy, I don’t even bother doing a regular face washing after this, and my skin is fine with it.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I used this a couple of weeks ago and I love it.  It goes on smoothly on your skin. When I wake up my face look much rested. I highly recommend it

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I used this cream a couple of days ago. I love how smoothly it goes on my face. It feels less dry and more alive. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this sunscreen for a couple of weeks now. It doesn’t not leave a sticky feeling on your face. It’s has a nice smell to it. It leaves my face feeling smooth and I don’t have any sunburn or dark spots on my face.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Excellent quality in product. I wear it daily and leaves my face very smooth. No harsh smell. I highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Excellent quality in product. I wear it daily and leaves my face very smooth. No harsh smell. I highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Absolutely obsessed with this. One of the very few lip products I finish completely because it’s so nourishing and leaves the prettiest color on. Love how smooth is goes on and how long lasting the look is.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product so much. Made such a difference in my skin. Within a few days I noticed my skin look much brighter and less dull. I love that it has the long term effect of reducing fine lines and wrinkles.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Wow just wow. Amazing products after a few days of using my skin texture was gone. Such a good retinol. I also have very sensitive skin and I didn’t feel like this was affecting me in any way. Can’t wait to keep using it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Wow just wow. Amazing products after a few days of using my skin texture was gone. Such a good retinol. I also have very sensitive skin and I didn’t feel like this was affecting me in any way. Can’t wait to keep using it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this product so much. I have them in all colors. I use them everyday. I love how they look on and how long they last. I use this one every single day and then the other shades when I want a more subtle look.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this exfoliator! It’s gentle on my skin. A little bit goes a long way. I have used a few different exfoliators and this is definitely one of my more favorite ones. It’s nice and creamy, without any rough areas. It does dry me out a little bit so I only use it to to three times a week.It does leave my skin nice and smooth and prepped for when I’m putting make up on.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this exfoliator! It’s gentle on my skin. A little bit goes a long way. I have used a few different exfoliators and this is definitely one of my more favorite ones. It’s nice and creamy, without any rough areas. It does dry me out a little bit so I only use it to to three times a week.It does leave my skin nice and smooth and prepped for when I’m putting make up on.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this Precleanse Cleansing Oil. It is wonderful for taking my makeup off. I have used other cleansing oils and balms and I prefer this one by far. It takes my mascara off easily without pulling at my lashes. It leaves my skin feeling smooth and is an excellent addition to my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this Precleanse Cleansing Oil. It is wonderful for taking my makeup off. I have used other cleansing oils and balms and I prefer this one by far. It takes my mascara off easily without pulling at my lashes. It leaves my skin feeling smooth and is an excellent addition to my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This has been my go to moisturizer for the last couple of years. I tend to switch it up every once in a while but I keep coming back to this moisturizer. It keeps my face feeling soft and smooth all day long every time I use it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This has been my go to moisturizer for the last couple of years. I tend to switch it up every once in a while but I keep coming back to this moisturizer. It keeps my face feeling soft and smooth all day long every time I use it!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This was a nice hydrating crème. There wasn’t much of a scent to it which I appreciated. A little bit goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This was a nice hydrating crème. There wasn’t much of a scent to it which I appreciated. A little bit goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I really love this sunscreen. It apples just like a primer and without any smells like sunscreen can normally have! It doesn’t leave a white cast which is really great!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This is a great moisturizer with SPF! It doesn’t smell like most sunscreens. It comes out of the time with almost a light pink sheen. It blends into the skin without leaving a white cast which is a huge plus!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I liked this cream. It was very hydrating. I was t able to see it it reduced my forehead lines much because it was a small sample. However, it was very moisturizing.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This stuff is next level!  I use once weekly as my Sunday skin care routine and always walk into work Monday extra glowy, fine line free, and ridiculously soft. Sometimes it’s hard to not constantly touch your face after because it truly feels like a baby! Burning and stinging yes but worth it for the dramatic results

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Love this moisturizer from DE! I used to alternate between this and Protini but for the harsh wither weather and inevitable dry flaky skin- this is where it’s at! Has a beautiful thick consistency without weighing you down.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve seen some reviews complain about dry flakey skin. However, I’ve found that as long as I use in combination with B-Hydra and finish off with LaLa Retro it’s really does the trick! This combo has worked for me to lock the retinol in to do its thing while also moisturizing. Fine lines and pores be gone! This stuff is great and a little goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I’ve only been using F-balm for one week and can already see and feel a major difference!  I’ve slowly fallen in love with a handful of Drunk Elephant products and this one is a quick favorite. I use with TLC Framboos every other night , alternating with A-Passoni, and Baby Facial once a week (always with LaLa Retro to top it all off) and WOW just wow!! Coworkers and boyfriend have said I’m glowing and my pores have visibly shrunk down to nothing. Definitely get your hands on this lineup!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Love this sunscreen!  It’s the first that stays in place and doesn’t sweat off. It does leave a bit of a texture on your face and feels like it stays above the skin surface rather than seeping in. Again, love this for when I’m out in the sun by the pool or working out outside but wouldn’t love the texture if I ever tried layering it with makeup all day.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Love this sunscreen!  It’s the first that stays in place and doesn’t sweat off. It does leave a bit of a texture on your face and feels like it stays above the skin surface rather than seeping in. Again, love this for when I’m out in the sun by the pool or working out outside but wouldn’t love the texture if I ever tried layering it with makeup all day.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this product for so many years and still loving it!  Every couple of years I try another brand or formula but always end up disappointed and turn back to Fresh. It effectively cleanses and removes all makeup while still feeling nourishing and just like you’re doing something good for your skin. Not stripping or drying at all, you’re just left with a nice healthy glow. Very light scent that just smells clean and fresh

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: On my second bottle of this and loving it!  I’ve never had such a low maintenance, natural looking tan. I’m pretty fair so often products like this just look fake and strange when I put them on but not this one, a nice healthy glow and can turn the dial up or down depending on the season with how many drops used. Not streaky at all and none of that dreaded transfer to clothes and sheets. 10/10!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: Nice thick consistency and once warmed in fingers a little and tapped in under eyes melts into skin. I have super sensitive eyes and this is the first retinol that doesn’t irritate them (I use every other night). Just finishing my first jar and not sure how dramatic the results but also haven’t noticed anything negative so happily moving onto my second soon. Jar is tiny but lasts a really long time. Also the little scoop it comes with is the cutest!  Be sure to save when you order a new one to use with other product jars

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Great cleansing balm for double cleanse. I couldn’t believe the amount of makeup and gunk that it removed from my face. Truly the first pre cleanse product I’ve used that I feel like really gets absolutely everything off my face after having worn makeup all day/night. Love the little scoop they include to get the perfect amount each time. 10/10!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Great cleansing balm for double cleanse. I couldn’t believe the amount of makeup and gunk that it removed from my face. Truly the first pre cleanse product I’ve used that I feel like really gets absolutely everything off my face after having worn makeup all day/night. Love the little scoop they include to get the perfect amount each time. 10/10!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have to admit I was such a skeptic because I’m so used to spending $60 - $100+ on similar products in my skincare routine.  I’m blown away by how beautifully this Niacinamide worked on my skin, how thoughtful and clean the packaging looks, and of course the unbeatable price point. I use after applying HA and then Tretinoin at night before I use my moisturizer. I was blown away at how soft my skin felt and hydrated it looked the next day after incorporating this product. In my personal opinion a must if you’re using any sort of retinoid to keep your skin hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: A simple, non-irritating and effective cleanser.
reviews.review_text: I tried this cleanser by Drunk Elephant a few years ago and dismissed it as nothing special, but I’ve since had a second opportunity to give it a go and I’m finding myself won over this time. It’s not a miracle product for me, but I’ve generally disliked jelly cleansers as I prefer something thicker with a bit of lather, but this cleanser performs very well without irritating my combination/sensitive skin. If applied to a dry face, it is possible to work a bit of a lather out of it. It isn’t fragranced and it does leave my skin very clean without drying it out. I also find it effective at removing makeup (though maybe not something like waterproof mascara). I think it’s a good product and I’ll definitely continue to use it.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_title: Wintertime moisturizer for the driest skin!
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is a very thick cream. If you struggle with cold-weather dryness, this may be the right choice for you. Lala Retro might be overkill for those who don’t need that extra boost to their moisture barrier, though. And I can’t imagine using it in the summer. I do find it gentle and effective, though, after it’s had a chance to absorb. It doesn’t break out or irritate my sensitive combo skin.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_title: A top of the line lip balm if money is no object!
reviews.review_text: This is a great lip balm if money is no object. It’s somewhat strange in that it’s quite a thick stick, but that doesn’t bother me at all. The oils are very hydrating and it doesn’t have that horrible thick, wavy texture like chapstick. A little goes a long way to helping out my chronically dry lips, but it doesn’t last all day for me. Nothing else does either so I don’t mind reapplying.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: As I’m getting older, I’m finding that it’s time for me to ramp up my skincare routine to prevent signs of ageing. This eye cream feels lovely and absorbs beautifully. I love the packaging and how sanitary it is. Is this a miracle product for me? No. I haven’t noticed a dramatic difference in appearance. But I do feel that it’s adding an extra level of hydration and I appreciate that.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I actually have come to really love the sunscreen as a facial sunscreen. It layers well beneath my cosmetics and doesn’t ball up or pill. I find it offers a really good sun protection without being irritating or causing breakouts. The finish is quite smooth and invisible. I would strongly recommend this product to anyone looking for a sunscreen to wear a day-to-day. Shiseido really knocked this one out of the park. I received this product complimentary from Influenster but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: What I enjoy most about the sunscreen is how well layers underneath other products. The finish is invisible and light. I don’t find it as oily as some other people too but that might be because I have combination skin. It’s pleasant and it seems to last quite a while which is a win in my books. I would definitely repurchase this and appreciate its portability. I received this product complimentary from Influenster in exchange for review a review but all opinions on my own.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: A gentle step to make your eyes feel taken care of
reviews.review_text: This serum is a beautiful skincare step in my under eye routine. The best way to describe its effect is that it softens everything and boosts hydration. It feels so lovely and luxurious when applied. The scent is pleasant, but does fade away relatively quickly for those who have sensitivities to fragrance. All in all, it is a pampering step. I’ve noticed that my under eye area (which is quite sensitive in general) feels smoother.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_title: An improvement on an already fantastic serum!
reviews.review_text: I’m hateful anytime a brand listens to feedback and makes a great change in their product line. I’ve been a fan of C-Firma for years. It brightens and evens out my combination skin. What I didn’t enjoy was the gamble of buying a bottle and having it arrive in already on its way to expiry (which can be determined by the colour of the serum). I was able to swap out my older bottle for a new one, but it felt wasteful and unfortunate. This new option solves that problem! Keeping the two forms of the serum separate increases the longevity of the product and, most importantly, keeps the Vitamic C stable. This is so easy to mix together! And it works just as well as it always did, which is the most important part. I’m so happy to see this step in the right direction!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This oil-free sunscreen has a surprisingly hydrating finish that is quite pleasant without being greasy or uncomfortable. I find the consistency to be thicker than I would like, but it’s still thinner than the average drugstore suncare product. It does have a strong Shiseido scent that eventually fades, but I could see it causing issues for those who suffer from scent-induced headaches. I don’t mind how it sits beneath makeup, but there’s another Shiseido formula I prefer to use over this one. The bottle itself is extremely small, though, so you don’t get a great blue there when it comes to the product. I suppose it’s great for tucking into a purse or pocket.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I love the way this sits on my skin beneath my makeup. So many sunscreens leave behind a shiny, almost greasy finish, but this one seems to absorb very well and doesn’t mess with the finish or consistency of the products being worn on top. It does have a smell to it that I don’t enjoy, but I do find that it fades much faster than most. It’s quite potent and spreads easily so I don’t feel wasteful when I’m using it or as though I’ll be going through it too quickly, which speaks to the value of the product.  I’ve had the opportunity to use other Shiseido suncare products and this one is easily the best.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This serum definitely presents itself as luxury in a bottle. The applicator and sleek look are lovely. There is a floral scent upon application, but it fades quickly, which might be a relief to those with fragrance sensitivities. Although it does feel quite nice upon application, I woke up the morning after to clogged pores. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and this formula just doesn’t agree with mine, unfortunately. Too bad because I otherwise enjoy a lot of Charlotte Tilbury products, but this one just wasn’t a match for me.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: This has cleared up my skin beautifully. However, I experienced quite bad peeling and sensitivity after using it after about a week (only using once a week). My skin couldn’t even handle a light tinted moisturizer afterwards. I see a difference in the brightness and clearness of my skin tough, it definitely works.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I used this for a year straight every night, and I’m still using it now. I notice a difference if for some reason I forget to use it. I was skeptical, but I really really like it.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Pricey, but worth it. Great for in between professional peels. I have very light toned acne prone and sensitive skin, this seriously helps with scarring. I will keep buying these.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: This broke me out so badly. I went ahead and tried it as an alternative to the ultra pricey skinceuticals c e ferulic serum. This is not even close to the same thing. My poor skin is still recovering. If you have sensitive, acne-prone skin I would stay away!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I don’t know what is in this to make it so amazing, but it is! It has completely calmed down my reactive, acne prone skin. I’ve gone from lots of breakouts to a clear complexion using this at night and the probiotic gel in the morning. I haven’t changed anything else in my skincare so I’m attributing my newly clear skin to this. A hefty price tag, but I will gladly pay it for such great results. This is definitely in the richer side, it would be too much for me during the day but is excellent for overnight.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: This worked really well for me. I make sure to add a hydrating makeup base overtop of it though. I do this for every sunscreen because, really, most sunscreens are terrible makeup bases. It didn’t break me out at all and it adds a nice glow.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I don’t know why this is so good, but it is. I see more results with this than I do with a vitamin C serum. The price tag is hefty, but I will keep buying it. It smells amazing as well, and the light fragrance doesn’t irritate my sensitive, breakout prone skin either.

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a mini sized sample of this product and used it for a couple of weeks.  I liked the way it went on and it moisturized nicely without feeling heavy or sticky.  However, it doesn’t do anything like lifting or firming that would make it good for aging skin.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser.  It is gently exfoliating without drying skin out.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser.  It is gently exfoliating without drying skin out.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this cream as part of my birthday gift. It made my sensitive skin break out. I stopped using it twice but broke out again as soon as I resumed.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This product is more like a thick gloss than a mask. It doesn’t a decent job, but there are probably less expensive options.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I have normal skin but I’m older and I look for products to address firmness and loss of volume. There is no research to show that topically applied collagen is effective. However, I gave this product a try because the reviews were good and I trust the line. I got a sample from Sephora. I have three issues with the product. First, it has an overpowering fragrance. Second, it didn’t absorb into my skin overnight. Third, it left my skin feeling “tighter,“ but not in a good way. My skin felt itchy and uncomfortable. Even after I washed it off the following morning and applied my usual serum and cream, my skin felt uncomfortable. Definitely try a sample before you purchase.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I find this product works best in combination with the peptide eye gel from Biossance, which makes this a pricey option for an eye treatment.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum goes on smoothly and dries quickly without feeling tacky. One bottle made a noticeable impact on a stubborn dark spot. A good, but expensive, option in a 15% strength Vitamin C serum.

reviews.product_name: Mini Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Not effective for fading dark spots
reviews.review_text: I received this size with a full-sized moisturizer. It lasted me about 3 weeks, applying it to my face and neck. The applicator is too short and leaves a couple of days’ worth of product at the bottom of the bottle. I have been tracking the effect of Vitamin C serums on some stubborn dark spots. This serum didn’t improve them. In fact, I lost ground over what I had accomplished with Sunday Riley. This serum does make a nice complement to the CT moisturizer, in that my skin had a nice finish when I used the products together. However, it appears to be ineffective as a treatment.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this cleanser. It smells wonderful and is one of the few to explicitly state that it’s ph-neutral. So I was surprised that the micro-exfoliators strip my aging combination skin. Not recommended for older women.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this cleanser. It smells wonderful and is one of the few to explicitly state that it’s ph-neutral. So I was surprised that the micro-exfoliators strip my aging combination skin. Not recommended for older women.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: As many reviewers have commented, this product isn’t “magic.“ However, it does contain many good ingredients and it leaves my skin with a nice finish, not quite as good as a primer would, but something like it. CT is essentially a makeup line. This product is a very good base for those who wear makeup or whose skin is clear enough to go without it.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: The combination of Vitamin C with AHAs is effective. After using up the bottle, some dark spots had faded and my skin felt very soft. However, I think the AHAs may be too effective. Dermatologists recommend against using AHAs every day because of the risk of over-exfoliation. In addition, Vitamin C and AHAs work best with different PH levels and may interfere with each other. In combining them, Tatcha seems to be capitalizing on a wide range of PH levels, so the product’s effects may come from either the Vitamin C or the AHAs . Bottom line, you could think you were using Vitamin C, but actually be seeing the effect of the AHAs. So, as much as I liked the feel of my soft skin, I don’t think this is a good product to use on a daily basis.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I recently battled a case of contact dermititus due to using too many actives. This product saved my skin! It was the only moisturizing serum I tried that actually made a difference. I continue to use it twice a day to maintain my skin’s condition. One night I was really tired and forgot to apply my expensive moisturizer on top -- it didn’t matter. My skin felt just as hydrated and soft the next morning.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum

reviews.review_text: i bought this originally because of how hyped up it was and how everyone was using it and loving it. the first time i used it i applied a large amount to my face (because when using face masks i like to see the product on my face) and immediately started feeling an uncomfortable stinging sensation! i thought it was just the product working and after i wiped the excess off and the product chemically burnt my face! my face was red and hot for 2-3 hours after use.after that i had completely written off the product until i saw a youtuber apply it and use far less product than i had used. i gave it another shot and used a thin layer for the suggested time and loved it! it made my skin feel so soft, plump, and moisturized and pores around my nose looked smaller! i recommend use of this if used correctly! watch how much product you apply!!!!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: the consistency of this is insane. you apply a little pea/pearl-sized amount with the spoon to your hand and then apply it to your skin and it has a certain bursting affect that smoothes all over your skin! perfect for OILY COMBO SKIN!!!! i wouldn’t recommend for dry skin unless you like a light moisturizer in the summer!!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: the consistency of this is insane. you apply a little pea/pearl-sized amount with the spoon to your hand and then apply it to your skin and it has a certain bursting affect that smoothes all over your skin! perfect for OILY COMBO SKIN!!!! i wouldn’t recommend for dry skin unless you like a light moisturizer in the summer!!

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: i love this toner.... it’s so moisturizing and still feels like a toner. i stopped using cotton pads so i just apply this to my hands and press it onto my face. despite having denatured alcohol and fragrance, it does work and feel good on my face. it takes a little second to absorb into your skin when you use your hands to press it in, but i love the way it makes my skin feel!!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: first of all, a little goes a long way. i use a small pile and add water and just gently rub it on my face. it lasts forever too!!!i know tatcha says it could be used every day morning and night, but i honestly don’t recommend using an exfoliator every night even if it’s gentle. i used this product every night the first month, then switched it to every other night the next 2 months, and now i use it every 3 nights. it does the job well and smooths out the texture of my skin! i do think it’s a tiny bit stripping even for oily combo skin, but with the use of a good moisturizer that would be fixed!

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: i use this as my first step of my double cleanse and i love it! it quickly wipes away all makeup, including eye makeup! i use it only at night as i have oily skin and double cleanses should be used only after a day of wearing makeup and being exposed to the outside. it also lasts forever! i’ve had it since november and it’s not even halfway gone in the bottle!

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: this is the only face wash my boyfriend will use! he loves it but hates to admit it. he has dry combo occasional acne-prone skin and it has looked so much better in texture and cleared up exponentially!

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: this is the only face wash my boyfriend will use! he loves it but hates to admit it. he has dry combo occasional acne-prone skin and it has looked so much better in texture and cleared up exponentially!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: i use a pump of b-hydra every morning with the c-firma and it helps the c-firma, which is normally somewhat sticky, apply like a dream. this product has made my skin feel so hydrated and soft! and it lasts forever! i would definitely purchase this again, although i do think it’s slight overpriced by maybe $5-10. still worth the purchase though!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: use this mask as your restart button! i have sensitive skin and the first time i used it there was a somewhat unpleasant sting, but i find that only happens when i use it for the first time in awhile rather than every week. using every week, there is less stinging. i apply two pumps of the product all over my face and neck and take off after 20 minutes as directed. it makes my skin a tiny bit itchy after use, but i just finish with my routine (toner, serum, oil, moisturizer) and the itchiness dies down immediately. skin comes out so much clearer and softer after use throughout the week.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: OMG YES MAKE THIS PURCHASE!!!! first of all, retinol is so good for your skin and this is the first retinol product that really spoke to me. i have somewhat sensitive skin and upon research and my gut feeling about retinol, i decided that an oil would be the best first retinol product to try out. with retinol, you don’t see any drastic changes until a few weeks in, but it made my skin feel and look so nice that i will never want another retinol product other than this. this is definitely holy grail worthy and i will shout it from the rooftops!i use 4 drops rather than 3 because it spreads more easily on my face that way. i use it after serum and before moisturizer. fine lines (especially smile lines) have disappeared after use of this every night. retinol also helps with acne! if i experience a breakout, this helps it die down overnight.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: i love this product! it’s so nice feeling and works wonders for your skin. it’s so easy to apply and is a lightweight hydration mask for overnight use. every time i use this product, i forget how much i love it. it’s so nice for sensitive skin! i have oily combo skin and i still like using it because i wake up feeling so refreshed in the morning.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: The most wonderful, perfect serum I’ve ever used! Others have irritated my skin or made it break out. This serum truly makes my skin brighter and more even toned. Will absolutely buy the full size.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This green cream really works! I could go without foundation it works so well!! BUT sadly, it caused significant breakouts, is really stinky - and expensive. I really wish I could use this. Alas, no.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This green cream really works! I could go without foundation it works so well!! BUT sadly, it caused significant breakouts, is really stinky - and expensive. I really wish I could use this. Alas, no.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: My daughter gave me these coconut water wipes as part of a birthday package because she knows I adore coconut beauty products. Such a sweetie! I’ve used up the whole package, and can say they are a good product. Nothing special though. No coconut scent. I often added cleaners to them and using them more like a washcloth. To save the environment, I’m no longer purchasing packaged wipes except for travel.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My daughter bought me the Tatcha Gift Set with this cleanser and the Water Cream. I have Combo-Oily skin. The cleanser left small burns on my skin. Yikes!

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My daughter bought me the Tatcha Gift Set with this cleanser and the Water Cream. I have Combo-Oily skin. The cleanser left small burns on my skin. Yikes!

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The term ‘holy grail’ is overused in product reviews - but when it comes to PTR’s Water Drench Cloud Cream - IT IS THE HOLY GRAIL I’ve been searching for all my life!! I’ve tried other hyaluronic acid products but none CLEARED and SMOOTHED my skin like this cream! My skin literally GLOWS. I’ve received so many amazing compliments! Here’s the thing - For Spring/Summer this cream is sufficient during the day and under makeup. At night and in the Fall/Winter, I use it like a serum and add Benefit’s Total Moisture once the PTR cream has absorbed. The two together give my aging skin the moisture it needs. If you have oily skin year round, you probably won’t need an added moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: HOLY GRAIL! Finally - Clear, Glowing Skin!!

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Received a sample of this cleanser in a beauty box a while back (my first Origins product) and threw it in my travel bag. Wish I had tried it earlier! It’s so gentle. I love the thick, soft, silky feel - like washing with clouds. The reviews are true, a tiny amount goes a loooong way. This is now my go-to morning shower face/neck/décolletage wash. I have fair, sensitive skin with redness and blackheads that is dry in winter and oily in summer. I don’t use Origins at night because I find it doesn’t cleanse as thoroughly as I need at the end of the day, especially with a full face of makeup. Ergo, the 4/5 stars. (I double cleanse at night - Kiehl’s Cleansing Oil for makeup, then a cleanser based on my skin’s needs that day/season.)

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: Another reviewer called this serum “a workhorse” and I cannot agree more! After a lifetime in the sun, I started developing sunspots on my face a couple of years ago. I completely freaked out. I’ve tried so many products that promise to lighten dark spots, but this is the only one that has had any visible effect. The price is steep though so I’m going to keep my eye out for sales.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: I purchased the Caudalie Favorites Kit and this moisturizer was one of the 5 items included in the kit. This Sorbet did not absorb well. It sat on top of my skin. It did not seem to be hydrating my skin - but I wanted to give this Sorbet a fair trial so I continued using it. By the second week, my skin was breaking out in a way I haven’t seen since I was a teenager. I had stop using it and tossed it into the recycling bin. I am discovering that plant-based beauty products, though all “natural” are not always beneficial to my sensitive, reactive skin. (When it comes to skincare - I only try one product at a time so I know if there are any changes, positive or negative, it’s due to the new product.)

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: FIRST - You MUST rub the crème between your fingers to “release the Miracle Broth” before applying. You end up wasting a lot of product on the tips of your fingers. SECOND - It STINKS! Smells like rotten seaweed. And it lingers. THIRD - It’s GREASY. Doesn’t absorb well. My skin looked greasy all day. FOURTH - NOT hydrating! You’d think with all the oil it would at least provide my dry skin with moisture. After the first week, I had to add my PTR hyaluronic acid serum first to get the hydration my skin needed. FIFTH - Stopped using this after two weeks because my skin was getting RED SPOT breakouts. Good thing I used my Sephora points for this!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Reading all the fabulous reviews about Biossance, I purchased a kit with deluxe samples of their popular products - including this squalane eye cream. The cream is thick, dry and doesn’t absorb easily or mix well with makeup, so I only used it at night. It gave me weird hag eyes - drying out the skin under my eyes making them look wrinkled. Yikes! After 3 nights, I tossed the cream into the recycling bin. So disappointed! Really hoping the other Biossance products in the kit are better…

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: LOVE this as a hand and body cream!! Rich, creamy and wonderfully hydrating. I have sensitive skin that turns red and can break out with certain ingredients, but I’ve had no reactions to this FAB cream. Been using this for years! I prefer the tube to the tub as it’s more sanitary. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: While I do love Fresh products, my sensitive, combo-dry skin did not love this night moisturizer. It felt heavy which I don’t mind on winter nights, yet was quite drying. The worst was it made my skin itch! I woke up to dry, itchy skin. No ty.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive, combo-dry fair skin and have struggled with redness, large pores and tiny blackheads all my life. I know no product can permanently reduce the size of pores, so I’ve been looking for a product to clear my skin without drying it out. Most clay/acidic masks are too harsh for my sensitive skin, leading to flaking, red spots, dryness and overproduction of oil - but not this mask! Wow! This mask WORKS! It clears my pores, combats redness and calms my skin leaving it soft and clean. Highly Rx!

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Gentle, effective + the delicious blueberry aroma
reviews.review_text: HG!! I use this as the second step in a double cleanse after a cleansing oil. Gently cleans without making my combo dry skin taut or uncomfortable. A little goes a long way, so this bottle lasts a long time. Added bonus: the delicious fresh blueberry pie aroma. LOVE it!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I adore Fresh, and was sure that I would love this Soy Face Cleanser, but I can’t get past the stinky, sour milk smell. It’s nauseating and worse - the odor lingers. Had to go back and wash my face again with a different cleanser just to get rid of the smell.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed the texture, smell, and results of this product (my skin felt softer and dead skin was removed from my forehead). My one major drawback is the expensive price and the fact that my jar wasn’t even full when I received it. Goop gifted me this product.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed the texture, smell, and results of this product (my skin felt softer and dead skin was removed from my forehead). My one major drawback is the expensive price and the fact that my jar wasn’t even full when I received it. Goop gifted me this product.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. It’s lightweight and absorbs quickly. Works well under makeup and is a good budget option for a sunscreen. I wish that innisfree was a cruelty-free company and I would definitely buy this.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe. It smells like watermelon candy. I used it as a serum instead of a moisturizer since I have dry skin. I like the packaging and the consistency of the product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this cream complimentary from Skinfix. I was drawn to this product due to the slick packaging but ended up really liking the cream inside too. My skin tends to be dry and this cream worked really well for me.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this cream complimentary from Skinfix. I was drawn to this product due to the slick packaging but ended up really liking the cream inside too. My skin tends to be dry and this cream worked really well for me.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received Good Genes complimentary from Sunday Riley. I have used this product to help with texture on my skin. It works well when I use it a couple of nights a week to give me glowing skin. I love it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I received this Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant complimentary from Paula’s Choice. This is a product that I had wanted to try for a long time and it didn’t disappoint! It worked really well to clear up clogged pores on my nose. I use it twice a week on my sometimes sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this Honeymoon Glow AHA serum complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. So far I’ve loved every product that I’ve tried from Farmacy and this is no exception. It’s making my skin looking healthy and glowing without any irritation. Love it!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been seeing a lot of eye serums around lately and I wanted to give one a try. I like how this 5 Stars Retinol Eye Serum from Sunday Riley feels on my eye area and I do think it’s helping to reduce fine lines while also providing extra hydration.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I received this PreCleanse Cleansing Oil complimentary from Dermalogica. The cleansing oil works flawlessly for cleaning off all of my makeup, including waterproof mascara. I especially like that it comes in a bottle with a pump.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I received this PreCleanse Cleansing Oil complimentary from Dermalogica. The cleansing oil works flawlessly for cleaning off all of my makeup, including waterproof mascara. I especially like that it comes in a bottle with a pump.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this Daily Microfoliant complimentary from Dermalogica. I don’t typically use physical exfoliants on my face because I have sensitive skin, but this one is really gentle. I love how clean and refreshed this makes my skin feel!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this Daily Microfoliant complimentary from Dermalogica. I don’t typically use physical exfoliants on my face because I have sensitive skin, but this one is really gentle. I love how clean and refreshed this makes my skin feel!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So many people had told me that BB’s Vitamin Enriched Face Base was their number one face product, and I have to agree! It works really well to keep my skin hydrated and plump, especially under makeup.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: I received this Lip Butter Balm in Vanilla complimentary from Summer Fridays. I had been wanting to try this for a long time as I had heard very good things. I really enjoyed the vanilla flavor and found that this did a great job to lock in moisture.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I received this Peace Out Wrinkles complimentary from Peace Out Skincare. Such a unique skincare product! I used this on my forehead wrinkles and I definitely noticed a big difference. I’m really glad I got a chance to try this out.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this Retinol Youth Renewal Serum complimentary from Murad Skincare. I have tried several retinol products in the past and I like how gentle, yet effective this one is. My skin really looks refreshed and younger when I use this.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this Retinol Youth Renewal Serum complimentary from Murad Skincare. I have tried several retinol products in the past and I like how gentle, yet effective this one is. My skin really looks refreshed and younger when I use this.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this Magic Cream from Charlotte Tilbury Beauty many times in the past and it’s one of my favorites for prepping my skin before makeup. It works especially well with my dry skin. I will definitely buy this again in the future.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this Sugar Lip Treatment in Rose complimentary from Fresh. This has quickly become my favorite everyday lip product. The color is super flattering and it feels really comfortable on my lips.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I have tried samples of Clarins Double Serum in the past and enjoyed it but now that I’m using it nightly, I’m really seeing results in how glowy and firm my skin has been looking. Can’t wait to see more!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this Tea Elixir Skin Resilience Activating Serum complimentary from Fresh. This was my first time trying a serum from Fresh and wow, I’m impressed! Since I started using this serum, I’ve noticed an increase in the bounciness of my skin. It’s also been helping to make my skin more glowy on days when I don’t have time for a full skincare regime.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: Farmacy Beauty gifted me their Daily Greens moisturizer and I’m impressed by yet another product from them. It’s texture is very lightweight and it feels SO refreshing on my skin. My face feels very hydrated and smooth after I apply it.  It has a subtle lime scent, and lime extract is on the ingredient list! If you’ve tried Green Clean then you’re familiar with the scent I’m referring to. This will surely be a staple for me during the hot summer months! #greensforall @farmacybeauty

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I am very pleased with the results that I’ve been seeing from this eye cream so far. My undereye area looks a lot more smooth and hydrated ever since using this cream. The eye cream itself is quite thick and leaves a noticeable sheen on the skin, so a little goes a long way. My advice is to use this solely at night in the beginning if you’re concerned about the sheen shining through your moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this moisturizer complimentary from Glow Recipe in exchange for a review. I’m a huge fan of this moisturizer for many reasons. First of all, it smells deliciously like a watermelon jolly rancher...YUM!! If you’ve used the Lip Pop then you know exactly what I’m talking about! Second of all, it leaves my face very dewy, which is my favorite base for makeup. And lastly, the packaging! It’s so minimalistic and beautiful to look at. Glow Recipe has never disappointed me!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love how hydrated my under eyes look after I apply this eye cream. I have veryyy dry under eyes, and concealer always creases on me. I feel like this hydrates my skin adequately and makes for a lot less creasing.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: As a person with sensitive skin, this mask is the perfect solution for me, especially on those days when I don’t want to do my 10 step routine. I love how it helps soothe my skin and lighten the redness.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m not new to this retinol serum as I have purchased it before in a kit. This is one of my favorite retinol serums because it doesn’t sting my skin, doesn’t cause purging, and best of all it has improved my skin texture so much. Complimentary from Murad Skincare

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m not new to this retinol serum as I have purchased it before in a kit. This is one of my favorite retinol serums because it doesn’t sting my skin, doesn’t cause purging, and best of all it has improved my skin texture so much. Complimentary from Murad Skincare

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I remember seeing this toner go viral on tiktok, and now I know why. This has such an interesting texture — sort of like snail mucin, but not as sticky. It leaves my skin glowing and hydrated, and I’m completely obsessed with how gorgeous my skin looks.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’m a very big fan of the Fresh beauty lip balms because of how hydrating they are. This particular rose shade is a very pretty flush of pink. It’s very buildable and can be built up to a punchy bright pink

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Fresh Beauty never misses, especially with their serums and toners. I love that this has both ceramides and niacinamide, two of my absolute favorite Ingredients that work SO well together. This leaves my skin looking plump and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_title: It is lovely but not quite worth the price
reviews.review_text: Do not get me wrong I love this lip mask. It is a luxury experience but you could get the same results with blistex. If it was 8-10$ cheaper it would be five stars.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I get the puffiest eyes in the morning that take hours to go away and was hoping that this product would speed the process. It goes on nice and it’s always lovely to have a little eye massage but I just did not notice anything different. I know skincare is a marathon and not a spring but i was not really impressed.

reviews.review_title: i don't want to run out
reviews.review_text: this is the best cleansing balm. a little goes a long way! i am close to the end of my jar and am so sad! i might rebuy but I am curious to try out others

reviews.review_text: this is perfect for a night product, but for day time wear it was a bit tacky feeling on my skin. it is great though for the price

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: this was a bit of a splurge for me since i usually only use cera ve sunscreens but it was well worth it. in the morning i like to use a lotion but in the afternoon I never want to reapply since I have combo skin. this is perfect for a mid day reapplication without wrecking your make up or making your skin greasy

reviews.review_text: i got this for my boyfriend and have stolen it from him! it is so soothing, a perfect mask and more sanitary than using oatmeal from your kitchen! highly recommend well worth the price

reviews.review_text: i got this for my boyfriend and have stolen it from him! it is so soothing, a perfect mask and more sanitary than using oatmeal from your kitchen! highly recommend well worth the price

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

reviews.review_text: This isn’t my favorite serum I’ve ever used, but it’s a solid choice for combination/oily skin. I like the slightly thick texture and the dropper applicator. It feels nice going on my face, and after using it for a while, I think I did notice a slight reduction in the appearance of my pores. The one downside is that it is somewhat drying on my skin. I would recommend using either a heavy moisturizer after application or not using it conjunction with other pore tightening/acne fighting products in order to prevent dryness.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I have to say, Farmacy knows how to make a great first impression. The color of the product is such a pretty mint green, and I like that there is a plastic cover under the lid to help keep the product fresh. This moisturizer has a really cool gel texture that feels great going on my skin and provides a nice cooling sensation. It provides plenty enough moisture, even with the lightweight texture. However, it does leave my skin a bit tacky and takes some time to try down. It also doesn’t play nice with some other products that I layer on top of it. My sunscreen went on ok, but when I applied primer, everything started pilling up on my skin. I’m fortunate that I have a different primer with a different formulation I can use that ended up working much better with this moisturizer, but I know not everyone will have that option. It does really live up to its claim of reducing shine though. My face looked great and wasn’t shiny on my forehead and cheeks like it normally is, even at the end of the day. Overall, I think this is a great moisturizer for combination/oily skin, and even though you might have to do some experimentation with the products you layer over it, it’s worth it!

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this Pore Clearing Clay Mask 2X with Super Volcanic Clusters complimentary from Innisfree, and I have to say that I really like it! The product goes on really smoothly, and I only need a little bit to fully cover my entire face. This mask does a really good job drawing gunk to the surface. I can see my pores through the mask in some places, and it gets darker where oil is being drawn to the surface. Because it is drawing things to the surface, it can create a bit of an “it gets worse before it gets better“ effect on the skin, so I did notice some new blemishes after using. When washing off, I really like the volcanic clusters because they help scrub your face to provide some additional exfoliation as you’re washing it off the face. Overall, this is one of the best clay masks I’ve ever used because it works exactly how I want my clay masks to work: absorbs oil, shrinks pores, isn’t overly drying, and is obviously drawing things out of my pores and to the surface of my skin.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a free sample of the bareminerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum from PINCHme. This seemed like a decent serum. It has the texture I would expect from a serum - thin but not watery and a bit sticky. It felt good going on my skin and didn’t cause any issues with layering any of my other skincare products over it. I only received a foil packet to try, so I couldn’t really see how it did with my skin long-term.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: These pore strips were interesting to use. They are hydrocolloid, similar to many of the acne dots on the market today, which is different from traditional pore strips. I’ve always had luck with hyrdocolloid drawing oil and other gunk out of my pores, and these strips worked the same. Each pack comes with both a traditional nose pore strip as well as a rectangular shaped strip you can put elsewhere on your face. I used these overnight instead of the recommended 4-6 hours (but really, who usually has time during the day to let something sit on their face for that long?), and it didn’t seem to cause any negative effects to leave them on for that long. I put the rectangular one on my chin, and I think the hydrocolloid drew out more gunk there than on my nose. And I did notice a difference in the pores on my nose and cheeks right near my nose - they were much smaller the next morning. The only downside is these have very strong adhesive. They felt like pulling bandaids off my face, which I can’t imagine is good for the more delicate skin on my face. My nose and chin felt pretty sensitized for a few hours after taking these strips off, so I think I will be using these very sparingly going forward.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer complimentary from Fresh. This is a large jar that should last me quite a while. The product truly does smell like roses and is nicely cooling on my skin. This is a thick moisturizer but doesn’t feel greasy or heavy on my face. It took some trial and error to discover the right amount of product to use for my combination skin - I think I used too much at first, and I did experience some pilling on my face throughout the day. But when I used less I didn’t seem to have that same issue. Overall, I think this moisturizer is more than I really need for my combination skin in the summer, but I can’t wait to use it during winter time when my skin will be in need of a bit more moisture.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I’m not the type of person who uses a true facial oil every day because, although I am dry, I am also very acne prone. This oil didn’t cause me to break out like others do but I also didn’t notice anything incredible about it.However, I bought a sample kit from YTTP with this in it and had a significant amount of the trial size left. I recently started to mix it in with my foundation and WOW. Life changing.My foundation always looks really cakey regardless of what I’m using and how much I moisturize beforehand. But mixing in this before application CHANGED EVERYTHING. My skin looked to dewy and hydrated with no dry patches at all! Totally maximized my foundation and even my BB cream.I will likely be purchasing a full size of this for use as a makeup oil and also for lymphatic massage!

reviews.review_text: This is one of my favorite cleansers! Its gentle and hydrating but the gentle foaming and crisp natural scent from the superfoods makes it a really refreshing experience. I love to use this as a morning cleanser to get started for the day. I would HIGHLY recommend this to anyone!

reviews.review_text: I finally took the plunge on purchasing this product and do not regret it at all! I’ve used other hyaluronic acid serums with minimal results and poor textures (pilling, stickiness, etc.). This product not only provides noticeable hydration, its also cosmetically elegant. It doesn’t pill, layers well with other products, and isn’t all that sticky. I would highly recommend this to anyone looking for a hydrating serum for their routine. Its pricey, but I think its worth it.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I took the plunge and purchased the full size of this mask after using a sample size for a while. This mask is an incredible addition to my routine and my skin loves it! My skin isn’t dry enough to need this every day (especially in the summer) but I use this at least once a week after my self care sunday masking routine along with any night that I feel my skin needs to be nourished. Its a thick, balmy texture but it rubs into the skin really seamlessly. Every time I use it, I wake up with hydrated, happy skin!I know there is vitamin C in this product, but I don’t find it so strong that I can’t use the mask along with other actives like AHAs or retinol.If you’re not sure about whether you would like this product,  I would highly recommend taking the plunge or buying a sample size!

reviews.review_text: I love this product! I use it as a mix in with my tinted moisturizer to give me a nice glow. It’s all depending on your financial situation, but if you can swing it - don’t hesitate to try it out!

reviews.review_text: I wasn’t a huge fan of this product when I tried a sample for a couple of weeks. It also caused some stinging in my eyes - not as bad as some oil cleansers I’ve tried, but not as good as my Green Clean. It didn’t cause any irritation or breakouts, but I won’t be purchasing a full size.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is my favourite brand BUT this particular cream is for drier skin, not for combination/oily skin. It can look extremely dewey/wet if worn with makeup.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is awesome. I have really enjoyed using this product. It is so soft . This product is also very gentle on my skin . It makes a big difference in my skin I feel that it has made a change for the better !

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Octoly. This product GoopGlow Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator is wonderful. You get 50 ml and it has a protective cover as soon as you open the container which I appreciate. This product instantly takes away roughness or uneven texture on your face .You only need a little bit of this product as it goes a long way. I was blown away at how soft my face felt after one use! You take a dime size and massage on your face and let it sit for up to three minutes. Wash away and pat your face dry. Your face feels so clean and soft. You can use this product up to three times a week. I highly recommend!

reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. The daily greens oil- free gel moisturizer is awesome! The ingredients are so good for your skin. You apply this product straight to the skin and it absorbs so well. It does not feel oily on my skin it makes my skin feel nice and soft. It’s a very gentle formula for your skin. I love that this product it is oil and alcohol free. The glass packaging is also very nice. A plus I love about this product is it is vegan,cruelty-free,and gluten-free. This product also comes in recyclable packaging what a win. If you are looking for a new moisturizer I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product is really good! You open the top and squeeze out a tiny amount . You rub it together and rub into your face where you have breakouts. reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree.  This product is so lightweight. It’s not sticky at all it glides right on the skin. I would definitely recommend this product.

reviews.review_text: Skinfix + barrier is a great product. This product definitely  hydrates and moisturizes your face. My face feels like it’s not dry anymore. It feels soft and smooth. I really love that it is fragrance free! I would highly recommend this product. Gifted by Skinfix.

This is my new go to moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The it cosmetics confidence in a cream is so good. I love how it makes my skin feel so hydrated. It is one of the best moisturizers I have used and i have used many. This will definitely be a new staple in my collection. The benefits of this product is your skin feels more plump. It helps with the look of my pores and wrinkles. I would highly recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: The Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum by Dior is so good. I apply morning and night per directions. I apply with  wry light pressure around my eye and on the upper eye lid. I come around and apply to brow bone. I do this application on each side. I have noticed from day one my fine lines and wrinkles have started to improve. It makes my eye area feel refreshed. The puffiness has also went down around my eye area. It keeps my eye area nice and hydrated also. Definitely seeing plumper and brighter skin already. I would highly recommend! I did receive this product complimentary from Influenster to review.

When I apply makeup everything sits so beautifully on my skin.  It looks more airbrushes and perfected now due to this serum. This has quickly become a love and will be purchasing once it’s all gone. My one con is that I seem to going through this serum super quickly and it’s a pricey item.

reviews.review_text: Super creamy and hydrating product. Feels like a rich moisturizer for your eyes without it being too heavy. I love that when I wake up in the morning, I notice the moisturizer is still present but only to the touch while washing the skin because I don’t feel it on my eyes.  Need to test out long term whether or not it wrinkle corrects or not, but with the high hydration I can see why it is called such.

I will keep using this to see if I get any results on my acne prone skin. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I love how you don’t have to rinse your face after using this mask - makes it very convenient to use. It is definitely hydrating and leaves my face glowing. But, I find the smell too strong.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I love how you don’t have to rinse your face after using this mask - makes it very convenient to use. It is definitely hydrating and leaves my face glowing. But, I find the smell too strong.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Rich Texture, but not a dewy finish
reviews.review_text: I thought this moisturizer would have a dewy finish since it’s tailored for dry skin, but to my surprise it leaves a non greasy satin finish. It gives my skin enough moisture where my skin feels hydrated, but not overly greasy where it feels like oil is sitting on my skin. It absorbs fairly quickly when you rub into the skin, but does leave a slight film. I think this is great for normal skin. It has a really rich texture almost like a hybrid between a balm and moisturizer. Jars are not my favorite since you have to dip in and sanitary reasons, but I think it is the right component as it might be too thick for a pump. Overall I love this moisturizer, but think if you have dry skin you might not like the satin finish and want a dewier one like the tatcha luminous dewy cream.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: This oil smells so good! It has a very light rose scent to it which is not too strong/over powering or perfumey. I have oil skin so i love using this at night instead of a traditional oil as it absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a heavy or greasy feel to the skin. Also love adding to my night moisturizer for a boost. I haven’t seen any brightening effects (using it for 2 weeks) but hopefully with more time I will see results. For now, love it as an every night oil for oily skin.

reviews.review_text: A really cool texture! It is more of a watery serum than an oil and I don’t feel like it leaves my skin oily at all. Not greasy and lightweight. It also hydrates my skin nicely

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I deal with oily skin that is acne prone, and have tried AHA and BHA to help tackle my issues. This product not only helped with gentle exfoliation, but cleared up so many different acne spots. Cystic and blackheads are almost nonexistent now. It also adds hydration which is a bonus for me, during these cold months, and a bonus of glow and radiance that I’m not use to seeing. It is helping with my fine lines and dark spots as well. I can go on about this product, even the scent of lemongrass and prickly pear.I do recommend this product and will continue to repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I love SPF and try to wear it daily. I have tried this product with and without makeup, to see both effects. With me having oily skin, I feel this amount of glow might be too much. I will say that there’s no glitter involved, which is a plus for me. I could use this in my high points, underneath highlighter, but I can’t personally wear it on its own though. I do recommend this to all skin types, to all SPF lovers, and anyone who enjoys a glowy natural look.

reviews.review_text: Where had thus cleanser been all my life?! I received this product as a free sample.  I have been double cleansing with various cleanser balms and facial washes for 2 years now. reviews.review_text: I received sample size Origins Original Skin Retexturizing Mask With Rose Clay as a complimentary gift from Origins via Influenster and I’m SOO happy I did! reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this product. Even after not being a fan of face oil, a Sephora associate told me such wonderful things about it that I thought I’d give it a try. This was my second try with Sunday Riley as I had also purchased their acne kit with an acne oil, Martian toner and Saturn Sulfur mask. That kit was a fail for me as well. I faithfully followed the regime for the Luna oil nightly. On the plus side, it never broke out my acne prone skin but I had to deal with the extremely oily skin feeling all night. I just kept thinking it would be worth it for the results of lessened dark spots, even tone and texture, ect. That never happened. My skin didn’t even feel softer due to the addition of the oil. This will be the last Sunday Riley product that I try. I feel the brand is overpriced and doesn’t deliver. There are literally better, less expensive products out there with the same, if not better ingredients that actually deliver what they promise. If you find yourself looking at a Sunday Riley product, just search for the product without a brand name on the Sephora site and your better options will appear.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster to test. I have used Drunk Elephant products in the past and ended up ditching them for price, however was happy to see this one is affordable. I will absolutely be purchasing when I run out. I’ve used Garniers Micellar water forever but it pales in comparison to Drunk Elephants Milki Micellar. The consistency is much thicker and it seems to pick up so much more, and removes makeup easier. It also leaves my skin feeling soft and fresh. Definitely a new skin care staple for me.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this for free from Influenster to try as a sample. It has completely changed my skin texture, wrinkles look so much fainter. Before this product I had extremely oily skin. I would need to wash my face mid day to keep it at bay... which obviously isn’t a workable way to live if you like wearing makeup. After using this product I noticed my oil levels changing. I have been using this well over a month now (I bought a bottle immediately after running out of my sample) and I no longer have oily skin. I no longer have to wash my face mid day or worry about oil control. It is amazing. I will not go without this serum from here on.
