reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love Ole Henriksen, I am a long time user of their Truth Serum so I was extremely excited to see I was picked to test this for Influenster. The look of the bottle is a let down compared to the cute packaging they used, but it is functional and works great. I haven’t noticed any smell with it bad or good. It claims to have a tingle effect but I’ll be honest, I didn’t feel anything. Maybe my skin is just used to the ingredient used already. I put it on before bed every night  since receiving a couple of weeks ago. I do have a solid skin care routine already in place so I just added this in. My skin texture appears a bit better, I don’t know about dewy but appearance is nice overall. The price point is not as bad compared to other brands and I do love Ole in general. I would consider switching just because of the price point honestly. Overall a decent skin care product, I think it is worth the try.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: There is a reason this product sells out repeatedly. It is beyond words! I put it on at night, which I’d recommend because it almost looks like I buttered my face, and it soaks in by morning to make my face look more radiant and my skin more plumped up and hydrated. Some products claim to make skin radiant. Trust me, this does just that and more.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Tried it as a sample and I’m In love! It’s so amazingly perfect at reducing lines and plumping my skin that I’m definitely thinking of the full size!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: This is a must have for any type of skin! From before applying it into the next day, it’s a great experience for the senses. The scent is indescribable. It’s slightly reminiscent of Vaporub, but at a much lighter scale that makes it refreshing. The texture is slightly like pudding so it glides on. The next morning it’s soaked in and my skin is glowing. Perfect!

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Before buying this, I’d read about the wonders of caffeine in de-puffing the skin. I decided to start inexpensive and work my way to expensive. The truth is, I’m sticking with this and not limiting its use to just my eye area. It works everywhere!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I am so grateful to be able to try this new product by Glow Recipe. I been fan of the brand for quite sometime now. This new Dew Drops are spectacular. It gives the most beautiful glow that is not greasy. The texture is a bit sticky but in my opinion it helps grip my foundation better. I aslo love the bottle. Gosh is fancy and I love the halo duo chrome pink on it. Another plus for me is that there is a pump, which makes so much easier to work with this product. Overall i am so impressed. Product was gifted by Glow Recipe for review.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Sunday Riley is one of my favorites skin care brands. I tried most of their products with really good results. Hoping this will be same with this eye cream. So far after a week of using i been enjoying it. Application is rrwally easy and I’m applying not day and night. Definitely notice hydration under my eyes.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Don’t you get excited seeing new Fresh products? I know i do! I actually really been liking this cream. I started using it over a week ago and so far so good. Texture is great and sinks right into the skin without feeling greasy or tacky. In a week of using i notice that my skin is more hydrated and less red. Definitely a keeper

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Fresh makes some of my holy grail products and they are in my routine a lot. For the new Tea Elixir is amazing. Not only it comes in a beautiful vibrant green packaging it makes my skin feel and look good. Especially now with my life being in a chaotic phase, with lack of sleep and just being on the run all the time. My skin suffers..by using this serum daily i can see the difference. My skin is more awake and more glowy. It works amazing under the makeup. It has great ingredients that feature Adaptive Phytocompound Tea (APT) Technology™: to increase skin’s bioenergetic systems & antioxidant protection- Niacinamide (Vitamin B3): Refines the look of pores and improves visible radiance.- 5kDA Hyaluronic Acid: Intensely hydrates and minimizes the look of lines and wrinkles.My over all experience with this elixir is pleasant. Plus did i mention it smells amazing! Definitely give it a try

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff! It gives the skin a nice glow and smells amazing! The smell reminds me of the watermelon jolly ranchers. To cover my full face it only takes one pump, so a little goes a long way. I would definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Love this! It’s very hydrating and makes my skin feel amazing after use! Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Love this! It’s very hydrating and makes my skin feel amazing after use! Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This stuff is great for dry skin. After washing my face I put the moisturizer on and the next morning my face was noticeably smoother and less dry. I recommend this for anyone with dry sensitive skin!

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water
reviews.review_text: Got the darkest shade and did three layers to get a nice bronzed look. It came out streaky and dealers on my elbows, knees and ankles. Since it is a clear spray it’s hard to see what’s covered.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I got a sample size from influenster in exchange for a review. This serum made my skin feel soft and didn’t cause issues with my skin. It gave a nice amount of moister. I don’t think I would buy the full size as it is pricey.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I love these so much! I have oily acne prone skin & these have came in handy so many times & they actually work miracles on the cyst pimples I get that never come to a head just a big knot & they actually shrink it & make it go away so fast I love it!! Plus they actually stick on & stay on so I don’t have to worry about it falling off while sleeping :)

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: My new fav moisturizer!! I have oily acne prone skin so this is perfect for me, it’s hydrating but lightweight doesn’t make me an oil slick & reduces texture/smooths my skin just after wearing it for one day. Been using it almost every day in the hot humid heat & it’s perfect! It has a whipped gel texture that’s cooling to the skin. I use this in the AM mainly bc I’m a skincare snob & have other heavier moisturizers for the pm when I exfoliate use retinol etc but I’m sure u can use it am & pm :) worth the price tag

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: These lip sleeping masks are soo good I love them!! This gingersnap one smells just like caramel I can’t stop smelling it lol, I love to use these during the day while lounging around at home as well at bedtime of course & such a little amount goes a long away so they’re definitely worth the price bc they last forever!

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I’ve wanted to try this since it first came out but was reluctant bc Farmacy green clean has always been my holy grail but this is my new favorite & I will be repurchasing when I run out!! This one doesn’t burn my eyes like green clean & it doesn’t leave an oily residue on my skin. 10/10 I love it!!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: So i have oily skin that had been getting a bit dry from another product that was making my skin flaky so I was looking to try YTP facial cleanser as I had recently started watching Hyram. Thankfully the Sephora I went to was out of the YTP mini set but the sales girl sold me on the mini which I finished and then came back and bought the normal size. I love this cleanser which is lightly hydrating, but not heavy. It has the consistency of a light lotion but it doesn’t leave any greasiness. I follow up with a hydrating essence, a salicylic or niacinamide serum, then face lotion and I’m done.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a little over a month daily, morning and evening and I love the way it feels throughout the day. It has a lightly whipped texture in the glass container and glides on smoothly. Love the very light scent and even though I’m pretty oily, if I use this moisturizer I’ll look dewy for about an hour then hydrated for the rest of the day. It does take a while to absorb which is fine. I don’t use any other YTP products on a daily basis so I don’t know how it pairs with the others

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Initially when I used this serum I had semi oily skin and this helped with excess sebum. I used it day and night, semi tacky initially but it dried well. I never wear makeup so I’m not sure how it holds up. No no huge improvements with active acne or scarring though and while I used this for about about a year there wasn’t a huge improvement other then my excess oil no longer making my acne as frequent.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m going to be honest, when I initially bought this I really did not enjoy how tacky it made my skin feel, to the point where it made my moisturizer slip off (YTP Superfood). However after starting Retin-A .025 and my skin drying in the process the tackiness has come in handy as it feels like a moisture barrier before I put on the retin-a. I use it only at night but I feel very hydrated and if I were to use it during the day I probably would only use a very light moisturizer if at all

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I bought this as my first foray back into salicylic cleansers after my Clean &Clear days. While this isn’t as harsh, honestly it wasn’t worth it, I immediately went to the cerave 2% salicylic acid cleanser instead and i prefer it’s consistency and ability to clean without stripping. This cleanser has an almost liquid hand soap consistency but I don’t feel cleaned.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this cleansing balm mostly because others I’ve tried leave a residue or a “goopy” feeling on my face that i feel I have to wash with another cleanser a few times. This one not that way at all ! I love it i can rub this all over get my makeup off, and then rinse and my face feels refreshed and clean. No triple and quadruple cleansing needed

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I love this cleansing balm mostly because others I’ve tried leave a residue or a “goopy” feeling on my face that i feel I have to wash with another cleanser a few times. This one not that way at all ! I love it i can rub this all over get my makeup off, and then rinse and my face feels refreshed and clean. No triple and quadruple cleansing needed

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I use this as my daily sunscreen under my makeup and let me tell you i was nervous at first. The consistency of it will make you think it’s going to be greasy, and cause your makeup to be blotchy. Wrong. This stuff is solid and if anything helps my face look smoother and hides my pores. Great product. I’ve tried other sunscreens under makeup and this one by far is the best option.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I use this as my daily sunscreen under my makeup and let me tell you i was nervous at first. reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser. I’m a big Glow recipe fan in general and this product started it all. It smells fantastic; not too strong. It gets sudsy which I personally look for in a cleanser. Also it REMOVES MAKEUP which I appreciate because not all cleansers do and sometimes you have to use 2-3 washes to get makeup off. This however gets it all off first use. It also makes my skin feels soft and smooth which is nice as well

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really can’t say enough good things about this product and brand as a whole. There has yet to be one product I don’t like from them this included. It is very hydrating but not sticky or oily or greasy. It is almost kind of cooling on the skin. I use a lot of skincare on my face and makeup etc and it is so soothing at the end of the day to finish with this. Definitely will repurchase, great price and I love its refillable

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: Expired. Don’t waste money on this, I opened mine and had a very similar experience to many on here. Moldy brown and black liquid in with the mask. Gross. Will not be purchasing again

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: I broke out, smells like mildew
reviews.review_text: I don’t know how to feel about this product. I have oily skin, and get occasional breakouts around my chin due to hormones. After about 3 weeks of using this product, my entire face started breaking out with very large zits, including along my cheeks. The first couple of weeks I thought that this product felt nice on my skin until these breakouts occurred. Despite the breakouts, I continued to use the product thinking it could have been something else, however the acne will not clear up and has now been on my face for over a week. The only change in my skincare regimen was this and the Milk makeup vegan milk cleanser Super disappointed :( the smell is quiet odd, it smells like mildew.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: While it’s hard to notice major changes in the skin with products during this time of wearing masks and having mascne, I have noticed that my breakouts havent been AS severe since using this product for the last 3 weeks or so. O love love love the way this serum smells and the way it sinks into ththe skin. It doesnt leave my face feeling oily at all! The ingredients are amazing too.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: The product itself does make my face feel really soft and smooth after use. I will say I feel like my $10 exfoliator works just as well though, so I don’t think that this product is worth the price that it is.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: The product itself does make my face feel really soft and smooth after use. I will say I feel like my $10 exfoliator works just as well though, so I don’t think that this product is worth the price that it is.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: So far so good. I have been using for about 2 weeks and I feel like I have noticed a big difference in my skin. I notice a natural glow and a way more even skin tone than prior to use. I am impressed!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I’m pretty impressed with the amount of moisture this product has given my skin! During these cold, dry winter months this is exactly what my skin needed. The product is a thick consistency that is very hydrating. It smells nice too! I can’t say I noticed a huge difference in  my pores, but overall I am satisfied.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_title: I look forward to Sunday nights!
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this mask! It does everything it says it will. How often does that happen?? I no longer have texture on my cheeks unless I skip my DE mask. I actually look forward to using this. The oil that comes with it makes me break out even though it’s a dry oil so I don’t use that but the mask itself is a dream come true

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: These are great! I keep a mini in my purse. They smell amazing and they exfoliate really well. Don’t pass on these.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m on my 3rd bottle of this. It smells so yummy and feels so silky and light when I apply it. Every Sunday night I do the DE Babyfacial before bed and it’s pretty rough on the skin and then I apply this moisturizer and it soaks right in. Then I use the matching sleep mask and wake up Monday morning with soft radiant silky skin.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I got this in one of the holiday sets and didn’t care for the smell. It’s kinda like when your coconut oil goes bad. Anyway, I put it aside but saved it for a back up in case I ran out of something. I’ve been using it at night with my Clarisonic to remove my makeup because, as much as I love my DE jelly, it doesn’t get the makeup off. This stuff gets the job done I just don’t care for the smell at all.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product but I hate the price. I got this and the pink in my Play! boxes and was very excited. Just don’t keep it in your pocket or carry it around on a really hot day because it will melt and then when you go to apply it to your lips you might lose a chunk of it. Oops. Live and learn.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_title: works on my dehydrated sens skin!
reviews.review_text: Hmm. How to explain... I have sensitive dehydrated skin. Very very dehydrated. What this means is even if I wear tons of makeup, I still have to use sensitive washes, can’t exfoliate, and have to be very gentle because my face will dry out and will be rough rough rough and bumpy. Because of the sensitivity, I can’t just scrub or I’ll be beet red. Everything has to be wiped off in my case, if not, it’s excess! Bc of this, these wipes are great! Gets rid of anything extra I couldn’t simply get off with gentle washes. Leaves skin feeling clean but not tight. I don’t worry about clogged pore AT ALL. I know these wipes get in there. Luckily on me it hasn’t caused Any adverse reactions yet. Great first step for prepping before foundation.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: Not sure if this is “worth the hype”. But worked great for my dehydrated skin. A lot of creams are too heavy n leave my face sticky and congested. Lighter lotions aren’t hydrated enough. Layering serums + light gel lotions + water based primer is the perfect set up for face. Light concealer application on redness, and light powder foundation dusting leave me with perfect coverage. But the last step, the powder dusting, makes my face look like a desert. 2-4 sprays IS enough. Dab it with a lightly damped blender sponge, and u get all the coverage u need and save on product! The most is light that it’s easy to want to over so it. And you CANNNNNN over do this!!! But when used correctly, it does what the name LITERALLY says- dewy. If you’re a Mayte person, this isn’t probably for u. If you’re looking for glow, I’m sure u can glow with this, but really, it’s for dew. I’ve bought 2-3 minis, 2 large bottles. I use the tatcha essence in of my empty larger mist bottles and it’s perfect at making the product last longer. 1 star off because of the price tho. Olay makes an aloe Vera mist that is a pretty decent back up. But tatcha glass bottles make the experience luxurious.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This ended up being a pleasant surprise! I was using very strong cleanser loaded up with “acids and vitamins”. Finally I decided to double cleanse with milder ingredient. Honestly, I only realized how amazing my skin was looking with cleansing oil until I ran out!!! My pores are now out of control and my make up applies terribly!! Definitely repurchasing over and over again! Calmed redness down and helped with cleaning out whiteheads. I pair it up glossier milk cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: This is really amazing! I have used it for 3 straight weeks and I love how my skin is looking! I have seen a lot of improvements and I totally recommend this to anyone who is wanting to up their skincare routine! I received this product from Influenster for free and it was for testing purposes. It does not shape the way I review stuff.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from influenster and I loved this product. I used it for a week straight and noticed instant results. I will be purchasing the bigger bottle so that I can use it longer. I definitely recommend trying this product out.

reviews.review_text: I received this product free from influenster for testing purposes. I loved this product and i loved the formula it has. The only thing I’m against is the tube that it comes in. I don’t see it being sanitary. I hate dipping my fingers in it and then applying it to my lips. So i used an applicator to do so which takes more time. Overall the product did make my lips feel so much better.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: yes this is a nice product, nice but expensive.  Let’s be honest u can just use Vaseline. Companies are out here making lip masks for 22$ if u can afford it cool, i guess go for it. If u can’t especially in 2020 just use vaseline. Same results. I gave 3 stars because like I said it is nice, very soothing smells sweet. I received this as 1 of my samples in a previous order.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite face cream ever. ive been using it for about 3 years. I first got introduced to Fresh when I went to the Wendy Williams show and she gave s full size gift box of fresh products during her holiday/xmas episodes. I have never looked back.  this cream is very nourishing without being too thick or thin. Perfect balance. I have dry skin especially during the winter months.  This cream works well for me all year round. 5 stars in my book

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: best in the business.  ive been using this for years.  it’s very easy on the skin, cleans very well and honestly ever since using fresh products my skin has been the best its ever been. I’ve bought every size throughout the years.  the jumbo is the best.  oh and it cleans off makeup very well.  no harsh ingredients.

reviews.review_text: after using my other facial cleanser for years I’ve decided to try something new so I went ahead and bought the small size of this cleanser. I absolutely love it.  It has a decent accent n it’s very gentle on the skin. doesn’t leave my face feeling too dry. Feels fresh and clean.  For reference I have dry skin

reviews.review_text: I like this a lot ! My boyfriend struggles with oily AF skin and this is the only thing that will both control oiliness andprotect him.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I love this so much! No flashback very light, feels like a light moisturizer and works great under primer! I don’t have any negative things to say!

reviews.review_text: This is my holy grail waterproof makeup remover. It smells so good and it’s cooling. I have repurchased this a few times and gifted it as well! I love it so much!

reviews.review_text: This is my holy grail waterproof makeup remover. It smells so good and it’s cooling. I have repurchased this a few times and gifted it as well! I love it so much!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Leaves my skin very smooth but has a weird smell.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a couple months and haven’t noticed any change in my skin. I have normal to dry skin. This didn’t cause breakout but it didn’t significantly brighten or soften. I’ll keep using it because it’s so expensive but don’t think it’s worth repurchasing. Also it has a weird smell.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a couple months and haven’t noticed any change in my skin. I have normal to dry skin. This didn’t cause breakout but it didn’t significantly brighten or soften. I’ll keep using it because it’s so expensive but don’t think it’s worth repurchasing. Also it has a weird smell.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: Very nice lightweight oil with pleasant smell. I have not noticed any changes from the vitamin C.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: Its nice. it does its job in clearing black heads

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: A really good face wash. If you want your face squeaky clean this will do it. So I have dry skin and I use it because of the amount of makeup that i have on a daily bases on I don’t like the feeling that most “dry skin“ face wash leaves because I want everything gone. If there was a con I feel like if you’re mature and skin is really really dry then this will be very stripping on the skin and will leave the skin tight. My skin is dry so in the winter my skin gets tight after using this, but nothing a serum and good moisturizer can’t fix.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite mask of all time. Honestly a game changer.  It helped my texture go away and it exfoliates lightly to remove the dead skin and helped to tighten my pores.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: It is very lightweight and not greasy. I love that it is spf 42. It is hydrating and also acts like a primer. It absorbs into the skin quickly. It does not have a strong scent. It has Hyaluronic acid which is a plus. I absolutely love the fact that it is ocean friendly!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: It is very lightweight and not greasy. I love that it is spf 42. It is hydrating and also acts like a primer. It absorbs into the skin quickly. It does not have a strong scent. It has Hyaluronic acid which is a plus. I absolutely love the fact that it is ocean friendly!

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love the smell and the texture is sticky. If takes a little more product to cover the face and neck. The smell is not overpowering. My skin feels cool and taut after use. I love the product, but I have to point out that they have designed the bottle to be deceiving. If you look at the bottom, the bottle is a lot shorter actually and it is all plastic below. Something to note when considering the price vs value.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is the first Tatcha product I’ve tried, and it is pure luxury! I’ve tried multiple eye creams in the past, but this one has really been a game changer! The anti-aging melting cream leaves my under eyes looking instantly refreshed! I’ve only used it for a few days but I have no doubt that adding this into my daily routine will continue to moisturize and brighten my under eye area, bringing back that fleeting youthfulness! Thank you @tatcha @influenster I should note a little goes a long way, so this jar will last a while! And there is a very faint smell, a clean sunscreen-like scent, nothing strong or obnoxious. received this product complimentary from influenster for testing purposes.The above is my own opinion.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Holy grail of moisturizers. I’ve tried several in the last year from dupes to the real thing, but this one takes the cake. My skin for sure is not as tight and dry as it has been these last winter months. It’s super smith and soft! The cream is so easy to apply, a little goes a long way and it soaks in almost instantly making it perfect for before makeup application. There’s no real scent to it so if your sensation to fragrance this one is perfect for you! I highly recommend this moisturizer! Can’t wait to try other Charlotte tilbury products now!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is so smith and hydrating. I haven’t noticed a change in undereye circles, but that’s not always something that can be changed. As far as an eye cream goes this one is great in that my under eyes feel smooth and hydrated!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this product for so many reasons, but most of all because it leaves my skin silky smooth and hydrated, I have dry skin and this product instantly nourishes my skin through-out the day.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: The container speaks for itself, it’s simple and clean. The scent alone is amazing. I’m looking forward to using this product all during fall. I especially like that it’s cruelty-free and synthetic fragrance free.  You can also pat it on over your make-up for extra radiance, who doesn’t need extra radiance? I received this product #complimentary for testing purposes @influenster. #cleanbeauty #contest

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using The Essence for about a month and I notice my skin instantly feels more radiant. I’m not sure it improves your skin overtime due to aging by I feel more hydrated and my skins also feels smoother. I especially love applying this product during the day before my moisturizer because of how refreshing this product makes my skin feel. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: I notice a difference in the size of my pores when I use it at least twice a week but I don’t think it extracts as much as I would like.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This has a great feel to it.  It absorbs fast but leaves your skin feeling and looking hydrated all day or all night.  I prefer to use this as a day moisturizer, I am 36 and like a heavier cream for night use.  If you are in your 20’s this would be an amazing product for both day and night.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: This is one of the few skincare products I’ve tried that delivers exactly what they claim and more!! Not only did I see the results this brand claims but I saw dramatically smaller pores the next day. I’m 37 and have dry skin from aging. I’ve tried very expensive moisturizers and nothing comes close to this.  My skin is plumper the next day, softer, smaller pores, this is my go-to now.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: I have had this for two months and it is fantastic. No where near the halfway point. Help with scarring, redness, acne, etc. I’ve seen a visible difference in my skin. I absolutely love this. It is worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is very good on my skin, lightweight and non drying. I prefer it to many other gel cleansers I’ve use as it doesn’t feel stripping or leave a gross residue.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is very good on my skin, lightweight and non drying. I prefer it to many other gel cleansers I’ve use as it doesn’t feel stripping or leave a gross residue.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I adore this serum! I have seen a noticeable difference in my blackheads and the occasional pimple since I started using this two months ago. As this is a silicone, it will pill if you layer it with oils.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: extremely hydrating for very dry skin
reviews.review_text: this product is a holy grail. I have worked at front desk of high end Spas where with staff discount i have purchased high end professional products like Dr Babor.  I have used many expensive hyaluronic acid which never felt like added any extra hydration to my skin.  This product is so cost effective and works wonder.  I will keep buying this product again and again.  I have been telling all the aestheticians at my spa about how amazing this product is.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: not for people of color as it can burn
reviews.review_text: i bought this product but i will be returning it as it is unused.  After buying this i got to know that glycolic acid is not good for the skin of people of color instead lactic acid works wonder.  Glycolic acid can burn the skin of people of color

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: works for hydration not for fine lines
reviews.review_text: i do notice it helps in reducing puffines and add hydration to the under eye skin but please do not expect any miracle for fine lines with this product

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_title: Does not do anything instead of hydration
reviews.review_text: I do not really know whether this product did anything to my skin.  I never noticed any difference in my skin instead of added hydration.  I would not recommend this product as i think it does not really do any visible difference to your skin

reviews.product_name: Mini Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: it hydrates my dry skin very well. I do not think i need to buy any other moisturiser since i have started using this it works wonders,  Definitely will be buying again.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: the product stings a bit initially.  I was using it everyday and it used to sting alot.  Whenever i woke up in the morning i felt my cheeks were red and stinging.  But started using it thrice a week to build tolerance with the skin.  but now i am using it everyday and yes i have noticed difference in my skin.  It has become brighter and my face feels brighter.  it is gritty and sometimes feels it is piling up but hardly matters it is making my face brighter so i will continue using it.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this product from free thanks to Influenster, and I couldn’t have been more ecstatic to try it! It was super light weight and my skin drank it up as soon as I applied it. My skin changed within a few days of use, it was glowing and soft, I really enjoyed this product. The one thing I will say I wish it was a bit MORE moisturizing because my skin is very dry but other than that I loved it!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Ok, this product is absolutely incredible. Just with the first use I noticed a difference, the smell is light and fresh it’s amazing! My pores felt tighter and looked, my face was glory and moisturized, light not heavy or greasy, and absorbed into my skin beautifully. No breakouts. It’s amazing. I deff recommend , I have normal to dry skin for reference.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a great cream, the texture is incredible gel-like but applies like a cream it’s lovely. It is a bit strong because it did sting me a little bit but I do have sensitive skin and eye area, but it has gotten better with more uses. My eyes look plump and incredible even with just a few uses. I love it!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is so hydrating and is perfect for winter. If you have dry and sensitive skin, you may like this since it is fragrance-free, paraben-free, sulfate-free, silicone-free, dairy-free and gluten-free. The product is also cruelty-free and vegan. The only con is the consistency is thick and I don’t like it.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: Estēe Lauder - Advanced Night Repair is a must have serum which I keep buying everytime when it nearly runs out. I have been using the previous formula for a long time since it helps my skin recover from not sleeping well enough.The new formula is easier to absorb than the older one which I really like. I’ve been using this for a week and I can see the difference. It  hydrates my skin giving it a radiant and plumping look. It also can be used in the morning and it doesn’t bother your makeup at all.

reviews.review_text: I really liked these easy to use peels. They were easy to use, felt great and left my skin feeling and looking brighter. I have already bought a second batch because I am so happy with the results.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really liked this cleanser. I have oily skin that is prone to breakouts and this has been working well for me. It completely removes all my makeup and rinses cleanly. I also like that it is part of the Clean Beauty at Sephora

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample from Pinch Me and really liked the way my skin felt after applying. It was easy to apply, absorbed quickly and left my skin feeling soft and not at all greasy. Will def be buying a full size to continue using.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Full disclosure: I have never really had an issue with redness so I cannot comment on that aspect, but I can say that this product works great for calming irritation (after I toner I used basically burned my face) so I would imagine it would also be great for redness. I purchased solely because I wanted a moisturizer to use in the morning that had SPF and this had great reviews. After using this for about ~2 weeks I can honestly say that this is a great product. I’m a bit more on the tan side so be aware that the darker you are, the more the product is going to look a bit white on your face (it is a color corrector after all). I can usually blend it into my skin pretty well and it looks fine if I decided not to wear make-up but it also looks great under my foundation. Overall, quality product. I bought the smaller jar to try it out and I will be purchasing the bigger size once I run out (a little goes a long way). Bottom line - moisturizing, not irritating AND has SPF. I love it so far.

reviews.review_text: Okay so first off, I have extremely sensitive skin. Like, products that are targeted/ labeled for sensitive skin still irritate me. That being said, I’ve been using a few drops of this on the areas on my face where I get “irritation“ bumps every night and by the time I get up in the morning, they’re either completely gone or almost unnoticeable! The consistency can be a tad bit sticky but I only wear it at night (not under make-up) and it dries fairly quickly.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Honestly I have no complaints. I’ve tried other cleansers that claim to be for sensitive skin but they still irritated me. This is a nice gently cleanser that removes makeup and doesn’t leave my skin feeling super dry or irritated. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water
reviews.review_text: I got the dark (mostly because medium was sold out) and I am loving this product. I do like a more of a less subtle bronze glow. Don’t go with dark if you want it to look super natural. The reviews on the bottle are right. My pump didn’t even work when I received it, but I just easily transferred it into a small travel spray bottle that was $1 and no problems! Does not streak and it STAYS PUT. So make sure if you get it on your hands to wash it off right away or they will be orange ! Only reason it didn’t get 5 stars is just the sprayer

reviews.review_title: You get what you pay for!

reviews.review_text: I’m so happy that Influenster and Tatcha sent me another product to try in exchange for my honest review. And once again I am IN LOVE! After each use my face felt softer and well hydrated without leaving a weird sticky texture. My only con of this product is the cost.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster. Complete transparency I was a little skeptical about using the product but I was actually pleasantly surprised. This little eye cream/serum was wonderful. The applicator tip is nice and cooling which felt really good after a long day and once I had taken off my make up. I did notice that after about a week to week and a half I had less fine lines and I feel like my eyes were slightly less puffy. I can see this product lasting me a while because truly only need a small small amount of the cream/serum. Big fan of product not a big fan of the price.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: This was my first time using this product although I use other products from this brand. At first I was worried that it might be too strong for my skin type, but quite the opposite. After first use my skin feeling glowy and hydrated. What a great daily treat!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This has been an absolute favorite of mine since Sephora started carrying it. I have dry, sensitive skin and Magic Cream is one of the few products that matches well for me, especially during the winter months. I love how it serves as a primer before I put on makeup and I equally love that I can use it as nourishing masque if I apply a fuller layer as part of my Sunday skincare ritual. This just one of those products that will continually serve you well.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Estée Lauder’s new Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Cream is love at first use for me in the new year. Immediately nourishing, this has ingredients my skin enjoys, such as Moringa Plant Extract. I could actually see a change within the first week. It leaves behind a soft, satiny, hydrated feel. My skin looks balanced and now my makeup foundation glides across my face. Best of all, I don’t get to mid-day sensing that I need a top up of anything further. I really believe a quality moisturizer should give you the satisfaction of feeling that you are using a product which is simple and effective. I was kindly gifted this product and I’ve used it as my daytime moisturizer every day since…and now I purchased a jar myself because it’s that good!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: When I was first thinking about investing in to my skincare, I knew clean ’green’ products were important to incorporate for my routine. Drunk Elephant products weren’t widely known yet but I liked what they represented AND how important skincare is to their brand. T.L.C Framboos serum was my first purchase from DE alongside their Beste Cleanser. I used this serum every other night consistently for a year. I’ve repurchased this product twice - it’s not an affordable product- so I always saved to buy. The biggest difference I saw in my skin over a year is how soft and even my skin looks. The texture of my skin changed after about 3 months and I saw an evenness to my skin that wasn’t there before. My skin tone looked brighter with consistent use and even after trying other products aside from DE’s Framboos serum, I still maintained softer and smoother skin. This product didn’t prevent me from breaking out or magically changed my skin over a week but with consistent use, you’ll see a difference in your skin. I don’t get as many pimples or blackheads as much as before. I’d say this product changed my skin for the better. This didn’t happen miraculously or right away but the investment I had in using this product for about a year (combined with other DE products is even better) paid off.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using Drunk Elephant’s Beste Cleanser for about 2 years now. It’s a morning cleanser since I don’t need a deep ’clean’ right when I wake up. This is gentle, it doesn’t irritate my skin or dry it out. I’ve started using this product around the time of its release so I still remember the original twist cap :). I haven’t broken out from this cleanser nor has it clogged any of my pores. My skin type requires me to wash twice a day but I don’t use this at night after a full day outside or to wipe any type of makeup off. I rarely wear makeup so not sure if it’ll wash away a full face. I wouldn’t recommend this if you’re looking for a deep cleanser.

reviews.review_title: A Patch to Heal Acne Spots...
reviews.review_text: After reading about a spot treatment patch, I decided to try this particular one since the reviews seemed positive. I’ve used the Peace Out Acne Healing Dots for about a year (repurchased about 2 times). I do see a size reduction of my zit/pimple but for the larger (hormonal zits) ones, it isn’t as effective. Those hormonal zits will heal faster if I consistently use the acne healing dots. These do work fantastic for the smaller zits with a whitehead present. I see less of a scar if I use these dots as opposed to picking them...I try not to pick at my zits. I’ll continue using these dots but it isn’t necessarily a staple in my beauty cabinet.

I’m going to try again once my skin heals fully in a month or so but next time I’m going to try it without the framboois serum.For reference, I do have sensitive skin but don’t break out normally.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: The BEST. I tried them all, nothing compares sorry.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Very nice toner, I’m not a huge fan of glow recepie but this is one of the better products. I really like this and noticed results only a few days after I started using it. Very comparable to the glossier toner but even better if you ask me.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Very nice toner, I’m not a huge fan of glow recepie but this is one of the better products. I really like this and noticed results only a few days after I started using it. Very comparable to the glossier toner but even better if you ask me.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing serum! It’s the best I’ve used and amazing for the price.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this serum! It hydrates the skin but it is a little sticky. It gives the skin a glow which is amazing. Will definitely recommend and repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: Leaves the skin clean and removes dirt within pores. I’m really happy with the product!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I really liked the smell of this sunblock. Although it says you can use this in your face, I don’t really suggest it for people with oily skin. This contributed to it, so instead I use the dry touch one from neutrogena. Like the clear stick, I love that this is reef safe and that it comes in sustainable packaging!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I really liked the clear stick. It’s super convenient to put in your purse or pocket. It wasn’t as oily as the all over body sunblock, which was really nice! It has a very light smell and I love that it’s reef safe!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I think the very first thing I have to mention is that this product smells awful. However, the smell is not the reason I use it. If you can get over the smell, this product is great! I look forward to using it and covering it up with sunscreen every morning. I think it is definitely worth the price and would recommend to anyone!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This will be my go to shoulders décolleté and neck sunscreen this summer. Beautiful Consistency and is very very sheer on any skin tone. Impressed!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: So I am oily and live in the south this product can get a little shiny if used under an oil based make up it is really better for a boat or a beach day when you will not be wearing any or much make up. It does have a very light fragrance and feels a bit like a make up primer which is nice.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Love this veil like fluid. if you have maturing skin (mid thirties for me) but live in a humid climate or have oily tendencies this absorbs right in and feels absolutely lovely!! Obcessed with this formula.  Very delicate smell !! A nice daily SPF experience.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I am super duper oily textured skin but at 36 have to address aging concerns as well. This lightly fragranced formula is pleasant not only to the eye but smells and feels great. As a first time user I can guarantee I will be re-purchasing as a daily moisturizer/spf product for the fall/winter.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite moisturizer for the summer. It’s a perfect balance of light but having enough oil. I also love how it smells. Overall, an amazing product if you have oily/combination skin.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: An awesome moisturizer for the summer for combination / oily. It’s very light but is very moisturizing. I think this alone is not moisturizing enough for my skin, but it’s perfect when I use it with the other moisturizing serums I have.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: The best cleansing balm out there! It’s so lightweight but gets everything off. The scent is lovely too. I’ve tried multiple cleansing balms, including Korean ones, but always come back to this one

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: The best cleansing balm out there! It’s so lightweight but gets everything off. The scent is lovely too. I’ve tried multiple cleansing balms, including Korean ones, but always come back to this one

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: best moisturizer I have been using from last few month and it has change my skin I have tried many other but this is the best one....

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: I got as sample first and tried for a week now I just bought full size  my face is so clean and  feels so good and hydrate along with the under eye cream from same brand ... it’s the best moisturizer for oily skin

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this from Influenster for honest review. I loved it… made my skin so clean and super soft. I have already bought the full size.. I would highly recommend to all

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this from Influenster for honest review. I loved it… made my skin so clean and super soft. I have already bought the full size.. I would highly recommend to all

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE!! I was using makeup wipes and switched to this and I will never go back. Not only is the product itself so good, but it’s clean. I love that I can use a product that works AND is beneficial to my skin. No harsh chemicals.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE!! I was using makeup wipes and switched to this and I will never go back. Not only is the product itself so good, but it’s clean. I love that I can use a product that works AND is beneficial to my skin. No harsh chemicals.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Holy grail 100%. I will always have this on me. I have very sensitive acne prone skin. When my skin is dry, I break out. This stuff is amazing. I use it as a moisturizer more often then not whenever I feel like my skin needs something extra. I wake up in the morning and my skin is instantly transformed. If I feel some pimples coming, I slop this on and go to bed. By morning I have no zits.. I honestly can’t believe it. I love this stuff!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Holy grail 100%. I will always have this on me. I have very sensitive acne prone skin. When my skin is dry, I break out. This stuff is amazing. I use it as a moisturizer more often then not whenever I feel like my skin needs something extra. I wake up in the morning and my skin is instantly transformed. If I feel some pimples coming, I slop this on and go to bed. By morning I have no zits.. I honestly can’t believe it. I love this stuff!!!

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: To start off - I am super pale. Like, I’m a natural ginger. I was nervous about buying the dark shade so far into winter as I’ve lost my summer tan. But I did anyway. I only put 2-3 drops (can’t remember which) in each palm full of lotion. Which means 2-3 drops went on each leg, arm, and my chest and neck. The smell that develops over a few hours is honestly so terrible which is why I’m only giving it 4 stars. However, I am the kind of person that puts it on at night and showers in the morning - so I really don’t care as much. But with that being said, I wasn’t sticky like some other tanning lotions and I love how easy it is to apply. I wasn’t orange at all and had the perfect glow the next day. I will absolutely continue to use these drops!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Love it! I suffer from extremely dry lips in the winter. This stuff is amazing! I love applying it at night while I sleep, but I also use it as a lip gloss during the day. The smell and consistency is amazing. And I love the applicator that comes with it!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Perfect compliment to my skincare routine
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin.. but VERY dry skin in the winter. I got a sample of this to try with the DE Retinol cream and I absolutely LOVE this Hydration Serum. I am going to go buy a full size TODAY. I think it is the perfect compliment to any moisturizer if you have extremely dry skin. I really enjoy this with my Firma-C in the morning followed by my Tula moisturizer. It goes on nice and smooth - I’m in love!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_title: Yes, but for the price.. no.
reviews.review_text: I will say, I love the product - 5 stars for that. BUT I think the price point is just terrible. I have the lip sleeping mask which I absolutely love and I was so excited to see a gloss/balm for on the go. However, my first impression was “Wow this is tiny.“ In my opinion - not a lot of product for the price point. The lip sleeping mask is $20 and you get SO much more product with it. I love this but I will not buy again at this price point.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Just like everyone else, I bought this to combat the cold Midwest months. My skin is so dry right now so I wanted something thick to help get my skin back on track. After a few days of using though I noticed tiny pimples all over my forehead, nose, and jaw line. My skin was also not any more moisturized than before I started using it. So disappointed! I’ve never had a product break me out like that before! I’ll still recommend this product for those that don’t have such sensitive skin

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love everything about this product except for the fact that I breakout every time I wear it. I love the texture and consistency. It’s like a makeup primer for your face. I love the way it makes my skin feel. But every time I wear it, I break out on my forehead & cheeks.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love everything about this product except for the fact that I breakout every time I wear it. I love the texture and consistency. It’s like a makeup primer for your face. I love the way it makes my skin feel. But every time I wear it, I break out on my forehead & cheeks.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this cleanser!!! I just got a sample of it and I already know that I’m going to buy a full sized one when it’s gone. I was very skeptical about how well this would actually cleanse my skin, but I believe in DE so I tried it. It works!! My skin felt and looked clean afterwards and OH SO SOFT! I have very dry skin and this is now my holy grail. It didn’t dry my skin out or worsen my redness. If anything, it calmed my redness! It didn’t make my skin feel tight or hot like many cleansers do either. I love the exfoliant it comes with, it’s gentle enough for my red skin but still gets the job done! Also, I’m loving the magnetic spoon, it’s genius! Please follow the instructions if you try this product, it’s a balm cleanser and you HAVE to apply it to a DRY face with DRY hands! Water activates the formula and emulsifies it so make sure it doesn’t come in contact with water until you’re ready to rinse. It doesn’t leave behind a greasy residue like you think it might... just soft, supple, clean skin!! I highly recommend it. Btw, for the price and size of the container, it’s incredible!!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: This is a great mask for pores! I’ll admit that it didn’t remove all of my blackheads but I didn’t expect it to. What I did expect it to do is minimize the appearance of my pores and make my skin feel softer and look brighter, and it did all of that! The only downside is that it’s a bit drying, but most clay masks are. I believe this mask is targeted to people with oily/combo skin and I have very dry skin. I definitely noticed that it dried my skin out but I was fine as long as I applied my Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream afterwards. So bottom line, I really like this mask! Just be careful and give your skin some extra hydration if you have dry skin.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Let me start by saying that I’ve always been the “you don’t NEED eye cream” type of person. This eye cream changed my mind! The skin around my eyes have never felt this smooth or firm. Seriously, my skin’s texture has completely changed around my eyes. It used to be very textured and much less firm, but after just a few uses, I noticed a difference. After continued use, it just gets better! I know this is pricey and honestly, idk if I’ll even be able to purchase a full size when my mini runs out but I seriously love it and highly recommend it!!

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I was so disappointed with this lip mask. First of all, I’m a lip product hoarder so I’m very picky. However, I’ve never disliked anything I’ve tried from Tatcha so I had very high expectations for this. Unfortunately, none of them were met other than the luxurious packaging that you come to expect with Tatcha. This lip mask did absolutely nothing for me. My lips have been very dry, raw and sore from this winter weather and this didn’t help at all! I applied this stuff several times a day and generously before bed for several consecutive days and there was NO improvement in the condition in my lips. I’m not sure that it made them any worse, but it definitely didn’t help. After a few days of using this, when I went back to one of my regular lip products, my lips quickly started to heal. The jar is gorgeous and the product feels nice on the lips, but for me, there are no actual benefits. And with a hefty price point like this, you can get much better lip products for the same or less.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Let me start by saying I cannot recommend this product enough. Babyfacial is absolutely the best AHA/BHA product I’ve tried and it exfoliates my skin like nothing else. My only warning would be to those with sensitive skin because I can see how this could be irritating to sensitive skin. For those with super sensitive skin, I’d actually recommend trying TLC Framboos rather than Babyfacial. Mind you, I actually have sensitive skin myself and sometimes, although not every time, my skin is left pretty red after my weekly Babyfacial treatment. However, I honestly don’t attribute this to Babyfacial because I am constantly trying new skincare products so my routine is forever changing, and I acknowledge the fact that some products aren’t going to agree with all of my staple products, and some of them just don’t agree with my skin and therefore cause reactions that may be mistakenly blamed on my normal products, even though that’s not the case. Sorry for rambling, I hope this makes sense lol! Anyway, I swear by this product and highly recommend it to nearly anyone. The difference you’ll see in your skin will speak for itself. I actually went several months without using Babyfacial and my skin went back to the crappy state it was in prior to using high-end skincare - rough texture, huge pores, blotchy complexion. Of course when I started using Babyfacial again, this all went away again almost immediately! Give it a try, you won’t be disappointed. Side note, definitely follow up with a good, quality moisturizer! On days I use Babyfacial, I personally prefer using a combo of DE’s Protini and Virgin Marula Oil. It soaks into my skin like a dream and calms everything down after the Babyfacial treatment. Happy exfoliating!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: First of all, I love just about everything from DE and this is no exception! I have super dry skin that worsens in the winter so I go back and forth between Lala and Protini depending on the season and my skin’s needs. Lala is the perfect moisturizer for people who have extremely dry skin like myself - it’s thick, ultra moisturizing and packed with awesome ingredients. I’d have to say it’s my favorite facial moisturizer when I’m dealing with dry, flaky skin in the winter, compared to several other high-end brands I’ve tried. It’s a bit too heavy for me in the summer when I know I’ll sweat it all off, so I stick with Protini during the hot and humid months. I also use Lala on the backs of my hands and wrists in the winter where I get bad eczema and it works wonders. No body cream (even ones specifically for eczema) compares to Lala. I know it’s pricey but it’s worth every penny, I highly recommend this moisturizer for anyone with dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: First off, this primer serum is fragranced. I liked the scent but I know it’s a dealbreaker for some people. The serum sinks really nicely into the skin and pretty quickly too, so that I’m able to start applying my makeup soon after. It did give a blurring effect to the skin but didn’t noticeably prolong the wear of my base makeup. The packaging is sleek and easy to use.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I have tried this both as a scrub and also as recommended to leave on the face for a few minutes. If you’ve tried Ole Henriksen’s walnut scrub this lemon scrub is MUCH better. It isn’t as harsh but I would not consider this a gentle scrub. I prefer to use this scrub by leaving it on my face and then gently removing it. I do like the mix of chemical and physical exfoliation and my skin had a nice glow afterwards. The lemon scent is bold and refreshing. I typically do not use physical exfoliants but I did enjoy using this product and would recommend if you are a fan of physical exfoliants.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This was a great hydrating cream. It made my skin look plump and glowing regardless of it I wore foundation on top. However this cream is really expensive and I’m not sure it’s worth $100.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer was so hydrating. I noticed a difference in how plump my face felt with moisture. I also thought this texture was thick yet sunk in quickly. I used it under makeup and it didn’t cause any pilling.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received these gifted by Dermalogica Sampling. I really was surprised by how much I enjoy these microexoliants. Typically I am not a physical exfoliating gal, especially not daily. These were gentle and gave my skin a nice glow. Dermalogica products never let me down

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received these gifted by Dermalogica Sampling. I really was surprised by how much I enjoy these microexoliants. Typically I am not a physical exfoliating gal, especially not daily. These were gentle and gave my skin a nice glow. Dermalogica products never let me down

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: While this did make my skin feel more hydrated, it did not refresh my makeup. If anything I felt like it made my foundation look worse. It does have a great nozzle on it so you do get a fine mist, but this did not work for me as a setting spray.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this Hyaluronic acid from The Ordinary. It works well with my dry skin especially in the summer time under primer and sunscreen without my makeup pilling up on me. It’s a great hydrator for very little cost. I highly recommend trying out this line if you’re curious.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I love the feel of this oil! I have dry skin, and this helps a ton in the wintertime to pamper my skin. I wake up with soft skin each time I use this product. A few drops is all you need for your entire face, and the bottle lasts about 3-4 months with daily use. No issues with clogged pores or flared up skin. I highly recommend this oil if you’re in the market. For the price it can’t be beat!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried a lot of toners from brands like Kiehls,Tatcha, Lancome, PIxi, and including Fresh’s own regular Rose and Kombucha toner, to try and help out my poor dry skin and this is the best toner that I’ve found on the market! Soaks into my skin almost immediately, and I do see a difference in my skin’s dryness and also it appears to help brighten my skin a bit as well which is a bonus. The rose petals become problematic as you get to the bottom of the bottle (it blocks the product and does look a little gross), but with that said I have yet to find a toner that works so well for me. Works under makeup as well and plays nicely with other products like my moisturizer(s) and SPF so I have no piling of my foundation.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_title: Heaven sent holy grail eye cream
reviews.review_text: I have had horrible issues with dry scaley patches in my under eye area this winter that I just could not fix. I tried all sorts of different brands that Sephora sells trying to find an under eye cream that would get rid of my dry patches to no avail. I finally tried the Moisturizing Eye Balm and in less than 72 hours my dry skin was healed! I use it every night before bed and I haven’t had an issue with dryness since. Pairs nicely with my eye serum that I use as well.  A little goes a long way - thank you Belif for saving my under eyes!

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and in the wintertime it is about impossible for me to find a moisturizer that keeps my makeup from looking cakey and also not ball up on me. Look no further! This cloud cream is a dream underneath makeup. I have no issues with it balling up or it leaving me look like a grease ball. Keeps the cake face look at bay and no breakouts either. A must have if you’re trying to find a moisturizer for under your makeup. It also plays well with my SPF too.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_title: okay if you're in a rush
reviews.review_text: These get the job done if you need to get makeup off of your face, but I feel like a film is left behind once you use it. Also with eye makeup I usually need to use 2 in order to remove my full face. The price is reasonable though.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried this eye serum out for about 3 weeks and these are my impressions so far. It is lightly scented, but it disappears with time. The applicator is a nice touch, but I feel like a little too much product can come out if you’re not careful. The serum sinks in nicely and plays well with my makeup. With that said I do have eczema so while I need something more emollient for my eye area this was nice for the daytime. As far as seeing any change in wrinkles or dark circles I felt like this did help a bit with my dark circles, but I don’t notice any change with my fine lines. I was given this product for free from Influenster for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and suffer with eczema and am a big fan of Fresh products so when I heard that they had reformulated their Rose moisturizer I wanted to give it a try. Their original formula was not hydrating enough for me to use as a daytime moisturizer, but this fits the bill! I have no issues with this pilling up underneath my makeup and it works nicely with everything else as well (SPF, primer, serum etc). This is my daytime cream and I do not get oily with it at all throughout the day. I love gel moisturizers and this one sinks into the skin quite nicely. It it scented though (floral) I find that it does dissipate with time. I have had no issues with it breaking me out or making my eczema flare up at all. I’m so glad they reformulated this which is something you never say about a product. I highly recommend giving this a try if you suffer from dry skin and are trying to find a moisturizer that will work under your makeup.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This is pretty moisturizing. I haven’t seen a difference in my fine lines though. However, I still like this and will keep using as I think it helps my skin keeps from being dry.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I used this moisturizer for a few years actually. I used to love it in the winter months and would always order it for the winter. However, this year I broke out very bad all over my chin and got closed comedones over my chin. I read that heavy creams could cause this so I stopped using this and replaced with Clinique face lotion and my breakouts cleared up within a few days and I hadn’t put anything else new into my skin care routine so I am confident saying it was this. I didn’t believe a cream could make me break out but I was wrong. I used to love this lotion but I guess it does not work for me anymore. It’s a great face moisturizer and really clears up dry skin but just be careful as it’s quite heavy and could clog up your pores. I would recommend this product but with caution.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: This is such a nice face lotion. It smells amazing and soaks your skin with hydration. I love all caudalie products so I wasn’t surprised when I feel in love with this either. This is perfect for winter months when you need hydration but don’t want to clog your pores. I also use this in the summer time just less often as my skin isn’t as dry in the summer.

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I just recently started using this sample and wow. I have combination skin and this has made my skin look so good. I haven’t needed near as much makeup. It makes my skin look smooth supple moisturized and way less red. Expensive but worth it.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this primer when my skin is dry. It makes your skin look so dewy when you apply it and also adds a subtle highlighter look. I am used to use Becca primers and other way more expensive ones but this is a steal. I have never tried a primer that has been more moisturizing than this. When you apply it is sticky like a good primer should be and it helps your makeup last all day. Absolutely love this stuff

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This has been my first retinol product ever purchased. I got it for bad adult acne I just couldn’t get rid of - not for wrinkles. So far, I have been using this for 3 weeks and I still have some product left in the container. This takes awhile to see progress just like any retinol from what I hear but this is the first time my skin has been clear in months. I absolutely love this product and I will continue to buy it. It is drying so you will need a good moisturizer and you may want to start off using this every other day.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This has been my first retinol product ever purchased. I got it for bad adult acne I just couldn’t get rid of - not for wrinkles. So far, I have been using this for 3 weeks and I still have some product left in the container. reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love this toner! It’s super smooth and makes my skin feel amazing. I will say, there is a strong watermelon scent so if you are sensitive to smells, I would choose a different toner. The texture is the slightest bit sticky and gooey, but I love that feeling because it actually sticks to your face and doesn’t make it feel wet. It makes your skin feel super smooth! My pores are noticeably smaller after only a few uses

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I’ve had eczema on the back of my arms for years.  Then after having my baby I ended up with eczema on the sides of my thighs. At first I used this as my daytime lotion, under my make-up and it felt light, silky, and smelled nice.  Then I randomly thought to put it on my arms and within a day I noticed the bumps start to fall off.  Within a week the color of my skin is no longer full of red little spots. I’m now using this all over my arms and legs and am having the best results. I’m so happy with the results of this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I got this as a free sample and couldn’t believe my eyes the first time I used it.  I have been exfoliating with St. Ives products for years and only until after using this product did I realize what a true exfoliator should do. The application is a little clunky (you have to pour it in your hands and then add water and mix into a paste), but the results are worth it.  The exfoliation is gentle and doesn’t have much of a smell. This literally removed texture from my skin the first time I used it. I even did a double-take.  Once I finish the sample size, I’m going to get the mini since I don’t use it everyday and a little goes a long way.
