reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have struggled with dry skin for years, I mean years! After researching face creams for days, I realized not only was I using the wrong cream but I was also not washing my face enough. At first this cream seems expensive but when you see how little you need it’ll change your mind.  Within 2-days, I couldn’t believe it.  My nighttime face regimen is the following line-up 1) Tatcha Pure One Step Camellia Cleaning Oil, 2) Fresh Soy Face Cleanser, 3) Tatcha the Dewy Skin Cream.  I have only been using this for 2 weeks and already my face has plumped up, not broken out once, gotten brighter, and has not flaked or itched. I am an absolute believer in this cream. I haven’t used it under make-up and I sometimes switch up this regimen and add the Dermalogica Microfoliant but my skin has never looked better.  Good bye to dry skin!!

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Does the Job, Smells Great, Moisturizes
reviews.review_text: This is so easy to use and does a great job of getting rid of all of my make-up and grime, including my waterproof mascara.  I don’t have to rub my eyelashes until they fall off, in order for it to work.  It has such a nice, delicate scent and feels amazing.  It leaves my face feeling moisturized, instead of dry and tight, after washing everything away.  Love this cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for testing purposes courtesy of Lancôme & influenster. Product is much thicker than most toners I’ve used before. It comes out more like a gel consistency than a liquid which was surprising. My skin was left feeling hydrated & soothed afterwards. I would describe my skin as normal to combo where I have a tendency to get shiny in the t zone but not oily. A small amount of this on a cotton round is all it takes, it absorbs into the skin quickly & worked well with my other skincare & makeup products.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: Great lightweight gel texture (would be great for oily skin) quick absorbing & leaves the skin feeling soft & hydrated. Has a soft floral scent which normally I don’t go for but this one has a refreshing feel to it & smell disappears quickly.  I would describe my skin as normal combination. I can get a bit oily in the t-zone but not overly so just a bit shiny at the end of the day. This moisturizer absorbed quickly & later well with my usual skincare products & everyday makeup.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I was a bit sceptical about trying out a new serum especially one that “lightens” dark areas on the skin because I have freckles that I love & don’t want to fade but this serum worked wonders on my skin! It brightened & got rid of darkness under my eyes after the first use plusbis smells like lemon squares so it’s yummy to apply! I was pleasantly surprised that my freckles had not faded but the darkness I wanted to illuminate was gone. My skin feels more hydrated & plumped after use. It does leave a bit of a sticky feeling after it absorbs into the skin but it’s not uncomfortable in anyway & makeup applies evenly after use so I’m overall really impressed with how immediately I noticed a difference after using it! I look forward to it’s affects on fine lines!

reviews.review_text: LIFE SAVER for my dry and dull skinned people! reviews.review_text: It’s wonderful. I have very dry skin and am quite picky about moisturizers. reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is truly a treat to use. I bought based solely on the reviews. I noticed a difference in the way my skin felt after one use. It was so soft and smooth. It’s gentle and non-irritating. It has a faint scent that’s pleasant and not too over powering. I like to use this mask 2-3 times a week. I use a toner, serum, and moisturizer after rinsing the mask off.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I’m on my third jar of this. I get the one that’s for dry skin. I used to think that the best exfoliates has to have large grainy particles to be effective. This just isn’t true. The tatcha powder is fine but still exfoliates brilliantly. It works up to a rich, thick lather. I usually massage my face for at least 60 seconds and then rinse. reviews.review_text: Super effective. For me personally it stings and burns slightly at first it goes away after a few minutes. I do use it twice a week. Leaves skin super soft and silky and my makeup applies and looks better than ever.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Recently, Skinfix gifted me their peptide cream, and I must say, I fell in love with this moisturizer instantly! It has quickly become a staple in my fall to winter skincare routine. The pump is fun to use and produces the perfect amount of product, and it smoothes perfectly over my skin and sinks in wonderfully. I love the creamy texture, and my skin feels hydrated all day long. I use a small amount in the morning and lather it on at night, and it helps to combat dryness from over-exfoliation and colder weather. I highly recommend this moisturizer to anyone suffering from dryness or someone who wants a peptide-rich winter cream!

reviews.review_title: The moisturizer I have been looking for
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this as my birthday gift from Sephora. I have been looking for a new daily moisturizer and this is the one. I find the lotion to be hydrating without being heavy. The texture is nice and it goes on smooth. Typically I get breakouts from different products and this has not caused any blemishes or clogged pores. I have been using this in combination with other new products and I have noticed my fine lines have diminished and my skin appears more hydrated and healthy.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I like this product it has changed my skin. I use it at night a few times a week. It did not cause any breakouts however if I use it too often it makes my skin feel a little raw and sensitive. I noticed that my skin is smoother, more even, brighter and my fine lines are diminished. I have been using it for about three months. I am excited to try it over winter to see if it helps reduce dullness.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product at night time a couple times a week for a few months now. It is a nice moisturizer overall. I feel like the texture is a little heavy which is why I prefer it as a night cream. I do notice that my pores are clogged the next morning when I wake up after using it. I am interested to try this product over winter and see if it helps my skin out more than. I am unsure if I will repurchase this product, it depends on how it effects my winter skin.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is a nice product. I have been using it daily for a few months now. I noticed right away after I started using it that it did make my skin look more “plumped up”, helping diminish the appearance of some fine lines. I have been using it in combination with other new products recently so I am not sure what other effects it may have had on my skin alone. I will continue to use this product over winter when my skin gets really dry and dull and see how it helps me then.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is a nice product. I have been using it daily for a few months now. I noticed right away after I started using it that it did make my skin look more “plumped up”, helping diminish the appearance of some fine lines. I have been using it in combination with other new products recently so I am not sure what other effects it may have had on my skin alone. I will continue to use this product over winter when my skin gets really dry and dull and see how it helps me then.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I have used other facial oils which I thought were great until I tried this one. This product is amazing. The oil is the perfect texture and glides on my skin like butter.It absorbs in no time, giving my skin a healthy and moisturized glow rather than looking oily. I will continue to use this oil.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I received a sample for my birthday gift. I really enjoy this serum. It’s a different texture than my other serums but this baby adds an immediate glow to my skin. It’s my fav to use before makeup. However, I didn’t notice immediate improvement in my skin. You must use it consistently and you will love it.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: This is a very nice moisturizer, it goes on more like a gel.  It sinks into your skin quickly which is a good thing but the moisture seems to not last very long however I would re-purchase. I received this in my birthday gift from Sephora.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this facial moisturizer. It is lightweight cream with almost gel like qualities. It absorbed quickly into my skin and helped my skin feel very hydrated. It is my new morning go to because it doesn’t leave my face greasy for my long work day.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this facial moisturizer. It is lightweight cream with almost gel like qualities. It absorbed quickly into my skin and helped my skin feel very hydrated. It is my new morning go to because it doesn’t leave my face greasy for my long work day.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_title: I love the story behind the ingredients
reviews.review_text: First off, I received a sample compliments of Influenster. I was so excited to try the pure ingredients from an ancient land. The story of how these santorini grapes are grown and harvested is so interesting! And the results left me very satisfied. After a weeks use, my skin was smoother, more primed for makeup application, and hydrated. My skin feels softer and my pores are much less noticeable than before. I recommend this product! Texture is nice and smooth

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this moisturizer compliments of Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I am OBSESSED!! My skin has never looked better. I have used so many types of moisturizers. This one keeps my skin hydrated without being greasy or heavy. My skin GLOWS. I have already ordered. I can not be without it. I have dry skin. It has minimal scent and just melts and absorbs into my skin like a dream. It has made my skin texture overall more smooth. I love it!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I love the feeling of this product on my skin. It not only makes my skin feel refreshed and dewy, but it also smells amazing (citrusy)! Application is easy and you don’t have to wash it off so even better. I cant necessarily tell if its lightened anything on my skin, but iit makes my skin feel nice so it was a success for me! ** i recieved this product free for testing purposes**

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I quite like this lip gloss! I normally prefer lip products that dry down, but this one is actually quite nice. My lips feels more moisturized, I like the pinkish hue it adds and it isn’t too sticky. One downfall is that the product doesn’t stay on THAT long- it gradually fades away over 1.5 hours roughly. Overall, I enjoyed my experience with this product! **I received this product for reviewing and testing purposes **

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Amazing scent and love the feeling
reviews.review_text: Absolutely LOVED this lip mask. It was completely hydrating and made my skin feels amazing. Also, i’m obsessed with the grapefruit scent, smells very natural.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: ** I received this product free for testing and reviewing purposes **I loved how lightweight this oil is, as it doesnt feel like its clogging your pores. I use about 3-5 drops and it felt quite nice on my skin. Its moisturizing and is actually really nice as a hand/cuticle oil also. I know it’s supposed to be used on the face, but It can be multi-purpose. The smells is lovely but a tad strong for the face.Overall, this was a great, lightweight and beautifully scented oil that I would use again!

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: ** I received this product free for testing and reviewing purposes **I loved how lightweight this oil is, as it doesnt feel like its clogging your pores. reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Great little moisturizer for those who have dry skin! I liked the texture as it’s quite lightweight and doesn’t feel like it’s clogging up your pores. This made my skin feel refreshed! **I received this product for testing and reviewing purposes**

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Honestly, I have nothing but good things to say about this product. The scent pleasant, kind of with a very faint hint of lemon, and had a texture like vaseline. The product goes on smooth, and does make my lips feel very hydrated upon application and the next morning! **I received this product for testing and reviewing purposes**

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this product to test, and overall I would say it’s a decent moisturizer. I have dry skin and this was definitely not my favourite product out there for my skin personally. It applied easily, was a slightly thicker texture and absorbed into the skin rather quickly.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser feels so refreshing!! I use it in the morning and it just wakes up my skin!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser feels so refreshing!! I use it in the morning and it just wakes up my skin!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I have just started to really focus on skin care and a friend recommended this brand to me. I got their mini set with the cleanser, this serum, their mask and two moisturizers. I have noticed an instant glow in my skin using this serum. And it just adds even more of a flow to a moisturizer. I definitely will be repurchasing!!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: So far, I have to say this is probably the only Drunk Elephant product that I’ve tried so far that I haven’t much liked. I have normal to dry skin. And I found after using it my skin almost feels more dry. And my other products I use afterwards don’t feel as nice as they have when I’ve used other cleansers.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant to try this product especially since it only comes in full size. I tried the protini mini and really liked the product. But I also really wanted to give this one a try as it looked like it would be better for my skin type. Normal/dry and at times sensitive. I was told not to bother as it wasn’t anything special and to stick to the protini. I decided to purchase the full size of this and the protini and use one for day (protini) and this one for night as I heard it was a thicker texture. Now that I’ve had the chance to compare the two for a bit now. I can honestly say I really love this moisturizer. While it is a bit thicker and more rich then the protini I find, I just felt it really nourished my skin. I think this would definitely be perfect for during the day for the winter months as my skin is a bit more dry. Definitely glad I decided to try this out. Will be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Decided to give it another try!
reviews.review_text: I will admit I wasn’t a fan of this mask at first. I wasn’t really feeling the texture of this mask and the heavy greasy feeling I felt while it was on. It almost felt as tho it just was not absorbing into my skin. I came back to the reviews on this because I really couldn’t understand all the hype and maybe I was doing something wrong which I found that I was. Someone mentioned needing a very thin layer and not needing much product. While I was using a thick layer. So I decided to come back to it and try what this reviewer suggested. And it made a huge difference and felt a lot nicer. I also like to pair it with an oil as well such as the herbivore Phoenix oil and I find that to be a really beautiful mixture and my skin in the morning looks radiant even if i don’t get the proper amount of sleep that I should. It helps to disguise that.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_title: Decided to give it another try!

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I got this in part of the mini set that also included the CEO glow. I really like the texture of this serum, and I’m actually a fan of the smell. I find it gives me a nice glow, especially if I mix it with the CEO glow oil!

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I’m pretty picky about my moisturizers, so I made sure to sample before investing in the full size—and invest I did! This is now a staple in my skin care routine. It’s just-right consistency is smooth and creamy without being heavy. It just feels good going on your skin. Delivers hydration that lasts all day -- no tightness or dryness mid-day like I experience with some moisturizers. Love that it has the added benefits of adaptogens. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Amazing! Thick but blends well, and the green tint does neutralize redness. Love that it has SPF -- makes it my go-to “no makeup weekend“ moisturizer plus essential UV-blocking benefits.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Amazing! Thick but blends well, and the green tint does neutralize redness. Love that it has SPF -- makes it my go-to “no makeup weekend“ moisturizer plus essential UV-blocking benefits.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: An exceptional exfoliant that makes my dull, dry skin super soft and radiant immediately after use. And it’s not too potent for my sensitivity-prone skin. Seriously can’t beat the price: I’ve used products that are triple this price and deliver the same results.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Have re-purchased more times than I can count! Definitely one of the more effective-yet-affordable pre-cleansing makeup removers out there. Dissolves long-wear mascara, foundation, and eye liner without a lot of rubbing or fuss.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Have re-purchased more times than I can count! Definitely one of the more effective-yet-affordable pre-cleansing makeup removers out there. Dissolves long-wear mascara, foundation, and eye liner without a lot of rubbing or fuss.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: An Essential Serum for Healthy Skin
reviews.review_text: Incredible serum at an incredible price. Hydrates to plump and keep fine lines away ALL DAY. I even used this on some skin that was slightly irritated, red, and chapped, and it relieved the discomfort immediately. Will purchase again.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Have you ever tried a product and wondered how you went your entire life without it? Yeah, that was how I felt when I started using this serum. It will 100% be in my PM skincare routine from now on. First, the way it smells....OMG it’s amazing. My boyfriend even commented on how good my face smelt LOL.  It is definitely potent but not in a bad way at all! Second, the way it absolutely melted into my skin, wow I needed it. The texture is really nice and felt moisturizing on my dry skin. Overall, I am in love with this serum and highly recommend it to anyone!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Have you ever tried a product and wondered how you went your entire life without it? Yeah, that was how I felt when I started using this serum. Overall, I am in love with this serum and highly recommend it to anyone!!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Charlotte Tilbury products honestly never disappoint! This moisturizer cream has been perfect on my really dry winter skin. It feels thick but doesn’t leave your face feeling greasy or clogged. It also pairs really well with my makeup, probably the best cream I’ve used with makeup!! Overall, I highly recommend it to anyone with dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: This product is literally a GAME CHANGER. No seriously, it makes me so excited to do my skincare in the morning. I have always been bad about adding sunscreen to my skincare routine because I always felt like it was too heavy and clogged up my skin. This sunscreen is great because it feels like skincare and not just a heavy sun screen. Also, I loved the smell of it...its super subtle but a hint of watermelon.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Usually I don’t love the way lip color looks on my lips but I gave this one a try and WHOA. It’s such a beautiful color! It’s subtle but definitely a good pigmented color. Also, it’s really hydrating which I like. Overall, I’m really impressed! This product was gifted by Fresh but my own review.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Rarely will I ever try a product and immediately be like, “YUP this will now forever be in my routine“ but WOW this product I knew right away! It is buttery soft and feels so silky on my skin. Truly just blends right in. I have extremely dry skin, especially in the winter, and this has helped so much. 10/10!!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: It made me break out like crazy! I was so excited to try it. It seems like it works well for some, and others not so much.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: These smell amazing and work well! Nothing spectacular about them, as they’re very similar to ones you can buy from the drugstore\walmart\target, but still a great purchase.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: It truly is a Buffet for your skin. It has cleared up acne scars I’ve had from when I was a teenager. It makes my skin look so healthy. I ADORE this product. I’ve already repurchased it three times and I’m sure I still will for orders to come.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: Got this as a sample size and ended up loving it! I love how it makes my skin look & feel. Bought the full size almost right away. A plus: It smells amazing!

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_title: A lovely and refreshing face oil
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review!I was so excited to receive this in the mail because it targets dullness and uneven texture which I have a lot of. The little beads inside the bottle burst and create this refreshing experience when you apply it to the skin. It’s cooling all while being refreshing. My skin absorbed the moisture effortlessly and it gave my skin a really nice glow. I’m super satisfied with this oil and I’ll continue to use it. (Please note that this item is fragranced so if you’re not into scents in your skincare / are sensitive to fragrance in products pass on this.)

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this product from Influenster in exchange for an honest review. This is a lightweight gel moisturizer that has a cooling effect when applied. It reminds me of the glam glow hydra moisturizer. This would be fantastic for the summertime. It has next to no scent, and it made my skin feel baby smooth and soft.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Ahhhmazing!!! Hydrating and brightens up my acne scars!! It work great with her Exfolikate! I am writing this as part of a contest, but my reviews are all mine and honest!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster, but these opinions are mine. I like doing this moisturizer because it wasn’t super mattifying, but because I am a drier skin type, it’s a better primer for me. I would definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: I use this mask when I just need a skin refresher! I don’t usually see any amazing difference with texture, but it seems like there is almost a liveliness to my skin afterwards. I do tend to feel a little dry after so I load up on my serums, oils and moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I’m still trying this toner out, but I think I actually like it. It can be difficult to find a toner for a dry skin type that doesn’t dry us out even more. I feel that this toner gave me a little bit of hydration. I’m pleased. I received this complimentary, but opinions are mine.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I was a little surprised,for the better, by this product. I felt pretty hydrated and without a gross film on my face. I am a pretty dry skin type, and even though I liked this product, I don’t think it’s the best for DRY skin because of the gel texture. It didn’t give the the hydration I needed and maybe more suitable for normal or combo skin. I received this complimentary, but this is my own opinion.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: Pretty impressed! It’s a lightweight moisturizer that doesn’t dry me out despite having charcoal and salicylic acid in it. No major purges with it so far.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I have never been a fan of toners as most dried my skin out. I’m very pleased with Ole’s Glow2OH. I’ve used it at night for 2 weeks and can see a difference. My face feels smoother and there are less patchy red splotches and an overall healthy glow. If you are sensitive to scents you may want to pass. I love the scent and don’t find it overwhelming.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Excited to test this out as I received it from Influenster for free.. Initial impressions are I love the clean ingredients, has a pleasant scent, consistency is a little thinner than I’m used to, absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave an oily film. I’m going to use it daily and report back if the claims come through for my skin.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I used the mini size (perfect for testing and lasted a week+) and was skeptical I’d see results. I focused on the skin around my mouth as I’d noticed fine lines and irregular texture appearing. The product absorbed quickly with no residue; a few drops covered my face. At the end of the week I could see and feel a difference. My skin felt smoother and the fine frown lines were plumped up and not as noticeable. Definitely will add this to my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: First of all, I LOVE the built in applicator. It makes it so easy to apply product on such a sensitive area. I used my fingers to tap it into clean skin. I noticed improved moisture and will continue to use to see if there are any changes with fine lines. Still very happy with the product.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a few weeks and have found it quite moisturizing. It is thick and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feel. Granted, it’s winter in MN and my skin is super dry so it drinks it up. I haven’t noticed a change in fine lines, but my skin definitely feels moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a few weeks and have found it quite moisturizing. It is thick and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feel. Granted, it’s winter in MN and my skin is super dry so it drinks it up. I haven’t noticed a change in fine lines, but my skin definitely feels moisturized.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Normally my skin is combo/oily t zone, but at the first sign of a dry winter day it becomes extremely dry, flaky, and itchy. I’ve tried many thick creams and facial oils, but nothing worked. I picked up this moisturizer solely based on its claims to hydrate skin and I am SO GLAD that I did. It’s so lightweight and goes on smooth.  Within the first two days, the dry skin became supple and the itchiness was GONE. My makeup went on so smooth! I use it both day and night, although since my dry patches have cleared up, I’m now able to swap in my facial oils at night. I am oily/acne prone and this moisturizer did not cause any breakouts. I’ve never had a product work so well almost overnight. This moisturizer is definitely a keeper in my winter skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: SO happy I purchased this toner. I use it every other night after I wash my face. Has a nice mild citrusy scent. My acne scars have faded and no more breakouts! If I see a pimple forming, I apply some of this toner over it and it shrinks. I was worried this might make my skin dry in the winter time, but with daily moisturizing its completely fine! I’ve received comments about how smooth and glowy my skin looks and I credit this product. Also helps my makeup go on so much smoother. On my second bottle! Will definitely repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: SO happy I purchased this toner. I use it every other night after I wash my face. Has a nice mild citrusy scent. My acne scars have faded and no more breakouts! If I see a pimple forming, I apply some of this toner over it and it shrinks. I was worried this might make my skin dry in the winter time, but with daily moisturizing its completely fine! I’ve received comments about how smooth and glowy my skin looks and I credit this product. Also helps my makeup go on so much smoother. On my second bottle! Will definitely repurchase.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer seriously brought my skin back to life. Every winter I used to get dry itchy patches around my lips and chin. I tried lots of thick moisturizers, oils, Vaseline...nothing worked.  walked into Sephora one day and sampled many moisturizers. I’m so glad I picked this one. Within a week, the dry spots were gone and my skin was moisturized even on dry winter days!! It plays well under foundation. I normally have combo skin and don’t notice any extra oiliness from this moisturizer unless it is warm and humid out in which case I switch to aqua bomb.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this! It felt so soothing to apply to skin after cleansing. Nice fresh scent. No breakouts. Unfortunately it just didn’t make any noticeable difference for my skin.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Makes lips feel so supple. Helps lipstick application feel much smoother. I’ll note that it only made lips supple while the product was applied and had no effect on keeping them supple once product wears off. I got it as a gift, but wouldn’t personally spend this much on a lip balm. There’s much cheaper drugstore shoes available.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I bought this lip balm because I love the Laneige lip masks which I use nightly and I wanted something more portable for daytime use. This does not have the same thick consistency as the lip mask. It does a good job at moistening dry lips, but it fades very quickly and doesn’t hydrate them. My lips do feel nice while I have it on, but have to keep reapplying. I’ll finish up what I have, but won’t be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A lot of times, I’ve found splurge items aren’t really with it, but this one is worth the $! I have oily/combo skin and sometimes sensitivity around cheeks will lead to redness. This moisturizer is sooo soothing. It has a nice rich consistency without feeling greasy. It sinks in nicely and leaves skin looking so smooth and plump. My dehydrated skin loves how this moisturizer feels. For me, it’s perfect for the winter, but I think it’d be too heavy for summertime. If I had the $ and wanted to splurge on one item, this would be it.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is phenomenal! I have been lucky to test a number of skincare and beauty products through Influenster and this has been my favorite product of all the products I have tried. I have a bad tendency of judging products by their packaging and when I got this in the mail I wasn’t crazy about the packaging and assumed I wouldn’t like it. This I put it on my face and OH MY GOODNESS- it is so soft and has this cooling sensation when it’s spread across your skin. I AM OBSESSED and will for sure be buying more when I run out! Do yourself a favor and try this out!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I loved trying this product! It smells good and feels super smooth on your face. I love the idea of having something to put on my face overnight that will help give more moisture and promote healthier skin. My 10 year old daughter tried it at night too and loved it. :)

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I hate to just give 3 stars but I really couldn’t tell any significant difference in my skin from using this product. It didn’t have a great smell either. It DID feel good applied to face. And it’s a huge plus that it’s plant based. But I wasn’t very impressed. Still glad I got to test it.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this sunscreen! I love the smell and the texture when you put it on. It’s not too thick but the substance is thick enough to feel like you are getting good coverage. I have sensitive skin and rosacea so I was nervous about if I would have any reactions but I did not! I would definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this eye cream! It feels really good on and is the perfect amount of moisture.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: HOLY GRAIL! For starters I have sensitive combination very dry skin that is acne prone. THIS PRODUCT RIGHT HERE caters to all my skin needs. I put this over eye cream and face serum for my night time routine. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Very little goes a very long way! I love this makeup removing balm, it is easy on my sensitive acne prone very dry combination skin and leaves very little to no makeup on my face

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Very little goes a very long way! I love this makeup removing balm, it is easy on my sensitive acne prone very dry combination skin and leaves very little to no makeup on my face

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This lip mask is SUPERB!! Thanks to this lip sleeping mask my lips are super hydrated and no longer chapped. I also used on my 4 year old because no chapstick did enough and overnight my child’s lips were completely fixed with no more dry patches and no more peeled lips! MIRACLE LIP MASK

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this cream! I love the dewy mist already so I had high expectations for this cream and my expectations were surpassed. This cream is the perfect amount of hydration, dewyness, and protection. I used to use the Silk Cream plus sunblock plus the Dewy Skin Mist, but now I only need this Dewy Skin Cream and sunblock alone! I love this. My skin is dry, sensitive, I have mild rosacea and this cream did not affect my skin in any negative way. I immediately noticed the natural (LIT FROM WITHIN) dewyness this cream brings! I love it. Great addition to my morning routine.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I recently added this amazing serum to my night routine. I apply this serum after the essence and before applying the Silk Cream (i have super dry skin and winter isnt helping). I love this serum i have noticed a drastic change in my skin, in my old acne scars/marks, and sun spots. Definitely a great addition to sensitive skin night time routine. It is hydrating and does NOT sting.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: A night serum that made the difference in my skin
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this serum. This serum has helped with the texture on my skin like no other!!! I mix it with my nightly DE moisturizer and couldn’t be more pleased. I get so many compliments on my skin now. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: A little goes a long way!
reviews.review_text: This is such gentle cleanser! Soaps and suds aren’t necessary; with a cleanser like this, you can feel the clean! I use a pea size amount every night to cleanse my face after a long workout. It is a staple in my skincare routine! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This products leaves my skin so moisturized and plump! one pump of this product is enough for my entire face and neck. I’ve never gotten so many compliments on my skin. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_title: Does the job- a bit pricey for little product
reviews.review_text: This lip balm is very moisturizing although you don’t get as much product as I think you should for the price. I use this as a finishing touch in my morning and night skincare routine. There is no fragrance which I love! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Hydrating and refreshing! The fine lines I used to see around my eyes have seemingly vanished. There was one specific time that I used this and my eye burned and I had to rinse. I believe one pump is too much product for me so I pump 3/4 of 1 pump. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This lip mask was recommended to me by my cousin and I can definitely say it works. My lips during the winter season would have cracks and after using this product about 2-3 times a week, I noticed my lips becoming moisturized. Will buy this again.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: This is a great charcoal face mask! The first time I used it, I only used a little amount and found that the product did not have its full effect. In order to see the results, consistency and the amount used is key. I found that making sure to cover the face fully and have a thicker layer was the best way to use this product. I used maybe a Canadian quarter or thumb size amount all over my face to see results. As for consistency, I use this product twice a week.This product has a coal smell to it and is a grey colour. At first, it can have a light sting but once it dries up, you can feel the firmness of the mask and the sting goes away. It is a bit hard to get off so I would recommend using a gentle towel or wiping off in the shower. The after feeling is amazing and my pimples are noticeably smaller. I would recommend the full size product but if you’re still unsure, a great option is to get the smaller version in the best sellers kit with all origins product for a cheaper price to try it out. This is how I found my liking in this mask and I would recommend to my family and friends too.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: This is my go-to after a long day out. My first impression did not disappoint. It has a minty smell with a pearl white look. A little bit of this product goes a long way. You can customize it to become more foamier by adding more water but if you’re like me and want a gentle cleanse, add just a touch of water. I think this product works best alone and/or with the other products on the line as I have done variety of ways and found that this product works with my combination skin type. There is no residue or irritation afterwards - just a fresh face. I would highly recommend this product in full size and if you’re still unsure, I would suggest getting the smaller version with the other products first to trial it out for a better price.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: My first impression and review on Farmacy Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm. I was wearing a full face of makeup and trying this line for the first time. -colour is a minty green, smells fresh, a balmy texture that melts in hands-when putting it on, I noticed it almost felt like applying a light oil to my face. The texture from balmy to oil look helped me see that my makeup was being removed properly. -When rinsing my face, there was a pleasant cool and refreshed feeling from the product. -after patting down dry, my skin felt clean and I can see that I did not have to go in a second time as the first application really took off my makeup well. -No irritation to my combination skin. Overall, very content with this product and I will definitely be purchasing this in a larger size. For the price point, I think it is worth it, especially if you want a product that is gentle with your skin when removing makeup.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my first time trying an Ole Henriksen product. After using a full bottle, I have now purchased a second one. Here’s why:-I have combination skin so I’ve been looking for a product that combats the dryness in some areas without making my face look oily at the end of the day. I also had some dark spots from scarring of pimples from wearing masks. This product definitely catered to my needs.-The formula feels like a gel but it glides on smoothly without the feeling of “too much product” or stickiness. The scent is refreshing and similar to orange candy. -I do see an “instant glow” as my skin looks rejuvenated. Over time of using this bottle, I’ve noticed that it’s become by daily go to and can be used as a primer under makeup looks. -I haven’t had any problems with irritation to the skin with this product which is great. Overall from my experience, I would recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was gifted Goop Beauty’s goop glow exfoliator and it did not disappoint! This smells great and is an awesome exfoliator! I have sensitive skin and it did not irritate my skin at all and left my face so smooth! Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is far far far from being sheer!!!! It definitely leaves a white cast. I really enjoy that it is fragrance and essential oil free, so I will repurchase it. It feels great on the skin and does not break me out. I appreciate that. But just a disclaimer that on colored skin (I am on the fair side of olive toned Indian skin tone) this definitely looks like sunscreen. But I personally don’t mind it as I can apply a tinted moisturizer and cover it up.  The protection is what I care about. And this does the job for that.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: This is an effective micellar water. I don’t wear too much makeup on a daily basis and this is a great first cleanse. reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster. It has good spf rating, safe ingredients for skin and planet. reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I got this complimentary from Influenster to test out. This has good spf rating and safe ingredients but the texture is so gritty and dry. reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: The Caudalie Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum has shrunken my large pores. I’ve been using this serum for 2wks consistently and I have seened a difference. The formula does not leave my skin tacky. I put mines in my skin fridge so when applied it has a cooling sensation. My skin has been looking smooth and healthier. What’s also been helping my skin is using the Caudaline cleanser and moisturizer. I recommend everyone trying this set. #freeproduct #tryitwithtopbox

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: After using the Sunday Riley good genes there was a difference in my skin texture. My skin gets very dry and patchy in the winter months so I tend to use physical exfoliaters but after applying this serum, my skin felt so smooth! I did felt some stinging and tingling so I used it as a mask for a couple of minutes.This exfoliator got rid of the dead skin cells that was on top of my skin and I saw a difference in my pores, they looked cleaner and smaller. It definitely left a glow in my skin and my face felt plumper. This is a product that I have to keep using consistently in order to see some clarity in my skin. I have sensitive skin so using as a mask at first is the best choice right now for me then as time goes I can eventually begin using it for overnight masking.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: The SK-II Facial Treatment Essence was gentle on my skin. It gave my skin the moisture back that was taken away from using the SK-II Facial Treatment Cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: The SK-II Facial Treatment Essence was gentle on my skin. It gave my skin the moisture back that was taken away from using the SK-II Facial Treatment Cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: The OriginsGINZING™ VITAMIN C EYE CREAM TO BRIGHTEN AND DEPUFF is amazing! It really does work for depuffing my eyes in the mornings. I like how there’s two shades to work for different skintones and I do a difference in the brightness under my eyes!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: It confidence in a cream moisturizer supercharged
reviews.review_text: •Lightweight•Non greasy•Hydrating•Safe on sensitive skin•Slight scent•Double the ingredients •Plumping •Slight reduction on my wrinkles•Did not see any difference on my pores for the amount of time using it. (2 1/2 weeks)

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Keeps my eyes looking youthful and healthy
reviews.review_text: I love this eye cream by Shiseido. It’s brought vitality and life back to my eyes. I’ve been using it only for a week and my eyes have been looking smoother and more moisturized. The cream isn’t super heavy and neither is it too light. Some eye creams can be too oily or too watery in consistency but not this one. It’s literally the perfect consistency and super creamy. I use it every morning and night and it’s great for using it by itself or for blending into my concealer. It has a very pleasant light smell and not too perfumey. I love the glass jar it comes in, it adds to the richness of the product.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: Farmacy gifted me this amazing face cream and I’m in love! This new face cream is a skin quenching, gel like moisturizer that works great for combination and oily skin types. It does an amazing job at hydrating my skin while helping to create a balanced texture. I love the fact that it’s vegan, cruelty free, silicone free, and alcohol free so it never dries out my skin. It has a hyaluronic acid which helps with hydration, moringa and papaya which helps to reduce shine and clear my pores. I like to use this morning and night after washing my face and it has a very pleasant minty smell which invigorates my senses and creates a great start to my day. I love the glass jar that it’s packaged in and it makes a wonderful addition to my skincare routine! Highly recommend and will be buying again!

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. I absolutely love the sunblock! It has a light weight but creamy formula and it completely absorbed into my skin without leaving a greasy residue or feeling too heavy. I like to wear this every morning before I put on my make up for work. It does a great job of protecting my skin and it also adds a bit of moisture. Love this so much!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this Good Genes serum complimentary from Sunday Riley and I am so amazed by the short term results! I have been trying to find a serum that would work good for my combination skin type and won’t dry me out. This not only offers moisture and anti-aging benefits, but the overall tone and complexion of my skin has improved and just a matter of a few days. It has adorable packaging and I love the fact that their products are heavily scented and don’t contain any bad ingredients.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask gives a double duty for all skincare lovers out there. I honestly don’t like doing a lot of facemasks, because I hate all the steps are involved and the rinsing it off afterwards. This mask has proved to be different! It’s lightweight and non-greasy, but still very moisturizing and has a thick consistency. I love that it also doubles as a moisturizer so you can just rub it in afterwards!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I fell in love with this the second I saw it - the ingredient list and the cute glass packaging drew me right in! I tend to go for a lot of skin barrier replenishing products because I am sensitive/dry so I got this to help combat my chronic redness. This is a lightweight, milky serum that smells faintly of cucumber melon, you just need one pump to cover your whole face. It feels silky going on and the tacky feeling dries down quickly. This is really hydrating, it feels soothing and this has greatly reduced my redness! My skin looks more toned, even and I don’t need to wear as much foundation to cover redness, which is a win in my book. The product needs a little time to see results, but this really works in terms of deep hydration and reducing redness. I’ve seen more results with this than I have with other skin-barrier rebuilding products which has made me pretty happy. If I could change a few things, it would be the amount of fragrance since it’s rather strong, and the price! It’s $42 for only one fluid ounce, and if you use it morning and night like the brand recommends, you will go right through the bottle and that can get costly. If you have the budget for it, I highly recommend giving this product a try. I know I’ll be re-buying one this product runs out.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a beautiful product! The frosted glass packing feels heavy and luxe, and will look stunning on a vanity. The thick cream spreads easily but takes a minute to fully sink in. The formula contains several kinds of hyaluronic acids which leaves my extra dry skin super hydrated and soothed, but after a while the Rose scent starts to get annoying as it never fully fades away. Since this cream is so thick it would be perfect for dry or combo skin but I can see this being too heavy for oily or acne prone skin. Overall I liked this cream but couldn’t love it due to the strong scent.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Sunday Riley 5 Stars Retinoid + Niacinamide Eye Se
reviews.review_text: I have never been picky with eye creams until now. This Sunday Riley eye creamis expensive but it’s worth the price tag. The blue holographic packaging is beautiful, and the heavy ceramic applicator is so luxe. The formula itself smells like chemicals, but it fades quickly. The gel like formula feels cooling and is so hydrating I can only use it at night, this will make foundation or concealer shift. The ingredients list is a absolute powerhouse, packed with 6% Retinol blend to firm and smooth lines, Niacinamide for anti-aging, Ceramides to hydrate, and centella to reduce irritation. It’s too soon to see line smoothing yet, but my eye area feels super hydrated and looks fresher, which is a positive sign. I feel like with further use I’ll see an improvement on my crows feet (I’m 34) and dark circles. I really like this eye cream so far and I’m looking forward to seeing the results I get from it.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Glow Recipe Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturize
reviews.review_text: This was such a fun product to try! The packing is adorable and you can buy refillable pods for this, which I absolutely adore. The formula is a nice, plush gel cream that’s best for combo skin. It sinks in nicely and leaves skin with a nice “plump” that makes applying makeup easy. It’s not heavy enough to be my winter moisturizer but it’s great for everyday when you want a little added moisture boost. It gives me a nice glow that makes me look healthy without being greasy.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Glow Recipe Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturize
reviews.review_text: This was such a fun product to try! The packing is adorable and you can buy refillable pods for this, which I absolutely adore. The formula is a nice, plush gel cream that’s best for combo skin. It sinks in nicely and leaves skin with a nice “plump” that makes applying makeup easy. It’s not heavy enough to be my winter moisturizer but it’s great for everyday when you want a little added moisture boost. It gives me a nice glow that makes me look healthy without being greasy.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: This was gifted by the company. I love this fun little stick. It’s packed with Glycerin and squalane to keep your eye area from drying out, and the retinol in it is potent, I’m only able to use it about once a week to avoid irritating my eyes. This has made my under eye area a lot smoother, my fine lines look a little less prominent, and I even like to use it on my lips for my lip line. I heard that they came out with a face stick for this, and I plan on buying that as well. I love how it’s compact and can travel as well!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’m a years long fan of Fresh lip balms, and the classic Rosé shade is my favorite. This is extremely similar to the original formula that I love, which is a creamy, buttery balm that’s non sticky. It’s worth nothing it doesn’t last long but reapplying is a pleasure. This has a very light lemon sugar scent, but I prefer the original scent more. As much as I love this lip balm, the fact that they removed the SPF 15 is a huge drawback for me; it’s one of the best reasons I’ve liked them. I used to wear this all the time during the day but I’ll need to switch now, which is a bummer. The formula and packaging of this lip balm can’t be beat, but the lack of SPF is truly a big deal for me. I won’t repurchase when this is done.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: It’s really nice! It has a really soft texture, softer than you might have expected. This is perfect for sensitive skin, although I’ve used it on break out skin without any issues. It makes my skin so soft and clean, but I took one star off because of the price.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: It’s really nice! It has a really soft texture, softer than you might have expected. This is perfect for sensitive skin, although I’ve used it on break out skin without any issues. It makes my skin so soft and clean, but I took one star off because of the price.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great product. It gets all the makeup as well as any other dirt, but the best part is the smell. Its sweet. My skin feels great after I’m done washing it. I really enjoyed it. I received it for free from Influenster’s in return for my honest review

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I most absolutely love this product. It has certainly made my skin look youthful and radiant. It doesnt feel greasy or heavy on the skin. I highly recommend it!!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I really like this sun block. From the smell to the texture of the lotion, its all wonderful. Its not heavy or greasy. I have been wearing it under my makeup every day and it has not clogged my pores. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This stick is great! I love the size. Its not greasy and it fits perfect in my purse for when I know I will need to reapply. The smell is pleasant and it did not clog my pores. A definite need!!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: This serum is amazing. It leaves your skin looking and feeling as if you are getting younger instead of older. My skin is vibrant and soft. Its never looked so good. This is a fabulous product. I highly recommend it. I was given the opportunity to test this product for free in return of my honest review from Influencers and Clarins.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: For starters the package is stunning and the quality looks great! I like the consistency of the cream, it’s not too heavy and it left my skin feeling hydrated.  Overall I think it’s a good moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I live in LA so daily SPF is a high priority and I love that this Watermelon Glow Niacinamide sunscreen has an SPF of 50. The product is super easy to blend and doesn’t leave a white cast! It leaves my skin feeling super hydrated and glowy. New favorite!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I recently got the new Glowscreen SPF 40- Golden Hour  from Supergoop and the glow is no joke. This sunscreen applies smoothly and blends into my skin nicely. Its great for summer when my skin is tan.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love using this new Fresh Tea Elixir Skin Resilience Activating Serum so much! The texture absorbs straight into my skin and feels so lovely. It also pairs well with the rest of my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I got to sample this daily microfoliant complimentary from Dermalogica.  The product comes in powder form and when mixed with water turns into a lovely cleanser that doesn’t leave my skin feeling stripped but smooth and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I got to sample this daily microfoliant complimentary from Dermalogica.  The product comes in powder form and when mixed with water turns into a lovely cleanser that doesn’t leave my skin feeling stripped but smooth and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Very gentle and soft cleanser. Amazing for sensitive skin and I love the scent! Very soothing.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Fantastic general cleanser! Very easy to work with and great for sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: Great mask! Definitely helps clear up acne and refresh skin!

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: The best moisturizer I have ever used. HG status and I’ve tried just about everything. Smells amazing and wakes me right up. Does not feel too heavy on my combo skin but still hydrates. LOVE LOVE LOVE.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Pricey for a Lip Balm but works really nicely! Feels great on the lips. Scent is really strong but overall pleasant.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Average. Works fine as moisturizer but not really as a primer. Not crazy about the smell (smells like artificial coconut) and doesn’t seem to do anything for my makeup

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: Awesome exfoliating mask! Smells great too and really clears away dead skin! Skin will feel so soft after.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great cleanser, doesn’t strip the skin or feel right after washing it off. I like the more natural approach to skin care and feel this does a great job. I adore Korres and this does not disappoint! I received a sample size of this complimentary but my review is 100% mine!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: This is super lightweight, milk consistency. It has a very slight tint when you pump it out but it blends easily on skin  and feels smoothing. There is a slight scent but it goes away after you apply. It’s a perfumey-sweet scent. This is supposed to transform your skin after 7 days. I only am 3 days in and am loving it. This is high up in price point but it is more than a primer. It’s primer infused with high end skincare ingredients. I am hoping this helps with the dull appearance my skin has. I love that this is refillable packaging. Not many brands are offering something like this. I received this complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: Great product, easy to use. Clarins is a great brand and you know you’re getting a good product. While the sample I received was nice, I can’t speak to any long term results. I would have to purchase a full size. This serum was light and didn’t break me out.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Pretty good so far! I received this from Influenster for my review. It’s lightweight which is great for my combo skin. I can’t speak to long term results yet but so far so good!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This is by far the lightest texture of sunscreen I have ever used. It’s serum-y and blends into the skin flawlessly. I look forward to using this in the summer as it is so lightweight and blendable. It has a fresh scent that goes away after you put it on. Really liking this!! No white cast either!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This is a great lightweight sunscreen. It is a creamy texture that melts into the skin. Very light scent, nothing too overpowering. I will have to see how long term results are but my skin doesn’t feel dry or irritated from this. Blends easily! It is a white cream but blends out no issue

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: I have been using ORIGINS Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask for about 3 months now. It leaves my skin feeling clean and bright. I am looking forward to using this during Summer as that is when my pores tend to get really clogged. If it works this well even during those Summer months, then we have a winner.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I have acne prone combination oily skin and I appreciate any product that does not break me out. The Origins face wash leaves my face feeling clean and has not caused a break out. So, it is a winner in my book. Although, since it leaves my skin feeling somewhat dry afterwards, I would not use it during winter. For summertime, it does a fine job.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have acne-prone, combination skin. This didn’t break me out, which is great. Other wise, it was okay. It didn’t exactly feel ’moisturizing’ per se. Neither good, nor bad.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: It cleansed without drying out my skin. Plus, I loved its texture. Nice cleanser.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I am on my second bottle now as I am not getting any younger and I  really wanted to add an oil to my skin care routine before age-related dryness sets in. I have acne-prone skin. This doesn’t break me out, which is always a plus. However, I don’t see any changes to my skin. Overall, it’s neither good nor bad in my book.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: - a súper hydrating gel cream with a light weight and cooling feel on the skin. Left my skin hydrated without feeling heavy. I used the whole travel size sample that was sent for testing and review purposes from @influester I used at night for almost a month. I loved the light almost unscented smell, my skin felt smooth, soft and bounces. The most noticeable changes were the brightness and glow to my skin, it also helped with my texture and pore appearance. I used it a couple of times before applying makeup and I didn’t need a primer, it was absorbed really fast, the base application was smooth and my skin looked flawless.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Believe the hype, this creme by La Mer is a luxurious and rich cream that will hydrate and plump your dehydrated skin. Your skin will feel so moisturized without a heavy feeling or greasy. I recommend if you have combination skin like mine, apply by dabbing in your dryer areas first and the rest on the rest of your face and neck.  A little goes a long way, I used the recommend pea size and warmed it up first until it becomes clear, then you press it on your face and neck. If you feel is too heavy for you during the day use it at night and you’ll wake up to a softer, hydrated and plump looking skin! I noticed the redness faded away within the first week using it! My dry areas appreciated the amazing benefits of this creme, I’m in Love!

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Believe the hype, this creme by La Mer is a luxurious and rich cream that will hydrate and plump your dehydrated skin.
