reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: The True Cream Aqua Bomb Is so lightweight and airy, literally like applying water on your face. Refreshing, hydrating and absorbs so quick, you can instantly feel the moisturizing effects.  I truly enjoyed the experience of trying the light texture and cooling effect of that cream on my skin, it felt soft and plumped afterwards without feeling heavy and a little goes a long way! It felt amazing on my combination skin, the dry areas had a blast while the oily areas enjoyed the hydration without the greasy ness some other heavy moisturizer leaves behind. I didn’t notice oil either after several hours of wear! That’s a win for me!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: C-Firma Fresh Day SerumI’d like to begin this review by emphasizing how much I loved mixing this myself, that way you get a “fresh” batch of this powerful 15% vitamin C, maximizing the potency and hence the benefits! This is a big plus since vitamin c tends to oxidizes and degrades faster than most acids. Now, I’d like to review the effect on my skin: at first the consistency is that of a serum, lightweight and absorbs fast, it didn’t feel sticky. My skin felt refreshed, and it within first week I noticed a change in my skin texture. Minimized the size of my pores (a huge deal for me!!!) and loved how bright and even made it look… I’m on the end of my 3rd week and I love the results! I’d definitely keep this as a staple and part of my beauty routine!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Lightweight, daily oil-free sunscreen protects against harmful UV rays, hydrates skin, and doubles as a face primer. I found this sunscreen to be an essential, especially for days you don’t want to wear any makeup on. It had a nice coverage, with an almost matte soft focus filter effect, that it blurred your pores. I loved the fact that it did not leave a white cast on your face. With makeup on top it had a good grip which made the foundation apply evenly and had a beautiful healthy satin finish. I would recommend this for normal, combination and oily skin!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Daily, dewy moisturizing sunscreen protects skin against harmful UV rays and maintains skin’s moisture for 12 hours.This one is more for a dewy finish, it left a beautiful fresh and dewy look to my face! I can truly say this would be ideal for more normal to dry skin types, as I felt in my oily areas (im combination skin) a little too moisturizing making it accentuate my pores. I have to say though that it even though it was really moisturizing it is not greasy, it has a radiant plumping effect. I love the scent too, it is not too overwhelming!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Skinfix. Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Cream is amazing. I have nothing bad to say about it. My skin has never felt better. The smell isn’t bad and the feeling is great.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Skinfix. Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Cream is amazing. I have nothing bad to say about it. My skin has never felt better. The smell isn’t bad and the feeling is great.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: The Shiseido Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ is an amazing sunscreen. Its went on so smooth and felt so nice. The smell is very pleasant and it looks so good on my skin. Compared to other sunscreens this one seemed to last longer on my skin and not dry so fast. I love it and will definitely being buying more.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer Reformulation is amazing. The way it makes my face feel so fresh and smooth. It really helped keep my face moisturized. If you have dryness, this product is for you.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: The Estée LauderAdvanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream was an amazing addition to my skincare. It has helped my eyes so much and I’m in love. The smell isn’t strong and goes on so well. I would totally recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Dermalogica gifted me Dermalogica Sampling. It was enjoyable to try. It really seems like it helped alot of my skin issues. I noticed my skin was more hydrated and soft. It is very easy to use and I would totally recommend this product

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Dermalogica gifted me Dermalogica Sampling. It was enjoyable to try. It really seems like it helped alot of my skin issues. I noticed my skin was more hydrated and soft. It is very easy to use and I would totally recommend this product

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I like the formula and applicator quite much. Light weight but moisturizes my under eye and surrounding eye area well. Giving it 4 stars because I am still testing out how it treats my dark circles and lines, so far, not too bad. The price is also very reasonable, especially for an eye cream.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen took me by surprise. I was on the hunt for something I could wear everyday and sometimes under my makeup, this fits both the criteria well. No white cast, and I would not call it greasy really (I have combination skin, aligning more towards the oily side). It is just moisturizing enough for me and also light. Convenient to put in your purse too and reapplication.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: In my experience, two in one (or more) products haven’t worked all that well but this one is so unique! I have combination skin and this is great for me in winter especially. I was looking for a new toner but was happy to find something, which if you layer up (2-3 extra drops) doubles as a nice, light moisturizer and it keeps my winter dry face areas hydrated. Also can be awesome for sometimes lazy people with their skincare routines (a.k.a. me, lol).

reviews.product_name: Mini Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wanted to lovee this product. It doesn’t really do much when or after I apply it. I don’t mind scented or unscented products but when you first apply this, you get just a tiny hint of blueberry and are left wondering about the smell, it seems to fly away too quickly. The consistency isn’t my favorite too. A bit disappointed but thankfully I bought the mini to try it out first. We all have different skin so it could work for someone else but it just didn’t work for me, unfortunately.

reviews.product_name: Mini Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I can be picky about the exfoliating face washes I purchase and use but I absolutely love this one! JUST the right amount of exfoliation feel on this product for me and it smells so fresh & light. Face doesn’t feel dry after I wash it off like some similar products make my skin feel like! Have been enjoying using this since last winter.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: Starting from the formulation, look of the toner and smell to the packaging and aesthetics, this one is a winner in my books! I bought the small size to try it out and I am planning on getting the full size since I am almost out of the present bottle. I don’t use toner regularly but this product made me look forward to including toner in my skincare routine more. I have combination skin and it’s hydrating so a little goes a long-ish way.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: So far, I like this. It’s a transparent liquid so no chance of leaving a white cast. Formula is satisfying. The bottle is convenient to put in your purse if you’re on the go. I mainly use it for my face and neck. I have combination skin and do get more oily during the summer months, so, if you’re oily, I would be a little careful since it does get “decently” oily on your skin if you apply even just a tad more. Thus, one less star.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: As someone with combination skin who prefers her toner to be slightly more on the hydrating side, I look forward to using this despite not being the biggest toner person. The aesthetics of this product are a solid 10/10 and if you enjoy rose scented anything, you would like this (though the smell can be a bit too strong but I still like it). I feel like it really helps clean up any remaining makeup from my face and especially my neck after using a cleansing balm if I have any left. Initially got the smaller size to try but ran through that very quick so upsized as soon as I could!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: It makes the routine feel complete and I absolutely LOVE the results. My skin is brighter and looks all around better ◡̈

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: It makes the routine feel complete and I absolutely LOVE the results. My skin is brighter and looks all around better ◡̈

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: SO obsessed. I love the smell and the results of this serum. I have only really ever used samples of face/brightening serums and they were never great enough for me to want to use regularly. I LOVE how this makes my skin feel and look ◡̈

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: Good product! I love the look of the bottle and really like how my skin feels post facial. The only drawback is the how the product feels when applying/drying on the skin. The product is very sticky and does not really “dry” on your skin. When rubbing it into my skin, the formula was stringy when taking my fingers off of my face. Overall - great results!! I received this product for free for testing purposes

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Let me begin by saying that I LOVE THESE PRODUCTS! After purchasing yellow facial moisturizer in a square bottle from department stores since I was a teenager, and occasionally trying high-end products from drug stores, I was skeptical about trying yet another face moisturizer but am wowed with the results of these 3 products! The Lotus Youth Preserve Moisturizer has a light, pleasant scent and goes on smoothly, keeping my face looking clean and fresh throughout the day. It is not greasy or heavy, but makes a big impact on my skin. I’ve received several compliments about how good my skin looks since I started using these products 2 months ago. I feel the difference and see it every time I look in the mirror. I really enjoy the Lotus Youth Preserve Dream Face Cream and the combination of using these 3 products daily has rejuvenated my facial skin and gives me a younger appearance, and at 61 years old, I never thought this was possible. These products are now part of my daily routine, and they have a permanent place on my bathroom counter.I received this product as a free sample.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was testing the ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer as part of a contestant I gotta say it’s pretty nice a little out of my price range but I will definitely use the whole sample

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for testing purposes. I have been using this toner for weeks now along with the Belif Aqua Bomb True Cream morning and night, and i must say that this duo is really a holy grail! This toner is water-based with lightweight formula. It gives extra boost and hydration to my skin leaving it softer, smoother and calmer! This toner really does and amazing job! Highly recommended, you can never go wrong!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for testing purposes. First of, i love the packaging, it’s cute and compact! The consistency is also really nice, not too thick and not too runny! It Absorbs quickly with no greasy feeling. The smell is not an issue either, it is light-scented & smells so refreshing! It also makes skin soft and smooth and is perfect as hydrating primer under makeup! I have been using this cream for weeks now along with the Belif Aqua Bomb Hydrating toner and i must say that this duo is really a holy grail!

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: This clay mask is easy to apply and to wash off. Its nice that it has no overpowering smell. It has no tingly or tightening feeling, it feels so comfortable on face. I love how it leaves my skin clean, soft and fresh after use. It does not irritates or dry out my skin either.  #freeproducts

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a free sample and used it for a week. The consistency is gel like, it is not too runny and not too thick. It is easily absorbs by the skin, making it hydrating, soft and smooth with no greasy feeling. I love that this moisturizer is fragrance free.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sachet sample in exchange to my honest review. #freeproductWrinkle correction result is really hard to tell since the sachet only last for 2-3days of use. But, What I love about this product is that it is non irritating. It is gentle and perfect in eye area. The consistency is a bit heavy but it absorbs quickly and is not greasy.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: Hi received a free sample ( #freeproduct) in exchange for my honest review. I do have dry skin and this is a good moisturizer for my skin type. It does not have any greasy feeling and no overpowering smell. It glides on skin smooth ly and absorbs quickly. However, I cannot share any experience with wrinkle reduction as the sample only last for few days to a week. Overall, as a moisturizer I still like clinique brand.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a sachet sample of this serum in t for my honest review. This serum is hydrating and gentle on skin. It is lightweight and no greasy feeling, no irritation and makes skin smooth and soft. Can’t say anything about the wrinkle reduction result.   #freeproduct

reviews.review_text: great for controlling oil, preventing acne, and brightening the skin & scars. not to mention it’s both cheap and highly effective.

reviews.review_text: i was lowkey expecting this to be purple-colored but it’s clear, and i’m kind of happy with that. if you want a purple gloss, this isn’t it, but if u like grape, this is good

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: not as good as the lip sleeping mask, but it mimics that mirrored lip effect and has a nice tint to it. the flavor is even stronger which i loves.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: truly resurfaces the skin, makes you feel baby smooth, and gives you a glow. make sure to use SPF during the day if you use this product, though!!

reviews.review_title: good, but expensive and causes milia
reviews.review_text: i love this. it’s super hydrating and pretty much free of irritants. it loses a star because it’s so expensive, when something like vaseline works better (even though it doesn’t look as good in the mirror bc it’s shiny) and causes a lot of milia in my mom.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_title: love scent and gentle but overpriced
reviews.review_text: good gentle cleaner, but the AHA exfoliation claims i didn’t notice in my skin. i may repurchase for the scent, but it’s not worth the price

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this as a complimentary from Glow Recipe.  I’m in my late-30s and started to notice that my skin isn’t as firm or plump as it used to be. This is super effective in keeping my skin hydrated and bouncier. My skin just feels more tight - in a good way. It does feel a bit sticky at first but once applied, it absorbs well. Also, I’m super impressed with the ingredients - hyaluronic acids, plum and vegan collagen and silk proteins. Worth trying and deciding for yourself it the product is for you.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m loving this moisturizer so much! Everything from the green packaging to the color and scent of the cream, they nailed it again. Its creamy yet lightweight and applies smoothly. It absorbs quickly without any greasiness or stickiness, which I love. It contains two of my favorite ingredients - PHA and hyaluronic acid to provide deep and long-lasting hydration. My skin looks and feels healthy, hydrated and dewy. I prefer this in the morning.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m loving this moisturizer so much! Everything from the green packaging to the color and scent of the cream, they nailed it again. Its creamy yet lightweight and applies smoothly. It absorbs quickly without any greasiness or stickiness, which I love. It contains two of my favorite ingredients - PHA and hyaluronic acid to provide deep and long-lasting hydration. My skin looks and feels healthy, hydrated and dewy. I prefer this in the morning.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: What a sensory overload! This is a beautiful cream that clams and hydrates skin overnight. The texture is buttery and rich yet it blends smoothly and not at all greasy or heavy. The cold weather can dry and irritate skin and this gives my skin the opportunity to reset and heal overnight. I wake up to a soft, soothed and hydrated skin. They always do a good job of providing an incredible sensory experience, especially their scent.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: First of all, the color of the bottle is so soothing and I’m enjoying it on my vanity. The serum is very lightweight and plush and absorbs quickly. My skin is immediately hydrated and feels velvety soft. The more you use it, the better your skin becomes and my skin has never been healthier or plumper. I love that it also improves my skin barrier overtime. Love the innovative adaptive phytocompound tea (APT) technology, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. It does have strong tea scent that lingers but eventually fades so doesn’t bother me.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this on and off for many years now and I love it, along with the entire Liquid Collagen line! It is on a higher price-point but it’s totally worth it. Love how velvety and plush it feels and it makes my skin look and feel so supple, healthy, plump and glowy. Its unique vegan collagen formula works well for my skin. It also contains alguronic acid & microalgae oil and it works in synergy with the vegan collagen. I love using this both in the morning and evening and it works well under makeup. Keeps my skin well hydrated all day. I appreciate the new pump packaging!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using their retinol line on and off for many years now and always had a wonderful experience and result. The serum is one of my favorites from this line. It’s so effective yet gentle since it contains flower extract and hyaluronic acid. I’ve experienced zero negative side effects and skin always looks and feels hydrated, plump and smooth. I prefer to use it in the evening so I can layer on thicker cream on top.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using their retinol line on and off for many years now and always had a wonderful experience and result. The serum is one of my favorites from this line. It’s so effective yet gentle since it contains flower extract and hyaluronic acid. I’ve experienced zero negative side effects and skin always looks and feels hydrated, plump and smooth. I prefer to use it in the evening so I can layer on thicker cream on top.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: One of my favorite vitamin c serums! It’s on a pricier side but it’s well worth it because you are paying for high-quality and effective ingredients. Besides the15% vitamin C, it also contains loads of antioxidants, essential nutrients & fruit enzymes. So it is a well-rounded serum that also hydrates and nourishes my skin. It’s very lightweight & not sticky so perfect for morning use. My skin looks brighter and fresh.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: Obsessed! It glided easily & smoothly. It is so hydrating my eyes literally glistens every time. Boosted by encapsulated retinol to tackle fine lines & wrinkles, power peptide complex to firm, vegan squalane for hydration & vegan astaxanthin to fend off environmental elements. As someone who is always carrying an eye cream to reapply throughout the day, this is super convenient!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this eye serum! It applies so easily due to the curved applicator. It also has amazing ingredients like retinoid and niacinamide. I use this daily at night and have seen that it helps with my eye wrinkles. It has a thick gel/cream texture and it absorbs really easily. I only use one drop per eye at each use. Overall, works well and would recommend!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Amazing oil cleanser! Helps unclog my pores and leave my skin refreshed and not overly stripped. My makeup melts away seamlessly with this cleanser and it’s a definite must to try if you wear makeup. Overall, I would definitely recommend it and the price point is also quite reasonable for the size of the bottle. I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Great product and absorbs easily to the skin. Comes in floral and cute packaging. The box was a little damaged when it arrived but the container was fine so that was great. Overall, would recommend to people with similar skin types as me.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Very luxurious feel with a seal on the cover. The cream is thick but easy to incorporate into the skin.  There is a orange peel scent and it feels hydrating and soothing to the skin. It is not greasy and there is not sticky after effect for this primer.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Really amazing and moisturizing cream! The texture of the cream is very sick and it has a white color. It also has a slight rose scent to the cream and it also absorbs very easily into my skin. After use, my skin feels hydrated and full of moisture.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: Great cream! This cream has a very thick texture and applies really easily into my skin. It also has a citrus scent and leaves my skin looking very dewy.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Works pretty well! Has a slight color to the lip treatment. The packaging is also a twist of packaging. It has a plum sand but also with a slightly citrus scent as well. Overall, I wouldn’t say it’s worse the lip tree math I think there’s better ones on the market but it’s a pretty good higher end lip balm. gifted by fresh

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Works well! Great design for packaging. Smells like tea. It comes in a droplet packaging and the formula is really thick but blends in easily and overall has great effect and really nice formulation. Gifted by fresh

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: Very thick and hydrating lip balm! The lip balm has a sweet vanilla scent. It applies very easily into my lips. The packaging is designed with a squeeze tube and curved applicator. Very easy to use and my go to for the winter

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I would highly recommend getting this moisturizer. It has some blurring capabilities and looks beautiful underneath makeup. The scent is very pleasant and the texture is relatively thick for a moisturizer which I love as it works with dry skin. It is quite pricey but it lasts a really long time.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: One of the best out there
reviews.review_text: This mask is everything. I use it as a night cream. It has really helped me with flaky winter dryness. A little goes a long way and I am on my 3rd box. Would highly recommend to anyone with dry skin. In the morning the skin looks glowy and feels soft.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_title: One of the best out there
reviews.review_text: This mask is everything. I use it as a night cream. It has really helped me with flaky winter dryness. A little goes a long way and I am on my 3rd box. Would highly recommend to anyone with dry skin. In the morning the skin looks glowy and feels soft.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: As a moisturizer it lacks the thickness I would be looking for so I will use it with my moisturizer. For a primer, it doesn’t perform. I touched my skin and I saw the foundation taken off. Wouldn’t recommend this product. The smell is pleasant but doesn’t live up to the promise.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I highly recommend purchasing this product. The skin feels SO soft after. No other product makes my skin feel this way. It is really worth the price tag.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I didn’t have poor experiences with Youth to the People yet and this product is not an exception. The oil really delivers on its promises. It is quite thick and smells very nice. It goes well with any night cream. The day after usage the skin looks more glowy, less dull, the texture looks more even out texture and improves hydration. Definitely ticked all my requirement list for an oil.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is great. I have dry sensitive skin and it works. The pearlescent finish does brighten up the eye area but not too much that you can tell from afar, like some other products which can look exaggerated. It is quite expensive which is my main drawback. I love that it is gentle, soft and feels good on the skin. I really like the fact that it is a Clean cream. I do see that my undereye wrinkle appear smaller.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got a sample of this product a few months ago. Right after the first use I knew I had to review it. This is the most potent cream I ever used. I can see noticeable change in the skin the morning after using it. I can tell that the very small wrinkles I have seem to disappear. The consistency is balmy which is unique and probably contributes to the way this cream works so magically. I am using it one a week and I love it. It works great with dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product! I use it as a day cream. At first I used it as an overnight mask. It is very thick, very thick, but I personally love it as when I was it off, my face feels smooth and hydrated. I saw someone recommend to use it during the day under make up and that was the best tip I ever got. The makeup looks flawless on top of this heavy cream. If you are looking for a very thick and hydrating lotion, search no further.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product! I use it as a day cream. At first I used it as an overnight mask. reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for about a week now. I definitely like the light foaming feel on my skin. My skin definitely feels clean afterwards. I am very sensitive with scent and this stuff smells pretty good. I also have sensitive skin and have not noticed any type of breakouts since starting to use this product. I would definitely recommend. I did receive this product complimentary for trial purposes.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: so I have been using this tone up for about 10 days now. I received a full size bottle for review. the first thing I noticed that I really enjoyed about this toner was the smell. I am very picky about smell and this toner just gives off a very refreshing smell. I have dry skin and I noticed immediate hydration. I generally use spray toners but I did like how clean and hydrated this toner made me feel after cleansing. It even helped to remove some excess dirt. I think it worked well with my other skin products also, which I added a photo of. I do have redness as well and did not notice it making my redness any worse and my redness has been a little better but I cannot necessarily say if it’s the toner or not as I have also switched a few other of my skin care products. would recommend and purchase in the future.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Loved it but a little too light for Winter
reviews.review_text: I started using this moisturizer about 2 weeks ago in my morning skincare routine. I am 38 and have dry skin. I did find this product to be moisturizing a little thin for this time of year. I think this would be a great day time moisturizer for the summer or warmer months. It was just a little bit too late for my dry skin in the winter. It had a great smell and absorbed quickly which I really enjoyed. Would definitely recommend to someone that needed a lighter moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I received these drops free for review. I started using them a little over a month ago. I have dry sensitive skin and they definitely helped with both issues. I mix a little with my Moisturizer in the morning and at night. I have definitely noticed the redness in my skin being weigh less and my skin stays very well hydrated day and night. The price point is a little high but I have been using them almost every day and you can barely tell I’ve used that much of the bottle after a month. So it will definitely last you a long time. Would definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received this product free for review and have been using it for a few weeks now. I love that it is oil free and contains hyaluronic acid. The SPF 42 is perfect and 40 minutes of water resistant make this a slam dunk. It feels so great on the skin and I would definitely repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received this item free for review and have been using it for a few weeks now. I absolutely love the fresh moisture hyaluronic acid. I have dry skin and a lot of the time sunscreen dries it out more but not this one. it has SPF 42 and keeps my face hydrated while getting some sun. would definitely repurchase in the future.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I received this item free for review and have been using it for a little over a month now pretty much every night. I have tried other Charlotte Tilbury products in the past and have always been a big fan. I love the benefits of vitamin c in this product and they combo perfectly with the retinol night cream that I use. The serum smells amazing and really helps the overall texture of my skin. Will definitely repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: it’s a really good moisturizer. I was skeptical since this is geared towards oily skin types and I have severely dry skin. boy was I surprised. it plumps and hydrates like no other. it’s a really nice gel like texture and a little bit goes a long way. smells amazing and keeps me hydrates ALL day long. only problem is that it feels tacky after application but only for a few minutes. love it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: why am I the only one who doesn’t like this. in fact none of my family members liked it either. it has a very waxy texture and it didn’t absorb into my lips and I saw no difference the next morning either. disappointed.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: these work when used correctly. only put on breakouts that have come to a head otherwise you’re wasting them. leave on overnight and by morning it sucks out all the gunk. I find I have to use about 3 patches on a blemish to really flatten it. these are expensive so for someone like me who has multiple breakouts, its too much. but if u have only a few, go for it!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: this is such a rich, luxurious feeling moisturizer. it smells amazing + feels like butter. I use it every night and find that it moisturizes without feeling heavy and does brighten a little too. I apply biossance squalane oil first, then this since i have really dry skin and this combo is a life saver! plus doesn’t break me out and can be used every night

I highly recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the sunscreen! It doesn’t make your face all white. It feels so light and has a nice light smell. It works great under makeup and I love the fact that becomes stronger when exposed to heat, water, and sweat. I clean houses for a living so I like that it gets better as u sweat. Cant say enough about it.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I had bought a few products from Tatcha and got a mystery bag and this was included in it. Now normally I dont like sprays that are supposed to be for several uses because I have really dry skin and feel like they aren’t hydrating enough but since I received it free I tried it.  This mist is everything!! First off the spray is perfect. It spray lightly but consistently. The smell is like heaven. Its not overwhelming at all as I dont like heavily fragranced products and it really actually hydrates. I dont use it as a primer or setting spray but I carry it with me and when my face starts feeling dry I use it. Never thought I’d love this type of product but its amazing!!

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_title: A must for us with dry skin
reviews.review_text: I figured I’d try this after hearing so much about it and I see what all of the hype is about. I have really dry skin and was using retinol but it dried my skin out even worse than it was so I had to stop using it. When I started using this it helped my skin so much that I figured I’d try the retinol again and now my skin looks and feels so much better.

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I have tried more eye serums and eye creams from high end to not so high-end than I can count but this serum might be my favorite. I absolutely love the packaging. The applicator feels so good on my eyes in the morning esp when they are a bit swollen. The serum itself has such a lovely scent but its not too much at all. My dry skin drinks this up which def helps with the fine lines under my eyes. You also don’t need a lot so although this is a pricey product, it will last awhile.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: I got this in the lip sephora favorites and it exceeded my expectations. It feels like silk on my lips, has such a beautiful tint that will look great on any skin tone and it is so hydrating which is important now that fall is here. It is also reasonably priced for what you get since its a decent size tube.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this updated version of Confidence in a cream. I have tried the original and this definitely is better. I find it creamier, more moisturizerising and the scent is subtle and doesn’t bother me but my fiance said I smelled like Ben gay. Cant say anything about anti-aging benifits as ive only used it for 2 weeks.I definitely would buy this when this runs out.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is amazing. Received a sample from Sephora Play and wish I had a whole bottle. Serums are a must have and one with collagen is even better. It seems to make my skin a little tighter and glowing. But too expensive for my budget so keep looking for equivalents.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Such a luxurious crepe. Received a sample in Sephora Play box and just love it. Use it under eyes and around lip area. Absorbs quickly and feels silky on. Belif is a great product line!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: I love face masks and am always delighted to get one in my Sephora Play box. This is a great brand and a lovely product but a little too drying for me. First tried it in the winter and it left my skin feeling tight and dry. So I gave it to my husband because he has oily skin. But tried it again in the summer and only on nose and chin and it works well for that. So it’s a good product for people with oily skin but limited use for dry or combination skin.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Received this in an Allure Beauty Box and have been using it for a few weeks. It is lovely to use and feels thick and luxurious when it’s on. My concern is to prevent or reduce age lip lines and obviously any product that would help that has to be around the lips not just on them. I apply it around the mouth area at night at it seems fully absorbed when I wake. It may be my imagination but it does seem like it improves the plumpness and smooths lip lines. I would buy this.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: Received this as a sample in Sephora Play box and tried it right away since I’ve used other rose products and liked them. This is a lovely mask and the sample is a generous size. My skin concerns are anti aging and I have dry skin and live in a dry climate. So the clay aspect of this is not good for me but it smells nice and the exfoliating grains leave your skin with a nice smooth texture but I had to layer on massive amounts of moisturizer so probably wouldn’t buy this for myself and look for something a bit more emollient.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: Received a .25 oz sample in an Allure Beauty Box and didn’t try it for several months. I was a little put off by the idea of putting oil on my face. When winter rolled in and my skin was DRY, I grabbed the Luna to give it a try. At first, the color and scent were a little weird. Unlike most sweet smelling girlie looking creams I’m used to, this smelled like a barn full of hay and looked like green pond scum. I got a little break outs on my forehead and blamed the night oil so only used it every other night. But after a couple of weeks, the break outs stopped (might have been some other cause?). I started really liking how my skin felt in the mornings and started using it nightly.Now I’m hooked. The sample size lasts forever and I really like the earthy scent. I use it as my final layer of a 5 step routine over essence, serum, cream then oil. It seems to lock all the other ingredients onto my face and reduces the dryness that happens overnight from pillows and heating. I also pile on the Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask to keep my lip area hydrated.Sadly this product is quite expensive. But I’ve found Sunday Riley trial bundles that include trial sizes of it and I do like Sunday Riley products in general even though I can’t afford them.  So when my trail sizes run out I will be combing sites for more.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: Received this sample in either Allure or Sephora Play box. I am picky about serums. Don’t give me some thin, clear gel and call it serum if it doesn’t do anything.  This is awesome!I’ve been using it for a few weeks. The sample size is a generous size tube but far from full. But it really does make a difference. It smells lovely and soaks in fast. I use it as layer 2 over CosRX Snail and before a Body Merry Vitamin C moisturizer.  This is the first product from this brand that might be worth the cost. It has salicylic acid so I might not want to wear it in summer because I live in a sunny climate but it works wonders for dry winter skin. I love it!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this in a Sephora Play or Allure Beauty Box and am reviewing a sample size item. I’m new to First Aid Beauty products and this is the first I’ve tried. I used it as a primer over two other moisturizers and under foundation especially under eyes and around lip area. My general impression is that it is an adequate primer that goes on nice and soaks in quickly. Light and clean feeling but probably more suitable for oily to normal skin as it seems to dry out quickly in dry climates. I’ve tried many primers and in the comparison to others, it isn’t particularly special and I probably wouldn’t seek it out. But it has very clean ingredients and for the right skin, is a nice product.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a very gentle face wash. I received this as a sample and used it primarily in the morning so I cannot attest to its make up removal effectiveness but overall I like the product and would likely purchase it. The ingredients are awesome: aloe, cucumber, ginseng, Rose extracts and soybean, sunflower and Borage oils. It is a light gel, low suds cleanser and doesn’t leave your skin feeling tight or dry. Try it.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: Overall I like Caudalie products as they seem pure and mild. I received this as a sample in a beauty box, either Sephora or Allure. The sample is 10 ml/.33 oz so it was a good size amount and lasted for several weeks using it twice a day.  It is a lightweight smooth serum that sinks in quickly with a barely noticeable fragrance. However I did not notice any real difference in my skin between using it and not using it. I do use a lot of other products (6 steps of K-Beauty) so if this was your primary treatment, you might see stronger results. For me, I will probably not purchase unless I were to find it as a bargain since it is fairly expensive.

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have tried several of the Tarte Rainforest of the Sea products and I like them. I sampled the Drink of H2O from a Sephora Play Box which I saved for summer when I prefer water based products. This moisturizer is a clear gel that is rich and sort of tingles when applied. A little goes a long way and its a bit sticky until it dries. I use it only at night for this reason. However it really does leave your skin feeling nice and hydrated by the next morning much like some sheet masks I’ve used. It’s lovely if it’s kept in the fridge and used on a hot summer night! I like it and despite it being a but pricey would buy it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this product and used it for about a week and a half. Not really long enough to form a strong opinion but long enough to like it. I am a long time retinol user and it takes a special product for me to see significant difference. But this product seems like it’s emollient enough to improve texture and moisturize. However with the wide variety of retinol products, cost is also a factor. I would buy it if I found it affordable.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this product and used it for about a week and a half. Not really long enough to form a strong opinion but long enough to like it. I am a long time retinol user and it takes a special product for me to see significant difference. But this product seems like it’s emollient enough to improve texture and moisturize. However with the wide variety of retinol products, cost is also a factor. I would buy it if I found it affordable.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: I received this Caudalie product as a sample in a beauty box. It is light and has a faint floral scent and is more like a serum. It goes on thinly and soaks in quickly and I use it after essence and before moisturizer. It is a moisturizer but not enough for my combination skin. It probably would not buy this unless I found it on sale.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I got a 1oz sample in a beauty box. At first I didn’t like this cream because of the minty feeling it leaves. But after using it for awhile, I grew to like it. It reminds me of Noxema, a brand I used as a teenager. Ultimately it won me over because it is very hydrating and great for dry winter skin. First Aid brand is priced reasonably and I may want to purchase again.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a 5 ml sample in a beauty box. I love this brand and I love vitamin C serums so I expected to love this.  But it was only so-so and not particularly unique or great. Once Vit C serums were hard to find and expensive but there are so many good choices out there that I will probably skip this one based on price and consistency. Its a little sticky and I did not see or feel any difference from using it.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I am a big fan of Belif products. I received this .15 oz sample in a Beauty Box. It is a blue gel that goes on easily and is absorbed quickly. Does it improve elasticity? Not that I can tell, but how is that measured by a couple of weeks use? Does it last 26 hrs? Again hard to prove. But it is a nice moisturizer that would be great in summer or warm climates.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this serum! First of all, the bottle feels so heavy and well made that you totally feel like you’re holding a luxury product, and the quality really matches the packaging! This serum feels very light on the skin but hydrating at the same time, without making the skin greasy. I love the natural ingredients and how clean this feels. I apply it every night before my moisturizer and wake up with radiant skin. I can’t wait to use it for a long time and see more results. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_title: Best sunscreen for on the go
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster but all the opinions are my own. I love this little sunscreen stick for the formula and the convenience. I love to keep this in my purse at all times to reapply my sunscreen throughout the day as I’m trying to be more conscious about wearing sunscreen every day. It absorbs into the skin very nicely and does not have a white cast. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: It really feels like you got gifted good genes
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Sunday Riley in exchange for a review but all the opinions are my own.First of all, the product is very aesthetically pleasing. The frosted glass bottle looks very sleek and I love the pump.I used this product after applying my usual toner and before moisturizer. I have slightly larger pores underneath my eyes on my cheeks and they look smoother after use, and my skin looks more plump overall.It does not irritate my skin thanks to the aloe and the arnica included in the ingredients that help soothe my skin afterwards. I do have somewhat sensitive skin but I did not have to rinse at it suggests for sensitive skin (using it as a mask rinsing it off after 15 minutes instead of leaving it on).Overall this product worked very well on me, seeing results after a week of using so I am very excited to keep using it for longer. Highly recommend, it is more on the expensive side but the ingredients are high quality.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen. First of all, the bottle is usually bigger than other face sunscreens so you get more for your money. It absorbs rapidly in my dry skin and it does not leave a white cast on top of the skin. It also doesn’t cling into my dry patches which sunscreen sometimes does that.It does not look greasy, and it does not pile when I reapply throughout the day. Overall a great product with great ingredients as well. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe. I am really loving this serum. I use it especially at night before moisturizing and it absorbs quickly and layers well with other products. The texture is almost like a gel that does not feel greasy or sticky. The scent is also not overpowering. Overall my skin feels smoother, more plump and hydrated with each use. The bottle is also adorable and I love that it comes with a pump. This has become a staple in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_title: Best night time moisturizer for dry skin
reviews.review_text: Favorite night time moisturizer! I was so excited to use this moisturizer as I own (and love) most of the barrier + line and this one did not disappoint! I use it at night mostly since it is a little thicker, after I cleanse and apply a hydrating serum and it layers perfectly with other products. I have dry skin and I find that it absorbs very easily without feeling greasy. My skin feels very smooth and hydrated after and even in the morning! I usually wake up with dry patches but not with this product.I love the clean ingredients and the lipid blend to help repair my skin barrier (which needs some help). I also have to mention that I love the pump as it is easier and more sanitary than other pumps I’ve tried. Overall it is a great product and has already become a staple in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer feels thicker at first but it absorbs completely once applied to the skin. I use it at night as the last step in my skincare routine, and some mornings if I need extra hydration. It layers very nicely after other products without sitting on top of the skin, as well as before makeup.It does have a scent but it doesn’t bother me or irritate my skin.I’m not sure about the 72 hour hydration it claims but it does hydrate my skin from nighttime until the next morning. I am very interested in the damask rose as an ingredient as it helps repair the skin barrier, as my dry skin needs it.Overall a good product, but would not recommend if you’re sensitive to fragrance.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I was very excited to try the new formulation of this jet lag mask. I have never tried the original formula but I have heard so much about it. I love that there are no essential oils and no fragrance on this one, as I try to avoid those ingredients so my skin doesn’t react to them.I have very dry skin, somewhat sensitive and after using this mask I found my skin to look very hydrated and plump, and I did not have any of the dry patches that I usually get. I leave it on overnight instead of blotting it with a cloth like it suggests and wake up with plump skin.I use it after I moisturize, as the last step in my skincare routine and it layers very well with my other products.Overall this is a great mask and it has already become a part of my skincare routine, especially when my skin has been feeling dry or irritated.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I was very excited to try the new formulation of this jet lag mask. I have never tried the original formula but I have heard so much about it. I love that there are no essential oils and no fragrance on this one, as I try to avoid those ingredients so my skin doesn’t react to them.I have very dry skin, somewhat sensitive and after using this mask I found my skin to look very hydrated and plump, and I did not have any of the dry patches that I usually get. reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I was very excited to try this eye cream since I have loved everything I’ve tried from Sunday Riley. First of all, the packaging is very easy to use and I love the cooling applicator. I’ve even put it in the fridge so it gets colder and it helps to de-puff. I love that it has retinol to help with fine lines, and niacinamide to brighten. It layers perfectly on top of my serums and before my moisturizer and it does not pill. It also does not irritate around the eyes. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_title: Great oil cleanser for dry skin
reviews.review_text: This is the perfect first cleanser to remove makeup or spf, as it is oil based. It cleanses without stripping my skin. It does not feel tight after either, my skin actually feels hydrated still. I also really like the pump as it makes it really easy to dispense, especially while in the shower.Even though it doesn’t contain artificial fragrance and the ingredients are natural, it does have a natural fragrance/scent but it does not irritate my skin.It also doesn’t leave a greasy film after I rinse.Highly recommend as a first cleanser for a double cleanse or even by itself.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_title: Great oil cleanser for dry skin
reviews.review_text: This is the perfect first cleanser to remove makeup or spf, as it is oil based. It cleanses without stripping my skin. It does not feel tight after either, my skin actually feels hydrated still. I also really like the pump as it makes it really easy to dispense, especially while in the shower.Even though it doesn’t contain artificial fragrance and the ingredients are natural, it does have a natural fragrance/scent but it does not irritate my skin.It also doesn’t leave a greasy film after I rinse.Highly recommend as a first cleanser for a double cleanse or even by itself.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Fresh but this is my honest opinion.This is a really nice tinted lip balm. I use lip balms daily and this one is the perfect for every day since it is also slightly tinted but still very natural looking and comfortable. The berry shade is really pretty and matches any makeup look, as well as a no-makeup makeup look. I love the nourishing ingredients like grape seed oil, castor oil and jojoba oil. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a really innovative serum that I loved trying out. I love that it’s specially formulated to help the skin resilience which is very unique. My skin is constantly trying to adapt to changes (such as weather, environment and humidity) and bounce back so this was the perfect product for that.First of all, the bottle is gorgeous, and it’s glass that feels and looks well made. I also really like the dropper as it makes very easy to apply the right amount of product. I apply about 4-5 drops on my face at night, after cleansing. My skin feels instantly more supple and bright thanks to the niacinamide and the ocean kelp. I really enjoy these innovative ingredients like the 5kDA Hyaluronic Acid. I also always look for ceramides in my products since it helps heal and protect the skin barrier.Overall I’m so happy with this product!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a really nice retinol serum. First of all, I love the shape of the bottle and the airless pump.I love using anti aging products like these on my late 20s to target fine lines and keep a youthful skin.I like using a retinol serum twice a week and this one has been working great for my sensitive skin. I don’t get irritation after using or dry skin the days after.I have been using it for a couple of weeks and I notice plumper skin also thanks to the Hyaluronic Acid. I can’t wait to see longer term results after months of use!Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a really nice retinol serum. First of all, I love the shape of the bottle and the airless pump.I love using anti aging products like these on my late 20s to target fine lines and keep a youthful skin.I like using a retinol serum twice a week and this one has been working great for my sensitive skin. I don’t get irritation after using or dry skin the days after.I have been using it for a couple of weeks and I notice plumper skin also thanks to the Hyaluronic Acid. I can’t wait to see longer term results after months of use!Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This cream has helped my complexion so Michu my skin is a lot more even and less red. It applies so well and has been so effective even after just a week of using it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This cream has helped my complexion so Michu my skin is a lot more even and less red. It applies so well and has been so effective even after just a week of using it.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a complimentary gift but I love it! This cream has changed my skin. It’s softer, smoother and even. It’s a thick cream but applies so well!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this serum! I received it as a complimentary gift but I’ve been using it everyday morning and night. My skin feels softer and smoother after each use.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this cream. I have incredibly dry skin and this has helped so much. Since using this, my skin feels so much more hydrated, smooth and plump. I also have noticed my face looks brighter. The cream doesn’t have much of a scent which I prefer. I love that the cream is made with lipids and hyaluronic acid.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this cream. I have incredibly dry skin and this has helped so much. Since using this, my skin feels so much more hydrated, smooth and plump. I also have noticed my face looks brighter. The cream doesn’t have much of a scent which I prefer. I love that the cream is made with lipids and hyaluronic acid.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer from Fresh. It is so hydrating and leaves my skin soft and glowy all day. It had the perfect amount of rose scent, however it isn’t overpowering. I love that it has Hyaluronic Acid which is great for my dry skin.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I always have a hard time finding an eye cream that really makes a difference, but this one really does! It is so hydrating and leaves my under eyes soft and smooth. I have noticed my under eye concealer is going on a lot smoother since using this product. I also really love the applicator tip!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This primer is perfect for my dry skin! It’s so rich and creamy, leaving my skin soft and smooth and ready for foundation. It helps my makeup to not settle into my fine lines and wrinkles. It’s extremely hydrating so I love it especially during the winter.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I love Fresh products so I was really eager to try this mask. I have really dry, sensitive skin and this mask was a great match. I noticed it calmed my redness and helped smooth my texture. The smell is light but delightful. I love that you can wash it off or even wear it overnight. I would definitely recommend this if you have sensitive skin!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen. It applies so well - smooth and lightweight. It works great under makeup as well. I love the light scent, it’s fresh and fruity but not overwhelming. It also hydrates my skin, leaving it soft and smooth.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I did not expect to love this as much as I do! It’s the most perfect tinted sunscreen. It gives you a beautiful glow but doesn’t leave you looking greasy. It’s all I’ve been wearing lately for my face for a “no makeup makeup” look.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! I will continue to buy this time and time again. It is so incredibly hydrating on my dry skin, but doesn’t leave it greasy. It leaves my skin feeling so soft. I know a significant difference with makeup application when this is in my routine. If you have dry skin, I would highly recommend this cream!

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary in my voxbox and have had great results with it thus far. The consistency of the product makes it a little tricky getting out with nails but a little bit goes a long way. My skin is supple and smooth when I wake up which makes my makeup application seamless. when I’m done with this product I would definitely replace it.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I used this product in conjunction with the sleeping collagen and it helped my skin feel so smooth and plump when I woke up. The only issue I had was the pump and getting the product out. I ended up just shaking it out of the bottle which still wasn’t easy. I did receive this product complimentary in my recent voxbox but these views are purely my own.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Fresh in my influenster box and it’s been great thus far. It truly is a gentle exfoliator and the longer you wash your face the exfoliating pieces dissolve away nicely. The only slight downside is the strong smell so if you’re sensitive to that I’d be careful.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary in my voxbox and I can’t believe how great this works as a primer. It literally leaves the smoothest canvas so any foundation you put on afterward looks amazing! It’s got just the right amount of moisturizer in it but doesn’t leave you feeling greasy.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary and so far I love it. I use it at night after I wash my face and it leaves my skin smooth and hydrated without breaking it out or being too oily.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary and unfortunately I’m not impressed with its performance. It’s oily on the skin and I’d rather just use one of my foundations with SPF already built in.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this product complementary from Influenster and I’ve been so happy with the way it’s nourished my skin. I use this just about everyday as a regular moisturizer and my skin is feeling dewy and alive.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster and I’ve been using it everyday since. I apply it after my face oil every night and it’s the perfect combo to waking up to beautifully soft, radiant skin in the morning. It’s just the right amount of hydration without making my skin oily. I’m definitely switching to this in my routine now!

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: 100%.  Just try it.  I have horrible acne problems.  I realized how dry my skin was too which triggered the acne.  I’m also aging over 40.  I have to say I am blown away at how my skin has recovered after all the stress in my life that cause the worst skin I have ever experienced.  It’s a must try especially for us older, dry skinned, even though it’s also oily, scarred and acne skin.  Please try.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I spent this past month trying about 8 different skin products with full understanding that it takes more time to see efficacy.  But you can tell right away if you will react even giving it a few more days.  So!  Charlotte’s Tilbury Magic Cream hands down is the cream of choice.  It has less silicone than all the other products and they use the soluble silicones that evaporate.  It calms down my acne from my breakouts within 24 hours.  It was my emergency treatment between trying out products.  It 100% tightens and forms skin while reducing timelines almost immediately it improve. There’s so much hydration that I was worried about a breakout but instead it soothes it.  I actually works amazing as a primer.  So you don’t need one with this.  You can save a lot of money with this.  So worth a try.  I love it so much!

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product is a 5/5 star no matter what you read.  It is the best gel cleanser and is perfect with a Luna 2 exfoliator.  It has the right amount of moisture to leave you skin soft, especially in between exfoliating.  Skin can start to get rough in between exfoliating so you need a gentle deep exfoliating cleanser as he nears are soft enough to not get a rough exfoliation.  It is important not to create micro tears in your skin.  Sometimes your skin breaks out as a result.! I highly recommend this product.  I have truly helped my dry, oily, acne filled and acne prone skin.  I only have a few acne left and blemishes are fading away.  I match this with the Tatcha water cream, which is just the best cream for an oily, acne prone, yet dry skin face.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_title: A good product just not for me.  Best for Oily on
reviews.review_text: I do like this product.  It was not enough to calm my acne or moisturize.  It was very light and did absorb in.  My skin is oily, acne prone, sensitive and very dry.  This product was not enough to moisturize for me.  I bet it would work on just oily skin.  Consider acne treatment products in combination.  The smell was strange for me.  Texture was nice.  Worth a try.  Not too pricey.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Made zero difference to my skin and not better after wash.  My Tatcha exfoliating cleanser beat it out by far.  Does not leave skin supple after.  Not worth the money for me.  I have very dry skin with oily acne prone skin.  It’s hard to please.  3 stars because some people may benefit from that maybe if they are just oily.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I had no idea.  I never bought this because the silk cream is heavier.  I thought this cream would not be enough to moisturize my oily acne prone skin that is likely due to the severe dryness of my skin.  It’s oily but when you touch it, it’s very dry.  I had a breakout from a Kate Somerville acne product.  I got this product on my Rouge rewards.  I was shocked as I was putting this on that I can feel silk in it and a burst of water like hydration.  My skin soaked it up and  held onto the moisture.  My skin was moist.  Acne and blemishes started to heal and fade.  My fine lines reduced the next day.  My skin is super sensitive and 33 years of skin product trials and this is it for me!  You’ve got to give it a serious try even past your outbreak.  I find there is a 2 week adjustment period.  Lucky for me, It was overnight.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry and oily skin.  This is perfect.  My skin is very extreme dry in winter with oily T zone.  This cream worked perfectly except my dry spots o cheeks.  I always have to apply alarmist night cream on if at night.  It is not too heavy for oily skins for sure.  If Oily skinned people avoided moisturizing creams, their skin would cause more acne because your skin would have to keep secreting oils from oil glands to keep moisturizer skin.  It definitely is not too heavy.   I really recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I have always been uncomfortable with the idea of serums and oils due to my oily acne prone skin.   I also have very dry skin around my T zone.  Oils just sit on my skin and does nothing.  This oil is 100% fantastic.  It penetrates my skin and feels so good applying it on.  It does not leave my skin oily at all.  And my fine lines and dry skin have diminished since starting.  I highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Wow.  I never believed in this stuff.  It’s amazing how this essence water changes how the serum and creams absorb into your skin.  I have oily but also very dry skin.  I’m actually left with a more matte look at the end of the day.  My skin feels plump and not dry at all.  My wrinkles cleared in a few weeks.  It helps absorb all the goodness in my creams.  Through the hard long working hours of pandemic, my skin looked awful and breaking out.  Retin A Micro gel absorbed better to get rid of acne.  You end up using less product.  Only need few drops of this.  100% worth the price.  Not purchasing serums creams as often.  I highly recommend it

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Skin feels plump and beautiful after.  Not drying at all.  Gets rid of oils and dirt 100%.  I couldn’t stop touching my plump skin.  It is the first cleanser I have ever enjoyed.  Strongly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Skin feels plump and beautiful after.  Not drying at all.  Gets rid of oils and dirt 100%.  I couldn’t stop touching my plump skin.  It is the first cleanser I have ever enjoyed.  Strongly recommend.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_title: I’ve found my product (before and after pics)
reviews.review_text: Love at first try.  Only need like 1/2 a pump or less.  3 weeks later, my skin is even softer than ever before.  I have very oily and dry skin.  The product doesn’t sit on my skin but rather absorbs right in.  I hardly have to use much cream after so it will save me a lot.  I do find a significant difference if you used the essence first because it requires less product and soaks in more.  My boyfriend tried on his hand and he was shocked when it absorbed in.  Told me to keep it.  I’ve tried many serums but never expected this result.  Fine lines and dry spots are gone.  No breakouts.  Beautiful product.  There is a scent but it diffuses within minutes.  I’m sensitive to smells too.  Along with the face wash, my skin is at its best.  Give it a try.  Ignore the scent and you’ll notice after that it’s barely there.  100% recommend.  Before pic, see fine lines on forehead and eyes.  I’m 43 years older.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Beautiful, soft, and hydrating cream.  It feels amazing when you put it on.  With my aging, dry, and damaged frontliner skin, this really helped moisturize and heal.  It is honestly not that thick or that rich of a cream.  I found it much lighter than I thought it would be.  But it hydrates and repairs your skin extremely well.  The smell is pretty raw honey smelling but goes away after 30 minutes or so.  I really recommend this cream.  It is much cheaper than luxury creams I have bought over $250.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: 100% the deepest moisturizing and softest feeling face cream that has ever landed on my face.  I was trying from $100 to $700 (Cle de Peau) face creams but I found myself still mixing creams to get the feel that I wanted and needed.  I was nervous about this one.  But holy cow what an instant surprise.  It’s like a soft creamy gel that my skin just soaked in.  My face felt velvety and soft.  It does on smooth and is slightly tacky after yet soft.  Once it soaks in, that slight tackiness is gone and my skin is instantly plump.  I press into my skin and it is plump deep under.  I’ve never put on any cream like this before.  The $700 Cle de Peau was beautiful but deeper layers of my skin was still dry and I can tell that.  My skin is super dry yet oily on T-Zone.  It even has dry patches on oily areas!  This cream softens my oily, dry areas without greasiness or being shiny.  It’s unbelievable.  I’m 43 with some fine lines, slight wrinkles, extremely dry, and very oily T Zone skin.  I am also a frontline HCP so my skin was destroyed with welts all over it from all the sanitization on my shield and reused N95 masks for over 1.5 years since pandemic started. This cream saved me and it’s only been less than 2 days.  My skin felt just as soft before bedtime so after 16 hours.  I so strongly recommend this for all skin types.  Honestly, just use a dime size amount.  Too much will make it feel too thick and too tacky.  You have got to try it.  Note, I found it for $88 on the Tatcha Canada website but I already bought this from Sephora.
