reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have dry acne prone skin and normally use an acne serum in the morning. In the past I have used and love the glossier pure serum, Sunday Riley UFO and the bareminerals acne serum. All are amazing and this equally effective! I don’t like using salicylic acid as it dries out my skin and have had good experiences with niacinamide and zinc in the past. I mix this with the hylaronic acid in the morning and it works well with my moisturizer and makeup. I purchased another to make sure when I use my current one up I will have one handy. I love this brand so much and cannot recommend this product and brand more!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I have dry acne prone skin and I like to use a hydrating serum with my acne or anti-aging serum. This is wonderful! I have used the glossier bounce serum in the past and I don’t feel like it did anything. I also got a sample of the clinique moisture surge serum and these serums are equally as good! I will be purchasing this one from now on though! I care about my skin and am willing to invest but if I can get the same or better results for a fraction of the price, I will take this route. This sinks into my skin quickly and I do notice that it is more plump and hydrated. I highly recommend this product and brand!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing!! I always use some sort of heavy lip balm before bed but none were as hydrating. My lips are plump and soft each morning. Plus you get so much product for $20. I love this lip mask so much!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Based on my skin type this product is not intended that be a moisturizer. Even though I have dry skin I use a thin gel moisturizer powder in the morning under my primer and makeup (typically the clinique yellow gel moisturizer). I had read really good tins about this product and combined with FOMO I purchased as soon as it was on the Sephora ap. I think this is and ok moisturizer. I only use it in the morning because I need a much more heavy duty one at night. I hope honestly don’t think it’s any more hydrating than the clinique yellow gel moisturizer and it’s was cheaper. I use 2 pumps per cheek and 1 on my forehead. It does soak in right away and work well under primer and foundation. You also get 2 ounces which is more than the typical 1 or 1.7 ounces. I recommend this to anyone looking for a light moisturizer. (On a side note I hate watermelon and the smell is strong at first but quickly disappears.)

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_title: Not the best for dry skin
reviews.review_text: I was excited to get a nice size sample of this as I have dry skin and am always looking for a good moisturizer. This moisturizer smells really good and soaks in fast. Unfortunately it is not enough for my dry skin. I have only used it at night and my face is not as hydrated as I like in the morning. I usually go for thicker creams especially at night. I think this is more for people with normal skin. After reading the other reviews it seems to confirm that this is not ideal for dry skin.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Maybe Not for People with Dry Skin
reviews.review_text: I have dry acne prone skin with acne scar dark spots. I was excited to get a .5 oz sample of this with one of my recent orders. I can’t say how well it brightens because I only had a small amount of product to try. I used it in the morning with my normal skincare and makeup products and my makeup broke down really fast. I was surprised this happened because this is marketed as  working well under makeup. After that incident I used it at night and I do not like how it didn’t sink into my skin very well and left my face sticky. In the morning when I would wash my face it felt like my face was covered in slime. This has happened to me before with products like the clinique moisture surge gels that are full of silicones. The hydrating aspect of this product is ok. I typically like something lighter for the day time and thicker at night. I am so glad that I was able to try a sample of this product but I don’t think I will purchase it due the fact that it does not sit well under makeup and doesn’t sink in leaving my skin feeling sticky.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin that gets really dry in the winter and decided to pick this up during the sale after seeing and reading reviews all over the place. I planned to primarily use this as a sleeping mask. After using this for 3 weeks a couple of times a week, I don’t think think it’s anything too special. I use the Drunk Elephant Lalo Moisturizer or the Dr Jart Ceramiden cream at night and they both soak in and leaves my skin nicely hydrated for the next day. I’ve use a lot or a little of this mask and it leaves my skin really sticky and doesn’t sink in all the way. If it wasn’t sticky I think I would like it more, it’s just uncomfortable sleeping with it on because throughout the night my face is on my pillow. I also don’t feel like it is as hydrating as any of the night moisturizers I use and haven’t noticed any other benefits. I will keep this and try to find a way to make it work. The slight peppermint smell is nice though. I think if you don’t have super dry skin or normal skin this would work to add that extra small hydration.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and fine lines under my eyes and usually look for something targeted at treating fine lines. After trying multiple regular and deluxe samples, I got the full size during the skincare double point event. I only use this at night as I don’t think it sits well under makeup, and I wake up with nicely hydrated and plump under eyes. I have used the Kiehl’s creamy avocado eye cream in the past and it recently started to give me milia (I think they changed the formula or I got a weird one because it has a different texture than what I was used too). This eye cream also doesn’t irritate my eyes and is comfortably lightweight.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Compared to the Laneige lip mask this mask is super sticky, not as hydrating and WAY more expensive. I knew when purchasing it the amount of product you get for the price is steep but I wanted to try it. This mask is just so sticky and the little spoon is cute but not helpful. It does sink in pretty fast but I don’t feel the long lasting hydration the Laneige mask provides. Yes this was fun to try but I will stick with the Laneige mask.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Finally! A moisturizer that is thick and rich enough for my dry skin! I use this at night and my skin is so soft, supple and hydrated in the morning and throughout the day (even when I wash my face and apply my morning skincare and makeup). I got a small sample of this and purchased the full size the next day. I would highly recommend this for anyone with dry to very dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry, acne prone skin and have been wanting to try this for a while. I purchased the smaller size during the Spring Sale and have really liked it. This toner is a good first hydrating step and i still use my serums and moisturizers. It has a slight milk scent but it is not noticeable when on. This product is good, thus the 4 stars, but i was kind of hoping for something amazing. I would definitely still use a moisturizer as it is not hydrating enough on its own and has not caused any acne.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I have dry, sensitive, acne prone skin and have gone back and forth on whether I like this cleanser. You only need a small amount as it really frothy. I like to use this as my second cleanse at night if I wear makeup or as my only cleanse when I don’t wear makeup. I use this with my PMD and it works great. This cleanser is really strong and leaves my skin squeaky clean. I then follow up with my serums and a thick moisturizer otherwise this cleanser will dry out and irritate my skin. I do take a break every so often and use a gentle cleanser to give my skin a break. I would suggest this cleanser for anyone needing a deep clean.

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: This smells exactly like a Nature Valley Granola Bar!! I was expecting more of their signature scent but this is fun! It is average and keeps my lips soft but not a deep hydration. I really love how it does not feel waxey. I would purchase again but if my lips are extremely dry I would go with the Bite Beauty balm or mask.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I have dry dehydrated skin and regularly chemically exfoliate my skin, but I do like to physically exfoliate my face 1-2 times per week. This is very gentle and makes my skin feel soft but not stripped. I typically use the Dr Brandt Microdermabrasion Age Defying Exfoliator, but this is a nice alternative when I don’t feel I need a deep scrub or my face is a little sensitive.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_title: Minimally Hydrating, but nothing really else....
reviews.review_text: I have dry dehydrated skin that could definitely use some dew in the winter! This serum isn’t bad but it’s not good either. It’s a little hydrating, but other then than I have not noticed a dewiness, plumping or resurfacing. I was using two pumps each morning with my usual moisturizer and sunscreen and I noticed no difference. I now mix one pump with my vitamin c serum each morning. I use it more for a small burst of hydration than anything else. If the price were decreased quite a bit, I would be more inclined to repurchase as a hydrating serum.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I have dry dehydrated skin and have been wanting to try this for ages! I first used this at night and used quite a bit, but I would wake up with extremely flaky and tight skin. This product soaked in but it did not hydrate my skin at all (even using my humidifier at night). I then tried using it in the morning and it was not enough hydration either. At least during the day, I could layer on another product when my face started feeling dry. I am really disappointed but glad I only used a few samples and did not purchase the full size product. If you like the feeling of a thick moisturizer but do not need the extreme benefits, I would suggest this moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I have dry dehydrated skin (even in the summer) so a ‘hydrating’ sunscreen would be nice but overall I’m looking for something light and soaks in. This sunscreen feels exactly like a thicker Smashbox Original Photo Finish Primer, heavy and like an uncomfortable layer of silicone. This did not set and made my face feel gross all day. Not that I necessarily wanted it to set (and clog my pores) but it would rub and transfer when the slightest touch of anything touched my face. I guess it worked as sun protection but I just cannot get over the feeling. If you are OK with the texture, I guess I would recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I have dry dehydrated skin (even in the summer) so a ‘hydrating’ sunscreen would be nice but overall I’m looking for something light and soaks in. reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_title: Not a Beet Shield Dupe! Lots of Irritation
reviews.review_text: I’m gutted this sunscreen does not work out for me!! I LOVED the KraveBeauty Beet Shield and saw this was a pretty good dupe. Once rubbed in there is no white cast, it is very lightweight and leaves a dewy glow like the Beet Shield but it irritates my skin so much!! Throughout the day my face literally explodes in small red bumps and whiteheads. The fragrance is also pretty strong and lingers for a while. I would not suggest using this for any type of exercise (not that it claims to be used for) because it runs and really stings and irritates my eyes and contact lenses. Again, I am so sad this is not a Beet Shield dupe! I will sadly be returning this.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: Wow, I’ve been looking for something for years to clear up my splotchy cheeks. Within 3 days of using I woke up today to see smoother, resurfaced skin! My skin looks brighter and clearer. Even my small spider veins look diminished.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Loved this! And it’s $15 cheaper at Amazon, though, just saying. I buy it here because of the points.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Very hydrating and woke to really nice skin. I like that it targets both dryness and brightness. Unfortunately I dropped my jar and since it’s glass, it broke! Fortunately it was the trial size so now I gotta buy the full size!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: Very hydrating and woke to really nice skin. I like that it targets both dryness and brightness. Unfortunately I dropped my jar and since it’s glass, it broke! Fortunately it was the trial size so now I gotta buy the full size!

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Why did I take so long to try this!! I’ve used Clinique since my teens and never tried this product, thinking I would not enjoy a greasy type of cleanser. I was wrong! This cleanser removes every drop of makeup, including mascara, and my wash feels so clean after! When I started using it I thought I needed a large amount to cleanse but I found you really only need a small amount to throughly clean your whole face. I start by warming a small amount in my hands and then apply it to my cheeks, chin, neck and forehead first, massage away all my foundation, then spread to eyes to remove mascara, eyeshadow and eyeliner. Remove with a warm washcloth. Baby smooth skin!

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Why did I take so long to try this!! I’ve used Clinique since my teens and never tried this product, thinking I would not enjoy a greasy type of cleanser. I was wrong! reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m loving this moisturizer. It works beautifully under foundation and performs like a primer. It’s expensive but worth it. You really need so little and I found that if you use too much sometimes it pills under foundation. I can use it around my eyes without any burning. I do find that my fine lines are plumped and it does give a small dewy look, but not shiny at all. I apply it after my serum and then try to wait about 5 minutes before foundation for best results.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this, but I’ll give it a firm like. My main criteria on my search for a facial sunscreen is whether it stings my eyes, and unfortunately this does. But I loved the formula, it glides on and doesn’t leave a white cast. It worked great under makeup. But after a few hours my eyes started to sting. I wear contact lens and this may be why. I know I could just avoid the eye area but I want to protect that skin from the sun.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Wow, just wow. I recently spent 2 weeks it Italy and I brought with me a sample size of Jet Lag to use as an overnight mask. I was blown away! I woke up to the smoothest plump skin. A little goes a long way too. I just bought the full size. It’s a very moisturizing formula that also plumps up my fine lines. I’m in love with this stuff and I even use it around my eyes.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Wow, just wow. I recently spent 2 weeks it Italy and I brought with me a sample size of Jet Lag to use as an overnight mask. I was blown away! I’m in love with this stuff and I even use it around my eyes.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: First let me say the packaging is luxurious looking and feeling! I do have creating under my eyes and I’m always looking for a good eye cream. This eye cream really hydrates under my eye area. I do notice that it has helped with not letting my foundation look caked on there. It does have a strong perfume scent but that hasn’t bothered me in any way. It absorbs nicely into the skin. I like how it does make my under eyes look more hydrated and healthy. I’m still on the fence if it’s actually getting rid of my under eye wrinkles but I think I won’t know for sure until I’m done with using the whole jar! With continued use I’m sure I will be more than satisfied. I actually brought it with me on my trip to Oaxaca!  Also a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’m surprised I actually like this cleanser!  I don’t get bad acne, but I do breakout about once a month.  I still use it on a daily basis. This cleanser is a clear gel like formula, not too thick.  It does lather up nicely.  It can feel drying sometimes, but not too bad.  I just then apply my moisturizer.  This cleanser wasn’t irritating to my skin either and I do like how it made my skin feel clean.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: This pore clearing clay mask was gifted to me from Innisfree, for my honest thoughts and opinions. This really does feel like it gave my face a deep cleaning.  It’s a creamier, not so thick formula compared to other clay masks.  So it was easy to apply all over the face.  What’s the time was up to remove,  I added a bit warm water to start and started massaging.  It does feel exfoliating.  I was surprised it didn’t overly dry my skin out, but I still went in with a good moisturizer.  You could also use a good facial oil instead of a moisturizer to follow after the mask.  This innisfree pore clearing clay mask does have some good key ingredients, lactid acid and Jeju volcanic clusterss.  If you have dry skin like I do, then I recommend only using this no more than two times a week.  Maybe even once a week just depending on how your skin feels after.  Also don’t forget to moisturize after.  I’ve already recommended this innisfree clearing clay mask to a family member who is having a big pore breakout.  As far as how it felt on my skin, it didn’t make me itchy, irritate my skin, or any tingling.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Sunday Riley.  I am so excited about this product, because I am seeing brightening results!!  I was surprised I am noticing that my skin tone is starting to even out, very slight.  It says deeply exfoliants, which it probably does since I am seeing brighter skin and my skin tone evening out.  It’s a cream formula, no exfoliating rough particles.  I don’t feel any effects like tingling when I apply, or any skin irritations.  I been applying this in the morning since I am not really go out anywhere right now.  This also says it will plump fine lines and wrinkles in three minutes.  Which I can say yes it does.  It just makes my wrinkle on my forehead that I have less noticeable.  It doesn’t really plump it out completely, but that is okay for me because it does make it less noticeable!  The scent of this is a citrus one to me, which I don’t mind it, it doesn’t linger.  I do like the product because I do feel it is doing something but no it’s not a miracle cream that’s going to take your wrinkles away especially if they are deep, but it you have slight ones it will make them less noticeable!  Also I love the pump style packaging.  It does leave my face feeling good and soft, and definitely moisturized.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Sunday Riley C.E.O for honest thought and opinions.  First off when using I instantly smell the citrus scent it has, which I do love scent of it.  I have used and like previous products and this one is no different.   It’s a high quality product that does show results.  My skin has been looking so much healthier and as it states it does brighten.  It’s a 15% vitamin C brightening serum.  I am not sure what percentage other vitamin C are but can definitely tell when I am using this one.  I have been using this for over a month.  I us alone on no makeup  days or even if I am wearing makeup.  I just make sure each layer dries before proceeding with the next and I haven’t had any piling.  I love the packaging it’s a pump style so easy to dispense, glass bottle too.  This is an expensive product but for me it does work, I am seeing results.  No, it’s not going to change everything at once but I have been seeing my skin improve over the past month.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Summer Fridays.  I actually got this at a perfect time, my lips were lightly cracked and dry and needed moisture.  I like that this lip butter is in a tube and the applicator has a curve to it, not just angled.  The curvy applicator glides easily along the lips.  This is lightly scented and does smell like vanilla.  After one day of using this lip butter, I could see and feel the improvements to my lips.  They didn’t feel so chapped and felt moisturized.  My lips were all better, no more dry or chapped lips within three days!  I use it on a daily basis and it does stay on my lips for several hours.  After having the lip butter on my lips for several hours, with my finger I just rub all around my lips removing the excess and apply a fresh layer to my lips.  Perfect for these winter months.  The consistency is also good, it’s not overly thick.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Dermologica sampling.  I have used this daily microfoliant before so I already knew that I liked it, but it had been awhile that I had used it.  Getting to try this again it’s a great daily exfoliant that doesn’t irritate or bother my skin.  I like using this in the shower, because it’s a powder and you add water to make a paste before applying to the face.  It’s a gentle microfoliant that keeps my skin feeling smooth.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This is my first purchase from Summer Fridays, and now I definitely want more. I got a sample of this before a long haul flight and put it on while I was on the plane. For the first time ever, I walked off the 16 hour flight with hydrated skin. My skin is usually dry and gets even drier and more irritated when I travel. This saved the day and I’ve been using it as a sleeping mask since then. It gives a great boost of hydration and I wake up with healthy happy skin. Can’t say enough good things about this. If you’re on the fence, get a sample and try it out. You will not regret it, it’s an absolute must in my routine now

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: If you love the sleeping mask, you will definitely love this. I had to go to 3 different stores to get a backup so that tells you how amazing it is. It’s very hydrating, feels like a regular lip balm, but looks like a lipgloss. The “pear“ shade smells sweet and yummy and goes on clear. While I love the sleeping mask, I only like using it at night because it has exfoliating properties. This is great for daytime use since it does not exfoliate. All in all, I love it!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a DREAM! I didn’t believe the hype at first. I am a skincare fanatic and I didn’t see how a moisturizer could be that life changing, until I tried it myself. I am HOOKED. I have dry skin with a normal t-zone. When I put this on, my skin looks glowy, healthy, and fresh. I can wear this under some of my matte foundations to make them look for natural on my dry skin. This has no glitter particles in it and is definitely not oily. It absorbs quickly into the skin and leaves the face looking dewy. I am in LOVE and will definitely repurchase when I finish it. I should also note that I only use this during the daytime. It is moisturizing enough as a nigh cream, but I don’t want to run out that quickly so I save it for days when I’m wearing makeup.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have tried and consistently used many products from Fresh and they’ve always been great. This night cream is rich and did a really good job hydrating my very dry skin. It has a nice peachy scent that dissipates after application. I gave it three starts because for some reason it broke me out, otherwise it would have been a great night cream

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: I used to use the ceramidin cream from Dr. Jart and wanted to switch things up as the weather gets warmer. I gave this a try and fell in love. It’s just as moisturizing as the ceramidin cream but also helps soothe my skin when it’s red and irritated. I had a few dark spots from previous breakout and this is slowly making them fade away.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got a mini of this in a drunk elephant gift set, and I am now purchasing a full size. I have really dry skin, and on me this doesn’t work on its own as a moisturizer. I like it for the polypeptide complex that it contains and the anti-aging benefits that that has. I use a thin layer of this on my face and follow up with my moisturizer from belif. Together, they leave mu skin looking and feeling hydrated and plump.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I have repurchased so many of these that I lost count at this point. It’s gentle, hydrating, and takes every last bit of makeup off. I still have to follow up with a second cleanser but this is really wonderful for getting the majority of the gunk out of the way. If this is too expensive for you, try the No. 7 cleansing balm which is available at the drugstore for around C$14. It’s very similar to this, the only reason I don’t like it as much is because it is fragranced

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I bought this today and tried it out for the first time tonight. I used the scrub too and when I finished cleansing my skin was so clean and my pores looked minimized, and my blackheads were clearer. I don’t know if it was just the cleanser or the scrub combo, but it was AMAZING. Only a few dollars more than my beloved clinique and definitely well worth the price difference. Drunk Elephant, PLEASE RELEASE THE SCRUB IN A FULL SIZE!!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: I am a skincare junkie but I have to be honest, toner is one step I often used to skip. I just didn’t feel like toners did anything to my skin. That is until I tried this one. No matter why cleansers I use, my dry skin is left feeling pretty dry afterwards. This balances my skin and reintroduces some much needed hydration. My skin is left feeling soft and hydrated. Would definitely repurchase

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I have really dry skin and wanted to incorporate an acid toner into my routine to help with some dark spots left behind from hormonal acne. I really love how this smells and feels on my face. The dark spots on my chin are already fading slowly after two weeks of use. If you have dry skin, I highly recommend you give this a shot. I am usually very sensitive to fragrance, but the smell in this is not overbearing at all and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: This is the MOST glowy dewy setting spray I have ever used. I have about 20 setting sprays in my collection, why I don’t know. This is the only one that is “clean“ and it also happens to be the best for my super dry skin. This in the winter makes me look like I have a filter on my face. Without it I look like a cakey mess even with the lightest coverage products

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This ended up replacing my drunk elephant and my sunday riley acids. While the other two products work out really well, this is equally as great and has a higher concentration of acids in it PLUS it’s CHEAPER. Can’t go wrong with that, and I love how it applies and how glowy my skin looks the next morning. It’s also a huge bonus that it comes from a clean brand. TOTAL WIN!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: The best!!! I use this everywhere for everything! It helps keep my sensitive skin moisturized without any reactions. It’s great used as a body or hand lotion--nongreasy, aborbs quickly. I slather it all over my face when I’m using retinol, when it’s super dry (airplane, outside, inside, EVERYWHERE). I have several different sizes stashed all over the house and in every purse because you never know when you need some.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: My favorite acid based mask. I have sensitive skin so I use this once every few weeks or so in conjunction with other masks/skincare. Nothing beats the glow I get afterwards. Definitely recommend using DE’s marula oil immediately after.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a great eye cream. I love the texture and think it really delivered when it came to hydration and nourishment, on the fence about the brightening (leaning towards some effects noticeable by the time the container was finished). I think the container is bulky but I love the pump to keep things hygienic.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I think this is a good cleansing balm, but not my favorite. It did not irritate my sensitive skin but I did find it bothered my eyes more than other balms. It does a great job removing makeup and sunscreen but I think is more stripping than other balms.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I think this is a good cleansing balm, but not my favorite. It did not irritate my sensitive skin but I did find it bothered my eyes more than other balms. It does a great job removing makeup and sunscreen but I think is more stripping than other balms.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Possibly could be my favorite balm...I love that there’s no detectable scent, it’s smooth and has no texture but isn’t too soft, it has a great non-greasy finish when washed off (I don’t feel like I *have* to double cleanse afterwards unlike other balms I’ve tried), and that it comes with a little scooper. I can’t say that I’ll never try another brand but I am very impressed with this one.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Possibly could be my favorite balm...I love that there’s no detectable scent, it’s smooth and has no texture but isn’t too soft, it has a great non-greasy finish when washed off (I don’t feel like I *have* to double cleanse afterwards unlike other balms I’ve tried), and that it comes with a little scooper. reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I had high expectations and feel slightly let down. The mask has a great thick gel like consistency with no strong scent or taste. It does an OK job in repairing dry lips, but isn’t a miracle worker. I think after several days consistently using it, it does improve dry, chapped lips, but it’s not a one night thing. I don’t love the packaging...it’s annoying to scoop product out with the spoon and then have a sticky spoon lying around, so I just dab the tiniest amount on my finger. Not sanitary, but it’s so much easier. I love tatcha’s products, but feel like this isn’t their best work.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: LOVE! This is exactly what I’ve been looking for. I love that my skin has the perfect glow to is (the most perfect shade for my fair complexion) with solid SPF. Now I don’t have to layer on a bunch of creams/products to get a glow with pilling or waiting a while to let the layers set. I think it gave a decent amount of hydration (will likely be the perfect amount of hydration when summer/humidity hits). This is all I need when I just want a little oomph to my bare skin.

reviews.review_text: Super impressed with this impulse purchase...i have yet to find a cleansing balm or oil worth repurchasing. I think this is a winner. The price cannot be beat. I love the formula and prefer the tube over potted balms. I hate digging my fingers into cleansing balms. The formula is really nice. Pleasant non-fragrance smell. It feels moisturizing and calming and does what it says it will do--took of an entire day’s worth of grime, sunscreen, and makeup. It’s a great first step in a double cleanse set up and I will for sure be repurchasing. Now I just wish they made a travel sized tube.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I am incredibly impressed with this cream. This performs just as well or maybe even better than more expensive “triple lipid“ creams out there. I love the pump v. dunking your into a jar or using a teeny spoon to get product. The texture is lovely--its light, yet thick. My skin is hydrated without feeling oily all day. It doesn’t pill under sunscreen. This will definitely be a staple for me now.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment

I do appreciate that it is no longer a blue colored cream. I hate that it’s still a cream in a jar requiring my hands to be dunked in or using the stupid teeny spoon. It has a beautiful texture, feels nourishing and rich on without being heavy or sticky. I wake up with glowy, calm, moisturized skin. I don’t have to use my usual squalane oil on top of PM moisturizer to feel properly hydrated.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I tried the water cream during the summer for the first time and I love it!! At first I thought this is just a normal cream and kinda regret buying it, BUT after about 2 weeks - a month i finally SEE the heavenly effect of this moisturize!! It transformed my skin so nice and everyone gave me compliment!! When this new Dewy Skin Cream came out, I had to get it right away because my skin is very dry during the summer.  I absolutely love this. It made my skin very different and alot nicer after a few days using it. I would never want to use any other brand but Tatcha. Highly recommended!!!

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: Def worth it. You will see the difference after a few days- a week using. Make sure only use it at night though because it has vitamin C

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Fine lines gone but not as moisturizing as lala
reviews.review_text: The lala retro whipped cream is my holy grail moisturizer. It’s the right balance of deep moisture and non greasy. I also love the Marula oil, c firma and baby facial by DE. So when I saw they were coming out with a moisturizer with a peptide complex, I was pumped. I love skincare that has multiple benefits. So I knew I would be into a product that moisturized as well as had anti aging properties. With that being said, there are pros and cons to this. If you are just looking for a good moisturizer, get the lala retro. It feels luxurious and there’s nothing on the market quite like it. This product doesn’t do as good of a job at moisturizing my skin. I have normal skin, but I notice after using this product, my skin feels somewhat tight as if it were dry. With that being said, the fine lines in my forehead and my smile lines have almost completely disappeared. While I’m only 24, they were pretty prominent and caused my foundation to sink in pretty noticeably. This changed that almost overnight. Used in conjunction with a facial oil (I use de Marula, Sunday Riley luna, or Sunday Riley Juno depending on my mood), and the “tight” feeling is no longer there. If you don’t want that extra step, I might pass on this and opt for the lala retro. However, the minimizing of my fine lines has got me hooked.

reviews.review_text: I’ve tried a ton of cleansers. My two holy grails before this were the korres Greek yoghurt and philosophy purity. Both are amazing but this one knocks both out of the park. It’s in an entirely different league. It manages to get my face completely clean, without stripping it, and somehow still make it feel insanely soft? I use this at night with my Michael Todd facial brush and the difference when I use something else is noticeable. I’ve suffered my whole live from very noticeable blackheads on my nose. This completely erases them. It’s honestly unreal. If you buy this, you won’t regret it.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Being spoiled by DE moisturizer packaging, it’s a little weird going back to jar packaging. But it’s worth the sacrifice for this. I switched last year from drunk elephant lala retro to their protini and I LOVE protini. But I found that it wasn’t enough hydration for me at night. Lala retro is great, but it’s a little heavy for my preferences now. This yttp is is the perfect middle ground between protini and lala. It’s more of a “cream” consistency rather than a gel like protini, but not nearly as heavy as lala. It soaks into the skin and leaves so greasy layer or film. It gives enough hydration at night while also laying beautifully under makeup. Definitely worth the money if you’re looking for a solid moisturizer that makes your skin super soft.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Although it is too early to tell what long term improvements this will make in my under eye area, I love it so far! It is nice and light and leaves my skin moisturized without leaving a sticky residue. Not overly fragranced and the packaging is perfection because it doesnt allow light in and keeps the product fresh. I cant wait to see the improvements this continues to make to my skin!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I usually am pretty particular about my eye creams. I like them to be very moisturizing, sink in quickly, work well with my makeup routine, and they can’t leave a sticky or tacky feeling. I’m so happy to be able to find this cream because it checks off all those boxes for me. It’s a very rich creamy texture but isn’t oily at all. It’s layered well under my concealer, and still kept my eye area plump and hydrated all day.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: My skin IS glowing after using the fabulous GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator! Looks and feels fabulous! Goopbeauty gifted me this amazing exfoliator to try! This product is a spa treatment in a jar.  Using this air whipped cream is a relaxing and enjoyable experience. Living in the desert of AZ, my skin’s normal state of being is dry and dull.  This product has not only brightened my complexion, but has also refreshed my look! I find my favorite time to use this mask is before bedtime.  It’s creamier then I thought it would be and seems to melt into my face as I massage it in.   The texture is not rough or harsh, yet strong enough to really slough off dead skin.  Leaving the product on for 3 minutes is very comfortable and soothing.  I enjoyed the scent but even more so, the results.   While rinsing off with warm water I could  feel the difference!  In an instant, I had a rosy cheeked, bright complexion. My skin became dewy and velvet soft.  I just love the visual difference and feel this mask has made to my skin.   My experience.....clear skin that looks smooth, clean and healthy!  Luminous! P.S Love that GOOP formulas are not tested on animals!

reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary to test and review, and was very pleasantly surprised! This is now a staple in my routine, and something I carry with me. Highly recommend!!

reviews.review_text: I love how well this worked! My skin felt hydrated and looked clear and smooth after using, with my pores appearing smaller. The scent was interesting- definitely a natural watermelon scent versus the expected artificial scent.

reviews.review_text: Have been using once a day more or less regularly for a few months now and can honestly say that on the days that I wear this my skin does look clearer and brighter. reviews.review_text: I saw all the good reviews about this mask, and knew I had to try it! I’m so glad I did because it made my lips much better after just one use! Lo and behold, my pucker was soft and healed the very next morning!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I LOVED this skin resurfacing serum! It took my dull dry skin to nice plump glowing skin! Fresh skincare truly never disappoints! My skin began to pull after about two days of use. After my skin began to pull it left me with glowing skin!

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this cleanser!  First, it smells amazing.  Not perfumey, but a nice yummy smell.  Love the soft foam it makes when I use it just to cleanse and love the way my skin feels afterwards.  I don’t feel like my skin is totally stripped of all the moisture it contains.  I also liked the effects after using it as a mask.  I think this is an excellent product and very effective.  I did receive this product as a gift through Brandbassador, but the opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: This is definitely a good eye cream!  I am plagued with dark circles and since I started using this I have noticed a bit of a decrease in the appearance of their darkness.  It also depuffs the under eyes very well.  It is very conveniently dispensed for easy application.  It doesn’t have a strong scent, which is a huge plus for me.  I would definitely purchase this again for myself when this is gone.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: This cream came through for my skin when the colder weather was doing it’s best to destroy it!  It is wonderful!  It is thick and creamy.  It is so moisturizing.  It leaves my skin feeling supple and soft.  The scent is not bad at all.  It is barely noticeable.  I don’t like skincare product with heavy scents.  This is not a problem at all with this one.  It also comes with a convenient spatula.  That is so important and adds that extra touch of luxury and sanitation.  I definitely love this one and would purchase it again when this is gone!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this serum.  Eye serums are incredible and this is one of the best I have tried.  I love the texture and it absorbs very easily leaving my skin nice and hydrated.  I will definitely continue to use this and highly recommend it to everyone!

reviews.review_text: I got a sample size of this. It’s seems to be good for very dry skin. But if your skin is not that dry and/or you’re using it when it’s warm, it might make you oily.

reviews.review_text: This is a good lightweight moisturizer. It has a nice texture, absorbs well, and has a very mild scent. It’s not great for very dry skin though. My skin got really dry over the winter, and this was not cutting it. I had to use a different moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: I initially got the light shade, which was too light. I had to put multiple drops just to see a difference, so I ended up getting the medium shade. With the medium shade, I usually do one drop for my face and 2 drops per pump of lotion for my body. This does seem like more work than the other methods because you have to repeat the method of getting a pump of lotion and putting 1 or more drops to cover your body. But it’s not sticky, doesn’t stain, doesn’t get on surfaces (like the spray), and overall does a good job.

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water
reviews.review_text: I wanted to try this mainly because the tanning drops seems like a lot of work sometimes. This allows me to just do a few sprays and rub. What I don’t like about this is that the product gets on the floor and the spray bottle can be hard to use. The continuous spray bottle would definitely work better. It also leaves the body a little sticky. I’d say takes a least 20 minutes for the stickiness to go away. But overall, this does give a good result.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have to say this is the best exfoliant I’ve ever used. I received a small sample and honestly waited awhile before trying it. When I did I was surprised how smooth my face felt. You only need to use a small slightly bigger then a  pea sized amount for your entire face. Wish it wasn’t as pricey but I plan on repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have to say this is the best exfoliant I’ve ever used. I received a small sample and honestly waited awhile before trying it. When I did I was surprised how smooth my face felt. You only need to use a small slightly bigger then a  pea sized amount for your entire face. Wish it wasn’t as pricey but I plan on repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product. I wish it wasn’t so pricey but I always end up coming back to it as it’s the best HA that I’ve used so far.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I used this product and found it to be a good eye product. They give you a nice amount and it lasted for a hood while. I would purchase again.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t super wowed with this moisturizer. I love Glow Recipe but this moisturizer was under whelming all together. I wouldn’t recommend. It’s not the worst thing by any means but nothing special.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t super wowed with this moisturizer. I love Glow Recipe but this moisturizer was under whelming all together. I wouldn’t recommend. It’s not the worst thing by any means but nothing special.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is a solid hood product. It helps with redness and moisturizing too. I wish you got more for the price. That’s the only downfall. Not sure if I will repurchase since I wish there was more.

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for like 3 months and have to say it’s great!  My skin has never been this clear and smooth. It’s hard to find exfoliants that stand out but this one was a pleasant surprise.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product absolutely lives up to its name, it really is magic!! I’ve never used a moisturizer that absorbs so fast into the skin as this one. I have normal skin, and I can instantly feel the added hydration after I apply the moisturizer. I purchased one for my mom as well and she loves it too! It’s creamy and rich without being too heavy or greasy, but it does have a slight initial scent that fades away quickly. I personally love using this moisturizer to prep my skin before makeup as a smooth, hydrating base!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I have been searching for a good sunscreen and let me tell you this is the one! I love Glow Recipe, and I was so excited when they dropped a SPF! It’s super lightweight and blends easily without leaving a white cast. My skin feels so hydrated when I apply it and stays hydrated throughout the day. With other sunscreens, I tend to get oily and feel greasy towards the end of the day but not with this one!! I cant wait to see the skincare benefits it provides after a few weeks.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I really like this sunscreen! I was worried because the product dispenses out a little orange tinted, but it blends out to a really nice bronzey glow when applied. I don’t typically go for the super glowy dew look, so if I’m wearing the sunscreen with no makeup I just set it with translucent powder to take some of the shine away

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This was gifted by Fresh, but I’m already a huge fan of the Fresh lip products! This is a new favorite of mine! First of all the package is so luxurious, it’s very sturdy and has weight to it. I love the subtle touch of color, just enough to enhance my natural lip color but also has a buildable coverage. My lips have been so dry lately and this lip treatment keeps them hydrated all day long!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is wonderful! I have concerns about the dullness and texture of my skin so I was excited to try this new serum out. It’s very hydrating and brightening while having a very lightweight formula, which I love!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I love that this retinol serum provides a super Easy way to ease into adding retinol to my skincare routine! It has a really nice consistency with a light scent, which I don’t mind at all. So far I love the results I’ve been seeing!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I love that this retinol serum provides a super Easy way to ease into adding retinol to my skincare routine! It has a really nice consistency with a light scent, which I don’t mind at all. So far I love the results I’ve been seeing!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m a sucker for a good moisturizer. I love the feeling of deeply hydrated skin. This moisturizer feels so good when applying. It’s creamy and intensely hydrating with a slight rose scent. It smells delicious and not too strong. I’ll be using it mainly at night as I’m using a moisturizer with SPF during the day.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: PRO: - lovely unique packaging. makes for a great gift. - comfortable scent, smells like roses but not too strong - hydrating CONS:- it’s a nice lightweight moisturizer but I don’t like the marketing behind it that is required to justify the price - overpriced for such a tiny jar- made my skin itch I can see that this goes the La Mer marketing route and is made for a specific kind of clientele. Nothing wrong with that but it’s still just a lightweight moisturizer. In a very pretty packaging.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Lovely serum that feels very hydrating with a subtle but gorgeous scent. Feels a lot more hydrating than most serums I’ve tried . I know that because usually I feel the need to apply moisturizer right after I use a serum but in this case I’ve actually totally forgotten to use any moisturizer after and yet my skin feels super hydrated! Great product!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Loving a good exfoliating experience! This doesn’t disappoint. Made my skin feel super smooth after. Since it’s in powder form it’s perfect for traveling! Definitely helps clear up the skin and fight impurities.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Loving a good exfoliating experience! This doesn’t disappoint. Made my skin feel super smooth after. Since it’s in powder form it’s perfect for traveling! Definitely helps clear up the skin and fight impurities.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I’ve never used pore strips before . It says Apply a nose strip or pore strip, tacky-side down, on clean, dry skin. After four to six hours, gently remove the strips. I wear them overnight and wake up with very clean feeling skin! Not sure about big changes as I don’t really have any major skin concerns.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: Feel amazing on my freshly cleaned skin almost like a serum and it’s super hydrating. The price is a bit high but the product feels incredible. My skin is on the dry side and this serum helps with that !

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted to me by Sunday Riley and since I’ve started using it, I’ve noticed a difference in my skin’s appearance! It is getting clearer, brighter, and I am starting to really get hooked! Thank you :)

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Have been looking for a moisturizer for a very, very long time and so glad to have finally found one that works. I use it every morning and evening and find that my face is a lot happier since I started to use it. Love!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I have been trying this cream for a little bit of time now, and I am definitely noticing the effects that it has on my skin. It certainly helps my skin to stay hydrated and moisturized. Will continue using it to see long-term effects!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I have been trying this cream for a little bit of time now, and I am definitely noticing the effects that it has on my skin. It certainly helps my skin to stay hydrated and moisturized. Will continue using it to see long-term effects!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Just recently started using this product and so far really like it. Love the texture, how easy it is to apply it and that I’m starting to notice my under eye area looking brighter. Looking forward to seeing how this transforms my eyes overtime

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Just recently received and started using this product. So far really like it, my skin after use looks smoother and firmer, and I’m noticing a more even skin tone, as well. Will continue applying the product to see further results.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Just recently received and started using this product. So far really like it, my skin after use looks smoother and firmer, and I’m noticing a more even skin tone, as well. Will continue applying the product to see further results.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Just started using this product and it’s not become my favorite, go-to lip balm. Beautiful shade, that’s very buildable, and hydrating. Would definitely get another one upon running out of this one. gifted by Fresh

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Although pricey, this is a wonderful product that lasts a while.  It’s velvety smooth and my skin soaks it in.  It does diminish fine lines over time.

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: I originally tried this in the illumination version, and it was too glittery in my opinion.  However, I received this as a sample and it’s super great. I wouldn’t say that it is full coverage though. I have used bare minerals powder foundation for a very long time, and wanted to try something new.  This definitely is worth the try. When applied with the 702 brush, it goes on quick and easy. I am mixing it into my rotation from now on.  I asked my fiance if he noticed that it looked too light/dark, uneven, cakey, etc and he said “it doesn’t look like you’re wearing anything.“  BINGO!  It just gives off a nice smooth finish, the color is perfect, and I am very happy I tried this version. *I take back the poor review of the 702 brush - I initially tried it with a powder foundation and it was not great.*  That’s the thing about all of these products - they might have to be stored a specific way, or used a particular way, to ensure the best payoff. If you are applying them wrong, or ordering illumination when you really like matte, of course issues will come up.  Knowledge is power!

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Received this as a sample and I absolutely love it!  It is so incredibly luxurious, silky, smooth and hydrating.  I will definitely purchase a full size.  My lids as well as my under eye area love it.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: This is a pretty cool product.  You definitely can’t beat the price. I have been using this for a few weeks, twice a week, and it really does make a difference.  It doesn’t burn in my experience, but it does tingle a little, more like a tickle.  But retinol and things like that don’t bother my skin, so I must have a higher tolerance to these types of products.  It easily applies, it’s kind of like a serum.  When I wash it off, I immediately notice how my skin is glowing and the wrinkles in my forehead look way less noticeable.   I definitely invest in skin care products if they are worth it and actually provide results, and this one isn’t really even an investment at the price point and it does work. I recommend if your skin can tolerate these stronger types of products.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have used the same sensitive skin Aveeno cleanser for a lot of years.  I got this one as a sample and immediately fell in love with it.  Some time passed and I decided to buy a full size.It is so creamy, silky, luxurious and it smells amazing. It foams up beautifully and removes all of my makeup, even stubborn eyeliner and mascara.  It’s definitely a luxury face wash in my opinion.  It’s more pricey that what I am used to but it is incredibly worth it.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: This is by far the best sunscreen for your face that there is.  It’s a clear-ish gel that is silky, fast absorbing, and scentless.  It feels great going on, and does not pill with your actual skincare.  There is no white cast, nothing to rub in until the color wears off.  I also put this on my neck and hands.  What a genius product!  I’m so glad I decided to try it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: This is by far the best sunscreen for your face that there is.  It’s a clear-ish gel that is silky, fast absorbing, and scentless. reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I was looking for a plain/simple type of moisturizer, so I picked this one.  I wasn’t super impressed with it, although I will say that if your skin is irritated in any way (redness/dryness, etc.) this is good to use because it doesn’t further irritate the skin.  I feel the Inn Beauty slushy serum and next level moisturizer work way better.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Omg! I used to use the Unseen but I’m a glow fan so I bought this one. I’ll still use and rebuy the Unseen for going for outside runs/walks and going to the beach, but the Glowscreen is now my everyday sunscreen, but again, I’m a glow addict! If you don’t like the dewy effect then this is not for you!

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Omg! I used to use the Unseen but I’m a glow fan so I bought this one. I’ll still use and rebuy the Unseen for going for outside runs/walks and going to the beach, but the Glowscreen is now my everyday sunscreen, but again, I’m a glow addict! If you don’t like the dewy effect then this is not for you!

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a strong retinol, so if you’re not used to retinol, you need to slow down, and use it only a few days a week and work your way up to every day. I used AHA for years (more than 10) everyday, and I LOVE the glow effect that AHA gives me, but now that I’m close to 40 I started using retinol (when I was 37). I still prefer AHA for the aspect of the skin, BUT I understand that retinol works better when we talk about reducing fine lines. If you break out when using retinol and you say you don’t like it, that your skin doesn’t get used to it, it’s probably bc you’re not moisturizing it properly. You really need a very good moisturizer on top of the retinol to prevent breaking out. I’m a skin care addict, started using Vit C when I was 22, added AHA to the routine when I was 29, and over the last 3 years I added the retinol to my routine. Because I love AHA once a week a use the Babyfacial from Drunk Elephant and I use this retinol on the other days of the week. I mix it with Vit C + Some oil (either Marula or Rose Hip) + moisturizer (whatever I have). If you want to be extra extra extra with the moist and protection of your skin hydration when using retinol I would highly recommend the Pharmacy Honey Saviour Balm OR the REN ultra comforting rescue mask.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this, but I only like it. It’s a good cleanser, but just prefer cleansers that will make my skin soft and moist. It’s a matter of preference. But it’s a good cleanser and makes my skin shinny and bright after using it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this, but I only like it. It’s a good cleanser, but just prefer cleansers that will make my skin soft and moist. It’s a matter of preference. But it’s a good cleanser and makes my skin shinny and bright after using it.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: After several try outs, this is my favorite daytime moisturizer to mix with Vit C. It gives me the perfect moist after the cleanser before sunscreen and make up. I’ve tried the ID Clinique, and it’s ok, but for me this is better. I super hydrate my skin at night, so Every morning I just need a little something to nourish and protect my skin. It’s super delicate but it does what it needs to do. Will def buy another one after I finish the ID Clinique one.If this is the only moisturizer you’re planning to have, then I would say you’ll prob need something else for winter time, but if you’re looking for something light to mix with Vit C, before your daytime routine, this is perfect!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: MUST HAVE! This is essentially a peeling (the least strongest) you’d get with a dermatologist. It’s perfect to use it once a week if you’re using retinol on the other nights of the week.I’m a skin care junkie and this have been part of my routine since 2015 and I’ll never leave it. I’m addicted to the AHA glowy effect and I’ve been using AHA or glycolic acid since I’m 29 (I’m about to turn 40!), but over the last 3 years I switched to retinol... Bc of course... fine lines! But the babyfacial once a week (I don’t use the retinol on the day I use the babyfacial) changes the whole game. It gives you exactly what it says it can do - give you a baby/younger skin texture. It’s on my top 3 list!

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite eye cream. It has a very light texture but it really hydrates my eyes. I even use it on my lids. I’m not sure about the dark circles, but my eyes are so hydrated after using this that the brightness of the skin surely helps with that restful look we all love.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a great night time cream! It’s so hydrating and leaves my skin feeling rejuvenated with every application. I’m really enjoying using this product in my skin care regimen now.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for testing purposes from Influenster, and I am blown away by it! It leaves my skin feeling silky smooth and compared to my alternative moisturizer this one is even better!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary as a sample to try for my honest review and I am really enjoying it! It makes my skin feel so fresh.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed using this product. I found it to be quite hydrating on my skin and would overall highly recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: So far I’m really enjoy using this product. It makes you look well rested.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is awesome! I love how well it hydrates and brightens the skin. It had so many great benefits to using it.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: holy grail product!!! stopped using it for about a month to try other stuff that didn’t work out, when I started using it again I noticed just how much it positively affects my skin! No more acne and smooths out my pores. Will always use from now on!!!!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: After trying it once my face, like a lot of other people’s, went bright red from irritation and it felt like it was burning my skin. Yet, this happened to me with other products such as with the Ordinary’s niacidamide because my skin wasn’t used to the formula (but I now love the product). It just takes a while for your skin to get used to it.The key is to try a patch test first, then start by only putting a thin layer on your face before adding more. For me, by the third time using this I had no irritation and love to wear it overnight and it has really helped me with my winter dry skin! I took a star off mostly because the instructions aren’t that clear about how to use it (aka do a patch test first) which I definitely will start doing with all new skincare products I try!

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I tried the 6 pack on one spot on my forehead twice a week for three weeks. Short term was really good and it did smooth them out a little bit but long term I feel like it didn’t do that much. I will be repurchasing soon to see if it has lasting benefits! For a patch it’s pretty good so the 4 stars are deserved!

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_title: I have sensitive skin and I love this!
reviews.review_text: I had no expectations for this product since I have sensitive skin and these types of products usually upset it. But I ended up loving this! Has such a great scent that’s not too overpowering, and makes me skin look so plump and glowy. I’ve had no adverse reactions and will be purchasing this after I run out! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: Claims: • Cooling • Plumping • Hydrating As far as these claims go I would definitely agree! On first contact it absorbs and instantly cools. The intense hydration left my skin feeling supple and hydrated without feeling greasy! I also haven’t experienced any bad reactions or breakouts. I don’t know if this will become a staple in my routine but I have been loving it after exfoliating or using a clay mask!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: New go to second cleanse for sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: I’m a huge fan of this cleanser. At first I was unsure of the texture as it starts off grainy, but as you add water it becomes the most light (slightly foaming) cream texture that feels so cleansing on the skin without stopping it.⁣⁣Compared to traditional cream cleansers I have used, The Rice Wash leaves my skin feeling completely clear of any leftover makeup and impurities and I would absolutely agree with their claims that over time this leaves skin feeling softer and more hydrated! ⁣⁣My only complaint is the fragrance (which is fairly strong). I wish this was a bit more subtle however, it has not irritated my skin in any way, this is just personal preference. ⁣⁣ I think this is perfect for dry, normal, combo, and especially sensitive skin types and I will be repurchasing this cleanser after I finish it! ⁣⁣I received this cleanser free for testing purposes through Influesnter. #complimentary #myricewash

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this the past couple of nights and have instantly noticed a difference in my skin texture! I have pretty dry skin, especially around the wintertime, and my makeup really clings to my dry patches but this serum has noticeably made a difference in my skin prep just from using it at night! The only complaint I have about this product is the weird smell that lingers FOREVER on your hands and face after applying.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I thought this oil was all hype until I received a sample of this product in a goodie bag and found myself literally scraping the bottom once it was empty. Not only does this incredibly gentle oil hydrate my skin, but it visibly reduces the redness and irritation caused by my hormonal acne! My pimples usually vanish overnight, or are noticeably smaller after using this as well! I just can’t go back to using my regular facial oil - this is too good. If you have dry, irritated skin, or are simply looking for a way to hydrate and soothe your skin during the harsh winter climate, this is worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Initially, I was hesitant to use this product after receiving it as a gift because of its grainy texture - but I found that after a couple of uses, I absolutely LOVED it. It’s perfect for gentle physical exfoliation - getting rid of dead skin cells, dullness, etc. - but also doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry or dehydrated after. Despite my initial thoughts and assumptions about this product, I saw a visible reduction in the amount of blackheads on my nose and chin after a week of consistent use! I think I’ll keep using this product 2-3 times a week for max results.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I had never heard of this brand before I got a box from Influenster to try out two of their face washes. I’m happy I did because I really liked both products. I already reviewed the Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash, which I personally favored of the two, but this is still a great face wash and one I can see many loving. It is a simple tube with a snap cap and comes in a clear, gel form. The fragrance gives me cucumber and soy, which I found refreshing and not very strong, but if you’re sensitive to either of those, just be mindful. This was extremely  gentle on my skin which is on the sensitive side. It didn’t lather much, but it did leave my skin clean and not stripped of moisture. I had my boyfriend try it after he got sunburned to wash his face, and it was extremely gentle for him as well, while still cleaning his skin. Overall, I think this is a great option for those who have sensitive skin, or simply prefer a gentler but still effective facial cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Full disclosure: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe for review. However, whether a product is gifted or personally purchased by myself, I always give my honest thoughts. This is a moisturizing serum that comes in a glass bottle with pump dispenser. I love the minimalistic, pastel aesthetic. It is cute, but still elegant enough for any age. The color is a light pink and the serum has a watermelon scent that isn’t overly sweet or heavy.  After cleanser and toning, I use two pumps to apply to my face. The texture is smooth, spreads easily, and my skin absorbed it quickly.  It was hydrating to my skin without leaving a tacky residue or sitting heavy.  Depending on how dry my skin is on a particular day, I may or may not use an additional cream moisturizer on top of the serum. If I do, it’s usually in the evening. During the day, I like this alone because it was a good base for when I used makeup. It applied well to my skin by gliding over and not getting patchy from stickiness or pilling. I think this would be good for most skin types.  My skin has some sensitivities, and I would describe it as combo as I get a bit oily around my nose or chin. It does gets drier during the winter, so I this is better for the summer months for me. I noticed no negative effects while using this serum. No redness or congestion. Overall, I am very happy with my experience with this product, and would definitely recommend. The packaging is so cute, so I think this would make such a nice gift item for any beauty enthusiast.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is incredible. You always hear people say “I saw results after the first use“ and I always roll my eyes like yea okay sure you did, sis. Well this product totally left me speechless after rinsing it off. My skin felt sooo smooth. What texture?! It looked so bright and even. It does tingle when applying and the instructions on the insert that the jar comes with does state that that is normal. This is a chemical exfoliant. The tingling goes away after a minute or two and my skin was not irritated at all. I urge you to give this a try. I love this waaaay more than the Drunk Elephant Babyfacial and it’s a fraction of the price. You won’t be disappointed with this mask.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: As a skin care junkie, I find it hard to try a new product and stick to it long enough to pinpoint it as the one true queen of changing my skin. I bought this months ago and that was the case; I tried it, it was nice, didn’t notice anything “miraculous” with inconsistent use in between using other  serums that did seem to brighten and smooth overnight. Fast forward to last month when my skin had a *terrible* rash/reaction (not from this product) that I had to go see my primary care manager for. It was itchy, so irritated that I could only use cool water, and thus it became extremely dry and literally flaking off. After some medicated treatment, I was able to return to my normal skin care products and decided to pick this back up because I remembered how gentle it was. You guys...this stuff did work a miracle! I’ve been using it day and night for two weeks now and my skin feels softer than it has in my whole life, even before my skin rash. I’ve always had a little texture but now, literally nothing. It’s so plump and smooth and well hydrated but not at all greasy or oily. It works beautifully under makeup as well. There is no scent that I can tell and my skin has not been irritated one bit. Bottom line: it is not going to work overnight, like say, the Farmacy Honeymoon Glow. But in my opinion the honeymoon doesn’t produce long term effects. This product, I use one pump twice a day and my skin has literally transformed. It is a gradual improvement but a beautiful one nonetheless. I highly highly recommend!

reviews.review_text: With Good Genes All-in-One Lactic Acid Treatment, you’ll be more than pleased with the results. You’ll love the fresh lemon grass sent. Lemon grass being one of the key ingredients. Other key ingredients include, arnica; which helps soothe the skin by reducing the look of skin discomfort. One of the most hydrating ingredients would be purified lactic acid. It deeply exfoliates the surface of the skin, as well as, helping fight any build up of dead skin cells and sebum. It diminishes the look of discolorations and dark spots, while plumping the appearance of fine lines. Which I sometimes suffer from when my skin looks dull and dry. It’s recommended to apply as a mask for sensitive skin, you’ll apply to dry skin then wash off after 15 minutes. You may also use it as a leave on treatment, applying moisturizer afterwards. I use this as a leave on treatment over night and wash off in the morning. It’s suggested to limit any sun exposure while using this product and for a week afterwards. This is due to this product having alpha hydroxy acid. You apply 1-2 pumps, but I believe one pump is more than enough. The first night of using this as a leave on treatment overnight, I noticed less fine lines. I believe what mostly impressed me with this product was how hydrated my skin looked and felt. Your skin will have a natural glow and you will notice a much more even skin tone. Really impressed and highly recommend! Complimentary from Sunday Riley, in exchange for my honest review.

It really gets into your pours to help clean it out and then you can follow your normal routine. I can tell a difference in just how I feel after using this. I feel much cleaner and face feels much lighter from all the guck and grime throughout the day.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This product had a very light fresh scent. A very fast acting chemical exfoliant. Perfect for those late nights when you want a quick treatment. The white balls wash off very easily and my face was left feeling soft and smooth. It was also very gentle as I have sensitive skin and did not experience any burning or irritation. Thank you influenster and huda for allowing me to try this product for free. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
