reviews.review_text: This product had a very light fresh scent. A very fast acting chemical exfoliant. Perfect for those late nights when you want a quick treatment. reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: One of the best day time moisturizers for oily combination skin. This is light weight, moisturizing and absorbs quickly making it awesome for wearing under makeup. Will always repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was so excited when I got this yo review from influenster. It has a rich smooth consistency that absorbs instantly with a more tolerable scent than most. My skin has been smooth and glowy with no irritation or discomfort. Would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: A really great daytime moisturizer sinks in really quick leaving a smooth canvas for makeup. It has a nice fresh scent and pairs well with the oil for night time.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: The B-hydra intensive hydration serum quenched my thirsty skin especially this winter season. My skin would be super dry and tight, this moisturizer helped my skin get the moisture and hydration it needs which I know will help diminish fine lines caused by aging. I love that it has a gentle, clean scent and that it is easily absorbed into the skin. I highly reccommend!

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Great face sunscreen! I like that it has a gentle scent that’s not to overpowering. It is a little thick when applied and doesn’t get absorbed quickly so I would leave it alone on my face for 5-10 minutes before I would put makeup on. It doesn’t make my face look oily at all and doesn’t cause any skin irritation. I highly reccommend!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: The Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream has helped diminish the appearance of fine lines on my eyes. I was born with already puffy eyes so I really don’t expect for anything to happen with just a month of use. I definitely saw the difference on the fine lines as I begin to see that it makes the skin mousturized and supple. Hence, avoiding fine lines to get deeper. I love the luxurious smell and feel of ths cream. It is easily gets absorbed in the skin so I can use it with or without a concealer. It makes my eyes look a little bit more awake. I love it and highly reccommend!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I got to try this as part of a deluxe sample. It’s definitely one of the best makeup removers I’ve ever used. It’s good for taking off liquid lipstick and I use it as a final defense to get rid of residual eye make-up. Wish it was less costly but it does its job.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I got to try this as part of a deluxe sample. It’s definitely one of the best makeup removers I’ve ever used. It’s good for taking off liquid lipstick and I use it as a final defense to get rid of residual eye make-up. Wish it was less costly but it does its job.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I like using the Origins Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream underneath my makeup. It reduces the appearance of my dark circles and it is hydrating. The dark circles aren’t completely covered but it is lessened. It blends into my skin quickly. I like the use of Vitamin C and Niacinamide in the product. Compared to other eye creams I’ve used, this is better at reducing the appearance of my dark circles while wearing the product. I’d like to see the long-term effects though to see if it reduces dark circles over time. I would consider re-purchasing. I would recommend it to my friends.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The IT Cosmetics Confidence in a Cream is a very moisturizing product. Thanks to the squalane, my face feels hydrated and soft. My skin looks plumped when I use it. It has helped with some of my dark spots in combination with other products. It has a nice, light scent to it. I tried the original product years ago and it didn’t work with my skin so I’m glad they changed up the formula. It’s a pretty hefty price tag but I do like the product and would consider re-purchasing when it is finished. In addition, I think this is a product that my aunt would enjoy so I’d recommend it to her.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff!! The picture is a before and after of an entire routine I recently started. I was only washing and moisturizing when finally at 30 years old I realized I needed to do more for my skin. No experience with acids whatsoever, I bought this. It stings pretty bad when first applying but after a few seconds I don’t feel it at all. No irritation afterwards as long as I follow up with TO Hyaluronic Acid and my moisturizer (Weleda Skin Food)Since I have incorporated other things in my routine I can’t give this product ALL of the credit but I give it most of the credit. I truly believe this is the one that has made such a difference. I know they say don’t use it if you’re a newbie to acids, but I haven’t had any problems. My skin has never looked better!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this serum! It really helps my skin retain moisture. I change up my routine periodically to try out new products - but this is THE one I can’t go without. I use twice a day and always follow up with moisturizer. My skins feels hydrated and soft all the time.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I’ve used the caramel for a couple of years now. I haven’t ventured out to the other flavors because I love it so much. My lips feel so luxurious and hydrated. I’ll continue to buy this.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have oily acne prone dehydrated skin, so it’s a lot of trial and error for my skincare regimen. I really wanted to love this so much, but it broke me out pretty bad. The packaging is nice and the consistency of the cream is okay, but I will be returning this product. Going to try Tatcha next.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I bought this in the travel size to test it out because I have combination skin. Oily acne prone on my cheeks and chin, dry nose and forehead. This just wasn’t enough for my dry areas. I felt like like I needed to reapply less than an hour later. I like that it literally feels like water on you skin but it’s just not moisturizing enough. I didn’t even finish the little jar. If you have very oily skin with no dry areas then this is for you. I have also tried the dewy skin cream which is AMAZING for my skin.

reviews.review_text: I have combination/very sensitive skin. Not only does this mask effectively detoxify my skin but it nourishes it and gives me a nice glow. It stings at first application but goes away in seconds and does not brake me out.

reviews.review_text: Have been using this for a month now and I don’t see a difference in my skin. I had really high hopes for this product, but even the consistency is like water. Will not buy again.

reviews.review_text: This is the second cleansing balm I’ve used, and I’m pretty happy with it. I don’t really wear make up, but I wear sunscreen daily. I use this nightly as part of my double cleanse routine, it’s not stripping which is something I enjoy.

reviews.review_text: It’s not a bad product, but there are definitely better options out there for much less. It smells like lemongrass, which is nice. It’s gentle enough if you have sensitive skin and doesn’t leave the tight feeling. Gives you a nice lather, and nice clean feeling, but again you get all this for much less from other products. But if you don’t mind the price and can splurge, this would be a nice splurge.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: I have oily skin and this has been a life saver! Worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: If I could give it zero stars I would! This is the worst cleansing balm I’ve ever used. I bought it because of all the hype over it—overhyped and overrated! If I could return it I would in a heartbeat, but unfortunately, I live overseas and returning is too much of a hassle. It smells amazing, but that’s the only positive I could find. It doesn’t emulsify very well, doesn’t even breakdown light makeup, can only imagine how bad this would underperform with those that wear heavy makeup. I wear light tinted moisturizer and occasionally wear some mascara. I literally have to rub continuously, to the point that they get irritated and guess what?? this still doesn’t break it down enough for it to come off. I normally use Farmacy Green Clean and will definitely go back to that one. Don’t waste your money on this one—not worth a $0.01 at all.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: Love it smells amazing not tacky skin looks great pores are smaller thank you caudalie

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I have been using for 2 weeks now and I love how it lathers and a little goes along way my skin is combo I feel it cleanses without drying .I also love the way my skin looks and after I rinse it seems to have a fresh look instead of that stripped clean cold look some cleansers give off .rating a 4 because I have not used long enough to say it is great but so far it does what it claims

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: my forever serum .I have used so many serums and have not been impressed this is the first time I felt it was worth the purchase specially for the price ..does all that it claims I have combo skin absorbs quickly and really gives a healthy  non greasy glow

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: For over 60 days, I’ve tried D-Bronzi.  Using a small cosmetic spatula, I blend a few drops with my daily SPF moisturizer to match my medium brown skin.  As we head into winter months, I need a little less to avoid orange undertones (one pump vs. two).  Let me tell you, I love this stuff.  Officially hooked!  Unless, you have a deep brown skin-tone, I recommend starting with a small amount (a drop or two) until you find the best blend.  It leaves my skin with a subtle glow - like a little August in December!  People mention I’m glowing, but the reflective particles are very fine so they don’t instantly know I have a product secretly working for me.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: I have oily 30+ skin that’s sensitive and acne prone.  Yippie!  I tried this product based on an in store suggestion.  I’m glad I did!  It gently pulls off a layer of dull skin without making my face red.  I applied moisturizer after my face dried a little and went on with my day.  I noticed a better glow and improved texture immediately.  Also, it didn’t break me out.  I usually stick with Drunk Elephant products, but this one is also a keeper!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I really like the gentle exfoliation this product delivers.  I have aging acne prone sensitive skin.  I follow the directions, leaving on for only 20 minutes.  I was initially afraid of the Marula oil sample they sent in the package.  Oil on oily skin?!?? I’m here to tell you, my skin even likes the oil.  A little goes a long way.  My only complaint is about the packaging.  I thought I ran out after the first use!  For $100, not happy!  It turns out the product settled, I had to swing it around to get additional uses.  I’ve used it five times and I think I have more, but that’s a mystery - another packaging flaw.   You can’t see what’s left in the container.  Overall, I’m very happy with the two or three day glow it gives me (no redness). Solid investment.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I love how it is made to both mouisturizele and blur your pores. I received this product free from influenster I honestly didn’t see a change in the moisturizer to my face.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Peace Out. I used the strips on my nose and forehead. It made such a huge difference on my nose. I left them on for 5 hours and when I removed it you could see white dots all in it which was my dead skin. My pores were closed on my nose it also left my skin looking smooth. This is definitely a must and works well!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. I love how it left under my eyes moisturized and minimized the dark spots under my eyes. It is small but a little goes a long way so you can get so many uses out of it.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Farmacy Beauty. First let’s talk about the smell! It smells of natural raw honey which I love. When you are applying it is so smooth and leaves your face feeling moisturized almost instantly.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser. It’s very gentle but effective. I love how my skin feels nice and moist after cleansing. I received this product complimentary and it’s now one of my favorite cleansers. I highly suggest it.

reviews.review_text: My son uses this everyday (he is who I purchase it for) his skin is flawlessssss for a 15 year old athletic human who used to be prone to breakouts.

reviews.review_title: It does actually work and is non-irritating.

I noticed a difference in a WEEK!!! I have dark spots that i occasioonally get with acne and they are fading thankfully. Some I have been dealing with for a year and are also finally seeing some leeway. This product does work. Will definitely use until I finish the bottle.

reviews.review_text: After the first day, these ANNOYING acne scabs that refused to go away had already started drying up to fall off. I was in shock and forever grateful because sometimes i get ones that stay for weeks. Seriously purchasing this product. I haven’t had anything work that fast in forever.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am already always excited to try new moisturizers to compare and the IT Cosmetics Confidence in a Cream was fantastic! The thing is, I’m a nurse and most days I do not wear base or powder to cover any blemishes or to give my face a little life, which in turn makes me feel “pretty” or presentable. Well, after wearing this confidence in a cream, I have seen my skin improve as far as appearing clearer and brighter. I actually feel “confident” going makeup free (and I’m not being cheesy, it really has changed my attitude). In comparison to other moisturizers, this one has definitely shown me results in a shorter period of time and that fact that I have seen any results at all is an improvement! The confidence in a cream also goes on smooth and dries fairly quickly and doesn’t feel greasy or heavy on my skin. Another positive is that it smells great. I have not had any breakouts with this product either. I would highly recommend this product to anyone that asks. The bottle is a large full size and you do not need to much to apply to your face. I will definitely be repurchasing!!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use the cream as a night cream. I love how you don’t need a lot to have your face feeling moisturized and the next day my skin is glowing! This has helped me save on using so much moisturizing in my morning routine. I use Drunk Elephant protini as my day time moisturizer and now I only need about half a pump. It does have a faint fishy smell but goes away within seconds! I can’t stress enough how much I love the way this moisturizer makes my skin feel baby soft and creates a natural glow! A must have!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have used Tarte, Drunk Elephant, and Ole Henriksen eye cream. Biossance is the one that worked the best for me! The other 3 brands I do love but my eye responded better to this cream. I think to me the color of the cream just worked better for my under eyes and the formula that is Biossance my eyes seem to just like better. This is light weight and a little goes a long way so its definitely worth your money. I also use this with the eye serum so I feel like having both is why this eye cream bet out the other 3.

reviews.review_text: I am in love with everything about this product, from the bottle appearance. reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin looks so much healthier after using The New Fresh Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Face cream; finding a routine that works for me hasn’t been an easy task, and My combination skin and sensitivity is not too easy to figure out and but This cream has worked for me. It is extremely rich but yet feels light and easily absorb into my skin without causing me to breakouts. It also has a relaxing rose scent I enjoy. I Personality recommend for dry/combination type skin!

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: This vitamin c eye cream is pretty smooth, and I enjoy the color; it blends pretty good on my tan complexion; I also notice my under eyes to be less puffy after compile of minutes of application and feels very hydrating. This is my first eye cream, so I can’t compare to further in the market but will continue to use

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Very simplistic cleanser to just clean your face, don’t buy if you’re expecting it to get rid of problematic areas. I enjoy this one so much ‘cause I’m a combination skin gal, and I hate the feel of other cleansers. Jelly is the way to go if you hate the feel of slip and oil in cleansers, or you feel other cleansers make your skin even oiler than before.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This was my first product from this brand I fell in love gradually with it. At first I didn’t see much of a difference but after week 2 I saw improvement in my high pigment areas on the side of my chin and temple. The watermelon smell doesn’t last (which is good if scents bother you) it goes away about after 12 seconds or so. The glow it gives your skin is not intensifying, so don’t expect to glow to the gods l.o.l but it gives a nice healthy subtle rich glow. Try on the back of your hand at your local Sephora to see if you like it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Wasn’t what I expected for the Peppermint. I thought it was going to smell like the peppermint candy and have strong scent. It actually smells like the sweet peppermint candy cane you would hang on a Christmas tree. So it some what smells minty but more like candy, it’s a faint smell it’s just as bad as the peach iced tea scent.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I am truly in love with the lip sleeping mask; I have tried the berry, gummy bear, gingerbread, peppermint, the limited edition set which had lemon sorbet, mint cocoa, and sweet candy. A lot of the reviews are saying it didn’t work for them, I understand everyone is different but some may be using a lot of product; a little does go a long way and it last you a long time.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Worth every penny! I have oily skin, enlarged pores, and some small breakouts occasionally. I have tried everything over the years from Proactive, Rodan and Fields, and numerous Sephora brand products for acne, oil, and pores. While I have found good things I have never found something I loved. This is awesome!! After two uses my skin looked dramatically different. I have used it four times now and already my skin is more even, clearer, and my pores are dramatically smaller! I have some redness and sensitive areas around my mouth and nose. While this product is effective, I feel it is also gentle as it doesn’t aggregate those areas. Love this product! Thank you drunk elephant!!!

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This is amazing!!! Clears breakouts but does not dry you out or make sensitive areas worse!

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This stuff is awesome! My skin feels so hydrated all day and make up goes on so well over it! I e been using it a few weeks and I can really tell a difference. My skin is always so soft. My skin is still hydrated when I wake up in the morning and usually that is when my skin is the driest.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: Love this!!!! After one use unnoticed my skin looked brighter and smoother. I’ve used it about 5 times now and my skin looks so nice! I wore make up for the first time in about a week today. I kept looking at my skin thinking wow it looks so smooth! And then I thought it has to be this mask! Really helps with texture and dullness! Perfect price as well.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I did not think this would work for me as a lot of other products have let me down. Products that had similar ingredients have even let me down. This however, must be magic! I have been using it for a week now and I would say my dark acne scars are about 50% better! They are no longer that deep dark purple, they are pink. This product also smells good and has helped with my texture. I still have some texture but I’m hoping as I continue using it that it will keep getting better along with the acne scars. This toner also doesn’t feel like it’s drying out your face like other toners. It is very comfortable and makes my skin look glowy the next morning.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: Its texture is pretty good, firm, not greasy which is the most important thing to me when using facial nourishes

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love the product and its effects on my skin but I don’t like the smell. Some cucumber or aloe vera scent that hasn’t added to this amazing toner

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love the product and its effects on my skin but I don’t like the smell. Some cucumber or aloe vera scent that hasn’t added to this amazing toner

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I’m a huge fan of glycolic acid and its benefits, so my expectations were met with this peel mask! Brighter and shinier skin after the first use.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I’m a huge fan of glycolic acid and its benefits, so my expectations were met with this peel mask! Brighter and shinier skin after the first use.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: Nice texture! Even though it’s an acid, it doesn’t burn nor peel my face. Has a light smell and I could see some difference after 2 weeks of use.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_title: Perfect serum with an amazing perfume
reviews.review_text: Both serums share the same gel texture. It has a very light and pleasant perfume, and doesn’t leave any residual product on your skin.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: In my daily skincare routine, I normally use a retinol and niacinamide, so I was delighted to see them paired in this eye cream. The ceramic tip of the applicator is cooling which is nice. The formula feels hydrating and soaks into the skin pretty quickly after being patted in which makes it perfect to layer in a routine. I’m looking forward to using this daily to see how effective it is over a few months.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: My first time using the floral recover overnight mask, I thought it had a pleasant smell and the ingredients like squalane and vitamin c. It felt soothing and I think that you get a decent amount that will last a long time. If you are sensitive to fragrance, this might not be for you, but I have enjoyed it.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I’m a fan of acne patches, but haven’t tried the peace out ones till now. I wore them over night and my pimple was completely flat and healed the next morning. Redness still remained, but it was one the way to recovery.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This tinted lip balm complimentary from Fresh has made it into my makeup rotation for the summer. I love the sheer, but buildable color, the  hydrating performance and that it contains SPF. I have been wearing it to work as well and it has nice staying power too. I’ve been throwing it in my purse to use on the go. Even on no makeup days, with this I look put together

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This new serum from Fresh was exciting to add to my routine. The serum felt nice going onto the skin and has a light, refreshing scent. It didn’t leave my skin dry or flaky, but left it feeling hydrated ad soothed. I will continue to use this in my routine which is after cleansing and before moisturizing.

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: Love this for my oily skin. It’s not too drying and lasts all day without looking too heavy or too matte. Perfect for everyday wear!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love how cooling this moisturizer is and the way it smells. It sinks in but can be a little sticky at times. None the less, I love this!

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The best moisturizer I’ve ever used. Sinks into my skin and hydrates like no other. I’m in love!

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! It sinks into the skin and doesn’t makes me oily.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is the smoothest lip balm I’ve ever used! I use it before bed as well as throughout the day. Leaves my lips soft and hydrated!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Wish I'd found it years ago...
reviews.review_text: I use it in the morning and with a cleansing brush at night along with the face cream for about a month now, and I can genuinely say my skin has NEVER been this happy. It smells awesome, doesn’t strip my skin, and I’ve been having fewer/less severe breakouts, my skin looks more supple and even, and my scars are fading more quickly! I used cetaphil for a long time because it didn’t make my skin worse, but this is the first skincare line that’s actually improved my skin. I feel like I’m actually feeding my skin the good stuff. I wish I’d had this when I was a teenager, might have saved me a lot of trouble.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Wish I'd found it years ago...
reviews.review_text: I use it in the morning and with a cleansing brush at night along with the face cream for about a month now, and I can genuinely say my skin has NEVER been this happy. It smells awesome, doesn’t strip my skin, and I’ve been having fewer/less severe breakouts, my skin looks more supple and even, and my scars are fading more quickly! I used cetaphil for a long time because it didn’t make my skin worse, but this is the first skincare line that’s actually improved my skin. I feel like I’m actually feeding my skin the good stuff. I wish I’d had this when I was a teenager, might have saved me a lot of trouble.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I love YttP’s products because they’re organic and contain few ingredients, which is better for my sensitive, acne prone skin. The cream alone isn’t super hydrating, especially during the dry, cold winter. But I’ve been using it in combination with Herbivore’s Prism glow potion and lapis facial oil. My skin is less red and irritated, I have fewer/ less bad breakouts, and my acne scars are healing and fading more quickly! Might try the adaptogen moisture cream after I finish this pot.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Love it! Feels way more moisturizing than their other face cream. Thick, but not greasy texture and helps battle the dry, cold winter air. I’ve noticed less flaking, and doesn’t break me out.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Love it! Feels way more moisturizing than their other face cream. Thick, but not greasy texture and helps battle the dry, cold winter air. I’ve noticed less flaking, and doesn’t break me out.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Got a sample of this along with their face wash. This moisturizer was decent. It didn’t seem to clog up my pores, but even using it morning and night, my skin is pretty flaky by night time.  Not a bad product, but definitely not with the nearly $70 price tag.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I went into Sephora looking for a better moisturizer to use over the winter, and while the sales person helped me find a decent one, she also recommended a hyaluronic acid serum to help treat my acne (dry skin can cause breakouts, who knew?) and recommended either this serum or the inky list. Initially, using this under moisturizer at night made my skin feel more hydrated for longer. Using it continuously (I recently purchased my second bottle) has made my skin more plum, even, and reduced breakouts, and actually gave my skin time to heal. While I might try to look for a serum with a few more ingredients, this is such a great product for the price point. I would definitely recommend it to anyone with dry, acne prone skin, or anyone who lives in an extreme climate!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: Very happy with this product. I’ve been using it for about a month now in the morning under sunscreen. I’ve noticed my acne scars starting to fade, I’ve had fewer breakouts, and the breakouts aren’t as angry and red as they’ve been in the past. The formula has grit to it (which they acknowledge on the deciem website), but the grit disappears after I put product on top of it. Its a pretty high concentration of l-abscorbic acid, so it might not be for more sensitive skinned people. I used once a week, and then increased use to every day. Also, it can sting around broken/irritated skin. Will be purchasing again because it’s a good product for the cost!

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I was wary of cleansing balms for so long because many of them are expensive and I don’t want to wash that much money down the drain. But the price is right, I feel like it does a fantastic job of grabbing onto makeup, doesn’t require as much product as micellar water, and it’s not as messy to use as other cleansing oils. I use it to remove makeup and follow my second tube and definitely plan on repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I was wary of cleansing balms for so long because many of them are expensive and I don’t want to wash that much money down the drain. But the price is right, I feel like it does a fantastic job of grabbing onto makeup, doesn’t require as much product as micellar water, and it’s not as messy to use as other cleansing oils. I use it to remove makeup and follow my second tube and definitely plan on repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I was amazed by this product. I use a makeup removing face wipe, this product, and then my drunk elephant cleanser. This product works and smells AMAZING.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I was amazed by this product. I use a makeup removing face wipe, this product, and then my drunk elephant cleanser. This product works and smells AMAZING.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve only used this product a few times and I have already seen a difference in my skin. It regulates the amount of oil I have, and it has helped minimize a dark spot on my face. The first day after adding this to my routine it healed an acne breakout I had had that day. This usually does not happen. I love moisturizing and so if I have a breakout, it usually takes a little while to heal up. This product sped up that process significantly. I also noticed my crows feet look less pronounced after using this product a few times. I’m in my 30’s and have tried a lot of luxury skin care products. This is just as effective and you get so much more for your money!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Okay so this product smells good AND it is not overpowering. it feels so nice on my skin. My skin had no negative reactions to this product. my skin felt soft afterwards and clean! it was able to remove residual makeup. This has AMAZING ingredients. I am super impressed with this product!I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_title: Don't need to buy two shades of foundation!
reviews.review_text: I started using the Amazonian clay Foundation from Tarte. I know I’m late to the game, but it’s because there wasn’t a perfect shade match for me. The one I purchased is okay for winter, but it’s still a little on the pale side. I mix my D-Bronzi drops with it and ai can control the shade of my foundation depending on the season. I can so use a generous amount and make any foundation more of a tinted moisturizer. I live in a highly polluted location so the fact that it also protects my skin from pollution is an amazing bonus. I absolutely love this product and would give it 10 stars if I could. It is so multifunctional.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Not only does this have fabulous ingredients, it is the best mineral sunscreen I have ever used!

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Like many other reviewers I didn’t want to like this. I figured it was a gimmick. It’s so expensive I thought either it has gold in it or people are getting ripped off here. I WAS WRONG. I received a sample of this and used it religiously every night for about a month. The sample was small so I really stretched it out. I started getting tons of compliments about my skin. I noticed that in pictures my skin was smooth, glowing, even-toned, and my lines less noticeable to name only a few of the many improvements. I had started using a few new products along with the Creme de La Mer sample, so I thought nothing of it. Sure enough, my sample ran out and I stopped using it altogether. Even with my new intense skincare routine my skin started going downhill slowly. After a month without using La Mer I looked in the mirror one day and I felt discouraged because I was having breakouts again, my skin did not look as even, my skin just didn’t look like it had before. It was the only thing I had taken out of my routine. So it’s safe to say I made the investment and bought Creme de La Mer again. I bought the smallest size and I am going to drag it out as long as possible. I found that the amount I use doesn’t seem to matter as long as I cover (even with the thinnest amount) most of my face. My skin is once again almost completely FLAWLESS. I could throw out all my other products. I’m not kidding.Because it has been such a miracle for my skin I have been using it on my arms. I pick at my arms when I get anxious (it’s a horrible habit I know). I wear long sleeves usually to hide the marks. I have put Creme de La Mer on it for a few nights and The scars have already faded DRAMATICALLY. It works. This is the only other thing powerful enough except for retinol that can cause such amazing and huge results. It just works like an incredible miracle potion, that is all.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Received this as a point perk and fell in love. It is a great moisturizer. I have oily skin and it balances it out perfectly. I first started using it at night as a thick moisturizer, and then incorporated it into my AM routine as well and my makeup looked GORGEOUS on top of it. It is a great AM and PM moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This stuff is great at taking off every bit of makeup. I still cleanse after using but there is zero makeup left on my face. I also think it is priced great as well as compared to other brands!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This stuff is great at taking off every bit of makeup. I still cleanse after using but there is zero makeup left on my face. I also think it is priced great as well as compared to other brands!!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: OBSESSED with this product. Never in my life have I done an at home mask and literally saw the results immediately after washing it off. It makes your skin so incredibly soft and really works. It does tingle quite a bit the first couple of minutes but it doesn’t sting beyond that. It also does not make your face red either. My only complaint is that it is such a large amount of product. You can only use it a max of once a week, and it has a one year expiration date once opened. I am concerned I will not be able to use it all before it expires. I would love to see this in a smaller size option!

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: This was the first serum I ever purchased, part of upping my skincare game in 2019. I love that it has the two functions of the AHA and the vitamin C. I have used it just over a month and have already noticed a big difference in my skin. It has a very nice consistency and absorbs into my skin very quickly!! The packaging it also very luxurious. I am very happy with this purchase!

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: This product is lovely for oily skin! It is a true full coverage foundation. The application is soooo important though. I tried it one day with a buffing brush and it looked so cakey and splotchy I thought I was going to hate it. I tried it the next day with a beauty blender and it was flawless!! I wouldn’t use this with anything but a beauty blender to get the best result.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I received a sample in a Sephora Play! smarts bag and while it found it alright, three days wasn’t enough time to see any noticeable difference.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this every morning and evening for a week now and it’s the perfect winter-time moisturizer for my oily, acne-prone skin. Definitely recommend.I received this cream complimentary from Influenster for testing and review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: A perfectly fine and acceptable rose oil! Didn’t do an exceptional amount but also didn’t cause me to break out so there’s a plus. Giving it good marks because of this. Also, I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing and review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: Nothing exciting but also nothing bad to point out? It has a nice, soft, not artificial scent and it didn’t seem to aggravate my occasional acne flare ups. With that said, I didn’t find it exceptionally different from any other rose oil on the market? It wasn’t particularly glowing, it didn’t particularly clear up any skin issues.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Love how handy this is to keep in my purse. It’s not like I find myself out and about as much anymore but a few times now I’ve run errands and realized I forgot to apply my daily spf before I left. This glides on clear, not greasy, and provides great coverage! I ESPECIALLY love that they reformulated and removed the oxybenzone and octinoxate since those are ingredients I try to avoid in my house. My skin is combo oily but I’ve had no issue with breakouts!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: The good: it gives a healthy glow to skin and lasts all day. Ingredients have been updated to be reef safe and on top of it all, it has a light, lovely scent that gradually disappears.The bad: Mix it first or prepare to be a grease monster! Those of you with oily skin also need to be careful since it can wear heavily.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I know this has mixed reviews but it really does work well covering my natural redness. I’ve learned to pat it in, rather than rub, and it doesn’t cause any breakouts that way. If you have dry skin, I think it could be hard to apply without being patchy.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I know this has mixed reviews but it really does work well covering my natural redness. I’ve learned to pat it in, rather than rub, and it doesn’t cause any breakouts that way. If you have dry skin, I think it could be hard to apply without being patchy.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I have yet to meet a lip mask that does better than this one. It’s expensive (one star off for how much money it yanks from my wallet) but darn if isn’t worth it.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: In Love with Origins clearing moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley for my honest review. I loved the Sunday Riley Good Genes. When applying it it feels so refreshing on my skin. Immediately gives the skin a glow and moisturized look. It also smells so wonderful! I couldn’t tell if it’s the licorice or lemongrass that gives it that’s heavenly smell. I have oily skin and acne spots as my skin is acne prone and texture wise, I did notice improvement. My skin feels softer, smoother and brighter. I use it only at night or when I know I’m staying inside away from the sun since it has AHA. I also saw improvement on some of my smaller forming pimples getting dried out. I think with continued use I’ll see more clarity as the days go on darker spots but will say that I did not see any improvement in one day, probably around a week after. My pores and fine lines honestly look the same but seems to give your skin a “younger” look and feel due to how moisturizing it leaves the skin giving it a glowy look so if you’re looking for just fine lines or wrinkles going away this is not for you, it’s a temporary look. Will say works great for textured skin and preventing excess oil on skin.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I had never tried Glow Recipe products before and glad that I had the chance to try their new Avocado Ceramide Recovery Serum! It states that it protects the skin’s barrier and to reduce redness. I can say that I don’t see any improvements on redness. I have oily skin and some redness due to acne and scars and I didn’t see any improvement there. I did however notice my skin a lot more moisturized. It gave me sort of a natural glow and very refreshed look. The packaging does note that it hydrates so I think this is the barrier that it gives the skin to protect from dehydration leaving my face looking moisturized. The serum is very thin and does not feel sticky at all, this allows it to absorb a lot faster. It also smells refreshing and clean without it being overpowering. The pump of this has a cover, which is nice but I had trouble knowing this at first and was applying it through the application stick, the cover blends in so well that it doesn’t seem there is a pump with it. I’d recommend the company to just use a lock pump instead to avoid using more plastic then necessary but it’s not a stopping factor for me to purchase. Since it comes in a glass bottle, I recommend placing it in the fridge during the summer for that refreshing feel. I have been able to apply it with and without makeup and doesn’t affect the look of my makeup, if anything it made my makeup look more natural!

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: The Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream is great! I got the Original shade, I tend to use beige or natural beige colors and this do not change any of my tones under the eye nor does it give any yellowish tones. I do want to try the warm shade as I think will also go nice with my skin tone. This definitely does brighten my eye area, it has some slight shimmer to it but no glitter or anything but like a highlighter without it being too shiny. It’s also very hydrating and leaves it feeling nice and smooth throughout the day. I have worn this day and night time and works great for both. I have also worn this underneath makeup and makes concealer application a lot smoother as it seems to prime the area. I definitely recommend even for those without dark circles as it gives you a more awake and glowy look!

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: The Origins Check and Balances Face Wash is a great face wash for any skin type, especially sensitive. I have oily skin and was able to use this to wash away the oiliness as well as it’s great for taking off makeup. I love that I can use a very small amount and it’s enough for the entire face and gives a very good froth amount. The texture is very soft, I would say it feels almost like a soft paste. It has a very slight minty smell but doesn’t leave any lingering smells. It hasn’t caused any breakouts nor left any other sensations. I love this face wash because compared to other face washes, this one doesn’t leave my face feeling dry. Instead leaves my skin soft, smooth, and can tell that it leaves it clean without leaving it dry. I recommend this for any skin type!

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this as a complimentary sample and I knew that algenist had great stuff but never expected this to be so good. After 3 days using it I already got results. The texture is buttery but it’s not sticky which I love. It’s smels great and made me sleep so well. I used this product with the liquid collagen. My skin got moist and I can tell it’s different. It feels healthy. I also loved the idea of being vegan. It’s one thing I have been trying to change is use less products with animal products and tested in animals.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I got it 3 days ago and started using it right away. I already can see such difference.  It’s good as primer and it also goes well with the alguronic acid   collagen at night. It’s a great product!

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have received this productas a complimentary gift for testing purposes  I’m a fan of face creams which makes me really picky about them. I simply loved it. It makes my eyes area really soft and smooth making my fine lines show less. I do believe it did improved the look of it as well. I loved the consistency and scent of it.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this moisturizer from Influenster I love it!! I’ve noticed since using this my skin looks well balanced and just fresh. It’s Magic!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this product but I NOPE. the texture and consistency is pretty good but after using for 2 weeks, I saw no visible difference in my eye lines or dark circles. I also found the applicator had a small rough edge which scratched my delicate under eye area, I did receive a small trial size. Overall, it was a nice cream, just didn’t see the effects that I would have liked.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: It’s easy to use, and after a week I definitely could see improvement. Totally worth it! I received this product from influenster and Dior to give my honest opinion

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: Since I have used this product, I am always getting compliments on how refreshed and bright my skin looks! it doesn’t feel oily and my skin feels so good now!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: As a person with sensitive skin, especially rosacea, this cleanser is the best face wash I have ever used. It works great at removing makeup and leaving your skin smooth and cleansed. On top of that, it helps with my oily skin and works well with my sensitive skin! Highly recommend!!

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have very sensitive skin and have struggled to find the right cleaner to keep my skin clean and control my rosacea. As soon as I first tried this, I could tell a HUGE difference with my skin. My skin looks wonderful and my rosacea is barely noticeable now!

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have very sensitive skin and have struggled to find the right cleaner to keep my skin clean and control my rosacea. As soon as I first tried this, I could tell a HUGE difference with my skin. My skin looks wonderful and my rosacea is barely noticeable now!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: My skin is very sensitive, and any kind of exfoliator that I have used, always left my skin red and caused my rosacea to flare up. I wanted to find the right product that could keep my skin soft, but gently at the same time. Using this product, I have noticed the difference in my skin. It feels cleansed, but refreshed. I’ve had no issues with my rosacea flaring up as well!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: On top of the amazing smell, this mask has really helped my pores become barely noticeable! I LOVE the cooling effect with the mask on, and after you rinse. My skin feels clean and can breathe!

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I really like this formula because it is the perfect amount of moisture for what I need. I don’t suffer from dry lips but have occasional bouts of it after wearing matte lipsticks and in the winter. I’m also very acne prone around my chin area so greasier formulas tend to transfer and cause painful breakouts around my mouth, which this one does not. It doesn’t have any strong flavors and really doesn’t transfer so it definitely fits my needs. The only reason I didn’t give it a 5 star is that it is really pricey for the amount of product (picture shown is a new tube that has been used once) and the chubby size of the stick makes it more difficult to apply precisely without using a finger.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this product in conjunction with the Lala Retro Whipped Cream. I use these both in the evening and have noticed that my skin is a lot more balanced; less patchiness, less redness, and less breakouts. I have oily, acne prone skin and have not had issues with this combination of products causing breakouts. I think if I used this product alone, it may cause my skin to be irritated from the acids. The only reason I did not give this 5 stars is the packaging. For a $90 product the packaging feels cheap and when I travel, I can’t just throw it in my bag because it pops open, especially as the bottle wears out and gets down to the end (the plastic wears and it barely takes anything to pop it open).

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Great for dry or sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: Overall, this cleanser is great if you have dry or sensitive skin or if you are looking for a less-harsh cleanser to rotate into your schedule. It did a decent job of removing makeup, but didn’t quite get it all around the eyes. It leaves your skin feeling smooth, but not stripped. I have oily, acne-prone skin and it didn’t cause any breakouts or leave my skin feeling greasy. I received this as a free sample, but I would definitely re-purchase for winter months when my skin is more combination.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_title: Amazing moisturizer for all skin types
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this product in conjunction with the TLC Framboos Glycolic Night Serum. I use these both in the evening and have noticed that my skin is a lot more balanced; less patchiness, less redness, and less breakouts. I have oily, acne prone skin and have not had issues with this combination of products causing breakouts. I think if I used the moisturizer alone, it may cause my skin to be a lot more oily, except maybe in the winter months when the air and my skin are a lot drier. Sits lightly on the skin, no strong fragrances, and no heavy, filmy feeling.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Nice eye cream, but nothing special
reviews.review_text: I enjoy using this product at night before bed, as it is super moisturizing. It says it’s light enough to use during the day, but in my opinion it is really thick for a day eye cream; you would definitely struggle to apply makeup over top of this. I didn’t really notice any brightening effects, but this would definitely help with wrinkles or dryness. Overall, nice eye cream but there are a lot of other eye creams out there that are cheaper that would be pretty comparable.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_title: Good moisturizer for combination or slightly dry s
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this complimentary and have been testing it out for the last week or so. I have oily skin that has been a little dried out from extra sun and electric heat. This moisturizer was just enough extra moisture without clogging pores or causing breakouts. I only give it 4 stars because it’s definitely too thick for my regular oily skin. I think this product would definitely work best for combination or slightly dry skin.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this serum because Moisturizes the skin but does not leave a heavy and oily appearance.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I was really impressed by this eye cream! I have used the same popular vit c eye cream for years now and I did not realize how seemingly ineffective it is until I added this to my routine. Any texture under my eyes subsided and my under eye area was super hydrated. I did use this several nights in a row though and noticed that the outer corners of my eyes were red and a bit sensitive so for me personally I will be using this a few times a week and not every night.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I LOVE THIS!! The texture is sooo nice and smooth, it makes my skin look so radiant and plush! reviews.review_text: LOVE this product for the first step in my double cleanse. I don’t wear makeup so I can’t speak to how well this removes it, but definitely great for breaking down sunscreen. reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Normally I love The Ordinary, but this wasn’t it for me. This had a nice cooling and de-puffing effect under my eyes the first few times I used it, but it doesn’t do much in the long run. I purchased two bottles at once (wish I hadn’t lol), so I’m finishing it up by mixing in a few drops with my moisturizer for an antioxidant boost all over.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Super hydrating! I’m on my second bottle and have noticed my frown lines become way less prominent over time, likely in-part due to the peptides in this. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: LOVE this cleansing balm! It feels so luxurious, and I actually prefer this one over the Farmacy Green Clean one. A little bit definitely goes a long way (if you use too much then it will feel like it leaves a film after washing it off). Also my fave product from this brand! Price is a bit steep but definitely repurchasing if available at the next sale.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I just finished my first bottle of this and I am in LOVE! I’ve previously only tried the two Hyaluronic serums from The Ordinary and this one was WAY nicer than those. It absorbed very well, never felt sticky, and plumped my skin so nicely. I personally won’t be repurchasing because I find I don’t really need a HA serum in my routine, but this product is totally worth it for the price and the quality!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Got the mini size of this in one of the FAB holiday kits. Overall a great fragrance-free and non-stripping cleanser. I think it would be good to use for all seasons even though the texture is more on the creamy side. However the price is too high and not at all justified for how simple this product is.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I always wanted to try this moisturizer but it was never in my budget. I was able to use my insider points to get a free mini size recently, and I’m glad I did because there is no way I would ever spend $75 CAD on this product. It’s a good moisturizer for sure, but it doesn’t do anything more than any other cream with ceramides from more affordable or drugstore brands. While I appreciate it is fragrance-free, the smell was very off putting (it kind of reminded me of soy sauce, but if it were fermented? didn’t like it at all). This moisturizer definitely works, but the cons outweigh the pros for me.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My favourite treatment cleanser! This was very effective in clearing some of my breakouts. It lathers quite nicely and isn’t overly drying, but I definitely need to follow it up with a hydrating toner or serum. Really great product and value!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I feel like this cleanser is so underhyped, it’s soooo good! While it doesn’t foam up the way its name would suggest, it has such a beautiful texture and lather. It’s a great non-stripping cleanser that leaves my skin feeling clean, but still so smooth and hydrated. It smells so good too (I usually avoid fragrance but am fine with them in cleansers, and this one really elevates the experience of using this product). Definitely recommend and will repurchase!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I got a mini size with my insider points and it was just ok. It comes out quite thick but lathers up nicely. It can be quite stripping, leaving my skin feeling somewhat dry and not entirely clean after each use. Would not spend the money on a full size.

reviews.review_text: I started using this as a part of my nightly skin care routine and my skin is sooo glowy and soft in the morning. The price is kinda high but its so worth it. A must have!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Super hydrating and makes my lips feel soft and supple. Also leaves a very subtle baby pink coloured hue and a nice shine. A must have!

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I have dry, irritated, sensitive skin and this is the perfect moisturizer for me! I use it as a part of my night time skin care routine and wake up with soothed, hydrated skin. It has also noticeably reduced the redness on my cheeks and forehead. My sister (oily skin) also tried this product and she felt like it was a bit too heavy on her skin, and that it accentuated her oiliness. I feel like this product might be better suited for people with dry skin.

reviews.review_text: This serum is unbelievable. First time i tried it, it kinda burned my dry, sensitive skin but I didn’t have a bad reaction and i woke up to super smooth, baby soft skin. I use it 3 times a week under my night cream and I have noticed that my fine lines have been significantly blurred, redness has been reduced, acne scars have faded, and my face doesn’t really have any of those small annoying bumps anymore. It also doesn’t dry out my skin like most AHA serums do. It does smell a bit odd, but other than that i think it’s totally worth it!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I used to have chapped, broken lips and I started using this every night. Now my lips don’t even know who dryness is. This product seriously hydrates and repairs. I wake up to soft lips every day. And the value is amazing, I finished my first one after 9 months of using it.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: I have dry, sensitive, irritated skin and it’s difficult to to find a physical exfoliator that wont completely dry out my skin and this is it!! I got the sample size so i used it about 3 times and i noticed my skin was instantly smoother. I have a bit of darkness around my mouth and this product really helped brighten that area up. I recommend applying it to wet skin and gently massaging if you have sensitive skin. Will be purchasing the full size!

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: I have dry, sensitive, irritated skin and it’s difficult to to find a physical exfoliator that wont completely dry out my skin and this is it!! I got the sample size so i used it about 3 times and i noticed my skin was instantly smoother. I have a bit of darkness around my mouth and this product really helped brighten that area up. I recommend applying it to wet skin and gently massaging if you have sensitive skin. Will be purchasing the full size!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: So happy with this product!! I have combo (more on the dry side) sensitive skin, and I use it as a part of my night time skincare routine after my moisturizer. Wake up to soft, plump, glowing skin. This helped get rid of those annoying little bumps on my forehead and cheeks, making my skin look so smooth! You only need to use about 2-3 drops on your face because its very spreadable. I pat it into my skin instead of rubbing to help it get absorbed. 100% recommend!!!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My dry, sensitive, easily irritated skin LOVES this product. Usually my skin (especially cheeks and chin area) starts feeling dry throughout the day, no matter how much moisturizer i apply. I use this in the morning under my makeup and my skin feels hydrated and looks soft the whole day. I also use it at night as the last step in my skin care and I wake up to hydrated, glowing skin. This product has also helped reduce the redness on my cheeks. It’s a very thick, hydrating cream, but it absorbs easily and you don’t need to apply too much on your skin. I highly recommend this if you have dry skin!!!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this twice daily for a week. All those annoying small bumps on my face are gone. My skin feels incredibly smooth. My redness has also been significantly reduced. I have dry, sensitive skin and I have a difficult time finding toners that dont irritate my skin. This is the one. It’s a bit sticky but it absorbs quick. Smells like fresh watermelon, very light and pleasant. I love this. Bless you glow recipe

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this twice daily for a week. All those annoying small bumps on my face are gone. My skin feels incredibly smooth. My redness has also been significantly reduced. reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this. It is a bit more expensive than the cult favourite The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid, but the texture is much better. It’s light and not as thick. It also absorbs quickly into the skin. Must have for the colder seasons.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I must say I was shocked how amazing this product it. I love Farmacy, so don’t get me wrong, and I was expecting to like this product. But I am absolutely head over heels. The product is light-weight and as the name describes the ingredients, the product smelled of honey. It was not an overbearing smell too, which I prefer. The packaging is beautiful as always too. I have always been a fan of ceramides, especially in the winter time, so I was very happy to be able to test this product out. I am sure it’s going to be an absolute skin saver this winter!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe to review and this is the easiest 5 star review I have ever given. Packaging is absolutely stunning! From the box it was packaged in to the glass moisturizer bottle, everything is convenient and simple. Now to the moisturizer. As you can imagine, this product smells delightful. It’s not heavily fragranced which is perfect for more sensitive skin. It’s texture is very light, yet it moisturizes does well! I highly recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by glow recipe and at the same time I received the same product as a gift! So now I have double the awesomeness. The product not only smells AMAZING but is so light in that it glides across my face so smoothly - leaving a natural look to obsess over. Smells very similar to their watermelon mask!!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: A phenomenal sun screen that glides on so smoothly! You can never go wrong with Sheisedo products anyways. This product doesn’t have a thick feel like other sunscreens and the smell is not overbearing. Does not leave residue either. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I am so obsessed with this product I don’t even have words. I have been out hiking the past few days where the sun is the brightest and I can feel a major difference when using this product! It leaves no residue like other sun screens and is not as sticky either! Smell is nice too.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Glow recipe gifted me this AMAZING facial serum I am obsessed beyond words. The ceramides in this serum have such an amazing hydrating effect and my skin has never felt more smooth. I also feel like this serum has helped with my acne. It’s great for sensitive skin too! Packaging is a bonus, since glow recipe has the best looking products!

reviews.review_text: Fresh is one of the most amazing brands I have ever discovered in my life. This cream in particular is Not overbearing but smells amazing. Packaging is wonderful as well. You can never go wrong with this brand or their products!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: A wonderful product! Seriously. Glides on so smoothly and leaves my skin feeling refreshed. Packaging is cute as always. You can never go wrong with this brand and their products! I highly recommend this to anyone!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: A wonderful product! Seriously. Glides on so smoothly and leaves my skin feeling refreshed. Packaging is cute as always. You can never go wrong with this brand and their products! I highly recommend this to anyone!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I love Sunday Riley with all my heart. It is one of the best brand that seriously helps my skin. This product specifically works wonders because of it retinol ingredients. It’s not harsh and I really see a difference in my eye puffiness!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer

reviews.review_text: Can you get better than glow recipe? Like seriously - keep coming out with these new products! Packaging is cute as always and the product smells divine. Texture is amazing and light, not too sticky. Leaves your skin feeling and looking fresh!
