reviews.review_text: Obsessed as usual with Fresh. This product glides on smoothly! The smell is not overbearing at all making it perfect for sensitive skin, and keeping it on overnight. Your skin looks great as soon as you wake up!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Fresh. I’ve been a fan of fresh for years, and this product is magical. My lips have been so dry recently, and this product has moisturized and hydrated my lips completely! I highly recommend this product. Packaging is cute too

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Fresh has my heart. There has never been a product that I did not like. This new serum works so well, leaves no residue behind, and leaves my skin looking and feeling fresh and bright! Packaging is nice as well

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Good Genes works well, but it is stinky!
reviews.review_text: I recently received a sample of Good Genes from Sephora and it definitely lives up to its claims. It works like a chemical exfoliant to make your skin smoother and less textured. My only issue with this product is the smell! It takes a couple hours after application for the fragrance to dissipate. If it wasn’t so stinky, I would definitely give this product five stars. If anyone knows of a product that works as well as this one sans the smell, please let me know. Good Genes definitely lives up to the hype surrounding this product. I am really impressed with the results. I have sensitive, combination skin, so I prefer to use this product every other day. Because of the smell, I prefer to apply it prior to a face mask or in the morning before I apply my sunscreen and makeup and on of my favorite Tom Ford fragrances to help mask the smell of this product.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: This moisturizer is my new HG.
reviews.review_text: For over a year, a majority of skincare routine was comprised of Tatcha products (including my beloved water cream). A couple of weeks ago, I asked an SA for a smoke of this moisturizer. Within two applications of this moisturizer, I knew I had to purchase the full size. I was worried that this moisturizer would be too heavy for my combination skin but it absorbs easily without feeling heavy or greasy. In a perfect world, I would love to be able to afford to use Tatcha’s Water Cream during the day and this moisturizer at night. But for now, I can only purchase one moisturizer at a time and I enjoyed have moisturized, plump, and healthy this moisturizer made my skin in a couple applications that I am now enjoying the benefits of using it twice a day. I cannot speak to the long-term benefits of using this product yet, but fingers crossed, I will continue to experience the immaculate results that I have seen thus far.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: As soon as I read about this product on the Sephora website, I knew I had to buy it ASAP. Fortunately, I was able to snag the last one at my local Sephora. This product lives up to its claims. It is the perfect consistency. I have tried mixing it with my DE B-Hydra and C-Firma serum, and even applying the DE Protini moisturizer and sunscreen afterward, it still gave my skin a bit of color and a luminous glow. I have also tried mixing it ain’t my sunscreen and applying it by itself. I do find it works best when mixed into one of your other procured in your morning skincare regimen. Since Drunk Elephant has changed my skin dramatically for the better, I can easily get away with wearing this sans foundation. This product is already HG station for me. Especially since my face is always paper than the rest of my body. I live in Arizona, and I religiously apply face sunscreen every morning (I only put on full body  SPF if I am going to be doing something outdoors). So this product instantly gives me that extra oomph and my face and my body no look like they belong together.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: HG Serum in my nighttime skincare routine.
reviews.review_text: The first Drunk Elephant product that I ever tried was the TLC Sukari Baby Facial. And while that face mask does wonders for your complexion, this serum gives you those same results everyday! In fact, using this serum every night, I have found that I don’t need to use the Sukari Baby Facial nearly as often. The combination of AHAs and BHAs in the TLC Framboos glycolic night serum keep my sensitive, combination skin under control. Even though I am in my thirties, if it is that time of the month or I am super-stressed put, then I will still breakout. But this serum is my secret weapon because when I use it daily, I find that my skin stays so much more clear (even during my period and when I am stressed out, etc.). I have tried so many products over the years and not a single serum, lotion or potion has improved my complexion as much as this serum has... especially in combination with all of the other amazing Drunk Elephant products that are a part of my morning and evening skincare routine. And if you really want to your skin to look like your using an IG filter (without actually needing to use one), alternate nights between using this serum and the DE retinol mixed with a few drops of marula oil in the evenings. Of course make sure to do all of the other important steps of your evening skincare routine, but I have noticed continuous improvement to my complexion since I went back to using all Drunk Elephant skincare products. I love this brand and they offer clean/green beauty products that actually work and over a matter of weeks you will actually physically be able to see and feel how much your complexion has changed for the better in not that many weeks time. Regardless of how my skincare routine may change overtime, this serum isn’t going anywhere (unless Drunk Elephant or another brand comes out with an even more incredible skincare product).

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: 1st time using Beste instead of Juju & Pekee bars
reviews.review_text: I first fell in love with this brand a few years ago. But I have loved using Drunk Elephant’s Juju and Pekee cleansing bars so much that I never even bother to try the Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser until a few weeks ago. I have been using it twice a day for the past few weeks and I am pleasantly surprised how effective this cleanser is. And if you want it be more like an oil based facial cleanser, just add a few drops of DE’s marula oil to the Beste jelly cleanser! It is a total game changer. I have sensitive, combination skin and this cleanser doesn’t cause me to breakout or cause any issues with my skin whatsoever. Since this cleanser is a clear, sort of aloe vera gel-esque consistency, I always feel like I need to use way more of it to fully clean my face. But a little goes a long way and when I do use too much, it just takes me longer to fully get it off of my face. But it doesn’t bother me because I will just use my Foreo and give my skin a deeper cleanse. Once you add water, this jelly cleanser turns into a lovely lather. I so recommend using the DE Slaai Makeup Removing Balm if you have full face makeup on and/or stubborn eye makeup. The Beste jelly cleanser is great for a go to daily cleanser that doesn’t strip your skin of its natural moisture but somehow manages to thoroughly cleanse my face and neck. But for heavy lifting (as far as makeup is concerned) starting with the DE makeup-removing balm and double cleansing with the Beste No.9 Jelly Cleanser is a dynamic duo for days when I am all dolled up (or at least have waterproof eye makeup on). I think this cleanser woll work well for all skin types and if you are in the market for a new cleanser, as your SA at Sephora for a sample of this cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_title: DE Protini lover finally tried Lala Retro.
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive, combination skin so ever since DE released the Protini moisturizer a few years ago, I switched my skincare routine from Tatcha to predominantly Drunk Elephant skincare products.  But the Lala Retro moisturizer was one I always steered clear of (besides using the tester in store on my hands). I assumed that since Lala Retro has a blend of oils and seems to be more moisturizing than Protini is, I was worried that it would make my combination skin go out of control (especially in my T-zone). I do know that the current version of Lala Retro is a slightly different formula and has a lighter consistency than original Lala Retro formula. I have been using Lala Retro twice a day for the past few weeks and my skin is actually much more balanced. I do think that this moisturizer would be a bit too much for me to use in the summer time here in Arizona, but I will definitely use this as my autumn/winter moisturizer moving forward. I do have different hues of foundation for the different times of year (depending how tan or pasty I am), but I hadn’t considered changing up some of skincare routine products seasonally until I tried this moisturizer. My skin tone and texture has evened out, I don’t have dry and oily portions of face and no traces of redness. If you are struggling with winter skin (thanks to cold weather outside and dry, warm central air heating your home inside), this moisturizer has really helped my skin feel and look as good as it does during the warmer months.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_title: A lovely Lippe Balm, but I wish it was bigger...
reviews.review_text: Drunk Elephant Lippe Balm is a five star product, but the reason why I took off a star, (side note: will Sephora ever change the star ratings to allow us to take-off a half of a star instead of a full star?!) is because I wish this Lippe Balm was bigger, or at least they offered two sizes. Fir example, the current size is great for sticking in your purse but I like to have my lips moisturized 24/7, so I go through this Lippe Balm way more quickly than I go through all of my other Drunk Elephant products. It would be nice if they also sold a larger version in either the same form or in a pot like the Laneige lip sleep mask. I do love that this lip balm moisturizes my lips but just feels hydrating on my lips and doesn’t have an intense smell or taste and also isn’t emollient to the point where you can physically feel it layered on your lips. I like to put this on after I brush my teeth and prior to putting on makeup in the morning. In the evenings I put it on (surprise) after I brush my teeth and wash my face, but prior to doing my evening skincare routine. I keep one of these in my purse, one by my bed, and one in my bathroom because I have this horrible habit of licking my lips and then peeling off the dry skin if I don’t keep my lips moisturized 24/7. Oh! And one more thing, adding some of the DE marula oil and/or one of the DE face moisturizers to your lips first and then using this balm will keep your lips super-hydrated... even if you decide to wear a matte lipstick for the day. Or at least it helps me to not feel like I have been on an overseas airplane ride and then attempted to put on lipstick. So the pros are everything about this Lippe Balm sans the size of the product. But at least Drunk Elephant acknowledges that this lip balm is smaller by pricing this Lippe Balm at a price comparable to their travel sized skincare products.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: While I occasionally test out new eye creams and serums when they are released, this eye cream is the one that I keep coming back to using again and again. While no eye cream is a total miracle worker, this one does a better job than all of the other eye creams and serums that I have tried up until now. Fortunately, since I started a skincare routine when I was in Middle School, I don’t have a lot of complaints about the skin in my eye area that a lot of my friends have now that we are in our early thirties. My biggest issue with my eye area are my hereditary dark circles. Ugh! I am hoping that someday scientists will discover an skincare ingredient that can actually hardcore alleviate that issue. But until that happens, I have found that this eye cream tends to make a greater improvement on my under eye circles than any other eye product I have tried. I have been using the C Tango eye cream twice a day for the past few weeks and I totally forgot how much I adore this eye cream. I am able to get away with much less under eye concealer on since I have been using this eye cream twice a day every day for about a month or so. The other huge change I have noticed is that those pesky little fine lines that I was starting to get on the outer corners of my eyes (thank you gravity and facial expressions) have become non-existent unless I am laughing really hard or it is a really sunny outside. Of course crying will do the trick too. But aside from when I am actively using those facial muscles, the subtle fine lines have disappeared. It makes it a lot easier to apply my eye liner and concealer. Oh! And I forgot to mention that I am a contact wearer with sensitive, combination skin and allergies. So many eye products irritate my eyes and I can’t use them. But C Tango eye cream doesn’t give me any issues. Also, a little bit goes a long way. I actually only need to use a half pump for both of my eyes because otherwise I have way too much if I use a full pump of this product.

My skin feels so plump, I can’t wait to see how it will look in 6 weeks of using this. I plan on testing to see how quickly it all works but so far it’s working pretty quickly.

reviews.review_text: I was a bit skeptical about using this product since a SPF product and I am of melanin complexion. It is, however, my first Glow Recipe product and I was excited about that. This product did have my skin feeling moisturized and soft the entire day. I didn’t have any issues with feeling greasy and it didn’t leave a white cast like most sunscreens do on my skintone. However, it did get caught in my eyebrows and would show up there. The texture was nice and smooth and I didn’t have problem with blending it into my skin. But it does have a watermelon scent if you are too keen on that. It didn’t bother me, but it did throw me off at first. I have not seen any real changes in my skin or the texture. But I have been using it everyday since receiving it. I can say that I like it. Hopefully, they’ll come out with an unscented one though.

reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Fresh. Honestly, the product is not anything to be too excited about. It does not keep your lips moisturized like it says though. And it does have this tingling feeling when you first apply it.

I don’t think I would be paying $80 though. That’s a bit steep for my pockets.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_title: Skincare/makeup hybrid that changes the game
reviews.review_text: First off, I love the design of this bottle—it truly does look like a dewy drop! Glow Recipe always has iconic products and this one is no exception. Secondly, the ingredients that are included in this gel are powerhouses—niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, and watermelon, to name a few! I LOVE niacinamide and it is one of my favorite ingredients of all time—so it’s no shock that this product has quickly made its way into my daily lineup.The gel absorbs nicely into my skin after cleansing or layering serums, and it smells really nice as well. It truly does leave my skin with a dewy, hydrated, and perky look! However, those of you who don’t like the glass skin look might want to skip this one—it definitely does leave you with a “glow,” so to speak, but it’s not greasy and there aren’t any reflective ingredients like mica in it. I haven’t tried this under makeup yet (lol what is makeup at this point) but judging by how well it absorbs into my skin, I don’t anticipate any issues with it pilling as you layer products.This was my first time trying a Glow Recipe product and they really do live up to their name! So glad to be adding this to my skincare routine.Thank you Glow Recipe for kindly gifting me your Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops! All opinions are my own. #glowrecipegiftedme

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This is my second Sunday Riley product after trying the Vitamin C oil (which I loved!). I am used to using retinol products and was intrigued by how this would fit into my routine. So far, I’m loving what it is doing for my under eye circles and creases. I apply this overnight and when I wake up in the morning the area around my eyes looks slightly more rested than usual. Plus, my fine lines and crows feet are starting to smooth out. I haven’t noticed any sensitivity with this product yet but make sure you wear sunscreen. A little goes a long way too, so even though it’s a small tube you can get a lot of mileage.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is hydrating and feels good on the skin, and is super gentle compared to some other retinol products I’ve used. This one contains a “tri-active” retinol formulation which they describe as a fast-acting retinoid, a slower release retinol, and a retinol booster all in one. As someone who uses retinol daily at this point, I haven’t noticed any stinging or irritation so this is likely a gentler/less potent retinol formulation. The serum is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and keeps moisture locked in. As far as fine line reduction… a little? My skin does feel taut and refreshed when I use this so that’s something. I do feel like it’s helped a bit with crow’s feet and my laugh line area.If you are sensitive to fragrance, you might not like this one. I liked the smell but it’s definitely pretty obvious and it lingers after applying the serum.Lastly, I definitely feel like this serum could be cheaper! There is no reason that retinol products have to be so outrageously expensive—look at all the affordable brands out there with no frills, high potency retinol serums that actually work. You’re basically paying for the brand name here. I also don’t like the lack of information on the exact strength of the retinol and retinoid in the “tri-active” formulation. That seems a bit sus to me. Can only give 3 stars because of those.Overall, this is a really nice serum and I do think it has some anti-aging/tightening effects based on my experience. However, it’s so expensive for what you get. If you can afford it, great! But if not, there are other cheaper and just as effective brands (that aren’t afraid to spell out the potency of their formulation) out there you can try.

It didn’t seem to get as much product as it should have, but not the hugest deal.Overall: pleased with performance, sad about the expensiveness.

reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this exfoliator, it’s so effective. I wouldn’t use this one every day as it is a little too much for daily use, but every other day or twice a week is perfect to keep my skin smooth and happy. Gifted by Dermalogica Sampling

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this exfoliator, it’s so effective. I wouldn’t use this one every day as it is a little too much for daily use, but every other day or twice a week is perfect to keep my skin smooth and happy. Gifted by Dermalogica Sampling

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this product. First of all the idea of this concept is awesome to me. After just one use I can tell my skin is way more hydrated. I used this before applying my serum then moisturizer. It’s pretty expensive but honestly worth the money because you can use such a small amount. Love that it sinks below the first layer of skin. Highly recommend!!!!! I received this as a free sample for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this product. First of all the idea of this concept is awesome to me. After just one use I can tell my skin is way more hydrated. reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: Love this product! Also love that it has the clean at Sephora badge. My skin felt smoother after using it. I also love that you can use just one pump and get a ton of product out. If you want to pair it with the tatcha essence its literally a dream like combo. Highly recommend!! I received this complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It does exactly what it says it does. It takes away dirt without stripping your face. It is super moisturizing and feels so good while still being cleansing. I am going to keep using it and I may even switch to this for my main product. I also love that it is a clean at Sephora product. I received this product as a free sample.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Okay this if freaking AMAZING! If you need ultra-hydrating (like it states) this product is for you. It is soooo hydrating I fell in love the second I used it. I would use it AM Or PM depending on when you feel like your skin could use a moisturizer boost. It has a great scent but nothing over powering. I love the subtle hint of honey in it. The packaging is also freaking amazing because it comes with a spatula BUT NOT ONLY THAT - it is MAGNETIC so you can keep it on the product. I literally always lose these spatulas - so good job Farmacy for once again killing it! I literally can’t review this product high enough. It is the freaking best!! I was sent this for free but I will be purchasing it after I run out FOR SURE.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff! I was surprised how gentle it was seeing as how it was a “treatment“ but it was super moisturizing and I love putting it on my face before I go to bed. This was gifted to me complimentary by Sunday Riley for testing purposes. It is pricey but so worth it in my opinion!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I absoluutely love this stuff!! One of the main reasons I love this product is for the application. It’s so easy to use for night time and you dont’ have to use your hands or fingers at all. It slides on super easily and is very hydrating. I received this product for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I really love this mask! This mask is seriously really calming and smells so good!!!!! I have loved Fresh for a long time and always love using their products so to see that they had a calming mask I knew I needed it in my life lol. The texture is really thin but I like it a lot!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: amazing can't get enough love love love
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product. This product is amazing because it is a moisturizer and primer combo. I always love to use this when I’m getting ready & I know I’m going to put my makeup on right away after I shower. I think it smells good and feels great on my face. Can’t recommend this product enough.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is really hydrating. I really love the packaging and how beautiful and how high end it looks and feels. The only thing is that it has a little bit of a perfume like smell and I typically go for a cleaner smelling type of moisturizer. But overall I’m impressed!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Okay I seriously love this sunscreen. I think the best part about this sunscreen is that it’s more like translucent rather than white. Sometimes sunscreen will leave my face looking white (which who wants that lol) and this one doesn’t do it at ALL. It is so beautiful and gives your skin a nice glow. I will definitely be mixing this in with my moisturizer. It also smells amazing - like watermelon of course! So happy!!!!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Okay this stuff is amazing. This is by far one of my favorite sunscreens I have ever used. I will be wearing this nonstop all summer.  It has a perfect tint to it. It also doesn’t smell like sunscreen hardly at all.  A 10/10. This was given complimentary to me for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I really loved this serum! I think it smelt and felt very clean. I also love the packaging as well. I thought it was hydrating as well. I will use this product for sure. I do think it is a little pricey though.  I was gifted this product from fresh for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: First of all I love the packaging. Second, the product feels and smells super clean and fresh. It’s also super moisturizing and great to put underneath a moisturizer. I was gifted this complimentary from Allgenist for testing purposes. It’s pricey!!! But i love it!!!

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy. This is my first products from this company and I love it! My skin tends to get oily so I go for gel moisturizers more often. I really like the consistency of this moisturizer as it is light weight as a gel and spreads easily, but provides a lot of moisture and richness to your skin! It really feels lightweight but really moisturizes your skin. I also love the very subtle scent as it reminds me of gummy candy :)

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This product complimentary from Glow Recipe gives me skin life!! I usually don’t wear primers since they tend to make my oily skin look too oily later in the day, but this serum when used under my makeup makes my skin GLOW in a good way! It absorbs so well and layers well under makeup. I love using this as a highlighter on top of makeup as well!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love this product! I love how gentle it is on my skin and it didn’t cause any irritation. It goes on smoothly and layers will with other products. My skin looks brighter and more even toned after a week of use. Received complimentary from Sunday Riley.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is such a luxurious cream!! My skin felt softer and more supple after use and I just feel so bougie using it. Lol. I love how gentle it is on my skin, how it spreads smoothly and absorbs well. Love it!! Gifted by La Mer.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is such a luxurious cream!! My skin felt softer and more supple after use and I just feel so bougie using it. Lol. I love how gentle it is on my skin, how it spreads smoothly and absorbs well. Love it!! Gifted by La Mer.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love how well this cream absorbs into my skin. It leaves it feeling soft, hydrated and plump. The rose scent was also refreshing. It doesn’t leave my skin feeling or looking oily either which is great.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This is such a lovely cream! It feels rich and nourishing and leaves my skin feeling supple and soft. My skin is sensitive and I have yet to have any breakouts or irritation. This is good to use throughout all seasons too :)

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This is such a lovely cream! It feels rich and nourishing and leaves my skin feeling supple and soft. My skin is sensitive and I have yet to have any breakouts or irritation. This is good to use throughout all seasons too :)

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I really like this pre-cleanse! It removes my waterproof make up and it’s also great to use on days where I don’t wear make up. My skin feels clean and supple afterwards without any dryness. I can’t imagine not using a pre-cleanse anymore! Gifted by Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I really like this pre-cleanse! It removes my waterproof make up and it’s also great to use on days where I don’t wear make up. My skin feels clean and supple afterwards without any dryness. I can’t imagine not using a pre-cleanse anymore! Gifted by Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am a fan of this cream! It’s very hydrating and glides on smooth. My skin feels hydrated and looks more plump. Love that it doesn’t leave a sticky residue and it layers well under my makeup. Also love the packaging.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am a fan of this cream! It’s very hydrating and glides on smooth. My skin feels hydrated and looks more plump. Love that it doesn’t leave a sticky residue and it layers well under my makeup. Also love the packaging.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed the serum! My skin looks youthful, Feels hydrated and plan. It layers well with other skin care products and under make up. It absorbs quickly into my skin as well! Definitely would recommend this serum

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really tried to like this product as it has so many good reviews and good ingredients. I just couldn’t though. It really didn’t work as a first step cleanser for me because I felt it didn’t clean anything off (makeup, sweat, sunscreen) so I couldn’t even imagine using it as a cleanser on its own? It felt like I was rubbing pure aloe on my face ? No feeling of cleaning ? Maybe if you have super sensitive/dry skin this would work for you. I even gave my bottle to my mom thinking it would work for mature skin. And I noticed it’s been sitting in her washroom untouched for a year now. So she must have not liked it either ? Your better off saving yourself money and buying the dry skin Spectro cleanser. It’s got the same gentle feeling but you actually get a clean face from it and for a fraction of the price.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: Great simple charcoal/clay mask. Does exactly what it should detoxes pores, dries up pimples/acne, minimizes blackheads, and decreases pore size.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This is a great makeup remover. Just as good as boscia cooling breakup oil for taking off long wear makeup. My only issue is it’s too heavy and think? Yes you melt it in your hand but it’s a little too heavy for my skin type. And will cause me to get blackheads. Wish it didn’t because it’s the best makeup remover. No scrubbing needed. No red irritated eyes.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This is a great makeup remover. Just as good as boscia cooling breakup oil for taking off long wear makeup. My only issue is it’s too heavy and think? reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I found this moisturizer very drying and not moisturizing at all? And I have combination but acne prone skin so usually creams don’t dry out my skin? Also I saw no pore minimizing.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I found this moisturizer very drying and not moisturizing at all? And I have combination but acne prone skin so usually creams don’t dry out my skin? Also I saw no pore minimizing.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I bought these to try as a dupe for the Dr Dennis gross alpha daily peels. These worked ok but no where near as well as the dr Dennis gross ones. And these you have to use daily where as the dr Dennis gross ones I only need to use 2x a week.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I really liked this face oil actually. I don’t usually use face oils and tend to steer far away from them as they cause breakouts, blackheads, and pore problems usually. I can use this (not every night) but occasionally and wake up with glowy brighter skin. If I use too frequently though my pores will get very large. Great to wear the night before I know I have to wear a full face of makeup. Makes foundation look flawless and keeps dry patches from happening.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really didn’t like this face cleanser. It didn’t feel like a chemical exfoliator. But yet it dried my skin out so bad. I also didn’t get that deep feel clean and fresh feeling that you get from other exfoliators. I got no improvements in my texture, acne, pores. Glad I got samples and didn’t purchase a full bottle.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

I also didn’t get that deep feel clean and fresh feeling that you get from other exfoliators. I got no improvements in my texture, acne, pores. Glad I got samples and didn’t purchase a full bottle.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Ok primer. But it seemed more of just a moisturizer to me then a primer. It definitely didn’t do anything to help my enlarged pores. Didn’t help with skin texture. Didn’t break me out but didn’t work as a primer either.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I really liked this face oil actually. I don’t usually use face oils and tend to steer far away from them as they cause breakouts, blackheads, and pore problems usually. I can use this (not every night) but occasionally and wake up with glowy brighter skin. If I use too frequently though my pores will get very large. Great to wear the night before I know I have to wear a full face of makeup. Makes foundation look flawless and keeps dry patches from happening.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: This is a very creamy moisturizing eye cream. It’s a basic eye cream and does a simple job of just moisturizing. I found no brightening affect, no depuffing. But does really help with crows feet. Also I am acne prone and I have to be very careful not to get any on my nose as it will cause an explosion of blackheads. Overall great simple eye cream. If you’re looking to just be proactive towards anti aging, this eye cream is perfect.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a necessity for me. My first night using it the next morning it completely changed my skin. And with continued use my acne has completely cleared up and my pores have reduced in size. Great prize for 2oz too. The only thing I have to say is it did burn my face for the first few times I used it and the first time it did make my skin red for about a half hour. My skin has built tolerance now and it no longer burns and my face doesn’t go red. So it is strong and I only use it at night.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I grabbed this because my usual Clinique Moisture Surge moisturizer was delayed in delivery. I don’t usually try different face creams as switching up tends to break me out. This was the first cream in a very long time I grabbed randomly, used and did not breakout from. My skin was nice and balanced not oily or dry. It worked well with makeup and all my serums. It definitely brightened up my skin and didn’t cause my pores to blow up massive or a breakout in blackheads. Which is a rare thing. I also have very sensitive skin with lots of allergies and I got not rash or irritation from this moisturizer. A pleasant surprise for trying a random face cream on a whim. Now because of price I will continue to use the Clinique Moisture Surge. If this had the same price tag for the amount I would definitely consider adding this to my skin care routine. So if you’re looking for a light weight gel moisturizer this is a great choice. And can definitely work with pretty much any skin type, as it helped my dry patches and texture but kept my oily t-zone at bay.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m on the fence with this product. I usually use Wishful’s Thirst Trap Juice serum but have been looking for a cheaper alternative. Decided to give this a try as The Ordinary brand always seems to work with my skin. Now this has the same texture (not oily or greasy) as the Thirst Trap Juice and absorbs just as nicely, I thought I found a much cheaper dupe. After over a week of using though I started to get really bad blackhead breakouts on my nose and cheeks. So I had to stop using it. Not sure why the reaction with my pores as it’s oil free not greasy at all and absorbed really well into my skin. So I keep it but now I mainly use it on my cuticles now. So still looking for my dupe for Wishful’s Thirst Trap Juice but I do recommend trying this product. Even if you are acne prone because I am and did not get any full out pimple breakouts from using this, but if you suffer from big pores or blackheads I would stick with the Thirst Trap Juice.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: This is by far my favourite retinol product on the market. Retinol products usually irritate my sensitive skin but this is one of the few that doesn’t I can use it nightly without any irritation at all. It clears up acne and helps healing acne heal faster and nicer. It heals acne scars, and helps with blackheads and big pores. I found it made all the texture on my cheeks disappear. My skin looked over bright, clearer, and just overall an healthy glow. One of the best serums out there. I suggest it to all skin types, even dry and sensitive just don’t go in using daily if you are dry and sensitive. But definitely a game changer this serum, and worth it’s price.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: This is by far my favourite retinol product on the market. Retinol products usually irritate my sensitive skin but this is one of the few that doesn’t I can use it nightly without any irritation at all. It clears up acne and helps healing acne heal faster and nicer. It heals acne scars, and helps with blackheads and big pores. I found it made all the texture on my cheeks disappear. reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I get huge pores and blackheads from just about every moisturizer I have tried and I think I’ve tried everything on the market. And if it doesn’t do that it causes dryness and dry patches. This stuff is awesome. I use it as my main moisturizer and my skin has never looked better. It also does really well under makeup. It’s very moisturizing without being heavy and causing me my pores to react. Highly recommend if you have skin that doesn’t do well with regular moisturizers.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a go to face cream for me. It has a gel, watery texture, but moisturizes like a thick heavy cream. Does not clog pores causing breakouts and blackheads. And absorbs well with no greasy feeling, and does wonderful under makeup. Price is reasonable for an everyday face cream. I find it helps balance out my skin, and helps keep dry skin and flakes at bay. This is a basic face cream, it has no frills to it and does not have any SPF in it (which is why I took a star off). But definitely a good basic face cream for all skin types. And recommend even if you are acne prone but suffer from dry skin from acne products/prescriptions.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I do not put oils on my face usually. I stick to all oil free products because I am acne prone, with large pores, and prone to blackheads. So oil and my skin never work well together. I gave this oil a try during the colder dry winter months and it revitalized my skin! This has to be one of the few oils I have tried that didn’t break me out, cause my pores to get larger, or a blackhead breakout. I don’t use it in the am or during warmer months as it will make my skin greasy, but during the winter I use it at night and when I wake up I have such a healthy glow and my rough dry patches have cleared up. Wonderful face oil, definitely recommend for all skin types!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Lovely hydrating mask, but caused a breakout on my combo skin.  Unfortunately had to return.  If you are acne prone, this may be too heavy for you.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My go-to daily face wash.  I use this every morning, it feels really nice.  Does not agitate my acne prone skin, and just the right balance for combo skin.  The ingredient list is lovely, and I have noticed a shift in my skin health over all.  I do not use this at night, I use a cleansing oil and/or First aid beauty pure face cleanser to remove makeup and sunscreen. A couple of notes:-if you are dry, this may be stripping to your skin, or leave it feeling really tight.-I would use this in conjunction with a pre cleanse oil or balm, this will not take off all your makeup and clean your skin.  Unless you use it twice, but that may be too stripping.-The glass bottle, although nice, is not travel safe or good to keep in the shower, can get messy.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My go-to daily face wash.  I use this every morning, it feels really nice.  Does not agitate my acne prone skin, and just the right balance for combo skin.  The ingredient list is lovely, and I have noticed a shift in my skin health over all.  I do not use this at night, I use a cleansing oil and/or First aid beauty pure face cleanser to remove makeup and sunscreen. A couple of notes:-if you are dry, this may be stripping to your skin, or leave it feeling really tight.-I would use this in conjunction with a pre cleanse oil or balm, this will not take off all your makeup and clean your skin.  Unless you use it twice, but that may be too stripping.-The glass bottle, although nice, is not travel safe or good to keep in the shower, can get messy.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The best cleanser for combo, acne prone skin.  I use this mostly at night to clean off any heavy build up in my pores (sunscreen, makeup residue, sweet).  It leaves the face feeling nourished and clean.  I can even use this to clean off makeup if I forgot my pre-cleanse, and there will not be any residue.  The ingredients are great, and never cause a flair up for me. Great day and night.Note: great to travel with, lid topper is secure.-I do use the Youth to the People green cleanser in the morning, as I love the ingredients and the tightening effect. However if I had to pick one, First aid beauty would definitely win.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I was looking for a face oil for the dryer months to treat my combo skin.  However within the first night of using this I woke up with a bad breakout.  I tried this through the week thinking it could have been from something I ate (I have PCOS and it can cause acne breakouts due to refined sugar intake), but as I tried to reintroduce this oil to my skin I kept on breaking out.  Another con is the price, there are similar products that Sephora sells for less.Note: If you do not suffer from breakouts or acne, and do not mind the price point, then this may be a nice moisturizing oil to use.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product on and off since they started selling it as Sephora.  It is a really nice cream for combo skin, and was even a little to heavy for me in the summer months.  The ingredients are really nice, and over all it is a good product.I am giving it three stars because I have found that this product triggers breakouts for me.  I could never understand why I kept getting them when I wasn’t hanging anything in my routine (having used this on and off).  Since stopping this, my breakouts have cleared up. Unfortunately will not buy anymore.Note: Still a great product for those who do not have product breakouts and combo skin.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: A lovely serum toner, that really does give a smooth appearance to the skin.  I do not treat this as a toner, the product is bouncy and thick enough that it can be applied with your hands. The ingredients also speak to a serum, I would not double up on serums if you are using this.Note: I did stop using this as the “pore tightening“ effect did cause some texture on my skin (more blackheads and bumps).  This was the only change to my skincare, so I stopped using it.  I did regift this product and it is loved by those who to not have such responsive skin.  That is why I am giving it 4 stars.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: A lovely serum toner, that really does give a smooth appearance to the skin.  I do not treat this as a toner, the product is bouncy and thick enough that it can be applied with your hands. The ingredients also speak to a serum, I would not double up on serums if you are using this.Note: I did stop using this as the “pore tightening“ effect did cause some texture on my skin (more blackheads and bumps).  This was the only change to my skincare, so I stopped using it.  I did regift this product and it is loved by those who to not have such responsive skin.  That is why I am giving it 4 stars.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: Currently using this as a night cream for winter.  It is hydrating enough on my combo skin that I do not wake up dry, and it leaves the skin feeling plump.  The scent can be off-putting to some, so if you are sensitive to scents, I would test it first.  It is 4 stars for me as it is not wowing.  I have not seen a difference in my skin since using it, but am happy enough with it.  will likely not repurchase and will try a new product for night.  If you like the brand and/or ingredients then give it a try.Note: I use this for nighttime because a heavier cream meant for night will break me out (I have tried many).  My skin is really picky, so I use a lot of day options for night and they work just fine for my combo skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: Lovely hydrating mask, but caused a breakout on my combo skin.  Unfortunately had to return.  If you are acne prone, this may be too heavy for you.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: After trying every moisturizer Sephora has to offer for combo skin, I thought I would just have to deal with unsatisfying products that either hydrated my skin but broke me out, or did not break me out but left my skin dry.  This moisturizer is the best of both worlds.  I cannot believe my PCOS hormonal acne (my experience) loves this so much.   It is not too heavy in the summer when I am oily, so I use it day and night.  In the winter however, I only use it during the day as I need something more richer for night time dryness.  I cannot recommend it enough, try the mini to test it out!

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: Excellent product for calming/reducing acne flair-ups.  I used this product as suggested (use everyday for a week, then reduce to once a week or as needed) to treat a bad breakout, and it was in the healing faze by the end of the treatment week!  Usually getting my flare-ups to heal takes much longer, and have to use drying products.  Not only does this product not leave my skin feeling stripped, it also soothes.  One thing to look out for:  it will tingle on freshly cleaned skin, so if you are sensitive to that sensation, try a test patch.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I truly think this is the best lip mask out there.  I know the ingredients do not impress people (and I am finicky with ingredients myself), but I have had nothing but love for this product since it has come out.  I have dry, thin lips and nothing I have used has ever helped to hydrate them.  This mask I use night and day and has been the product that has brought some plumpness back to my lips.  To the point where family members have commented on the difference.  When I stopped using this for a few months to try and use a “better“ product recommended by skin care “experts“, my lips went back to being lifeless and dry.  For reference I purchased the milk makeup lip balm/mask (purple jar) at double the price for half the product because it was better.  Well, not for me because my lips darkened to a purple brown, and stayed dry.  I personally do not care that this is not the “best“ out there because it is the best for me.  Thankfully I returned to this product and my lips are hydrated and flushed again.  This will always be a staple in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This used to me my go-to moisturizer, but I couldn’t take the plunge to repurchase due to the price.  I personally do not believe the price reflects the ingredients in this moisturizer.  If you are however willing to buy ($95 Canadian) this did not irritate my acne prone combo skin, and was just hydrating enough.  I personally switched to the Glow Recipe watermelon moisturizer gel.  It has a similar texture and feel on the skin, better ingredients (in my opinion), and is half the price.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This used to me my go-to moisturizer, but I couldn’t take the plunge to repurchase due to the price.  I personally do not believe the price reflects the ingredients in this moisturizer.  If you are however willing to buy ($95 Canadian) this did not irritate my acne prone combo skin, and was just hydrating enough.  I personally switched to the Glow Recipe watermelon moisturizer gel.  It has a similar texture and feel on the skin, better ingredients (in my opinion), and is half the price.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical to use this product because of the price, but I’m glad I took the plunge.  Although it is an AHA product, my skin does not feel agitated when applying this.  There is an initial tingle, so I would recommend a patch test for those who are reactive or sensitive.  I use this serum 2-3 times a week, depending on my skin’s needs.  Based on how I use it, the product lasts a long time and I really do see a difference in my skin.  Especially with my acne scarring, it fades more quickly than if I did not use.  The majority of this line I really love, which is hard to find for my acne prone combo skin.

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have two issues with this product.  Firstly, the shimmer effect to brighten the eyes makes my under eye look yellow and like I’m sick.  Four times I’ve had someone remark to me that it looked weird (without makeup on).  Instead of a brightened look, I appeared sick.  secondly, the formulation worsened my clogged pores under my eyes (Milia) and I noticed a lot more white spots than I normally had.  Although I do find this formulation to be hydrating, and the metal applicator to help with cooling, these are not enough pros to outweigh the cons.  This was a return.I am giving it three stars because if you do not suffer from milia, particularly under the eyes, then this may be a nice hydrating day eye cream.  for the price, it is worth it to try and see if it works for you.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My face always feels so refreshed and cool after I use this! Will always rebuy whenever I run out. I recommend to anyone!

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: It’s hydrating and feels great to the skin. I also use the AmorePacific dewy mist which also has bamboo extract. I was recommended to buy that one before this because this one is more water based, which I did. But I will say this is still a great product and I’m glad to have it. I know it will last me a while because I alternate between the mists I have. When the time comes I’ll definitely rebuy!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: This is one of the toners I use and I love it. I have tons of Fresh products and I’m never disappointed. This hydrates the skin so well. A little goes a long way so you only need a tiny dot on your hand and then use your fingers to apply the product.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I was waiting for Tatcha to release this! I noticed their deep cleanse suited normal to oily skin like the rest of their ’green’ packaged products. Once this was released I jumped right on the bandwagon. The texture suits my skin well and hydrates it. I love how the product foams as I rub it on my face. I don’t see myself switching face washes any time soon if I ever do. I would recommend this product to anyone with skin that’s more on the dry side.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I was waiting for Tatcha to release this! I noticed their deep cleanse suited normal to oily skin like the rest of their ’green’ packaged products. reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: It’s not what I expected. I love the texture as it glides very easily across the skin, but it just doesn’t do the job for me. I’m all about the Dewy look. I use everything tatcha. But when it comes to serums, Kiehls Vitamin C Serum works better. I like sticking to natural products but that is my one exception. It just clears up blemishes better. As for this serum, I didn’t notice a difference in the dewyness of my skin. But that’s because I already have a super dewy regimen and look soaked as it is. So I guess it’s something I didn’t really need. I just wanted to use this and give it a try because I love tatcha so much. Everyone’s skin is different and acclimated to different products, so I would still recommend to those wanting to boost hydration and ensure it stays all day.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: Great daily moisturizer. Love the gel cream texture, not too heavy, not too light. Not quite moisturizing enough for dry Utah winters, but perfect the rest of the year.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Adore this moisturizer! It smells amazing, green and fresh, and feels heavenly. Perfect for everyday wear and my makeup went on smoothly over the top without feeling sticky or greasy. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Such a great night cream. Makes my skin feel so dreamy and soft. Smells so good and feels so hydrating without being heavy.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: My go-to treatment for breakouts. More affordable + less packaging waste than ZitSticka and I love the actives: salicylic acid, retinol + aloe. These patches definitely help decongest skin, pull out the zit gunk and noticeably speed up healing time.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Such a fantastic product. use every day. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_title: The Ordinary is a skin care life changer.
reviews.review_text: Such a staple to The Ordinary regime, use twice a day wither other The Ordinary products, and has made my skin go from layers of foundation to be able to go naked for the first time since I was a teenager.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I received this as a free sample. While it was very hydrating and made my skin soft in the morning, it was very heavy and didn’t absorb into my skin well and felt a lot more tacky than other overnight masks and didn’t absorb enough.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this as a free sample. While it was very hydrating and made my skin soft in the morning, it was very heavy and didn’t absorb into my skin well and felt a lot more tacky than other overnight masks and didn’t absorb enough.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: My skin has never been worse than after I used this product. My cheeks are red and bumpy and unlike anything I’ve ever experienced before from any product I’ve ever used. I wouldn’t recommend this product to anyone.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cleanser! I have sensitive skin and I have no problems using this at all. It smells amazing and feels great on the skin. I pair this with the water cream and my skin looks better after and feels so much softer.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cleanser! I have sensitive skin and I have no problems using this at all. It smells amazing and feels great on the skin. I pair this with the water cream and my skin looks better after and feels so much softer.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Probably my favorite product I’ve tried from the ordinary. Diminishes the look of my pores and pairs well with almost any moisturizer. My skin can be sensitive to new products but I had no issues with this! Highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_title: Not as great as other ordinary products
reviews.review_text: I have quite the variety of ordinary products and this one was a little disappointing to me. I do not feel as if this is quite as moisturizing as other products. I really wanted to love it. One plus is that a little bit goes a long way. The bottle may be a little small but it lasts a while.

reviews.review_text: I ordered the smaller size of this mask and I love it! I can actually tell a difference in the morning as to whether I used this or not the night before. My skin feels smoother when I use this. The smell is not my favorite but it’s very faint. I am just sensitive to smell. My skin can be sensitive to new products and I had no issues with this.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I am very pale so I was not sure how this product would look on me but I was pleasantly surprised! I only needed one drop and I mixed with my moisturizer and it added a nice glow! Very happy

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have been a fan of Fresh lip balms for years (back to highschool over ten years ago) and have have tried many colors/flavors. The rose is a classic one! The color is not as intimidating as it may look in the tube. It goes on pretty sheer, but leaves a pretty pink tint to give your lips some color. They are hydrating and also smell so good! I received this product complimentary from Fresh Beauty in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Wow okay I LOVE this. I have dry skin that gets flakey on my forehead and around my nose. This moisturizer is amazing. It smells good (but not over powering) and it truly makes my skin feel plump and hydrated. I love the texture and how my skin feels and looks in the morning after applying this before bed. *gifted by Farmacy Beauty

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: this is a tried and true product! works as a moisturizer and a primer. smell is amazing. reminds me of like a lemon cake lol but not too overpowering! this is definitely my summer product - as I sometimes need a lil extra hydration during the winter for my dry skin. i would say this product would work well on oily gals too. love it and will always have this in my collection!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product gifted by Drunk Elephant! I definitely notice a difference in how bright my skin looks after using for a few days. Plus it is fun to mix the product to use, makes me feel like a little scientist at work!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_title: Great, but Not for Sensitive Skin
reviews.review_text: I’d give this 4.5 if possible! This product contains AHAs which are alpha hydroxy acids. They function like a chemical exfoliant to remove dead skin. In past products i’ve used containing AHAs my skin has sort of “pilled” off like lint on a sweater, if that makes sense. This product didn’t do that, but it was DEFINITELY tingly/burn-y feeling. You use this at night and make sure to use sunscreen the next day (you should every day :))! Also, keep it away from the sensitive areas of your face such as your under eyes or lips as it tends to be too harsh for there’s areas. I’d definitely say I noticed a brightening/more awake look in my skin, most likely due to the AHAs. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes and happily and truthfully will recommend it to you, even just to try once considering the price.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product was my first experience with the brand Tatcha, one that I had heard great things about. I loved the packaging for this product and found it innovative and interesting, while the pump design is sanitary and easy to use. The serum has a light floral scent and easily soaks into the skin. I do feel as though this product has helped my skin to bounce back from a time marked by depression and has assisted in rebuilding my confidence by helping me to feel beautiful again. My only complaints are (1) that there is no way to see how much product is remaining in the bottle to know if you are nearing the end and (2) the price is not something I can really justify, especially during a pandemic that has left so many struggling.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have really enjoyed my experience with this product thus far. It’s lightweight but also hydrating enough that it can be used as part of both your morning and nighttime skincare routines. I have also heard great things about incorporating squaline into your skincare routine, so I was excited to find a moisturizer that includes that ingredient.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have really enjoyed my experience with this product thus far. reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I like that this product is able to simplify my skincare routine down to just cleansing and using this product since it’s packed with beneficial ingredients! This makes it great for anyone on the go with little room to bring along a whole 4-5 step routine of products. The product is easy to apply and feels lightweight on the skin. It also doesn’t leave any greasy residue so it’s great for both night and morning routines.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: I use it in the day too
reviews.review_text: Why just a sleeping mask? I use it whenever I feel like my lips are dry (which is a lot less frequently since I started using it). I had *the* driest lips, seriously the kind that frequently bleed in the winter, and this stuff is the best thing I have found. I do like it that it comes in a pot so I’m not tempted to take it around with me since I have a habit of losing lip balms (which makes this a really good deal for me since losing lip balms all the time gets expensive).

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: Most moisturizers irritate my skin. This did not. It went on smoothly, absorbed quickly, and moisturized without feeling oily. My skin has improved but I have also been adding other products so I can’t say it’s this moisturizer. But I’m sticking with this. I’m glad you can get it elsewhere on the internet since Sephora is always out of stock.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Wish I had tried this first
reviews.review_text: I really wish that I had just trusted the responses to this product instead of trying to find something more economical. It would have saved me a lot of money. One thing I hate, truly can’t stand, is little blackheads visibly coming out of pores. Biore strips take care of it, and I would use them once or twice a week. It was time for me to do my little strip but I kind of forgot and used this instead, which I had picked up a sample of at the store (by the way a packet sample only has one use but an in-store pot sample will give you two or three). The next day my annoying little blackheads that were poking out of my skin were gone. I didn’t sample this in the hopes that it would fix my blackhead issue but boy did it. I’m not sure it is cheaper than doing strips a couple of times a week, but it might be and seems like it has to be a heck of a lot better for my skin. I’ve only been using it for a week and I haven’t noticed other results.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: At first this eye cream was a dream. It hydrated, thickened my skin, and got rid of my eyelid droop. But then it became just another meh moisturizer. I think the culprit is the packaging. Once exposed to air, the beneficial ingredients start breaking down. Think about it: how long does an avocado exposed to air stay good for? I so wish this was in a tube because it’s such an amazing eye cream when the ingredients are active. But if you want to pay a ton of money for about two weeks of an amazing eye cream, I recommend!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I wavered between a four and five star review. On the one hand, it’s pricey. On the other hand, it’s so nice to mix my sunscreen with a bit of this so that sunscreen doesn’t turn me white. I am not sure about it’s efficacy as a skincare product but i do like the way it looks. I have started justifying the price of this product by calling it a replacement for foundation, which it has actually has become for me.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Good but not my favorite moisturizer, a bit too thin for me. I use this on days where my skin isn’t as dry or I’ve already used hydrating treatments.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Leaves skin looking super smooth afterwards and decreases blackheads.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I buy lip balms and glosses ALL THE TIME trying to find the perfect ones and I think I found the perfect blend of the two!!! The scent I bought was peach and it’s so lovely and fresh and perfect for spring!! I’m hoping they come out with more

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I really love this eye cream!!! It does everything it says that it does!! My only complaint is that I wish I could see how much product I have used so that I can get a general idea of when to buy more before I run out.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: You need this part of your life!
reviews.review_text: I love this product so much! Living in Minnesota I Ari sk my lips getting chapped in the winter, but last year was the first year that never became a problem for me and I fully blame this stuff for that miracle!! I also love how the berry smells!! I was so excited to try the apple/lime one, but I was a little disappointed that it smelled more like lime rather than apple, so I just picked up the new holiday pack of 3 to try out instead!! Regardless of scent, this stuff is awesome!!

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask

Fragrance free as always I can’t get enough of DE products and this one has jumped to the top of my favorites list. I use 4-5 pumps at night at the end of my routine but doesn’t the day I sometimes add 2 pumps before sunscreen. It’s amazing. Don’t hesitate. Buy it.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Really enjoying this mask. I never tried the original because of fragrance. This leaves my skin so soft and subtle. Perfect overnight hydration.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Really enjoying this mask. I never tried the original because of fragrance. This leaves my skin so soft and subtle. Perfect overnight hydration.

reviews.review_title: Definitely a new staple for me.
reviews.review_text: It’s a great essence. If you’re looking for a fragrance free (if there is any added I couldn’t smell it and I’m HIGHLY sensitive to fragrance of any kind). It’s a no nonsense just great hydrating essence. The packaging is heavy and stunning. I love the aesthetic

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Depuffs and reduces dark circles is exactly what I needed. The hydration is amazing too. Sits well under makeup. I love that it contains peptides. I’ve used under makeup and it kept the under eye area hydrated all day. #giftedbyalgenist

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I was worried about using these on my sensitive skin but so far, no problem. Helped smooth out my texture and gives my skin an overall brighter, fresh complexion. Helps with any clogged pores around the nose. Great fit these hot, sweaty summer days.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: My skin has been abnormally dry this winter mostly due to being at home so much and with the heat blasting. My go to fixes weren’t working but after my first use of ICE, my skin felt hydrated, soft,  protected, and not at all greasy. The hydration lasts until you wash your face and even after,  my skin still felt remarkably better. I love the applicator that comes with this cream which keeps your product bacteria and germ free, versus using your fingers to scoop out cream. My skin can be a little particular when it comes to creams and pores but,  I’ve had ZERO issues with this cream. It’s gentle,  won’t clog your pores, and it does exactly as it claims. ICE is a  definite new go to for hydrated,  healthy skin.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: Due to life’s current curveball, I’ve been staying home more, wearing less make up, and not getting as much deep sleep. I wanted to try something that would help me lessen the need for under eye concealer. This cream definitely helps with morning puffiness and over time, I’m noticing my under eye area is looking lighter and more smooth. A tiny bit goes a long way and I’ve had no negative reactions with my sensitive skin.  No watery eyes and it settles well under make up when I do wear it.  Great product,  great results.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the first vitamin C product that hasn’t irritated my sensitive skin. I’ve got a few sun spots developing around my eyes and one on my cheek. This serum has definitely made a difference, with continued use, I my spots are fading. I’m thrilled and will continue using this magic potion. Spots be gone!

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a sample from this from my local Sephora after being selected for a Virtual VoxBox from Influenster. I love a good moisturizer and one that makes my skin glow. I used this both before makeup and at nighttime and I love it more for before makeup. I have normal to dry skin with my skin being more dry in the cooler months. Overall great product.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Wow! I’ve tried many moisturizers but this one hands down is the best. The consistency is perfect and keeps skin hydrated all day. Also there is no fragrance (which can be irritating for us migraine sufferers). Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Wow! I’ve tried many moisturizers but this one hands down is the best. The consistency is perfect and keeps skin hydrated all day. Also there is no fragrance (which can be irritating for us migraine sufferers). Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: As someone who has more dry normal skin this product was pretty good. I wore as a primer before makeup to cover up my pores. Overall decent product

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: As someone who suffers from dry skin this product is fantastic. It is a thicker product but surprisingly sinks into skin effortlessly. Leaves skin feeling nice and hydrated. Received free from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product free from Influenster. I love belif products and this one really loved my dry skin. I used in the morning before applying makeup and at night. I noticed after being out in the sun my skin really liked this product. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: After trying out product in the AM & PM I noticed that I only like using this particular product in the PM. I found that using this any applying makeup did not mesh well for my skin. I have noticed after 14 days of use my skin feels plumper and more hydrated. I did receive this product free from Bzzagent.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

reviews.review_text: Love this moisturizer so much so lightweight and looks amazing on my skin . I have dry skin and this is so good I absolutely love this brand so much . My skin has improved so much since using it . My go to moisturizer

reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cream so much , my face has never been better . It’s such a beautiful cream and makes my skin so soft and feels like butter .It’s so light weight and it hydrates my skin so much .

reviews.review_text: I love all fresh products  so much and this moisturizer it’s so amazing .The packaging is so cute and it smells so good .My skin is dry and this one hydrated my skin without leaving it greasy . I love it .

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love glowrecipe so much . Their sunscreens are so amazing and don’t leave a whine cast at all . They blend so good in your skin and will make your makeup look so beautiful while protecting you from the sun

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love fresh products so much and while they came out with this serum I had to try it .It’s so amazing it leaves my skin so soft and hydrated and it makes my skin look so plump too .I just started using it and loving it

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I think The Essence is an absolutely lovely product that completely enhances one’s skincare routine from just the application to its effectiveness. I can honestly say my skincare has performed a hundred times better than before adding The Essence into my skincare ritual. It’s just a lovely product to use and experience.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I think The Essence is an absolutely lovely product that completely enhances one’s skincare routine from just the application to its effectiveness. I can honestly say my skincare has performed a hundred times better than before adding The Essence into my skincare ritual. It’s just a lovely product to use and experience.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I have been using the Violet-C Serum for roughly a month alongside The Essence and within a couple weeks, I noticed a real difference in my skin. It appears so much more even. My dark spots from sun damage have faded tremendously. My skin looks clean. My acne scars are reduced. It’s kind of amazing. I have used a few products similar to this and reviewed them but not have performed this well. I am also seeing the surface and texture of my skin change for the better. It’s smoother and the fine lines have diminished. I am really impressed and pleased with this product. I feel confident in my bare skin for the first time. I haven’t seen a product make this big of a difference in my skin in ages.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely facial oil. I like to apply it in the AM 30 minutes prior to doing my makeup giving it time to soak in and work its magic. It also looks beautiful on my vanity and the soft rosy scent is nice.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely light weight serum for nighttime. I’ve been using for a few weeks and my skin seems pretty happy with it. It does however,  peel up when used with other products.
