reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: My favorite eye cream. The autocorrect leaves my under eyes so nourished and youthful in appearance. It’s a heavier formula but I have been loving it in these cold-weather months. My concealer sits so well since I began using this product.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has saved my skin this winter. It leaves it looking so plump and radiant. It’s rich in texture but sinks into the skin beautifully.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Beautiful eye serum. I love the tube and applicator tip. Super cooling and refreshing. I can’t wait to see the full results. So far so good. Thank you Sunday Riley for gifting me this lovely eye serum. Great companion to the Auto Correct.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: One of my favorite undereye creams. Moisturizes and leaves my undereyes feeling great. Perfect for under concealer because it has a nice thin texture that sinks right in.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m loving this new version of the cream! It goes on rich and creamy, then absorbs quickly into my skin leaving it feeling amazing for the day. Performs great under makeup.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I wanted to try this out for a bit before writing a review. I use it whenever I wash my face and it is pretty nice. The smell is pretty strong but also natural enough that it doesn’t bother me. The ingredients are really nice. I have the most dry sensitive skin out of anyone I know. This doesn’t make my pores disappear but I do feel like it works great if you have oily skin or even a slightly oily t zone. It will keep you moisturized enough but I still had dry patches that were not helped by this. It made my pimples diminish if one started. But I didn’t feel like it prevented any. I received this for testing from Influenster. I think I’ll keep using it in my t zone but I wouldn’t recommend it for your whole face. Maybe use it in conjunction with another product? Otherwise it’s quite lovely.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is a light and fresh moisturizer. It has good ingredients in it like hyaluronic acid. It does have fragrance in it so you should be weary of that if you have a sensitivity. It’s lightweight and nice. I received this complimentary from Influenster to review.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I was disappointed when I tried this. I have extremely dry skin and was so excited to see if this would work but didn’t even get a chance because it was so strongly scented that I immediately got a migraine and couldn’t keep it on my face. I wish I could’ve kept it on longer to see if it worked but I couldn’t. If you have a sensitivity to scent, this is not for you.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This product is really lightweight and smells almost herbal. I have incredibly sensitive skin and am prone to migraines but it didn’t really bother me. That being said, I didn’t feel like it was all that hydrating. My skin looked and felt good right after application but I found dry spots after a few hours. All in all, I think this would better suit someone that doesn’t have really dry skin. It’s gentle and I did like it.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using glossier balm as a lip mask for years. It’s always been so good I never bothered even trying something else. Then I received this from Influenster to try out and wow. Literally overnight my lips became so plump and hydrated. I woke up amazed. I’ve tried so many complimentary products and this is the first time I think I will be purchasing after. The scent is very soft and it feels really nice.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: So I received this complimentary from Influenster and Shiseido in exchange for my honest review. Immediately I thought I would like this one better than the fresh-moisture sunscreen by Shiseido because it had a mineral sunscreen too. I liked the texture more. It soaked in and didn’t seem to leave any noticeable residue. It felt like my skin. Now, it is still very smelly. It smells super strongly of sunscreen which is off putting especially on my face. Also, there are still very high concentrations of certain ingredients that the fda recommends against. This lead to mild irritation on my face. All in all, I’m torn. If you don’t have sensitive skin and you’re not really worried about these things would I recommend it? I guess. But it wouldn’t be something I would recommend first.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I wanted so badly to like this when I received it complimentary from Influenster and Shiseido. It does soak into your skin quickly although this leaves a bit of an oily/dewy feeling. My issues with this are mostly the ingredients and the smell. The concentrations of some of the active ingredients are higher than the fda recommends. This can cause hormone disruption and increased risk of skin irritation. For me, it caused a rash. Then there’s the smell. It smells so strongly of sunscreen that I ended up with a migraine. I don’t think I could honestly recommend this to anyone with sensitive skin or with a sensitivity to fragrance. I was disappointed.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I actually liked this product. It is gentle enough for my extremely sensitive skin. It feels nice and I did feel like it made my skin look better but I didn’t think it was a massive difference. It’s just really expensive… that’s really the downside. While I am enjoying it I don’t know if I’m enjoying it $90 much, you know?

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I had actually used this product before and had debated buying it for years. My issue is how expensive it is. It’s really so much for a small face cream. However, I will say that it’s extremely gentle and nourishing. I actually think it wasn’t thick enough for my particularly dry skin. Mostly I can’t justify the price for what it is. I’m willing to drop $$ for great skincare but this just doesn’t impress me as much as other things have. Is it a good product? Yes. Is it something I feel like I need to have after trying it? No.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: It feels nice on my skin and feels like it’s making it better as I sleep. My boyfriend likes to steal it all the time too,  but I don’t mind cause we can have perfect skin together!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: My skin has adjusted been dry but it has been SO dry lately.  I just moved to a much colder climate and I have been struggling to get moisture in my skin. Then this product entered my life and I’m in love. It’s great all over the body. It’s good on the face too. I love the packaging and feel so fancy using it.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_title: What I need in my life
reviews.review_text: This lip balm makes my lips feel so soft. The balm came in the mail right after my lips had erupted in cheapness. It felt so soothing on the sores and helped it get better quick. I have a feeling this is about to be a new purse staple of mine.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I like this product as a face wash and makeup remover. I haven’t used it near my eyes but it had been effective at removing lipstick stains and foundation,  etc. Its very gentle and does not aggravate my skin sry all. I’m excited to use this product more!

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love the packaging on this product which is normally not something to lead with but it’s just so fun. I like how it feels near my eyes. It does not sting or anything and makes my skin moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_title: Tone your face with just your fingers!
reviews.review_text: At first I thought this product was meant to soak into cotton pad or tissue and was a bit disappointed in the product. But then I realized it is better to just use your hands and I loved it. It’s easy. There’s no waste. It smells nice if you like watermelon. My skin feels tighter after, just as the product is advertised. I will definitely continue to use this product. I received this product for free from Influenster for testing purposes.

Unfortunately, I only received one mask,  so I only got to try it once and cannot speak to long term use benefits.

reviews.review_text: Solid glycolic acid toner, but too strong for my sensitive, rosacea prone face. However, I have noticed an improvement using it on the keratosis pilaris on my arms.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this serum. It’s moisturizing and I’ve used multiple bottles of this and the copper version. Not irritating and seems to improve my skin for a great price. Certainly worth picking up.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Great product. I’ve noticed a visible brightening effect while using this. While I don’t have acne it seems to also help a bit with my rosacea redness and does not irritate my skin. It can leave your skin a bit tacky but being that I use a moisturizer over top it has not been an issue for me.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Recieved sample of this and was so excited to try it as I’d heard great things. Within a minute of application my face was bright red and starting to itch. I had to wash it off my face immediately. two stars because I used the rest of the sample on my hands and forearms and they feel lovely and moisturized. Too bad Belif feels the need to add so many irritating scents to this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This is like a very scented version of a popular drugstore water cream. The texture is nice but it caused some minor irritation of my rosacea, likely due to the heavy scent.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is like a very scented version of a popular drugstore water cream. The texture is nice but it caused some minor irritation of my rosacea, likely due to the heavy scent.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I wanted so badly to love this because of how much I love La La Retro but Protini destroyed my skin. I have sensitive, rosacea prone skin and had to give up on this after 3 days. I have irritation breakouts all over my face. I’ll be using up the rest of my small pot as a hand cream.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I use this as part of my once daily double cleanse. First I massage this all over my face to break up makeup. I then massage my cleanser (DE Beste) on top, add water and work it all into a lather with my Foreo. My skin feels so clean and hydrated afterwards.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this. I don’t use it every night but when I do I use about a pump as the last step over my Lala Retro. It feels cooling an immediately hydrating and I wake up with plump, soft skin.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin but for some reason my nose is rife with sebaceous filaments and viable pores. I used to use traditional pore strips once or twice a month but was afraid I was damaging skin so I gave up on them. picked these up with low expectations because of the mixed reviews and wow! The first time I was only able to wear the strips for about 2 hours but the amount of gunk on the strip was amazing. My pores were much, much less visible and my skin was super soft. keeping an eye out for when they come back in stock!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: My entire routine is DE and I had high hopes for this as a makeup remover but it just couldn’t handle removing my minimal day to day makeup. I use SPF, concealer, eyebrow pencil , and mascara and it did a poor job of removing all of it. I ended up having to use Slaai to get what it missed. When I tried using it as a leave on it irritated my skin. I tried using it in the morning in place of my usual rinse with water and I didn’t notice a difference aside from adding an extra step. I just don’t see a place for this anywhere in my routine.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have super sensitive skin and this worked well for me with no irritation. It didn’t fully remove my my makeup, even with using a makeup remover first. Which doesn’t get me 5 stars. It’s a good cleanser but I wasn’t wowed.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve had my eye on this cleanser for over a year now and was super excited to get a trial size of it. Unfortunately my hopes were dashed. While the packaging is beautiful the cleanser itself was a disappointment. My dry skin felt like all of the moisture had been sucked out of it. The scent was much stronger than I expected and quite unpleasant, bordering on bitter. If it wasn’t so heavily fragranced I would consider saving it to try again in the summer months.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: My lips have been dry and cracking this winter and none of my usual balms or oils were working to soothe them. I had a little sample packet of this balm stashed away so I decided to give it a shot and wow, did it deliver. I immediately felt relief and within two applications I was placing an order for a full sized tube, by far the fastest I’ve ever purchased a product based on a sample. I’ve been applying 2-3 times a day for a few days an my lips are completely healed. It’s not sticky, the vanilla scent is delicious and the glossy appearance is a plus.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The end result of this cleanser was clean skin, not overly stripped but slightly irritated. The scent was over powering, and while I don’t mind fragrance in wash off products it detracted from the experience rather than enhancing it. The texture was creamy with a slight gritty feeling that irritated my sensitive skin. It was also extremely thick and difficult to spread without adding a ton of water which I did not enjoy.

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Feels so nice and refreshing!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: I love this product! It clears my pores and leaves my skin feeling clean! It’s so similar to Glam Glow but without the burn feeling. I love using this 2x a month to keep my face fresh.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This smells so amazing and leaves my lips feeling incredibly smooth and hydrated. Much needed in a chilly m, windy winter climate!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: So Hydrating, easy to blend into your skin, and feels so smoothing. I love how this helps my redness and dry spots reduce.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser removes make up pretty well, but it is drying. Fresh scent but would work better for oily skin

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: Completely healed the red dryness around my nose and mouth. I love how soothing and gentle this cream is. It melts into the skin and leaves it feeling hydrated and replenished

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Perfect for acne scaring and uneven texture!
reviews.review_text: I have somewhat sensitive skin, so I was hesitant to try Good Genes but after treading more about the product I decided to give it a go! I use it as a mask treatment 2-3x a week in the morning during my skincare routine and it helps my face look much more lively. I’ve also noticed a major improvement in my skins texture which makes me so happy! I did experience a minor break out when starting it, which I was warned may happen as a purging stage, but it cleared up within a week and my completion has been great since.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_title: Perfect for my dry sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: I can’t get enough of Luna! I apply this at night and let it settle in before using my moisturizer and it’s made a huge difference in the look and feel of my face. It’s so much more smooth, my pores look smaller and overall just more healthy looking. I’m so happy this was recommended to me and has made a permanent spot in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: With under eye products, I don’t usually see much of a difference, so I was sceptical about how this caffeine solition would work. I was pleasantly surprised when I noticed that my undereyes were beginning to look brighter after using it twice a day for about a week. After using for a month, my undereyes no longer look dark and tired, I’m so happy with the results!

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love how this has made my skin look and feel! Since incorporating it into my skincare routine I’ve noticed that my complexion is much brighter and more even. Since I have dry, somewhat sensitive skin, I decided to start out slow only using it a few times a week and slowly worked my way up. I didn’t experience any sensitivity or negative reactions. Not only is the product amazing, but I also really appreciate the packaging. The pump is so easy to use with a round cotton pad.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love how this has made my skin look and feel! Since incorporating it into my skincare routine I’ve noticed that my complexion is much brighter and more even. Since I have dry, somewhat sensitive skin, I decided to start out slow only using it a few times a week and slowly worked my way up. I didn’t experience any sensitivity or negative reactions. Not only is the product amazing, but I also really appreciate the packaging. The pump is so easy to use with a round cotton pad.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: Blown AWAY by this (and so were my blackheads)
reviews.review_text: I have been on the hunt for a product strong enough to effectively help with the removal of my black heads. Since I have dry, sensitive skin, I was admittedly a little bit scared to try this product but decided to grab the mini set of 5 to try out. After the first use my skin had immediately improved; I had fewer black heads, my whole face felt incredibly smooth, and to my surprise- the dry, flakey red patches around my nose we’re GONE! I was hoping it would help with flaking skin, but I really wasn’t expecting such miraculous results so quickly. Using the treatment every second day has given my skin an amazing healthy glow, it looks and feels so healthy and soft, and my stubborn blackheads are almost completely gone (thanks to the BHA!!) I’m so impressed with this, I will definitely be repurching to keep this apart of my regular skincare routine!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: There’s so much to be said for this cream, which really is very lightweight and milky once you touch it. It soaks right into the skin, giving it a very smooth surface. My dry skin drank it right up! That being said, this is more like a serum than a moisturizer? As others have said, it really works best when you have another moisturizer to apply on top, alone it is not nearly hydrating enough. Although it left the surface of my skin super smooth and supple, it also made my face feel tight and wanting more moisture, no matter how generous I was with application. Using this did clear up my dry patches very quickly, which shows me that it’s really working beneth the surface, but unfortunately my skin needs more moisture for the top base as well. My skin is dry/sensitive/acne prone, and I’m happy to say that using this cream didn’t cause any acne or blemishes. It has so many amazing properties, of your skin isn’t too dry, this may be the perfect moisturizer for you, otherwise it’s an excellent serum.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Adding Lippe to my skincare routine has made a huge improvement on my lips. I like to use it at the end of my skincare routine in the evening, and keep it in my bag for daily use. It leaves them feeling soft and hydrated without feeling waxy, and it smells very pleasant without being overpowering.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy using D-Bronzi to add a bit of colour into my face, especially on days where my skin looks more dull and tired. I always find it helps me to look more lively and bright while evening out my complexion. It’s the perfect no-makeup days product! I like to apply a small drop to B-Hydra, mix them together in my palm, and then rub the mixture into my skin. I top it off with Lala or Umbra and my face is left radiant, hydrated, and sun-kissed!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: My dry skin has been so much better since incorporating this serum into my skincare routine! It adds a boost of hydration that really helps keep my face supple. I notice that when I focus on keeping my skin hydrated, it looks less dull and my fine lines are also less noticeable. I use B-hydra as part of my morning routine, I like to use it before applying Lala or Umbra, and also find that D-Bronzi mixes very nicely with it.

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: My skin is typically very dry so I depend on great masks, serums, and moisturizers to keep it hydrated and moisturized. Using the Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping mask has been a delight since it feels so refreshing, and the results are long lasting. When  I apply the essance, the lightweight gel texture melts into my skin and feels very hydrating. The Water Cream is perfect to apply on top to lock in that hydration and to moisturize the skin. On me, the mask began to feel slightly cooling, and was very relaxing to fall asleep with on my face. I noticed that this mask doesn’t have fragrance or perfume listed I’m the ingredients which is great since added fragrance can be very irritating for my skin, I will note that it does have a strong rose scent due to the rose extracted ingredients. This formula didn’t bother my skin, I usually handle rose well, but others who have sensitive skin may want to take that into consideration. When I woke up the next morning my skin still felt moisturized and soft, and looked luminous and fresh! I also saw that redness around healing acne had subsided a noticeable amount, thanks to that super shot of hydration! Overall I have really enjoyed using this mask and look forward to more nights of rosey hydration. I received this complimentary of Influenster to test out.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is my go to cleanser! I really.enjoy this jelly like texture and the way it spreads over my skin, breaking up my sunscreen and removing impurities from throughout the day. My skin is always left feeling clean, but not stripped or dry.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_title: Pretty pink sheen of color, silky lips
reviews.review_text: I keep this lip treatment on hand to use throughout the day so that my lips stay smooth and moisturized. It keeps my lips feeling silky soft, and adds a really lovely sheen of color, I adore this pink shade!

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this oil for over a year now, and I still get excited when I reach for it! Using this facial oil always outcomes in smooth, supple, bouncy skin. It is great to use to massage the face, especially with a jade roller! I also really enjoy the dewy glow that I can acheive when I use this in my skincare routine!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is such a dreamy face cream! I love the lightweight texture and have been surprised at how moisturizing the formula is. It soaks into my skin locking in hydration and creating a smooth, bouncy complextion.The packing is ideal to keep the product sanitary and dispessses an ideal amount for application. The surface is also great for maxing DE smoothies, I like to pump out my moisturizer and then mix in my serum and oils before applying. It’s so quick and easy! Overall this is an amazing product that is great to splurge on if you can!

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I don’t usually write reviews but felt this particular product warranted an official endorsement. I’m 43 and have been using this for a month now. These past two weeks I have surprisingly received quite a few compliments on my skin. This is the only Vit-C I have ever used where I noticed a change in my skin: definitely brighter, smoother, plumper. I have some dark spots that look like they are ever so slightly starting to lighten, it’s very subtle, but I’m pleased. I really like the liquid formula - no stickiness at all. And I like the dispenser as well as it protects from light and air. It is pricey but I don’t mind paying for results. I just bought the Tatcha Vit-C mask and can’t wait to try it - I have high hopes!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: Wow, I am really surprised at how much I love this. It’s a fun science experience every time I wash my face and my skin is so soft afterwards. 3 stars because it’s far too expensive for what it is tho. The jar is gorgeous and the dispensing mechanism is genius, but even so I don’t think I can justify the price. There are dupes that will get you more bang for your buck.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love oil cleansers, but I do not love this. It’s a mediocre product especially for the price. I have to use more of this than other oil cleansers and it still doesn’t remove all my mascara. There are far better oil cleansers out there for much cheaper. I do love some Tatcha products, but this one is a hard pass.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I got a free sample of this and have only used twice but am impressed. Probably gonna purchase the full size. I love masks - the whole experience is fun, relaxing and feels more special than just the chore of washing my face. This one got my attention straight away: upon opening the little sample tube a blob just forcefully quirted out onto my marble countertop. I wiped it up immediately but it still managed to etch the surface. While I’m am not happy about the etching, it’s not in a noticeable place so I’m over it. After seeing how strong it was, I was a little scared (but also kinda excited) to put it on my face. It only tingled, no burning. Results were pretty instant - skin was super soft, bright and glowy. My goal is to get rid of some sun damage/dark spots and I think this might do the trick.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical, about this product and it’s claims but the reviews were undeniable - how could so many people be in love with a freakin lip balm. Whelp, now I know. This is not a basic lip balm - it truly is a mask, that stays on all night and works its magic. Magic is the best way to describe it - after one night, I woke up to smooth plump lips. I’m 43, so lip lines have been an issue, repeat, “have been“ as in past tense. I had dinner with friends that night and without any provocation, (we weren’t talking about skincare at all) one asked if I had gotten a littler filler in my lips. I was floored that she had noticed anything at all, told her it was all due to this mask. I’m convinced that I should now buy stock in it now. Anyway, did it again last night and husband commented this morning on my “younger-looking“ lips. This is Holy Grail for me and the ONLY thing I’ve ever put on my lips that has made an impact.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I have been so interested in this since it’s gotten such amazing press and reviews. Finally got a sample and used for a week. Sadly I saw nothing and felt nothing. Basically the same results as if I had used plain old tap water. Maybe this is for the best since it’s RIDICULOUSLY expensive. I don’t get the hype or the price.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I have been so interested in this since it’s gotten such amazing press and reviews. Finally got a sample and used for a week. Sadly I saw nothing and felt nothing. Basically the same results as if I had used plain old tap water. Maybe this is for the best since it’s RIDICULOUSLY expensive. I don’t get the hype or the price.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried this a few times now and have now concluded I don’t like it. It leaves my skin tacky and never dries down or feels smooth. I guess because it’s “moisturizing“. Personally, I like the way it smells (light and lemony), but I really prefer no fragrance for products that I apply to my skin. It causes pilling whenever I touch my face afterwards - like just rubbing my nose. It doesn’t dull the shine of my sunscreen either.  Glad it was only a sample.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_title: Not for me, but maybe for you
reviews.review_text: This was underwhelming for me and I won’t buy again. My skincare routine is pretty solid and I think my skin is probably at it’s peak, so not sure adding anything at this point is going to make a huge difference. But I still get excited about finding that one game-changing product though which is why I bought the mini version of this with the lapis oil.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This is a nice basic moisturizer. I have dry skin that can be on the sensitive side and use this in the daytime. Texture is lovely and sinks into skin well. It doesn’t blow my socks off or anything but I like and trust YTTP for their thoughtful, clean ingredients and philosophy on skincare. I haven’t noticed a huge difference when my skin gets irritated so I’ll probably go back to DE Protini for the skin firming. Maybe if I was higher on the sensitive spectrum, I might see more benefit from this.  Also I HATE jars! I actually transferred this to an empty DE airtight pump jar that I sanitized. So at least it’s protected from air, light, and bacteria from my fingers, as I finish it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: This is pure heaven. It’s a fluffy and thiiiiick cream that smells divine and soothes my dry/semi-sensitive skin. A little goes a looong way so while the jar seems small, trust me, it’s real value for money. I use as a sleeping mask and as a regular mask especially when I over do it on actives. I’ve been trying to use Retin-A and I’m sure I would have given up long ago if it weren’t for this mask.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was sooo ready to love this, but it was a bust. It never sunk into my skin and left an unpleasant weird film on top that most definitely did not look “dewy“. I guess it was too thick for me? I thought my desert-like dry skin would drink it up but nope.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I like this, especially the airtight pump jar. I’ll use until I find something better, but for now, it’s the one I keep coming back to. I’m going on faith that it’s firming my skin in the long run - but I honestly can’t tell.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Thought this would be great for my dry skin but it was surprisingly too heavy and too greasy. My skin couldn’t absorb it even in the tiniest amounts. I don’t think squalane agrees with my skin. Not a bad product, just not right for me.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_title: Perfect summer, daytime moisturizer for DRY skin
reviews.review_text: My skin is actually dry, but after all the serums I slather on my face, I don’t need a heavy moisturizer during the day, especially during summer, especially in Texas. I absolutely hate having a tacky, shiny, “dewy“ finish so I’ve been on the hunt for something light but powerful. I was immediately drawn to this for the main ingredients. However, I did read many reviews dissing it for the high amount of irritating essential oils for fragrance and lack of transdermal water loss ingredients. Here’s how I use this to get the most benefits and a smooth, soft, non-tacky finish: A pea sized amount of this product mixed with The Inkey List’s Polyglutamic Acid Hydrating Serum (which has dimethicone to prevent transdermal water loss). My skin is a dream and stays fresh and hydrated all day. I also don’t get dry flaky patches anymore like I used to, even when using heaving creams. Yes, it has a strong fragrance, but I find it delicious and beautiful and it has not bothered my skin at all. They should make a fragrance-free version though.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely cleanser, but was just a bit drying for my very dry skin. I gave to my husband who has oily skin and he looooves it!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely cleanser, but was just a bit drying for my very dry skin. I gave to my husband who has oily skin and he looooves it!

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Is this actually doing anything? I can’t tell. All I know is it leaves a sticky, tacky film.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I was intrigued by a balm cleanser with enzymes and had to try. So glad I did! It works well to remove sunscreen, makeup and even heavy mascara. It rinses completely clean and leaves my skin softer than my long time HG DHC oil cleanser. I don’t really notice the smell that everyone else is enjoying. I find it to be nearly undetectable - it’s very, very subtle, which I prefer. I have tried balm cleansers in the past but always went back to DHC. I’m officially a convert now.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Got sample and didn’t notice anything good or bad, but after a week I got a rather larger zit. I can count on one hand how many breakouts I’ve had in 5 years. That was the clincher and in the trash it went. I don’t understand the reviews on this.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I loved this serum. After using it for a few weeks I noticed a reduction in the line lines on my face and my skin was clearer. It made my skin feel moisturized as well. I love being able to feel good about my skin and I can after using this.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I love this daily peel! I have acne and this helped my face to clear up after a few days of using it. I have dry skin and this wasn’t harsh on my skin. I am so glad I tried this because it has made my skin clearer! I would highly recommend it to anyone that has acne and is looking for a product that will help to clear up your skin. The Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel is worth using!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! It has made my skin feel smooth and moisturized. My skin looks more even and I feel like I can be around people with no makeup on. This moisturizer works and I would highly recommend it to anyone that is looking for a moisturizer that helps to make your skin look great. I received a free sample complimentary from Skinfix but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

I received a free sample complimentary from Skinfix but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum because it helps my face to feel smooth and it helped my face to look better. I thought it made my skin feel moisturized. It really helped my skin to look better and my makeup went on smoother after using it. It is a great serum and I would highly recommend it to others.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I loved this product! After a few days of using it my skin has felt soft and more clear. My acne marks are a lighter and I am so happy with the results. My face feels moisturized after using this and I feel more confident in my skin! I received this product gifted by Sunday Riley but my opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer. It helped my skin to feel moisturized and soft. It felt nice on my skin and it absorbed well. I like how I noticed a difference after a few days of using it. I would highly recommend it to others that are looking for a good moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I liked this eye cream because it helped to get rid of my dark circles and fine lines under my eyes. I noticed a difference after two weeks of using the product. I thought my eyes looked moisturized as well. I’m so happy with the results! I would highly recommend it to others that are looking for a good eye cream.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_title: new mask to add to my routine
reviews.review_text: I already own a bunch of origins products so I was excited to try this mask. I just moved and my skins been freaking out a bit from all the work in the house and the change in environment so i knew I needed to try this right away. I could already tell a difference right after washing it off. My skin looked much better and felt super clean. The next morning my skin was looking even better than before. Also i have very sensitive skin and I didn’t break out so thats a bonus. I received this product free for testing purposes but all my opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: this is by far my favorite day cream ,ive ever used. its lightweight but still super moisturizing and great for under makeup. Also it is basically scent free which i love for anything on my face

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

reviews.review_text: This mask is my go to in any situation where my skin is irritated or just feeling kinda drab . I leave it on overnight and my skin is always left feeling refreshed and looking bright and plump . This is definitely one of my favorite masks !

reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is perfect for summer . It’s light and absorbs fast . Leaves me skin feeling soft and hydrated it also has a nice fresh scent to it that’s not chemically scented.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: While this serum is moisturizing and has nice packaging this serum did not work for me . The fragrance was a bit much for me to start with , then it left my skin itchy and irritated. After using it for 3 nights with no new products added to my routine but this serum I woke up with bumps and red patches .

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This makes the sunscreen step so much easier . I don’t have to wait till it sinks in since it’s clear . I can just glide it on rub in and I’m good to go . It does smell like sunscreen but the scent fades

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Mine was kinda separated and even after mixing was a bit oily . I tried on both my face and body and will just be using it on my body from now on . It’s too greasy for my face and the fragrance is too strong . I think as a body sunscreen it would do much better

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I was really excited to try this mask since fresh I’d a favorite brand of mine . I really like that the scent isn’t too overpowering and it sits so nicely on the skin I also enjoy there is more than one way to use it . It’s been super hydrating and I’m really loving adding it to my routine!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Perfect base for makeup , it smells heavenly not too much fragrance though . Goes on super easily and leaves a great base to add your foundation on next . I also feel like it keeps my foundation on longer .

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: With any retinol I won’t see any results this soon but so far I haven’t experienced any irritation. I’ve been using it every two days so I can adjust my skin to it just in case . I’m not a big fan of the fragrance scent that’s perfume like in it but it’s not a deal breaker. It did leave my skin feeling really soft and plump in the mornings .

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Omg this scent is so delicious, perfect for summer too . It’s fresh and yummy and they make some of the best lip balms I’ve ever tried I’ve been keeping this one in my bag since I use it so much lately , this was gifted by fresh

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for my review. All opinions are my own based on my experience with the product. I have very dry sensitive skin, and most acids tend to irritate my skin and damage my barrier (especially glycolic and lactic acids). This doesn’t and because of that it’s a major win in my book. As with all acids, results are difficult to be seen short term. My skin feels smoother and my pores look a bit smaller (their size ofc doesn’t change but they’re probably just unclogged) but that’s about it. I’m very excited that I’m able to use a product like this without fearing that I’m angering my skin barrier and I’m also very excited to see the progress of my skin. They do suggest using it as a mask if you have sensitive skin. I didn’t do that but I do recommend it if you have very sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Lovely serum! Goes on the skin beautifully and it sinks in quickly. Very hydrating which is exactly what I was expecting from it. reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: What a treat of a product. The rose line from Fresh has always been one of my favorites, and this moisturizer is a great addition to it. Very soothing and hydrating, applies beautifully on the skin and I easily see all skin types enjoying it (morning and night).  I have dry skin, and I can see myself using it throughout the year. Beware of the fragrance though. If you’re avoiding fragrance in skincare or you simply don’t enjoy it, this is not for you. If you enjoy the scent of Bulgarian roses on the other hand, this is the product for you.

reviews.review_text: I adore Sunday Riley products. This eye cream is amazing, very hydrating, gentle and feels great. My eye wrinkles are fading. My under eye area looks smooth and healthy. I recommend it, it works great.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed with Dermalogica products. This cleanser does an amazing job for my skin. I massage it on my dry face and eye area to melt away dirt and makeup form my skin. It also removes waterproof makeup easily. Complimentary from Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed with Dermalogica products. This cleanser does an amazing job for my skin. I massage it on my dry face and eye area to melt away dirt and makeup form my skin. It also removes waterproof makeup easily. Complimentary from Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This has become my favorite overnight mask. The results are wonderful. This calms my redness and uneven skin tone. The vitamin C brightens the skin while making it looks smooth. I recommend Fresh overnight mask because it works great.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I love these acne dots. Extremely easy to use and effective. If the zit is formed, this dot has the best result. Leaving the skin sooth and clear looking. And the redness is not that bad. Complimentary from Peace out skincare.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: The packaging is classy and the container feel luxurious. The cream is wonderful. My skin doesn’t look dull anymore. I apply it daily on my face and neck. It’s giving me great moisture and I absolutely recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: Great product that works like magic. It has softened the look of fine lines and wrinkles, while leaving a smooth t texture. My skin looks firm and rejuvenated. After using this, I don’t have a tired look anymore.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: This is two power serums in one product that works like magic. I use it daily on my face and neck area. It has visibly minimized pores and reduced wrinkles. This serum works great my skin type, to smooth and hydrate it.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: If you are looking for an eye cream with fast results, this is the one. It has reduced my under eye dark circles in only ten days. It has energized my eye area while making it smooth and firm. Complimentary from Algenist.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I’ve used the Glow Recipe watermelon line for sometime, and happy to add this toner to my collection. It hydrates my skin and pores look tight. I gently pat into my skin and follow with my moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I’ve used the Glow Recipe watermelon line for sometime, and happy to add this toner to my collection. It hydrates my skin and pores look tight. I gently pat into my skin and follow with my moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: If you are looking for a serum to give you a visible glow, and reduce wrinkles, this one is for you. I apply it daily, morning and night, and I love how smooth and glowing my skin is. I recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Dermalogica had great products. This one has smoothen and brighten my skin. It has even my skin tone, and it safe to use daily. It’s vegan, cruelty free, silicone free. The packaging is nice and sustainable. Complimentary from Dermalogica

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Dermalogica had great products. This one has smoothen and brighten my skin. It has even my skin tone, and it safe to use daily. It’s vegan, cruelty free, silicone free. The packaging is nice and sustainable. Complimentary from Dermalogica

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: This is an awesome gel moisturizer. It’s fragrance free, and has a long lasting hydration. I use it in the morning and at night. It has reduced shine and balanced oil on my face. My skin looks much healthier. Complimentary from Farmacy Beauty.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Really really really loved this product! Very lightweight and applies so nicely! I love how it is a gel to water texture so you don’t feel like you’re rubbing the delicate skin around your eyes while applying! This is very hydrating, I normally get dry under and above my eye but this really get my eyes bright and moisturized!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This was kindly gifted to me by Skinfix but  is one of my new holy grail winter moisturizers! It’s so thick and velvety but feels so light and airy on the skin! It really locks in the moisture keeping my skin so hydrated for these dry winter months!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This was kindly gifted to me by Skinfix but  is one of my new holy grail winter moisturizers! It’s so thick and velvety but feels so light and airy on the skin! It really locks in the moisture keeping my skin so hydrated for these dry winter months!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from the brand and have been using it consistently every night in place of an eye cream. I really love the texture, very smooth and creamy! I didn’t notice much in the brightening aspect, but for someone who normally has drier undereyes this is great for staying hydrated! I have seen some changes for my fine lines, but I haven’t been using it long enough to have it be very noticeable.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Fresh beauty* this is a beautiful rich cream that doesn’t feel too heavy on the skin but really locks in moisture! The only bad thing I have to say about this is how strong the fragrance is, it does fade after putting on but quite strong at first. If that fragrance does not bother you than this is a great option!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I reallllly love this eye cream! It has a pretty strong percentage of retinol so this would be great for those who have already built up their retinol tolerance. I haven’t been using long enough to have noticeable results, but I do think this is a great option. Very thick consistency as well as not too drying. The applicator is very easy to use and great for keeping the product sanitary since you are not dipping your finger into a pot.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This has quickly become one of my new favorite moisturizers! It leaves the skin so dewy and plump creating the perfect base for makeup! I love that it hydrates but doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy - I also live in an area with extreme winters and need an intense moisturizer and this does the trick!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This has quickly become one of my new favorite moisturizers! It leaves the skin so dewy and plump creating the perfect base for makeup! I love that it hydrates but doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy - I also live in an area with extreme winters and need an intense moisturizer and this does the trick!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love love love this makeup primer! It is the perfect makeup base while still being skincare! This doubles as a moisturizer and a primer and is perfect if you have dry skin or just if you need a little extra hydration! New holy grail!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I am a fan of belif products and really enjoyed how hydrating this eye cream is. Perfect for dry Colorado winters! The texture is super luxe but absorbs very quickly. I’ve noticed my concealer applies VERY smoothly following this eye cream and have even noticed a slight reduction in crepiness. I am still looking for that HG anti aging eye cream for dark circles and fine lines, which this doesn’t address, but I do feel like it is a nice addition to my daily regimen.*I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I recently received the SHISEIDO Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream complimentary via Influenster and have been pleasantly surprised! I’m 40 and live in a dry climate so hydration is key. This eye cream is very rich and hydrating but does not run or irritate my eyes. It’s very glossy upon application (reminiscent of a balm) and creates an occlusive barrier while brightening the eye area. I like this both at night because it doesn’t budge and I know it will keep my eye area hydrated, but I also really like how it wears under luminous finish makeup. This is not for skin that is not dry or dehydrated and sadly it does contain parabens which I am just not a fan of. I’m actually quite surprised to find that Shiseido still formulates with paragon sand am curious if this only applies to their U.S. formulations? While I was quick to dismiss this because of that I do find myself reaching for this product lately and would definitely recommend it for dryer folks like myself!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: What did you think of the texture? The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly w/o any greasy, tacky residue. The smell is incredible, like a juicy watermelon Jolly Rancher! Although I haven’t been able to put it to a marathon makeup day it does apply well and allows for a flawless makeup application. Leaves my skin looking plump, and dewy without unwanted sparkle. I like to use as a primer under foundation and then tap over foundation at high points. This product works really well for my mature (41 years), dry/dehydrated skin. *Gifted by Glow Recipe.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Received Complimentary from Sunday Riley but have purchased multiple times in the past. Good Genes is lightweight, easily absorbed, and leaves my skin looking noticeably smoother and brighter within the first weeks use when used consistently. Pores and sebaceous filaments are less visible plus makeup application is also flawless when using this! It’s one of the rare active, exfoliating serums that I can use without my skin becoming sanitized or damaging my barrier. You also don’t need a lot nor do you need to use it daily for results, so while pricey it does last for a long time!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: My skin = dehydrated, maturing, reactive, prone to redness (plus I live in a dry, arid climate). I just started using the new Avocado Ceramide Redness Relief Serum from Glow Recipe and WOW! This is an instant HOLY GRAIL product for me!! It has a milky serum consistency with a slight amount of slip that absorbs into the skin beautifully without the least bit of tackiness. Slight cucumber aroma that dissipates quickly. This is the first “hydrating” serum I’ve tried that leaves my skin feeling plump and nourished while also addressing redness and soothing that lingering feeling of irritation. My skin looks incredibly healthy after just a few days use and youthful but also feels comfortable for the first time in ages. It also plays well with my other skincare products and layers beautifully with makeup. My favorite ceramide product I’ve tried thus far (and I’ve tried MANY) and now a staple in my routine!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I have wanted to try the Skinfix Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream for SO LONG and it’s everything I expected it to be! It truly is deeply hydrated and is an excellent night cream for dry dehydrated, aging skin types like myself. If you’re a fan of the DE Protini but felt like you needed a touch more hydration, you’re going to love this cream! The addition of peptides and lipids have done wonders for my skin condition. My often compromised barrier is in better condition than it has been in years, and my skin looks noticeably smoother and youthful, and that glow!!! Would not be recommended for oily/problematic skin but can’t recommend enough for all others.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I have wanted to try the Skinfix Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream for SO LONG and it’s everything I expected it to be! It truly is deeply hydrated and is an excellent night cream for dry dehydrated, aging skin types like myself. If you’re a fan of the DE Protini but felt like you needed a touch more hydration, you’re going to love this cream! The addition of peptides and lipids have done wonders for my skin condition. My often compromised barrier is in better condition than it has been in years, and my skin looks noticeably smoother and youthful, and that glow!!! Would not be recommended for oily/problematic skin but can’t recommend enough for all others.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Having heard such great feedback about Summer Fridays and their Jet Lag Mask I was thrilled at the opportunity to try it out. I’m 42 with dehydrated skin, texture, and live in an arid climate. This mask works great as moisturizer or mask when my skin needs a boost of hydration and leaves my skin feeling nourished while looking plump and refreshed. Also great to revive skin post-travel!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Having heard such great feedback about Summer Fridays and their Jet Lag Mask I was thrilled at the opportunity to try it out. I’m 42 with dehydrated skin, texture, and live in an arid climate. This mask works great as moisturizer or mask when my skin needs a boost of hydration and leaves my skin feeling nourished while looking plump and refreshed. Also great to revive skin post-travel!!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve always been a HUGE Sunday Riley fan so I was thrilled to try this and it does not disappoint! The creamy serum texture is really lovely. It absorbs quickly while leaving my underlies well hydrated. The packaging is absolute perfection and the product does feeling soothing/cooling upon application. I can be sensitive to rented products not to mention having sensitive eyes and this has caused no problems while leaving my eyes looking bright, well-rested and reducing my crow’s feet.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Fresh products are always such a luxe, sensorial experience and this one Is no exception! It has a rich texture but isn’t overly heavy at all. More of a creamy gel consistency that sinks in to the skin beautifully. So far it works well to calm redness and discomfort from the dry, winter air. When I wake up my skin is more even toned, plump, and hydrated. It does have a light scent but it does dissipate quickly. I love that this mask absorbs easily into the skin and doesn’t leave any tackiness which leaves my face sticking to the pillow when I sleep. And the packaging is oh so luxurious!! Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Fresh gifted me their Sugar Lip Balm in Rose and the formula is stunning! I love the texture and how it makes my lips feel hydrated but not sticky. I have chronically dry lips and this helps them feel  comfortable and adds the perfect hint of color. The only downside is that I’m not a huge fan of the scent/flavor but I do like it otherwise as a good daily lip balm.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: WOW! I have been using the new Tea Elixir Serum froM Fresh for a few weeks now and I’m obsessed! The combination of ingredients is stelar for my maturing, dehydrated skin. It’s such a lovely, lightweight formula tat works both AM & PM, and plays well with other products and makeup. My skin is glowing and the texture appearance has been dramatically improved already.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: You know that saying, “you get what you pay for“? Well that definitely applies to this product. It comes with a hefty price tag but woah mama is it good! After using it for a week and I can already feel my face getting brighter. I went to the beach a lot this summer and I felt like my skin was getting a little dull. This has helped brighten up my complexion. It’s moisturizing without being heavy or leaving my skin feeling oily. I am pasryicioating in a contest and so asked for a free sample of the moisturizer at a sephora store. That being said, I feel like I could choose a moisturizer that is at a better price point and get similar results. Don’t think I’ll be buying the full size.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I was initially turned off by the scent of the toner (spoiler alert- it smells like roses) but after a couple of uses, I quite like the scent! It’s a thicker consistency then the toners I’ve used in the past. It is like a gel type consistency. I put some on a cotton square and wipe my face after using my regular face wash / exfoliator. It’s pretty surprising how good this toner works. Even after scrubbing, this toner manages to clean my face. It’s not harsh or drying, and it leaves my face feeling hydrated, smooth, and clean! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I am totally loving this product! I am always going between gel vs cream moisturizers and I find that this moisturizer is a happy medium. It feels like both a gel (lightweight and moisture filled) and a cream (hydrating and rich). You don’t need a lot, because a little goes a long way with this product. I apply this after using the toner from this same line. My skin has gone through a lot, what with hormones and summer (beach all day every day!) and I definitely feel like this moisturizer has gone above and beyond to soothe my skin and replenish all those necessary ingredients for healthy and glowing skin! I’m very happy with the outcome so far. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Goop and I’m so glad I did (it comes with a hefty price tag). I tried it tonight for the first time as part of my bedtime routine. I used my regular cleanser from Ole Henriksen (wonderfeel). I normally use an exfoliator  throughout the week as well but skipped that tonight since I would already be using the goop exfoliator. I scooped about a quarter sized amount of product and applied to my face in circular motions. I tried to not use too much since it’s a relatively small container for $125. I left it on for 3 minutes and then rinsed off with warm water. I patted my face dry with a towel and applied my nighttime moisturizer and eye cream as I normally would. While applying the mask, I could feel the tiny beads exfoliating my face as I scrubbed in circular motions. Not a lot of pressure is necessary as it can feel a bit rough on the skin. I felt a small tingly sensation on my face as I let the mask sit. I noticed some redness on my cheeks and nose. This area remained rosy for about 15 minutes after removing the mask. I also still felt a bit of a tingle on parts of my face after having the mask removed (nothing painful or uncomfortable). Although I’ve only used it once so far, I did notice that my skin felt smoother and tighter. I didn’t notice any flakey or dull skin. The product suggests using 2-3 times a week so I’m confident that after some regular use, I’ll be able to see more noticeable results. The product does not have a strong smell and is a nice consistency and texture, making it easy to apply. While I’m happy to be able to use this product until it runs out, I will most likely not purchase a replacement. My reason being that it’s not a lot of product for $125. I know that I will get better results in one sitting for around that price if I went to a salon instead.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: The Capture Totale Eye Serum from Dior has a very light consistency that absorbs quickly into the skin. I usually wake up with puffy eyes in the morning or with dark circles depending on how much sleep I got. I like to use this serum in the morning before applying a tinted moisturizer and heading off to work. I like that this serum has a metal applicator to apply the serum to the skin under the eye. This is a nice feature that I think helps in the de-puffing process. I also appreciate the steps in how to depuff, smooth, lift, and sculpt as oftentimes I don’t get the max benefits from a product from not knowing the best ways to apply. I haven’t had a chance to use the serum long enough to notice long term benefits however I have noticed my eyes are not as puffy after using. Dark under eye circles still linger however I’m hoping that with time, I’ll also notice results! There is a scent to this serum that is on the stronger side at first but I think it fades pretty quickly and it doesn’t bother me, especially considering the moisturizer I apply afterwards. I’m curious to see if pairing this serum with the eye cream from the same line would help speed up the process and make the results long lasting. I would definitely use this again simply from the depuffing I’ve already noticed and the expectation that it will deliver on the other things as well!

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This repair cream is a fragrance free thick formulation. It’s on the heavier side for me which I’m not a huge fan of. When applying, it makes my face feel sticky. As it’s an overnight mask, my hair ends up sticking to my face which can be annoying. Another downside for me is the applicator that is included. It’s so tiny, I’m not sure why it’s included as it’s hard to use. These things aside, the cream works. I am 2 months postpartum and the hormones have been all over the place. I’ve recently had some breakouts that left redness along my jaw line. I used this product every night for a week to see what kind of results I would have. By night 3, there was no redness and you could not tell that I had a breakout. I’m pretty amazed by the quick results since I feel like most products I’ve used take a little longer to get noticeable results. I probably will not continue using on a nightly basis (more likely 2-3 times a week). However, I see a huge benefit in including this cream in my skincare routine. I’m excited to see long term results.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This repair cream is a fragrance free thick formulation. It’s on the heavier side for me which I’m not a huge fan of. When applying, it makes my face feel sticky.
