reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: My rating is based on the 3 claims: dryness, dark circles, puffiness. While I’ve only used this eye cream for just over 2 weeks, I have noticed some positives. Mainly in the areas of hydration to combat dryness from chilling weather and reducing puffiness. I apply the cream in the morning and it does visibly brighten the area making me look more awake and ready for the day. I use the original formula! The skin feels very smooth and supple and doesn’t have that puffy morning eye look. In the two weeks, I have not noticed any visible reduction to dark circles. I’m a first time mom of a newborn so sleep is only when I can sneak it in right now. I honestly don’t know if there’s a cream in the world that can help my dark circles in the current state they’re in. Perhaps when baby and I start getting better sleep at night, the combination of sleep and eye cream will be able to kick the dark circles to the curb. All in all, I’m pleased with the 2 of the 3 benefits of the eye cream.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is a lightweight gel consistency moisturizer for dry and dull skin. It has a very faint fragrance. I am in New England in the middle of the winter season so my skin is pretty dry. This gel cream provides temporary hydration to relieve some of the dryness from the cold and harsh winds. For my skin, it does not provide lasting hydration and I have to opt for a more thicker cream or balm type moisturizer in order to lock in the moisture for all day hydration.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I have both this and the aqua bomb. After using both, I’ve come to realize that the moisturizing bomb is ideal for right now - New England winter season- and the aqua bomb for warmer temperatures. Unlike the aqua bomb, this moisturizing bomb left me feeling hydrated all day despite cold temperatures and harsh winds! It has been helping to relieve the flakiness the happens as a result from my dry winter skin. Unlike some of my other heavier creams, this one feels a little more lightweight and non greasy. It also has a very faint scent.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this product! I think it’s a good hydrating moisturizer but then there are so many others out there and I personally have some that I love. I was hoping that what would make this stand out was it’s claim to blur pores. I have large pores near my nose and cheek area and am looking for a product that can help minimize them. This skin cream did not do the trick. It did leave my skin feeling hydrated and it’s lightweight and non greasy. I liked the fragrance and the ingredients ! Would I purchase once my sample is done, probably not.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love the benefits of this cream - moisturizing, lightweight, makes my skin feel refreshed and smooth..BUT the smell! It smells like sour milk or something is off. I saw a few people mentioned the new bottle didn’t have a smell so I don’t know if I got a bad batch? I can’t stand using it because it smells so bad.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: I dont know how its possible to not love this
reviews.review_text: BEST THING EVER! Any other cleanser I’ve ever tried, Ive had to wash my face 3 times and STILL use makeup remover or remover wipes afterwards! This takes it all off w/o drying your skin or irritating it or making it oily. I received a sample for my bday from Sephora a few months ago, still have a ton left and am so stoked to find out you can even buy it for under $50! I’m hooked for life!! LOVE!!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Moisturizing & not too heavy. I have been getting oddly enough, random break outs, as I have been getting older but never had problems when I was younger!  I can say this did not make it worse. I really like this moisturizer & a little goes a long way. I got this as my bday gift last year & didn’t use it right away but I still have some left which is great (altho I do switch between it & another moisturizer from time to time) but Id be weary of purchasing the full size as many reviews say its pricey for how much you end up getting - and Ive actually heard the same thing about many other DE products. But if you can afford it, I would recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Im a huge fan of The Ordinary!! Im obsessed with their 2% retinoid emulsion  serum and this was no different. A few drops works for your entire face and personally, I can feel the different. I use it before anything else on my face, then add the aforementioned serum & a moisturizer to lock it all in place & I feel like my most wrinkled areas, esp. between my eye brows, do look healthier, smoother & all around plumped a bit. And really, you absolutely CANNOT beat The Ordinary’s prices for their high quality products!

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: Most cream moisturizers make me break out. This does not & I’ve been using it daily for a few months now! The formula is light & not greasy. I use it on my face & neck. And a little goes a long way! For a low price & a product that works (at least on my skin - which is more dry than oily but I tend to break out on my chin for some reason) & will last bc a little goes a long way - its the perfect moisturizer!! Love!

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: This is the most potent retinol I’ve ever tried (I switch off days with The Ordinary Granactive Retinoid 2%) and no signs of irritation, no breakouts - nothing. Ive only been using it a couple weeks so I can’t say about longer term effects but my fine lines & wrinkles are definitely not worse, maybe even a little less noticeable! So, so far so good. High price point is the only drawback but if you dont have sensitive skin I’d recommend it. Unlike some DE products it seems like it should last a decent amount of time too!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I used to use the DE Cleanser but I got a sample of this once and had to purchase the full sized! I just love it!! It actually even removes (most) of the magnetic eyeliner that I use for my lashes! It leaves your skin feeling fresh, clean & even moisturized but not so much so that you break out (depending on skin type maybe?) Plus you can’t beat the natural ingredients!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I used to use the DE Cleanser but I got a sample of this once and had to purchase the full sized! I just love it!! It actually even removes (most) of the magnetic eyeliner that I use for my lashes! It leaves your skin feeling fresh, clean & even moisturized but not so much so that you break out (depending on skin type maybe?) Plus you can’t beat the natural ingredients!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Can double as a lip mask or even a gloss!
reviews.review_text: I really like this stuff! I don’t necessarily always wear it when I’m sleeping either! If my lips are feeling dry, it can double as just a healing lip gloss! Seriously, just use a light layer. It definitely hydrates & keeps my lips soft, even though I wear A LOT of Matte lippies!

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: I love this stuff! Really Works!
reviews.review_text: I love this! I keep it in my Cooluli Beauty fridge & I love the cooling feeling of the product & applicator under my eyes. I’ve noticed a difference in the dark circles under my eyes & when kept cool it also makes your eyes less puffy! Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This has been my go-to face cream for 2 years straight. I have tried switching out of it (just to be adventurous) but nothing beats it! I love that it moisturizes my face + doesn’t leave it feeling sticky + it’s a clean product + environmentally friendly + low fragrance. Really can’t get better than that (unless somehow they figure out how to add SPF to this??)

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This has been my go-to face cream for 2 years straight. I have tried switching out of it (just to be adventurous) but nothing beats it! I love that it moisturizes my face + doesn’t leave it feeling sticky + it’s a clean product + environmentally friendly + low fragrance. Really can’t get better than that (unless somehow they figure out how to add SPF to this??)

reviews.product_name: Mini Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Weird consistency (literally like milk). Leaves my face feeling sticky

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: Goes on beautifully - mostly watery with a touch of oil. Heavily perfumed. Dries sticky

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: Goes on beautifully - mostly watery with a touch of oil. Heavily perfumed. Dries sticky

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Solid product. Good moisturizer, no scent, goes on well, doesn’t feel too heavy after… just a solid no-nonsense face cream. However, for a “whipped” moisturizer, it’s actually quite dense. So if you have pores that clog easily, I wouldn’t recommend.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: It’s a good solid eye cream. Does what it says - visibly firms and instantly smooths eye wrinkles at the first application. It’s also nice that there’s no scent. It is a bit on the pricy side - I feel like similar products are priced a bit lower.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: A little goes a long way
reviews.review_text: Have been using a sample size of this (3ml, 0.1 oz) so 1/5th of the size of this product and it has lasted me 6 months (and there’s still a little bit left! So a little definitely goes a long way and feels great when I put it in but I’m not quite sure if it’s doing anything and it’s quite pricy…

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: All around good product - does a lot of things well but no singular thing great. It’s a good moisturizer and a good enough primer. I have experienced better products in both categories elsewhere. Don’t think the vitamin E does much for me personally

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: Works up to a point - definitely noticed a difference in dark spots on my face (they’re slightly lighter) but some super dark spots (like under my eyes) are still just dark. This is a gentle enough vitamin c serum that I don’t breakout or anything when it’s on my face. Smells like oranges (up to a point)

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! It feels so luxurious and smells so good!! I did notice that it does seem to sit on top of my face (in the AM when I wash my face, can feel myself washing it off) so hoping that some of the goodness got absorbed and some of it stayed as a protective layer over my skin throughout the night.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: The product was Dr. Dennis Gross, Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel. It was so easy to use because it was only 2 steps! I noticed right away that the pores on my nose looked smaller and even some of the lines on my face were less noticeable. I can’t imagine how my skin on my face would look after using this for a prolonged period of time!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I really didn’t expect this to work anywhere near as well as it did. It was so easy to apply this serum which I did every night. The next day my face felt smooth, refreshed, and my skin looked healthy. After a week I can definitely tell that my pores are smaller especially around my nose!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a free sample. I really enjoyed using bareminerals Skinlongevity long life herb serum. My skin just ate it up and it absorbed so well. There was no greasy feel afterwards which I experience from a lot of serums after using. My skin looked glowy, hydrated, and moisturized. The scent was very suttle and fresh. I really liked it. I like this “clean“ serum!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer definitely gives my skin a radiant glow. After applying in the morning (a little goes a long way) I usually don’t put on any face makeup. My skin looks great, firm and glowing. It doesn’t make my skin oily even over time and never feels heavy (although it still does a great job at moisturizing). The only reason I took one star off is because I really don’t notice a difference in fine lines. As I continue to use it I hope that will improve. Overall, it’s a win.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer definitely gives my skin a radiant glow. After applying in the morning (a little goes a long way) I usually don’t put on any face makeup. My skin looks great, firm and glowing. It doesn’t make my skin oily even over time and never feels heavy (although it still does a great job at moisturizing). The only reason I took one star off is because I really don’t notice a difference in fine lines. As I continue to use it I hope that will improve. Overall, it’s a win.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Wow is the first word that comes to mind. The quality of the ingredients is evident in my skin. I loved using this as my daytime moisturizer. I have a lot of pores around my nose and this did a great job of minimizing the look of them. It wasn’t greasy and kept my skin soft and hydrated day after day. It’s lightweight and not thick enough for me to use as my nighttime moisturizer. However, this has become my new favorite daytime one

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is the only eye cream that I can say I have ever seen any results with. My dark circles have lightened up and my under eye looks moisturized and smooth. It has no fragrance and doesn’t irritate. It really is an incredible eye cream. Not too thick abs absorbs really well too.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This little product packs a big punch. I love trying eye serums and although this one is pricey it definitely makes a difference. I have darkish circles under my eyes and in almost two weeks they look so much lighter. I love the whole application process and it’s super relaxing to apply and rub in with the applicator. My under eye area is moisturized because of this serum and that feeling lasts all day long. However, it still absorbs really well and does not look greasy. I also notice that the little lines by my eyes are less noticeable. I look forward to using this even longer and seeing even more incredible results.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have read a lot of great reviews on this toner. I’m so excited to try this out. The packaging is pretty cute and good size for me. I usually use as a toner, it gives my skin a soft and hydrated feel. This toner is perfect for the summer, Not sticky or oily! I love this product and would absolutely recommend for dry skin. I received this product as a free sample.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I see all the great reviews on this product. It just doesn’t work for my skin. I don’t see any difference in the morning and the texture is not good enough for this hype. I wouldn’t recommend this for sure to my friends.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I see all the great reviews on this product. It just doesn’t work for my skin. I don’t see any difference in the morning and the texture is not good enough for this hype. I wouldn’t recommend this for sure to my friends.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Leaves my skin feeling smooth, easy to apply and you just need a small amount! It’s really gentle and doesn’t leave any stickiness which i love. The packaging is cute blue plastic and it will be for traveling. You might like this packaging but the design is a little different. The cream comes out from a small hole when push it down. But you can still remove the the top and finish the cream. I received this cream as a free sample.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Leaves my skin feeling smooth, easy to apply and you just need a small amount! It’s really gentle and doesn’t leave any stickiness which i love. But you can still remove the the top and finish the cream. I received this cream as a free sample.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Goop gifted me. It’s really gentle and doesn’t make me break out. My skin looks brighter and softer. I was quite impressed. You definitely will see the difference for sure. It has a whipped texture and subtle earthy scent.  It works well but I only gave 4 stars because it’s too pricey. It probably wouldn’t last long if you use 2 times a week. It’s beautiful product itself tho.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Goop gifted me. It’s really gentle and doesn’t make me break out. My skin looks brighter and softer. I was quite impressed. You definitely will see the difference for sure. It has a whipped texture and subtle earthy scent.  It works well but I only gave 4 stars because it’s too pricey. It probably wouldn’t last long if you use 2 times a week. It’s beautiful product itself tho.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Glow Recipe. I can’t rave enough about this moisturizer. This is my favorite product from Glow Recipe. I am really enjoying it so far, although it was a little sticky at first, it dries pretty quickly and smells so nice. If you have normal to oily skin right now this is perfect for you. The packaging is beautiful and good quality.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Glow Recipe. The packaging is super cute and there is a pump that allows the serum to come out easily. It is perfect for those no makeup days to achieve that gorgeous glow, also can wear under foundation or tap on the high points of your cheeks to achieve that glow. It’s a very thin formula and it doesn’t feel like you add another layer of skincare to your face. I’m enjoying it so far!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Glowrecipe. It absorbs quickly without leaving behind any tell-tale residue and works beautifully on all skin types. As you can see, the bottle is so cute! It has a great texture and amazing fragrance. It just smells so good and it really gives your skin glow.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this eye cream It is lightweight, absorbs right into my skin and didn’t break out my skin. I love all their plastic bottle, easy to grab and good for traveling.  I don’t notice a big difference but my goal is to moisturize now to prevent wrinkles in the future.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I always do a double cleansing unless i wear only sunscreen or something light. This oil cleanser is the perfect formula for double cleansing, it gently dissolves your makeup without leaving behind a greasy film. Complimentary from Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I always do a double cleansing unless i wear only sunscreen or something light. This oil cleanser is the perfect formula for double cleansing, it gently dissolves your makeup without leaving behind a greasy film. Complimentary from Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So moisturizing without be greasy! Nice scent that isn’t too overwhelming. I’m always nervous to try new moisturizers but this one was great. It absorbs well, but leaves a soft dewy finish and plumped, very hydrated skin.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So moisturizing without be greasy! Nice scent that isn’t too overwhelming. I’m always nervous to try new moisturizers but this one was great. It absorbs well, but leaves a soft dewy finish and plumped, very hydrated skin.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I’m absolutely in love with this gentle exfoliator. This is similar to most other powder exfoliants, it’s gentle, non-stripping and very effective for my sensitive, combination skin without drying or leaving a feeling of tightness.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I’m absolutely in love with this gentle exfoliator. This is similar to most other powder exfoliants, it’s gentle, non-stripping and very effective for my sensitive, combination skin without drying or leaving a feeling of tightness.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: It’s not the most expensive mask on the market, but it’s not the cheapest, BUT it’s so worth the money! It is so hydrating and replenishing and left me with such healthy looking skin. It didn’t cause me any irritation. While this is recommended as a mask, I use it most often as a moisturizer especially overnight.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Not too heavy to wear under makeup. Just the right amount of moisture! The jar is the perfect size and the packaging is beautiful.This moisturizer keeps my face so smooth and gives me the perfect glow but the fragrance is not my favorite.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: This serum feels great on my combination skin.Absorbed into the skin quickly, non greasy application and makup sat on top of nicely. It left my skin soft and was nice to apply. You can definitely tell the quality!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: At first glance, the bottle looks high quality. The application is easy. The serum can be easily and hygienically removed with the pipette. It is so productive that two to three drops are sufficient and absorbs quickly. I use the serum after cleansing my facial skin and before applying a skin care cream. The skin is intensively moisturized by the serum, so that dryness lines disappear! It only takes a small amount and it blended in so smoothly.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Algenist. I wake up with my skin very hydrated and not dried. Very easy to spread all over my face and it leaves my skin very moisturized. I also use this as a primer before my foundation and the rest of my daily routine. It soothes skins and helps reduce breakouts.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: Love the application and consistency. Ease to maneuver under the eye. Doesn’t break me out or burn. But I’m unsure of how I feel about this eye balm? I don’t feel like it super hydrating and lasts as long as it says. I haven’t noticed any difference of any kind around my eyes. Only time will tell I guess.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Sunday Riley. This has become my new go-to exfoliant. Now that I am in my 40s with drier skin, I don’t need the exfoliant every day. I use it at night, a few times per week. This makes my skin so, soft so smooth and it makes my makeup look flawless. I also have sensitive skin and while this product causes a mild stinging immediately when applied, it doesn’t lead to irritation and discomfort.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_title: Perfect way to start your day
reviews.review_text: These wipes really do brighten my skin! I use these each morning when I wake up in replacement of washing my face with cleanser. I have used them as makeup remover wipes and they do work, but they aren’t very effective in taking off waterproof mascara. However, they work so well for hyperpigmentation! After I use them, I follow up with serum and moisturizer/spf. Perfect and easy skincare in the morning!

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product since I started college and it has been the key to fully cleansing my skin. This will really get everything off of your skin (I love makeup!) but still keep it balanced. I have tried Purity Made Simple and so many others, but none compare. I recommend to everyone!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: Origins is what got me into skincare- their products are so good for your skin and they make you feel good too. I have normal skin that gets oily in the T zone and I really do love this moisturizer! It definitely leaves you matte so it can be a little too matte sometimes, but it is great for a no-makeup day or a day where you will be hot and sweating! Plus - it smells so amazing!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I love gel moisturizers and have always loved the scent of First Aid Beauty’s smoothie primer/moisturizer but- it left my skin greasy by the end of the day. This is so perfect! It doesn’t leave your skin tacky, but it definitely feels moisturized and smells AMAZING. I use this, some spf, and First Aid’s matte primer (also recommend!!) before foundation and it gives me such a flawless base!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: This works so well. I’ve been using this in conjunction with their Vitamin C to fade my dark spots and I’ve noticed a major difference within a month. I recommend this! One note- May be too intense on sensitive skin because it’s strong.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I ran out of my usual drugstore cleanser and wanted to treat myself. I absolutely love Tatcha products but don’t normally spend my money on cleansers, more on active ingredients. But this product is so much more than I expected! First- it smells like a spa and it makes the experience amazing. Second- I live that it foams but definitely doesn’t strip my skin! Highly recommend this. Plus, you only need a pea sized amount to cleanse your whole face and neck so this will actually last a long time.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I ran out of my usual drugstore cleanser and wanted to treat myself. I absolutely love Tatcha products but don’t normally spend my money on cleansers, more on active ingredients. But this product is so much more than I expected! First- it smells like a spa and it makes the experience amazing. Second- I live that it foams but definitely doesn’t strip my skin! Highly recommend this. Plus, you only need a pea sized amount to cleanse your whole face and neck so this will actually last a long time.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Love! This can take off a whole face of makeup or just your sunscreen. I’ve tried so many and this is my favorite for that slight lime scent and easy glide. You only need to size of a pea and it takes everything off! Definitely need to go in with a cleanser afterward, currently using the Tatcha one and they’re a great duo.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Love! This can take off a whole face of makeup or just your sunscreen. I’ve tried so many and this is my favorite for that slight lime scent and easy glide. You only need to size of a pea and it takes everything off! Definitely need to go in with a cleanser afterward, currently using the Tatcha one and they’re a great duo.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have a small baby and sleeping thru the night is not happening very often. So I started to use this cream on my eye area and notice a big difference. It helps to keep my tired skin hydrated and it feels soft the next morning. It’s like giving a little boost on my skin. I’m even using it before I apply makeup now. It helps to keep the area of the eye hydrated and don’t show too much crease when I apply concealer. I just put a tiny bit and blend with my primer! It’s perfect!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty.Loving this moisturizer for my night care routine. It has a rich texture and it’s perfect if your skin needs an extra boost of hydration. It’s formulated with honey and ceramides that replenish and restore your skin barrier. The smell is a light hint of honey and once applied goes away. The packaging is so nice and convenient. The lid is magnetic and you can place the scoop that comes with it on top so it doesn’t fall. I’ve been using it for a few days an I already notice my skin is soothed and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_title: A new must have on my skincare routine!
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing!! You can apply as the last step in your morning skincare routine and before makeup.  It will give your skin a healthy and natural glow. I have also used as the last step of my makeup in certain parts of my face where I want more luminosity. Looks amazing under a CC cream and leaves my skin looking super healthy. I’m really liking this product because is lightweight, fast absorbing and doesn’t leave my skin greasy. I have normal skin and I think this product is perfect and work with any skin type! Definitely a new must have on my skincare routine! This product was received complimentary from Glow Recipe.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: First, let me tell you I’m in love with this cute green packaging! During the last few weeks of winter my skin tends to be dry and my cheeks get red. So I always look for products to sooth, hydrate and get my skin ready for spring and summer. This serum is lightweight, absorbs very well and doesn’t leave my skin oily. I’ve noticed that flakiness is gone and the red on my cheeks is starting to fade as I’ve introduced this product in my routine a week ago.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m loving how this product is working great on my combination skin. It hydrates very well without leaving my T- zone oily. It has a heavier gel consistency that soaks right into my skin & doesn’t make it feel like there’s product sitting on top. It also smells really good, like fresh roses. I like to apply before my makeup for that super sleek and smooth skin finish. Love it and recommend it!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using it daily in the evenings after my moisturizer. I love the cooling sensation of applying it with the ceramic applicator. It has help to diminish the appearance of fine lines and my eye area looks brighter and well hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: With temperatures dropping, my skin tends to change as well. I have normal skin, but during colder months it tends to get dry and red. This overnight mask has worked wonders. It is thick but it absorbs into the skin very well leaving it so soft and moisturized. I wake up looking like my face was never red! Really reduces visible redness and calms the skin!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_title: Loving the results with just 2 weeks of use!
reviews.review_text: Have been using this product for about two weeks now and can totally notice the visible results. I only use it at night before bed and in combination with my cleanser and moisturizer. My skin is looking radiant and glowy and the big expression lines on my forehand are less noticeable. The fast acting retinol really does the job on diminishing my fine lines. Will keep using it to prevent future wrinkles and to treat the ones I already have!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_title: Loving the results with just 2 weeks of use!
reviews.review_text: Have been using this product for about two weeks now and can totally notice the visible results. I only use it at night before bed and in combination with my cleanser and moisturizer. My skin is looking radiant and glowy and the big expression lines on my forehand are less noticeable. The fast acting retinol really does the job on diminishing my fine lines. Will keep using it to prevent future wrinkles and to treat the ones I already have!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Not only is this moisturizer so creamy and effective it’s also the most beautiful packaging I’ve seen. So chic! I’m loving the texture and to use it in my morning skincare routine before applying makeup. It instantly gives my skin a natural glow and keeps it hydrated all day long but not oily which I love. Big fan of their makeup line and now just got hooked with their skincare too!

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: When it comes to eye cream I like to use for at least 2 weeks to start seeing results! This balm has been working great and I have noticed less fine lines and puffiness around my eye area. It’s hydrating and goes on smoothly. Also works well under my makeup! I was gifted by Algenist.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: This is my first Supergoop product and I love it! It feels so light on my skin and it blends  beautifully with my skin complexion while giving me that perfect natural glow. I’ve been using this product as a primer for my make up for that glowy look and feel good knowing it gives me SPF protection. A new go to!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Finally a primer with all benefits of a moisturizer. I love this product. It’s a must every day before applying makeup. Foundation looks much better with this face base as a layer. Absorbs very fast and smells amazing!

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: There is a reason why there are so many 5 star reviews. It really is amazing. reviews.review_text: This is the best moisturizer I’ve used! It is light weight but I still feel like I am getting lots of moisture. If you use the Umbra Sheer sunscreen over it, it is such a nice pair, it feels so nice under the sunscreen. You don’t need too much of this moisturizer, which is nice so it’ll last a long time.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I use this moisturizer at night because my skin is a little too oily in the morning to use throughout the day. You don’t need too much. It actually doesn’t feel super heavy on the skin although it is a thicker cream. I think it is a great moisturizer for when you use retinol or BHA/AHA’s. If you don’t have super oily skin I think you will really like this if you want a thicker moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this oil so much. I have sensitive skin and I find this oil is soothing and helps reduce some of the redness from my face. Its not oily (unless you use too much) so make sure you only use one or two drops. I mix it in with my other drunk elephant products and I really notice that it helps to just make my products melt into my skin and feel so nice. The 1oz bottle is actually quite big and there’s a lot of product, especially considering you are only using one or two drops a day. Because of this, the products lasts a really really long time. I love this produce and will repurchase, but I think I would repurchase the smaller size because the bigger one is just too much oil for me to use in a period of time. If its your first time purchasing, I suggest buying the smaller size too, I think it will still last quite some time and you don’t have to pay as much but there’s still enough product to see if you like it!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: The first time I used this product I hated it. It irritated my eyes and it just wasn’t as effective as the makeup removing balm from Drunk Elephant. Now I use it as a morning cleanser and any time I need to do a quick clean in a pinch without using water! By using it in the morning it has made a huge difference in my skin. I have less dryness and redness and overall my skin feels really nice and prepped for the day. Personally, I think that if you want a product that removes makeup, use the makeup removing balm from Drunk Elephant instead. I would highly suggest this for morning or quick day time cleansing, like after working out!

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I am almost finish my second jar and about to buy a third. I think it’s safe to say that I LOVE this product. It also has no fragrance and has lots of amazing ingredients. Many reviews are right, this does make your skin feel greasy sometimes. This is because you HAVE to do a double cleanse with this and use a water based cleanser after. You should be doing that with all cleansing balms, not just this one. If you use this product according to the directions and properly by cleansing with a water based cleanser after, you will love this and have a really great cleansing routine. It is much better than makeup wipes as it doesn’t produce the waste that makeup wipes do. I have only used the bamboo booster a handful of times because I use retinol and glycolic acid serums and the booster would be too much for me to personally use. The few times I have used it though I loved it!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_title: Not the Best, Not the Worst
reviews.review_text: I am quite torn with this product. It only works when you place it on a pimple that has the big white head exposed. However, the problem that I have with this product is that when you remove it after wearing it overnight, the patch essentially takes the top layer of skin over the white head of the pimple. Idk how healing it is when it just takes off the top and you have to clean the rest of your pimple away. It honestly doesn’t feel much better than just popping the pimple yourself (which we all know not to do), the result after using feels the exact same. Despite all of this, I do find that the recovery is quicker with the dots and the pimple doesn’t travel as much on the face. Overall, not my favourite product for healing my pimples but also not the worst out there.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_title: Absorbs well, leave skin soft and smooth with no s
reviews.review_text: I received a free sample of the Bareminerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum from PINCHme for my honest review. I’m 34 and have never used anti-aging products. My skincare has always focused on acne, dark spots, and pore treatments. I have combination skin so I get excessively oily on my T-zone. The sample size I received was only good for 1 day of use (morning and evening) so I cannot attest to their claims, however, I can talk about how well the product did on my skin. I applied the Bareminerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum after cleaning and toning my face in the morning and I applied my gel moisturizer after the serum absorbed into my skin. The absorption was pretty quick which I really liked because that meant that I didn’t have to waste so much time before applying my gel moisturizer. Once the Bareminerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum absorbed, I noticed my skin was really soft and smooth. I went about my did and did not experience the T-zone shine I normally have which meant this was a product I could use because it wouldn’t make me feel extra oily. My evening application was the same I applied it after cleansing and toning the serum absorbed fairly quickly and then I applied my gel moisturizer. I woke up the next morning and my skin was again nice and soft. I give this four stars based on the experience I was able to have with the serum I will have to reassess my review after trying the Bareminerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum for the full 4 weeks, which is when their study claims to have shown results.
