reviews.review_text: This was definitely moisturizing. However, I didn’t see much of a difference in brightness or circles as compared to other eye creams I have used. Packaging and consistency are nice.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Probably like most people i picked this up as a recommendation from Hyram. I have normal to dry sensitive and acne prone skin. This has a refreshing almsot cooling sensation. It doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry like almost every other cleanser. I’ve see a significant improvement in the redness of my skin and overall texture. I even got my sister addicted to this cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Probably like most people i picked this up as a recommendation from Hyram. I have normal to dry sensitive and acne prone skin. This has a refreshing almsot cooling sensation. It doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry like almost every other cleanser. I’ve see a significant improvement in the redness of my skin and overall texture. I even got my sister addicted to this cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: if you want a primer thsi is fantastic!! however if you have try skin THIS WILL NOT BE ENOUGH MOISTURE. i love the look it gives, but i have to pair it with another moisturizer. however, it makes your skin look amazing !!! adds a beautiful glow, has a smoothing effect, and helps cover up redness and scars

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I have dehydrated acne prone skin. i use a benzoyl peroxide treatment twice daily so i’ll do anything to hydrate my skin and improve my moisture barrier. this serum is so lightweight and sinks in almost immediately. jsut a warning, i wouldn’t put this on damaged skin. i had really irritated my face from the ordinary aha/bha mask and so i used this thinking it’d help but it only intensified the burning. but other than that i love this and 100% recommend

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: i’ve been needing a more intense moisturizer ! this is great fo both day and night. it is soothing and feels hydrating the second you put it on. it locks in moisture. it is a slightly thicker cream. if you have dry or normal skin you need this! might be too much for oily skin. it’s worth the price

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: i’ve been needing a more intense moisturizer ! this is great fo both day and night. it is soothing and feels hydrating the second you put it on. it locks in moisture. it is a slightly thicker cream. if you have dry or normal skin you need this! might be too much for oily skin. it’s worth the price

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: this lip balm has a similar consistency to carmex. it provides a nice shine on the lips and a sight flush of color. the grapefruit smell isn’t too strong but smells great(has a slight grapefruit taste too). overall i love this lip balm. and fyi it adds enough to the lips you wouldn’t need to apply gloss

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It has a gel formula that is super great is cream moisturizers feel too heavy or make you break out and it smells fresh. A little goes a long way with this product and will leave your skin feeling super hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is so light and moisturizing, but powerful. I use this cleanser after removing my makeup with a wipe and it gets everything I left behind. My second favorite thing about it is that it is gentle enough to be used on the eyes. I have never once felt my eyes being burned or irritated by this product. My first favorite thing about this is the smell. It smells so fresh and fruity, but doesn’t linger enough to irritate. I use this every day and it makes my skin so soft.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I got this in a sample size, but ran through it too quickly so I had to buy the full size. This does wonders for your under eyes! I put this on morning and night to keep my under eyes hydrated and keep my dark circles at bay. Another Drunk Elephant product that I am in love with!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I was looking for a new facial exfoliator when I saw this one on the Sephora app. I already love the Fresh Soy Face Cleanser, so I thought I would give this a try. The sugar in this is very nice and not too big, so it doesn’t scratch your face enough to hurt. My skin looks glowy and feels smooth after every use of this product.

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: This two-part mask is innovative and very moisturizing! When I use this I wake up with my skin feeling more smooth and hydrated than when I went to sleep. I think the smell is just fine, but some of my friends have told me they thought it was strange when they tried it out, so be aware of that. The smell doesn’t linger though. I think this mask has a cute design and I love the way it makes my skin look and feel!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Used this cleanser for over 4 years.. doesnt agree with my skin anymore. I dont know if the formulation changed of my skin changed... now it dries me out to the point that i get oily afterwards! my husband loves it and use it now. He has oily skin with dry patches that itches.. not anymore since he use this combo with the moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Smells like donut.. need i say more?I use this for double cleansing when i put on more make up than usual. Its nice, oily and smooth. Really like this texture on my skin. Effective for removing make up. I have the sample size that i redeemed with points. Might buy the full version.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Smells like donut.. need i say more?I use this for double cleansing when i put on more make up than usual. Its nice, oily and smooth. Really like this texture on my skin. Effective for removing make up. I have the sample size that i redeemed with points. Might buy the full version.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love the texture of this cream and the way my skin felt after apply and the morning after. But the smell is so strong and synthetic... i couldnt believe how overwhelming the scent was! Was really hoping of loving this..

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: I tried this as a sample.. been using this for 2 weeks now and so far so good. My skin is soft and hydrated. No harsh smell. Might try this as a full size!

reviews.product_name: Mini Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love the consistency, its gel but lather very well. A good cleanser to get glass skin.The scent is not overpowering but doesnt smell natural either.. i dont understand why brand still use fragrance..

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I tried 10 different moisturizer in the past year and a half trying to find something that would work for me... been using this for 4 months now and i really like it! I use it with introdcting retinol and for now, no peeling. My skin feels velvety soft.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Love love this! Sink so well on damp skin before my moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: AMAZING! Best hand cream ever! Goes on smooth, no greasy feel, absorbs quickly, no gross scent. I use this for travel in the dessert and one application lasts 24 hours on dry, cracked hands. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Feels like you just got a facial. Very natural, not greasy, absorbs instantly, and feels like a dream! I don’t feel like there are chemicals on my face. Outstanding under makeup, just enough moisture for someone with borderline oily skin. Not sure about long term anti-aging effects yet, but well on my way to finding out as I just repurchased. I think this is a smart choice as so often the chemicals in anti-aging products often make signs of aging worse.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Definitely does a great job of moisturizing, however does not make skin look poreless. Calming for skin, absorbes well, and makes skin feel conditioned. I feel there are better anti-aging moisturizers out there.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Definitely does a great job of moisturizing, however does not make skin look poreless. Calming for skin, absorbes well, and makes skin feel conditioned. I feel there are better anti-aging moisturizers out there.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: Well, to me, I don’t see the point. After two weeks of use, just seems like an unnecessary part of my skincare routine. More of a luxury item than anything.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Been using this a couple of weeks. Leaves my skin feeling good, definitely not as though it has been stripped of moisture. Does however leave makeup residue around eyes and nose area. Works pretty well as a pre-cleanser, but what’s the point with so much residue left? Does make skin feel soft, a big plus.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: Out of all the Tatcha products I have tried, this is the best so far. Gentle, yet exfoliates, which is great to get rid of the cleansing oil residue that builds up in my pores. Two weeks now and will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: On the hunt since my last facial wash was discontinued. I love the YTTP moisturizer, so thought I would give this a try. Love the packaging, it’s great! I can see how this wo is be good for any skin type. This is great for not stripping oil from your skin and has a refreshing feeling. Leaves skin feeling clean. The only downside is it struggles with removing makeup during my pm wash.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: On the hunt since my last facial wash was discontinued. I love the YTTP moisturizer, so thought I would give this a try. Love the packaging, it’s great! I can see how this wo is be good for any skin type. This is great for not stripping oil from your skin and has a refreshing feeling. Leaves skin feeling clean. The only downside is it struggles with removing makeup during my pm wash.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: While Ole is one of my absolute favorite lines, I am absolutely baffled at this product’s rating. while reviews were one of the reasons I selecting this product, it does not at all deliver for me. It sits on my face, does not absorb, leaves a filmy feeling, and pills if you rub it. Seriously scratching my head on this one. Being returned.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this product! I received this in my Ipsy bag and fell in love and HAD to buy the full size after finishing the mini one. I pair this cleanser with the First Aid Beauty Intense Moisturizer and my skin has been better than it ever has been. I have extremely sensitive skin and this combo is perfect. It doesn’t dry out my skin and has been the remedy to smooth my skin and rid me of the bumpiness that sometimes comes from my skins reaction to, well, everything. It’s also took away the redness that I used to experience after washing my face.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I got this product as a sample with my foundation purchase. I was a little nervous about using as some products that I’ve tried in the past with AHA’s have tore my skin up. This product the whole package. I’ve used a lot of expensive products that have been just okay but not mind blowing for how much you pay. This stuff is incredible! My skin is almost like silk when I wake up in the morning. It’s magical. I will be buying this after I’m done with the sample!

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I just got this in my Ipsy bag and I am stumped. I don’t really battle acne, however, since having to wear face coverings my jawline and cheeks have taken a beating and have resulted in bumps. Y’all think I’m lying but I put this stuff on the spots and in 30 seconds the swelling and redness had already diminished! I’m still shook...

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I tried this on a whim. I saw results the next morning.My skin has been incredibly smooth and my pores are not even visible. I am very amazed. Great packaging as well. The product comes out very easy. I will be purchasing this for my lady friends as Christmas gifts. Everyone needs this!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I tried this on a whim. I saw results the next morning.My skin has been incredibly smooth and my pores are not even visible. I am very amazed. Great packaging as well. The product comes out very easy. I will be purchasing this for my lady friends as Christmas gifts. Everyone needs this!!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Amazing product. There are a lot of reviews claiming it’s too sticky, however, this product is very concentrated. You only need a pea sized dot to the forehead and cheeks. After a few minutes it sets in very nicely. I have very fussy skin and this is one of the few products my skin drinks up with no sass. I’m obsessed with this product. Smells great and is a favorite I recommend.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This is my second time buying this toner. I keep coming back because of the glow it provides. My skin is clear and is uniform in colour. It does not dry it out at all either. I also am weirdly obsessed with the smell. It actually makes me more excited to use it just because it smells so good. Glow recipe is becoming one of my favourite skincare brands at Sephora!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This is my second time buying this toner. I keep coming back because of the glow it provides. My skin is clear and is uniform in colour. It does not dry it out at all either. I also am weirdly obsessed with the smell. It actually makes me more excited to use it just because it smells so good. Glow recipe is becoming one of my favourite skincare brands at Sephora!

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I first found out about this product in march 2020. If you scroll through the ordinary website they’ll tell you what each product caters to. I’ve been using this since then, at night, in the last step of my routine. This oil makes my skin glow and makes it so soft. I’ve tried other oils and this one is always my main go-to. You can’t beat this price!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: this is the one you’ve been looking for!
reviews.review_text: I am in love with this moisturizer. I have combination skin that leads more to the dry side. I’m not a fan of gel type or water based moisturizers. I prefer ones that are like a thick cream. I have used both of the drunk elephant ones because they have the texture that I desire and I honestly found that those did nothing and ran out rather fast. I love how this moisturizer comes with an applicator so that I can choose how much I want to use AND I don’t have to come into contact with the rest of it with my fingers. A little goes a LONG way with this moisturizer. Seriously. I use about the size of a pomegranate seed each time I apply. It fully blends into my face and absorbs beautifully. I’ve noticed an amazing difference in the softness and the plumpness of my face since using this. It has the slightest honey scent as well and it’s very comforting. I love this product and would totally recommended it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: I’d give this product a million stars if I could
reviews.review_text: I have tried this lip mask in all the flavours/scents available. My favourite has to be grapefruit but I decided to try sweet candy this time! This product is the one product I’d take with me if I ever only had to choose one thing. Wearing it before bed, your lips are so plump and soft and full in the morning. However, I’m a person who always takes this with me everywhere I go so I use it as a gloss/lip oil too and it’s perfect for that. I’ve been using these sleeping masks for almost two years now and I cannot recall the last time I ever had chapped lips. I live in Canada too and it gets super dry here in the winter and this mask always has me covered. I think the best thing about it is the price point. I apply this at least 3 times a day minimum and it always lasts me around 6+ months a jar. My favourite product at Sephora hands down.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_title: You Need This. Just Buy It!!
reviews.review_text: I’ve been wanting this product for so long. I decided to finish up my Niacinamide & Zinc from The Ordinary before purchasing, and wow there is quite a difference! I also must note that I saw on Tiktok that this product also somewhat doubles as a primer. I was shocked to find out that it’s true. Applying before moisturizer and sunscreen, I have noticed that my foundation looks so natural on my face with this product. It’s light, you only need one pump, and it smells amazing. Have noticed an acne reduction with this product too. I can’t say enough good things about it. If you’re like me and have been wanting it, just get it!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I bought this oil because I had been using The Ordinary’s Rose Hip Oil and was recommended this one as a “better version” if you will. I must say this product is beautiful. I apply three drops at night and the next morning my skin is so bouncy and hydrated. I have even noticed that if I do end up skipping it, the colour of my face is not as bright and uniform, so it even does that too. Again comparing it to the ordinary, this oil is much more soft, easy to spread about the face and is nowhere near as greasy. Smells great, not too much fragrance. A bit pricey, definitely bought the mini before going for the full size.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Excellent cream that really hydrates without feeling heavy. Has a great scent too.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Lovely clean and light feel on the skin. I like the smell a lot. Works well. I use twice a day and highly recommend adding to your skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Lovely clean and light feel on the skin. I like the smell a lot. Works well. I use twice a day and highly recommend adding to your skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I have normal skin but I am prone to breakouts on the jaw line. This product works great and didn’t cause any skin issues whatsoever. No irritability or breakouts. It felt good when on and left my skin moisturized afterward. I recommend this product and will be buying more for myself.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I have normal skin but I am prone to breakouts on the jaw line. This product works great and didn’t cause any skin issues whatsoever. No irritability or breakouts. It felt good when on and left my skin moisturized afterward. I recommend this product and will be buying more for myself.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I am loving this product. It feels wonderful on my skin and goes on smoothly with a thin, rich finish. I have been receiving compliments on my facial skin since I started using it and I’ve noticed an improvement in my skin as well.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_title: This Product Really Works On Me!
reviews.review_text: Lovely product. I can feel and see a difference after just one week of use, I swear. My skin around my eyes looks better and feels better in the morning and after applying at night. I’ve been looking for something to help with slight aging around my eyes and between my brows. I think this may be it!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Nice cream. Goes on smooth. Feels great on my skin. Nice smell too.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Nice cream. Goes on smooth. Feels great on my skin. Nice smell too.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is a must hydrating serum for those with combination skin like me. Very lightweight but very effective to keep every bit of hydration in my skin. Not sticky at all! Definitely worth the high price tag. Will always repurchase it again and again. Recommended.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Good sunscreen but it leaves white cast residue
reviews.review_text: I like the idea that this is a physical sunscreen and has broad spectrum protection; but I am not a fan how the sunscreen applies on my skin. The texture is thick and needs a lot of rubbing to make the white cast disappear. But it does it’s job well. Use it to the beach and doesn’t get sunburned.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Very nice toner with potent exfoliating properties. I used it after washing my face at night, followed by essence, serum and moisturizer. This toner has a very delicious fruity smell which I really like. Leaves my skin smooth the next morning after 5 days of use. Love it! Highly recommended!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Very nice toner with potent exfoliating properties. I used it after washing my face at night, followed by essence, serum and moisturizer. This toner has a very delicious fruity smell which I really like. Leaves my skin smooth the next morning after 5 days of use. Love it! Highly recommended!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: A quick way to exfoliate after shower. It’s a bit tingly but it doesnt leaves my face red or irritated. It’s hard to judge if it improves my skin in one application.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: A quick way to exfoliate after shower. It’s a bit tingly but it doesnt leaves my face red or irritated. It’s hard to judge if it improves my skin in one application.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Shiseido always makes the best sunscreen products!! I love this sunscreen because it doesn’t looks weird or pilling up underneath my makeup. Will continue repurchase after i am done. Product received in complimentary for review.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Very portable and travel friendly sunscreen. It is easy to apply and doesn’t really leaves my skin greasy. Perfect for gym back for travel because it is not a liquid. Product received in complimentary for review.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been enjoying this serum by Sephora. It is lightweight and most importantly, doesn’t breaks me out. It does beautifully underneath my make up. Im considering getting a full size

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: The barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptides Cream was gifted by Skinfix for my honest opinion.  After using it, I found it that I love the packaging, a little does go a long away, it’s more of a natural based product, and that the dispenser makes it very easy to get the perfect amount out of me. As for the moisturizer itself, I like that it does not have a strong scent, and it is very hydrating on my sensitive dry skin. My only issue with it is, even after 40 mins of application on my face, it left my skin with a bit of a greasy feel and did not absorb well with me. I would recommend this perhaps for more of a nighttime cream.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: The barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptides Cream was gifted by Skinfix for my honest opinion.  After using it, I found it that I love the packaging, a little does go a long away, it’s more of a natural based product, and that the dispenser makes it very easy to get the perfect amount out of me. As for the moisturizer itself, I like that it does not have a strong scent, and it is very hydrating on my sensitive dry skin. My only issue with it is, even after 40 mins of application on my face, it left my skin with a bit of a greasy feel and did not absorb well with me. I would recommend this perhaps for more of a nighttime cream.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’m really impressed with this product. The Sunday Riley Good Genes Lactic Acid Treatment smells amazing and has a very nice texture when applied. As for the results, it left my skin feeling so soft/smooth and left my skin with a brightened and refreshed look.  I highly recommend this. Gifted by Sunday Riley and I love it.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love the beautiful glass jar with its metallic pink lid. As for the moisturizer itself,  the Rose fragrance is beautifully light and not overpowering at all. This moisturizer is more of a gel consistency and it really does leaves my skin looking hydrated. My only issue is it feels a little heavy on my skin and leaves slight tacky feeling for about 20 mins. Being that it’s a thicker cream, I could only use this at night. Gifted by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I really like this eye cream. It left the skin under my eyes looking very soft and smooth. Other than it having vitamin C, I feel as the small tint-like feature also helped to make my eyes look brighter as well. I did not notice much of a difference with puffiness but all in all I liked the results.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love how it makes my skin look and feel. This moisturizer seems a little thick when first removing from the jar but actually spreads very easily and absorbs quickly onto my skin leaving my skin feeling soft and hydrated each time I use it and I love how a little does a very long way for me. Since I’ve been using it I have noticed more even skin tone with less redness on my cheeks which is terrific and it leaves my skin plump with a vibrant glow and the pores near my cheeks are not are prominent. IT works for me so well for sure.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I got this eye cream as a sample. I wanted to find an eye cream I could really see a difference with. I’m 32 and was starting to see viable lines around my eyes and my regular eye wasn’t really helping. Well I have noticed a big difference in less than a week of using this product. I will definitely be buying this product.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have seen a bit of a difference in my pores, but I have seen the biggest improvement with helping reduce my acne outbreaks and clears up my skin fast . Plus it makes my face look smoother and soft.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I recently got this product and I have been using it for less than a week and I have already noticed that the yellow discolouration under my eyes from lack of sleep and stress has started to fade. I will definitely have to see how it works for me in the long term but so far I am impressed.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using for about a week and I started noticing a difference in my skin tone, it was more even, smaller pores, reduced the redness in my cheeks. I love the lathering since I was using a cream cleanser for years before. I am excited to see the more long term effects.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using for about a week and I started noticing a difference in my skin tone, it was more even, smaller pores, reduced the redness in my cheeks. I love the lathering since I was using a cream cleanser for years before. I am excited to see the more long term effects.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: I got this product for free from another seller and started using it. I love how it goes on matte there’s no shiny residue after and it’s easy to rub in so I bought the 100ml. It also lasts a very long time. I’m still using the 30ml after 3 months. I use it morning and night, I don’t know how much more plump my skin looks but it gives me the moisture I’m looking for.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: This is awesome, it really works!
reviews.review_text: Dr. Dennis Gross Alpa Beta Extra Strength Daily Peels are so good, they really help to smooth my skin and make some fine lines disappear over a short time. I don’t use daily though, I use every three days and still see great things happening to my face skin.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve used other products from the Dr. Dennis Gross skincare line and have great results from them so I was excited to try the pore perfecting and refining serum when I was gave the chance. After two weeks use I can see a difference in the size of my pores in a magnified mirror, they over all look smaller and much less noticable. The best looking spots are around my nose area. So I’ll definitely continue to use it.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I’ve used many different kinds of wrinkle lotions and creams but this is my first time using a product with micro needles and I was truly impressed with how these Peace Out micro needle patches work. I used as instructed by the product, leaving on over night and I was shocked by how much smoother my smile lines were after use, I also like that it was long lasting. The wrinkles stayed smooth for several days after use and Peace out has gained a new fan and permanent user.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_title: Great product at an even greater price
reviews.review_text: I stopped using my regular night time serum(a more expensive brand with a elephant on it) and started using “The Inkey List serum“ several weeks ago. I found out I’ve been paying to much for night serum. The Inkey List works just as well, goes on smooth and absorbs fast, doesn’t leave an oily or greasy feeling either. With such a great price on this product and the results of smoother, firmer skin I’ve decided to switch permanently and continue use. I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve used and loved bareminerals make up products for years, so I was excited to get to try out they’re Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum for free thanks to Pinchme. As I expected it works great like all the other products of this company I’ve tried. Skin is smoother and more youthful looking and feeling. Also has a light fresh scent that’s really pleasent.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Let’s start with the beautiful packaging. It makes me feel luxurious every night. The cream starts off thick and melts into the skin. When I wake up in the morning my skin looks radiant and not greasy. I love it so much. I’m thankful to have received this product through Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The scent is delicious! Makes me think about fresh cucumber in the summer. The cream blends so well into my skin and makes me feel hydrated. My skin looks healthy and bright. It doesn’t take much I just dot 5 times around my face. I’m so happy to have received this from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way! I was able to test this out for a week and it felt so good. I feel like my skin got softer and looked more blurred almost since it was plumped up lol. Overall I really enjoyed it! Ordering it soon!

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way! I was able to test this out for a week and it felt so good. I feel like my skin got softer and looked more blurred almost since it was plumped up lol. Overall I really enjoyed it! Ordering it soon!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way! I was able to test this out for a week and it felt so good. I feel like my skin got softer and looked more blurred almost since it was plumped up lol. Overall I really enjoyed it! Ordering it soon!

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: I found this to be so interesting! I’ve never tried something like this before. The dead skin really does ball up and you can see the difference after the first week. I use this three times a week at night. My skin has been a bit dull and uneven lately. I feel like it’s been helping my skin even itself out more and be brighter. I feel more confident going out with no makeup even. I don’t have sensitive skin so if you do I would say start slow once a week and work your way up. I’ll be incorporating it into a forth day. I love that it’s a clean product as well with easy to understand ingredients.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: I found this to be so interesting! I’ve never tried something like this before. The dead skin really does ball up and you can see the difference after the first week. I use this three times a week at night. My skin has been a bit dull and uneven lately. I feel like it’s been helping my skin even itself out more and be brighter. I feel more confident going out with no makeup even. I don’t have sensitive skin so if you do I would say start slow once a week and work your way up. I’ll be incorporating it into a forth day. I love that it’s a clean product as well with easy to understand ingredients.

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: OBSESSED! I was a little weary to try this mask since I have pretty oily skin and “dewy” usually ends up making me look sweaty or super oily. But I’ve been using this every night for a week and I’m so happy with how my skin looks and feels. It’s noticeablely softer and had more a glow than usual. I was also really pleased that it didn’t make me break out, since that’s also a concern I usually have. I received this as a complimentary product for testing but I would definitely purchase it myself.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t too impressed with this moisturizer when I first started using it but now after a couple of weeks I really love it! It’s not too greasy and my skin has cleared up a bit. I’ve been leaving the house without makeup more often since using this. I received this product complimentary through Influenster for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I was excited to try this moisturizer since my skin was in need of something hydrating to get through the winter. I’m prone to breakouts so anything too heavy irritates my skin. This cream was light enough that it didn’t bother me but still prevented me from drying out. I received this complimentary through Influenster

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Not a big fan of this moisturizer unfortunately. I used this for a bit after seeing so many good reviews but it just isn’t right for my skin. This makes me too oily and doesn’t feel like it helps hydrate that much.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I liked this product a lot! The coverage is sheer but I was impressed with how it blended to match my skin. There was still a bit of redness but it was much better than it looks without any makeup. Perfect for when I want light coverage! I haven’t tried it under foundation though

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I liked this product a lot! The coverage is sheer but I was impressed with how it blended to match my skin. There was still a bit of redness but it was much better than it looks without any makeup. Perfect for when I want light coverage! I haven’t tried it under foundation though

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_title: Best serum ever for combination skin!
reviews.review_text: My holy grail!! I absolutely LOVE this product. It is definitely worth the price. Every month I get hormonal breakouts and this has almost put an end to it completely.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: BEST face cream! I have very sensitive and acne-prone skin and this moisturizer hydrates my face and does not break me out at all. It feels amazing and super light on my skin! I definitely recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: Love this sleeping mask!!! It feels super light yet hydrating on my face. I have combination acne prone skin and have used this multiple times and not once it has caused any breakouts. This is great during the dry winter for me!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this eye cream. I’ve been trying multiple different eye creams over the past 2 years and can never find one with a good creamy consistency that is easy to spread. Happy to say this one is finally THE eye cream! Perfect creamy consistency, easy to apply, and keep my under eyes super hydrated. I’ve also noticed a huge improvement in the lines on my crows feet using this eye cream!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Love Drunk Elephant with this serum had to take some precious because I was feeling that in the beginning my skin was getting some bumps than I mixed for a week with my Protini and than my skin was adjusting to this serum.My skin improved and removed some pores and wrinkles.My skin look younger,fresher less wrinkles and less oily which for me is a plus since I have oily skin.Would buy and use with other products especially mixing with DE is the BEST.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love all products from Drunk Elephant.This cleanser make my skin fell very cleaned without any irritation.Removes makeup extremely well and doesn’t make my skin dry.Very great cleanser that comes with two sizes and when you travel the smaller size is very handy.I use and love Drunk Elephant products would definitely buy this in the future.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is my one of Drunk Elephant favorite products.This cream moisture my face for so many hours my skin look fresh hydrated with brighter fresher looking skin.I mix this cream with serums or D-Bronzi for my skin have different texture and every time works great. Works amazing well with other DE products for me mixing them together give another boost to your skin.Love as most DE products would buy more in near future.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Drunk Elephant I’m sorry but this lip balm didn’t work for my lips.Using for the third time didn’t change my reactions to this product,unfortunately my lips were not moisture the balm even make them drier and rough than normal.Also the the bottle could get upgrades because it’s very hard at the end get it out.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love Drunk Elephant for quite some time.This eye cream removes under eye puffiness and wrinkles ,wakes up the eyes in the morning and at night makes your eyes looks spotless.I use this cream for so long and I would stick to this Drunk elephant products for a long time.Please try Drunk Elephant products you may love them for your daily care.This brand is the Best

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I first tried this from the Fresh Lotus free sample and I am officially hooked. It KILLS me that I am writing a glowing review for $50 moisturizer but YOU GUYS. It’s so good. Feels wonderful on my skin, smells lovely, absorbs quickly, and I wake up looking so refreshed and hydrated! My skin leans oily and sensitive, so it’s difficult to find a really hydrating moisturizer that doesn’t make me break out. Can’t imagine switching away from this one.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: PROS: This stuff is AMAZING! It goes on so smoothly and it is truly unseen - no whitecast, no oily skin, no sunscreen smell. Works great under makeup and doesn’t pill. CONS: honestly none. I mean, it’s expensive, but for me it’s totally worth it to spend $$$ on a sunscreen I will actually wear every day instead of one I have to convince myself to use. OVERALL: If you’re looking for your HG sunscreen I have to recommend giving this a try.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: PROS: This stuff is AMAZING! It goes on so smoothly and it is truly unseen - no whitecast, no oily skin, no sunscreen smell. Works great under makeup and doesn’t pill. CONS: honestly none. I mean, it’s expensive, but for me it’s totally worth it to spend $$$ on a sunscreen I will actually wear every day instead of one I have to convince myself to use. OVERALL: If you’re looking for your HG sunscreen I have to recommend giving this a try.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: PROS: just everything!!! Just a tiny bit leaves my skin hydrated and glowy! I got this first as a gift with purchase from Sephora; I purchased it again recently when that ran out, and think the full size will last me about 6 months. It feels wonderful and smells great! Also, vitamin C usually breaks me out- this did not. CONS: Does not always absorb too quickly so it’ll get on your pillow if you use it right before bed.OVERALL: Great purchase, 10/10 recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: PROS: just everything!!! Just a tiny bit leaves my skin hydrated and glowy! I got this first as a gift with purchase from Sephora; I purchased it again recently when that ran out, and think the full size will last me about 6 months. It feels wonderful and smells great! Also, vitamin C usually breaks me out- this did not. CONS: Does not always absorb too quickly so it’ll get on your pillow if you use it right before bed.OVERALL: Great purchase, 10/10 recommend!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: PROS: this is a lovely cleanser. I use it after an oil cleanse/balm and it removes all makeup residue and leaves my skin feeling clean and looking glowy and hydrated. Has not caused any issues for my skin, which can be prone to whiteheads. Got this as a free sample, and have since purchased the full size and loving it. CONS: more of a heads up! I do have oily skin, so if you have dryer skin this might not be hydrating enough (despite the description).OVERALL: worked wonders for my oily, sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Loved this cleanser! It isn’t creamy so not a problem for oily skin, but also wasn’t too stripping. It is a gel like consistency that feels gentle but throurough and a little goes a long way. My skin feels clean but refreshed and ready for other products.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This cream is lala lovely. Whipped to perfection and a great moisture without feeling oily. Love the packaging too, the push feature to pop up some cream is genius, you don’t have to dip your fingers in a jar.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Not a fan at all. I LOVE DE products, they make my skin amazing, so figured the lip balm would round out the collection. I was quite disappointed. This is very tiny and expensive and honestly nothing special. It is wide where I prefer a skinny lip balm. It doesn’t taste like anything and honestly doesn’t feel that moisturizing. There are products for a couple bucks that do a much better job. Really wished this was tasty and silky, but it left me super underwhelmed.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Loved this eye cream, it has a shimmery yellow look that I think actually perks up under eye circles. It hydrates and feels great. I also love the packing with the flip up pump to get just the right amount of product.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Was super impressed with this product, love a good Night serum. This serum felt great and left my skin feeling soft and glowy. I’m a big fan of natural and cruelty free items, and even the packing was great. the way the pump twists out is awesome and makes iT easy to get the right amount.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: Great toner for a great price
reviews.review_text: This is a really great glycolic toner.  I have used several different brands with different acid percentages and for the money you can’t beat this one.It has a slight smell but acids have a scent since they are chemicals.  It’s part of it.  It doesn’t burn my skin at all.  There is a slight flush to my skin but that is normal with an acid exfoliant.  I have really liked how it is has helped with the texture of my skin and I have noticed a bit more of a glow since using it.  You really can’t beat it for the price.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: This toner really delivers soothing moisture.  I use it at night after double cleansing and I have been very pleased with the results so far. You get a moisture boost immediately when you apply it.  I have also noticed my skin looks plumper and more glowy the next morning after I use it.  It seems super gentle and doesn’t cause my sensitive skin to turn bright red. I love the smell as well. I highly recommend this toner!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is good but not amazing. It is moisturizing but beyond that doesn’t do that much. The moisture does help plump up lines but after using it for almost a month I haven’t seen any true change in the texture of the skin around my eyes. Also it is highly fragranced and the scent is very sweet. It is too much. It gave me a bit of a headache. If you aren’t sensitive to fragrance and you want an eye cream that is fairly moisturizing then this will worn for you. That said, there are better options for less than $70.00

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I really, really like this sunscreen a lot!  It rubs in easily and doesn’t break me out which I love. It doesn’t have an off putting fragrance like so many sunscreens do. It is water resistant and that is important for a daily use sunscreen!  I also really love the high SPF. The only reason I don’t give it five stars is because I prefer a mineral based sunscreen as opposed to a chemical based one. That said, this is the best chemical based one I have ever used!

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Not so great for my oily skin
reviews.review_text: This serum looks gorgeous on your vanity and it has some really fun ingredients (looking at you gem stones and gold!) but I need it to do more than that. For my oily, maturing (I’m 38) skin, it just didn’t work well. I used it consistently for a month before reviewing so I could be fair to the products and the people who would read the reviews and I have to say that yes it is moisturizing, but it broke me out. I am guessing it is the shea in it. I wanted to like it because it is such a lovely product but it just wasn’t right for me. If you have dry skin you should for sure try it out.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is probably the single most beneficial step in my skincare routine. Before using Good Genes I was using a glycolic acid to exfoliate and didn’t notice a difference after several months and the whole bottle. Truly within a week my skin was brighter and smoother with Good Genes. I have oily skin and it works great, can’t speak for other skin types.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Great daytime moisturizer for my oily skin
reviews.review_text: I’ve repurchased this product twice and I’ll continue to. I have oily skin and I use this as my day time moisturizer. It hydrates my skin without making it greasy and my makeup sits beautifully on top of it.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_title: Prevents my under eye concealer from creasing
reviews.review_text: I love this eye cream. I’ve only been using it for a couple of weeks but I notice that my concealer creases much less. Success!

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I add a few drops of this to my nighttime moisturizer. It helps keep me from getting pimples. I didn’t think it was actually doing anything, so when my first bottle ran out I didn’t repurchase, but then I started breaking out just a little bit here and there. It’d take a while to clear up, so I repurchased and boom, no more issues!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_title: Feels weird but not a bad product!
reviews.review_text: I have oily/oily (none of that combo BS) skin and this is nice at the end of the week. My skin looks fresh after I rinse it off and it isn’t the best pore-clearer I’ve ever used but it’s fine, especially for the price. I see a lot of reviews saying they broke out and I highly doubt that’s what actually happened. I have cystic acne and my skin responds the same way it does to my charcoal cleanser, which is all the acne under the surface of my skin literally comes to a head. I like this in the seemingly never-ending battle for clear skin, it helps a good bit.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Very moisturizing and hydrating, love the ingredients in it. I don’t care for gel-type face creams though and I’m still very used to the FAB cream, which is more thick. Will definitely repurchase. I have oily skin.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product is everything my skincare routine was missing. After I cleanse and time I put half to three quarters of a pump on and then go on with my oil and moisturizer. I saw an immediate and long term difference, and I have oily skin with a history of cystic acne. I will say it doesn’t smell great but it’s not that bad. The box says 1-3 pumps which I think is a bit much, especially if you haven’t tried it before.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Been using this for a few weeks now and it’s made a big difference in my oil production. I’m oily all year round with a history of cystic acne and while good skincare healed my skin, this helps control my oil production. I am definitely still oily but no where near as bad. I cleanse, tone, exfoliate, then use this and finish with a moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: This just dries out my skin and leaves it feeling sticky. Feels immediately hydrating but after it dries I feel just a little tight. Gone through two of these (super quickly might I add) and I simply cannot recommend. It’s not a money saver if you have to buy it constantly and it delivers sub par results. Some of the other products in this line are bomb, though.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_title: Where have you been all my life???
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster & Korres in exchange of my honest review. Omg, where has this cream been all my life?!?!? Don’t know where to start... it’s lightweight, makes my pores blur, hydrating on my skin!!! I love it!!! I’ve already recommended this to my sisters and friends.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from PINCHme & Algenist in exchange of my honest review. I am very satisfied with this eye cream. I’ve been using it for atleast 2 weeks and i have noticed some changes on my under eyes.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received these products for free from Influenster and Shiseido in exchange of my honest review. I am literally very satisfied with this sunscreen, the fact that it’s not oily & thick it’s perfect for my type of skin!!! My new favorite Sunscreen!!!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received these products for free from Influenster and Shiseido in exchange of my honest review. I am literally very satisfied with this sunscreen, the fact that it’s not oily & thick it’s perfect for my type of skin!!! My new favorite Sunscreen!!!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Loved this moisturizer! I’m an oily combination skin type and this sits amazing under my makeup amazingly. I don’t find the sent over powering either !

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: It was a nice toner, it left a nice clean feeling to my skin: although I found the high amount of alcohol made it a little bit drying.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer, I would suggest for daytime since it’s such a gel and lightweight texture. Sits really beautifully under makeup!

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: Such a beautiful product! Amazing lightweight texture and sits great under makeup, perfect for a daytime oil.

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: Such a beautiful product! Amazing lightweight texture and sits great under makeup, perfect for a daytime oil.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I can think about since the first time I put it on was the watermelon candies. The scent of this moisturizer is light but really does smell like them; however I love that the smell doesn’t trail along for too long. I love the gel texture especially when I place it in the fridge! It feels very light and hydrating and provides a nice glow all day! It can be a little tacky/sticky. I usually prefer a gel moisturizer during my AM routine, but after this happened, I switched to using it at night and actually prefer for nights that I’m not using actives!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: The scent is strong but dissipates quickly. The application is lovely but over the course of the day it doesn’t look oily but feels oily.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: While I enjoyed the application I personally don’t love the idea of a stick sunscreen that continuously touches my skin.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This was gifted by Sunday Riley and is really a great AHA chemical exfoliant! I love the formulation, application, and gentleness of the product! The product is exfoliating but at the same time hydrating. It provide really great outcomes with consistent use for uneven texture!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Skinfix sent me this lovely moisturizer and it’s really nice for skin barrier repair and strengthening. I’ve used this product as well the many other products from the line and just find it so nourishing. I do only enjoy it in my evening routine as it can be a little too greasy for my oily skin during the day but for my evening routine it’s so nourishing and perfect for overnight repair! I also really appreciate the sealed packaging.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Skinfix sent me this lovely moisturizer and it’s really nice for skin barrier repair and strengthening. I’ve used this product as well the many other products from the line and just find it so nourishing. I do only enjoy it in my evening routine as it can be a little too greasy for my oily skin during the day but for my evening routine it’s so nourishing and perfect for overnight repair! I also really appreciate the sealed packaging.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is lightweight yet so nourishing. I always love an eye cream that has focused ingredients like retinol to work towards reducing fine lines with consistent use. I’ve enjoyed the product on a day to day basis and excited to see the long term results.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Dermalogica gifted me this cleansing oil but I would continuously repurchase this! Lightweight and effectively removes my waterproof mascara! It has a nice refreshing citrus scent and the overall experience is really impressive!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Dermalogica gifted me this cleansing oil but I would continuously repurchase this! Lightweight and effectively removes my waterproof mascara! It has a nice refreshing citrus scent and the overall experience is really impressive!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a staple to prep my skin before makeup! It gives my skin such a great base without being too heavy. To provide a glow without grease and not too matte is always a change for me but this does it!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is complimentary from Fresh, but I have used the clear Fresh lip balm for years. After trying it with tinted, this is the perfect everyday look to help my lips stay moisturized and nourished while giving such an amazing buildable color to it!

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from La Mer. I really liked this moisturizer. I have oily skin and I don’t feel my skin sticky and it is very quick to absorb. I have sensitive skin too and the power of hydration this moisturizer helps me a lot.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from La Mer. I really liked this moisturizer. I have oily skin and I don’t feel my skin sticky and it is very quick to absorb. I have sensitive skin too and the power of hydration this moisturizer helps me a lot.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a complimentary from fresh. I love this moisturizer. It’s super hydrated and thick. The smells it is good. Smell just like roses, but if you don’t like scents can be a little uncomfortable.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm

reviews.review_text: Great product! Has all I need! Great Ingredients that get the job done. I would highly recommend

reviews.review_text: This might be my new favorite face wash! My skin feels so soft after using this and it took off all my makeup. I haven’t been using it long enough to see how my skin will fully react, but so far so good!

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This might be my new favorite face wash! My skin feels so soft after using this and it took off all my makeup. I haven’t been using it long enough to see how my skin will fully react, but so far so good!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: My lips are never dry thanks to this stuff! I’ve even noticed my husband using it after seeing how soft they are. Big fan!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the holy grail for acne! My oily, problematic skin has never looked better since I added this into my routine. Any zits I get have their timeline cut in half. It dries them out before they have the chance to become a big problem. I always keep a bottle on hand.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: My husband has been using this for a few months now and loves it. He has oily skin and it hasn’t made him break out. It’s a little too thick for my oily skin under makeup, but that’s not an issue for him. There’s been a noticeable difference in his skin. It’s smoothed out his texture and it looks more even. His pores look smaller as well.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: My husband has been using this for a few months now and loves it. He has oily skin and it hasn’t made him break out. It’s a little too thick for my oily skin under makeup, but that’s not an issue for him. There’s been a noticeable difference in his skin. It’s smoothed out his texture and it looks more even. His pores look smaller as well.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I want to start by saying this does work for under eye puffiness and bags. I look so refreshed immediately after applying. With that said, it doesn’t last too long. It’s also irritating if not used with something moisturizing. A bottle lasts a long time, but I’m still on the fence about buying another.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I use this as part of my daily skincare routine. My skin has been GLOWING since I added it. I mean literally glowing! My skin tone is even, my pores are smaller. Everything feels so smooth! I will keep buying this one. Love The Ordinary!

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: The purple peeling solution is a little too harsh for me to use regularly. This is a good option to use instead. Definitely ease your skin into it and watch for irritation. I’ve noticed a difference in the scarring I have on my face since I added this.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I used Drunk Elephant’s TLC Sukari Baby Facial for almost 2 years before I stumbled upon this product. Not only is it stronger than DE’s version, it is a FRACTION- literally fraction- of the price. I honestly see better results with this. But as previous reviewers have mentioned, definitely do not leave this on longer than 10 minutes! And use a good moisturizer afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing y’all. Literally amazing. I got this as a birthday gift and I wasn’t expecting much since it’s just a face wash, but boy was I wrong. Although I don’t really have an issue with acne, I do have sebaceous filaments on my nose. I have tried everything to get them to go away- acids, peels, scrubs- you name it, it’s in my skincare cabinet. This stuff totally erased them! And as an added bonus, it helped control my oil all day and made my skin super glowy. Just a forewarning- I do have very oily skin, and I can easily handle a clarifying face wash. Not sure this would work for drier skin types.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m really loving this stuff. Since starting this stuff, my breakouts are minimal and my oily face stays shine free at least through lunch! I put it on after cleansing and let it dry at least 5 minutes. In the mornings, I put Buffet on top, and at night I use the 2% retinoid emulsion! My skin is glowing

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I really love this stuff. I use it in the mornings after the niamacide (sp?) and I have started foregoing a primer!! It’s THAT good! Fine lines have gone away, pores are minimal, and my face is hydrated but not overly so. It’s magic y’all!

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: This stuff is so, so good. I used Sunday Riley’s Good Genes for about a year until I stumbled upon this. It is everything GG is and so much more. First, it is not nearly as heavy. My face would be a grease ball after using GG, but not with this. It absorbs beautifully! Second, this has absolutely no smell, which was a huge plus for me. After cleaning at night, I tone with the ordinary’s glycolic toner, then apply this. I let it soak in and put the Granuactive (so?) Retinoid 2% on top. My skin has seriously never looked better. The texture is smooth and my dark spots have almost vanished.  I haven’t had one single break out in weeks, which is unheard of for my skin. Can’t recommend this (and the whole Ordinary line) enough.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: What this is, is the BEES KNEES. I apply it at night after my tretoinin and BEFORE my moisturizer. It gives an extra hydrating vitamin boost, and has really improved the dryness and irritation in my skin. In the morning, I use it in lieu of a moisturizer before my primer (Tatcha Liquid Silk) and it works beautifully. I will buy this again and again!!!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: OILY GIRLS, BUY THIS ASAP. I had previously been a loyal user of the green Ole toner, just because it’s marked for acne and oily skin. Switching to the blue toner has made all the difference in the texture and appearance of my skin. I find it controls my oil and acne better than the green, too. As a bonus, it smells AMAZING.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite face sunscreen. Great serum-like texture, absorbs quickly, and smells like peaches! Most importantly, it doesn’t burn my eyes. It also lasts for a long time before I feel the need to reapply. Holy grail for sure!

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant to buy this because the majority of reviews are from people who got it for free. Well I paid for it, and I can honestly say it’s one of the best products I’ve ever used. It is a little sticky when you first apply, but absorbs fast. I wake up with glowing skin and minimized pores. It’s also faded so many of my old acne marks. I’m sold on this y’all. Get it!!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: I was bummed when I saw that the original oil control moisturizer had been discontinued, but I’m super happy with this!! It really helps to keep me matte all day, and has also helped with my acne. It provides the perfect amount  of moisture (I’m combo/oily) and wears super well under makeup. I have had no issues with burning like others have said. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I am so picky when it comes to cleansers. I have some holy frail favorites. And this one is bumping some off! First off it smells amazing. I love how it foams so it even gives an impression that its cleansing your skin. And after all said and done my skin felt clean. Some cleansers just leave your skin feeling dry or even still dirty. This one didn’t. And my skin appeared brighter after a few uses. I did recieve this complimentary to test but I will definitely be purchasing more.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: This smells very refreshing. I believe this has helped the health of my skin. It just looks better. Can’t explain how. It just looks better. This is a nice product. Lightweight. Absorbs into my skin.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Okay this packaging is so cute. I love the applicator, it glides so smooth against my undereye. The way you twist the product up so you don’t accidentally squeeze out too much is perfect. I really enjoy this eye cream!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I love most Fresh products. This is no different. I just moved and so my skin has been so stressed and red. I immediately saw a different in my skin after that first night. My skin looked so hydrated and relieved. Plus the smell is lovely.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have never tried an exfoliant like this. And so I was excited to try it out. It’s super simple to use. You wet your hands then pour some of the powder into your palm, rub your hands together then massage your face. I have to adjust the ratio a bit when I first used it but I figured it out and my skin felt so good. So soft and shiny. I have had no reactions to this product and am so happy to keep using it.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have never tried an exfoliant like this. And so I was excited to try it out. It’s super simple to use. You wet your hands then pour some of the powder into your palm, rub your hands together then massage your face. I have to adjust the ratio a bit when I first used it but I figured it out and my skin felt so good. So soft and shiny. I have had no reactions to this product and am so happy to keep using it.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I am new to using retinol, but I definitely should’ve started sooner. I’m a huge Murad fan so this is definitely a product I trusted to use. It’s too soon to notice any long term benefits/improvements. But my experience so far has been great. I use one pump before my nightly moisturizer. It doesn’t sting or burn or itch. I don’t feel as if it’s drying out my skin. I haven’t had any breakouts from using it. And I feel as though my skin looks brighter but that could be a placebo effect right now. Ha! We will keep using it. And hopefully by the end of the bottle I will have results.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
