reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I know everyone was SO excited to try this new sunscreen! And so was I. I love glow recipe skincare and had no doubt their SPF would be equally as amazing. I have oily skin but this winter it’s been quite dry, more than usual. This SPF is very hydrating. And VERY glowy. Oh it adds such a beautiful glow to your skin. It has a light natural scent to it that hasn’t seemed to irritate my skin. I have tried this with different skincare combos and have not experienced any sort of pilling. I think this is an amazing SPF and if this checks off the boxes you’re looking for, then I say give it a try!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love almost all Fresh products I try. And this one is no different. I have oily skin and this Tea elixir gives my skin a hydrating plump without leaving a greasy feel. My skin is smooth and I definitely notice a more even texture. I definitely recommend trying this out!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This is not a “miracle worker” that everyone thinks it is. I have been using this for almost a month and my skin overall looks much better but takes time to see results. This did help with some breakouts that I had on my cheeks but as far as using this for lighting up acne scars or reducing texture didn’t work for me. It’s better to use the Alpha Arbutin serum or the Azelaic Acid Suspension!

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I really tried to give this product a try but my skin just hates it. It left my face feeling super sticky and almost like a dirty feel? Like I haven’t had washed my face in months! It also caused a lot of tiny bumps on my forehead and chin. This may work for other people because at the end of the day everyone’s skin is different, but sadly this didn’t work on mine.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This was one of the first products that I tried from The Ordinary a year ago and I immediately fell in love! It doesn’t leave my face with that greasy feeling and hydrates my skin pretty well. You just need a tiny bit to cover your whole face. I do think this is more for people with oily skin rather than people with dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: This has really help me to get rid of my acne scars and texture. I use it one to three times a week because I’m afraid if I use it every night it will irritate my skin. Every time I use this my skin wakes up next morning looking brighter and smoother. It also leaves it with a nice glow that I love. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: This is an excellent chemical exfoliator. I’ve been using this for a while now(almost a year). I use this once or twice a week depending on how my skin is feeling. This has helped me with texture and some horrible blackheads I had on my chin. MUST BUY.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: As a person with oily skin, I loved this. I use this only at PM and I mix it with my other serums. My face feels more hydrated and plumped, with a healthy glow. I don’t use this during the day or before makeup just because of how sticky it is and I’m afraid it will make my face look oiler than ever. Overall I think it’s a great product!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_title: Didn’t do anything for my skin
reviews.review_text: Saw the reviews raving about this one and decided to give it a try. I’ve been using this for months now and I haven’t noticed any changes. I was hoping this could help with my uneven skin tone and dark spots but mu skin looks the same.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_title: Love these but you can get them for cheaper
reviews.review_text: Don’t get me wrong, these are fanatics and I love the ingredients but you can get these exact ones for cheaper. It does pull out all the nasty stuff from your zit next day but I just don’t think $19 is worth for healing dots!

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample size and I’ven using it for two days. I can already see a difference in my skin texture and acne. My pores also looks more minimize. I pair it a night with dark spot sleeping cream and wake up to a beautiful glow and brighter skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample size and I’ven using it for two days. I can already see a difference in my skin texture and acne. My pores also looks more minimize. I pair it a night with dark spot sleeping cream and wake up to a beautiful glow and brighter skin.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I was looking for a foaming cleanser and this came up. I’ve been using this for over a month and in my personal experience it doesn’t do anything. This didn’t make my skin better or worse and for the price point I just wouldn’t repurchase again. I will continue to use until I finish it.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: This might be my favorite lip balm yet. I was on the look for a super hydrating lip balm since it’s getting cold and winter is coming. This product instantly hydrated my lips and made them much smoother. Definitely worth the purchase!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This product did nothing for me except literally make my lips peel and they stung. It was awful and not worth all the hype it gets.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I’ve used neutrogina makeup wipes for over 5 years.... these blow them out of the water and smell AMAZING! The rose is my favorite scent ever! My fiancé LOVES the exfoliating charcoal wipes!

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: Works amazing - loving my dewy glow!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: I am in love with this mask - it truly is amazing. I’ve noticed such a difference in my pores. It feels SO incredible and I just love the color of it, which is what made me decide to buy it. I highly recommend this mask!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Seriously y’all. If you need anything skincare in your life, I’ve found what you need. This product has made SUCH an impact in my skin already. It’s so creamy and lightweight but very moisturizing. Y’all. Do yourself a favor and buy this. Now!!!!!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: My favorite night time facial serum I have ever tried! It gently exfoliates your skin every night and then use babyfacial one night a week for a deep cleaning. Amazing!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: the best facial cleanser in the entire world!! This stuff gets all of my makeup off and other dirt that I can’t see without stripping my face. You need this in your life!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Drunk Elephant is just incredible. Babyfacial has completely transformed my skin.... it exfoliates and makes my skin shine and feel so smooth. #babyfacialsunday is my favorite!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I am so oily and was so hesitant to ever even use an oil on my face, well when I got the littles set by DE, I decided to try their virgin marula facial oil and wow.... I couldn’t love without it now! My skin is so smooth and soft, the oil absorbs so well and has not made me breakout once! I highly recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: THIS MASK IS INCREDIBLE!!!!! Seriously.... the appearance of my pores after using this mask are non-existent!!! It’s SO affordable, only $26 and it smells good! If I could give 100 stars, I would!

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Omg I can’t say enough good things about this product!!!! It’s honestly amazing. One of my favorite purchases! I use it primarily as a toner them follow with serums, moisturizers, etc! It is SO hydrating... I am obsessed with the consistency.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So far, I have been absolutely LOVING this moisturizer at night time! I like to hydrate the most at night time and it’s so heavenly. Such a great addition to their honey collection! This is amazing and smells SO amazing! I highly recommend this for those who want hydrated, plumped skin!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This eye serum is AMAZING!!!! I am absolutely obsessed with this. The ingredients are incredible… retinol & niacinamide are a dream team together. I am already seeing amazing results! The applicator is also life changing! I highly recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I really liked this serum, it works great on my skin. In just 1 week of use I have seen a good improvement in my skin and my pores got minimized and my skin looks smoother, softer and more toned than before. I use it twice in the morning and night, just take a small amount apply it all over. Its lightweight formula absobs fast into the skin. It is gentle and safe to use on all skin types. It is pricey but extremely effective making it worth every penny. I am glad that I got this to try and will continue to use this to get my best results.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I in love with this cream, it works great and leaves the skin silky smooth in touch. I use it daily in the morning. It is easy to use, just take a pearl-size amount and dot all around the eyes and slowly massage the cream into the skin. Its lightweight formula absorbs fast into the skin due to its creamy soothing mixture which blends easily into the skin and my areas around the eyes feels smoother and looks more radiant than before. After the first week of use, I have seen a noticeable improvement in my under-eye puffiness but not any improvement in the wrinkles. Now my skin feels nourished and moisturized. I am glad that I got this to try and will buy again this when I am out. I will continue to use this to get my best results. Highly recommend this to everyone.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Packaging: I like the cute packaging, it comes in a small tube that makes it perfect to carry in the purse to reapply throughout the day.Opinion: I take proper care of my skin so I always use sunscreen before stepping out. Sunscreen protects your skin from sun damage and reduces the sign of aging. This should be a mandatory part of our daily skincare routine. I like this sunscreen very much. This is non-greasy, lightweight, and is water-based which stays light on the skin. I hardly feel that it’s there. Apply this daily, 15 mins before going out in the sun. I take a dime-size amount with my finger on my palm and gently apply it on my face and neck. It went in my skin just like the moisturize and was absorbed well onto the skin. reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Let me just say that I have been an idiot for most of my life, because I didn’t start using moisturizer until I turned 25. I have oily skin, and I definitely fell for the myth that I couldn’t use it on my skin. But, one day I went out and bought some Kiehl’s midnight recovery oil after being recommended, and then I started digging into videos about skin care in general and found out that I have been abusing my face via dehydration. So, I went out and bought the mini size of this...and I was skeptical at first. I’m not a fan of the smell, and it felt heavy at first. However, as I tried other moisturizers and began forming a skin care routine, I found that this was the only one I went back to consistently. I apply it at night with after the Midnight Recovery Oil, and it melts into the face and calms my skin. The combination of the two has me waking up with really refreshed looking, soft skin. My oil production is WAY less, and overall, I regret my last 25 years of living. I’m going to go for the big one next time, but I bought the small size two months ago and I still have half a jar left.

reviews.review_text: I wear this every night. It has made my skin even in texture and color, and a little younger ;). Wear sunscreen if using this, as it makes your skin more sensitive to UV. reviews.review_text: I had consistently bad acne before using this (at any given time I had at least 2 large pimples and a few smaller ones). reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_title: Great product! Make sure to follow the directions
reviews.review_text: I was both excited and terrified to try this product out. The benefits and positive reviews just made it seem too good to pass over. I have been struggling with large pores that seem to constantly be congested, as well as occasional acne (cystic, as well). As long as you follow the directions carefully, you should have no issue. Yes, the product does have a bit of a tingle or sting to it, especially if you have an open area like a popped pimple. However, it wasn’t intolerable. Set your timer for ten minutes, do not leave on any longer as it instructs. I noticed visibly smaller pores right after use, and with continued use twice a week, I have been breaking out less and struggling less with congested pores. I have been applying the Rose hip seed oil after use as I find that this prevents my skin from experiencing irritation. The times that I haven’t, I’ve found that my skin will get dry, itchy and irritated. Overall it’s a great product with great benefits and is super easy to use, not to mention the price point is amazing.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: The only thing that has worked for my dark circles
reviews.review_text: I have tried so many products to try to lighten my dark circles, which are unfortunately, in my genetics, and also likely due to dehydration since I am terrible about drinking enough water. This is the only product that I can say I have experienced visible results with. I have been using for a few months now, morning and evening, and I notice a great difference! reviews.review_title: Replaced my prescription for cystic acne
reviews.review_text: Niacinamide with zinc, in conjunction with the salicylic acid (and sometimes benzoyl peroxide for the occasional big breakouts), was just right in combating my cystic and hormonal acne problems. Before I bought this, I thought long and hard to stop my clindamycin prescription as it was no longer working on me and my acne got even worse and painful. After about 2 months of continued use, my skin cleared, but I do have occasional breakouts before menstruation, which is way better than what my skin did before using this. Also, my existing breakouts that I had when I first started using this sort of rose up on my skin and eventually purged itself out. It was weird for me to see solid pieces of old pimples on my skin cleansing brush, but I was happy to see those things out of my face and in that brush!

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: So after finishing my first bottle of this and awaiting for my next bottle to come in the mail, I like this stuff. It’s pretty amazing that a few drops of this goes a long way and does a great job keeping my skin feeling hydrated, especially around my delicate eye area. I use around 3-4 drops and I’m good to go (sometimes 4 may be too much, actually). Also, I have not developed any milia around my eyes and it doesn’t seem to break out other parts of my face using this oil.However, I had to dock one star off for a silly reason,  but can be important: It smells pretty bad. Don’t get me wrong, love the product, but it did take some time for me to get used to the smell and my husband has expressed multiple times when I began using this product that it smelled. I can describe the smell as earthy with a touch of fishy smell; kind of like wet soil that’s been sprinkled with omega 3 fish supplements. I know that may sound disgusting, however, please don’t let that deter you from trying this out if you have issues with dry skin. I am planning to get the travel-size Caudalie Beauty Elixir and see if that can take the edge off the smell. If I do decide to do this, I’ll update this review.

reviews.review_text: I hesitate buying this since I have had acid peel facials in the past and those are intense. Even though 7% is not nearly as much as getting a peel, I was still a bit scared. However, I don’t really like using physical exfoliants since the smoothness afterwards only lasts so long. I bought this just to try it since the price point and reviews are great.Needless to say I like this product! I use this at night, and sometimes with 2% salicylic acid, and it does a great job in keeping my skin smooth for the whole day (and starting off my day with a smooth canvas) keeping the cystic acne away. I also used this every other day at first since I wanted to ease myself in using this.I do also use sparingly on my cotton round and it is enough to cover my face and neck. You don’t need much.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_title: Impressive retinol for skin used to it.
reviews.review_text: With my first tube almost finished, I feel confident and comfortable with expressing my thoughts with this product:I have tried this and another retinol that I bought from Amazon (Tree of Life). I feel that the Inkey list is far superior in performance and stronger than the ToL one, I even feel it working throughout the day. I even received compliments on my skin after a few weeks of using it (even when wearing masks). Since I used this during Covid times, I rarely wore makeup and I felt this retinol product was an important part of my routine to look acceptable makeup-free. This may have softened and smoothed lines around my eyes. I also like the fact that a little dab of this stuff goes a long way (even spreadable down to my neck). Finally, the price is super awesome and affordable! For these reasons, I gave this product 5 stars.However, I do think that this retinol is a bit strong for people beginning with using retinol in their face routine. I can see this irritating skin new to retinol users, so I am happy to have used ToL as an introduction to retinol and then take it up notch with Inkey list. I don’t think I would have given this product 5 stars if I were new to retinol. The texture of this product is nice with a touch (I mean a super-light touch) of grittiness (that easily melts and gets into a smooth consistency after a few seconds in contact with my body heat). I am somewhat sensitive tactile-wise, so I do notice little things like this. In no way I’m saying that this product exfoliates; I still do use exfoliants in my routine. It also has a hint of sugar cane-like smell. It also looks like a bit of condensed milk. I have absolutely no idea if there is a correlation with those little details, but this product gives me a bit of a sugary sensory experience.

I wasn’t blown away though by this cleanser, so I don’t see myself buying a full size bottle.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I read so many good things about niacinamide and what it can do for your skin.  So when I noticed that The Ordinary offered a very inexpensive Niacinamide serum, I couldn’t resist.  Unfortunately, I am one of those people whose skin reacted negatively to this product.  I love the price and the texture!  But it causes breakouts along my cheeks, forehead and jawline.  When I stop using it, my skin starts clearing up within a couple days.  I’m pretty sure it’s because of the niacinamide, but I’m not sure if the concentration is just too high for me or if my skin simply hates that ingredient.  I did contact Deciem and was told that “with any active ingredient that affects skin behaviour, there can be an initial purging period during which breakouts are normal.“  Not sure if I will try this serum again or return it.  If I do give it another shot, I will try slowly introducing it back into my routine by only using a little at night once a week and then gradually increasing.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for a few weeks now. I wear it at night as part of my nightly skin care routine. If you like vanilla scents, this product is spot on. You don’t need to use a lot of product so the amount you get for the price is worth it.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample and was able to make it last about 2 weeks. I used it as part of my night time routine. It is nice and thick and ultra moisturizing. I like the fact that it doesn’t spread. It takes a little time to absorb but again I used it at night so it didn’t matter. I have combination skin with an oily t-zone. I haven’t had any problems with breakouts or irritation. I would buy the larger size but I prefer the Belief moisturizing eye bomb which is similar in size and price. Although I do like the product I wasn’t moved enough to make a switch.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this as a reward. My current full size moisturizer is Farmacy’s honey drop lightweight moisturizer but since I received this I’ve been using it everyday. I’m a nurse and normally by the end of my shift my face is so oily. This keeps me matte and hydrated all day. I feel like it tightens my skin and reduces visibility of my pores. There is a scent to this product but I find it clean and pleasant, almost medicinal. I logged on today to purchase the full size because I like it more than the the honey drop moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I have oily skin so i was nervous to use this toner since it is for dry skin. However, This toner is a lightweight moisturizer. It is thicker than most toners, it has a lotion consistency. My skin feels soft and refreshed after applying it. The scent is amazing but very subtle. A little goes a long way, if you use too much it can get sticky. A problem I had is I didn’t know how to apply it. Since it was a toner I assumed you needed to pour it on a cotton pad but it just absorbed into the cotton. I just started pouring it into my hands and rubbing it on my face. There needs to be instructions on the bottle. I would recommend. I’ve been using it for over a month and I have a ton of product left. I received this product for free to provide an honest review.

It’s supposed to be a morning moisturizer but I have to use it at night if I don’t want to be greasy. This is definitely meant for people with dry skin. I received this product complimentary for an honest review.

reviews.review_text: This is amazing! I had a makeup remover in balm format before trying this but this is so much better and more practical with the pump. I like to do a full face most days and this removes everything without making my eyes irritated. Gifted by Dermalogica

reviews.review_text: the packaging is really cute and the shade is gorgeous. I like how smoothly it goes on but it seems to not moisturize afterwards? My lips feel just as dry after so I have to reapply throughout the day. gifted by Fresh

reviews.review_text: I like this serum a lot, but I haven’t seen a significant difference in my skin as I haven’t used long enough but in terms of immediate results, the skin feels plump and smooth. The packaging is cute too.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Wonderful sunscreen, this is exactly what I have been looking for in a sunscreen for me!! I just love how glowy this is, it blends so nicely on the skin, smells heavenly and even helps even my skintone!? Yes please!

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum

reviews.review_text: I have never been so pleased with a moisturizer. I started using it morning and night and find that it does an amazing job at repairing my skins barrier during the colder months. My favorite part is that it includes peptides.

reviews.review_text: We are going into the new year GLOWING!I finally received these dew drops complimentary from glow recipe and i was so excited i immediately had to put them on my skin. I of course wanted maximum glow so i used the drops to accentuate my highlight and add even more of a glow to the high points of my face. These left my skin glowing! They smell like watermelon which i enjoy and though it is slightly sticky at first application it goes away quickly (this wouldI really like the texture of these drops! I definitely feel that the sticky feeling at first application would be so good under makeup. The sticky feeling did go away quickly and absorbed amazingly into my skin without making it feel tacky. Going in i was nervous because i haven’t enjoyed many of the other watermelon products in their collection but it is safe to say that as a first impression i am OBSESSED!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am always looking for a great nourishing cream to prep my skin for makeup that isn’t too heavy and won’t break me out. This cream is not only formulated with amazing ingredients but it gives me such a nice hydrated and smooth base to work with when doing my makeup. I 12/10 recommend!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: With the winter weather comes harsh winds which usually causes my skin to become red and irritated very easily! This mask not only soothes my skin and helps with any redness but it makes my skin feel so soft and ready to concur the cold!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Dermalogica Sampljng I am not one to like exfoliating powders as they can be rough on my combination skin but this one just changed the game for me! The creamy foaming consistency, the smoothness of my skin. I really do love this exfoliant.

I was curious about this one since I’m a huge fan of the brand. It’s good. I also use the ordinary serum (Hyaluronic Acid and B5) they don’t mix well. My skin burns, so I choose to not use them together. Over all it’s good. For a product that you really don’t need the price is a bit high.

reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product! It feels amazing. My skin feels more clear, my husband has been using it as well and I can see the difference. I use supergoop spf, so I was confused in the beginning how to incorporate it because the spf is matte and this has a glow, if I use it before the spf the spf kind of wipes the glow, so I started mixing both and it works amazing! I definitely recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: This takes off every bit of makeup and leaves my face completely clean. The exfoliating side is a bit rough for my sensitive skin, but those who might like that hard apricot scrub feel may like it.

reviews.review_text: Bought second bottle - love this cream; I have a very sensitive nose but the scent of this is light enough. Its very moisturizing and hydrating. Its thick without being sticky. This is going to be a staple for me(I have dry skin)

reviews.review_text: This is the Mecca of sunblocks I feel. I have tan skin and tan very easily. This definitely keeps me protected and it just feels so good on my skin

reviews.review_text: This cleaned my pores very well after I removed my makeup. It also is a good pair with the  moisturizer, them together made my skin look fresh and glow. I tested this product free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I love this product! It felt so nice on my skin. It made my face look fresh and glowy. The smell was also nice. I tested this product free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is super moisturizing! I love how cooling it feels on my eyes I love to add this to my night time skin routine! I received this product complementary from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use this product EVERYDAY! My face feels amazing after using this product in conjunction with the exfoliation treatment and the daily foaming wash. The moisturizer can be a bit tingly in some areas for me especially after doing the mask, but it still feels amazing. I feel like my skin feels tighter (in a good way) since using this product and it definitely feels smoother (texture-wise). The moisturizer is thick and works well to hydrate my DRY SKIN, but this means that I have to wait longer to start my makeup in the morning (time for it to soak in), but it is totally worth it. The texture, in this product and in the other two,  is good but I do wish the cleanser was a little more foamy ( but thats just my preference). My favorite thing about this moisturizer is the smell. It smells fruity but not overwhelming me as if I was covered in juice. By itself this product is amazing, but with the others it is so much better!  I was sent this product by Influenster in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: On the first night that I used this cream, I woke up to the nicest face feeling I have had in a very long time. I tend to use daily moisturizers from Neutrogena just out of habit but I will definitely be switching. The smell and feel of the moisturizer is amazing. I’m trying to find a downside, but I can’t seem to come up with anything!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin so I have to wear moisturizer after a shower or else my skin feels dry and tight all day. The first night that I used this cream, I woke up to the nicest face feeling I have had in a very long time. The smell is amazing if you like a cucumber-y and flower smell. The feel of it is great also. The first time I tried it I put way to much and it felt sticky and wet. I’ve been using it for about a week and I already have better feeling skin. Like some other users, I did break out a bit, but the benefits outweigh the small tiny pimples I got for a couple days.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I am loving this product, I have always suffered from hereditary dark circle ever since a very young age. I have tried all kinds of brand creams but finally I found combinations of eye cream I can use that helps brighten the dark circle, this product being one of them. Of course, I haven’t come across i product that completely diminishes dark circles but products like this has helped. I like the feeling and I wake up with smoother eyes. I highly recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I recently started using DE products and I must say it has really improved my skin tone, it feels much more brighter and healthier. Lala has become an important part of my skin regimen. It make my skin feel smoother and I sometimes use it only to hydrate my skin. This would be my 2nd bottle, as I find the product runs out real quickly hence the deduction in one star for a pricey product the quantity seems less. Also, won’t be able to tell when the product is going to be over unless you really twist open the bottle. It would be nice to actually being able to see how much product you have left so you can order before running out. Otherwise, I like really the product itself.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: One of my favorite products, I can’t live with out this one. Helps with dryness, and tightness. I use it daily as part of my moisturizing routine. Definitely provides with the hydration needed especially with winter coming I super excited to see how it plays out. I’ve been using this for 3 months now and noticed great difference with my skin.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Just like all the DE products, I thought this lip balm would be great but it wasn’t any different from a regular chapstick. Not very hydrating as I had expected and I found myself applying my other chapsticks. The texture just doesn’t feel great and seems more so drying.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: i got this as a gift in the power juice set. it’s a good product! i don’t really have acne spots but was hoping this would help more to even out my skin tone as i do have uneven skin. this product works pretty well in doing so but if you’re looking for something to just even out your skin tone and not lighten dark spots directly i would go with the olehenriksen balancing force toner. it worked a bit better for me making my skin appear all one tone. but this is still a great product! i didn’t see an astounding difference while using this but it did help with wrinkles as i am a long time smoker (ik yuck) so i believe it does what it says it will do i just prefer the balancing toner.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: i like this product a lot. a little goes a long way for me as i have oily prone skin. i definitely feel like it makes my skin brighter and gives my skin a nice glow. it also makes my skin feel very smooth! i do wish it was also an SPF but that’s asking a lot out of a product. i do have to be careful not to extend this to my under eye as i’m not sure why but it gives me an allergic reaction in that area and makes my under itch like crazy. other than that i love this product and will continue using!

reviews.product_name: Mini Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this about 3 weeks and I love it! It makes my skin bouncy, vibrant and my pores are nearly invisible. I noticed a difference with the first use. I got the tiny size but I’ll definitely be purchasing the full size!

reviews.review_text: Before I try it I was worried because other makeup removers I’ve tried leaves my skin dry and even doesn’t feels “clean”. But Farmacy throw away all the worries. Besides that, the fact that this makeup remover is totally green and will leave your skin with true results blows me away. This is a MUST on everyones skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: I abaolutely love this retinol. For me, it’s worth every dollar. My dark spots diminished within a week of use. HINT: I use it mixed with B-Hydra moisturizer and leaves my skin nourished, soft and fabulous when I wake up in the mornings. ANOTHER HINT: I use it every other day because is very strong and if I use it every night my skin gets burned. Be careful with it. Besides that, is a MUST on your skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I really really like this product! The consistency is great and a little goes a long way. I use this at night after I cleanse and use a retinol. I can feel it take my skin from dry to very moisturized. It works into the skin effortlessly. I received this complimentary from Influenster, but once I run out I will be purchasing more.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_title: Packed with moisture for your lips
reviews.review_text: I find myself liking everything from Belif. This lip mask is no difference. It definitely gives the moisture promised. With the weather changing and getting cooler, I find myself not just using it at night. Great product! I received this sample free from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I really liked this moisturizer. I received it complimentary to test and I was a bit nervous throwing a new product into my already established routine. I’m happy to say that I had no side effects from introducing this product into my regular routine. I like the consistency of the product. It blends well into my skin. It has left my skin feeling smooth and well moisturized. I really like it!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love the reformulation of shiseido sunscreen without oxybenzone and octinoxate. Reef safe!! The texture is very fluid and easy to spread. But that’s all ends up there. Once it applied on my face, the oily film just couldn’t go away after an hour. Definitely not a good makeup base if you apply foundation. Maybe okay for the body. FYI, the Asian version is totally different than this. It’s called Perfect UV Protector SPF50 PA+++. Goes on smooth and no whitecast.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I’m so grateful that the new version gets rid of the oxybenzone, which is harmful for coral reef and our skin. The stick is transparent, not whiteish at all. It glides on my face easily. I can apply before and over makeup with no problem. Looks tiny in a tube but it actually contains 20 grams. Hope it lasts throughout the summer. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: This essence is a gold standard to beauty industry. It looks like water — just like the rest — but this formula is packed with the proprietary Pitera complex. Pitera was discovered when scientists realized that Japanese sake makers had ageless hands. Now, a similar yeast and fermentation process is used to create the vitamin and mineral-rich ingredient that stars in many SK-II products.

It’s hard to find a great retinol eye serum that doesn’t irritate my skin. Sunday Riley did it! It’s gentle yet effective to lighten my discoloration and fine lines around the eyes. Plus, niacinimide is the perfect pair for retinoids. The formation is really one of the best!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: For those with dry and sensitive skin. The cream-gel formula is infused with floral extract, soothing algae, shea butter, and glycerin to lock in moisture while you snooze away. Come morning, you’ll wake up to plumper, dewier skin. My face looks brightening and even out after using it. The product was sent for free by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Bobbi Brown vitamin enriched vitamin is one of the most raved about makeup product of the moment. This advanced, oil-free moisturizer and primer is rich but never feels greasy. Formulated with shea butter, it hydrates, softens, and cushions skin for smooth makeup application. Bobbi Brown Vitamin Enriched Face Base comes in a beautiful glass jar with a twist-off cap, and this my friends is my only complaint. The packaging while beautiful and elegant is also very prone to contamination.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Retinol is almost always the answer to pretty much any skin issue — acne, fine lines, dark spots, drooping, dullness, dark circles, enlarged pores. I am glad I found this excellent over-the-counter retinoid that meet all my needs. The percentage of the retinol is about .3%, which is perfect for entry level and not too weak for long time users. The texture is so creamy and emollient in the winter time. My skin texture is definitely smoother and baby-skin like after one month. Highly recommended.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Retinol is almost always the answer to pretty much any skin issue — acne, fine lines, dark spots, drooping, dullness, dark circles, enlarged pores. I am glad I found this excellent over-the-counter retinoid that meet all my needs. The percentage of the retinol is about .3%, which is perfect for entry level and not too weak for long time users. The texture is so creamy and emollient in the winter time. My skin texture is definitely smoother and baby-skin like after one month. Highly recommended.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I’m so excited that glow recipes came out their sunscreen. This hybrid sunscreen has both chemical and mineral uv filters. Zinc oxide is a very stable uva filter that also great for sensitive skin. The only thing that I’m concerned is the watermelon fragrance. It burned my eyes as soon as I put it on. Not sure if it’s the active ingredients or the scent that causing the burning. Such a bummer coz it’s a very elegant sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Eye balm is great for dry undereyes. The patented alguronic acid helps to reduce fine lines and wrinkles. And Algae is a great antioxidant and trending ingredient that fighting aging skin. The texture is super smooth. It glides over my undereyes easily. I hope my eyes looks brighter and firmer. Gifted by Algenist.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This new lip Balm utilizes moisturizing and barrier-supporting natural ingredients like prickly pear oil and sea succulent extract. Over time, that stronger barrier means even dryness-prone lips hold onto moisture more effectively. Gifted by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the tea scent in this serum. It contains my favorite ingredients like niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. The texture is very milky and creamy. It is not clear serum like others. I feel very hydrated after using it.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: The Peace Out Acne Healing Dots are flecked with 0.5% salicylic acid, which we all know by now is a breakout’s worst nightmare. It fights the acne causing bacteria and dirt. I also love it has calming and soothing ingredient like aloe vera. My acne definitely was getting smaller the next day. And it kinds of act like a shield between my foundation and skin.I love it.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is a pretty purple color, and smells amazing. It absorbs pretty quickly for me, and doesn’t feel greasy; I haven’t noticed any increase in breakouts either. I have noticed an improvement of the overall texture of my skin, but no changes in fine lines or pigmentation; however, I’ve only been using this for about a week!I received this product complimentary for testing purposes, but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this serum! It has improved the tone and texture of my skin in just one week, and it doesn’t burn when applied (however, I don’t have sensitive skin). Overall, I’d definitely recommend giving it a try!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have acne-prone skin that’s oily during the warmer months and combination during colder months, and this serum doesn’t irritate my skin or increase my breakouts. It’s decently moisturizing for summer for me, but I need a thicker moisturizer during the winter months. I like to mix this with the C-firma DE serum.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I have oily, acne-prone skin, and this sunscreen works well for me. I prefer physical sunscreens, so was excited to try this; it does take some effort to rub in and let absorb before applying makeup to avoid a harsh white cast. I also have fair skin that’s prone to developing sun spots/melasma, and I use this year-round to keep my skin tone even.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I have acne-prone skin that tends to hyperpogment, so I was excited to try this brightening serum. Although I can’t say that I’ve noticed a significant difference compared to less expensive antioxidant serums, the scent and texture of this are pleasant; it has a light citrusy scent and gel-like consistency. It doesn’t make me break out or make my face feel sticky, but it doesn’t sit well under some of my other products/makeup and pills with some. Overall, it’s a decent antioxidant serum, but I’ll probably be sticking to my previous brands.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I wish that this contained only chemical exfoliants because I feel that the physical components are a little harsh, but it did leave my skin feeling a little smoother. I probably wouldn’t buy it again given the cost per ounce, but it was fun to try.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I wish that this contained only chemical exfoliants because I feel that the physical components are a little harsh, but it did leave my skin feeling a little smoother. I probably wouldn’t buy it again given the cost per ounce, but it was fun to try.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a 1-week sample of this to test. Although this isn’t enough time to determine wrinkle efficacy, I did notice improvement in the moisturization of my skin, which did slightly improve my texture. It didn’t irritate my skin or make me break out. I’m not sure that it’s worth the hefty price tag, but it’s difficult to say without prolonged use!

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I received a 1-week sample of this to test. reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This SPF is lightweight, non-greasy, and blends easily. It doesn’t leave a white cast, and didn’t irritate my skin or make me break out. It wears well under makeup for me, and I love that it’s broad spectrum. It does have a fragrance, which is the only negative for me.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I love how easily this SPF stick glides on! It’s perfect for face touch ups throughout the day, and it’s very portable. It’s non-greasy feeling and doesn’t leave a white cast. The only thing that I could do without is the fragrance - it’s not unpleasant, but I don’t think it’s necessary either.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I have constant dark circles, and also suffer from melasma. I had been using both an eye cream and antioxidant serum in my eye area for both these issues, but then I found this product! It saves me a step, and I feel like it’s improved the look of my under eye area as well. The tint is pretty sheer, but I’ve been forgoing my usual undereye concealer recently thanks to this eye cream!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is easy to apply and doesn’t feel greasy at all! It absorbs quickly and feels hydrating. I have combination, acne-prone skin, and it doesn’t make me break out. I also love that it has a slight tint, because it doesn’t leave a white cast on my skin. It also works well with makeup. It does have a light fragrance that’s not overpowering. Overall, I’d definitely recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This SPF absorbs quickly and does not feel greasy on my skin; the hyaluronic acid makes it feel hydrating. It does have a light scent that’s not overpowering. It doesn’t leave a white cast on my skin at all. I wish that it came in a much larger size, however - I’ll use this up it just a couple applications!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample. I was able to use it for almost a week with the amount I received so that was nice. Unfortunately, this product is nothing more than a sub-par lip balm. Instructions read to apply liberally and wipe of in AM. I woke up with lips that felt like I had not slept in anything. Two stars because it was a nice balm but does not deliver as it implies. Bummer. :/

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Holy grail for oily skin. I cannot recommend it enough and every person I introduce this to gets hooked. I’ve purchased this over and over and I can’t imagine living without it

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I love this so much I hope I never have to live without it

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: I love adding these to my moisturizer and lotion. My only small complaint is the smell of general self tanner and that it doesn’t last as long as I’d like. But I haven’t found anything better so I am happy with results. Will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This feels good on my undereyes but I don’t see much for results.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this brand so much, it has really transformed my skin. I can’t say enough good things. Love that this serum is 15% vit c. Will repurchase over and over.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_title: Smells like a park rangers b*tthole but works
reviews.review_text: I love this oil and the results but boy howdy do it stank like a long sweaty weekend in the woods

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: After my first application, I did not like this mask. It did nothing, or so I thought. So, I stuck it in a drawer and thought, “eh, I’ll use it eventually.” Well, 2 months later I decided to use it when my skin needed some help with texture. Well shocker!!!!! I woke up and my skin was sooooo soft! It felt amazing! So I used it again and same results. Stick it out with this product and you just might be surprised! Don’t forget not to use too many active ingredients underneath!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum smells like a can of farts but I love the way it makes my skin feel. Minus one point for the aroma otherwise it’s amazing.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: As a Derm nurse, I rarely venture far from the ol’ reliables (cetaphil, cerave, laroche posay) however this scrub is absolutely incredible. My skin feels so insanely clean and soft after using. I only use it perhaps once per week or once every other week due to the grit in rotation with my usual cleanser. I look forward to using this cleanser and I have never opened the app so quickly to order anything as I did after using a sample of this for the first time. I don’t feel that this is too rough on skin and doesn’t break down the barrier and yet somehow it leaves me feeling so exfoliated and fresh. Can’t recommend enough.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Despite seeing so many positive reviews and influencers using this product - I saw very minimal difference that does not match the price point here. I personally feel that the make up by Mario skin perfector did a much better job at what this product was trying to accomplish.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: A wonderful essence! Feels so great on me skin! I just think it’s overpriced.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: A wonderful essence! Feels so great on me skin! I just think it’s overpriced.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is a pretty good moisturizer. It’s not occlusive enough for “slugging” but is is still thick enough to be your nighttime moisturizer/cream.￼

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I like to use this product at night because even though it turns “ Beige” it just stays on top of the skin like Semi-slugging thing. So Putting it on before bed for its anti-redness, in my case rosacea, benefits make this work and not a problem.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I like to use this product at night because even though it turns “ Beige” it just stays on top of the skin like Semi-slugging thing. So Putting it on before bed for its anti-redness, in my case rosacea, benefits make this work and not a problem.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: This feels like a dream and smells like grapes. I love mine.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This is probably my favorite product by this line that I’ve tried I really like how finely milled the physical exfoliating particles are and I like that is a physical and chemical exfoliant simultaneously.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This is probably my favorite product by this line that I’ve tried I really like how finely milled the physical exfoliating particles are and I like that is a physical and chemical exfoliant simultaneously.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This has a lovely texture. Is a tiny bit thinner in viscosity than the average serum but feels very nice on the skin.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a very thick serum and it’s quite tingly. But my skin was noticeably softer the next morning.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I love a cream with ceramides in it, it’s so good for the skin’s barrier. A little bit of this goes a long way. This was less thick than the average cream I’d say.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I couldn’t stop washing my face with this cleanser....literally kept washing it over and over just to inhale the amazing spa like herbal fragrance - it was a therapy in itself! Amazing! I am 37 and have oily skin and wash my face with soap to get that clean feeling but this took the oils off but did not leave my skin dry afterwards ...usually I would wash with soap and put on moisturizer immediately after to compensate for the dryness... this is MUCH more luxuries then any soap or cleanser I used!  Wow!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: The best but the lady on the promo video is not using it exactly right. There is an Asian double cleansing method/ritual and she should be massaging this balm all over her face and then removing it with water followed by a second cleanse with this balm or something else.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: The best but the lady on the promo video is not using it exactly right. There is an Asian double cleansing method/ritual and she should be massaging this balm all over her face and then removing it with water followed by a second cleanse with this balm or something else.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: Being of European decent this mask cannot possibly duplicate any “Cold plunges “ anywhere. The Banya ritual is very familiar to me and this mask did not feel cold or even refreshing on my skin not on not after washing it off ... performance is also lacking ... hyped up for no reason at all. On the other hand their Sauna Scrub is fantastic!!!!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Yes. My lips were cracked and weathered and this is all I needed. Put it on overnight and it was great. No more lip stinging...smell is divine ahhh

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: Good solid cream. Can be used on your whole face or hands if you prefer.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Yes get it. Acne Oily Skin needs exfoliation and gentle acids. This will do.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: This creams brings back my childhood in Europe
reviews.review_text: Sooo nice! This cream brings me back to my childhood in Europe. It smells just like TURBO bubble gum if anyone ever had it as a kid they will know. The cream itself is AMAZING. Makes my skin SO soft and I have super oily skin that requires blotting at least 10 times a day. This is wonderful and not greasy at night. If anything it will balance your skin so your skin will produce less oil. Just love, love, love, love, love, love !!!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Have been using this serum for over a week now. There is no burn feeling, it smells like nice summer hay grass. I live in a country and I can definitely tell you it’s made with grass and flowers essences. I read a lot of reviews on here from I’m assuming young adults in their 20s that say this “ burns“ theirs skin. Please please understand that this has AHA acids and if you have fresh young skin and trying to use anti-aging products such as this serum because you think you need it - you’re in for a surprise. This is not for you. This is for people that can handle an exfoliating treatment serum because they actually need it to keep their skin clear and exfoliated due to various skin conditions such as acne or oily and rough skin. But if you’re going to purchase this because you think it’s cool and leave negative reviews on here - don’t bother. This is excellent serum. It is very moisturizing for mature almost 40sh skin. It is not sticky at all. It has great natural smell. Its light and super absorbent. It works. I love it.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Very hydrating lip balm. I use this during the day (and a lip mask as night.) Does not feel greasy or heavy,  and I have seen a reduction in lip lines.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A MUST have for mature skin. I ran out after several months of daily use and noticed a difference in my skin. 1 pump covers my entire face and neck. Not greasy or reactive with my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I was concerned with the Vit C to use around my eyes, but I’ve had no reactions. My dark circles are lighter and skin around my eyes is hydrated. Half a pump will cover both my eyes.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Fell in love with this line and will be back for more products. Hydrating, luxurious, I use it as a pick me up or overnight mask.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Fell in love with this line and will be back for more products. Hydrating, luxurious, I use it as a pick me up or overnight mask.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Absolutely the best cleanser, removes all trace of eye make up, including liner and mascara. I have sensitive skin and using a daily multi step product was drying me out. I’ve been able to switch to only this product.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This was a repurchase, I use this with other DE products and alone, on my face, neck, chest and the tops of my hands daily.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_title: Best retinoid product for sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: I have been a DE user for about a year and saw a tremendous transformation in my sensitive skin. I was hesitant about using a retinol product, but decided to give this a try. I mix it nightly with the TLC Framboos and I’ve seen an improvement in the texture and pores size of my skin on the face, neck and chest.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this product!! I use it as an overnight cream on top of my pm skincare routine, especially under my eyes. Hydrating, refreshing and so luxurious, I bought the mini for a trip and repurchased a second tube as well.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this product!! I use it as an overnight cream on top of my pm skincare routine, especially under my eyes. Hydrating, refreshing and so luxurious, I bought the mini for a trip and repurchased a second tube as well.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: Started this product and I’m seeing some immediate depuffing.  Dark circles are less, I use a pea sized amount every morning all over the eye area, very refreshing.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I got this in a kit for the VIB holiday sale. It came with a large Berry (The OG) and a Vanilla, Apple Lime, and Grapefruit(I think) minis and they are so fabulous! I keep the big one on my vanity, One at the office, one in my purse, and in my bathroom. I know they are suppose to be sleeping mask but they are great anytime you need them. If I put it on before bed I wake with plump hydrated lips. I know it isn’t marketed as a lip plumper but anytime your lips are well hydrated they will be larger. A little goes a long way and it comes with a little scoop which is wonderful. Very curious to try their balm in a tube =)

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely gel moisturize. I love that DE really cares about the ingredients they put into their products. A lot of moisturizers on the market contain silicone which tend to make your skin feel soft and silky but really it prevents absorption of any good ingredients into the skin. This actually feeds my skin instead of masking it. I use this as my AM moisturizer as I lean oily. Its thin gel consistency is perfect for me for daytime wear under my makeup. I have been using the whole line in conjunction with my tretinoin cream (prescription retinol) I notice a huge difference in my skin when I use these products my skin is smoother, brighter, radiant, and glowy. I swear by DE and highly recommend it; Get a sample, try it for yourself. Skin care is one of those not one size fits all kinda deal so I cant say it will be your holy grail but it sure is mine!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I use this but I also use Tretinoin (Cant recommend it enough life changing) The top layer of my skin sheds pretty much constantly I am not sure if this product has a lot to do with it because it is a side effect of Tretinoin too. but when I use this I can get a better result after cleansing. Placing makeup on top of peeling skin is difficult and this helps to loosen those cells for a seemly foundation application. An AHA BHA did make a difference in my skin texture prior to starting tretinoin just not as dramatic with it. I have not tried DE retinol but it does seem to have a high parentage of Vit-A which is the active ingredient in Retinoids so you may want to try that if you cant get a prescription.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This product is strong. DO NOT leave this on too long. I would recommend test patching it on the jaw line to see if you are sensitive to it. I don’t have sensitive skin but sometimes (Not all the time) Its too much for me. I like it and it works well but its hard to tell when I will and when I wont react to it. Keep it away from the skin around your eyes. Sometimes it dries me out and make my skin leathery feeling. When it doesn’t react it works beautifully I avoid using my retinol or TLC on the days I use this product. Its a great AHA/BHA mask just don’t over do it a little goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: This is great for those days when your not wearing any makeup. It adds a beautiful bronze glow to your complexion you can add as much as you need. I was worried it wouldn’t suit me as I am a fair baby when I am not using my loving tan. This also lays over my self tanner and gives me a beautiful lit from within glow.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This is a lovely lip balm it feels moisturizing but not sticky. I know the ingredients are good its not masking capped lips its actually treating them!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical about this product. I figured it couldn’t be that great it only has one oil in it. This product pleasantly surprised me. I had just started tretinoin prior to buying the DE the trunk which this product came in. My skin was going through that rough starter stage where it was so dry and painfully I was peeling like a dragon lady. It was so soothing and felt so good on my skin. Anytime my skin feels a little dry or is slightly irritated this is my go to. I put this on and wake up to normal. I add a few drops to my skincare cocktail. I assumed wrong and this will always be in my arsenal!

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I know this is an allure beauty winner and its clean and good for your skin but I just don’t love the way it sits on my skin. I use the DE line for my skin care I am not putting this on top of any product contain silicone. If feels like it just sits on top and leaves me feeling greasy. I have oily skin been leaning more combo since I started tretinoin and the DE line. I hate feeling greasy and oily! I got it in the Trunk so I cant return it will use on days I plan to be in the sun a lot. Maybe it would work better for someone normal to dry skin. I will use it and lose it!

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really like this product. I have also used Clinique take the day off balm and the Farmacy balm for reference. I like this one because it’s a great first cleanse to remove my makeup effectively but also gently. I begin by take a nickle sized glob and gently messaging my eyes till my eye makeup dissolves and breaks down. I wear a lot of eye makeup on the daily including eyeliner, mascara, liquid liner, and extremely pigmented eye shadows, glitter glues, primers, lash glue all the good and difficult to remove stuff. then I spread the balm allover my face to break down my foundation before rising and going in with my second cleanse. I like that this product doesn’t leave that weird filmy look in my eyes that I have gotten with other products. I am also a huge fan of the gently exfoliating bamboo charcoal powder it comes with to help remove any dead skin.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: Winter is here and I actually made the mistake of stopping my Retin-A for a little bit which means my skin is super dry and flaky peely. >.< this has been a life saver. A skin rescue reviver! A great look starts with a great base and this can help get you there!

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love that this product is fragrance free and clean @sephora I like knowing every ingredient is beneficial and has a propose. This does a great job of smoothing and perfecting. Good dose of acids.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing, I got it in a holiday kit never knew about it before. Life changing, I don’t get pimples very often but when I do it’s bothersome nobody wants them and they always show up at the most inopportune times. I placed this on went to bed woke up and it was like it sucked it out of my face! Seriously, like magic. Idk how to really explain it you just have to try it!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: It’s not a terrible product the product itself may work very well it’s the application I just can’t get over. The stick is firm not very emollient so when you apply it it drags and tugs on the delicate skin under the eyes. I can apply to a finger and Pat under the eye but again it isn’t very emollient or creamy so I don’t feel like I’m getting a whole lot on my finger and rubbing my finger on it doesn’t really warm it up and make it more the way I want it to be. It’s a pass for me.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Sun screen is so important! I am almost 38 and I use retin A. Sun safety is top priority in a good skin care regimen. This one is fantastic, it is skincare and sun safety rolled into one. Sits beautiful on the skin, doesn’t cause my makeup to wear funny. I am a fan they also make a great SPF primer that I pair together.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream will instantly fix your dry winter skin. On days that my skin is flaky from the cold weather or just feels dry

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream will instantly fix your dry winter skin. On days that my skin is flaky from the cold weather or just feels dry

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: If you like gel moisturizers, this is a really nice option! I have normal, sensitive skin and I typically use Clinique Moisture Surge as my daytime moisturizer. I’ve been using Daily Greens every morning for the past week and I haven’t noticed any skin irritation or breakouts. It keeps my skin hydrated throughout the day without being heavy and it sits well under makeup. It has a herbal scent, but the scent doesn’t linger on my skin. I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this product for review complimentary from Glow Recipe. The concept of this product is very unique and I enjoy the product a lot--from the packaging, to the amazing watermelon scent, to the thick yet silky texture. I’ve used this product in the various ways Glow Recipe suggests, and I much prefer to use it as a daytime serum to get the full benefits of the ingredients as opposed to a “skin care highlighter“ on top of or mixed into makeup. It stays slightly tacky which makes a nice base for makeup--and there is a slight glow (not glitter/sparkle, just a natural glow) which is really nice as well.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: PreCleanse is a lightweight oil cleanser that’s perfect to remove makeup or sunscreen at the end of the day. It has a very thin texture & emulsifies into a milky consistency when you add a little water. I love the citrusy scent it has & that it doesn’t leave a residue. I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: PreCleanse is a lightweight oil cleanser that’s perfect to remove makeup or sunscreen at the end of the day. It has a very thin texture & emulsifies into a milky consistency when you add a little water. I love the citrusy scent it has & that it doesn’t leave a residue. I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This product is perfect for my dehydrated winter skin! It feels so soothing on my skin, and I love that you can either use it as a moisturizer or mask/treatment. I primarily use it as an evening moisturizer since my sensitive skin loves it.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: The Murad retinol is a gentle & effective retinol serum to incorporate into anyone’s skin care routine. It’s a nice creamy texture that feels nourishing on the skin. I love that it’s in an airless pump to keep the product fresh.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: The Murad retinol is a gentle & effective retinol serum to incorporate into anyone’s skin care routine. It’s a nice creamy texture that feels nourishing on the skin. I love that it’s in an airless pump to keep the product fresh.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is the perfect addition to my daytime skin care routine. It’s lightweight and sinks into the skin without pilling when layered. I found that my skin was less red & more resilient when using this serum. Also, the dropper seems like it’s not getting a lot of product, but it’s actually the perfect amount for a full face application.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_title: The perfect spf moisturizer. Love clean products!!
reviews.review_text: I am so freaking grateful that I can FINALLY finish my skin care regimen with a CLEAN spf moisturizer!!!! I did not realize how difficult it would be to find a clean one. Clean meaning all natural ingredients. No sulfates, silicones, parabens, synthetic fragrances, mineral oil and all other crap that isn’t natural!! The color and texture is a little off putting at first, though. Since it is a pale green paste. I thought it would look like that on my face. It didn’t!!! Thank goodness. It says that it turns into a beige color once you rub it in. Well I have light skin tone with cool undertones. So my skin is basically beige already. It doesn’t make my face look green, pale or pasty. Just looks like my skin. So I am not sure if this will match medium and dark skin tones but I definitely think it’s worth the try. Dr Jart also has a BB cream that is also clean with spf in different skin tones. So if this fails for someone, then they’ll atleast have another option that will work for them! The texture is a teeny bit grainy. This did not break me out at all and it’s hydrating! It does not feel oily on the skin or pasty. It feels like a regular moisturizer. I love it and am so grateful to Dr Jart for their natural products!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
