I love it and am so grateful to Dr Jart for their natural products!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this mask! I was looking for something to get rid of my blackheads and to keep acne away without stripping my face of essential moisturizer or rubbing toxic ingredients on it! I was surprised to find an all natural, vegan and cruelty free brand from Sephora. Though Herbivores prices are high, I still needed to try some of their products because I was having a very hard time finding any clean skin care at the drug store. I bought mask in the blue tansy facial oil and mask duo set and I loooove the Lapis oil in the set and I loved this mask, though I didn’t get enough of the mask to use more than 4-5 times. Thankfully the directions say to apply a thin layer. So I was able to spread it out to 4-5 uses. I didn’t follow the directions, sadly. I did the mask once a week instead of every other day for 5 days. I really wanted to make it last and not waste it but I feel if I had followed the directions, I would have gotten better, longer lasting results. However, everytime I used this mask it helped to heal acne scars, acne and cleaned a lot of blackheads out of my pores. It also evened my skin tone, hydrated and make my skin soft! I’ve also tried the prism mask and the brighten mask and I feel that the blue tansy gave me the best, immediate results. I have only tried trial sizes of the 3 masks though and I did not do any of them as frequently as the directions said to do them. I am going to buy this full size to really put the directions to the test and see what kind of results I will get. Since I switched to clean skin care, I haven’t gotten any acne and I have barely gotten any blackheads!!! Herbivores PHOENIX, Lapis and Emerald CBD oils are my favorite that I have tried! Their all amazing and I honestly don’t know which one is my top favorite. I have stopped using moisturizer since I have gotten them and I use a different one every day! I cannot wait to try some of Herbivores other products and it is going to take some time to do so given their high prices.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Great ingredients but it is missing hydration!!
reviews.review_text: I have mixed feelings about this product. I always look up ingredients on products I am new to trying to see if they’ll work for my skin. I have combination skin that leans on dry if I over do the facial masks (not hydrating ones) sometimes. Like clay masks (very drying on skin) more than twice a week. So I do want my cleansers and moisturizers to be very hydrating. I have also incorporated the Farmacy honeymoon serum into my skin care regimen about 3 weeks ago and have been using it 2-3 times a week, now twice with this cleanser. I was using a moisturizing cleanser with the Farmacy serum and now using this one in the past 2 weeks. The ingredients are ALL good for your skin!!!! Literally every single one!!! This is actually hard to find in a cleanser. Youth To the People has some really great products. When I first started using this cleanser my skin did feel a bit tight and I noticed some dry patches. I amped up using my hydrating masks during the first week and a heavier moisturizer at night and that seemed to be working so I continued to use those into the next week. I wanted to give it time because with any new product your skin needs to adjust. After two weeks I started to noticed the skin around my lips (that have been really dry and chapped during this winter) turn into scabs, which was very alarming. After I put my heavy moisturizer on it healed it up. This is chalk full of antioxidants which is great for your skin! I just think it is missing some moisturizing ingredients for balance. If this would contain hyaluronic acid or sodium hyaluronate it would be one of the best cleansers I have ever tried! I am going to continue to use it to see if my skin just needs to adjust more unless it makes it too dry.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I am SO disappointed in this being sold at Sephora!!!! I selected this as a sample with one of my orders. Totally my fault. I did not read the ingredients. I assumed they would all be great for my skin. I struggle with small blackheads from time to time and occasional acne. After getting my skin care routine in order it has really helped to balance out my skin and I have not gotten acne and only have occasional blackheads. So I like to use a charcoal or clay mask 1-2x a week to clean all of the sebum out of my pores. I think everyone should use a charcoal or clay mask atleast once a week-no matter what skin type you are!! Seeing that this mask had clay and volcanic ash made me really interested in trying it! I can honestly say I have never tried a product with volcanic ash. The mask was somewhat hard to apply to my skin. It was creamy but it was very dry. I was able to cover my entire face, I am just used to very creamy masks. Applying it to my face it actually felt grainy, which I was surprised about. It felt fine while I had it on for the 10 minutes. It did not burn or bother my skin at all. Once it came time to rinse it off was when I noticed a HUGE problem! It actually HURT to rinse off! It felt like tiny pieces of glass while rinsing my face!!! I have used exfoliating masks before like the Origins Rose clay mask that uses jojoba beads (very good ingredient for exfoliating!) I have also used sugar and coffee scrubs but realized that they are too harsh for skin. I went to look up the ingredients in this mask and it contains WALNUT SHELL POWDER!!!! That is HARSH on skin and it is no wonder it hurt my face while rinsing it off!!!! Through out the entire day my skin felt and looked inflamed, it burnt and it did feel like there were tiny scratches all over it!!! I used a moisturizing mask immediately afterward and layered on heavy moisturizer after that and again at night. I will NEVER use a mask with shell powder, sugar or coffee again!!!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: Feels like applying Elmers glue to my skin!!
reviews.review_text: What the heck?! This is the exact opposite than I thought it was going to be... I love the texture-it’s like a gel almost. It was easy to apply. There’s no scent, thankfully. It’s clear in color. Only, a few minutes after it dried it PEELED! What?! I felt and looked like I had just applied Elmers glue to my face! HECK NO! I bought this to use in conjunction with skin care and makeup-not on its own. I could never use this. What sucks is that it was so cheap that, starting a return is basically pointless but I am doing it anyway because is $6 that can be used on anything else! Very disappointed!! I may have received a bad batch but I just don’t feel like trying again with this. The only other Ordinary product I have tried is the lactic acid and that is a million times better and so worth it!!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I bought a deluxe sample size if this is a Farmacy mini set with the serum (that I love) and the honey mask I really like. At the time I was really struggling to find an effective and gentle facial cleanser. I was using a deluxe sample that I got of the youth to the people probiotic cleanser for 2 weeks and it made my face too dry. I was also using the Pacifica sea foam cleanser and that also made my face dry. It was terrible!! I was used to using the Cera Ve hydration cleanser for a year and even after switching to the organic cleansers for a few months, my skin just couldn’t stop feeling dry!! A cleansing balm sounded super gentle and I have actually never tried a cleansing balm before. I don’t wear makeup often at all and if I do it is organic. So I was planning on using it to only remove makeup but I was desperate for a cleanser! This is SO GENTLE and effective!!! Honestly, I could actually feel it removing blackheads! I’ve never felt a cleanser or scrub remove blackheads without stripping my skin of moisture!!!! It isn’t greasy or foamy. It’s literally like rubbing lip balm on your skin!! I love it so much and I am going to buy a full size since it is also organic and cruelty free!!!!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

I love it so much and I am going to buy a full size since it is also organic and cruelty free!!!!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: LOVE THIS STUFF!!! I read that this is an ultra gentle exfoliator and helps with acne and evening out skin tone!! I have acne prone, combo skin that is also prone to sensitivity. I was using the Farmacy honeymoon glow but with it containing lemon, it was stinging my skin and I believe that lemon causes more harm, than good! The first time I used this, I saw an immediate difference! My skin tone was completely even and my face was ultra clear! I did get a few minor zits but my blackheads were completely empty-FOR ONCE! With any exfoliator/mask, you are going to go through a purging process. Even if you were already using an exfoliator!! This has never stung or burnt my face! I use it in the evenings, after applying my hyaluronic acid (also from The Ordinary!) It has kept my skin clear and has evened out my skin completely! It also had gotten rid of my hyperpigmentation and acne scars!!! I feel that this is absolutely necessary in any skin routine-especially for sensitive skin!!

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this moisturizer everyday since I have purchased it, so far 2 weeks now and I am fairly impressed with it!!!! Since switching to organic and cruelty free products, I’ve had to build a new skin care routine. I’ve used organic products (I.e: skincare, hair care, makeup, etc.) for almost a year now and I have never been healthier, nor have I ever looked better!! I tried Herbivore and Farmacies moisturizers and they were a bit too heavy for my acne prone skin and would pile often. I was using FAB ultra repair and I love that moisturizer but using silicones wasn’t sitting right with me. The Ordinarys prices are unbeatable!! Seriously. So, there is never a doubt when I want to try one of their products. I love how their products contain few ingredients and only ingredients meant to help your skin!!! No chemicals, synthetic or natural fragrances (like essential oils, which cause breakouts)!! This is a perfect moisturizer!!! It doesn’t pile, it isn’t oily nor greasy. It blends perfectly with my skin care products and makeup! I love how light it is but still hydrating! I would recommend The Ordinary to anybody!!!!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Broke out my skin very badly
reviews.review_text: This gave me chronic, cystic acne with each use. I am very knowledgeable with skin care, so I thought that this cleanser would work very well for me. It’s made of natural ingredients and nearly every single one being good for skin! The only thing that it contains that aggravates skin is Rosa Damascena Flower Oil. I’ve had a moisturizer containing this ingredients break me out in the past (I suspected), so I guess this is the proof that I cannot use anything with that ingredient. I used this cleanser for 8 days and by the last day I was so desperate for the acne to stop that I decided to use one of my other cleansers (my Burt’s bees argan and coconut oil cleanser) and the acne started to heal IMMEDIATELY. My skin literally did a 180. So I decided to stop using this for good.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin with an oily T-zone and regular to dry cheeks. I have struggled with acne since my teen years and I am 29 years old now. I only get acne if I use products that contain ingredients that break me out. For instance, if a product contains rose oil and rose extract I’ll develope cystic acne immediately. I recently tried the Fresh soy face cleanser. After the first day of using it, I started getting acne. I thought maybe my skin was just purging or adjusting to it, so I continued use. Everyday I would get a new pimple and after 1 week I had cystic acne all over my face. It was terrible! The only reason I got a new cleanser was because I wanted a more hydrating one since the Youth to the People kale cleanser was extremely drying. It was the only new product in my regimen, so I decided to recheck the ingredients list and turns out I missed an ingredient it contains: Rose oil. I knew that was the culprit and discontinued use immediately. The next day after discontinuing use of the soy cleanser, my acne healed immediately. I still had acne scars, though and The Ordinarys Niamicide wasn’t cutting it in fading the scars. I applied a few drops of this to my skin before bed (and applied my usual moisturizer afterward: The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors) and when I woke up my skin looked much clearer. I waited around 4 days to use it again and the next morning I woke up, my skin was unbelievably clear! Farmacy honeymoon glow serum, Drubk Elephant glycolic serum a d Miranda replenishing peel does not compare to this. This is my holy grail!!!! Even the color of it in the bottle makes it look like magic-LOL! It is a strong percentage of lactic acid, though. So using it everyday is not an option. I am trying to figure out how often to use it. So far once every few days had worked. I do wish I had known there was a 5% of lactic acid or I would have started with that one first and worked my way up to this one. I recommend this to ANYONE!

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Unfortunately, the Marula oil clogged my pores
reviews.review_text: I have wanted to try this, a lot of DF products for a few years now. It took me months to finally work up the courage to pay the price for this cleanser/exfoliator duo. $34 is a LOT of money for someone like me. Someone who barely has money 24-7 but I care about my body and I thought that this was the best option after looking at all the cleansers out there. All of the ingredients are good in this cleanser. I thought that all of the ingredients wouldn’t clog my pores but unfortunately I missed one: Marula oil... I thought Marula oil was like argan oil-noncomedogenic but unfortunately it is a big pore clogger. After the first time I used this cleanser, I woke up with a zit. The 2nd time I used it, I got 3 more zits. In just 24 hours of using this cleanser twice, I got 4 white heads. Thankfully my skin will tell me immediately if something is it agreeing with it. After using products that contained rose oil, rose extract, geranium oil, geraniol, Rosa Damascena Flower Oil and got acne everytime.. I have learned the difference between skin positively purging and a bad reaction to a product, causing cystic acne. I have combination, dry cheeks and oily t-zone, acne prone skin and if you are prone to acne, don’t use this. The best cleanser I have ever used, that has never dried my skin out or gave me acne is the Andalou milk cleanser which also contains vitamin C and brightens my skin. I was only trying to find a nighttime cleanser so I wasn’t using vitamin C before my retinoid. I do think that The Ordinarys squalane cleanser is a better dupe of this one, for acne prone skin.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Lived up to its hype but tragic, high price point!
reviews.review_text: This really does live up to its hype!!! Which sucks all the more because of it’s ridiculous high, HIGH price tag!!! $85?! That’s a joke! But the results blew me away.. My face has never been this smooth, not even from a 100$ facial or from any facial product that I have ever used. I have been using acids for a year now. I started with mixed acids but my skin ended up getting along best with lactic acid. I did use The Ordinary’s 10% lactic acid for a few months, mostly because of its affordability but I wasn’t getting the results that I desired. So I tried to find a dupe for Good Genes since it is the most popular lactic acid on the market. I came across MUAC’s lac-luronic and I do love it. It’s a pretty fair price point of $29 (currently on sale for $24.65) for 15% lactic acid! It has nearly all the best ingredients (except for sodium hydroxide, which is a corrosive). It did give me great results and I would say that lac-luronic is the closest you could get as a dupe to Good Genes. A few hours after applying this serum for the first time, I noticed all of my pores calmly purging! I couldn’t believe how many blackheads were sticking out and popped out so easily!!! The next morning my skin was so incredibly smooth, I don’t think it’s been this smooth since I was a child!!!! My pores were completely empty and smaller and post acne scars were already fading! I got this as a sample and now I really want to purchase it but I don’t know if I’ll ever be able to afford to, sadly. Which is why I removed a star from my review. Also, this contains potassium hydroxide which is also a corrosive on skin but albeit, it is in most skin care so it is a hard ingredient to avoid. What really made me happy was that this did not cause any tingling or burning upon application, which I have found to be very common with most acids! I don’t need my acids to painfully tingle or burn my skin to know that they are working! So I am happy that this is comfortable to use!!!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_title: This is great-if you do not have oily skin
reviews.review_text: I do appreciate this moisturizer, it does contain really great ingredients and is very popular. I used it for a while on my face, including the rest of my body. Unfortunately I would wake up with a very oily t-zone every morning and it didn’t help with my acne but it did replenish my skin with hydration. Unfortunately, due to the high enough amount of glyceryl stearate se that it contains, it made my acne problematic skin worse.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this lip butter balm! The scent is so addicting and the applicator makes for clean, easy use. As always, Summer Friday’s has the most beautiful and clean packaging. I have used their products in the past and have never been disappointed. This product is fairly sized for the price and is super convenient to take with you on the go. I received this product complimentary from Summer Friday’s in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: What’s great product for lip hydration! I especially like that the color is buildable, with one layer it starts with a sheer tint and up to 3 layers you have a subtle color! Definitely makes my lips feel more hydrated and is easy to carry around with you. I especially like the twist on cap, I know it is a random thing to mention but that way I don’t have to worry about it opening while in my purse or traveling with it! I received this complimentary from Fresh! If you don’t want any color I would definitely recommend the clear option for the lip treatment benefits!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is great! It goes into the skin nicely with out any sticky texture and does not smell bad, It actually smells good! The bottle is very pretty and is a decently large size. For application, only a small amount of product is needed which means the bottle will last quite a long time. Can’t wait to see long term results!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I think Farmacy knocked it out of the park on this product! Not only is the packaging adorable, it is funcitonal! The lid to the jar is magentic, allowing you to always know where the applicator is! I thought this was a genius idea! I love how the moisturizer feels, it is very smooth and goes on the skin nicely. I like that it is thicker and will be using it before bed for extra hydration. It also smells so so good! Which is such an added bonus for the benefits it gives! This was gifted to me by Farmacy Beauty. I love Farmacy Beauty’s mission for sustainability and responsible, farm-sourced ingredients.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_title: I will be using this forever! Holy grail!
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this product!! It is SO easy to apply, no need to touch anything! I keep it right next to my bed and apply at night once I have washed my face and am laying in bed! All you do is swipe it under your eye and you are done! no need to rub it in! I think this definitely helps with my dedication to using the product, it definitely makes it easier not needing to apply in the bathroom near a sink etc! Perfect lazy skincare! And the results are great! I will be re-purchasing this for years to come I can already tell! Also, it is the size of a lipstick so easy to travel with too!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: Another great product from Drunk Elephant! I am obsessed with Vitamin C serums and I think that this one has taken the cake for me. I really like that you have to mix it once you get it home so that it is the most fresh serum possible! Some people might not prefer this method but I definitely do! I love that it makes my skin feel awake and hydrated! Application is super easy and the product last a long time. This was gifted to me by Drunk Elephant.

reviews.review_text: I love this plump cream from Glow Recipe! The packaging is super cute of course and I love that they offer refills of the cream instead of having to order a qhole new jar! Super sustainable, I love it! This cream works so well to make my skin feel nourished and hydrated. I love the subtle glow that it gives me and I think it makes a difference! Also, super glowy! This was gifted to me by glow recipe.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: #glowrecipegiftedme Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops -a new highlighting serum that is niacinamide infused but with a dewy glow. You can use it as a step before moisturizer, as a primer, or a mix in with makeup.⁣⁣The texture is lovely, light and easily absorbed. ⁣I like to use it as a primer, although I didn’t see any longer wear out of my foundation, I did notice how much more healthier my skin looked overall with it underneath my makeup. Because of the glowy property and the way it smoothed out the skin, it really amped up my makeup to look even better. ⁣⁣This is a convenient way to have skincare benefits and makeup enhancing properties in one.  Btw I applied this with my fingers and my foundation with a brush. I will continue to use it because it is an easy step in my skincare and morning routine.  @cut_abovethe_rest

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: My go to when my skin is feeling overwhelmed or irritated. I love how light this is in texture and how soothing it is.  I have allergies right now and my skin can start to react as well and this serum keeps everything so balanced. I love how hydrating it is but at the same time not so rich where it doesn’t clog up my pores. Can’t speak of this serum highly enough, a go to when I need some calm.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: First, let me tell ya the formula is the same! Yes that vegan formula we all know and love has not changed. Still that soft, buttery, yummy vanilla scent goodness that this lip balm is, is all the same. ⁣⁣⁣The tube is a bio-resin recyclable tube, the boxes are tree free, and a new applicator at tip. Now it’s easier than ever to control how much comes out of the tube, plus definitely easier application to the lips. ⁣⁣⁣⁣Vanilla beige shade is oh so gorgeous! Literally it’s exactly the shade I go for when I apply a lip liner and a balm on top, but now the perfect one and done! ⁣⁣Sheer but a hint of color! This will be your holy grail!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: We all know retinol is the best studied skin care ingredient known to help with aging, especially since the eye area is so delicate it will start to age sooner. I was hesitant to start a retinol for under the eyes as it can be irritating on the face, so I was a bit skeptical to begin with. This is a night time treatment and in serum form which I love! It immediately soaks in. I’ve noticed depuffing and all around tightening under my eyes. I started with literally the smallest pearl size dab under my eyes, and only 2 days a week so my eyes could adjust and if I got a reaction. I have had no issues with irritation and have built up to 3-4 days a week. Will consistently use this as my eye cream and look for results when it comes to wrinkle prevention. Very happy that there is a sensitive retinol option for my eyes!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Pretty happy with this vegan oil, I would definitely say it helps in removing that first layer of makeup. I don’t have a Dermalogica cleanser, I just used a cleanser that I had and I’m happy with results. No this oil did not remove all my makeup, it did well on my face makeup but not so well on my eye makeup. But after going in with a cleanser it did help take off most of my makeup before the next cleansing step. It is named appropriately as it is supposed to be a pre cleanse to your cleanser. I personally enjoy balm formulas more as the product is easier to control. But if you like a oil formula, this is a very nice pick. Did not irritate my skin or eyes.

reviews.review_text: I am in love with this moisturizer! It’s bouncy cream that feels kind of like a gel is so moisturizing! reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica, I really enjoy using this physical exfoliating powder about 2-3 times a week. I feel like it helps my skin absorb my serums better and it helps my skin feel soft and refreshed after rinsing away all the buildup of skin cells and makeup.

reviews.review_text: I have always had a problem with oily skin and enlarged pores and after watching Gothamista’s YouTube video (highly recommend her for skin care!), I thought I would try this product. I have been using this product for a little over a month, in the PM after my toner, and the change in my skin is drastic. My pores have minimized and my oil levels are way more controlled!!! Such a life saving product, great value and I already have 2 as backup! The amount you get is about 2 months worth, maybe a little more depending on how much you put on (3 drops for me) so highly worth it!!!

reviews.review_text: Tried this because of trendmood box and I have to say, melts into the skin beautiful and super easy to put in your purse!

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing! The smell is gross, but after a while you get used to it and learn to deal with it since the results are better than most masks I’ve tried...and I’ve tried A LOT. I get hormonal, cystic pimples along the jawline and chin. This mask absolutely shrinks the sizes. I still love my other go to clay masks, but this is a nice cool alternative that feels so refreshing on the skin (except a slight tingle the first 2 minutes, after that it should go away) if you have sensitive skin definitely leave on for less time. I leave it on for the 20 min since I use it at night.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: Wow! I love these! What a great concept...I absolutely love the acne patches so when I received these I was so excited to try them. I saw my forehead wrinkles diminished the next morning after wearing overnight...I wish these came with more in the box because I feel like you have to use these very consistently for continued results...they were non irritating as well ...I received this for free in exchange for my honest review form PinchMe

reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this lip product... but it’s just meh. It doesn’t really hydrate my lips like I thought it would, it wears off pretty fast, and the smell is weird. I don’t typically reach for this and sometime I forget I have it.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this product! Firstly it smells amazing, when I got it and opened it up... and it just smells sooooo good. Secondly, it keeps my lips hydrated all day. I got this about a month ago and I’m almost out and definitely going to stock up soon. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: This is the first toner I’ve ever used and I’m having a great experience with it. I’ve had acne scars on my jawline for years and have tried a lot of things to lighten this. I’ve been using this toner for almost three weeks and it has significantly lightened them. There is a slight tingle when using this but it doesn’t burn and it smells great.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: By far the best moisturizer I’ve tried. It makes my skin feel soft and hydrated and, in conjunction with my cleanser, has helped the number of breakouts I have dwindle dramatically. A little really goes a long way so it will last awhile. Will definitely repurchase

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I’ve always wanted to love this product since I always see other people giving rave reviews about it. Frankly it didn’t work for my skin. It made me breakout and didn’t really moisturize my skin. I do like the aloe vera version of this but I think it’s been discontinued.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My skin used to be prone to a lot of little breakouts, and for years I was using Kiehl’s Facial Fuel Energizing Face Wash, which had done a fantastic job of helping my skin get clear and healthy. Now that I’m in more of a maintenance phase, I wanted something gentler, but still full of things to help keep my skin clear, glowy, youthful, healthy, and fresh. This herbaceous little cleansing elixir was exactly what I needed! It smells great, it’s powerful but gentle and soothing - my skin never feels stripped of oils after I’ve used it, though I always feel super clean - and I love the glass bottle it comes in. Glass packaging always makes everything feel just a little bit more luxe!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: As a darker-skinned lad - I’m Indian (South Asian) - it’s not always easy finding a sunscreen that won’t leave a white/grey/blue cast on your face and make you look like an extra in a Bollywood adaptation of The Walking Dead. THANKFULLY, this product does exactly what it says - it goes on completely invisibly! It feels great on my skin - light and easy to apply. It does give your skin a very matte/natural look, so if you prefer a more dewy/glowy finish, I’d suggest the Glowscreen, but honestly, this is like a holy grail sunscreen product.

reviews.review_text: So, first of all, I have to admit that this feels more like a serum than it does a moisturizer - it’s very liquid and lightweight, and has a light, candied scent that might be off-putting to some, but I revel in it. That said, I do find this moisturizer delightful - it absorbs beautifully into my skin, and keeps it looking healthy and glowing all day. It’s a great light moisturizer on days you don’t want something heavy - fantastic if you’re in warm California weather (like me) or warm spring/summer days anywhere else.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I switched to this moisturizer about a year and a half ago - I’m in my late 30s now, and definitely wanted something a little more preventative for my nighttiime routine. This stuff is magic. It’s light, smells incredible (and soothing!), and effortlessly sinks in to my skin. I wake up with glowing, refreshed skin!

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser! “Bounce“ is the right adjective for it - the scent, the texture, all of it is light and bouncy and beyond delicious. This is a very light cleanser and 100% a great addition to a double cleanse routine, or fantastic on it’s own (which is the way I’ve been using it for the last year. I haven’t worn a drop of make-up since the pandemic began because I’m working from home all day.) This hasn’t dried my skin out or anything, and it cleanses it perfectly so that it’s a perfect blank canvas for my night toners, serums, and creams. Honestly, this makes cleansing my face FUN, which isn’t something you’d think cleansing your face would be after a long, tiring day, but this makes me look forward to my nighttime skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: If you’re thinking of trying these I say go for it! I got the grapefruit. I am not a fan of products with strong scents and I was concerned that the scent of these wipes would be overpowering but for me it isn’t. These wipes do a pretty decent job at removing my make-up. However, it did not do much for removing waterproof mascara, hence my reason for giving 4 stars. I found the exfoliating side a bit too harsh for my skin, but if your skin can handle it then you’d probably be ok with using it. For the price I think its worth a try, I used these for a little over a month and overall had no negative effects.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample and it seemed very promising so I bought it. This started out great but didn’t end up being the moisturizer for me. I have combination skin and my t-zone is alwaaaaays oily and this did a great job at keeping the oil away and surprisingly it was also helping my dark spots to fade. However after a few weeks of using it, I noticed the oil was starting to come back and on top of that it made certain parts of my face even more dry than usual, like my cheeks and the skin under my eyebrows would become really dry and flaky and scaly (so sorry its gross, i know, but it happened!). I started applying more thinking maybe I wasn’t using enough but that didn’t make a difference at all, so I stopped using it. I did not experience any breakouts and I had no problems with the packaging or anything like that and the design of the dispenser really allowed me to stay in control of how much product I wanted to use at any given time but ... sigh. I guess my skin just wasn’t liking a few of the ingredients after a while but it has potential. If you want to try it out maybe get quite a few samples first before committing

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer may be a hit or miss depending on your skin type and the type of cleanser that you use. For me it was partially a hit. It appears to be of a thick, creamy consistency but it literally glides onto my skin when I apply it. Its scent-free and it is also non-greasy upon application which is a plus and I realized a little bit goes a long way if your skin is hydrated. I tried applying it after using a clay-based bar soap (which left my skin super tight and dry) and found that I was applying way more moisturizer as opposed to when I used a hydrating/moisturizing cleanser. I gave 4 stars because  overall my face honestly does not look super oily as it would when I tried other moisturizers. My face stays matte for the first half of the day but it tends to get a teeny-bit oily in my t-zone by the time mid-day comes around. I’ve been using it for about 2 months now and experienced no breakouts so I will keep using this until I can find my holy grail moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_title: Happy I gave this a try!
reviews.review_text: I have dark spots on my cheeks from previous breakouts and on top of that I kept getting occasional breakouts which would leave new dark marks as the other marks started fading. Just a never ending circle of annoyingness!!! I have been using this product for over two months and it has helped a lot, the breakouts are under control which is a huge relief and the dark spots are fading, not as fast as I would like them to but they are fading! My skin is brighter and the texture is also a lot smoother! I use it daily on its own and sometimes I mix it with the special cleansing gel, still performs great either way!  I decided not to use any other product for the dark spots and breakouts so I could see if this was really doing anything for my skin and I must say I’m happy with it! I recommend getting the mini version if you’re on the fence about getting it :)

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I have been searching for a lip balm with very little success until I recently came across this one! I’ve tried the lippe balm by drunk elephant, honey beeswax balm by farmacy, jack black moisture therapy balm and none of them worked for me the way this one did. This is super moisturizing compared to the others I’ve tried but it is also very glossy so if you’re not into shiny lips you probably won’t like this lol Smells great too and I also find that I’m not re-applying it as often as I would the others so that’s a plus for me!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: So I had zero hopes of this working for me... ok maybe I had a little bit of hope but it wasn’t a lot. This actually exceeded my expectations, overnight. I had two pimples both along my jawline that were obviously visible, I put one dot on each pimple, went to bed, woke up the next morning to find that the pimples had drastically reduced in size (slept for about 6-7 hours give or take). Also, removing it from my face was no hassle at all, it came off quite easily. The packaging is great too, inside the box there are 2 bags, so each sheet/strip with the dots comes in their own re-sealable bag (kinda like a mini ziploc bag) which is super convenient when it comes to storing them. It’s a yes for me! Totally worth a try!

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I really liked the consistency. It’s creamy and I noticed a difference in my skin when I Added this product. It began to lighten My dark spots and my skin was brighter. I would buy this again. I think a second bottle is needed to see a greater difference.

A little goes a long way.

reviews.review_text: Okay…. As you can see in the picture the problem with my skin was dark spot and I have very dry skin, so I used the ordinary hyaluronic acid 2% + B5 for hydration and Alpha Arbutin 2% +HA for dark spotAnd boom……… my skin started to clear up (consistency is key)

reviews.review_text: I honestly don’t like this product cause it makes your face itchy but it does work…. So what I do is I take literally the size of a pea and add an ointment to it to reduce the itchiness…… and so far there’s no issue(I blurred my eyes)

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been wanting to try the vegan milk skincare line from Milk Makeup, and it did not disappoint!! This moisturizer was plump, creamy, and very hydrating! I have pretty dry, dull, and uneven skin texture; this vegan milk moisturizer helped me fix all of it! I am very thankful to have found a moisturizer that works for my skin, and not to mention had clean ingredients! My dry skin is not longer a huge barrier for me. This is a new holy grail product in my skincare routine! I received this moisturizer complimentary from influenster for testing purposes. #Complimentary #Influenster #VeganMilkMoisturizer

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes. When I first opened the packaging for this product, I was extremely happy with how appealing the packaging was and was delighted at how beautiful I thought it would look sitting on my countertop. The packaging was just so sleek and chic. I also loved that this product is vegan and cruelty free. Upon my first use, I noticed that it had a pleasant fair smell and a nice consistency. I noticed my complexion had a subtle brightness to it and the texture of my skin felt quite soft and smooth. Overall, I was satisfied with this product!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster and Tatcha for testing purposes. I love the simple yet classic packaging of Tatcha products, so I knew I would appreciate the packaging for this serum! I am always looking to try different serums and this one exceeded my expectations! I am super picky about scents, but this has a wonderful smell to it! I was pleasantly surprised that the serum consisted of a milky like essence, which I absolutely loved! Upon use of this serum my skin felt softer and had a lovely glow to it! My skin is typically pretty dull looking, so this absolutely was such a great treat for me to receive and try out!! I love it!

reviews.review_text: Before I became a skin care junkie and knew anything about how to take care of my skin I was using an apricot scrub, I won’t say the name but we all know which one! Lol. Forever customer!

reviews.review_title: For Face, Neck, Chest, and Hands!
reviews.review_text: This night serum has raspberry extract and 12% AHA that lifts away dead skin cells. It can be used on your face, neck, chest, and back of hands. Goes on clear. Mix with Marula oil! Love the twist pump on Drunk Elephant products. Definitely pricey but the benefits are worth it.

reviews.review_text: This eye cream seems pricey but when you think of the amount of pumps you’ll get since you only need a dab for both eyes it makes sense. The cream has a cooling effect and makes your skin feel like it’s being treated even after you have gone on about your business. Can mix with your eye serums! Highly recommended.

reviews.review_text: This Fresh Rose deep hydration face cream is so  hydrating it’s insane! It literally melts into skin and gives your skin a velvety feel. I like the soft rose scent in this cream. I  have combination skin and this stuff is amazing. My skin didn’t become super oily at all after using! This is the kind of moisturizer I need morning and night! It’s amazing.

reviews.review_text: Sooo I’m not saying I’m lazy, but this two in one save me time and gets the job done. It’s a liquid form and the packaging is normal, nothing crazy. After using this product day and night for a week or so my skin became soft and hydrated without extra products.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I would say the vitamin c eye cream to brighten and depuff is different from other brighten and depuff cream due to the light tint color. It is not a color corrector it will not look like a makeup tint. The benefits of this product for me is it is 100% Vegan and it has Vitamin C & Niacinamide to help with my dark circles. Also it keeps my undereye hydrated. I love how it’s not greasy or slippery.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I wanted to try this serum because lately I’ve been having lack of sleep and added work stress. I would like to do everything possible to slow down visible signs of aging. While adding a healthy glow without the help of make up. I only been using this serum for one week. It’s a cream like serum with a tea like scent.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Dermalogica sampling and honestly I love this cleanser it is gentle and a daily exfoliant that help visibly brightens my complexion. I notice it does help with my texture, and clears pores. Also with my acne skin concerns.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Dermalogica sampling and honestly I love this cleanser it is gentle and a daily exfoliant that help visibly brightens my complexion. I notice it does help with my texture, and clears pores. Also with my acne skin concerns.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This serum was gifted by Sunday Riley to review. I am obsessed. I have not found a product that works this great. I had some dry red patches on my cheeks and even though I was using another product and it seem to be clearing away slowly, I noticed the difference in texture the first day of using. I am excited for what else it can do for my skin. You can feel how smooth it leaves the skin after one application. I also have pores in my nose that seem to start to look smaller. I will be using it longer to see the end results but so far I love it.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I received the serum complimentary from Glow recipe to review. I started using the serum in my skincare routine and I have to admit I was a little worried because it felt a little sticky in my hands.  Once I applied it it felt super lightweight and my skin easily absorbed it. Soon after my face did feel plump and my face felt hydrated for hours. Not to mention how smoothly my foundation went on. Overall this is perfect for my oily combination skin. Oh and the packaging is so cute. I highly recommend it.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: My newest obsession!!! This eye serum is so easy to use you can apply it every single night before bed on your bedtime skincare routine. It glides on really easily and is easily absorbed. Doesn’t leave you feeling oily which I love. Great product, im a huge Sunday Riley fan and this just shows quality and consistency between its products. It smells great its not irritating like other serums I have used. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for a couple of years when my face is dry during the winter times, I have oily dry combination skin but the oily is greater during the Spring and Summer. This moisturizer is amazing and works great with full coverage foundations. The whole look has a flawless finish. The packaging is amazing, I love the brand and I can never go wrong it any of its products. This is an absolute must have!!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I am so excited to be trying out this overnight mask. I love everything fresh but this has to top off all of the products I have ever used. I have weird combination skin that is dry during the winter, I get a lot of redness as well this helps with that and its soothing, hydrating, non oily and easily absorbed by the skin.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Im so excited to keep using it! Overall the days I have used it my skin around the yes feels moisturized, smoother and less creasing on my makeup. Which is always a plus! I have to see if my fine lines get smaller but anything positive is already great help. I do wish it would come in a bigger presentation.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Fresh lip sugar treatments have been my favorite so I was excited to try it in the color peony. Its super moisturizing. Its a pretty shade that is buildable. I applied it 2 times to get this color and I love it.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Absolutely amazing! I am in love I am obsessed with the packaging. It is lightweight, easily absorbed by the skin. It has a light milky finish. Leaves your skin feeling so smooth. It has become one of my top Fresh skincare product.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: This is such a great product. I have dark circles and puffiness from lack of sleep using this helps give you a hydrated and glowwy look. It goes great underneath your make up and doesn’t make your foundation crease which I love. It helps minimize the puffiness, but I am yet to see a difference with the dark circles so I will continue using it for better results.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is worth trying. Great packaging. It has a light citrusy scent not too much...just perfect. It is easily absorbed by the skin, its light, soothing. Highly recommend giving it a try. So excited to see long term results

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this lip balm since it first came out years ago in the different packaging and it still is my absolute favorite lip balm ever. I don’t have to constantly reapply and my lips stay hydrated all day!

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe to review! So first of all, I love Glow Recipe’s watermelon mask, so I knew I would love trying this one out! it’s a lightweight gel feeling texture that smells amazing like watermelon jolly ranchers. I would usually steer clear of fragrance but this one does not bother my skin type! it’s very hydrating and moisturizing, and sometimes I like to layer it with another moisturizer as sort of a hydrating serum or essence! it plays so well with makeup, and it’s light enough that it doesn’t feel heavy under makeup! I have combo/dry skin so this is def a need for oily skin and a must try essence or serum for drier skin types! Def a must try from Glow Recipe!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe for reviewing purposes. This new launch from GR is super intriguing. this is a serum that can work as a highlighter, primer, or even a glow serum. I have used it as a highlighter and love the way it makes my skin glow. as it is part of the watermelon line, love the bouncy texture and yummy scent. The bottle is shimmery and beautiful too! The niacinamide helps with oil production and the appearance of pores. Definitely a must try new launch!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by glow recipe this new ceramide serum! first of all, I love their entire avocado line. the retinol mask is a staple for me. this serum is lightweight, plays well under makeup, and does not cause breakouts for me. the serum helped me with redness and skin barrier repair without being “too much” in the mornings.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by fresh beauty this moisturizer. this is a reformulation of their original rose moisturizer. I really like this new formula for skin types leaning to the drier side. I think it smells really nice and does not make my skin oily.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: this serum was gifted by farmacy beauty. so this serum is a pretty strong acid. I only use it about 2 times a week because any more will lead to over exfoliating. if you use it correctly, your skin will look very smooth and bright. it smells like honey flowers too!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Glow Recipe sent me their newly launched Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops for review and they are exactly what you expect them to be! The serum is a light, gel texture with the scent of their watermelon line (like watermelon Jolly Ranchers)! It absorbs  into the skin beautifully and leaves you with a healthy and dewy glow! I love using it as a niacinamide serum since I am have not been wearing face makeup lately. You also wear this over makeup has a highlighting serum to keep that glow going all day long!Notable ingredients:Watermelon: rich in antioxidants and very hydratingNiacinamide: controls oil production, improves skin tone, minimizes appearance of poresHyaluronic Acid: humectant that retains moisture on the surface on your skinMoringa seed oil: vitamin-rich and supports a healthy skin barrier These ingredients work together to create a reflective glow to your complexion without the use of glitter or mica!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: *Complimentary from Sunday RileyGood Genes has been in my skincare routine for 8 months now and I LOVE IT! It smells amazing, my skin looks instantly livelier after applying it! It transforms my complexion and makes it more radiant. Over time, it smoothed out my textured skin and really gently resurfaces my skin. After having used this for 8 months, my skin is more radiant, softer and smoother.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: *I received a gift card to select a product of my choice to review.*The Dewy Serum has been on my wishlist since the launch, so I was so excited to get this opportunity to review this! This serum as the signature scent of Tatcha’s Dewy line. It has a light, gel-lotion texture and applies and absorbs beautifully. I use 2 pumps for my face and neck each morning and it leaves my skin feeling so hydrated, plump and radiant. After using this for 4 weeks, my skin is softer and more hydrated and my complexion is brighter. I wish that the packaging allowed for us to see how much product is left. It’s hard to gauge from just feeling the bottle, and I like to know when I’m running out of a product, so I am able repurchase or replace it before it’s completely empty.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: *I received a gift card to select a product of my choice to review.*I was excited to try this Retinol Eye Stick, but unfortunately, it was a little disappointing. I do like that it’s in a stick form, so it’s more hygienic. The eye stick is moisturizing, but not hydrating. I generally, like a cream around my eyes at night, so I feel like this itself is not sufficient in what I usually do for eye products. Additionally, the stick doesn’t glide easily on the skin unless the skin is slightly damp. I find that this tugs at the delicate skin around my eyes and that is not something I am fond of. I am hoping the effects of retinol and peptides are positive, but those are more preventative for me at this point.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: *Complimentary from Glow Recipe.* The Avocado Ceramide Recovery Serum is the perfect addition to Glow Recipe’s line! This is a light-weight milky texture that absorbs so well into my skin! I usually use 2-3 pumps for my face and neck. It has a light melon/cucumber scent that is very soothing! My skin isn’t usually red, but there was one night when my skin was itchy from something that must’ve brushed up against it and I put this on at night and it soothed it overnight. Redness was completely gone in the morning! Aside from redness relief, it makes my skin feel protected and hydrated. I especially love this at night to nourish and repair, but sometimes I use it in the morning too. I have another barrier repair serum that is slightly thicker and equally as nourishing. I like this lightweight one for now, as the weather gets warmer. Overall, I really like this new serum and am excited to continue using it in my skincare routines!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m a huge Sunday Riley fan, so I was so excited to hear they launched a retinol eye serum! First off, I LOVE the ceramic applicator! I usually don’t like these types of applicators that are metal because it doesn’t seem to glide on my skin very well, but this ceramic one glides with ease and the cooling effect is much more prominent than metal ones. The eye serum is a silky texture that sinks into my orbital area beautifully. It doesn’t have any distinguishable scent, which is nice. The encapsulated retinol and retinol esters are super gentle on my skin and I can use this every night without irritation. This serum makes my under eyes very hydrated and I love that the formula is balanced with ceramides, niacinamide and Centella asiatica to soothe skin and protect the moisture barrier.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: *Complimentary from Dermalogica.* This takes off all my makeup and sunscreen like a charm! The texture is super light and it doesn’t strip my skin’s moisture barrier, keeping my skin hydrated after washing this off. Win Win!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: *Complimentary from Dermalogica.* This takes off all my makeup and sunscreen like a charm! The texture is super light and it doesn’t strip my skin’s moisture barrier, keeping my skin hydrated after washing this off. Win Win!

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: *Complimentary from Sunday Riley.* I’ve used this before and this is such a great vitamin C serum! It contains THD ascorbate, so it’s a more stable and less irritating form of vitamin C. It’s great for people who can’t tolerate L-ascorbic acid. I love that this serum will not oxidize since it’s more a more stable vitamin C serum. It sinks into my skin so nicely. I’ve seen results with brightening and helping my skin look less dull. I wish the scent was a little more subtle. I am ok with fragrance in my skincare, but sometimes it can be too much.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This primer is so moisturizing! It’s creamy, nourishing and sinks into the skin beautifully. It makes my makeup go effortlessly and smoothly. It prevents my makeup from creasing on my smile lines, forehead and eye lids. The only negative aspect is that it’s heavily scented with citrus. I’m not a fan of this and it sometimes gives me a headache.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: *Complimentary from Dermalogica.* This powder to foam exfoliant is gentle and makes my face feel so smooth. You add water to it to lather it and massage it on your face like a face wash. The enzymes combined with chemical and physical exfoliation sloughs off dead skin cells, revealing smoother and more radiant skin. It’s so fun and gentle to use!

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: *Complimentary from Dermalogica.* This powder to foam exfoliant is gentle and makes my face feel so smooth. You add water to it to lather it and massage it on your face like a face wash. The enzymes combined with chemical and physical exfoliation sloughs off dead skin cells, revealing smoother and more radiant skin. It’s so fun and gentle to use!

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: These Isle of Paradise tanning drops are my FAVORITE! I’ve tried other brands before and they either don’t work at all or give me a fake, orange color. This is where IoP is different! These drops give me the mostly beautiful and natural tan. I use them on my face, arms and legs with moisturizer or body lotion. This product is so easy to use and mess-free, just remember to wash your hands well afterwards! *Complimentary from Isle of Paradise.*

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This Squalane + Omega Repair Cream is a simple and no frills moisturizer. It is not scented/ fragranced, but rather  just smells like like the “natural” ingredients. This moisturizer deeply moisturizes my skin. I love the key ingredients of squalane, fatty acids and ceramides to deeply moisturize, and protect  and maintain a healthy skin barrier. I use this at night and always wake up to such soft and radiant skin!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This Tea Elixir serum is a beautiful milky texture! It absorbs into the skin so nicely and has a fresh, pleasant, therapeutic scent to it. The APT technology combines ingredients to refine skin texture, deeply hydrate and strengthen the skin barrier. My skin felt and looked so glowy and radiant after use. I’m surprised that this serum doesn’t also claim to have antioxidant properties, since tea is a huge antioxidant.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe to me and I was so excited to use it. I heard amazing things about this moisturizer and now I know why! To start off, I have normal to oily skin which is a little acne prone. It feels super smooth when I put it on and leaves my skin glowy. It acted as a nice base to my makeup as well, which is important to me. This moisturizer is very hydrating and has a nice scent to it. I also love the packaging!!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Fresh but i will give my fully honest review. I loooove everything I have tried from this brand including this moisturizer. It’s super hydrating and feels great on my skin. I use this moisurizer at night to help replenish my skin in the morning!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this eye cream, it is definitely one of my favorites in my skin care drawer. It feels so refreshing when I apply it and it helps my dark circles/fine lines! Totally recommend- plus the packaging is so cute!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Dermalogica. I absolutely love this brand and I have been using their facial cleanser for as long as I can remember. I wanted to try using this product to takeoff my make up before washing my face and it really helped! The oils break down everything that’s on my face and it feels very hydrating!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Dermalogica. I absolutely love this brand and I have been using their facial cleanser for as long as I can remember. reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this product! My mom & I use it before our foundation and it is a great base for makeup! It isn’t too greasy like some other primers, and gives me a nice cushiony, moisturized base to put my makeup on! It makes my skin so soft! Especially during the winter when my skin starts to get dry (around my eyes mainly!!) it works so well to combat that!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this mask and everything about it! It’s so calming to my skin and I feel like it also gives my skin a nice moist barrier when I leave it on and sleep with it overnight. My skin feels really rejuvenated after!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Fresh. I really love this lip treatment and how it’s tinted! It has a great texture and is super moisturizing while not being sticky. I think it’s a great go-to lip product for sure - totally recommend.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this Murad resurgence retinol youth renewal serum complimentary few weeks ago. I have been using this for few weeks and I love that I’m seeing some results already.The first thing I noticed was it definitely made my fine lines on the forehead less visible. It also helped with my hyperpigmentation on the sides of my cheeks. I love how clear and healthy my skin looks with this product. I love using it and will recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this Murad resurgence retinol youth renewal serum complimentary few weeks ago. reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I was gifted the floral recovery calming mask by fresh. I’ve been using it for couple of weeks and I love how it leaves my skin feeling in the morning. My skin feels more evenly toned and my redness around my cheeks is reduced. I use it in the night and then I rinse it off in the morning. I love how smooth and calm my skin feels in the morning. I would highly recommend if you have sensitive skin and are looking for some thing that would help calm your skin as well as help you get even skin tone.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Glow recipe sent me their sunscreen complimentary and I can’t stop using this baby. The first thing i look at sunscreen is if it’s too greasy. I don’t like greasy sunblocks and guess what this one is not at all that way. I love the glow it leaves on your skin. I even used this under makeup and had no issues. The spf 50 makes me feel even more better. I love using this and this brand has not disappointed me ever.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I received Supergoop  best selling, hydrating makeup primer with SPF 40 that leaves a dewy, glowy finish. I love using this specially the days I know I’m going to leave the house. This doesn’t leave any cast and is so moisturizing. The makeup sits well underneath and I love that it has a tint.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love the lip treatments from fresh a lot. They are one of the best out there. These work both as a lip balm and lip mask at night. This makes your lips so smooth and hydrated. I love using it both during the day and night. I would highly recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: CLARINS double serum is not a new skincare product to me. I have been using this serum for a long time and I love the results. It’s so good that even my mom uses this religiously. It’s been helping me with my fine lines and wrinkles around the forehead. This has also helped with overall texture of my skin. I would highly recommend this serum.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Dermalogica Sampling, this exfoliator is one of my favorites. I love how clean it makes my skin feels. It’s not harsh at all. Dermalogica is one of my favorite brands for skincare. You will love it if you haven’t tried this before.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Dermalogica Sampling, this exfoliator is one of my favorites. I love how clean it makes my skin feels. It’s not harsh at all. Dermalogica is one of my favorite brands for skincare. You will love it if you haven’t tried this before.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Sooo obviously this can’t change your genetics, won’t do miracles if you don’t drink your water and get that beauty sleep but if you do what you’re supposed to do it WILL do wonders. I used it last night and this morning my husband noted how rested my face looks and my SUITCASES I’ve been carrying overnight are almost completely gone. It’s perfect price for value, you really only need one drop under each eye!

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really loved it in the first couple of weeks. My dry skin just sucks it in but after 2-3 weeks it lost it’s power and was left with a tacky silicony feel on my face. It’s a nice product but not sure if I will buy it again

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: After using Tarte Rainforest of the Sea moisturizer I wanted to look for something similar water based moisturizer for my super dry skin as the said product stopped doing its miracle for me. I got this recommended by a beauty adviser at one of your locations, gave me a generous amount to test and it was a confirmed match for me. Was lusting after it for weeks and finally gave in and bought it over the VIB sale. My face, neck and chest is as smooth now as a baby’s butt :)

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I really love The Ordinary products, personally own like 5-6 of them. This oil does help my skin to regenerate faster and make my scars fade but no matter how little I use on my face or other body parts it stains and piece of material getting in contact with my skin and really hard to get rid of the stains so be careful. Also it never fully absorbs so I only use it overnight and wash my face in the morning to make sure my skin can breathe.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I jumped in the Tatcha train and now I never want to get off. It makes my face baby smooth and follow it with a toner and moisturizer. If you have dry skin you might have to take a break after a few weeks or switch to the milder powder product from Tatcha

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I first got it as a sample and instantly grew a liking to it. Smells like bubble gums and feels nice. I apply it right before I go to bed and almost all of it absorbs by the morning leaving a super thin layer on and my lips feel soft and luscious. Ordered full size and now my husband is asking me to apply to for him too. Bye bye chapped, bleeding lips see you never

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for two years with other Ordinary products and so far never had an issue with any of them. This little gem gives me a very nice glow, put 4 drops at different parts of my face WITH my moisturizer every day before bed and my skin changed sooo much! used to struggle with very dry skin, now I’m on more on the normal side! My skin is so happy that it definitely shows, people never believe me how old I am because I have a “baby face“. Great results for very low price!

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This toner became my ride or die! I do a very thorough cleansing routine every day with my foreo and some cleansing products but still manage to miss spots here and there. This stuff makes sure to clean EVERYTHING while being a gentle exfoliator! you can use it on the daily, if you have open cuts or acne it might sting for a second or two but it passes right away. Make sure to moisturize tho or else it WILL give you dry spots on the long run

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: New favorite sunscreen of all time! I got a few deluxes is sephora favorites and I love the texture, how my skin feels, the fact it doesn’t break me out. If I do my whole skincare  routine after I use a water base moisturizer and make sure it soaked in this spf lays on my skin like butter and doesn’t peel off. Also used makeup over it and worked just fine, didn’t see any difference or sliding

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: love this cream. It feels so rich and luxurious, but it is not heavy or greasy at all. It feels velvety smooth going on, sinks in well and does a great job moisturizing. My skin feels baby soft when I use it. I don’t think I have found any cream or even serum that makes a huge difference in deeper wrinkles, but this is so moisturizing, it really does minimize the appearance of crepiness and fine wrinkles. My pores are not a big issue other than across my nose, so this does seem to even out the overall texture and make my skin look pretty flawless - most days, no makeup even. I think this has helped balance my skin moisture levels so that I have that very subtle glow, evened out the texture and pores, toned down some redness, and overall make a big improvement in my skin. KORRES carries a much larger line that is in my local Ulta, and I would love it if they expanded to line so I could try more of their products!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: First, I love the packing. It came in a super cute box and cute container that is very easy to apply. I tried it on the skin without make up and my skin radiated so much it looks visibly glowing after applying. When I applied, it was pretty quick to absorb. I love having the pump to apply because it’s not as messy on the hand and face. I also tried over makeup and it applied very well and not ruin my makeup. It’s such a easy way to make your skin look radiating and give a healthy look! I really love it! Gifted by glow recipe

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and finding good hydrating cream is always a challenge for me. So when I found this skinfix barrier+ I was so excited and it didn’t disappoint me. It sank into my dry skin perfectly and my skin feel so hydrated after I apply. I also like the radiance healthy look it gives to my skin! Highly recommended!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and finding good hydrating cream is always a challenge for me. So when I found this skinfix barrier+ I was so excited and it didn’t disappoint me. reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love how beautiful the outer container is.I have been looking for great skincare with hyaluronic avid and I was really happy when I found this face cream. I have really dry skin so hydration is very important to me. Some face creams only moisture my skin for the moment I put my face cream on and not  for too long but this one really kept my face moisture for long time. I also love how it smells! Perfect!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: While this is small, it doesn’t take much, just a Pearl sized amount everytime so it lasts pretty long. When I apply to my dry skin, it moisture and cover my fine lines. It is thick enough but not sticky after wards which I love. How the tip is designed so I can apply it directly to my face and not make a mess on my hand.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love a great cleanser and this is such a great one for me. I have dry skin and I hate when my face gets extra dry after washing my face. This never make me feel dry afterwards and I love it! I love the push pump bottle too!  Gifted by dermalogica

reviews.review_text: Loving this new product from them! I use their other products and was really excited to try out this one! It gives me great moistures and my skin feel great after applying. I love how it absorbs into the skin so quickly and make my skin feel so smooth!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Loving this new product from them! I use their other products and was really excited to try out this one! It gives me great moistures and my skin feel great after applying. I love how it absorbs into the skin so quickly and make my skin feel so smooth!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: What a great calming smell!! I am in love with the mask. Every once in a while I need a spa day at home and this is so perfect for it! You can use it everyday and feel like a spa day everyday too! I love the packaging too. Moisture my skin so well!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Perfect base for before putting my makeup on! It does perfect base job and it also work as moisturizer so I only really need to put this on then start with foundation after washing my face in the morning! Really made my prep so much easier!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I honestly can’t live without this daily exfoliate anymore. It’s just not the same as simply cleansing the face and washing with face wash foams. I always use this exfoliate in between cleansing and foam face wash and oh my gosh this is just the best thing ever! My skin feel so clean and smooth after using it. It’s seriously like no other!
