reviews.review_text: I’m in love with my new lip! It really show great buildable color which is perfect for no make up or little make up day too! It hydrates my lips perfectly and I really love the look of it! I also like the style of the case it came in too! Super cute gifted by fresh

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Fresh is one of my preferred brand whenever I’m buying my skincare products so I was really excited to try this serum out. I love it refined skin texture and look of lines are minimized after applying.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is the first Biossance product I’ve ever tried. Although I am intrigued to try cleaner and more naturally derived products, I question their potency and effectiveness for that very reason. Boy, was I pleasantly surprised. This cream feels incredibly luxurious and moisturizing with lasting effects. I apply it at night before bed and I don’t wake up with my skin feeling or even appearing dehydrated. My skin must really love Biossance’s squalane formula. I look forward to finally trying out the brand extensively! For reference, my skin is combination but can get very dry and flaky during the winter season. (I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are truly my own.)

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Glycolic Acid, hyaluronic acid, and niacinamide are three IMPORTANT ingredients for anti-aging. This serum is soo luxurious feeling and effective as it has an effective concentration of glycolic acid, which helps to chemically exfoliate the skin overnight. I LOVE this stuff.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is a cream I’ve been wanting to try for a LONG TIME. I’ve heard so many good reviews about it. I have combination skin and this cream did wonders for me but ONLY when I applied it at night. Not a good cream for me to apply during the day because I tend to get oilier as the day progresses. At night, this product leaves my skin moisturized and I wake up with supple, well-hydrated skin. I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I die for natural lip balms and although Laneige lip mask is my favorite, this one does not disappoint! Plus, this one carries far more natural and organic ingredients so I’ll be gravitating towards purchasing this one instead. You have to be ingredient-conscious, especially when it comes to lip products.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I really like this eye cream. I don’t usually get the point of eye creams cause I feel like my face cream can work just as effectively underneath the eyes, but I read about how vitamins C and E are essential for those stubborn fine lines and crows feet you get underneath the eye area so I’m willing to see how much this will help with that. It hasn’t been long enough to really show results but I do like the way it feels underneath my eyes :)

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Good cleanser for oily to combo skin.
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is very good for oily to slightly combination skin. It definitely cleanses make up and your skin does feel very clean. However it may dry out your skin. So I would not recommend it for people with normal to dry or even acne prone skin. Acne prone skin may get even dryer causing further sebum productionWhich will cause more acne. I’m not a skin care expert but this is just an inference. Otherwise this is a solid cleanser if you just want a cleanser that removes the day’s impurities off without any extra work.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is very moisturizing and emollient. Under eye creams need to have that kind of texture because the skin underneath is so delicate and is prone to become dry with fine lines and wrinkles. I took one star off for the strong fragrance as I truly don’t think any real skincare product should have fragrance cause it’s an irritant. But nonetheless, this eye cream really made my undereye skin soft and supple. Definitely will be purchasing when my tub runs out!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Amazing product! I received this beauty from Influenster and was pleasantly surprised because they also sent a mini eye-cream to review as well. The best part was that I got to experience the results of the magic of this cream, overnight!!!! Yes! The next day, my skin was plumped and so hydrated and bouncy! It made my otherwise dull skin, very happy! Recommended if you are on a fence, due to price, check out the smaller sizes. It is totally worth it! #magiccream#contest#complimentary@ctilburymakeup@influenster

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator so I can offer my honest review and I am happy to report that this product is just amazing! I was pleasantly surprised when I removed the lid and immediately got a whiff of the delicious fragrance and by taking a look at the texture of the product, I got excited to try it. What can I say about the texture? To the touch, it feels like something that you want to play with and most importantly, after application, my skin feel loved and super soft.  Per the packaging, it is to be used between 2-3 times a week so my plan is to use it in the shower because it is also suggested that you leave on for a couple of minutes so perfect to leave on while I brush my back or shave my legs.  Since I didn’t see otherwise on the instructions, I tried it on my chest on a different day and it left my skin very soft and even shiny.  Perhaps because it was removing dead cells with its combo of glycolic acid and Australian Kakadu Plum.  Adding that it is parabens and silicones free, among other great news, that is not tested on animals so definitely a plus.  I would recommend this beauty product to a friend, for sure!!!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I received from influenster this facewash from tatcha.  It is called The Rice Wash. Did not know that Japanese women preserve the water that they use to wash rice (prior to cooking it) and wash their faces and hair with it.  What a smart and useful tip!! Tatcha went and perfected the concept by adding essentials like hyaluronic acid, algae and their complex Hadasei-3.My opinion: this one is one of the best face washes I have ever tried.  I stay away from most facewashes and only use a couple that have proven to be amazing for my skin but gave this one a try and I cannot be happier with it.  It truly leaves my skin clean, not dehydrated clean, it feels soft and bright and makes me feel comfortable adding serums and other creams after I wash off the sunblock and other products that I use. It does clean and hydrate at the same time.  Giving it an A and loving that I was gifted the regular size sold at stores and not a small sample that won’t let you make a conscious review.Currently using it twice a day and loving it. #MyRiceWash #complimentary @Tatcha @influenster

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I received from influenster this facewash from tatcha.  It is called The Rice Wash. Did not know that Japanese women preserve the water that they use to wash rice (prior to cooking it) and wash their faces and hair with it.  What a smart and useful tip!! Tatcha went and perfected the concept by adding essentials like hyaluronic acid, algae and their complex Hadasei-3.My opinion: this one is one of the best face washes I have ever tried.  I stay away from most facewashes and only use a couple that have proven to be amazing for my skin but gave this one a try and I cannot be happier with it.  It truly leaves my skin clean, not dehydrated clean, it feels soft and bright and makes me feel comfortable adding serums and other creams after I wash off the sunblock and other products that I use. It does clean and hydrate at the same time.  Giving it an A and loving that I was gifted the regular size sold at stores and not a small sample that won’t let you make a conscious review.Currently using it twice a day and loving it. #MyRiceWash #complimentary @Tatcha @influenster

reviews.review_text: My skin feels so hydrated. I was experiencing some irritation and this cream really soothed my skin and it feels much softer now. Its really hydrating, I love using this in the evenings for a nice rich layer of hydration.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This creams really lives up to the hype. It was gifted by La Mer The entire experience from the scent to the texture feels so luxurious. It’s nice and rich but doesn’t feel greasy on the skin. I really need to get a bigger jar now!

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This creams really lives up to the hype. It was gifted by La Mer The entire experience from the scent to the texture feels so luxurious. It’s nice and rich but doesn’t feel greasy on the skin. I really need to get a bigger jar now!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I love how cooling this mask feels on the skin. It also calms down any redness I get from blemishes and resets my skin. I use it as a moisturizer, face mask and makeup primer. It gives your skin such a gorgeous natural glow.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I love how cooling this mask feels on the skin. It also calms down any redness I get from blemishes and resets my skin. I use it as a moisturizer, face mask and makeup primer. It gives your skin such a gorgeous natural glow.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: At first I thought this just moisturized but didn’t make a visible difference UNTIL I RAN OUT! This makes your skin a LOT clearer (I don’t have acne - i mean clear as in smooth/airbrushed), and more toned/firmed. It’s definitely something I never want to run out of again!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: First off this smells AMAZING! It moisturizes like nobody’s business but leaves no greasy residue. As a primer it’s unparalleled! You literally use half as much foundation as you would without a primer. Foundation goes on flawlessly with an airbrushed look.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: My best kept secret! Since I started using this last year my skin has been its best EVER! I got sick and didn’t use it for a week and I could definitely tell the difference! But after 2 uses my skin was back to its former glory. When FIRST using this though, it takes a while for your skin to get acclimated. But I promise you it’s worth it! You will have the smoothest, softest, clearest skin of your life! And yes it truly does zap fine lines! Absolutely, totally, completely worth the money.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Got a sample with an order and WOW!!! Not much difference immediately after use other than bright red painful skin areas lol (probably because I also use retinol) and I scrubbed pretty hard. Within an hour I started seeing a HUGE difference. I was becoming completely poreless! When I woke up the next morning the difference was INSANE. I’ve used AHAs before so I thought I had seen what they could do. Psshht... NO!!!! This stuff is unreal!!!! I immediately ordered some, but got the universal ones instead of extra strength so hopefully I won’t get red next time.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Don’t ask me how this works so well so quickly because I’ll say ITS SORCERY! It’s supposed to take 4 weeks to see results but this stuff is IMMEDIATE! 2 pumps and my skin was super smooth, soft and radiant. Even though you’re supposed to apply moisturizer on top, this serum is pretty hydrating! It smells good too. The packaging is great, looks and feels so boujee! If my skin looks this amazing after only 1 use, I can’t imagine how good it’ll look in 4 weeks!

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I love the dewy look this gives! It’s very hydrating without being heavy or oily. Looks great with or without makeup! Oh, and no harsh scent!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Initially got the sample version and fell in love. You can smell the sugar but not sure if it smells like caramel per say. This stays on for hours and hydrates me through the night, so I don’t have to keep reapplying everytime I wake up. I bought the coconut one, but had to return because the consistency was very thin in comparison to this. Loss of one star is the price and the amount you get for it

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Let me start off by saying I only have a couple dry spots on my face and my face is not rough, so if that’s what you’re looking for in a review, you may want to skip over.So I’ve tried a couple serums and this is by far THE BEST. Why? It smells absolutely amazing and definitely relaxing. I don’t need any face lotion. It’s soooo silky smooth, and isn’t tacky like others I’ve tried. It melts into your skin and doesn’t leave you oily or greasy. I put this on at night and when I wake up, my dull face does look a little brighter and pops my yellow under tones more, which I love. Every time I find this in the rewards bazaar, I snag 1 up. I put on 3 drops (or half of that little dropper), and it’s enough to cover my whole face in this. So this sample will last me several weeks. I will definitely be treating myself a little to this expensive serum this Christmas. I will get the smallest version because it lasts a while and not sure how long the bigger containers will hold up over time (smell and effectiveness wise)

reviews.review_text: Does exactly what is says! It removes ALL makeup…. Even your eye makeup. It also smells amazing… like light tropical smelling fruit. Lastly, the consistency is great and melts into your skin (like coconut oil). I have zero complaints

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Does exactly what is says! It removes ALL makeup…. Even your eye makeup. It also smells amazing… like light tropical smelling fruit. Lastly, the consistency is great and melts into your skin (like coconut oil). I have zero complaints

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: So let me start off by saying this is the first hyaluronic, AHA/BHA product I’ve used, so I don’t have anything to compare it to.I’ve been eyeballing this for sometime but the price is too steep for me to buy and not like. Sephora luckily listed this as a sample to try in their offer section, so I jumped on this immediately. After 1 use I immediately felt my face smooth and free of any tiny bumps I felt! After 2 or 3 uses (used 2x in a week) my husband said you look like you’re glowing and your face looks even. Now this could be a change in my diet, but I HIGHLY doubt it due to the fact I’ve done this diet before with no facial improvements. I’m honestly sold and will definitely buy after the 7-day samples (which I’m able to cut in half due to the consistency where I don’t have to use a lot… plus).Reasons why I love this:1. Immediate change in facial texture after one use the next day. Smoother skinAfter 2-3 uses: 2. Brighter skin3. Evening skin tone (I’ve had some discoloration in my skin which started in 2020. The sides of my face was darker than the center for some reason. This evened out my skin tone 90%). This alone is why I’m going to rebuy4. Plumper looking face (my husband noticed this)5. A little goes a long way. Love the consistency 6. Maybe very slight tingling the first or second use, but it did not burn. My skin is also not sensitive though. I also don’t use this dailyI absolutely LOVE Farmacy. I’ve tried 5 products so far, and not 1 has let me down! My eye dark circles are still very dark, so not sure if I’ll see a change or will take a longer time of usage. For reference, I’m mixed and dark caramel complexion

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I am loving this cleanser! Its effective, the scent isnt bothersome, and the texture of the formula is great. I have really sensitive skin and it didnt seem to react to my skin in a bad way which was a relief. It was slightly drying on my skin though, and when i saw the price of the full size tube i couldnt justify paying $47 knowing i would go through this fairly quickly and re-buy regularly. Great cleanser though!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Made me break out after 1 week!!!
reviews.review_text: The first few days i used this cleanser i thought it was great! My skin didnt feel dry and it looked good. But after about 4 days of using the cleanser my whole face broke out in little white heads and i have to stop using it. The breakouts are really bad and my skin is starting to get red. Such a shame, i thought it was working wonders but i guess not. i know its the cleanser because its the only thing ive changed in my routine, i also have dehydrated sensitive skin so that may be why its irritated.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: My skin is really sensitive to fragrance so i was skeptical because this has a really strong floral/lemon scent. When i did a patch test i didnt seem to have a bad reaction so i used it on my face. After applying other products on top you can barely smell it and it has a nice hydrating feeling on your skin. Ive been using it for 2 weeks and so far my skin has not reacted to the fragrance/ingredients in a negative way. Its actually a very effective toner on my dark spots! Id recommend getting a sample or the mini bottle to patch test on your skin before applying it to your whole face.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Nothing ever takes off my whole face including mascara.. UNTIL I TRIED THIS! I got it as a sample and fell in love. It smells fantastic and refreshing, like lime sorbet on a hot summer day. It loosens all your makeup with ease as you work it onto your skin. I was wearing waterproof mascara and it even took that off with very little residue left over. Its easy to wash off too, just use your routine cleanser to remove any excess residue and pat dry for a fresh flawless face! Will DEFINITELY purchase the full size when this sample runs out.

reviews.review_text: Left my undereyes feeling sticky and ended up clogging my pores long-term. This formula may be too heavy for people with sensitive skin, especially around the eyes. It did help reduce dark circles slightly but no long term payoff.

Not feeling it.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_title: Melanin pop with this subtle glow
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample. This product did what it states for me personally. I do agree that it is not a strong bronze (it may be too strong of a color for fair skin, like a fake tan), however it did make me glow! To give a reference of my skin tone, I am warm deep with golden undertone (slight yellow, I could get away with wearing neutral undertone makeup). I prefer a subtle glow, so it looks beautiful without foundation! I was worried if this would breakout my dry sensitive skin, it did not. It actually was smoothing and hydrating. I will be purchasing the full size. Although it did not break me out, I only used it for a week and a half, so I gave it 4 stars.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: There is NO COCONUT OIL?! I was game when I realized this after using the sample I got: I was sad when I ran out. I am def getting the full size! I buy my own oils because many facials oil I have researched contain coconut oil, my skin AND hair does not like coco-any-thing. The oil absorbs so quick

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical of this product because I tried A LOT of products recently and my skin rejected nearly all of them. I have always had clear smooth skin, my issue was it was always extremely DRY. Even though I had clear skin, I never had a regimen, so this year I wanted to try new things. Smh my skin hated me for it. I tried a sample of this and upon application, I did not like how it made my skin feel, felt like rubbing leather. HOWEVER, when I gave it a moment to penetrate my skin, oooh bae-beee! I have never felt my dry skin so SOFT

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: It’s good. Being that my skin is the Sahara desert, my moisture level has def increased. I do want to try other HA’s because I am not totally sure if I am sold. Although, I will purchase again since there’s no big ($$) loss or n trying it again. It did not irritate my sensitive skin, which is ALWAYS a bonus being that I never know when my skin will reject something, no matter how eco-friendly or natural it is. Def worth a try if you have not yet.

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_text: Marula oil is best for dry skin, which is what I was told by LA Beautiologist on YouTube. Now, I tried a sample before purchasing and loved it, and now I finally purchased. The bottle is bigger than I expected, it will last me quite awhile. Def repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I tried The Ordinary’s hyaluronic acid, and I liked it..but I wanted to try another brand. I finally got this after finishing up The Ordinary. The day after putting this on, my skin was irritated. I stopped using it, healed it up and returned it. The consistency & viscosity of The Inkey List is watery and sticky compared to The Ordinary; I find The Ordinary quite thick and heavier. I also noticed that my face had much more moisture and plumpness to it when I used The Ordinary. I did not like the type of dispenser/container that the Inkey List chose, I prefer a dropper (however The Ordinary needs to improve their dropper). I’m not biased, I don’t prefer one brand over the other, I am simply comparing the 2 based on my experience. I think I will go back to The Ordinary: my skin did not break out, wasn’t irritated, was much more plump, and I prefer the dropper.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: When I first bought this, it was perfection when I applied it my skin. However, as time went on I noticed that whenever I used this sunscreen after certain skin care products, it would ball up and peel off my face. “Maybe I put the sunscreen on before my skin care could dry down?“ So I waited until it dried down, that didn’t work! It would still ball up and peel off my face like soft silicone. I am very picky when it comes to sunscreens because my standard is Clarins, which I’ve been using for 5 years now. They haven’t re-launched their sunscreen due to Covid. Some may not like Clarins, but it works for me. But to get to the point my standard is Clarins, I need my sunscreen to work with whatever skin care products I choose to use. I really liked this sunscreen at first: it did not break me out, I did not irritate my sensitive, dry skin. I would still recommend it, just watch out for what products you use, it may not mesh well with them.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I love these dots they help my hormonal brakeouts so much I really do enjoy them a lot. They truly do help with those stubborn bumps.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this item complimentary from fresh and I so love it it goes on so smooth and it is truly hydrating it last all day it also calms my redness and my acne that’s acting up it truly is a miracle in a jar I look forward to trying more from this brand

reviews.review_text: This products helps me do much as I live in Fl where it’s hot and humid I love that this stays put and doesn’t move around on your face when your sweating

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I love this product so much it’s hydrating and goes great under makeup it also doesn’t have a white cast at all which I truly love as I’m darker skinned it doesn’t feel greasy or heavy

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I Received this item complimentary from dermalogica in exchange for my honest review and truly do like it it’s gentle and really cleanses and get the dead skin off I hydrating and drying you will have baby smooth skin

reviews.review_text: I suffer from really bad PIH because of post acne. This has helped with the discoloration and uneven skin tone. It’s so much better than Murad because it doesn’t contain hydronquine

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: dedicated to regime and reduce acne scars
reviews.review_text: So great on my dark cystic acne scars. Must remain consistent with a great skin regimen and add it a good moisture will see small improvements in brightness and slowly get rid of hyperpigmentation

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: great product with the sleeping mask
reviews.review_text: Love this product. Especially because it’s simple and easy. Suffer my bad PIH and dry skin. This did the trick to the losing those problems with the classic sleeping mask. I think this with the sleeping mask is a game changer. Don’t sleep on it.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this product and you can’t go wrong with it. Takes off makeup and sunscreen no problem. Often use this with my foreo and creates a lux experience and the smell is divine. It is a cult classic for a reason and will often re purchase, one thing the price for me.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: In the winter, this was my holy grail....and in the summer, it’s still working for me on days where my lips are cracked and bleeding. I’ve purchased this at least 7 months ago and my bottle is STILL half full. A little goes a long way. It fixes my dried lips in 24 hrs, isn’t cakey, and has lightened my lips into a pink from a dusky gray (which is something I wanted since sheer lip oils don’t show up on my darker lips). I would HIGHLY recommend this product for anyone who is over trying every lip balm under the sun. This stuff WORKS!!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have used this for months and haven’t seen results. I have oily skin so maybe this is for drier skin types and sensitive skin. I personally find it doesn’t absorb well for me, pills with other products if you don’t wait 5 minutes for it to dry, and just doesn’t brighten as much as I’d like. I’ve found other niacinamide that works better. If you’re on a budget though, this is very budget friendly.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This is cheap, has ingredients that you want, and WORKS. I personally don’t have dehydrated skin but this is something I’d recommend for plumper skin. It doesn’t help with wrinkles, though.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I. LOVE. THIS. Nothing has worked for my dark spots. With melanated skin I thought you would need something potent. I have tried so many vitamin C serums, exfoliants, etc. All of them break me out or make me wear sunscreen that breaks me out or makes my skin sensitive or red or bumpy....this doesn’t. This is a sun-safe dark spot corrector. Aka you don’t NEED spf with it (but obviously still wear it). And not wearing spf DOESN’T worsen your dark spots. It may be pricey but it works well for me and I’m definitely restocking when I’m out! I have oily skin and this absorbs quickly and doesn’t make my skin feel oily, clogged, or heavy. I love it!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This is the best niacinamide I have ever used. It absorbs. It doesn’t pill. It’s safe on the eyes--no watering, blurry vision, burning. It works. I use it daily in the morning and will repurchase when I’m out. I love it!

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I really like this product. It doesn’t make my skin red or dried out and it feels super clean after. It also isn’t super hard to remove when it dries, unlike some masks that leave a lot of residue. It’s not as intense as bentonite clay with ACV though. That really unclogs your pores. It just depends how clear you want your pores because ACV turns my skin beet red and puffy. :/

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: got a sample, became a fan
reviews.review_text: Got this as a sample with no expectations. Not a fan of the dewy moisturizer but wanted to try this brand’s other stuff. I have oily sensitive skin. The amount of times people have stopped to tell me how glow my skin is is insane! Thought I was pregnant lol. But nope. This is the only thing I changed. Now even my tried and true cetaphil burns my skin/eyes. This is perfect. Doesn’t strip my skin and gently exfoliates. I loooove it! And am buying the full size now lol.

I was really excited to receive Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream from Fresh as complimentary! The best thing about this cream is it smells so good and luxurious like fresh petals! Damask Rose and Hyaluronic acid is the key ingredient of this beautiful cream which makes my face so moisturized and soft every time I apply! This cream although looks thick its very light when applied, absorbs completely without sticky feel but making skin so silky soft I love it ! I would definitely buy this again from Fresh !

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: olehenriksen did it again!! This time with Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment!!I was gifted this as complimentary from influenster to try for free!I love their products from the time I used their Vitamin C Gel rush moisturizer and Truth serum and now this!It has powerful Acid blend (10% AHAs & 10% PHAs) which chemically exfoliate to help smooth skin texture Aloe Juice, Nordic Birch Sap and Cotton Water to Nourish and suppport Licorice extract to reduce the look of dark spot ! I used this product for few days and it has visibly improved my skin texture ! I love the smell of this serum it delicious citrusy which I like the only negative point about this serum is it stays sticky even after it is fully absorbed ! And also we need to stay away from sun and wear sunscreen since it has a lot of acid !

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received skinfix barrier triple lipid peptide cream complimentary from skinfix to try and review! Honestly I was looking for a peptide cream because I had some skin issues and my skin became extra sensitive because of it ! This cream is really good as it has all the peptides and it makes my skin feel healthy after using this .. I like that it does not have any smell and it gets absorbed completely and does not feel sticky ! I can even use this under makeup ! Love the jar which has a pump applicator and really convenient to use! I recommend this anyone with skin issues and also good for sensitive skin!

I can see and feel the product working its magic into my skin. I instantly feel my skin moisturized and hydrated. It barely tingles but I don’t have particularly sensitive skin so I wasn’t too surprised. I would highly recommend this product for anyone who is new into trying acids in your skincare or for your typical skincare junkies. It is abgreat product and I am excited to see the future results!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a week. Not new to the acid world by any means so I started off using it every single night. I also find this to be gentle yet effective (but I do not have sensitive skin). It is also hydrating. You can technically skip the moisturizer after this if your skin will permit. So far so good!

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I don’t quite get the confusion surrounding this product. It is marketed clearly as a toner AND moisturizer. Not OR but AND. No need to say it is one or the other... it is clearly both. If you use serums simply determine if they are lighter or heavier in consistency than this product, and apply in whichever order best suits your routine. Seems simple enough. Moving on, this product fits perfectly in my morning routine.I do not use it everyday, rather on the days I need a little extra moisture. And it does just that. Depending on the condition of my skin I may use this to replace my AM moisturizer, then follow it up with my SPF, or I use this before my AM moisturizer following that up with SPF. I use my Vitamin C serum before applying this because it is lighter in consistency. Loving this so far.
